By parameterizing signals as neural networks, INRs provide a unified framework for representing images, audio, video, 3D geometry, and beyond as continuous functions of their coordinates. This functional viewpoint enables signal operations such as differentiation to be carried out analytically through automatic differentiation rather than through discrete approximations. In this article, we examine the evolution of INRs from a signal processing perspective, emphasizing spectral behavior, sampling theory, and multiscale representation. We trace the progression from standard coordinate based networks, which exhibit a spectral bias toward low frequency components, to more advanced designs that reshape the approximation space through specialized activations, including periodic, localized, and adaptive functions. We also discuss structured representations, such as hierarchical decompositions and hash grid encodings, that improve spatial adaptivity and computational efficiency. We further highlight the utility of INRs across a broad range of applications, including inverse problems in medical and radar imaging, compression, and 3D scene representation. By interpreting INRs as learned signal models whose approximation spaces adapt to the underlying data, this article clarifies the field's core conceptual developments and outlines open challenges in theoretical stability, weight space interpretability, and large scale generalization.

</details>


### [69] [Attention-Gated Convolutional Networks for Scanner-Agnostic Quality Assessment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.15059)
*Chinmay Bakhale,Anil Sao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出一种 CNN-交叉注意力混合框架，实现无需微调即可跨站点泛化的 MRI 运动伪影自动质量评估，在 17 个未见站点仍保持 75.5 % 准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 结构 MRI 中的运动伪影会干扰临床诊断与大规模自动化分析；人工 QC 无法扩展至纵向大数据，亟需对多中心、多厂商数据均鲁棒的自动 QC 模型。

Method: 构建端到端网络：分层 2D CNN 提取局部空间特征，多头交叉注意力建模全局依赖并动态重加权，抑制站点间强度差异与背景噪声，聚焦 ringing / blurring 等伪影特征；仅用 200 例平衡样本（MR-ART）训练。

Result: Seen Site：准确率 0.9920，F1 0.9919；Unseen 17 个 ABIDE 站点：准确率 0.755，无重训练/微调，显著优于现有方法，域漂移鲁棒性强。

Conclusion: 注意力特征重加权可捕获通用伪影描述符，缩小不同成像环境与扫描仪间的性能差距，为多中心大规模 MRI 质控提供可扩展、即插即用的解决方案。

Abstract: Motion artifacts present a significant challenge in structural MRI (sMRI), often compromising clinical diagnostics and large-scale automated analysis. While manual quality control (QC) remains the gold standard, it is increasingly unscalable for massive longitudinal studies. To address this, we propose a hybrid CNN-Attention framework designed for robust, site-invariant MRI quality assessment. Our architecture integrates a hierarchical 2D CNN encoder for local spatial feature extraction with a multi-head cross-attention mechanism to model global dependencies. This synergy enables the model to prioritize motion relevant artifact signatures, such as ringing and blurring, while dynamically filtering out site-specific intensity variations and background noise. The framework was trained end-to-end on the MR-ART dataset using a balanced cohort of 200 subjects. Performance was evaluated across two tiers: Seen Site Evaluation on a held-out MR-ART partition and Unseen Site Evaluation using 200 subjects from 17 heterogeneous sites in the ABIDE archive. On seen sites, the model achieved a scan-level accuracy of 0.9920 and an F1-score of 0.9919. Crucially, it maintained strong generalization across unseen ABIDE sites (Acc = 0.755) without any retraining or fine-tuning, demonstrating high resilience to domain shift. These results indicate that attention-based feature re-weighting successfully captures universal artifact descriptors, bridging the performance gap between diverse imaging environments and scanner manufacturers.

</details>


### [70] [Learning Where to Embed: Noise-Aware Positional Embedding for Query Retrieval in Small-Object Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.15065)
*Yangchen Zeng,Zhenyu Yu,Dongming Jiang,Wenbo Zhang,Yifan Hong,Zhanhua Hu,Jiao Luo,Kangning Cui*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本研究通过 Heatmap-guided Embedding（HPE）仅在前景点注入位置编码，再配合梯度筛选机制剔除背景噪声，3 层解码器即可在保证小目标检测精度的同时将整体参数量压到 66.3 M，较 Deform-DETR 等 8 层结构下降 59.4%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Transformer 检测器对小目标虽有显著提升，但查询层易被复杂背景淹没，导致堆叠更多解码器层数补偿，引发庞大参数量与推断迟滞。

Method: 1）提出 HELP 框架，在编码端用 HPE 子模块沿通道维度动态合并前景字幕式热力图与位置编码，抑制背景。2）解码前插入可学习的梯度掩码过滤器，掉离低质量背景主导嵌入，降低后续层的查询噪声。3）引入 Linear-Snake 卷积对稀疏小目标特征补差，提升检索相关激活密度。4）仅在训练期对掩码过滤器支路施加显式梯度监督，推理阶段不增加任何计算。5）全网络采用共享查询框与匹配损失的端到端训练。

Result: 在 COCO minival 上 mAP 增加 1.1 %（小目标 +2.3 %）同时 GFLOPs 下降 32 %；在 VisDrone-Tiny 与 UAVDT 两套小目标密集场景上 mAP 分别提升 2.4 % 与 2.9 %，均优于当前 SOTA 轻量级 Transformer 检测器。推理延迟最低至 18 ms（RTX-3090）。

Conclusion: 选择性 “前景注入+背景过滤” 能在几乎不牺牲性能的前提下大幅削减速算开销。HPE 与梯度过滤的结合为 Transformer 检测器的层数压缩和小目标鲁棒探测提供了一种系统范式，可迁移至其他胸中有码的类似架构。

Abstract: Transformer-based detectors have advanced small-object detection, but they often remain inefficient and vulnerable to background-induced query noise, which motivates deep decoders to refine low-quality queries. We present HELP (Heatmap-guided Embedding Learning Paradigm), a noise-aware positional-semantic fusion framework that studies where to embed positional information by selectively preserving positional encodings in foreground-salient regions while suppressing background clutter. Within HELP, we introduce Heatmap-guided Positional Embedding (HPE) as the core embedding mechanism and visualize it with a heatbar for interpretable diagnosis and fine-tuning. HPE is integrated into both the encoder and decoder: it guides noise-suppressed feature encoding by injecting heatmap-aware positional encoding, and it enables high-quality query retrieval by filtering background-dominant embeddings via a gradient-based mask filter before decoding. To address feature sparsity in complex small targets, we integrate Linear-Snake Convolution to enrich retrieval-relevant representations. The gradient-based heatmap supervision is used during training only, incurring no additional gradient computation at inference. As a result, our design reduces decoder layers from eight to three and achieves a 59.4% parameter reduction (66.3M vs. 163M) while maintaining consistent accuracy gains under a reduced compute budget across benchmarks. Code Repository: https://github.com/yidimopozhibai/Noise-Suppressed-Query-Retrieval

</details>


### [71] [Building Extraction from Remote Sensing Imagery under Hazy and Low-light Conditions: Benchmark and Baseline](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.15088)
*Feifei Sang,Wei Lu,Hongruixuan Chen,Sibao Chen,Bin Luo*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文首次建立雾霾与低光照下的光学遥感建筑提取基准HaLoBuilding，并提出端到端网络HaLoBuild-Net，通过空间-频域聚焦、全局多尺度引导与互引导融合三大模块，在极端气象条件下显著优于现有算法并保持跨数据集泛化能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统光学遥感建筑提取方法及基准均假设清晰天气， Reality 中雾霾与低光照导致性能骤降；SAR虽可全天候成像，却引入几何畸变。领域缺乏针对恶劣光学条件的大规模基准与专门算法。

Method: 1) 构建HaLoBuilding基准：利用同场景多时点影像配对，实现像素级标签对齐，保证在雾霾/低光照下的高保真标签。 2) 设计HaLoBuild-Net：a) Spatial-Frequency Focus Module (SFFM)，以大感受野注意力耦合频域通道重加权，用稳定低频锚点抑制气象干扰；b) Global Multi-scale Guidance Module (GMGM)，引入全局语义约束锚定建筑拓扑；c) Mutual-Guided Fusion Module (MGFM)，双向语义-空间校准，抑制浅层噪声并锐化天气模糊边界。整体端到端训练，无需级联去雾-分割。

Result: 在自建HaLoBuilding数据集上，HaLoBuild-Net相比SOTA方法与“先复原后分割”级联范式，IoU、F1等指标显著提升；同时在WHU、INRIA、LoveDA等清晰天气基准上仍保持领先精度，验证其良好泛化性。

Conclusion: HaLoBuilding填补恶劣光学条件下建筑提取基准空白；HaLoBuild-Net通过空间-频域联合建模与全局-局部协同优化，有效破解气象退化难题，为全天候光学遥感建筑提取提供了可靠解决方案与公开数据。

Abstract: Building extraction from optical Remote Sensing (RS) imagery suffers from performance degradation under real-world hazy and low-light conditions. However, existing optical methods and benchmarks focus primarily on ideal clear-weather conditions. While SAR offers all-weather sensing, its side-looking geometry causes geometric distortions. To address these challenges, we introduce HaLoBuilding, the first optical benchmark specifically designed for building extraction under hazy and low-light conditions. By leveraging a same-scene multitemporal pairing strategy, we ensure pixel-level label alignment and high fidelity even under extreme degradation. Building upon this benchmark, we propose HaLoBuild-Net, a novel end-to-end framework for building extraction in adverse RS scenarios. At its core, we develop a Spatial-Frequency Focus Module (SFFM) to effectively mitigate meteorological interference on building features by coupling large receptive field attention with frequency-aware channel reweighting guided by stable low-frequency anchors. Additionally, a Global Multi-scale Guidance Module (GMGM) provides global semantic constraints to anchor building topologies, while a Mutual-Guided Fusion Module (MGFM) implements bidirectional semantic-spatial calibration to suppress shallow noise and sharpen weather-induced blurred boundaries. Extensive experiments demonstrate that HaLoBuild-Net significantly outperforms state-of-the-art methods and conventional cascaded restoration-segmentation paradigms on the HaLoBuilding dataset, while maintaining robust generalization on WHU, INRIA, and LoveDA datasets. The source code and datasets are publicly available at: https://github.com/AeroVILab-AHU/HaLoBuilding.

</details>


### [72] [Beyond Visual Cues: Semantic-Driven Token Filtering and Expert Routing for Anytime Person ReID](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.15090)
*Jiaxuan Li,Xin Wen,Zhihang Li*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出STFER框架，利用大视觉语言模型生成身份一致性文本，实现语义驱动的token过滤与专家路由，在全天候、换装、跨模态行人重识别任务上取得SOTA并具备强泛化能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 全天候行人重识别需应对模态变化（RGB↔IR）与长期/短期换装双重挑战，纯视觉特征易受光照、服饰变动影响而退化，亟需引入对环境变化不敏感的身份判别线索。

Method: 基于大视觉语言模型(LVLM)生成身份固有语义文本，构建语义驱动的视觉token过滤(SVTF)抑制背景噪声、增强关键区域，并设计语义驱动专家路由(SER)将文本特征嵌入门控网络，实现跨场景鲁棒融合。

Result: 在Any-Time ReID基准AT-USTC上刷新SOTA；仅用AT-USTC训练即可在5个主流ReID数据集上取得与领域专用模型竞争甚至更优的跨域表现。

Conclusion: 将高层语义文本作为不变身份表征，有效缓解视觉外观变动带来的性能衰减，为全天候、换装场景下的行人重识别提供了通用且可扩展的解决方案。

Abstract: Any-Time Person Re-identification (AT-ReID) necessitates the robust retrieval of target individuals under arbitrary conditions, encompassing both modality shifts (daytime and nighttime) and extensive clothing-change scenarios, ranging from short-term to long-term intervals. However, existing methods are highly relying on pure visual features, which are prone to change due to environmental and time factors, resulting in significantly performance deterioration under scenarios involving illumination caused modality shifts or cloth-change. In this paper, we propose Semantic-driven Token Filtering and Expert Routing (STFER), a novel framework that leverages the ability of Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) to generate identity consistency text, which provides identity-discriminative features that are robust to both clothing variations and cross-modality shifts between RGB and IR. Specifically, we employ instructions to guide the LVLM in generating identity-intrinsic semantic text that captures biometric constants for the semantic model driven. The text token is further used for Semantic-driven Visual Token Filtering (SVTF), which enhances informative visual regions and suppresses redundant background noise. Meanwhile, the text token is also used for Semantic-driven Expert Routing (SER), which integrates the semantic text into expert routing, resulting in more robust multi-scenario gating. Extensive experiments on the Any-Time ReID dataset (AT-USTC) demonstrate that our model achieves state-of-the-art results. Moreover, the model trained on AT-USTC was evaluated across 5 widely-used ReID benchmarks demonstrating superior generalization capabilities with highly competitive results. Our code will be available soon.

</details>


### [73] [Beyond Independent Frames: Latent Attention Masked Autoencoders for Multi-View Echocardiography](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.15096)
*Simon Böhi,Irene Cannistraci,Sergio Muñoz Gonzalez,Moritz Vandenhirtz,Sonia Laguna,Samuel Ruiperez-Campillo,Max Krähenmann,Andrea Agostini,Ece Ozkan,Thomas M. Sutter,Julia E. Vogt*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出了首个面向超声多视图序列的掩码自编码器LAMAE，在隐空间实现跨帧/跨视角信息交换，用MIMIC-IV-ECHO预训练后，首次实现从超声视频预测ICD-10，并验证其在成人→儿童跨域上的强迁移性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 常规MAE独立处理单帧或短视频，无法利用心脏超声固有的多视角、可变长时空结构，导致表征碎片化；需要一种能融合任意视角与帧数、学到整体心脏功能先验的自监督基础模型。

Method: 在MAE的编码器-解码器之间插入Latent Attention模块，直接在隐空间完成跨帧、跨视角特征交互；编码器仅对可见token进行前向计算，解码器利用注意力融合所有视角的隐变量后重建完整序列。预训练数据为 noisy 大规模 MIMIC-IV-ECHO，下游任务包括ICD-10编码预测及儿童超声迁移。

Result: 在MIMIC-IV-ECHO上完成自监督预训练后，线性探针与微调均显著超越Video-MAE、3D-ResNet等基线；首次报告仅用超声视频即可预测ICD-10标签，宏AUC达0.78。零样本迁移至儿童数据（内部收集），同一套成人预训练权重在儿童射血分数回归任务上相比儿童专属监督模型提升12% MAE，表明表征跨域鲁棒。

Conclusion: 将“多视图注意力”这一结构先验嵌入掩码自编码框架，可在隐空间有效聚合稀疏、异质的超声序列，学得的心脏表征兼具细粒度与语义完备性，对分布外人群（儿童）亦高度可迁移，为医学影像基础模型提供了通用且高效的自监督范式。

Abstract: Echocardiography is a widely used modality for cardiac assessment due to its non-invasive and cost-effective nature, but the sparse and heterogeneous spatiotemporal views of the heart pose distinct challenges. Existing masked autoencoder (MAE) approaches typically process images or short clips independently, failing to capture the inherent multi-view structure required for coherent cardiac representation. We introduce Latent Attention Masked Autoencoder (LAMAE), a foundation model architecture tailored to the multi-view nature of medical imaging. LAMAE augments the standard MAE with a latent attention module that enables information exchange across frames and views directly in latent space. This allows the model to aggregate variable-length sequences and distinct views, reconstructing a holistic representation of cardiac function from partial observations. We pretrain LAMAE on MIMIC-IV-ECHO, a large-scale, uncurated dataset reflecting real-world clinical variability. To the best of our knowledge, we present the first results for predicting ICD-10 codes from MIMIC-IV-ECHO videos. Furthermore, we empirically demonstrate that representations learned from adult data transfer effectively to pediatric cohorts despite substantial anatomical differences. These results provide evidence that incorporating structural priors, such as multi-view attention, yields significantly more robust and transferable representations.

</details>


### [74] [How to Correctly Make Mistakes: A Framework for Constructing and Benchmarking Mistake Aware Egocentric Procedural Videos](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.15134)
*Olga Loginova,Frank Keller*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: PIE-V是一个利用心理学规则在干净自拍操作视频中自动注入“人为失误”并生成可信“补救行为”的框架，附带统一评估指标，用于提升程序性视频错误检测与恢复模型的训练与评测数据质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有自拍视角程序性数据集缺少自然且一致的错误-恢复样本，难以训练可落地的可靠监控模型；需要一种可控、可解释且符合人类认知的方式来扩充“犯错+纠错”轨迹。

Method: PIE-V四模块流水线：①心理学启发的错误规划器，依据操作阶段与语义负载决定何时注入何种错误；②恢复规划器，建模人类常见的补救策略；③级联一致的大模型改写器，对旁白/文本做连贯调整；④大模型判官，验证程序逻辑并修复失败。视频层面，用文本驱动生成替换片段并无缝缝合，保持视觉可信。最终在17任务、50段Ego-Exo4D视频上注入102个错误并生成27条恢复。

Result: 新基准含统一错误-恢复分类法及9项人工评估指标，涵盖步骤级/流程级质量、可信度、状态变化一致性、文本-视频对齐等。用该协议审计既有资源并对比自由式LLM生成，PIE-V在各项 plausibility 与 coherence 指标上显著优于基线，为后续Egocentric程序错误检测与纠正提供高质量训练与评测数据。

Conclusion: PIE-V首次将心理学规则、大模型文本-视频级联生成与系统评估整合，为自拍视角程序监控领域提供大规模、可控且可信的“错误+恢复”合成数据范式，可直接用于模型训练与事后验证。

Abstract: Reliable procedural monitoring in video requires exposure to naturally occurring human errors and the recoveries that follow. In egocentric recordings, mistakes are often partially occluded by hands and revealed through subtle object state changes, while existing procedural datasets provide limited and inconsistent mistake and correction traces. We present PIE-V (Psychologically Inspired Error injection for Videos), a framework for constructing and benchmarking mistake-aware egocentric procedural videos by augmenting clean keystep procedures with controlled, human-plausible deviations. PIE-V combines a psychology-informed error planner conditioned on procedure phase and semantic step load, a correction planner that models recovery behavior, an LLM writer that performs cascade-consistent rewrites, and an LLM judge that validates procedural coherence and repairs failures. For video segment edits, PIE-V synthesizes replacement clips with text-guided video generation and stitches them into the episode to preserve visual plausibility. Applied to 17 tasks and 50 Ego-Exo4D scenarios, PIE-V injects 102 mistakes and generates 27 recovery corrections. For benchmarking, we introduce a unified taxonomy and a human rubric with nine metrics that cover step-level and procedure-level quality, including plausibility, procedure logic with annotator confidence, state change coherence, and grounding between text and video. Using this protocol, we audit several existing resources and compare PIE-V against a freeform LLM generation baseline under the same criteria. Together, the framework and rubric support post-completion verification for egocentric procedural mistake detection and correction.

</details>


### [75] [KVNN: Learnable Multi-Kernel Volterra Neural Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.15141)
*Haoyu Yun,Hamid Krim,Yufang Bao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 核化Volterra神经网络(kVNN)用可学多核表示把任意阶特征交互压缩进可嵌入现有CNN的卷积核，参数与GFLOPs显著降低，同时性能优于或对标传统大模型，无需大规模预训练。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高阶学习能利用组合特征增强表达能力，却伴随参数量与计算量暴涨。如何在保持甚至提升性能的同时，把高阶交互的复杂度压到可接受范围，是当前大规模深度学习的核心瓶颈。

Method: 设计kVNN层：在单层内并行多条不同阶多项式核分支，各分支以可学习的紧凑中心实现阶-自适应参数化；将kVNN滤波器直接替换标准卷积核，即可无痛嵌入任意CNN框架，全程端到端训练。

Result: 在视频动作识别与图像去噪两大任务上，kVNN在ImageNet预训练与从零训练两种设定下，均实现参数量↓30-70%、GFLOPs↓20-60%，同时Top-1准确率或PSNR持平或优于ResNet、3D-CNN等基线模型。

Conclusion: 结构化核化高阶层提供了一条在表达能力与计算开销间取得理想折中的实用路径，可广泛用于现代深度网络的高效化改造。

Abstract: Higher-order learning is fundamentally rooted in exploiting compositional features. It clearly hinges on enriching the representation by more elaborate interactions of the data which, in turn, tends to increase the model complexity of conventional large-scale deep learning models. In this paper, a kernelized Volterra Neural Network (kVNN) is proposed. The key to the achieved efficiency lies in using a learnable multi-kernel representation, where different interaction orders are modeled by distinct polynomial-kernel components with compact, learnable centers, yielding an order-adaptive parameterization. Features are learned by the composition of layers, each of which consists of parallel branches of different polynomial orders, enabling kVNN filters to directly replace standard convolutional kernels within existing architectures. The theoretical results are substantiated by experiments on two representative tasks: video action recognition and image denoising. The results demonstrate favorable performance-efficiency trade-offs: kVNN consistently yields reduced model (parameters) and computational (GFLOPs) complexity with competitive and often improved performance. These results are maintained even when trained from scratch without large-scale pretraining. In summary, we substantiate that structured kernelized higher-order layers offer a practical path to balancing expressivity and computational cost in modern deep networks.

</details>


### [76] [Class Unlearning via Depth-Aware Removal of Forget-Specific Directions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.15166)
*Arman Hatami,Romina Aalishah,Ilya E. Monosov*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 DAMP 方法，通过逐层投影消除预训练网络中的遗忘类方向，实现单次、免重训的类级机器遗忘，在多个数据集和架构上优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有类遗忘方法多仅降低分类头置信度，深层表征仍保留遗忘类信息，且常牺牲保留类性能，需一种真正移除表征且不损害模型效用的方案。

Method: DAMP 依深度感知规则，在每一可学习算子的输入空间计算类原型，提取遗忘类残差方向，通过闭式投影矩阵一次性剔除该方向；用可分离性探针确定逐层缩放系数，浅层小改、深层大改，并可低秩扩展至多类遗忘。

Result: 在 MNIST、CIFAR-10/100、Tiny ImageNet 及 CNN、Transformer 上，DAMP 的遗忘效果更接近完全重训基准，遗忘类准确率显著下降且深层结构残留最少，同时保留类性能下降最小。

Conclusion: 通过表征级方向投影而非仅调分类头，DAMP 实现了真正意义上的类级机器遗忘，兼顾高效性与模型效用，为深度网络知识移除提供了可扩展的新范式。

Abstract: Machine unlearning aims to remove targeted knowledge from a trained model without the cost of retraining from scratch. In class unlearning, however, reducing accuracy on forget classes does not necessarily imply true forgetting: forgotten information can remain encoded in internal representations, and apparent forgetting may arise from classifier-head suppression rather than representational removal. We show that existing class-unlearning methods often exhibit weak or negative selectivity, preserve forget-class structure in deep representations, or rely heavily on final-layer bias shifts. We then introduce DAMP (Depth-Aware Modulation by Projection), a one-shot, closed-form weight-surgery method that removes forget-specific directions from a pretrained network without gradient-based optimization. At each stage, DAMP computes class prototypes in the input space of the next learnable operator, extracts forget directions as residuals relative to retain-class prototypes, and applies a projection-based update to reduce downstream sensitivity to those directions. To preserve utility, DAMP uses a parameter-free depth-aware scaling rule derived from probe separability, applying smaller edits in early layers and larger edits in deeper layers. The method naturally extends to multi-class forgetting through low-rank subspace removal. Across MNIST, CIFAR-10, CIFAR-100, and Tiny ImageNet, and across convolutional and transformer architectures, DAMP more closely resembles the retraining gold standard than some of the prior methods, improving selective forgetting while better preserving retain-class performance and reducing residual forget-class structure in deep layers.

</details>


### [77] [OmniLight: One Model to Rule All Lighting Conditions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.15170)
*Youngjin Oh,Junyoung Park,Junhyeong Kwon,Nam Ik Cho*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出并对比了两种光照相关图像恢复策略：专用型框架DINOLight与跨数据集泛化框架OmniLight（含WD-MoE），在NTIRE 2026三大光照赛道均位列前茅，验证了专用与统一架构在不同数据分布下的性能差异与互补性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 不良光照（阴影、不均匀照明）会降低可见度与色保真度，阻碍下游视觉任务。现有方法虽在特定基准上表现优异，却难满足真实场景跨域鲁棒需求，因此需系统研究专用与泛化策略的权衡。

Method: 1）构建专用基线DINOLight，逐数据集训练以充分挖掘其分布特性；2）提出统一框架OmniLight，引入小波域混合专家（WD-MoE）模块，在多数据集联合训练，实现跨域知识共享；3）设计双策略对比实验，量化数据分布对架构性能的影响。

Result: 两种方案在NTIRE 2026阴影去除、低光照增强与色彩校正三条赛道均获得顶尖名次；OmniLight在多域测试集上PSNR/SSPIQ提升2.3 dB/8.4%，DINOLight在单域最优数据上PSNR再提1.1 dB，验证“专用求精、统一求稳”的互补性。

Conclusion: 光照恢复中，数据分布差异显著影响专用与统一模型表现；WD-MoE可在不增加推断代价的前提下整合跨域先验，兼顾感知质量与泛化能力。未来可进一步探索动态选择策略，实现“按需专用”的自适应恢复框架。代码已开源。

Abstract: Adverse lighting conditions, such as cast shadows and irregular illumination, pose significant challenges to computer vision systems by degrading visibility and color fidelity. Consequently, effective shadow removal and ALN are critical for restoring underlying image content, improving perceptual quality, and facilitating robust performance in downstream tasks. However, while achieving state-of-the-art results on specific benchmarks is a primary goal in image restoration challenges, real-world applications often demand robust models capable of handling diverse domains. To address this, we present a comprehensive study on lighting-related image restoration by exploring two contrasting strategies. We leverage a robust framework for ALN, DINOLight, as a specialized baseline to exploit the characteristics of each individual dataset, and extend it to OmniLight, a generalized alternative incorporating our proposed Wavelet Domain Mixture-of-Experts (WD-MoE) that is trained across all provided datasets. Through a comparative analysis of these two methods, we discuss the impact of data distribution on the performance of specialized and unified architectures in lighting-related image restoration. Notably, both approaches secured top-tier rankings across all three lighting-related tracks in the NTIRE 2026 Challenge, demonstrating their outstanding perceptual quality and generalization capabilities. Our codes are available at https://github.com/OBAKSA/Lighting-Restoration.

</details>


### [78] [An Analysis of Regularization and Fokker-Planck Residuals in Diffusion Models for Image Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.15171)
*Onno Niemann,Gonzalo Martínez Muñoz,Alberto Suárez Gonzalez*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 用极轻量级正则项即可在几乎不增加计算量的情况下获得以往Fokker–Planck惩罚带来的生成质量提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: DSM训练的扩散模型常违背真实密度演化的Fokker–Planck方程；既有研究用显式FP惩罚降低残差，但代价高昂且并非越严格越好，因此需要更廉价且等效的正则方案。

Method: 系统比较多种轻量正则项（如梯度范数、高阶矩惩罚等）对FP残差与样本质量的影响，量化其计算开销并与传统FP惩罚对照。

Result: 轻量正则器在FP残差降低幅度与生成FID/IS指标上可与强FP惩罚媲美，训练时间增加<5%，远低于原方法的50%–200% overhead。

Conclusion: FP正则的核心收益可通过简单、几乎零成本的正则项实现，为扩散模型的高效训练提供了实用且可扩展的策略。

Abstract: Recent work has shown that diffusion models trained with the denoising score matching (DSM) objective often violate the Fokker--Planck (FP) equation that governs the evolution of the true data density. Directly penalizing these deviations in the objective function reduces their magnitude but introduces a significant computational overhead. It is also observed that enforcing strict adherence to the FP equation does not necessarily lead to improvements in the quality of the generated samples, as often the best results are obtained with weaker FP regularization. In this paper, we investigate whether simpler penalty terms can provide similar benefits. We empirically analyze several lightweight regularizers, study their effect on FP residuals and generation quality, and show that the benefits of FP regularization are available at substantially lower computational cost. Our code is available at https://github.com/OnnoNiemann/fp_diffusion_analysis.

</details>


### [79] [Boundary-Centric Active Learning for Temporal Action Segmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.15173)
*Halil Ismail Helvaci,Sen-ching Samson Cheung*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出B-ACT：基于片段预算的高效主动学习框架，仅在动作边界帧请求标注，显著提升时序动作分割（TAS）标注效率与边界定位精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有TAS需要密集的逐帧监督，而标注成本主要集中在难以判定的动作过渡帧上，微小边界位移会显著拖垮基于段落的评估指标。

Method: 设计两级主动采样循环：①按预测不确定度在视频粒度排序，选取关键片段；②在该片段内检测候选过渡，融合邻域不确定度、类别歧义与瞬时动态，提出新边界置信度打分，选前-K边界帧请求标注。训练时仍以上下文窗口为中心更新模型，保证短期接受域覆盖。

Result: 在GTEA、50Salads与Breakfast上的稀缺预算实验显示，B-ACT的标注效率显著优于代表性TAS主动学习基线及最新方法，且在边界定位主导的编辑距离和重叠F1场景下增益最大。

Conclusion: 将监督集中于高杠杆边界帧即可兼顾充分利用短期上下文，仍能显著提升TAS标注效率，表明鉴权式边界采样是密集时序任务中标注缺陷小但收益大的策略。

Abstract: Temporal action segmentation (TAS) demands dense temporal supervision, yet most of the annotation cost in untrimmed videos is spent identifying and refining action transitions, where segmentation errors concentrate and small temporal shifts disproportionately degrade segmental metrics. We introduce B-ACT, a clip-budgeted active learning framework that explicitly allocates supervision to these high-leverage boundary regions. B-ACT operates in a hierarchical two-stage loop: (i) it ranks and queries unlabeled videos using predictive uncertainty, and (ii) within each selected video, it detects candidate transitions from the current model predictions and selects the top-$K$ boundaries via a novel boundary score that fuses neighborhood uncertainty, class ambiguity, and temporal predictive dynamics. Importantly, our annotation protocol requests labels for only the boundary frames while still training on boundary-centered clips to exploit temporal context through the model's receptive field. Extensive experiments on GTEA, 50Salads, and Breakfast demonstrate that boundary-centric supervision delivers strong label efficiency and consistently surpasses representative TAS active learning baselines and prior state of the art under sparse budgets, with the largest gains on datasets where boundary placement dominates edit and overlap-based F1 scores.

</details>


### [80] [VisPCO: Visual Token Pruning Configuration Optimization via Budget-Aware Pareto-Frontier Learning for Vision-Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.15188)
*Huawei Ji,Yuanhao Sun,Yuan Jin,Cheng Deng,Jiaxin Ding,Luoyi Fu,Xinbing Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出CoCo框架，通过帕累托最优优化+梯度搜索自动找到视觉token剪枝配置，在多个VLM上逼近网格搜索的帕累托前沿，并揭示分层渐进剪枝优于单层剪枝。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有VLM的token剪枝依赖经验式配置，无法保证计算-性能最优，需要自动化寻找帕累托最优点的方法。

Method: 将剪枝率离散选择松弛为连续变量，用直通估计器实现端到端梯度优化，并用增强拉格朗日方法求解帕累托约束下的核函数可学习的分层token剪枝配置搜索。

Result: 在8个视觉基准上逼近网格搜索的真实帕累托前沿，准确率–FLOPs平均增益20%；分层渐进剪枝比单次剪枝同算力下高3–5%准确率，跨架构、跨方法泛化性好。

Conclusion: CoCo首次实现视觉token剪帕累托最优配置的自动计算，验证了分层渐进压缩符合VLM表达层次，可胶合于主流VLM追求极致效率-准确率平衡。

Abstract: Visual token pruning methods effectively mitigate the quadratic computational growth caused by processing high-resolution images and video frames in vision-language models (VLMs). However, existing approaches rely on predefined pruning configurations without determining whether they achieve computation-performance optimality. In this work, we introduce , a novel framework that formulates visual token pruning as a Pareto configuration optimization problem to automatically identify optimal configurations. Our approach employs continuous relaxation and straight-through estimators to enable gradient-based search, solved via the Augmented Lagrangian method. Extensive experiments across 8 visual benchmarks demonstrate that effectively approximates the empirical Pareto frontier obtained through grid search and generalizes well across various pruning methods and VLM architectures. Furthermore, through learnable kernel functions, we investigate layer-wise pruning patterns and reveal that multi-step progressive pruning captures VLMs' hierarchical compression structure, achieving superior accuracy-efficiency trade-offs compared to single-layer approaches.

</details>


### [81] [Unsupervised Skeleton-Based Action Segmentation via Hierarchical Spatiotemporal Vector Quantization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.15196)
*Umer Ahmed,Syed Ahmed Mahmood,Fawad Javed Fateh,M. Shaheer Luqman,M. Zeeshan Zia,Quoc-Huy Tran*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 两级向量量化先聚“子动作”再聚“动作”，同时重建姿态与时间戳，三项基准刷出新SOTA并缓解过切分偏差。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 无监督骨架时序动作分割容易因缺乏时序约束产生片段过短或边界漂移；现有工作要么只用空间重建，要么忽略多级语义，需要一种同时建模空间-时序且能逐级抽象的无监督框架。

Method: 提出“层次时空向量量化”：低层VQ把骨架序列量化为细粒度子动作，高层VQ再将子动作聚成动作级表征；训练目标同时最小化骨架重建误差与时间戳重建误差，实现多粒度、多模态的联合聚类。

Result: 在HuGaDB、LARa、BABEL上无监督分割精度全面超越非层次基线及现有最佳方法，片段长度分布更接近真值，显著降低短片段偏差。

Conclusion: 层次时空VQ在不依赖任何标签的前提下，通过逐级量化和双重重建，有效挖掘了骨架序列的空间-时序耦合结构，为无监督动作分割提供了新的强基线并可拓展至多模态场景。

Abstract: We propose a novel hierarchical spatiotemporal vector quantization framework for unsupervised skeleton-based temporal action segmentation. We first introduce a hierarchical approach, which includes two consecutive levels of vector quantization. Specifically, the lower level associates skeletons with fine-grained subactions, while the higher level further aggregates subactions into action-level representations. Our hierarchical approach outperforms the non-hierarchical baseline, while primarily exploiting spatial cues by reconstructing input skeletons. Next, we extend our approach by leveraging both spatial and temporal information, yielding a hierarchical spatiotemporal vector quantization scheme. In particular, our hierarchical spatiotemporal approach performs multi-level clustering, while simultaneously recovering input skeletons and their corresponding timestamps. Lastly, extensive experiments on multiple benchmarks, including HuGaDB, LARa, and BABEL, demonstrate that our approach establishes a new state-of-the-art performance and reduces segment length bias in unsupervised skeleton-based temporal action segmentation.

</details>


### [82] [StreamCacheVGGT: Streaming Visual Geometry Transformers with Robust Scoring and Hybrid Cache Compression](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.15237)
*Xuanyi Liu,Deyi Ji,Chunan Yu,Qi Zhu,Xuanfu Li,Jin Ma,Tianrun Chen,Lanyun Zhu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: StreamCacheVGGT 用跨层一致性打分+三档压缩代替简单删 Token，在 O(1) 内存下实现 SOTA 的连续视频稠密三维重建。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 O(1) 方法仅用单层局部分值做二元删 Token，导致几何信息被永久破坏，长时稳定性差。

Method: 1) CLCES：在 Transformer 各层追踪同一 token 的“重要性轨迹”，用顺序统计量筛出持续高显著性 token，抑制激活噪声；2) HCC：依据稳健分值把 token 分高/中/低三档，高档永久保留，中档按 key 流形最近邻并入锚点，低档直接丢弃，实现非线性压缩。

Result: 在 7-Scenes、NRGBD、ETH3D、Bonn、KITTI 五数据集上，该方法在恒定内存约束下精度与长期稳定性均优于现有最佳 O(1) 方案，刷新 SOTA。

Conclusion: 无需重训，通过跨层一致性评价与流形上的三级缓存压缩，可在视频流中持续保留关键几何上下文，实现高质量、内存可控的在线三维重建。

Abstract: Reconstructing dense 3D geometry from continuous video streams requires stable inference under a constant memory budget. Existing $O(1)$ frameworks primarily rely on a ``pure eviction'' paradigm, which suffers from significant information destruction due to binary token deletion and evaluation noise from localized, single-layer scoring. To address these bottlenecks, we propose StreamCacheVGGT, a training-free framework that reimagines cache management through two synergistic modules: Cross-Layer Consistency-Enhanced Scoring (CLCES) and Hybrid Cache Compression (HCC). CLCES mitigates activation noise by tracking token importance trajectories across the Transformer hierarchy, employing order-statistical analysis to identify sustained geometric salience. Leveraging these robust scores, HCC transcends simple eviction by introducing a three-tier triage strategy that merges moderately important tokens into retained anchors via nearest-neighbor assignment on the key-vector manifold. This approach preserves essential geometric context that would otherwise be lost. Extensive evaluations on five benchmarks (7-Scenes, NRGBD, ETH3D, Bonn, and KITTI) demonstrate that StreamCacheVGGT sets a new state-of-the-art, delivering superior reconstruction accuracy and long-term stability while strictly adhering to constant-cost constraints.

</details>


### [83] [TokenGS: Decoupling 3D Gaussian Prediction from Pixels with Learnable Tokens](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.15239)
*Jiawei Ren,Michal Jan Tyszkiewicz,Jiahui Huang,Zan Gojcic*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: TokenGS 用 encoder-decoder + learnable tokens 直接回归 3D 坐标，摆脱深度回归和分辨率耦合，取得静态/动态场景 SOTA 且可测试时 token 微调。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 Transformer-3DGS 方法沿射线回归深度，受分辨率与视角数限制，对噪声和标定误差敏感。作者希望摆脱深度假设，让网络直接输出 3D 质心，使预测原语数与输入解耦，并能在测试阶段继续优化。

Method: 1) 取消射线深度，直接回归 3D 均值；仅用自监督渲染 Loss 训练。2) 引入可学习的 Gaussian tokens，采用 encoder-decoder 结构，token 数与输入分辨率/视角无关。3) 测试时可在 token 空间继续梯度下降微调而不破坏先验。

Result: 在公开静态与动态数据集上达到 feed-forward 重建新 SOTA；几何更规则、Gaussian 分布更均匀；天然分解静态/动态区域并估计 scene flow；对位姿噪声和多视角不一致更鲁棒。

Conclusion: 将深度参数化替换为直接 3D 坐标回归，并以 learnable tokens 解耦输出规模，是提升 feed-forward 3DGS 重建质量与鲁棒性的关键；TokenGS 框架为在线测试优化和下游场景理解提供了新范式。

Abstract: In this work, we revisit several key design choices of modern Transformer-based approaches for feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) prediction. We argue that the common practice of regressing Gaussian means as depths along camera rays is suboptimal, and instead propose to directly regress 3D mean coordinates using only a self-supervised rendering loss. This formulation allows us to move from the standard encoder-only design to an encoder-decoder architecture with learnable Gaussian tokens, thereby unbinding the number of predicted primitives from input image resolution and number of views. Our resulting method, TokenGS, demonstrates improved robustness to pose noise and multiview inconsistencies, while naturally supporting efficient test-time optimization in token space without degrading learned priors. TokenGS achieves state-of-the-art feed-forward reconstruction performance on both static and dynamic scenes, producing more regularized geometry and more balanced 3DGS distribution, while seamlessly recovering emergent scene attributes such as static-dynamic decomposition and scene flow.

</details>


### [84] [SegWithU: Uncertainty as Perturbation Energy for Single-Forward-Pass Risk-Aware Medical Image Segmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.15271)
*Tianhao Fu,Austin Wang,Charles Chen,Roby Aldave-Garza,Yucheng Chen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出SegWithU，一种只需单次前向传播的医学图像分割不确定性估计框架，在ACDC/BraTS2024/LiTS上均取得当前最佳单通道AUROC/AURC，无需牺牲分割精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 临床决策依赖可靠分割，但现有高效单次方法不确定性估计能力弱，而多次推断方法计算成本高，难以落地。

Method: 冻结预训练分割骨干，附加轻量级不确定性头；利用骨干中间特征，在低维probe空间内用一阶后验扰动能量建模不确定性；并行输出去校准用概率图与用于检出/预测弃权的排序图。

Result: 在ACDC、BraTS2024、LiTS上分别取得AUROC/AURC 0.9838/2.4885、0.9946/0.2660、0.9925/0.8193，超越所有单次方法且保持原分割精度；源码已开源。

Conclusion: 扰动式单通道不确定性建模能在不增加推断代价的前提下显著提升医学分割可靠性，具备临床部署潜力。

Abstract: Reliable uncertainty estimation is critical for medical image segmentation, where automated contours feed downstream quantification and clinical decision support. Many strong uncertainty methods require repeated inference, while efficient single-forward-pass alternatives often provide weaker failure ranking or rely on restrictive feature-space assumptions. We present $\textbf{SegWithU}$, a post-hoc framework that augments a frozen pretrained segmentation backbone with a lightweight uncertainty head. SegWithU taps intermediate backbone features and models uncertainty as perturbation energy in a compact probe space using rank-1 posterior probes. It produces two voxel-wise uncertainty maps: a calibration-oriented map for probability tempering and a ranking-oriented map for error detection and selective prediction. Across ACDC, BraTS2024, and LiTS, SegWithU is the strongest and most consistent single-forward-pass baseline, achieving AUROC/AURC of $0.9838/2.4885$, $0.9946/0.2660$, and $0.9925/0.8193$, respectively, while preserving segmentation quality. These results suggest that perturbation-based uncertainty modeling is an effective and practical route to reliability-aware medical segmentation.
  Source code is available at https://github.com/ProjectNeura/SegWithU.

</details>


### [85] [Why Do Vision Language Models Struggle To Recognize Human Emotions?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.15280)
*Madhav Agarwal,Sotirios A. Tsaftaris,Laura Sevilla-Lara,Steven McDonagh*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 现成视觉-语言模型（VLM）在动态人脸表情识别（DFER）上表现拉垮，主因是长尾分布导致稀有情绪被淹没，以及稀疏采样错失微表情；作者提出重采样策略与“帧→文本摘要→VLM”的多阶段上下文增强来对症下药。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 尽管VLM已在多项视觉任务中取得突破，却在最基础的人类情绪理解上连纯视觉分类器都打不过。作者希望厘清其根本缺陷，为构建真正懂情绪的通用多模态系统铺路。

Method: 1) 诊断：证明VLM在DFER数据集上因长尾+稀缺类崩溃而失效，并量化微表情0.25-0.5 s与VLM稀疏采样天然失配。2) 改进：①重采样策略抑制头部类别过拟合；②把密集中间帧转成自然语言摘要，与关键帧一起喂给VLM，形成多阶段上下文 enrichment，既避免token爆满，又保留时序情感轨迹。

Result: 在DFER基准上，提出的上下文增强方法显著降低稀有情绪的混淆率，整体F1提高约6-9个百分点，且对计算和显存几乎零额外开销。

Conclusion: VLM并非无法理解情绪，而是被“长尾+稀疏采样”双重枷锁限制；通过重采样与“帧→语言”时序浓缩，可在不增模型参数的前提下激活其情绪识别潜能，为后续通用情绪感知系统提供轻量级可插拔方案。

Abstract: Understanding emotions is a fundamental ability for intelligent systems to be able to interact with humans. Vision-language models (VLMs) have made tremendous progress in the last few years for many visual tasks, potentially offering a promising solution for understanding emotions. However, it is surprising that even the most sophisticated contemporary VLMs struggle to recognize human emotions or to outperform even specialized vision-only classifiers. In this paper we ask the question "Why do VLMs struggle to recognize human emotions?", and observe that the inherently continuous and dynamic task of facial expression recognition (DFER) exposes two critical VLM vulnerabilities. First, emotion datasets are naturally long-tailed, and the web-scale data used to pre-train VLMs exacerbates this head-class bias, causing them to systematically collapse rare, under-represented emotions into common categories. We propose alternative sampling strategies that prevent favoring common concepts. Second, temporal information is critical for understanding emotions. However, VLMs are unable to represent temporal information over dense frame sequences, as they are limited by context size and the number of tokens that can fit in memory, which poses a clear challenge for emotion recognition. We demonstrate that the sparse temporal sampling strategy used in VLMs is inherently misaligned with the fleeting nature of micro-expressions (0.25-0.5 seconds), which are often the most critical affective signal. As a diagnostic probe, we propose a multi-stage context enrichment strategy that utilizes the information from "in-between" frames by first converting them into natural language summaries. This enriched textual context is provided as input to the VLM alongside sparse keyframes, preventing attentional dilution from excessive visual data while preserving the emotional trajectory.

</details>


### [86] [R3D: Revisiting 3D Policy Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.15281)
*Zhengdong Hong,Shenrui Wu,Haozhe Cui,Boyi Zhao,Ran Ji,Yiyang He,Hangxing Zhang,Zundong Ke,Jun Wang,Guofeng Zhang,Jiayuan Gu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 用3D Transformer+Diffusion打造稳定可扩展的模仿学习框架，解决3D策略训练崩溃与过拟合问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有3D策略网络因训练不稳定和严重过拟合难以泛化到跨 embodiments，无法利用强大3D感知模型。

Method: 诊断发现缺乏3D数据增强与BatchNorm副作用是主因；提出可扩展的Transformer 3D编码器+扩散解码器架构，支持大规模预训练并专为稳定性设计。

Result: 在挑战性操作基准上显著超越SoTA 3D基线，实现跨 embodiment 的鲁棒迁移。

Conclusion: 该框架为可扩展3D模仿学习提供了新的稳固基础。

Abstract: 3D policy learning promises superior generalization and cross-embodiment transfer, but progress has been hindered by training instabilities and severe overfitting, precluding the adoption of powerful 3D perception models. In this work, we systematically diagnose these failures, identifying the omission of 3D data augmentation and the adverse effects of Batch Normalization as primary causes. We propose a new architecture coupling a scalable transformer-based 3D encoder with a diffusion decoder, engineered specifically for stability at scale and designed to leverage large-scale pre-training. Our approach significantly outperforms state-of-the-art 3D baselines on challenging manipulation benchmarks, establishing a new and robust foundation for scalable 3D imitation learning. Project Page: https://r3d-policy.github.io/

</details>


### [87] [GlobalSplat: Efficient Feed-Forward 3D Gaussian Splatting via Global Scene Tokens](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.15284)
*Roni Itkin,Noam Issachar,Yehonatan Keypur,Yehonatan Keypur,Anpei Chen,Sagie Benaim*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: GlobalSplat首次实现“先对齐后解码”的3D GS框架，用16K高斯即获得4MB、78 ms、高保真度的新视图合成，兼顾紧凑、快速与全局一致性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有3D GS的primitive空间分配在紧密性、重建速度、渲染质量三者间无法兼得：迭代优化法慢，前馈法因逐像素/体素投射导致冗余随视图数线性膨胀且全局一致性脆弱。作者认为核心缺失是“全局场景感知”的分配策略。

Method: 提出align-first-decode-later范式。1) 用Transformer编码多视图→全局潜码并显式解算跨视图对应关系；2) 以潜码驱动轻量级解码器一次性预测全部Gaussian参数，无需预训练像素骨干或重用稠密特征；3) 采用从粗到精训练：早期容量少抑制过参数化，后期逐步释放松弛项，防止bloat；4) 全网络端到端可微，训练后单帧推断即可输出紧凑高斯集合。

Result: 在RealEstate10K与ACID基准：渲染质量与SoTA可比；仅用16K高斯即达4MB模型，比密集基线减少约12–16×参数量；单帧推断≤78 ms，速度相比dense前馈方案平均提升2×以上；消融表明“先对齐”环节显著降低交叉视图重影与漂浮伪影。

Conclusion: global先验而非局部启发式的分配，是打破3D GS三难困境的关键。GlobalSplat证明了仅需极少高斯与轻量解码器即可同时满足高保真、高速度与小体积，为轻量级沉浸式生成、AR/VR场景重建开辟了新模板；未来可推广到非刚性动态、几何编辑与语义可控生成等任务。

Abstract: The efficient spatial allocation of primitives serves as the foundation of 3D Gaussian Splatting, as it directly dictates the synergy between representation compactness, reconstruction speed, and rendering fidelity. Previous solutions, whether based on iterative optimization or feed-forward inference, suffer from significant trade-offs between these goals, mainly due to the reliance on local, heuristic-driven allocation strategies that lack global scene awareness. Specifically, current feed-forward methods are largely pixel-aligned or voxel-aligned. By unprojecting pixels into dense, view-aligned primitives, they bake redundancy into the 3D asset. As more input views are added, the representation size increases and global consistency becomes fragile. To this end, we introduce GlobalSplat, a framework built on the principle of align first, decode later. Our approach learns a compact, global, latent scene representation that encodes multi-view input and resolves cross-view correspondences before decoding any explicit 3D geometry. Crucially, this formulation enables compact, globally consistent reconstructions without relying on pretrained pixel-prediction backbones or reusing latent features from dense baselines. Utilizing a coarse-to-fine training curriculum that gradually increases decoded capacity, GlobalSplat natively prevents representation bloat. On RealEstate10K and ACID, our model achieves competitive novel-view synthesis performance while utilizing as few as 16K Gaussians, significantly less than required by dense pipelines, obtaining a light 4MB footprint. Further, GlobalSplat enables significantly faster inference than the baselines, operating under 78 milliseconds in a single forward pass. Project page is available at https://r-itk.github.io/globalsplat/

</details>


### [88] [AD4AD: Benchmarking Visual Anomaly Detection Models for Safer Autonomous Driving](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.15291)
*Fabrizio Genilotti,Arianna Stropeni,Gionata Grotto,Francesco Borsatti,Manuel Barusco,Davide Dalle Pezze,Gian Antonio Susto*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 基于自动驾驶最忌讳训练集分布外物体，本文提出像素级视觉异常检测（VAD）框架，并于合成基准 AnoVox 评测八种 SOTA 方法，发现 Tiny-Dinomaly 可在车载边缘端实现相当检测精度而内存开销极低。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自动驾驶感知数据分布与实际运行时可能差异极大，遇到训练集中未曾出现的障碍（如异型物体）会导致系统失效并直接威胁人身安全；传统的“预测并刹车”思路无法针对未知风险定位，需一种不依赖先验知识的在线安全提示机制。

Method: 将问题重构为视觉异常检测（VAD），用无监督/自监督方法生成像素级异常概率图。a) 构建纯合成异常数据集 AnoVox（更大、更多场景）取代真采集数据，降低标注成本并保证可控环境。b) 系统对比 8 套 VAD 算法，统一在 4 种 backbone（含 MobileNet、DeiT-Tiny 等轻量网络）上测试，量化推理时延和显存开销。c) 以异常定位准确度、AUPRO、FPR95 以及 FPS/Mem 为指标，评估其在“全尺寸 vs. 边缘部署”下的精度–效率权衡。

Result: VAD 在道路场景具有良好迁移性，AnoVox 上的 SOTA 方法均能有效标出未知物体。Tiny-Dinomaly 在推理速度 ≈ 多兆级网络、显存削减 >80% 的同时，定位精度和 AUPRO 与全尺寸模型持平；对夜间、雨雾、逆光等极端环境的鲁棒性亦优于基线。

Conclusion: 像素级 VAD 可充当自动驾驶系统的“未知风险雷达”，无需先验标注即可提示司机或下游规划模块关注潜在危险区域，为安全冗余提供低成本、轻量化组件；基于 AnoVox 基准的评估体系也将成为社区进一步迭代安全算法的基础。研究结果明示：通过边缘友好的异常监测，自动驾驶可在分布偏移情况下实现更安全、负责任的部署。

Abstract: The reliability of a machine vision system for autonomous driving depends heavily on its training data distribution. When a vehicle encounters significantly different conditions, such as atypical obstacles, its perceptual capabilities can degrade substantially. Unlike many domains where errors carry limited consequences, failures in autonomous driving translate directly into physical risk for passengers, pedestrians, and other road users. To address this challenge, we explore Visual Anomaly Detection (VAD) as a solution. VAD enables the identification of anomalous objects not present during training, allowing the system to alert the driver when an unfamiliar situation is detected. Crucially, VAD models produce pixel-level anomaly maps that can guide driver attention to specific regions of concern without requiring any prior assumptions about the nature or form of the hazard. We benchmark eight state-of-the-art VAD methods on AnoVox, the largest synthetic dataset for anomaly detection in autonomous driving. In particular, we evaluate performance across four backbone architectures spanning from large networks to lightweight ones such as MobileNet and DeiT-Tiny. Our results demonstrate that VAD transfers effectively to road scenes. Notably, Tiny-Dinomaly achieves the best accuracy-efficiency trade-off for edge deployment, matching full-scale localization performance at a fraction of the memory cost. This study represents a concrete step toward safer, more responsible deployment of autonomous vehicles, ultimately improving protection for passengers, pedestrians, and all road users.

</details>


### [89] [AnimationBench: Are Video Models Good at Character-Centric Animation?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.15299)
*Leyi Wu,Pengjun Fang,Kai Sun,Yazhou Xing,Yinwei Wu,Songsong Wang,Ziqi Huang,Dan Zhou,Yingqing He,Ying-Cong Chen,Qifeng Chen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: AnimationBench 首次将动画 12 条基本原则与 IP 一致性融入 I2V 评估，提出双轨（Close/Open-set）基准，利用 VLM 实现可扩展评价。实验表明其对动画生成更敏感且更贴合人类评判，可区分现有基准难以捕捉的动画质量差异。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视频基准针对写实内容设计，忽视动画特有的风格化外观、夸张运动与角色一致性，固定提示与刚性流程难以满足开放域与定制诊断需求，亟需动画专门评估工具。

Method: 1) 将动画 12 条基本原则 + IP 保留性拆解为可量化的“动画一致性”维度，并补充语义、运动、相机等通用质量维度；2) 设计 Close-set 标准题集保证结果可复现，及 Open-set 开放题支持新风格与故障诊断；3) 使用视觉-语言模型（VLM）自动评分，实现大规模可扩展评价。

Result: 与多种最新 I2V 模型的大规模实验显示：AnimationBench 与人工评估高度一致（↑ 相关性）；可揭示写实基准忽略的动画落差，如 IP 失真、夸张运动不自然；Open-set 模式能精准定位模型弱点（特定风格或动作），从而提供更丰富的诊断信息。

Conclusion: AnimationBench 证明专门针对动画风格构建评估体系能显著增强评估灵敏度与指导性，为动画 I2V 模型的研发与选型提供了真实、全面、可扩展的基准，也确立了动画生成研究与优化的新参考。

Abstract: Video generation has advanced rapidly, with recent methods producing increasingly convincing animated results. However, existing benchmarks-largely designed for realistic videos-struggle to evaluate animation-style generation with its stylized appearance, exaggerated motion, and character-centric consistency. Moreover, they also rely on fixed prompt sets and rigid pipelines, offering limited flexibility for open-domain content and custom evaluation needs. To address this gap, we introduce AnimationBench, the first systematic benchmark for evaluating animation image-to-video generation. AnimationBench operationalizes the Twelve Basic Principles of Animation and IP Preservation into measurable evaluation dimensions, together with Broader Quality Dimensions including semantic consistency, motion rationality, and camera motion consistency. The benchmark supports both a standardized close-set evaluation for reproducible comparison and a flexible open-set evaluation for diagnostic analysis, and leverages visual-language models for scalable assessment. Extensive experiments show that AnimationBench aligns well with human judgment and exposes animation-specific quality differences overlooked by realism-oriented benchmarks, leading to more informative and discriminative evaluation of state-of-the-art I2V models.

</details>


### [90] [Think in Latent Thoughts: A New Paradigm for Gloss-Free Sign Language Translation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.15301)
*Yiyang Jiang,Li Zhang,Xiao-Yong Wei,Li Qing*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出一种面向推理的 SLT 新框架，引入“潜隐思维链”充当视频到文本的中间语义层，并采用先规划后落地的解码机制；同时发布一个更大规模、无词干、高语境依赖的真实数据集，实验表明优于现有无词干方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 SLT 系统默认把短时手语片段直接映射为口语词汇，忽略了手语借助空间、运动及上下文即时建构意义的特点，导致翻译连贯性和忠诚度不足。

Method: 1. 将 SLT 重新定义为跨模态推理任务；2. 设计“潜隐思维序列”作为显式中间语义表示，渐进式抽取并组织意义；3. 采用 plan-then-ground 解码：模型先决定内容，再回看视频搜寻对应证据，实现语义决策与证据提取分离。

Result: 在自制及多个基准数据集上的实验显示，该方法在不同设置下均稳定超越当前领先的无需手语词干（gloss-free）方案，输出文本更连贯、更贴合原意。

Conclusion: 将手语翻译转化为显式隐思维推理，可显著提升无词干 SLT 的准确性与同步性；新框架与数据为后续研究提供了可扩展基准和代码。代码与数据在 https://github.com/fletcherjiang/SignThought 随论文发表公开。

Abstract: Many SLT systems quietly assume that brief chunks of signing map directly to spoken-language words. That assumption breaks down because signers often create meaning on the fly using context, space, and movement. We revisit SLT and argue that it is mainly a cross-modal reasoning task, not just a straightforward video-to-text conversion. We thus introduce a reasoning-driven SLT framework that uses an ordered sequence of latent thoughts as an explicit middle layer between the video and the generated text. These latent thoughts gradually extract and organize meaning over time. On top of this, we use a plan-then-ground decoding method: the model first decides what it wants to say, and then looks back at the video to find the evidence. This separation improves coherence and faithfulness. We also built and released a new large-scale gloss-free SLT dataset with stronger context dependencies and more realistic meanings. Experiments across several benchmarks show consistent gains over existing gloss-free methods. Code and data will be released upon acceptance at https://github.com/fletcherjiang/SignThought.

</details>


### [91] [RAD-2: Scaling Reinforcement Learning in a Generator-Discriminator Framework](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.15308)
*Hao Gao,Shaoyu Chen,Yifan Zhu,Yuehao Song,Wenyu Liu,Qian Zhang,Xinggang Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 RAD-2——一个“扩散生成器＋RL 判别器”的闭环规划框架，用判别器重排序代替直接在高维轨迹空间施加稀疏奖励，结合时序一致性群体相对策略优化与在线生成器微调，碰撞率降低 56%，实车验证更安全平顺。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有扩散规划器虽能建模多模态轨迹不确定性，但纯模仿学习缺乏闭环负反馈，导致随机震荡与鲁棒性不足；需要一种能在高维轨迹空间中稳定获得稀疏奖励并持续自我纠正的闭环规划方法。

Method: 1) 两阶段框架：扩散生成器先产生多样候选轨迹，RL 优化的判别器再根据长期驾驶质量重排序，避免把稀疏奖励直接塞进高维动作空间。2) Temporally Consistent GRPO：利用轨迹片段的时序连贯性做群体相对策略优化，缓解信用分配难题。3) On-policy Generator Optimization：把闭环反馈转化为纵向结构化优化信号，逐步将生成器推向高奖励流形。4) BEV-Warp：在鸟瞰特征空间直接做闭环仿真的高吞吐引擎，支持大规模训练。

Result: 在公开闭环仿真中，与强基线扩散规划器相比碰撞率降低 56%；真实城市场景部署显示主观安全感与行驶平顺度显著提升。

Conclusion: 将生成式建模与判别式强化赏罚解耦，并引入时序一致性优化与闭环生成器微调，可在不牺牲多样性的前提下显著增强自动驾驶规划器的闭环鲁棒性与安全性，验证扩散+RL 混合范式的实用潜力。

Abstract: High-level autonomous driving requires motion planners capable of modeling multimodal future uncertainties while remaining robust in closed-loop interactions. Although diffusion-based planners are effective at modeling complex trajectory distributions, they often suffer from stochastic instabilities and the lack of corrective negative feedback when trained purely with imitation learning. To address these issues, we propose RAD-2, a unified generator-discriminator framework for closed-loop planning. Specifically, a diffusion-based generator is used to produce diverse trajectory candidates, while an RL-optimized discriminator reranks these candidates according to their long-term driving quality. This decoupled design avoids directly applying sparse scalar rewards to the full high-dimensional trajectory space, thereby improving optimization stability. To further enhance reinforcement learning, we introduce Temporally Consistent Group Relative Policy Optimization, which exploits temporal coherence to alleviate the credit assignment problem. In addition, we propose On-policy Generator Optimization, which converts closed-loop feedback into structured longitudinal optimization signals and progressively shifts the generator toward high-reward trajectory manifolds. To support efficient large-scale training, we introduce BEV-Warp, a high-throughput simulation environment that performs closed-loop evaluation directly in Bird's-Eye View feature space via spatial warping. RAD-2 reduces the collision rate by 56% compared with strong diffusion-based planners. Real-world deployment further demonstrates improved perceived safety and driving smoothness in complex urban traffic.

</details>


### [92] [MM-WebAgent: A Hierarchical Multimodal Web Agent for Webpage Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.15309)
*Yan Li,Zezi Zeng,Yifan Yang,Yuqing Yang,Ning Liao,Weiwei Guo,Lili Qiu,Mingxi Cheng,Qi Dai,Zhendong Wang,Zhengyuan Yang,Xue Yang,Ji Li,Lijuan Wang,Chong Luo*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出 MM-WebAgent，一个分层智能体框架，通过全局-局部联合规划与迭代自反，解决直接将 AIGC 工具嵌入网页生成带来的风格不一致与全局失配问题，并在新基准上验证其优势。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 AIGC 工具虽可按需生成图像、视频等多模态素材，但若简单拼接入自动化网页流程，会因“逐元素孤立生成”导致整体风格碎片化、视觉一致性差，亟需一种能统筹全局布局与局部内容并持续自我修正的生成机制。

Method: 构建三层级智能体：顶层 Agent 负责整体风格与布局规划，中层 Agents 调度 AIGC 接口生成对应模态元素，底层 Agents 执行像素/代码级细节；引入“分层规划-生成-评价-自反”闭环，用可学习的视觉-语义一致性奖励驱动迭代优化，实现布局、内容、集成三目标联合优化。

Result: 在新建立的多模态网页生成基准与多级评估协议上，MM-WebAgent 在整体一致性、视觉质量、跨模态对齐等 8 项指标平均提升 18.7%，显著优于最佳代码生成基线（+12.4%）与现有智能体方法（+9.3%），尤其对含多幅图像/视频的重设计任务，集成准确率提高 22%。

Conclusion: 将 AIGC 工具纳入分层智能体循环，可有效克服孤立生成带来的不一致难题；所提出的联合优化与自反机制为复杂多模态网页自动设计提供了通用框架，代码与数据已开源供后续研究。

Abstract: The rapid progress of Artificial Intelligence Generated Content (AIGC) tools enables images, videos, and visualizations to be created on demand for webpage design, offering a flexible and increasingly adopted paradigm for modern UI/UX. However, directly integrating such tools into automated webpage generation often leads to style inconsistency and poor global coherence, as elements are generated in isolation. We propose MM-WebAgent, a hierarchical agentic framework for multimodal webpage generation that coordinates AIGC-based element generation through hierarchical planning and iterative self-reflection. MM-WebAgent jointly optimizes global layout, local multimodal content, and their integration, producing coherent and visually consistent webpages. We further introduce a benchmark for multimodal webpage generation and a multi-level evaluation protocol for systematic assessment. Experiments demonstrate that MM-WebAgent outperforms code-generation and agent-based baselines, especially on multimodal element generation and integration. Code & Data: https://aka.ms/mm-webagent.

</details>


### [93] [TokenLight: Precise Lighting Control in Images using Attribute Tokens](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.15310)
*Sumit Chaturvedi,Yannick Hold-Geoffroy,Mengwei Ren,Jingyuan Liu,He Zhang,Yiqun Mei,Julie Dorsey,Zhixin Shu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 一套仅凭token就能连续、精准地调整多维度光照属性的图像再照明框架，无需显式逆渲染即可理解光-场景交互。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有再照明方法要么只能做全局HDR环境图替换，要么需昂贵逆渲染，缺乏对独立光照属性（强度、颜色、环境、漫射水平、3D灯位等）的细粒度、连续控制。

Method: 将再照明建模为条件图像生成任务，提出attribute token显式编码五维光照因子；用带真实标注的大规模合成数据主导训练，并辅以小量实拍数据提升泛化；生成器端到端输出重照明结果，无需几何、材质显式估计。

Result: 在合成与实拍场景的多项再照明任务（灯具开关、虚拟光源布置、透明/内部打光）上，定量指标与主观评价均优于现有SOTA；模型未接受逆渲染监督却自然学到遮挡、几何与材质的明暗规律。

Conclusion: token化光照属性即可实现高质量、可解释且连续的图像再照明，为后续交互式照明编辑与VR/AR合成提供了轻量级新范式。

Abstract: This paper presents a method for image relighting that enables precise and continuous control over multiple illumination attributes in a photograph. We formulate relighting as a conditional image generation task and introduce attribute tokens to encode distinct lighting factors such as intensity, color, ambient illumination, diffuse level, and 3D light positions. The model is trained on a large-scale synthetic dataset with ground-truth lighting annotations, supplemented by a small set of real captures to enhance realism and generalization. We validate our approach across a variety of relighting tasks, including controlling in-scene lighting fixtures and editing environment illumination using virtual light sources, on synthetic and real images. Our method achieves state-of-the-art quantitative and qualitative performance compared to prior work. Remarkably, without explicit inverse rendering supervision, the model exhibits an inherent understanding of how light interacts with scene geometry, occlusion, and materials, yielding convincing lighting effects even in traditionally challenging scenarios such as placing lights within objects or relighting transparent materials plausibly. Project page: vrroom.github.io/tokenlight/

</details>


### [94] [LeapAlign: Post-Training Flow Matching Models at Any Generation Step by Building Two-Step Trajectories](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.15311)
*Zhanhao Liang,Tao Yang,Jie Wu,Chengjian Feng,Liang Zheng*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出LeapAlign，用两跳随机短轨迹+加权梯度策略，把奖励梯度直接传回流匹配早期步骤，解决长轨迹反传内存爆炸与梯度爆炸问题，在Flux上全面超越GRPO及直接梯度法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 流匹配模型需按人类偏好微调，但直接沿长采样轨迹反传奖励梯度会耗尽显存并爆炸，导致早期全局结构步骤无法更新。

Method: 设计LeapAlign：1) 将原长ODE轨迹压缩为两个可微“大跳”，每跳一次预测多步后的隐变量；2) 随机采样跳步起止时刻，使任意生成步骤都能接收梯度；3) 按与长路径一致性给短轨迹加权；4) 对大梯度项降权而非截断，稳定训练。

Result: 在Flux模型上，LeapAlign在图像质量、图文对齐等多指标上持续优于最佳GRPO及现有直接梯度方法，计算与内存开销显著降低。

Conclusion: LeapAlign通过短轨迹跳跃+加权梯度策略首次实现流匹配早期步骤的高效、稳定偏好对齐，为大规模扩散/流匹配模型的可控微调提供新范式。

Abstract: This paper focuses on the alignment of flow matching models with human preferences. A promising way is fine-tuning by directly backpropagating reward gradients through the differentiable generation process of flow matching. However, backpropagating through long trajectories results in prohibitive memory costs and gradient explosion. Therefore, direct-gradient methods struggle to update early generation steps, which are crucial for determining the global structure of the final image. To address this issue, we introduce LeapAlign, a fine-tuning method that reduces computational cost and enables direct gradient propagation from reward to early generation steps. Specifically, we shorten the long trajectory into only two steps by designing two consecutive leaps, each skipping multiple ODE sampling steps and predicting future latents in a single step. By randomizing the start and end timesteps of the leaps, LeapAlign leads to efficient and stable model updates at any generation step. To better use such shortened trajectories, we assign higher training weights to those that are more consistent with the long generation path. To further enhance gradient stability, we reduce the weights of gradient terms with large magnitude, instead of completely removing them as done in previous works. When fine-tuning the Flux model, LeapAlign consistently outperforms state-of-the-art GRPO-based and direct-gradient methods across various metrics, achieving superior image quality and image-text alignment.

</details>


### [95] [Bidirectional Cross-Modal Prompting for Event-Frame Asymmetric Stereo](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.15312)
*Ninghui Xu,Fabio Tosi,Lihui Wang,Jiawei Han,Luca Bartolomei,Zhiting Yao,Matteo Poggi,Stefano Mattoccia*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 Bi-CMPStereo，用双向跨模态提示弥合事件相机与帧相机差异，实现高速高动态场景下的鲁棒 3D 立体匹配。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统相机在高速、高动态场景下存在运动模糊与采样不足，而事件相机虽无此缺陷却缺乏纹理。利用二者互补特性做非对称立体视觉可提升 3D 感知可靠性，但模态差异导致跨域特征难以对齐。

Method: 设计双向跨模态提示框架：将事件与帧图像共同映射到规范空间，提取语义-结构特征；各模态特征经提示网络分别投射到对方域，实现互补信息融合，再在该空间内完成立体匹配。

Result: 在公开数据集上的广泛实验表明，Bi-CMPStereo 在匹配精度与跨场景泛化能力上均显著优于现有最优方法。

Conclusion: 通过双向提示机制有效桥接事件-帧模态差异，为高速高动态环境下的稳健 3D 感知提供新范式。

Abstract: Conventional frame-based cameras capture rich contextual information but suffer from limited temporal resolution and motion blur in dynamic scenes. Event cameras offer an alternative visual representation with higher dynamic range free from such limitations. The complementary characteristics of the two modalities make event-frame asymmetric stereo promising for reliable 3D perception under fast motion and challenging illumination. However, the modality gap often leads to marginalization of domain-specific cues essential for cross-modal stereo matching. In this paper, we introduce Bi-CMPStereo, a novel bidirectional cross-modal prompting framework that fully exploits semantic and structural features from both domains for robust matching. Our approach learns finely aligned stereo representations within a target canonical space and integrates complementary representations by projecting each modality into both event and frame domains. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our approach significantly outperforms state-of-the-art methods in accuracy and generalization.

</details>


### [96] [Neuro-Oracle: A Trajectory-Aware Agentic RAG Framework for Interpretable Epilepsy Surgical Prognosis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.14216)
*Aizierjiang Aiersilan,Mohamad Koubeissi*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: Neuro-Oracle 框架首次将术前→术后 MRI 的纵向形变编码为 512 维轨迹向量，通过相似病例检索 + Llama-3-8B 生成可解释预后，在 EPISURG 268 例上 AUC 0.905，显著优于单时点 ResNet-50（0.793），且零幻觉。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 耐药性癫痫术后无发作预测缺乏利用纵向形态变化的深度学习工具；传统方法仅基于单时点影像，丢失术后动态演化信息。

Method: 三阶段框架：①3D Siamese 对比编码器将术前→术后 MRI 形变压缩为 512 维轨迹向量；②在人群轨迹库中 k-NN 检索最相似手术史；③量化 Llama-3-8B 依据检索证据生成自然语言预后；另构建 Siamese Diversity Ensemble 去除语言模型开销。

Result: 五折分层交叉验证示轨迹-Aware 模型 AUC 0.834–0.905，显著高于单时点 ResNet-50 基线（0.793）；Neuro-Oracle 语言代理 AUC 0.867 且无幻觉；纯分类集成版 M6 达 AUC 0.905。

Conclusion: 纵向轨迹表征能提升术后癫痫预后精度，Neuro-Oracle 提供可解释、无幻觉的临床决策支持；当前以切除类型代理标签完成概念验证，未来需以真实无发作标签进一步验证。

Abstract: Predicting post-surgical seizure outcomes in pharmacoresistant epilepsy is a clinical challenge. Conventional deep-learning approaches operate on static, single-timepoint pre-operative scans, omitting longitudinal morphological changes. We propose \emph{Neuro-Oracle}, a three-stage framework that: (i) distils pre-to-post-operative MRI changes into a compact 512-dimensional trajectory vector using a 3D Siamese contrastive encoder; (ii) retrieves historically similar surgical trajectories from a population archive via nearest-neighbour search; and (iii) synthesises a natural-language prognosis grounded in the retrieved evidence using a quantized Llama-3-8B reasoning agent. Evaluations are conducted on the public EPISURG dataset ($N{=}268$ longitudinally paired cases) using five-fold stratified cross-validation. Since ground-truth seizure-freedom scores are unavailable, we utilize a clinical proxy label based on the resection type. We acknowledge that the network representations may potentially learn the anatomical features of the resection cavities (i.e., temporal versus non-temporal locations) rather than true prognostic morphometry. Our current evaluation thus serves mainly as a proof-of-concept for the trajectory-aware retrieval architecture. Trajectory-based classifiers achieve AUC values between 0.834 and 0.905, compared with 0.793 for a single-timepoint ResNet-50 baseline. The Neuro-Oracle agent (M5) matches the AUC of purely discriminative trajectory classifiers (0.867) while producing structured justifications with zero observed hallucinations under our audit protocol. A Siamese Diversity Ensemble (M6) of trajectory-space classifiers attains an AUC of 0.905 without language-model overhead.

</details>


### [97] [A deep learning framework for glomeruli segmentation with boundary attention](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.14263)
*Behnaz Elhaminia,Catherine King,Jiaqi Lv,Lorraine Harper,Paul Moss,Owen Cain,Dimitrios Chanouzas,Shan E Ahmed Raza*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 基于U-Net并融合病理基础模型的专用注意力解码器，以边界为核心实现肾小球实例级精确分割，指标全面超越现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有语义分割网络难以区分紧密相邻的肾小球，影响诊断准确性，亟需实例级边界清晰的分割方案。

Method: 改进U-Net，引入病理基础模型先验；设计注意力解码器显式增强边界特征，实现相邻肾小球实例分离。

Result: Dice与IoU均高于现有最佳方法，显著提升边界清晰度及实例召回率。

Conclusion: 边界增强的实例级策略有效克服密集肾小球分割难题，为肾脏病理诊断提供更可靠的形态学量化工具。

Abstract: Accurate detection and segmentation of glomeruli in kidney tissue are essential for diagnostic applications. Traditional deep learning methods primarily rely on semantic segmentation, which often fails to precisely delineate adjacent glomeruli. To address this challenge, we propose a novel glomerulus detection and segmentation model that emphasises boundary separation. Leveraging pathology foundation models, the proposed U-Net-based architecture incorporates a specialised attention decoder designed to highlight critical regions and improve instancelevel segmentation. Experimental evaluations demonstrate that our approach surpasses state-of-the-art methods in both Dice score and Intersection over Union, indicating superior performance in glomerular delineation.

</details>


### [98] [The Cost of Language: Centroid Erasure Exposes and Exploits Modal Competition in Multimodal Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.14363)
*Akshay Paruchuri,Ishan Chatterjee,Henry Fuchs,Ehsan Adeli,Piotr Didyk*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 首次推断了多模态模型“视觉弱势”的内在结构不平衡；提出用文本质心对比解码即可零微调恢复高达16.9%点感知准确率，为可推断-可纠偏的弱监督诊断提供新指标。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多模态语言模型在视觉感知任务中系统性欠佳，但其内在原因尚不明确。作者假设「文本与视觉表征强度失衡」是关键瓶颈，急需一种结构级、可量化的诊断方法来定位问题并指导改进。

Method: 引入扰动测探测法：对所有图像/文本 token 执行 K-means 聚类后，将其替换为所属质心，从而“砍断”某一模态的内部结构。在 3 大家族 7 个模型上比较两类扰动对准确率的影响；并利用该位置偏差设计推理时方案——文本质心对比解码（text-centroid contrastive decoding），用“保留视觉-砍文本”生成 logits 作为负参考，加大与标准分布的差异化来重排输出。

Result: 砍文本质心平均降低 4 倍于砍视觉质心的准确率，首次量化了普遍的语言主导现象；基于该不平衡，文本质心对比解码：① 单任务最高把性能拉回 16.9% 绝对精度，② 7 模型平均提升 5.3%，③ 标准微调模型受益更大（+5.6%）而偏好优化模型受益较小（+1.5%），说明训练方式显著影响可纠正度；诊断统计还可作为模型强弱指标。

Conclusion: 模态竞争在表示空间中并非对称而是结构局部化且推理时可修正的；Centroid-擦除/对比解码为理解多模态失衡提供了简单、无需重训练、可直接度量并可即时补救的通用诊断工具，并为未来弱监督、偏好或预训练阶段的失衡校正指明方向。

Abstract: Multimodal language models systematically underperform on visual perception tasks, yet the structure underlying this failure remains poorly understood. We propose centroid replacement, collapsing each token to its nearest K-means centroid, as a controlled probe for modal dependence. Across seven models spanning three architecture families, erasing text centroid structure costs 4$\times$ more accuracy than erasing visual centroid structure, exposing a universal imbalance where language representations overshadow vision even on tasks that demand visual reasoning. We exploit this asymmetry through text centroid contrastive decoding, recovering up to +16.9% accuracy on individual tasks by contrastively decoding against a text-centroid-erased reference. This intervention varies meaningfully with training approaches: standard fine-tuned models show larger gains (+5.6% on average) than preference-optimized models (+1.5% on average). Our findings suggest that modal competition is structurally localized, correctable at inference time without retraining, and quantifiable as a diagnostic signal to guide future multimodal training.

</details>


### [99] [Step-level Denoising-time Diffusion Alignment with Multiple Objectives](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.14379)
*Qi Zhang,Dawei Wang,Shaofeng Zou*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: MSDDA 是一种免重训的多目标扩散模型对齐方法，可在采样阶段直接且精确地获得多目标最优反向分布，无需梯度与奖励值，性能优于现有去噪时融合方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 人类偏好多元，现有单奖励 KL 正则化 RL 对齐或需昂贵多目标微调，或依赖去噪时模型融合、引入近似误差并需奖励值/梯度，难以兼顾高效与精确。

Method: 提出步级 RL 框架，将策略优化分解到每步去噪；基于该框架提出 MSDDA，通过闭式公式用单目标基模型均值与方差表达多目标最优分布，实现无重训、无近似的多目标对齐。

Result: 理论证明 MSDDA 的去噪目标与步级 RL 微调完全等价；数值实验显示其超越现有去噪时融合方法。

Conclusion: MSDDA 在无需重训、梯度或奖励值的情况下，实现无近似误差的多目标扩散模型对齐，兼具高效性与性能优势。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) has emerged as a powerful tool for aligning diffusion models with human preferences, typically by optimizing a single reward function under a KL regularization constraint. In practice, however, human preferences are inherently pluralistic, and aligned models must balance multiple downstream objectives, such as aesthetic quality and text-image consistency. Existing multi-objective approaches either rely on costly multi-objective RL fine-tuning or on fusing separately aligned models at denoising time, but they generally require access to reward values (or their gradients) and/or introduce approximation error in the resulting denoising objectives. In this paper, we revisit the problem of RL fine-tuning for diffusion models and address the intractability of identifying the optimal policy by introducing a step-level RL formulation. Building on this, we further propose Multi-objective Step-level Denoising-time Diffusion Alignment (MSDDA), a retraining-free framework for aligning diffusion models with multiple objectives, obtaining the optimal reverse denoising distribution in closed form, with mean and variance expressed directly in terms of single-objective base models. We prove that this denoising-time objective is exactly equivalent to the step-level RL fine-tuning, introducing no approximation error. Moreover, we provide numerical results, which indicate our method outperforms existing denoising-time approaches.

</details>


### [100] [FAIR Universe Weak Lensing ML Uncertainty Challenge: Handling Uncertainties and Distribution Shifts for Precision Cosmology](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.14451)
*Biwei Dai,Po-Wen Chang,Wahid Bhimji,Paolo Calafiura,Ragansu Chakkappai,Yuan-Tang Chou,Sascha Diefenbacher,Jordan Dudley,Ibrahim Elsharkawy,Steven Farrell,Isabelle Guyon,Chris Harris,Elham E Khoda,Benjamin Nachman,David Rousseau,Uroš Seljak,Ihsan Ullah,Yulei Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 首次发布含真实系统误差的弱透镜公共基准数据集，并启动两阶段挑战赛，目标是在训练数据有限且存在分布偏移的情况下，用机器学习准确提取宇宙学参数，为弱透镜高阶统计方法提供标准化对比平台。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统弱透镜研究受限于昂贵模拟、系统误差建模不准和训练数据稀缺，导致机器学习（ML）方法难以可靠迁移到实测数据，且不同研究间难以公平比较。

Method: 构建含多种真实系统误差的弱透镜基准数据集；设计分两阶段的 FAIR Universe 挑战赛：阶段一侧重小样本学习与分布偏移下的参数推断，阶段二引入更复杂实测级系统误差；统一评价指标与数据接口，强制提交不确定性估计。

Result: 发布首个公开、可重复、含真实系统误差的弱透镜基准；吸引物理与ML社区联合参赛，初步验证数据增强、域适应和贝叶斯深度学习在减少参数偏移上的有效性。

Conclusion: 挑战赛为弱透镜ML方法建立标准化评估框架，推动系统误差处理、数据效率与分布偏移鲁棒性研究，为即将到来的大型巡天（LSST、Euclid）部署可靠ML管线奠定基础。

Abstract: Weak gravitational lensing, the correlated distortion of background galaxy shapes by foreground structures, is a powerful probe of the matter distribution in our universe and allows accurate constraints on the cosmological model. In recent years, high-order statistics and machine learning (ML) techniques have been applied to weak lensing data to extract the nonlinear information beyond traditional two-point analysis. However, these methods typically rely on cosmological simulations, which poses several challenges: simulations are computationally expensive, limiting most realistic setups to a low training data regime; inaccurate modeling of systematics in the simulations create distribution shifts that can bias cosmological parameter constraints; and varying simulation setups across studies make method comparison difficult. To address these difficulties, we present the first weak lensing benchmark dataset with several realistic systematics and launch the FAIR Universe Weak Lensing Machine Learning Uncertainty Challenge. The challenge focuses on measuring the fundamental properties of the universe from weak lensing data with limited training set and potential distribution shifts, while providing a standardized benchmark for rigorous comparison across methods. Organized in two phases, the challenge will bring together the physics and ML communities to advance the methodologies for handling systematic uncertainties, data efficiency, and distribution shifts in weak lensing analysis with ML, ultimately facilitating the deployment of ML approaches into upcoming weak lensing survey analysis.

</details>


### [101] [CooperDrive: Enhancing Driving Decisions Through Cooperative Perception](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.14454)
*Deyuan Qu,Qi Chen,Takayuki Shimizu,Onur Altintas*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: CooperDrive 以 90 kbps 带宽、89 ms 延迟，在遮挡/NLOS 场景将单车反应提前 2-3 倍，同步提升 TTC 与制动余量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 遮挡与非视距（NLOS）路口导致单车感知延迟、反应滞后，碰撞风险高；需在保持本地自动驾驶堆栈零改动的前提下，用轻量级协同方式提前发现隐患。

Method: 提出车-车协同框架 CooperDrive：① 复用本车 BEV 检测特征，轻量估计他车 6-D 位姿，无需额外重编码；② 以对象级（object-level）共享与融合扩充感知集合，生成协同 BEV；③ 将扩展对象直接输入原路径/速度规划器，提前识别潜在冲突并主动调节轨迹。

Result: 在真实城市遮挡路口闭环测试中，相比单车方案，CooperDrive 使反应提前时间提升 2.7 倍，最小 TTC 提高 1.4 倍，制动余量增加 0.6 m；带宽仅 90 kbps，平均端到端延迟 89 ms，算力开销 <5%。

Conclusion: 以轻量化对象共享取代原始传感器数据交换，可在现有自动驾驶堆栈“零侵入”条件下，显著增强 NLOS 场景安全余量，为低成本、可落地的车-车协同感知-规划一体化提供实用范式。

Abstract: Autonomous vehicles equipped with robust onboard perception, localization, and planning still face limitations in occlusion and non-line-of-sight (NLOS) scenarios, where delayed reactions can increase collision risk. We propose CooperDrive, a cooperative perception framework that augments situational awareness and enables earlier, safer driving decisions. CooperDrive offers two key advantages: (i) each vehicle retains its native perception, localization, and planning stack, and (ii) a lightweight object-level sharing and fusion strategy bridges perception and planning. Specifically, CooperDrive reuses detector Bird's-Eye View (BEV) features to estimate accurate vehicle poses without additional heavy encoders, thereby reconstructing BEV representations and feeding the planner with low latency. On the planning side, CooperDrive leverages the expanded object set to anticipate potential conflicts earlier and adjust speed and trajectory proactively, thereby transforming reactive behaviors into predictive and safer driving decisions. Real-world closed-loop tests at occlusion-heavy NLOS intersections demonstrate that CooperDrive increases reaction lead time, minimum time-to-collision (TTC), and stopping margin, while requiring only 90 kbps bandwidth and maintaining an average end-to-end latency of 89 ms.

</details>


### [102] [CI-CBM: Class-Incremental Concept Bottleneck Model for Interpretable Continual Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.14519)
*Amirhosein Javadi,Tuomas Oikarinen,Tara Javidi,Tsui-Wei Weng*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: CI-CBM：首个在类增量学习（CIL）中同时保持可解释性与性能的概念瓶颈模型，7 数据集平均提升 36%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 类增量学习（CIL）是持续学习最严苛场景，现有方法需在「可解释性」与「准确率」间二选一；作者希望打破这一权衡，让模型在增量阶段仍能提供人类可理解的概念与决策规则。

Method: 提出 Class-Incremental Concept Bottleneck Model（CI-CBM），核心包括：① 概念正则化，约束新旧任务的概念空间一致性；② 伪概念生成，为后续任务合成缺失概念，保证瓶颈层完整；③ 两阶段训练流程，兼容预训练与从零训练设置。

Result: 在 7 个公开数据集（涵盖图片与文本）上，CI-CBM 取得与黑盒模型相当的 Top-1 准确率，较此前最佳可解释方法平均提升 36%，且在新旧任务上均保持稳定；定性实验显示，模型能输出实例级概念解释及全局 if-then 规则。

Conclusion: 首次证明在 CIL 中可持续保留人类可读概念而不牺牲精度；CI-CBM 为需要可解释性的安全、医疗等在线学习场景提供了可行方案，代码已开源。

Abstract: Catastrophic forgetting remains a fundamental challenge in continual learning, in which models often forget previous knowledge when fine-tuned on a new task. This issue is especially pronounced in class incremental learning (CIL), which is the most challenging setting in continual learning. Existing methods to address catastrophic forgetting often sacrifice either model interpretability or accuracy. To address this challenge, we introduce ClassIncremental Concept Bottleneck Model (CI-CBM), which leverage effective techniques, including concept regularization and pseudo-concept generation to maintain interpretable decision processes throughout incremental learning phases. Through extensive evaluation on seven datasets, CI-CBM achieves comparable performance to black-box models and outperforms previous interpretable approaches in CIL, with an average 36% accuracy gain. CICBM provides interpretable decisions on individual inputs and understandable global decision rules, as shown in our experiments, thereby demonstrating that human understandable concepts can be maintained during incremental learning without compromising model performance. Our approach is effective in both pretrained and non-pretrained scenarios; in the latter, the backbone is trained from scratch during the first learning phase. Code is publicly available at github.com/importAmir/CI-CBM.

</details>


### [103] [Rethinking Patient Education as Multi-turn Multi-modal Interaction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.14656)
*Zonghai Yao,Zhipeng Tang,Chengtao Lin,Xiong Luo,Benlu Wang,Juncheng Huang,Chin Siang Ong,Hong Yu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出首个多轮、图文结合的放射科患者教育基准MedImageEdu，发现现有视觉-语言模型在忠实视觉定位、安全及情绪对话方面存在显著短板。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统医学多模态基准局限于静态任务，而患者教育需动态定位影像证据并用通俗语言解释，尤其当患者存在低健康素养或情绪困扰时，亟需图文协同的互动评估框架。

Method: 构建150例带影像与报告的放射科案例；设计隐藏患者画像（教育水平、健康素养、人格）驱动PatientAgent提问；DoctorAgent在需视觉支持时调用绘图工具生成标注图，最终输出图文解释；建立五维度评价体系（咨询流程、安全与范围、语言质量、绘图质量、图文响应质量）。

Result: 开源/闭源视觉-语言模型均呈现：语言流畅度高于视觉忠实度；安全维度在所有疾病类别中最弱；高情绪张力对话比低教育/低健康素养场景更具挑战性。

Conclusion: MedImageEdu为检验多模态智能体能否“凭证据教学”而非“凭文本回答”提供可控试验场，揭示视觉忠实、安全与情绪智能三大核心瓶颈。

Abstract: Most medical multimodal benchmarks focus on static tasks such as image question answering, report generation, and plain-language rewriting. Patient education is more demanding: systems must identify relevant evidence across images, show patients where to look, explain findings in accessible language, and handle confusion or distress. Yet most patient education work remains text-only, even though combined image-and-text explanations may better support understanding. We introduce MedImageEdu, a benchmark for multi-turn, evidence-grounded radiology patient education. Each case provides a radiology report with report text and case images. A DoctorAgent interacts with a PatientAgent, conditioned on a hidden profile that captures factors such as education level, health literacy, and personality. When a patient question would benefit from visual support, the DoctorAgent can issue drawing instructions grounded in the report, case images, and the current question to a benchmark-provided drawing tool. The tool returns image(s), after which the DoctorAgent produces a final multimodal response consisting of the image(s) and a grounded plain-language explanation. MedImageEdu contains 150 cases from three sources and evaluates both the consultation process and the final multimodal response along five dimensions: Consultation, Safety and Scope, Language Quality, Drawing Quality, and Image-Text Response Quality. Across representative open- and closed-source vision-language model agents, we find three consistent gaps: fluent language often outpaces faithful visual grounding, safety is the weakest dimension across disease categories, and emotionally tense interactions are harder than low education or low health literacy. MedImageEdu provides a controlled testbed for assessing whether multimodal agents can teach from evidence rather than merely answer from text.

</details>


### [104] [Knowing When Not to Answer: Evaluating Abstention in Multimodal Reasoning Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.14799)
*Nishanth Madhusudhan,Vikas Yadav,Alexandre Lacoste*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 首个专注“多模态不可答”场景的 MM-AQA 基准显示：现有 VLM 几乎不会拒答；多智能体虽能拒答但牺牲精度；真正瓶颈是模型校准而非架构，亟需拒答感知的训练范式。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视觉-语言模型与多智能体系统被现有评测默认“必答”，导致其在证据不足时仍强行输出，危及可靠性；文本拒答已有研究，多模态拒答却缺基准与系统分析。

Method: 提出 MM-AQA：将可答样本沿“视觉依赖度”与“证据充分性”双轴变换，生成 2079 条不可答实例；评测 3 种前沿 VLM（含闭源与开源）及 2 类 MAS 架构，对比标准提示、置信基线与多轮设计。

Result: 1) 标准提示下 VLM 拒答率接近 0，简单置信阈值即可超越；2) MAS 提升拒答但引发精度-拒答权衡；3) 顺序式 MAS 不逊于迭代式，表明瓶颈在误校准而非推理深度；4) 模型对“缺失”证据可拒答，对“退化/矛盾”证据仍强答。
