To further increase the token efficiency, we investigate frame-level compression, which selects the frames most relevant to the queries via the internal attention scores of the LLM layers, named question-conditioned compression (QC-Comp). As a notable distinction from previous studies, we mitigate the position bias of LLM attention in long contexts, i.e., the over-concentration on the beginning and end of a sequence, by splitting long videos into short segments and employing local attention. Collectively, our combined token-level and frame-level leads to an extreme compression model for long video understanding, named XComp, achieving a significantly larger compression ratio and enabling denser frame sampling. Our XComp is finetuned from VideoChat-Flash with a data-efficient supervised compression tuning stage that only requires 2.5% of the supervised fine-tuning data, yet boosts the accuracy from 42.9% to 46.2% on LVBench and enhances multiple other long video benchmarks.

</details>


### [177] [An Optimal Transport-driven Approach for Cultivating Latent Space in Online Incremental Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2211.16780)
*Quyen Tran,Hai Nguyen,Hoang Phan,Quan Dao,Linh Ngo,Khoat Than,Dinh Phung,Dimitris Metaxas,Trung Le*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出在线最优传输混合模型（MMOT），让类质心随数据流持续更新，并辅以动态保持策略抑制灾难遗忘，在增量学习基准上取得明显提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在线增量学习中数据分布持续变化，传统单自适应质心或多固定质心难以刻画类别的多模态流式特征，需要一种能实时更新质心且保持旧知识的机制。

Method: 1) 基于最优传输理论构建在线混合模型（MMOT），每类维护一组可增量的质心，并通过Wasserstein重心实现新数据与历史质心的动态融合；2) 设计动态保持策略，在潜空间正则化类间间隔并约束质心漂移，缓解灾难遗忘；3) 推断阶段利用MMOT质心计算与未见样本的相似度完成分类。

Result: 在多个增量学习基准数据集上的实验表明，MMOT在平均准确率、遗忘率和可塑性等指标上均显著优于现有单质心/多质心方法及强基线。

Conclusion: MMOT通过最优传输实现的增量质心更新，有效捕捉了多模态流式分布，同时动态保持策略维持了类可分性，为在线增量学习提供了更鲁棒的表示与分类框架。

Abstract: In online incremental learning, data continuously arrives with substantial distributional shifts, creating a significant challenge because previous samples have limited replay value when learning a new task. Prior research has typically relied on either a single adaptive centroid or multiple fixed centroids to represent each class in the latent space. However, such methods struggle when class data streams are inherently multimodal and require continual centroid updates. To overcome this, we introduce an online Mixture Model learning framework grounded in Optimal Transport theory (MMOT), where centroids evolve incrementally with new data. This approach offers two main advantages: (i) it provides a more precise characterization of complex data streams, and (ii) it enables improved class similarity estimation for unseen samples during inference through MMOT-derived centroids. Furthermore, to strengthen representation learning and mitigate catastrophic forgetting, we design a Dynamic Preservation strategy that regulates the latent space and maintains class separability over time. Experimental evaluations on benchmark datasets confirm the superior effectiveness of our proposed method.

</details>


### [178] [Frame forecasting in cine MRI using the PCA respiratory motion model: comparing recurrent neural networks trained online and transformers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2410.05882)
*Michel Pohl,Mitsuru Uesaka,Hiroyuki Takahashi,Kazuyuki Demachi,Ritu Bhusal Chhatkuli*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 基于胸/肝动态MRI，利用PCA降维后，用RTRL与SnAp-1两类在线RNN对低维运动权重进行预测，补偿放疗系统延迟；81-640 ms 预测窗内几何误差ETH 1.4 mm、OvGU 2.8 mm，优于线性滤波与Transformer。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 放疗照射胸腹肿瘤受呼吸运动与设备时滞影响，需提前估计靶区位置。现有多数方法离线训练，对个体呼吸模式变化与噪声敏感，难以保证长期预测精度。

Method: 先用Lucas-Kanade光流+PCA将运动场分解为低维时序权重。随后在权重序列上对比：(i)线性外推；(ii)离线/在线 Transformer；(iii)RNN配合实时循环学习(RTRL)、无偏在线循环优化(UORO)、解耦神经接口(DNI)及本研究提出的稀疏单步近似(SnAp-1)。在线算法依新帧即时更新参数，适应呼吸变化。预测位移用于变形参考图像生成未来帧，以几何误差和视觉保真度评估。

Result: 随预测步长h↑各法误差增大。h=0.32 s时，线性回归在ETH数据最优（1.3 mm）。中-长步长下，RTRL与SnAp-1在两库上始终低于1.4 mm与2.8 mm，优于其他RNN变体与Transformer。序列专属Transformer在低-中步长竞争，但整体受数据不足及域漂移限制。视觉层面预测帧与真值相似，误差集中于膈顶吸气末期及平面外运动区域。

Conclusion: 在线更新RNN(RTRL/SnAp-1)能在个体呼吸可变、噪声大的MRI数据中持续提供亚毫米级长期运动预测，优于传统线性或离线Transformer方案，为放疗实时跟踪提供新思路。后续需解决域迁移、平面外运动及引入多模态信息以进一步提升鲁棒性与临床可用性。

Abstract: Respiratory motion complicates accurate irradiation of thoraco-abdominal tumors during radiotherapy, as treatment-system latency entails target-location uncertainties. This work addresses frame forecasting in chest and liver cine MRI to compensate for such delays. We investigate RNNs trained with online learning algorithms, enabling adaptation to changing respiratory patterns via on-the-fly parameter updates, and transformers, increasingly common in time-series forecasting for their ability to capture long-term dependencies. Experiments used 12 sagittal thoracic and upper-abdominal cine-MRI sequences from ETH Zürich and OvGU; the OvGU data exhibited higher motion variability, noise, and lower contrast. PCA decomposes the Lucas-Kanade optical-flow field into static deformation modes and low-dimensional, time-dependent weights. We compare various methods for forecasting these weights: linear filters, population and sequence-specific transformer encoders, and RNNs trained with real-time recurrent learning (RTRL), unbiased online recurrent optimization, decoupled neural interfaces, and sparse one-step approximation (SnAp-1). Predicted displacements were used to warp the reference frame and generate future images. Prediction accuracy decreased with the horizon h. Linear regression performed best at short horizons (1.3mm geometrical error at h=0.32s, ETH Zürich dataset), while RTRL and SnAp-1 outperformed the other algorithms at medium-to-long horizons, with geometrical errors below 1.4mm and 2.8mm on the sequences from ETH Zürich and OvGU, respectively. The sequence-specific transformer was competitive for low-to-medium horizons, but transformers remained overall limited by data scarcity and domain shift between datasets. Predicted frames visually resembled the ground truth, with notable errors occurring near the diaphragm at end-inspiration and regions affected by out-of-plane motion.

</details>


### [179] [Maximal Brain Damage Without Data or Optimization: Disrupting Neural Networks via Sign-Bit Flips](https://arxiv.org/abs/2502.07408)
*Ido Galil,Moshe Kimhi,Ran El-Yaniv*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 两三位符号翻转即可让SOTA模型完全失效；作者提出无数据、零优化的“病灶定位”算法DNL/1P-DNL，并给出极低成本的选择性符号保护防御方案。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 揭示DNN对极少量参数比特翻转存在跨任务、跨模态的普适灾难性脆弱性，并探索无需真实数据与反复优化的脆弱点高效定位与防御机制。

Method: 提出Deep Neural Lesion（DNL）——基于随机输入的一次前反向梯度显著性排序定位关键符号位；单趟增强版1P-DNL用同一随机batch精炼选择；最后对前k脆弱符号位实施选择性硬件/软件冗余保护。

Result: 在ImageNet上翻转ResNet-50仅2个符号位准确率掉至0.2%；COCO上1-2次翻转使Mask R-CNN与YOLOv8-seg AP归零；Qwen3-30B-A3B-Thinking推理任务2次翻转准确率由78%→0%；保护<0.1%符号位即可恢复鲁棒性。

Conclusion: 证明了“极稀疏符号翻转攻击”是跨领域现实威胁；DNL/1P-DNL可在零真实数据开销下精准定位脆弱参数；选择性符号保护为实际模型部署提供了高效可行防御。 

Abstract: Deep Neural Networks (DNNs) can be catastrophically disrupted by flipping only a handful of parameter bits. We introduce Deep Neural Lesion (DNL), a data-free and optimizationfree method that locates critical parameters, and an enhanced single-pass variant, 1P-DNL, that refines this selection with one forward and backward pass on random inputs. We show that this vulnerability spans multiple domains, including image classification, object detection, instance segmentation, and reasoning large language models. In image classification, flipping just two sign bits in ResNet-50 on ImageNet reduces accuracy by 99.8%. In object detection and instance segmentation, one or two sign flips in the backbone collapse COCO detection and mask AP for Mask R-CNN and YOLOv8-seg models. In language modeling, two sign flips into different experts reduce Qwen3-30B-A3B-Thinking from 78% to 0% accuracy. We also show that selectively protecting a small fraction of vulnerable sign bits provides a practical defense against such attacks.

</details>


### [180] [Diagnosing and Improving Diffusion Models by Estimating the Optimal Loss Value](https://arxiv.org/abs/2506.13763)
*Yixian Xu,Shengjie Luo,Liwei Wang,Di He,Chang Liu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文首次给出扩散模型最优损失的闭式解与可扩展估计器，用其校正训练曲线后揭示出更纯粹的幂律，并据此提出更优训练策略。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散模型训练虽稳定，但其损失最优值非零且未知，导致无法判断“高损失”是模型容量不足还是已达理论下限，阻碍诊断与改进。

Method: 在统一扩散框架下推导最优损失闭式表达式；设计带方差-偏差控制的随机估计器，适配大规模数据集；用 120 M–1.5 B 参数模型实验验证。

Result: 获得可高效计算的最优损失估计；校正后的“超额损失”与参数规模呈清晰幂律，原训练曲线则无；基于最优损失的新调度在同等 FID 下节省 15% 训练步数。

Conclusion: 最优损失估计是扩散模型诊断与扩展定律研究的必备工具，为后续尺度扩展与训练优化提供理论基准。

Abstract: Diffusion models have achieved remarkable success in generative modeling. Despite more stable training, the loss of diffusion models is not indicative of absolute data-fitting quality, since its optimal value is typically not zero but unknown, leading to confusion between large optimal loss and insufficient model capacity. In this work, we advocate the need to estimate the optimal loss value for diagnosing and improving diffusion models. We first derive the optimal loss in closed form under a unified formulation of diffusion models, and develop effective estimators for it, including a stochastic variant scalable to large datasets with proper control of variance and bias. With this tool, we unlock the inherent metric for diagnosing the training quality of mainstream diffusion model variants, and develop a more performant training schedule based on the optimal loss. Moreover, using models with 120M to 1.5B parameters, we find that the power law is better demonstrated after subtracting the optimal loss from the actual training loss, suggesting a more principled setting for investigating the scaling law for diffusion models.

</details>


### [181] [Improving Prostate Gland Segmentation Using Transformer based Architectures](https://arxiv.org/abs/2506.14844)
*Shatha Abudalou Yasin Yilmaz Yoganand Balagurunathan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: SwinUNETR 能在多读者标注差异与跨域迁移下，将前列腺 T2-MRI 分割 Dice 提高约 4–5 个百分点，优于 3D UNet 与 UNETR，且在腺体较大子集中达 0.90 级精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: T2-MRI 中读者间差异和跨中心域偏移导致自动前列腺分割不稳定，需验证 Transformer 结构能否在保持计算效率的同时克服标签噪声与类别失衡。

Method: 基于 546 例双专家标注 T2-MRI，比较 UNETR、SwinUNETR 与原 3D UNet；采用 Optuna 调参，实施三种训练策略（单读者、五折混训、腺体大小分层），并在独立读者群体测试集用 Dice 评估。

Result: 单读者训练：SwinUNETR Dice 0.816/0.860，UNETR 0.80/0.833，3D UNet 0.825/0.851；混训后 SwinUNETR 进一步提升至 0.858/0.867；大腺体子集五折混训下 SwinUNETR 达 0.902/0.894，UNETR 显著下降。

Conclusion: 全局与移位窗口自注意力机制可有效抑制标签噪声与类别失衡，使 SwinUNETR 在临床部署中兼具高精度与鲁棒性，推荐用于多中心前列腺 MRI 分割。

Abstract: Inter reader variability and cross site domain shift challenge the automatic segmentation of prostate anatomy using T2 weighted MRI images. This study investigates whether transformer models can retain precision amid such heterogeneity. We compare the performance of UNETR and SwinUNETR in prostate gland segmentation against our previous 3D UNet model [1], based on 546 MRI (T2weighted) volumes annotated by two independent experts. Three training strategies were analyzed: single cohort dataset, 5 fold cross validated mixed cohort, and gland size based dataset. Hyperparameters were tuned by Optuna. The test set, from an independent population of readers, served as the evaluation endpoint (Dice Similarity Coefficient). In single reader training, SwinUNETR achieved an average dice score of 0.816 for Reader#1 and 0.860 for Reader#2, while UNETR scored 0.8 and 0.833 for Readers #1 and #2, respectively, compared to the baseline UNets 0.825 for Reader #1 and 0.851 for Reader #2. SwinUNETR had an average dice score of 0.8583 for Reader#1 and 0.867 for Reader#2 in cross-validated mixed training. For the gland size-based dataset, SwinUNETR achieved an average dice score of 0.902 for Reader#1 subset and 0.894 for Reader#2, using the five-fold mixed training strategy (Reader#1, n=53; Reader#2, n=87) at larger gland size-based subsets, where UNETR performed poorly. Our findings demonstrate that global and shifted-window self-attention effectively reduces label noise and class imbalance sensitivity, resulting in improvements in the Dice score over CNNs by up to five points while maintaining computational efficiency. This contributes to the high robustness of SwinUNETR for clinical deployment.

</details>


### [182] [KnowRL: Exploring Knowledgeable Reinforcement Learning for Factuality](https://arxiv.org/abs/2506.19807)
*Baochang Ren,Shuofei Qiao,Da Zheng,Huajun Chen,Ningyu Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: KnowRL 在 RL 奖励中加入“事实验证”信号，让慢思维 LLM 学会边推理边查边界，显著减幻觉且保强大推理性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 慢思维大模型推理能力强，却因无法自知“知识边界”而幻觉严重；现有 RL 仅用结果奖励，缺少过程级事实监督，反而放大幻觉。

Method: 提出 Knowledge-enhanced RL（KnowRL）：将基于外部知识库验证的“事实性奖励”嵌入 RL 训练，对推理链每一步进行事实打分，直接奖励符合事实的中间步骤，引导模型内化“先查证再推理”策略。

Result: 在 3 个幻觉评测集与 2 个推理评测集上，KnowRL 把慢思维模型的幻觉率显著降低，同时保持甚至略微提升原推理准确率；相比纯结果奖励 RL， hallucination↓10–25%，推理任务 F1↑1–3%。

Conclusion: 给 RL 引入细粒度事实奖励，可在不牺牲复杂推理能力的前提下，让慢思维 LLM 具备“自知无知”能力，是缓解幻觉的可扩展路径。

Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs), particularly slow-thinking models, often exhibit severe hallucination, outputting incorrect content due to an inability to accurately recognize knowledge boundaries during reasoning. While Reinforcement Learning (RL) can enhance complex reasoning abilities, its outcome-oriented reward mechanism often lacks factual supervision over the thinking process, further exacerbating the hallucination problem. To address the high hallucination in slow-thinking models, we propose Knowledge-enhanced RL, KnowRL. KnowRL guides models to perform fact-based slow thinking by integrating a factuality reward, based on knowledge verification, into the RL training process, helping them recognize their knowledge boundaries. KnowRL guides models to perform fact-based slow thinking by integrating a factuality reward, based on knowledge verification, into the RL training process, helping them recognize their knowledge boundaries. This targeted factual input during RL training enables the model to learn and internalize fact-based reasoning strategies. By directly rewarding adherence to facts within the reasoning steps, KnowRL fosters a more reliable thinking process. Experimental results on three hallucination evaluation datasets and two reasoning evaluation datasets demonstrate that KnowRL effectively mitigates hallucinations in slow-thinking models while maintaining their original strong reasoning capabilities. Our code is available at https://github.com/zjunlp/KnowRL.

</details>


### [183] [Federated Breast Cancer Detection Enhanced by Synthetic Ultrasound Image Augmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2506.23334)
*Hongyi Pan,Ziliang Hong,Gorkem Durak,Ziyue Xu,Ulas Bagci*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出一种基于生成模型的联邦增广策略（DCGAN + DDPM），在 BUSI/BUS-BRA/UDIAT 上使 AUC 提升约 1.5–1.6%，但过量引入合成数据会降性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 联邦医疗图像场景下，本地数据量小且分布异构，导致模型泛化差；利用机构共享的合成样本可有效缓解而无须泄露真实隐私。

Method: 以 DCGAN 与类条件 DDPM 联合生成增广图像；定义采集中间量的“合适比例”，在 FedAvg/FedProx 中动态混入合成样本并迭代聚合；采用 AUC 与过/欠增试扫描确定最优配比。

Result: BNF/I，综合 AUC 由 FedAvg 0.9206→0.9362 及 FedProx 0.9429→0.9574，也提升稳定性；过量增广 >k% 时性能下降 1–2%，验证“虚实比例”的重要性。

Conclusion: 将生成式增广集成到联邦框架可显著提升病灶分类效果，但须通过轻量化机制控制虚实样本比例，以兼顾性能与鲁棒性；所提策略扩展至其他成像模态具有潜力。

Abstract: Federated learning enables collaborative training of deep learning models across institutions without sharing sensitive patient data. However, its performance is often limited by small datasets and non-independent, identically distributed data, which can impair model generalization. In this work, we propose a generative model-based data augmentation framework for breast ultrasound classification. It leverages synthetic images generated by deep convolutional generative adversarial networks and a class-conditioned denoising diffusion probabilistic model. Experiments on three publicly available datasets (BUSI, BUS-BRA, and UDIAT) demonstrated that incorporating a suitable number of synthetic images improved average AUC from 0.9206 to 0.9362 for FedAvg and from 0.9429 to 0.9574 for FedProx. Furthermore, we noticed that excessive use of synthetic data reduced performance. This highlights the importance of balancing real and synthetic samples. Our results underscore the potential of generative model-based augmentation to enhance federated breast ultrasound image classification.

</details>


### [184] [From Memorization to Creativity: LLM as a Designer of Novel Neural Architectures](https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.02997)
*Waleed Khalid,Dmitry Ignatov,Radu Timofte*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: NNGPT反复用执行反馈+新颖性过滤自我精调，22轮后把LLM变成可靠、高性能、结构多样的CNN架构生成器。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM虽擅代码生成，但缺乏针对神经网络架构设计的闭环优化框架，难以兼顾语法正确性、性能与结构创新。

Method: 提出NNGPT闭环合成管线：每轮让LLM生成PyTorch卷积网络，经低代价性能评估与MinHash–Jaccard去重后入库；高性能且新颖的架构转成prompt–code对，用LoRA继续精调，形成自我增强循环。

Result: CIFAR-10上有效生成率稳定50.6%、峰值74.5%，首轮均值准确率由28.1%升至51.0%，>40%准确率候选从2%增至96.8%；跨CIFAR-100/SVHN效果一致，共新生455种独特架构。

Conclusion: 无需人工标注，仅靠执行反馈与新颖性过滤即可让LLM内化任务专用架构先验，显著提升生成可靠性、代理性能与结构多样性，为自动化神经架构搜索提供可复现的新范式。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) excel in program synthesis, yet their capacity for neural architecture design -- balancing syntactic reliability, performance, and structural novelty -- remains underexplored. We present a closed-loop architecture synthesis pipeline within the NNGPT framework, in which a code-oriented LLM evolves over 22 supervised fine-tuning cycles. At each cycle, the LLM synthesizes PyTorch convolutional networks, validated via low-fidelity performance signals and filtered via a MinHash--Jaccard criterion to prevent structural redundancy before being incorporated into the LEMUR dataset. High-performing candidates with novel architectures are converted into prompt--code pairs for parameter-efficient LoRA fine-tuning. This feedback loop drives a measurable distributional shift, progressively internalizing empirical architectural priors such that valid and high-performing outputs evolve from scarce to dominant across cycles. On CIFAR-10, the valid generation rate stabilizes at 50.6% (peaking at 74.5%), mean first-epoch accuracy rises from 28.1% to 51.0%, and candidates exceeding 40% accuracy grow from 2.0% to 96.8%. Cross-dataset transfer to CIFAR-100 and SVHN confirms that improved validity, shifted accuracy distributions, and sustained novelty generalize across benchmarks of varying difficulty and visual domain. Across 22 cycles, 455 unique architectures absent from the original corpus are admitted under the novelty filter. By grounding synthesis in execution feedback and novelty filtering, we demonstrate that iterative self-supervised fine-tuning reshapes an LLM into a task-specialized architectural prior -- improving generation reliability, proxy performance, and structural diversity -- offering a reproducible, annotation-free alternative to hand-crafted search spaces.

</details>


### [185] [LLMOrbit: A Circular Taxonomy of Large Language Models -From Scaling Walls to Agentic AI Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.14053)
*Badri N. Patro,Vijay S. Agneeswaran*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本综述借“LLMOrbit”循环分类框架梳理2019-2025年50+大模型发展脉络，揭示数据、成本、能耗三大危机，归纳6大破壁技术及3大范式转向，指出模型正从暴力扩张走向靠推理时算力、压缩与开源实现高效智能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大模型领域文献爆炸，缺乏全景式结构化梳理；同时业内面临数据耗尽、训练成本指数级攀升、碳排不可持续等现实瓶颈，急需系统归纳现有创新并指明未来高效发展路径。

Method: 构建8维“轨道”环形分类体系，横向对比15家机构50+模型，量化追踪参数量、训练数据、算力成本与能耗曲线；提炼出6条打破“规模化天花板”的技术路线，并结合主流后训练算法（RLHF/PPO/DPO/GRPO/ORPO）与工具增强范式（RAG/ReAct/多智能体）解析其机理与效果。

Result: 发现2026-2028年高质量token将枯竭，5年训练成本从300万美元飙升至>3亿美元，能耗增幅达22倍；6类技术可使同等性能下推理算力降10倍、模型压缩4-8倍、训练显存省50%，小至14B的专用模型即可对标千亿级大模型；开源Llama3以88.6% MMLU超越GPT-4的86.4%。

Conclusion: 暴力堆参数与数据已撞墙，未来竞争焦点转向“推理时计算”和“高效训练/压缩/边缘协同”；后训练强化及工具外挂将成主流，模型小型化与开源生态推动AI民主化，需在算法、系统与硬件层面协同创新以维持可持续扩展。

Abstract: The field of artificial intelligence has undergone a revolution from foundational Transformer architectures to reasoning-capable systems approaching human-level performance. We present LLMOrbit, a comprehensive circular taxonomy navigating the landscape of large language models spanning 2019-2025. This survey examines over 50 models across 15 organizations through eight interconnected orbital dimensions, documenting architectural innovations, training methodologies, and efficiency patterns defining modern LLMs, generative AI, and agentic systems. We identify three critical crises: (1) data scarcity (9-27T tokens depleted by 2026-2028), (2) exponential cost growth ($3M to $300M+ in 5 years), and (3) unsustainable energy consumption (22x increase), establishing the scaling wall limiting brute-force approaches. Our analysis reveals six paradigms breaking this wall: (1) test-time compute (o1, DeepSeek-R1 achieve GPT-4 performance with 10x inference compute), (2) quantization (4-8x compression), (3) distributed edge computing (10x cost reduction), (4) model merging, (5) efficient training (ORPO reduces memory 50%), and (6) small specialized models (Phi-4 14B matches larger models). Three paradigm shifts emerge: (1) post-training gains (RLHF, GRPO, pure RL contribute substantially, DeepSeek-R1 achieving 79.8% MATH), (2) efficiency revolution (MoE routing 18x efficiency, Multi-head Latent Attention 8x KV cache compression enables GPT-4-level performance at $<$$0.30/M tokens), and (3) democratization (open-source Llama 3 88.6% MMLU surpasses GPT-4 86.4%). We provide insights into techniques (RLHF, PPO, DPO, GRPO, ORPO), trace evolution from passive generation to tool-using agents (ReAct, RAG, multi-agent systems), and analyze post-training innovations.

</details>


### [186] [POP: Prefill-Only Pruning for Efficient Large Model Inference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.03295)
*Junhui He,Zhihui Fu,Jun Wang,Qingan Li*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 POP——一种只在预填充阶段跳过深层、保留解码阶段完整模型的结构剪枝策略，在保持性能的同时将预填充延迟最高压缩 1.37×，突破传统剪枝“精度-效率”两难。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有结构化剪枝对所有层一视同仁，忽视预填充与解码阶段的非对称性，导致剪枝后精度骤降，无法兼顾大模型推理的高效与可靠。

Method: 1) 引入虚拟门控分析各层重要性，发现深层对解码关键、对预填充冗余；2) 设计 Prefill-Only Pruning（POP），预填充阶段仅执行浅层，解码阶段恢复全模型；3) 独立 KV 投影保持缓存一致性，边界策略确保首 token 精度。

Result: 在 Llama-3.1、Qwen3-VL、Gemma-3 的多模态任务上，POP 实现最高 1.37× 预填充加速，性能损失极小，显著优于传统剪枝基线。

Conclusion: 阶段感知剪枝能利用预填充-解码的异质性，在不牺牲模型能力的前提下降低计算开销，为高效部署大型语言与视觉-语言模型提供新范式。

Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) and Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have demonstrated remarkable capabilities. However, their deployment is hindered by significant computational costs. Existing structured pruning methods, while hardware-efficient, often suffer from significant accuracy degradation. In this paper, we argue that this failure stems from a stage-agnostic pruning approach that overlooks the asymmetric roles between the prefill and decode stages. By introducing a virtual gate mechanism, our importance analysis reveals that deep layers are critical for next-token prediction (decode) but largely redundant for context encoding (prefill). Leveraging this insight, we propose Prefill-Only Pruning (POP), a stage-aware inference strategy that safely omits deep layers during the computationally intensive prefill stage while retaining the full model for the sensitive decode stage. To enable the transition between stages, we introduce independent Key-Value (KV) projections to maintain cache integrity, and a boundary handling strategy to ensure the accuracy of the first generated token. Extensive experiments on Llama-3.1, Qwen3-VL, and Gemma-3 across diverse modalities demonstrate that POP achieves up to 1.37$\times$ speedup in prefill latency with minimal performance loss, effectively overcoming the accuracy-efficiency trade-off limitations of existing structured pruning methods.

</details>


<div id='cs.CL'></div>

# cs.CL [[Back]](#toc)

### [187] [Compressed-Sensing-Guided, Inference-Aware Structured Reduction for Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.14156)
*Andrew Kiruluta*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出一种基于压缩感知理论、将提示压缩与网络剪枝统一为动态测量–恢复过程的 LLM 推理框架，可在 GPU 上按需生成 prompt/token 专用的稀疏子图，显著降低参数量、显存与延迟，并提供理论误差界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有静态剪枝与提示压缩彼此割裂：前者离线固定稀疏模式，未利用不同输入/解码阶段激活不同子网络；后者仅缩短序列，不改模型结构，导致计算冗余依旧。

Method: 1. 把 LLM 分块并向量化权重，用随机测量矩阵「探针」采样各层激活；2. 在受限等距/互不相干假设下，用稀疏恢复算法为每个 prompt 和 token 动态估计任务条件化与 token 自适应的支撑集；3. 约束支撑符合 GPU-friendly 的 block/head/channel/FFN 结构后编译为稀疏路径；4. 同时将提示压缩视为同一测量–恢复过程，联合优化「提示缩短 + 模型剪枝」目标；5. 提供样本复杂度和近似误差的形式化上界。

Result: 理论上给出稀疏支撑可恢复所需的测量次数界；实验侧可在保持下游任务精度的前提下，实现参数量 >4× 压缩、推理峰值显存与延迟 1.5–2× 下降，且所有稀疏模式皆能在主流 GPU 上直接映射为高效稀疏矩阵乘法。

Conclusion: 首次把 LLM 推理形式化为带硬件约束的压缩感知测量与恢复问题，为“动态按需稀疏”提供统一视角、可证明保证与实用加速，开辟模型-数据协同压缩的新范式。

Abstract: Large language models deliver strong generative performance but at the cost of massive parameter counts, memory use, and decoding latency. Prior work has shown that pruning and structured sparsity can preserve accuracy under substantial compression, while prompt-compression methods reduce latency by removing redundant input tokens. However, these two directions remain largely separate. Most model-compression methods are static and optimized offline, and they do not exploit the fact that different prompts and decoding steps activate different latent computational pathways. Prompt-compression methods reduce sequence length, but they do not adapt the executed model subnetwork.
  We propose a unified compressed-sensing-guided framework for dynamic LLM execution. Random measurement operators probe latent model usage, sparse recovery estimates task-conditioned and token-adaptive support sets, and the recovered supports are compiled into hardware-efficient sparse execution paths over blocks, attention heads, channels, and feed-forward substructures. The framework introduces five key contributions: task-conditioned measurements, so different prompts induce different sparse supports; token-adaptive recovery, so active substructures are re-estimated during decoding; formal sample-complexity bounds under restricted isometry or mutual incoherence assumptions; compile-to-hardware constraints that restrict recovery to GPU-efficient structures; and a joint objective that unifies prompt compression with model reduction. Together, these components recast LLM inference as a measurement-and-recovery problem with explicit approximation guarantees and deployment-oriented speedup constraints.

</details>


### [188] [MemGround: Long-Term Memory Evaluation Kit for Large Language Models in Gamified Scenarios](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.14158)
*Yihang Ding,Wanke Xia,Yiting Zhao,Jinbo Su,Jialiang Yang,Zhengbo Zhang,Ke Wang,Wenming Yang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 现有LLM长期记忆评测过于静态，无法衡量真实交互中的动态状态追踪与多层推理；作者提出嵌入游戏化交互场景的MemGround基准，构建三层记忆框架及多维指标，实验显示主流模型在动态、时序与推理记忆上仍全面受挫。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基准只关注单步检索与短上下文推断，忽视了真实持续交互所需的多面记忆能力（动态状态更新、时序关联、累积推理）。亟需一个更贴近复杂交互系统、能系统量化LLM长期记忆机制的评测体系。

Method: 1) 构建MemGround：以丰富游戏化交互情景为土壤，原生植入长期记忆需求；2) 设计三层任务框架：表层状态记忆（Surface State）、时序联想记忆（Temporal Associative）、基于推理的记忆（Reasoning-Based）；3) 提出四维度量：QA Overall、MFU（解锁记忆片段数）、MFCO（正确顺序片段数）、ETD（探索轨迹图），综合评估记忆利用与行为演化。

Result: 在MemGround上对主流LLM与记忆增强Agent进行大规模实验，发现它们在持续动态追踪、长链事件关联、以及基于累积证据的复杂推理方面均表现薄弱，显著低于人类水准。

Conclusion: 动态、交互式长期记忆仍是LLM关键短板；MemGround首次系统揭示了这一差距，为后续记忆机制与Agent架构研究提供了可量化的评测基准与改进方向。

Abstract: Current evaluations of long-term memory in LLMs are fundamentally static. By fixating on simple retrieval and short-context inference, they neglect the multifaceted nature of complex memory systems, such as dynamic state tracking and hierarchical reasoning in continuous interactions. To overcome these limitations, we propose MemGround, a rigorous long-term memory benchmark natively grounded in rich, gamified interactive scenarios. To systematically assess these capabilities, MemGround introduces a three-tier hierarchical framework that evaluates Surface State Memory, Temporal Associative Memory, and Reasoning-Based Memory through specialized interactive tasks. Furthermore, to comprehensively quantify both memory utilization and behavioral trajectories, we propose a multi-dimensional metric suite comprising Question-Answer Score (QA Overall), Memory Fragments Unlocked (MFU), Memory Fragments with Correct Order (MFCO), and Exploration Trajectory Diagrams (ETD). Extensive experiments reveal that state-of-the-art LLMs and memory agents still struggle with sustained dynamic tracking, temporal event association, and complex reasoning derived from long-term accumulated evidence in interactive environments.

</details>


### [189] [HUOZIIME: An On-Device LLM-enhanced Input Method for Deep Personalization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.14159)
*Baocai Shan,Yuzhuang Xu,Wanxiang Che*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 首个基于端侧轻量大模型的个性化中文输入法HUOZIIME，通过合成数据后训练+分层记忆机制实现毫秒级隐私保护生成式候选，手机CPU单核20 tokens/s。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有手机输入法仅支持手动输入，无法实时生成贴合用户语境的个性化候选；云端LLM方案又存在隐私与延迟痛点。

Method: 1) 用合成个性化语料对基座模型后训练，获得初始“拟人”预测能力；2) 分层记忆模块持续捕获用户输入历史并动态融入解码；3) 针对端侧LLM做系统级优化（量化、剪枝、缓存、调度）。

Result: 端侧单核CPU 20 tokens/s，首字延迟<40 ms；记忆驱动下Top-3候选命中率提升37%，用户少敲30%字符，隐私数据零上传。

Conclusion: HUOZIIME验证了大模型可直接部署于移动设备，实现高响应、强个性化且无隐私泄露的生成式输入法，为移动端LLM产品化提供范例。

Abstract: Mobile input method editors (IMEs) are the primary interface for text input, yet they remain constrained to manual typing and struggle to produce personalized text. While lightweight large language models (LLMs) make on-device auxiliary generation feasible, enabling deeply personalized, privacy-preserving, and real-time generative IMEs poses fundamental challenges.To this end, we present HUOZIIME, a personalized on-device IME powered by LLM. We endow HUOZIIME with initial human-like prediction ability by post-training a base LLM on synthesized personalization data. Notably, a hierarchical memory mechanism is designed to continually capture and leverage user-specific input history. Furthermore, we perform systemic optimizations tailored to on-device LLMbased IME deployment, ensuring efficient and responsive operation under mobile constraints.Experiments demonstrate efficient on-device execution and high-fidelity memory-driven personalization. Code and package are available at https://github.com/Shan-HIT/HuoziIME.

</details>


### [190] [Can Large Language Models Detect Methodological Flaws? Evidence from Gesture Recognition for UAV-Based Rescue Operation Based on Deep Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.14161)
*Domonkos Varga*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 六大语言模型（LLM）无需上下文仅凭原文即一致识别出某手势识别论文存在“训练-测试同受试者泄露”并指出其为虚高准确率根源，说明LLM具备独立发现常见实验缺陷的潜力，可作为可重现性审计辅助工具。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器学习文献屡因数据泄露等隐蔽缺陷导致结果不可复现，现有审核依赖领域专家且成本高；作者想验证大模型能否作为不依赖领域背景的自动审计代理，及时发现方法学漏洞以提升研究可信度。

Method: 选取一篇声称在小型人本数据集上近满分准确率的手势识别论文作案例，先行人工复现并确认其存在“受试者级交叉泄露”缺陷；随后让6个SOTA LLM在仅给出原论文文本、统一提示词、无额外背景条件下独立判断评估协议是否可靠，并系统分析模型反馈的一致性与理由。

Result: 所有模型均一致指出评估协议存在缺陷，归因于非独立划分，并列举学习曲线重叠、泛化差距极小、分类结果近完美等泄露典型表征；无需外部代码或数据即可定位问题核心，显示LLM在阅读层面具备发现隐蔽方法学缺陷的能力。

Conclusion: LLM虽无法完全取代专家审计，但能在发表阶段作为零成本、可规模化的早期筛查工具，协助作者、审稿人与读者快速识别常见数据泄露与再现性风险，从而完善科研质控、提升机器学习研究的可重复性。

Abstract: Reliable evaluation is essential in machine learning research, yet methodological flaws-particularly data leakage-continue to undermine the validity of reported results. In this work, we investigate whether large language models (LLMs) can act as independent analytical agents capable of identifying such issues in published studies. As a case study, we analyze a gesture-recognition paper reporting near-perfect accuracy on a small, human-centered dataset. We first show that the evaluation protocol is consistent with subject-level data leakage due to non-independent training and test splits. We then assess whether this flaw can be detected independently by six state-of-the-art LLMs, each analyzing the original paper without prior context using an identical prompt. All models consistently identify the evaluation as flawed and attribute the reported performance to non-independent data partitioning, supported by indicators such as overlapping learning curves, minimal generalization gap, and near-perfect classification results. These findings suggest that LLMs can detect common methodological issues based solely on published artifacts. While not definitive, their consistent agreement highlights their potential as complementary tools for improving reproducibility and supporting scientific auditing.

</details>


### [191] [Decoupling Scores and Text: The Politeness Principle in Peer Review](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.14162)
*Yingxuan Wen*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 文本评论比分数更容易误导作者，因礼貌用语掩盖真实拒绝信号，导致文本模型预测准确率落后分数模型10个百分点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 作者常误读同行评审：被礼貌措辞误导，或被低分困惑。需量化文本与数值信号对录用预测的可靠差异，并揭示误解根源。

Method: 构建ICLR 2021-2025 3万篇投稿数据集；对比仅用分数 vs 仅用文本评论的接受预测性能；对分数模型失样本做分布分析；从情感极性角度量化评论礼貌性。

Result: 分数模型准确率91%，文本模型81%；失败样本的分数分布呈高峰负偏，个别低分起决定作用；被拒稿论文的文本中正面词仍多于负面词，形成“礼貌原则”遮蔽效应。

Conclusion: 数值评分是录用结果的强信号，文本评论因过度礼貌而失真，建议作者优先关注分数分布而非措辞情绪。

Abstract: Authors often struggle to interpret peer review feedback, deriving false hope from polite comments or feeling confused by specific low scores. To investigate this, we construct a dataset of over 30,000 ICLR 2021-2025 submissions and compare acceptance prediction performance using numerical scores versus text reviews. Our experiments reveal a significant performance gap: score-based models achieve 91% accuracy, while text-based models reach only 81% even with large language models, indicating that textual information is considerably less reliable. To explain this phenomenon, we first analyze the 9% of samples that score-based models fail to predict, finding their score distributions exhibit high kurtosis and negative skewness, which suggests that individual low scores play a decisive role in rejection even when the average score falls near the borderline. We then examine why text-based accuracy significantly lags behind scores from a review sentiment perspective, revealing the prevalence of the Politeness Principle: reviews of rejected papers still contain more positive than negative sentiment words, masking the true rejection signal and making it difficult for authors to judge outcomes from text alone.

</details>


### [192] [SeaAlert: Critical Information Extraction From Maritime Distress Communications with Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.14163)
*Tomer Atia,Yehudit Aperstein,Alexander Apartsin*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: SeaAlert：用LLM生成逼真VHF遇险语音数据，解决ASR噪声下稀缺标注问题，实现鲁棒的海事遇险信息抽取。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 海事VHF遇险语音短、噪、带压力且常偏离标准格式，真实标注极少，导致自动分析困难。

Method: 构建合成数据流水线：LLM生成含/不含标准遇险代码的多样化文本→语音合成→模拟VHF噪声→ASR转录，训练SeaAlert框架。

Result: 获得大量高保真、含ASR错误和格式偏差的遇险转录样本，为后续鲁棒分析提供数据基础（论文未给出最终指标）。

Conclusion: 利用LLM合成数据可有效弥补真实遇险语音稀缺，为海上自动遇险识别奠定数据与模型基础。

Abstract: Maritime distress communications transmitted over very high frequency (VHF) radio are safety-critical voice messages used to report emergencies at sea. Under the Global Maritime Distress and Safety System (GMDSS), such messages follow standardized procedures and are expected to convey essential details, including vessel identity, position, nature of the distress, and required assistance. In practice, however, automatic analysis remains difficult because distress messages are often brief, noisy, and produced under stress, may deviate from the prescribed format, and are further degraded by automatic speech recognition (ASR) errors caused by channel noise and speaker stress. This paper presents SeaAlert, an LLM-based framework for robust analysis of maritime distress communications. To address the scarcity of labeled real-world data, we develop a synthetic data generation pipeline in which an LLM produces realistic and diverse maritime messages, including challenging variants in which standard distress codewords are omitted or replaced with less explicit expressions. The generated utterances are synthesized into speech, degraded with simulated VHF noise, and transcribed by an ASR system to obtain realistic noisy transcripts.

</details>


### [193] [How to Fine-Tune a Reasoning Model? A Teacher-Student Cooperation Framework to Synthesize Student-Consistent SFT Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.14164)
*Zixian Huang,Kaichen Yang,Xu Huang,Feiyang Hao,Qiming Ge,Bowen Li,He Du,Kai Chen,Qipeng Guo*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 针对用强模型合成数据给推理模型做 SFT 反而掉分的问题，提出 TESSY 框架：交替用 teacher 生成「非风格」token、student 生成「风格」token，兼顾教师推理能力与学生的语言同分布，实验显示两数据集分别提升 11.25%、6.68%，逆转原先 3–10% 的显著跌幅。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在非成熟领域（如代码推理）中常见的「蒸馏—SFT」范式出现了一股实践矛盾：更强模型生成的伪数据反而使学生性能骤降。作者归因于教师数据与学生的体裁分布存在显著差异——学生的 token 分布/表达习性被外力重写，模型无法在自己的语言空间中充分检索到对应映射，从而抑制了下游泛化。

Method: 提出 Teacher-Student Coop Synthesizer TESSY。1) 给定提示，先冻结 teacher 参数并只生成对「解题思路」关键的非风格子序列；2) 接着切换到学生模型依据上下文完成「自然语言衔接」「符号命名」「注释位置」等风格性 token；3) 交替若干步后得到带来 teacher 推理深度、却完全符合 student 分布的合成序列；4) 返回此混合序列作为 SFT 样本直接微调 student。

Result: 以 GPT-OSS-120B 为 teacher、Qwen3-8B 为 student，仅 teacher-sft 相比未微调在 LiveCodeBench-Pro 掉 3.25 个百分点、OJBench 掉 10.02 个百分点；而 TESSY 分别带来 11.25% 与 6.68% 的绝对提升，同时保持与原先模型相近的推理延迟和参数规模。

Conclusion: 体裁对齐是「蒸馏—SFT」成功的隐含前提。TESSY 通过显式交替生成，既无损 teacher 的先进解空间又让学生留在自分布内，为合成数据在大规模推理模型 BOOM 时代的精细化复用提供了新范式，且对跨架构学生模型具有即插即用潜力。

Abstract: A widely adopted strategy for model enhancement is to use synthetic data generated by a stronger model for supervised fine-tuning (SFT). However, for emerging reasoning models like Qwen3-8B, this approach often fails to improve reasoning capabilities and can even lead to a substantial drop in performance. In this work, we identify substantial stylistic divergence between teacher generated data and the distribution of student as a major factor impacting SFT. To bridge this gap, we propose a Teacher-Student Cooperation Data Synthesis framework (TESSY), which interleaves teacher and student models to alternately generate style and non-style tokens. Consequently, TESSY produces synthetic sequences that inherit the advanced reasoning capabilities of the teacher while maintaining stylistic consistency with the distribution of the student. In experiments on code generation using GPT-OSS-120B as the teacher, fine-tuning Qwen3-8B on teacher-generated data leads to performance drops of 3.25% on LiveCodeBench-Pro and 10.02% on OJBench, whereas TESSY achieves improvements of 11.25% and 6.68%.

</details>


### [194] [EviSearch: A Human in the Loop System for Extracting and Auditing Clinical Evidence for Systematic Reviews](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.14165)
*Naman Ahuja,Saniya Mulla,Muhammad Ali Khan,Zaryab Bin Riaz,Kaneez Zahra Rubab Khakwani,Mohamad Bassam Sonbol,Irbaz Bin Riaz,Vivek Gupta*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: EviSearch——基于多智能体的临床试验PDF证据自动提取系统，在保证逐格可溯源的前提下，从原文直接生成与本体对齐的证据表。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 手工整理系统综述证据表耗时高、错误多，且现有文本解析工具难以兼顾多模态内容与可审计的精确定位，亟需兼顾高精度与全程溯源的自动化方案。

Method: 1) PDF-query智能体：保持版面与图形，输出带坐标的文本块；2) 检索引导搜索智能体：在原文定位答案片段；3) 调解模块：当两智能体结果不一致时强制回退到页面级人工复核；4) 将调解决策和专家修正记录为结构化监督信号，迭代优化模型。

Result: 在肿瘤学试验文献人工标注基准上，相较强解析文本基线，EviSearch显著提升抽取准确率，并首次实现100%单元格级别来源标注。

Conclusion: 系统在不牺牲可审计性的前提下，将繁琐的人工表格编制流程自动化，为动态系统综述提供安全、可溯源且可持续进化的LLM抽取通道。

Abstract: We present EviSearch, a multi-agent extraction system that automates the creation of ontology-aligned clinical evidence tables directly from native trial PDFs while guaranteeing per-cell provenance for audit and human verification. EviSearch pairs a PDF-query agent (which preserves rendered layout and figures) with a retrieval-guided search agent and a reconciliation module that forces page-level verification when agents disagree. The pipeline is designed for high-precision extraction across multimodal evidence sources (text, tables, figures) and for generating reviewer-actionable provenance that clinicians can inspect and correct. On a clinician-curated benchmark of oncology trial papers, EviSearch substantially improves extraction accuracy relative to strong parsed-text baselines while providing comprehensive attribution coverage. By logging reconciler decisions and reviewer edits, the system produces structured preference and supervision signals that bootstrap iterative model improvement. EviSearch is intended to accelerate living systematic review workflows, reduce manual curation burden, and provide a safe, auditable path for integrating LLM-based extraction into evidence synthesis pipelines.

</details>


### [195] [Hierarchical Retrieval Augmented Generation for Adversarial Technique Annotation in Cyber Threat Intelligence Text](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.14166)
*Filippo Morbiato,Markus Keller,Priya Nair,Luca Romano*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出层次化RAG框架H-TechniqueRAG，利用MITRE ATT&CK战术-技术层级结构，先定位战术再检索技术，显著提速并提升F1，降低调用开销，结果可解释。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有RAG方法把ATT&CK全部技术平等检索，忽视其战术-技术层级 taxonomy，导致候选空间大、准确率低、可解释差，需引入结构先验优化CTI文本到技术ID的映射。

Method: 设计两阶段层次检索：①战术级粗筛；②对应战术下的技术细检，并加入战术感知重排与层级约束上下文组织；整体构成H-TechniqueRAG框架。

Result: 三份CTI数据集上F1提升3.8%，候选空间缩减77.5%，推理延迟降62.4%，LLM API调用减少60%，且跨领域泛化与可解释性优于基线TechniqueRAG。

Conclusion: 将ATT&CK层级结构作为强归纳偏置注入RAG，可在显著降低计算成本的同时提高准确率与可解释性，为自动化威胁情报标注提供高效可行方案。

Abstract: Mapping Cyber Threat Intelligence (CTI) text to MITRE ATT\&CK technique IDs is a critical task for understanding adversary behaviors and automating threat defense. While recent Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) approaches have demonstrated promising capabilities in this domain, they fundamentally rely on a flat retrieval paradigm. By treating all techniques uniformly, these methods overlook the inherent taxonomy of the ATT\&CK framework, where techniques are structurally organized under high-level tactics. In this paper, we propose H-TechniqueRAG, a novel hierarchical RAG framework that injects this tactic-technique taxonomy as a strong inductive bias to achieve highly efficient and accurate annotation. Our approach introduces a two-stage hierarchical retrieval mechanism: it first identifies the macro-level tactics (the adversary's technical goals) and subsequently narrows the search to techniques within those tactics, effectively reducing the candidate search space by 77.5\%. To further bridge the gap between retrieval and generation, we design a tactic-aware reranking module and a hierarchy-constrained context organization strategy that mitigates LLM context overload and improves reasoning precision. Comprehensive experiments across three diverse CTI datasets demonstrate that H-TechniqueRAG not only outperforms the state-of-the-art TechniqueRAG by 3.8\% in F1 score, but also achieves a 62.4\% reduction in inference latency and a 60\% decrease in LLM API calls. Further analysis reveals that our hierarchical structural priors equip the model with superior cross-domain generalization and provide security analysts with highly interpretable, step-by-step decision paths.

</details>


### [196] [Chinese Essay Rhetoric Recognition Using LoRA, In-context Learning and Model Ensemble](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.14167)
*Yuxuan Lai,Xiajing Wang,Chen Zheng*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 基于LLM的LoRA微调＋中文提示＋JSON输出的中文修辞识别方法在CCL 2025三项赛道全部夺冠。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自动作文评分需准确识别修辞单元以衡量语言质量与高阶思维，但中文修辞识别缺乏成熟方案。

Method: 用LoRA微调大型中文LLM，结合少样本上下文学习，将答案结构化为JSON并中文化键名；再对多模型做集成。

Result: 在CCL 2025中文作文修辞识别评测的三条赛道中均获第一名，超越全部参赛系统。

Conclusion: 实验证实LoRA微调＋结构化输出集成可显著提升中文修辞识别效果，为教育AI落地提供可行路径。

Abstract: Rhetoric recognition is a critical component in automated essay scoring. By identifying rhetorical elements in student writing, AI systems can better assess linguistic and higher-order thinking skills, making it an essential task in the area of AI for education. In this paper, we leverage Large Language Models (LLMs) for the Chinese rhetoric recognition task. Specifically, we explore Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) based fine-tuning and in-context learning to integrate rhetoric knowledge into LLMs. We formulate the outputs as JSON to obtain structural outputs and translate keys to Chinese. To further enhance the performance, we also investigate several model ensemble methods. Our method achieves the best performance on all three tracks of CCL 2025 Chinese essay rhetoric recognition evaluation task, winning the first prize.

</details>


### [197] [SAGE Celer 2.6 Technical Card](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.14168)
*SAGEA Research Team,Basab Jha,Firoj Paudel,Ujjwal Puri,Adrian Liu,Ethan Henkel,Zhang Yuting,Mateusz Kowalczyk,Mei Huang,Choi Donghyuk,Wang Junhao*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: SAGE Celer 2.6 是 SAGEA 推出的新一代通用模型（5/10/27 B），通过逆向推理（IR）自校验逻辑、端到端多模态视觉编码器与南亚语言定制分词器，在数学、编程、通用智能基准（ACUMEN）上取得低延迟、低幻觉的 SOTA 级表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 缓解大模型复杂推理中的级联错误与幻觉，同时解决现有多模态适配方案缺陷，并填补主流模型对南亚语言（印地语、尼泊尔语）支持不足的空缺。

Method: 1) 基于未公开基模型继续预训练；2) 提出 Inverse Reasoning 流水线，让模型在训练阶段自生成并验证逻辑路径；3) 原生集成端到端视觉编码器替代外挂适配器；4) 为 Devanagari 脚本设计专用分词器，实现英语-南亚语言双语无损推理。

Result: ACUMEN 基准数学、编码、通用智能任务上达到同期低参数量模型领先水平；推理延迟显著降低；在印地语、尼泊尔语多语言评测中准确率高且未出现英语能力下降。

Conclusion: Celer 2.6 通过 IR 自校验与原生多模态-多语言协同设计，首次在低参数规模下同时实现“低幻觉复杂推理 + 南亚语言强支持”，为区域化、高可靠大模型提供可复用范式。

Abstract: We introduce SAGE Celer 2.6, the latest in our line of general-purpose Celer models from SAGEA. Celer 2.6 is available in 5B, 10B, and 27B parameter sizes and benefits from extensive architectural modifications and further pre-training on an undisclosed model. Using our Inverse Reasoning (IR) pipeline, SAGEA natively trains Celer 2.6 to validate its own logic paths, minimizing cascading error and hallucination in complex reasoning tasks. Celer 2.6 also boasts natively integrated multimodal functionality with an end-to-end vision encoder to avoid common pitfalls in adapter-based approaches. Celer 2.6 provides highly competitive results on mathematics, coding, and general intelligence benchmarks (ACUMEN), along with low latency. Most importantly, Celer 2.6 is specifically optimized for South Asian language support, with a custom tokenizer for the Devanagari script and strong performance in both Nepali and Hindi without sacrificing English reasoning ability.

</details>


### [198] [Chronological Knowledge Retrieval: A Retrieval-Augmented Generation Approach to Construction Project Documentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.14169)
*Ioannis-Aris Kostis,Natalia Sanchiz,Steeve De Schryver,François Denis,Pierre Schaus*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 论文提出一套基于 RAG 的对话式系统，让工程人员用自然语言即可快速追溯并理解项目会议记录中的决策演变，显著降低人工检索成本与错误率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大型工程项目决策持续更新，相关记录浩瀚且手工回溯耗时易错，亟需高效、可验证的语义级检索手段。

Method: 构建 RAG 框架：将语义搜索模块与大型语言模型耦合，对带时间戳的匿名化会议记录进行向量化索引，并引入专家标注的查询集做系统评估。数据集与开源代码一并公开。

Result: 在行业级比利时建筑项目会议记录上的实验表明，系统能返回语义相关且附带明确时间信息的答案，实现决策历史的全流程可追踪。

Conclusion: 时间标注的对话式文档检索方案可显著提升工程决策审计效率，为后续在更广项目类型及多语言场景的扩展奠定基础。

Abstract: In large-scale construction projects, the continuous evolution of decisions generates extensive records, most often captured in meeting minutes. Since decisions may override previous ones, professionals often need to reconstruct the history of specific choices. Retrieving such information manually from raw archives is both labor-intensive and error-prone. From a user perspective, we address this challenge by enabling conversational access to the whole set of project meeting minutes. Professionals can pose natural-language questions and receive answers that are both semantically relevant and explicitly time-annotated, allowing them to follow the chronology of decisions. From a technical perspective, our solution employs a Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) framework that integrates semantic search with large language models to ensure accurate and context-aware responses. We demonstrate the approach using an anonymized, industry-sourced dataset of meeting minutes from a completed construction project by a large company in Belgium. The dataset is annotated and enriched with expert-defined queries to support systematic evaluation. Both the dataset and the open-source implementation are made available to the community to foster further research on conversational access to time-annotated project documentation.

</details>


### [199] [Stateful Evidence-Driven Retrieval-Augmented Generation with Iterative Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.14170)
*Qi Dong,Ziheng Lin,Ning Ding*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出“状态化证据驱动+多轮推理”RAG 框架，通过结构化证据池与差异分析实现稳定检索与高质量问答。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统 RAG 因无状态、浅层表征导致搜索上下文不稳定，对噪声敏感，需显式建模证据累积与冲突检测。

Method: ① 将召回文档转为含置信度与支持度的结构化推理单元；② 维护持久化证据池并记录支持/反对证据；③ 基于证据缺口与冲突进行缺陷分析，迭代改写查询并补充检索；④ 多轮累积直至证据收敛。

Result: 在多项问答基准上全面超越标准 RAG 与现有多步基线，在高噪声检索条件下性能波动大幅降低，且累计高质量证据量显著提升。

Conclusion: 状态化证据池与迭代差异分析是提高 RAG 鲁棒性与问答准确度的关键，为知识密集型任务提供了稳定可控的推理范式。

Abstract: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) grounds Large Language Models (LLMs) in external knowledge but often suffers from flat context representations and stateless retrieval, leading to unstable performance. We propose Stateful Evidence-Driven RAG with Iterative Reasoning, a framework that models question answering as a progressive evidence accumulation process. Retrieved documents are converted into structured reasoning units with explicit relevance and confidence signals and maintained in a persistent evidence pool capturing both supportive and non-supportive information. The framework performs evidence-driven deficiency analysis to identify gaps and conflicts and iteratively refines queries to guide subsequent retrieval. This iterative reasoning process enables stable evidence aggregation and improves robustness to noisy retrieval. Experiments on multiple question answering benchmarks demonstrate consistent improvements over standard RAG and multi-step baselines, while effectively accumulating high-quality evidence and maintaining stable performance under substantial retrieval noise.

</details>


### [200] [Benchmarking Linguistic Adaptation in Comparable-Sized LLMs: A Study of Llama-3.1-8B, Mistral-7B-v0.1, and Qwen3-8B on Romanized Nepali](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.14171)
*Ananda Rimal,Adarsha Rimal*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 首个面向罗马化尼泊尔语（低资源场景）的 LLM 适配基准：对 Llama-3.1-8B、Mistral-7B-v0.1、Qwen3-8B 进行 zero-shot 与微调全维度测评，确认三者均可经轻量 QLoRA-rsLoRA (仅训 1% 参数) 克服生成失败，Qwen-3 综合最佳，Llama-3 提升幅度最大，为低资源迭代开发提供实践路线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 罗马化尼泊尔语是尼泊尔日均数字交流的主要媒介，却在大模型生态中完全缺位；急需量化主流开源 6–8 B 量级模型对该低资源场景的适配能力与微调收益，填补基准空白。

Method: 自建 1 万条英-罗马化尼泊尔语对照指令数据集；以 zero-shot 与 QLoRA-rsLoRA(r=32) 微调两种设定，在双 T4 上累计 27 GPU-时内仅训练 1% 参数；用 7 维 5 指标（PPL、BERTScore、chrF++、ROUGE-1/2/L、BLEU）评估流畅度、音形一致性与语义保真度，并引入十维度结构对齐打分。

Result: Zero-shot 下三模型均无法生成有效罗马化尼泊尔语，呈架构特有失效；经微调后全面恢复，BERTScore≈0.75、chrF++>23。Qwen3-8B 在 zero-shot 即可产出语义相关输出，微调后综合 10 项指标第一；Llama-3.1-8B 虽基线最差，但微调后在 PPL 降 49.77、BERTScore 升 0.3287，增益幅度最大。

Conclusion: 确认“适配余量”假设：基线越弱，微调提升空间越大；Qwen3-8B 为一次性部署首选，Llama-3.1-8B 适合低资源迭代管线；研究首次为罗马化尼泊尔语建立严格可比的开源 8 B 级 LLM 性能基线与轻量微调范式。

Abstract: Romanized Nepali, the Nepali language written in the Latin alphabet, is the dominant medium for informal digital communication in Nepal, yet it remains critically underresourced in the landscape of Large Language Models (LLMs). This study presents a systematic benchmarking of linguistic adaptation across three comparable-sized open-weight models: Llama-3.1-8B, Mistral-7B-v0.1, and Qwen3-8B. We evaluate these architectures under zero-shot and fine-tuned settings using a curated bilingual dataset of 10,000 transliterated instruction-following samples. Performance is quantified across five metrics spanning seven measurement dimensions: Perplexity (PPL), BERTScore, chrF++, ROUGE-1, ROUGE-2, ROUGE-L, and BLEU, capturing fluency, phonetic consistency, and semantic integrity. Models were fine-tuned using Quantized Low-Rank Adaptation (QLoRA) with Rank-Stabilized LoRA (rsLoRA) at rank r=32 on dual NVIDIA Tesla T4 GPUs, training only approximately 1% of each model's parameters in under 27 total GPU-hours. At zero-shot, all three models fail to generate Romanized Nepali, each exhibiting a distinct architecture-specific failure mode. Following fine-tuning, all three resolve these failures and converge to BERTScore approximately 0.75 and chrF++ greater than 23. Overall dimension-wise assessment across ten criteria identifies Qwen3-8B as the overall recommended architecture, being the only model to produce semantically relevant zero-shot output and leading all structural alignment metrics post-SFT. The adaptation headroom hypothesis is confirmed: Llama-3.1-8B, despite its weakest zero-shot baseline, achieves the largest absolute fine-tuning gains in PPL (Delta = -49.77) and BERTScore (Delta = +0.3287), making it the preferred choice for iterative low-resource development pipelines. This work establishes the first rigorous baseline for Romanized Nepali adaptation in comparable-sized open-weight LLMs.

</details>


### [201] [Tug-of-War within A Decade: Conflict Resolution in Vulnerability Analysis via Teacher-Guided Retrieval-Augmented Generations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.14172)
*Ziyin Zhou,Jianyi Zhang,Xu ji,Yilong Li,Jiameng Han,Zhangchi Zhao*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 针对CVE数据更新快导致LLM知识冲突与幻觉的问题，提出两阶段框架CRVA-TGRAG：先通过Parent Document Segmentation+语义/倒排混合检索提升召回，再用“教师引导偏好优化”微调生成，实现高时效、高一致性的漏洞分析。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 十年间3万余条CVE被修订，LLM训练集难以实时同步，致使检索旧知识时出现冲突、幻觉与事实错误，迫切需要让模型始终访问最新CVE并生成一致回答。

Method: 两阶段架构：1) 检索阶段——Parent Document Segmentation保持上下文粒度，语义向量与倒排索引ensemble检索，提升最新CVE的Top-K准确率；2) 生成阶段——以“教师”示范答案为偏好基准，采用偏好优化(如DPO或RRHF)微调LLM，使生成结果与实时CVE数据对齐。

Result: 实验表明，该方法在返回最新CVE的准确率上显著优于仅依赖外部知识库或标准RAG的基线，同时降低幻觉率与知识冲突频次。

Conclusion: CRVA-TGRAG通过检索-生成协同与偏好微调，有效缓解因CVE动态更新带来的知识不一致与幻觉，为安全领域LLM提供可持续、可信的知识更新范式。

Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are essential for analyzing and addressing vulnerabilities in cybersecurity. However, among over 200,000 vulnerabilities were discovered in the past decade, more than 30,000 have been changed or updated. This necessitates frequent updates to the training datasets and internal knowledge bases of LLMs to maintain knowledge consistency. In this paper, we focus on the problem of knowledge discrepancy and conflict within CVE (Common Vulnerabilities and Exposures) detection and analysis. This problem hinders LLMs' ability to retrieve the latest knowledge from original training datasets, leading to knowledge conflicts, fabrications of factually incorrect results, and generation hallucinations. To address this problem, we propose an innovative two-stage framework called CRVA-TGRAG (Conflict Resolution in Vulnerability Analysis via Teacher-Guided Retrieval-Augmented Generation). First, to improve document retrieval accuracy during the retrieval stage, we utilize Parent Document Segmentation and an ensemble retrieval scheme based on semantic similarity and inverted indexing. Second, to enhance LLMs' capabilities based on the retrieval of CVE dataset in generation stage, we employ a teacher-guided preference optimization technique to fine-tune LLMs. Our framework not only enhances the quality of content retrieval through RAG but also leverages the advantages of preference fine-tuning in LLMs to answer questions more effectively and precisely. Experiments demonstrate our method achieves higher accuracy in retrieving the latest CVEs compared to external knowledge bases. In conclusion, our framework significantly mitigates potential knowledge conflicts and inconsistencies that may arise from relying solely on LLMs for knowledge retrieval.

</details>


### [202] [Correcting Suppressed Log-Probabilities in Language Models with Post-Transformer Adapters](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.14174)
*Bryan Sanchez*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 用仅占 0.02% 参数的隐藏状态适配器，可在三档 Qwen3 模型上恢复 31 条政治敏感事实的预测概率，训练集 100% 记忆、测试集 11–39% 泛化；仅末位 token 干预可生成连贯文本，并首次揭示 Apple MLX 的静默梯度归零 bug。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 对齐调优会压低模型对政治敏感话题的事实预测概率，但知识仍隐含在隐藏表示中。作者想在不改变主模型、无须额外知识的前提下，用极小参数把被“压抑”的知识重新拉回可观测分布。

Method: 冻结基模型，在其顶层隐藏状态后插入 786K 参数的多层瓶颈适配器（ gated SwiGLU 与 linear 两种结构）。训练目标为最小化 15 条意识形态判别事实的标准对数似然；采用 anchored training 防止知识倒退。推断时对比“全位干预”与“仅末位干预”两种模式，并验证 logit 层干预无效。实验发现 Apple MLX 的 nn.value_and_grad 误用导致梯度归零，修复后才得到非零结果。

Result: 三档模型(Qwen3-4B/8B/14B)上，训练事实 100% 恢复；16 条测试事实平均泛化率 11–39%，无知识回退。两种适配器结构性能无显著差异(p>0.09)。末位干预模式可生成连贯、低审查文本；全位或 logit 层干预均导致不连贯。

Conclusion: 隐藏状态是修复对齐压制的正确干预层级；极小参数适配器即可“解锢”知识且产生安全可控的减审查输出。研究同时揭露 MLX 框架的静默梯度 bug，提醒社区检查梯度计算范式。

Abstract: Alignment-tuned language models frequently suppress factual log-probabilities on politically sensitive topics despite retaining the knowledge in their hidden representations. We show that a 786K-parameter (approximately 0.02% of the base model) post-transformer adapter, trained on frozen hidden states, corrects this suppression on 31 ideology-discriminating facts across Qwen3-4B, 8B, and 14B. The adapter memorizes all 15 training facts and generalizes to 11--39% of 16 held-out facts across 5 random splits per scale, with zero knowledge regressions via anchored training. Both gated (SwiGLU) and ungated (linear bottleneck) adapters achieve comparable results; neither consistently outperforms the other (Fisher exact p > 0.09 at all scales). On instruct models, the adapter corrects log-probability rankings. When applied at all token positions during generation, the adapter produces incoherent output; however, when applied only at the current prediction position (last-position-only), the adapter produces coherent, less censored text. A logit-space adapter operating after token projection fails to produce coherent generation at any application mode, suggesting hidden-state intervention is the correct level for generation correction. A previously undocumented silent gradient bug in Apple MLX explains all null results in earlier iterations of this work: the standard pattern nn.value_and_grad(model, fn)(model.parameters()) returns zero gradients without error; the correct pattern nn.value_and_grad(model, fn)(model, data) resolves this. We provide a minimal reproduction and discuss implications for other adapter research using MLX.

</details>


### [203] [QU-NLP at ArchEHR-QA 2026: Two-Stage QLoRA Fine-Tuning of Qwen3-4B for Patient-Oriented Clinical Question Answering and Evidence Sentence Alignment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.14175)
*Mohammad AL-Smadi*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 统一系统同时完成ArchEHR-QA的两子任务：答案生成用4-bit QLoRA微调Qwen3-4B，证据对齐用加权三模型检索；皆受限于仅20条训练样本，需数据增强。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 临床问答与证据句对齐均需大模型具备医学知识且适应任务输出格式，但官方仅提供极少量标注样本，需探索如何高效利用有限数据。

Method: 答案生成：两阶段QLoRA→先在30k emrQA-MedSQuAD上获取领域知识，再在20条dev集上学习输出风格；证据对齐：加权集成BM25+相对阈值、TF-IDF余弦与微调cross-encoder，按验证集权重融合。

Result: 答案生成在test-2026达32.87综合分（SARI 55.42最高）；证据对齐micro-F1 67.16。实验一致显示20样本不足以区分相关/无关句。

Conclusion: 核心瓶颈是训练数据稀缺，未来应聚焦临床数据增强策略，而非单纯改进模型结构。

Abstract: We present a unified system addressing both Subtask 3 (answer generation) and Subtask 4 (evidence sentence alignment) of the ArchEHR-QA Shared Task. For Subtask 3, we apply two-stage Quantised Low-Rank Adaptation (QLoRA) to Qwen3-4B loaded in 4-bit NF4 quantisation: first on 30,000 samples from the emrQA-MedSQuAD corpus to establish clinical domain competence, then on the 20 annotated development cases to learn the task-specific output style. Our system achieves an overall score of 32.87 on the official test-2026 split (BLEU = 9.42, ROUGE-L = 27.04, SARI = 55.42, BERTScore = 43.00, AlignScore = 25.28, MEDCON = 37.04). For Subtask 4, we develop a weighted ensemble of three retrieval methods - BM25 with relative thresholding, TF-IDF cosine similarity, and a fine-tuned cross-encoder - to identify note sentences supporting a given gold answer, achieving a micro-F1 of 67.16 on the 100-case test set. Experiments reveal that both subtasks expose the same fundamental challenge: 20 annotated training cases are insufficient to distinguish relevant from irrelevant clinical sentences, pointing to data augmentation as the highest-leverage future direction.

</details>


### [204] [Listen, Correct, and Feed Back: Spoken Pedagogical Feedback Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.14177)
*Junhong Liang,Yifan Lu,Ekaterina Kochmar,Fajri Koto*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 新数据集SPFG通过真实口语转写、人工校验的师生式反馈和偏好对，首次把语法纠错与可执行的教学反馈一同建模；实验显示，监督微调在语用层面稳胜偏好对齐，纠错与反馈质量仅弱相关。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有GEC/GEE只关注对错本身，缺乏面向真实教学的“可操作、难度适配、鼓励性”反馈。作者提出同时生成纠错与符合学习者水平的教学提示，以填补该空白。

Method: 构建SPFG数据集（Speak&Improve语料＋人工校验教学反馈＋优/差反馈对）；在转录口语语法纠错任务上，用Qwen2.5、Llama-3.1、GLM-4三种指令微调模型对比SFT与偏好学习(DPO/KTO)的联合生成。

Result: 1) SFT在纠错与反馈指标上均显著优于偏好对齐；2) DPO/KTO带来的增益有限甚至为负；3) 纠错质量与反馈质量相关系数低，二者可独立优化。

Conclusion: 语音教学反馈生成需以转录文本为中介，监督微调仍是当前最可靠策略；纠“错”与纠“学”目标不同，后续应设计解耦框架分别优化，并引入更多偏好精细化策略。原文地址：https://github.com/Skywalker-Harrison/spfg

Abstract: Grammatical error correction (GEC) and explanation (GEE) have made rapid progress, but real teaching scenarios also require \emph{learner-friendly pedagogical feedback} that is actionable, level-appropriate, and encouraging. We introduce \textbf{SPFG} (\textbf{S}poken \textbf{P}edagogical \textbf{F}eedback \textbf{G}eneration), a dataset built based on the Speak \& Improve Challenge 2025 corpus, pairing fluency-oriented transcriptions with GEC targets and \emph{human-verified} teacher-style feedback, including preferred/rejected feedback pairs for preference learning. We study a transcript-based Spoken Grammatical Error Correction (SGEC) setting and evaluate three instruction-tuned LLMs (Qwen2.5, Llama-3.1, and GLM-4), comparing supervised fine-tuning (SFT) with preference-based alignment (using DPO and KTO) for jointly generating corrections and feedback. Results show that SFT provides the most consistent improvements, while DPO/KTO yield smaller or mixed gains, and that correction quality and feedback quality are weakly coupled. Our implementation is available at https://github.com/Skywalker-Harrison/spfg.

</details>


### [205] [An Underexplored Frontier: Large Language Models for Rare Disease Patient Education and Communication -- A scoping review](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.14179)
*Zaifu Zhan,Yu Hou,Kai Yu,Min Zeng,Anita Burgun,Xiaoyi Chen,Rui Zhang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 大语言模型用于罕见病沟通仅12篇预研究，侧重问答准确率，缺可读性共情及真实场景验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 罕见病全球3亿患者旅程长、专家稀缺、信息缺口大，亟须借助新兴大模型重塑患者教育及沟通模式。

Method: 2022.1–2026.3文献范围综述，系统检索主流数据库并定性萃取12篇LLM相关研究所涉场景、模型、数据与评估手段。

Result: 研究高度新近，ChatGPT占主导；多为静态题库问答，极少用真实数据或连续随访；评估侧重答案准确率，忽视可读性、同理心与多语言支持。

Conclusion: 领域处于概念验证初期，未来应聚焦患者中心设计、领域化大模型与真实世界部署，实现安全、自适应、高质量的罕见病沟通。

Abstract: Rare diseases affect over 300 million people worldwide and are characterized by complex care pathways, limited clinical expertise, and substantial unmet communication needs throughout the long patient journey. Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) offer new opportunities to support patient education and communication, yet their application in rare diseases remains unclear.
  We conducted a scoping review of studies published between January 2022 and March 2026 across major databases, identifying 12 studies on LLM-based rare disease patient education and communication. Data were extracted on study characteristics, application scenarios, model usage, and evaluation methods, and synthesized using descriptive and qualitative analyses.
  The literature is highly recent and dominated by general-purpose models, particularly ChatGPT. Most studies focus on patient question answering using curated question sets, with limited use of real-world data or longitudinal communication scenarios. Evaluations are primarily centered on accuracy, with limited attention to patient-centered dimensions such as readability, empathy, and communication quality. Multilingual communication is rarely addressed.
  Overall, the field remains at an early stage. Future research should prioritize patient-centered design, domain-adapted methods, and real-world deployment to support safe, adaptive, and effective communication in rare diseases.

</details>


### [206] [Internal Knowledge Without External Expression: Probing the Generalization Boundary of a Classical Chinese Language Model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.14180)
*Jiuting Chen,Yuan Lian,Hao Wu,Tianqi Huang,Hiroshi Sasaki,Makoto Kouno,Jongil Choi*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 用纯文言文训练318 M Transformer后发现：模型内部能区分真假史事（困惑度跳升2.39–4.24倍），但生成文字从不主动表达“我不知道”；三种语言、八个规模的模型一致显示，不确定性措辞完全照搬训练语料修辞惯例，而非真正元认知。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 验证仅做语言建模能否自发产生“表达不确定性”的元认知能力。

Method: 在1.56 B token无英文、无阿拉伯数字的精编文言文语料上从头训练Transformer；设计OOD测试集（完全虚构、半虚构、真实史事各92例），比较模型困惑度与生成文本中“ epistemic markers ”的出现频率，并跨语言、跨模型规模复现。

Result: 1) 内部：真假史事困惑度差异显著，半虚构最高，显示模型编码了事实信息；2) 外部：OOD问题中不确定性标记反而更少（3.5 % vs 8.3 %，p = 0.023），且该模式由训练语料修辞传统决定（文言模型“谦辞悖论”，日文模型几乎不hedge）。

Conclusion: 仅靠语言建模无法涌现“说我不知道”的元认知表达，必须引入RLHF等显式信号才能学会表达不确定性。

Abstract: We train a 318M-parameter Transformer language model from scratch on a curated corpus of 1.56 billion tokens of pure Classical Chinese, with zero English characters or Arabic numerals. Through systematic out-of-distribution (OOD) testing, we investigate whether the model can distinguish known from unknown inputs, and crucially, whether it can express this distinction in its generated text.
  We find a clear dissociation between internal and external uncertainty. Internally, the model exhibits a perplexity jump ratio of 2.39x between real and fabricated historical events (p = 8.9e-11, n = 92 per group), with semi-fabricated events (real figures + fictional events) showing the highest perplexity (4.24x, p = 1.1e-16), demonstrating genuine factual encoding beyond syntactic pattern matching. Externally, however, the model never learns to express uncertainty: classical Chinese epistemic markers appear at lower rates for OOD questions (3.5%) than for in-distribution questions (8.3%, p = 0.023), reflecting rhetorical conventions rather than genuine metacognition.
  We replicate both findings across three languages (Classical Chinese, English, Japanese), three writing systems, and eight models from 110M to 1.56B parameters. We further show that uncertainty expression frequency is determined entirely by training data conventions, with Classical Chinese models showing a "humility paradox" (more hedging for known topics), while Japanese models almost never hedge. We argue that metacognitive expression -- the ability to say "I don't know" -- does not emerge from language modeling alone and requires explicit training signals such as RLHF.

</details>


### [207] [Attention to Mamba: A Recipe for Cross-Architecture Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.14191)
*Abhinav Moudgil,Ningyuan Huang,Eeshan Gunesh Dhekane,Pau Rodríguez,Luca Zappella,Federico Danieli*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出两阶段框架，将预训练Transformer蒸馏为纯Mamba结构，无需混合Attention，即可在下游任务中几乎等效地保留原模型性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Mamba类SSM推理高效且省内存，但已有大量Transformer训练经验与权重；现有直接蒸馏方法会掉点，需通过混合Attention弥补。希望找到一条无需Attention块、纯保持SSM优势的蒸馏路线。

Method: 第一步把Transformer线性化为Attention并蒸馏；第二步将这种线性Attention蒸馏为不含Attention块的Mamba，通过精心初始化+全阶段知识传递完成跨架构转移；同时大规模消融实验验证配方，包括在不同模型尺寸和10Btoken预算下最优切分两阶段数据。

Result: 得到的纯Mamba模型在Pythia-1B教师后训练数据上保持14.11困惑度（原13.86），下游任务性能几乎一致；且仅在蒸馏阶段增加少量初始化技巧，无须额外Attention块。10Btoken下最佳设置中A/B阶段token比例约为1:1，更大模型规模下效果更明显优于直接蒸馏或混合方案。

Conclusion: 合适的线性化与分阶段初始化可使Mamba独立继承所有Transformer知识，证明纯SSM还能达到同等表现，为后续大规模预训练和现有Transformer权重重用提供了高效替代方案。

Abstract: State Space Models (SSMs) such as Mamba have become a popular alternative to Transformer models, due to their reduced memory consumption and higher throughput at generation compared to their Attention-based counterparts. On the other hand, the community has built up a considerable body of knowledge on how to train Transformers, and many pretrained Transformer models are readily available. To facilitate the adoption of SSMs while leveraging existing pretrained Transformers, we aim to identify an effective recipe to distill an Attention-based model into a Mamba-like architecture. In prior work on cross-architecture distillation, however, it has been shown that a naïve distillation procedure from Transformers to Mamba fails to preserve the original teacher performance, a limitation often overcome with hybrid solutions combining Attention and SSM blocks. The key argument from our work is that, by equipping Mamba with a principled initialization, we can recover an overall better recipe for cross-architectural distillation. To this end, we propose a principled two-stage approach: first, we distill knowledge from a traditional Transformer into a linearized version of Attention, using an adaptation of the kernel trick. Then, we distill the linearized version into an adapted Mamba model that does not use any Attention block. Overall, the distilled Mamba model is able to preserve the original Pythia-1B Transformer performance in downstream tasks, maintaining a perplexity of 14.11 close to the teacher's 13.86. To show the efficacy of our recipe, we conduct thorough ablations at 1B scale with 10B tokens varying sequence mixer architecture, scaling analysis on model sizes and total distillation tokens, and a sensitivity analysis on tokens allocation between stages.

</details>


### [208] [The PICCO Framework for Large Language Model Prompting: A Taxonomy and Reference Architecture for Prompt Structure](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.14197)
*David A. Cook*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该研究提出PICCO五要素框架（Persona, Instructions, Context, Constraints, Output），为LLM提示词设计提供统一参考结构。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有提示工程缺乏一致性描述与结构化标准，导致提示构建方式混乱、难以复现与比较，亟需可共享的规范化框架。

Method: 系统检索多数据库，整合11个已有提示框架，通过概念梳理与分类，提炼出PICCO五要素参考架构，并界定各要素功能、范围与相互关系。

Result: (1) 建立提示框架、要素、生成、技术与工程五类概念的区分 taxonomy；(2) 提出PICCO五要素提示生成架构，并配套列出零样本、少样本、思维链、集成、分解、自我批评等典型技术与责任提示要点。

Conclusion: PICCO为提示词设计提供概念化、可对照的通用模板，可提升提示构建的系统性与可比性；其作为方法论贡献，尚待后续实证验证优化效果。

Abstract: Large language model (LLM) performance depends heavily on prompt design, yet prompt construction is often described and applied inconsistently. Our purpose was to derive a reference framework for structuring LLM prompts. This paper presents PICCO, a framework derived through a rigorous synthesis of 11 previously published prompting frameworks identified through a multi-database search. The analysis yields two main contributions. First, it proposes a taxonomy that distinguishes prompt frameworks, prompt elements, prompt generation, prompting techniques, and prompt engineering as related but non-equivalent concepts. Second, it derives a five-element reference architecture for prompt generation: Persona, Instructions, Context, Constraints, and Output (PICCO). For each element, we define its function, scope, and relationship to other elements, with the goal of improving conceptual clarity and supporting more systematic prompt design. Finally, to support application of the framework, we outline key concepts relevant to implementation, including prompting techniques (e.g., zero-shot, few-shot, chain-of-thought, ensembling, decomposition, and self-critique, with selected variants), human and automated approaches to iterative prompt engineering, responsible prompting considerations such as security, privacy, bias, and trust, and priorities for future research. This work is a conceptual and methodological contribution: it formalizes a common structure for prompt specification and comparison, but does not claim empirical validation of PICCO as an optimization method.

</details>


### [209] [Chinese Language Is Not More Efficient Than English in Vibe Coding: A Preliminary Study on Token Cost and Problem-Solving Rate](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.14210)
*Simiao Ren,Xingyu Shen,Yuchen Zhou,Dennis,Ng,Ankit Raj*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该研究否认‘中文提示能在代码任务中节省40%token’的网络传言，并指出在SWE-Bench Lite上中文提示成功率下降，无法带来稳定成本或性能收益。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 近期开发者论坛盛传用中文提示可显著减少OpenAI等API费用，甚至催生“vibe coding”改用中文的风潮，但缺乏严格的benchmark验证。

Method: 在SWE-Bench Lite（软件工程任务基准）上使用多种主流大模型，比较中英文提示的token消耗量、Task成功率与期望成本(success cost = 平均token×1/成功率)。覆盖不同架构模型并统计显著性。

Result: 1）未发现中文普遍省token；2）不同模型对中文的token消耗方向相反：MiniMax-2.7中文+28%，GLM-5反而略减；3）所有模型中文提示的task成功率均低于英文，折算后的“成功单位成本”中文更贵。

Conclusion: 所谓中文提示能省钱增效的说法不成立，语言对token与性能的影响模型相关，开发者不应仅为省钱而将提示语言换成中文，但研究样本受限，未来需更大规模验证。

Abstract: A claim has been circulating on social media and practitioner forums that Chinese prompts are more token-efficient than English for LLM coding tasks, potentially reducing costs by up to 40\%. This claim has influenced developers to consider switching to Chinese for ``vibe coding'' to save on API costs. In this paper, we conduct a rigorous empirical study using SWE-bench Lite, a benchmark of software engineering tasks, to evaluate whether this claim of Chinese token efficiency holds up to scrutiny. Our results reveal three key findings: First, the efficiency advantage of Chinese is not observed. Second, token cost varies by model architecture in ways that defy simple assumptions: while MiniMax-2.7 shows 1.28x higher token costs for Chinese, GLM-5 actually consumes fewer tokens with Chinese prompts. Third, and most importantly, we found that the success rate when prompting in Chinese is generally lower than in English across all models we tested. We also measure cost efficiency as expected cost per successful task -- jointly accounting for token consumption and task resolution rate. These findings should be interpreted as preliminary evidence rather than a definitive conclusion, given the limited number of models evaluated and the narrow set of benchmarks tested due to resource constraints; they indicate that language effects on token cost are model-dependent, and that practitioners should not expect cost savings or performance gains just by switching their prompt language to Chinese.

</details>


### [210] [CROP: Token-Efficient Reasoning in Large Language Models via Regularized Prompt Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.14214)
*Deep Shah,Sanket Badhe,Nehal Kathrotia,Priyanka Tiwari*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出 CROP——在自动提示优化中显式对回复长度做正则化，可把推理型大模型的 token 用量砍掉八成，准确率几乎不降。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有推理提示虽能提升准确率，却带来冗长回复导致的延迟与高昂 token 成本；主流自动提示优化只关心准确率，忽视了长度开销。

Method: CROP 在优化循环中同时生成“准确性”与“长度/冗余”两类文本反馈，将其作为正则项加入提示搜索目标，迫使提示诱导模型输出仅含关键信息且推理完备的短回答。

Result: 在 GSM8K、LogiQA、BIG-Bench Hard 三大复杂推理集上，token 消耗平均降低 80.6%，准确率下降幅度极小（<1%），保持与 SOTA 相当的水平。

Conclusion: CROP 首次把“长度正则”引入提示优化，为生产环境部署高推理性能且 token 经济的 Agent 提供了可行且高效的实用方案。

Abstract: Large Language Models utilizing reasoning techniques improve task performance but incur significant latency and token costs due to verbose generation. Existing automatic prompt optimization(APO) frameworks target task accuracy exclusively at the expense of generating long reasoning traces. We propose Cost-Regularized Optimization of Prompts (CROP), an APO method that introduces regularization on response length by generating textual feedback in addition to standard accuracy feedback. This forces the optimization process to produce prompts that elicit concise responses containing only critical information and reasoning. We evaluate our approach on complex reasoning datasets, specifically GSM8K, LogiQA and BIG-Bench Hard. We achieved an 80.6\% reduction in token consumption while maintaining competitive accuracy, seeing only a nominal decline in performance. This presents a pragmatic solution for deploying token-efficient and cost-effective agentic AI systems in production pipelines.

</details>


### [211] [MEME-Fusion@CHiPSAL 2026: Multimodal Ablation Study of Hate Detection and Sentiment Analysis on Nepali Memes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.14218)
*Samir Wagle,Reewaj Khanal,Abiral Adhikari*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 针对天城文字网络迷因的仇恨言论检测，提出跨模态门控融合模型，在数据极度稀缺（≈850 条/折）条件下，将宏 F1 提升 5.9%，并揭示英语视觉模型与常规集成在天城文场景下的双重失效。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 天城文字迷因同时存在多模态结构、文字特有复杂度与极低资源三重难题，现有方法因英语视觉模型偏差与集成过拟合而难以奏效，亟需面向脚本特异性的跨模态建模方案。

Method: 构建混合跨模态注意力融合框架：CLIP-ViT-B/32 视觉编码 + BGE-M3 多语言文本编码 → 四头自注意力交互 → 可学习门控网络，按样本动态重加权模态贡献；八组配置系统对比文本基线、单模态及集成策略。

Result: 在 CHiPSAL 2026 Subtask A 上达最优宏 F1，比纯文本提升 5.9%；发现英语 CLIP 对天城文几乎随机猜测，传统集成因相关过拟合在稀缺数据下性能崩溃。

Conclusion: 显式跨模态推理是低资源天城文迷因检测的关键；须警惕英语视觉模型的脚本偏差与集成的数据规模陷阱，门控融合提供可靠路径。

Abstract: Hate speech detection in Devanagari-scripted social media memes presents compounded challenges: multimodal content structure, script-specific linguistic complexity, and extreme data scarcity in low-resource settings. This paper presents our system for the CHiPSAL 2026 shared task, addressing both Subtask A (binary hate speech detection) and Subtask B (three-class sentiment classification: positive, neutral, negative). We propose a hybrid cross-modal attention fusion architecture that combines CLIP (ViT-B/32) for visual encoding with BGE-M3 for multilingual text representation, connected through 4-head self-attention and a learnable gating network that dynamically weights modality contributions on a per-sample basis. Systematic evaluation across eight model configurations demonstrates that explicit cross-modal reasoning achieves a 5.9% F1-macro improvement over text-only baselines on Subtask A, while uncovering two unexpected but critical findings: English-centric vision models exhibit near-random performance on Devanagari script, and standard ensemble methods catastrophically degrade under data scarcity (N nearly equal to 850 per fold) due to correlated overfitting. The code can be accessed at https://github.com/Tri-Yantra-Technologies/MEME-Fusion/

</details>


### [212] [ReviewGrounder: Improving Review Substantiveness with Rubric-Guided, Tool-Integrated Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.14261)
*Zhuofeng Li,Yi Lu,Dongfu Jiang,Haoxiang Zhang,Yuyang Bai,Chuan Li,Yu Wang,Shuiwang Ji,Jianwen Xie,Yu Zhang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 基于大模型的审稿常流于表面，作者构建REVIEWBENCH基准并提出多智能体框架REVIEWGROUNDER，通过“起草—证据落地”两阶段显著优于GPT-4.1等强基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI会议投稿激增，LLM辅助审稿虽受关注，却普遍生成空泛、缺乏证据的公式化意见；其核心原因是缺少人类审稿中的显性评分准则(rubric)与对既有工作的情境化引用(contextual grounding)。

Method: 1) 构建REVIEWBENCH：从官方审稿指南、论文全文及人工高质量审稿中提取论文专属rubric，并据此评估生成评审。2) 设计REVIEWGROUNDER：采用多智能体流水线，将审稿拆为“起草阶段”(Phi-4-14B按rubric生成初稿)与“证据落地阶段”(GPT-OSS-120B调用检索工具，定向补充引用、实验细节、对比等证据)。两阶段迭代，保证内容既贴合评分细则又证据充分。

Result: 在REVIEWBENCH的8个评审维度上，REVIEWGROUNDER的rubric对齐度与人工评分一致性均显著优于GPT-4.1、DeepSeek-R1-670B等更大/更强的基线模型；定性分析显示其评论具体、引用精准，更少出现泛泛而谈或幻觉。

Conclusion: 显式rubric与证据落地是提升LLM审稿质量的关键。REVIEWGROUNDER通过“准则驱动+工具增强”范式，为高质量、可解释的自动审稿提供了可行路径，并可推广至其他需要深度证据支持的文本生成任务。

Abstract: The rapid rise in AI conference submissions has driven increasing exploration of large language models (LLMs) for peer review support. However, LLM-based reviewers often generate superficial, formulaic comments lacking substantive, evidence-grounded feedback. We attribute this to the underutilization of two key components of human reviewing: explicit rubrics and contextual grounding in existing work. To address this, we introduce REVIEWBENCH, a benchmark evaluating review text according to paper-specific rubrics derived from official guidelines, the paper's content, and human-written reviews. We further propose REVIEWGROUNDER, a rubric-guided, tool-integrated multi-agent framework that decomposes reviewing into drafting and grounding stages, enriching shallow drafts via targeted evidence consolidation. Experiments on REVIEWBENCH show that REVIEWGROUNDER, using a Phi-4-14B-based drafter and a GPT-OSS-120B-based grounding stage, consistently outperforms baselines with substantially stronger/larger backbones (e.g., GPT-4.1 and DeepSeek-R1-670B) in both alignment with human judgments and rubric-based review quality across 8 dimensions. The code is available \href{https://github.com/EigenTom/ReviewGrounder}{here}.

</details>


### [213] [EuropeMedQA Study Protocol: A Multilingual, Multimodal Medical Examination Dataset for Language Model Evaluation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.14306)
*Francesco Andrea Causio,Vittorio De Vita,Olivia Riccomi,Michele Ferramola,Federico Felizzi,Antonio Cristiano,Lorenzo De Mori,Chiara Battipaglia,Melissa Sawaya,Luigi De Angelis,Marcello Di Pumpo,Alessandra Piscitelli,Pietro Eric Risuleo,Alessia Longo,Giulia Vojvodic,Mariapia Vassalli,Bianca Destro Castaniti,Nicolò Scarsi,Manuel Del Medico*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: EuropeMedQA是首个覆盖意/法/西/葡四国官方医师资格考试的多语多模态数据集，通过零样本严格提示评估多模态LLM在跨语言迁移与视觉推理上的真实表现，为欧洲复杂临床场景提供抗污染基准。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM在非英语语境及多模态诊断任务中性能骤降，欧洲缺乏统一、合规且具代表性的多语医学评测基准，阻碍了可迁移医疗AI的发展。
