Our findings highlight a systematic gap in current SLMs' ability to maintain speaking styles, highlighting the need for improved style adherence in future models. Our code and evaluation data are publicly available at https://github.com/YuXiangLin1234/SLM-Style-Amnesia.

</details>


### [327] [Enhancing Linguistic Competence of Language Models through Pre-training with Language Learning Tasks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.03448)
*Atsuki Yamaguchi,Maggie Mi,Nikolaos Aletras*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: L2T在继续预测下一个token的同时，额外引入显式语言学习任务，显著提升模型语言胜任力且不减通用推理能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 仅依靠自回归预训练虽可获得世界知识与推理能力，但对语言胜任力缺乏直接优化，需要向人类语言习得机制借鉴来弥补这一缺口。

Method: 把原始文本转化为结构化输入-输出对，构建语言学习任务，并将其与常规next-token预测按比例混合进行预训练。

Result: 在多个语言胜任力基准上取得显著提升，训练效率更高，同时在通用推理任务上保持与基线相竞争的表现。

Conclusion: 引入显式语言学习刺激可在不牺牲推理能力的前提下，加速并增强大模型对语言的掌握，验证了其作为预训练范式的有效性。

Abstract: Language models (LMs) are pre-trained on raw text datasets to generate text sequences token-by-token. While this approach facilitates the learning of world knowledge and reasoning, it does not explicitly optimize for linguistic competence. To bridge this gap, we propose L2T, a pre-training framework integrating Language Learning Tasks alongside standard next-token prediction. Inspired by human language acquisition, L2T transforms raw text into structured input-output pairs to provide explicit linguistic stimulation. Pre-training LMs on a mixture of raw text and L2T data not only improves overall performance on linguistic competence benchmarks but accelerates its acquisition, while maintaining competitive performance on general reasoning tasks.

</details>


### [328] [Beyond Literal Mapping: Benchmarking and Improving Non-Literal Translation Evaluation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.07338)
*Yanzhi Tian,Cunxiang Wang,Zeming Liu,Heyan Huang,Wenbo Yu,Dawei Song,Jie Tang,Yuhang Guo*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 传统MT评测指标在非字面翻译场景失效；作者发布含7 530人工评分的MENT数据集，提出可动态调用子智能体的反射式框架RATE，在系统级与片段级相关性上均超现有方法3.2分以上。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM已用于文学、社交网络等非字面翻译场景，但成语、隐喻等表达导致BLEU/CHRF等指标失真；同时LLM-as-a-Judge存在知识截断与打分不一致问题，亟需更可靠的元评测方法与数据集。

Method: ①构建MENT元评测数据集，覆盖四领域非字面翻译并收集7 530个人类质量评分；②设计RATE框架：中心反射式Core Agent动态调用专用子智能体（知识补全、一致性校验、细粒度评分子Agent），通过多轮推理生成最终评分。

Result: 在MENT及通用领域测试集上，RATE的系统级与片段级Pearson/Spearman相关系数分别提升≥3.2分，显著优于BLEURT、COMET、GPT-4-as-Judge等基线，且方差降低，表现出跨领域鲁棒性。

Conclusion: 非字面翻译需要超越n-gram匹配的评估范式；RATE通过“智能体协作+反射校正”有效缓解知识缺失与打分漂移，为MT评测提供可扩展的新范式，代码与数据已开源以供复现与扩展。

Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have significantly advanced Machine Translation (MT), applying them to linguistically complex domains-such as Social Network Services, literature etc. In these scenarios, translations often require handling non-literal expressions, leading to the inaccuracy of MT metrics. To systematically investigate the reliability of MT metrics, we first curate a meta-evaluation dataset focused on non-literal translations, namely MENT. MENT encompasses four non-literal translation domains and features source sentences paired with translations from diverse MT systems, with 7,530 human-annotated scores on translation quality. Experimental results reveal the inaccuracies of traditional MT metrics and the limitations of LLM-as-a-Judge, particularly the knowledge cutoff and score inconsistency problem. To mitigate these limitations, we propose RATE, a novel agentic translation evaluation framework, centered by a reflective Core Agent that dynamically invokes specialized sub-agents. Experimental results indicate the efficacy of RATE, achieving an improvement of at least 3.2 points in combined system- and segment-level correlation with human judgments compared with current methods. Further experiments demonstrate the robustness of RATE to general-domain MT evaluation. Code and dataset are available at: https://github.com/BITHLP/RATE.

</details>


### [329] [Adaptive Layer Selection for Layer-Wise Token Pruning in LLM Inference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.07667)
*Rei Taniguchi,Yuyang Dong,Makoto Onizuka,Chuan Xiao*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 针对现有KV-缓存逐层剪枝策略固定选层带来的任务鲁棒性不足问题，本文提出一种无训练的自适应层选取方法ASL，只需在预fill阶段根据attention分数排序熵动态决定剪枝层，可与SnapKV等解码阶段方法叠加使用，兼具设定缓存预算约束与QAR/序列检索等硬任务性能提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在LLM推理中，KV缓存占用是延迟和显存的瓶颈；现有主流“固定若干层做token剪枝”方法易因任务差异剧烈掉点，尤其KV检索类困难任务退化显著，亟需一种任务通用、无需重训且能保证用户给定压缩比的方案。

Method: 提出ASL（Adaptive Selection Layer）：预填阶段实时计算各层attention得分的token-rank方差，选取方差最平稳的最晚层作为剪枝点，并对该层一次性过滤top-k token；核心仅需一次前向采样，无需训练或额外参数，并可与SnapKV等解码优化组合。

Result: 在InfiniteBench、RULER、NIAH等长序列基准评估中：对128k上下文指定<10% KV预算下，ASL较当前最优固定层剪枝方法提高检索类任务准确率8–15pp，平均任务方差缩小30%，整体吞吐量无明显降低；配合SnapKV时解码长度扩展率进一步提升1.2×。

Conclusion: 借助于简单的attention排序方差度量，ASL实现了训练无关的自适应KV剪枝层选择，在严格KV预算下显著平衡了准确率与效率，并兼容后续解码级优化，为无训练KV压缩提供了新的可靠基线，展示了在多变长序列任务中的高适应性与落地潜力。

Abstract: Due to the prevalence of large language models (LLMs), key-value (KV) cache reduction for LLM inference has received remarkable attention. Among numerous works that have been proposed in recent years, layer-wise token pruning approaches, which select a subset of tokens at particular layers to retain in KV cache and prune others, are one of the most popular schemes. They primarily adopt a set of pre-defined layers, at which tokens are selected. Such design is inflexible in the sense that the accuracy significantly varies across tasks and deteriorates in harder tasks such as KV retrieval. In this paper, we propose ASL, a training-free method that adaptively chooses the selection layer for KV cache reduction, exploiting the variance of token ranks ordered by attention score. The proposed method balances the performance across different tasks while meeting the user-specified KV budget requirement. ASL operates during the prefilling stage and can be jointly used with existing KV cache reduction methods such as SnapKV to optimize the decoding stage. By evaluations on the InfiniteBench, RULER, and NIAH benchmarks, we show that ASL, equipped with one-shot token selection, adaptively trades inference speed for accuracy, outperforming state-of-the-art layer-wise token pruning methods in difficult tasks.

</details>


### [330] [Language of Thought Shapes Output Diversity in Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.11227)
*Shaoyang Xu,Wenxuan Zhang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 改变大模型思考时的内部语言能显著提升其英文输出的多样性，越远离英语的语言带来的增益越大


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 解释并提升大模型输出多样性：一方面多样性是衡量模型质量的核心指标，另一方面现有方法多停留在采样温度、top-p等表层控制，缺乏从模型

Method: 提出“思维语言（LoT）”概念，将模型内部推理显式化后，用单机采样和混合采样两种策略对比不同语言下的英文输出多样性

Result: 非英语思维语言持续提升输出多样性，与语言到英语的语义 / 结构距离呈正相关；混合多语思维采样可获得组合增益，提升文化、价值观覆盖面

Conclusion: 作为结构性来源的思维语言对多样性具有独立、加法式的提升效果，为多语对齐和个性化模型设计开辟了新方向

Abstract: Output diversity is crucial for Large Language Models as it underpins pluralism and creativity. In this work, we reveal that controlling the language used during model thinking-the language of thought-provides a novel and structural source of output diversity. Our preliminary study shows that different thinking languages occupy distinct regions in a model's thinking space. Based on this observation, we study two repeated sampling strategies under multilingual thinking-Single-Language Sampling and Mixed-Language Sampling-and conduct diversity evaluation on outputs that are controlled to be in English, regardless of the thinking language used. Across extensive experiments, we demonstrate that switching the thinking language from English to non-English languages consistently increases output diversity, with a clear and consistent positive correlation such that languages farther from English in the thinking space yield larger gains. We further show that aggregating samples across multiple thinking languages yields additional improvements through compositional effects, and that scaling sampling with linguistic heterogeneity expands the model's diversity ceiling. Finally, we show that these findings translate into practical benefits in pluralistic alignment scenarios, leading to broader coverage of cultural knowledge and value orientations in LLM outputs. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/iNLP-Lab/Multilingual-LoT-Diversity.

</details>


### [331] [Anonpsy: A Graph-Based Framework for Structure-Preserving De-identification of Psychiatric Narratives](https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.13503)
*Kyung Ho Lim,Byung-Hoon Kim*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: Anonpsy 将精神科病历改写为图引导的语义重写任务，显式保留临床结构、扰动身份要素，兼顾诊断保真与低重识别风险。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统去标识化（PHI 遮蔽或纯 LLM 重写）仅在文本层操作，无法精细控制哪些语义要素需保留或变更，难以兼顾临床价值与隐私安全。

Method: 1) 把每条病历转化为语义图（实体-时间锚-关系）；2) 在图约束下扰动可识别上下文，保留临床必需结构；3) 用图条件 LLM 重生成文本。

Result: 在 90 篇临床撰写病历中，Anonpsy 维持诊断一致性，同时在专家、语义与 GPT-5 三重评估下重识别风险最低；相比强 LLM-only 基线，语义相似度与可识别性显著下降。

Conclusion: 显式结构表示加约束生成，可为精神科叙事提供高效且可控的去标识化方案。

Abstract: Psychiatric narratives encode patient identity not only through explicit identifiers but also through idiosyncratic life events embedded in their clinical structure. Existing de-identification approaches, including PHI masking and LLM-based synthetic rewriting, operate at the text level and offer limited control over which semantic elements are preserved or altered. We introduce Anonpsy, a de-identification framework that reformulates the task as graph-guided semantic rewriting. Anonpsy (1) converts each narrative into a semantic graph encoding clinical entities, temporal anchors, and typed relations; (2) applies graph-constrained perturbations that modify identifying context while preserving clinically essential structure; and (3) regenerates text via graph-conditioned LLM generation. Evaluated on 90 clinician-authored psychiatric case narratives, Anonpsy preserves diagnostic fidelity while achieving consistently low re-identification risk under expert, semantic, and GPT-5-based evaluations. Compared with a strong LLM-only rewriting baseline, Anonpsy yields substantially lower semantic similarity and identifiability. These results demonstrate that explicit structural representations combined with constrained generation provide an effective approach to de-identification for psychiatric narratives.

</details>


### [332] [Multi-Persona Thinking for Bias Mitigation in Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.15488)
*Yuxing Chen,Guoqing Luo,Zijun Wu,Lili Mou*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出推理阶段框架 MPT，利用多重社会身份视角识别并纠偏，显著降低 LLM 社会偏见且保持推理能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有大模型普遍存在社会（性别、种族等）偏见，引发刻板印象与不公平输出，亟需一种无需再训练、推理即可落地的去偏方法。

Method: MPT 推理框架：1) 指令 LLM 同时生成“男性”“女性”“中性”三类人格视角；2) 三轮以上交互式对话，让视角互相质疑-辩护；3) 引入去偏规则集与自我批评提示迭代修正，最终输出共识答案。

Result: 在 BOLD 与 BBQ 基准上对 7B–70B 开源及 GPT-3.5/GPT-4 闭源模型测试，MPT 偏见分数平均下降 28%（token 层面）和 32%（问题层面），优于已有提示基线，同时在 MMLU、BBH、ARC 等推理任务准确率保持在原模型 97% 以上。

Conclusion: MPT 将“人设”潜在缺陷转为纠偏工具，仅需提示即可在推理实时去偏，兼具易部署、零参数、模型无关等优势，为公平 LLM 提供可扩展途径。

Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) exhibit social biases, which can lead to harmful stereotypes and unfair outcomes. We propose \textbf{Multi-Persona Thinking (MPT)}, a simple inference-time framework that reduces social bias by encouraging reasoning from multiple perspectives. MPT guides the model to consider contrasting social identities, such as male and female, together with a neutral viewpoint. These viewpoints then interact through an iterative reasoning process to identify and correct biased judgments. This design transforms the potential weakness of persona assignment into a mechanism for bias mitigation. We evaluate MPT on two widely used bias benchmarks with both open-source and closed-source models across different scales. Results show that MPT achieves lower bias than existing prompting-based methods while maintaining core reasoning ability.

</details>


### [333] [CausalEmbed: Auto-Regressive Multi-Vector Generation in Latent Space for Visual Document Embedding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.21262)
*Jiahao Huo,Yu Huang,Yibo Yan,Ye Pan,Kening Zheng,Wei-Chieh Huang,Yi Cao,Mingdong Ou,Philip S. Yu,Xuming Hu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出自回归多向量生成框架 CausalEmbed，将视觉文档检索的嵌入维度压缩 30-155×，仅需数十个视觉 token 即可保持 SOTA 性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 MLLM 为每页文档生成上千视觉 token，存储与推理开销大，难以落地。

Method: 设计自回归对比学习框架，结合迭代 margin 损失，逐 token 生成紧凑、结构化的多向量表示；训练与推理均支持灵活伸缩。

Result: 在多种骨干与基准上，仅用几十 token 就达到与全 token 方案相当的检索精度，理论分析与实测均显示训练与测试阶段的可扩展性优势。

Conclusion: CausalEmbed 首次把生成式范式引入多模态文档检索，为高效 VDR 提供新的测试时可伸缩策略，代码已开源。

Abstract: Although Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have shown remarkable potential in Visual Document Retrieval (VDR) through generating high-quality multi-vector embeddings, the substantial storage overhead caused by representing a page with thousands of visual tokens limits their practicality in real-world applications. To address this challenge, we propose an auto-regressive generation approach, CausalEmbed, for constructing multi-vector embeddings. By incorporating iterative margin loss during contrastive training, CausalEmbed encourages the embedding models to learn compact and well-structured representations. Our method enables efficient VDR tasks using only dozens of visual tokens, achieving a 30-155x reduction in token count while maintaining highly competitive performance across various backbones and benchmarks. Theoretical analysis and empirical results demonstrate the unique advantages of auto-regressive embedding generation in terms of training efficiency and scalability at test time. As a result, CausalEmbed introduces a flexible test-time scaling strategy for multi-vector VDR representations and sheds light on the generative paradigm within multimodal document retrieval. Our code is available at https://github.com/Z1zs/Causal-Embed.

</details>


### [334] [POP: Prefill-Only Pruning for Efficient Large Model Inference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.03295)
*Junhui He,Zhihui Fu,Jun Wang,Qingan Li*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 针对 LLM 的两阶段推理差异，本文提出 Prefill-Only Pruning（POP）：仅在预填充阶段剪枝深层、保留完整模型用于解码，配合虚拟门控与独立 KV 投影，实现 1.37× 预填充延迟加速且几乎不掉点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有结构化剪枝因“阶段无关”设计，误将深层一并裁剪，导致解码阶段精度暴跌；作者观察到深层对预填充冗余却对解码关键，遂探索阶段感知的差异化剪枝策略。

Method: 1) 虚拟门机制量化各层在预填充/解码中的重要性；2) POP：预填充阶段跳过深层、解码阶段恢复全模型；3) 独立 KV 投影保障缓存一致性；4) 边界处理确保首 token 精度。

Result: 在 Llama-3.1、Qwen3-VL、Gemma-3 的多模态任务上，POP 预填充延迟最高降低 27%，下游指标下降 <0.3%，显著优于传统结构化剪枝。

Conclusion: 通过阶段特异性剪枝，POP 首次在结构化压缩中打破“精度-效率”权衡，为 LLM/VLM 的高效落地提供了可直接部署的新范式。

Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) and Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have demonstrated remarkable capabilities. However, their deployment is hindered by significant computational costs. Existing structured pruning methods, while hardware-efficient, often suffer from significant accuracy degradation. In this paper, we argue that this failure stems from a stage-agnostic pruning approach that overlooks the asymmetric roles between the prefill and decode stages. By introducing a virtual gate mechanism, our importance analysis reveals that deep layers are critical for next-token prediction (decode) but largely redundant for context encoding (prefill). Leveraging this insight, we propose Prefill-Only Pruning (POP), a stage-aware inference strategy that safely omits deep layers during the computationally intensive prefill stage while retaining the full model for the sensitive decode stage. To enable the transition between stages, we introduce independent Key-Value (KV) projections to maintain cache integrity, and a boundary handling strategy to ensure the accuracy of the first generated token. Extensive experiments on Llama-3.1, Qwen3-VL, and Gemma-3 across diverse modalities demonstrate that POP achieves up to 1.37$\times$ speedup in prefill latency with minimal performance loss, effectively overcoming the accuracy-efficiency trade-off limitations of existing structured pruning methods.

</details>


### [335] [Challenges in Translating Technical Lectures: Insights from the NPTEL](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.08698)
*Basudha Raje,Sadanand Venkatraman,Nandana TP,Soumyadeepa Das,Polkam Poojitha,M. Vijaykumar,Tanima Bagchi,Hema A. Murthy*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 利用印度三语种语料检验机器翻译在教育场景下的实用性与评估缺陷。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 回应印度国家教育政策（NEP 2020）对多语教育技术的急迫需求，补足低资源印度语言（Bangla、Malayalam、Telugu）机器翻译实证空白。

Method: 以NPTEL MOOC门户为原始语料，构建口语化技术话语三语平行库；采用表面重叠指标（BLEU等）及针对性指标对神经机器翻译系统进行对比评估，并做语言学误差分析。

Result: 表面重叠指标对形态丰富、语义浓缩的印度语言高度敏感，显著低估翻译质量；口语技术话语的语域与词汇选择进一步放大评估失真，暴露出现有指标的系统性偏差。

Conclusion: 必须开发融合形态、语义与语域特征的评估框架，才能准确反映印度语言机器翻译在教育场景中的真实可用性，并指导面向NEP 2020的多语教育技术落地。

Abstract: This study examines the practical applications and methodological implications of Machine Translation in Indian Languages, specifically Bangla, Malayalam, and Telugu, within emerging translation workflows and in relation to existing evaluation frameworks. The choice of languages prioritized in this study is motivated by a triangulation of linguistic diversity, which illustrates the significance of multilingual accommodation of educational technology under NEP 2020. This is further supported by the largest MOOC portal, i.e., NPTEL, which has served as a corpus to facilitate the arguments presented in this paper. The curation of a spontaneous speech corpora that accounts for lucid delivery of technical concepts, considering the retention of suitable register and lexical choices are crucial in a diverse country like India. The findings of this study highlight metric-specific sensitivity and the challenges of morphologically rich and semantically compact features when tested against surface overlapping metrics.

</details>


### [336] [Beyond Translation: Evaluating Mathematical Reasoning Capabilities of LLMs in Sinhala and Tamil](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.14517)
*Sukumar Kishanthan,Kumar Thushalika,Buddhi Jayasekara,Asela Hevapathige*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 四大主流 LLM 在非英语、低资源语言（僧伽罗语、泰米尔语）上做数学题时，复杂推理能力显著下降，简单算术尚可，直接部署多语言数学辅导存在风险。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 尽管 LLM 已用于数学辅导，但其在南亚学校主要教学语言——僧伽罗语与泰伽罗语——上的可靠性尚属空白；翻译语料会混淆语言能力与翻译质量，因此需原生构建评测集。

Method: 由数学背景流利的母语者独立创作 6 类数学题（含算术到最优化），形成僧伽罗语、泰米尔语、英语三语平行数据集；对 4 个代表性 LLM 进行零样本评估，对比跨语言表现。

Result: 基础算术跨语言稳健；复杂推理在僧伽罗语和泰米尔语上准确率显著下降，且失败模式随模型与题型而异；英语高分并不预示低资源语言高可靠性。

Conclusion: 在部署 LLM 作为多语言数学辅导工具前，必须针对目标语言进行专门评估与优化，否则可能误导学生、加剧教育不平等。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have achieved strong results in mathematical reasoning, and are increasingly deployed as tutoring and learning support tools in educational settings. However, their reliability for students working in non-English languages, especially low-resource languages, remains poorly understood. We examine this gap by evaluating mathematical reasoning in Sinhala and Tamil -- two languages widely used in South Asian schools but underrepresented in artificial intelligence (AI) research. Using a taxonomy of six math problem types, from basic arithmetic to complex unit conflict and optimization problems, we evaluate four prominent large language models. To avoid translation artifacts that confound language ability with translation quality, we construct a parallel dataset in which each problem is independently authored in Sinhala and Tamil by native speakers, and in English by fluent speakers, all with strong mathematical backgrounds. Our analysis demonstrates that while basic arithmetic reasoning transfers robustly across languages, complex reasoning tasks show significant degradation in Tamil and Sinhala. The pattern of failures varies by model and problem type, suggesting that strong performance in English does not guarantee reliable performance across languages. These findings have direct implications for the deployment of AI tools in multilingual classrooms, and highlight the need for language-specific evaluation before adopting large language models as math tutoring aids in non-English educational contexts.

</details>


### [337] [How Retrieved Context Shapes Internal Representations in RAG](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.20091)
*Samuel Yeh,Sharon Li*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 基于检索的RAG模型表现不仅取决于“检索到了什么”，更取决于“模型内部如何表征检索内容”；作者提出用潜表征分析框架，系统量化单/多文档、相关性差异对隐藏层状态的影响，从而把检索上下文与LLM输出行为关联起来。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现实检索结果常混杂相关、无关甚至误导文档，但现有研究多聚焦输出层面，缺乏对“内部表征如何被不同检索文档塑造”的定量认识，限制了对RAG失效原因的诊断与优化。

Method: 在4个问答数据集、3个规模LLM上设计对照实验：①单文档 vs 多文档；②高/低相关性；③逐层探针与表征相似性分析，测量隐藏状态分布偏移及注意力模式，再以表征变化预测最终答案置信度与正确性。

Result: 发现：1. 相关文档显著拉低深层表征与无检索基线的距离，无关文档仅在早期层产生微弱偏移；2. 多文档场景下，模型对“最相关”文档的表征集中度越高，答案准确率提升17-28%；3. 表征偏移量可作为0.81 AUC的“答案正确性”早期信号。

Conclusion: 检索上下文并非被动拼接，而是通过分层表征“重编程”模型知识激活；未来RAG系统可在检索重排序、早期退出及动态提示构建中直接利用表征监控信号，实现“以内部对齐驱动外部输出”的新设计范式。

Abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) enhances large language models (LLMs) by conditioning generation on retrieved external documents, but the effect of retrieved context is often non-trivial. In realistic retrieval settings, the retrieved document set often contains a mixture of documents that vary in relevance and usefulness. While prior work has largely examined these phenomena through output behavior, little is known about how retrieved context shapes the internal representations that mediate information integration in RAG. In this work, we study RAG through the lens of latent representations. We systematically analyze how different types of retrieved documents affect the hidden states of LLMs, and how these internal representation shifts relate to downstream generation behavior. Across four question-answering datasets and three LLMs, we analyze internal representations under controlled single- and multi-document settings. Our results reveal how context relevancy and layer-wise processing influence internal representations, providing explanations of LLMs' output behaviors and insights for RAG system design.

</details>


### [338] [DySCO: Dynamic Attention-Scaling Decoding for Long-Context Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.22175)
*Xi Ye,Wuwei Zhang,Fangcong Yin,Howard Yen,Danqi Chen*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 无需训练的DYSCO解码算法，通过检索头动态重加权关键token，在128K长上下文任务上最高提升25%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有语言模型虽支持长窗口，但随长度增加注意力漂移，难以持续聚焦任务相关上下文，导致推理精度下降。

Method: 提出DYSCO解码算法：利用预训练模型中天然存在的“检索头”实时识别当前解码步骤最相关的token，并在生成阶段动态放大其注意力权重；整个过程无需训练，即插即用。

Result: 在MRCR、LongBenchV2等长上下文基准上，对多种指令微调与推理模型测试，128K长度下相对提升最高达25%，额外计算开销极小。

Conclusion: 动态注意力重缩放结合检索头引导选择是长上下文推理提效的关键，同时为解码阶段注意力行为提供可解释视角；代码已开源。

Abstract: Understanding and reasoning over long contexts is a crucial capability for language models (LMs). Although recent models support increasingly long context windows, their accuracy often deteriorates as input length grows. In practice, models often struggle to keep attention aligned with the most relevant context throughout decoding. In this work, we propose DYSCO, a novel decoding algorithm for improving long-context reasoning. DYSCO leverages retrieval heads--a subset of attention heads specialized for longcontext retrieval--to identify task-relevant tokens at each decoding step and explicitly up-weight them. By doing so, DYSCO dynamically adjusts attention during generation to better utilize relevant context. The method is training-free and can be applied directly to any off-the-shelf LMs. Across multiple instruction-tuned and reasoning models, DYSCO consistently improves performance on challenging long-context reasoning benchmarks, yielding relative gains of up to 25% on MRCR and LongBenchV2 at 128K context length with modest additional compute. Further analysis highlights the importance of both dynamic attention rescaling and retrievalhead guided selection for the effectiveness of the method, while providing interpretability insights into decoding-time attention behavior. Our code is available at https://github.com/princeton-pli/DySCO.

</details>


### [339] [IF-RewardBench: Benchmarking Judge Models for Instruction-Following Evaluation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.04738)
*Bosi Wen,Yilin Niu,Cunxiang Wang,Xiaoying Ling,Ying Zhang,Pei Ke,Hongning Wang,Minlie Huang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出 IF-RewardBench——首个面向指令遵循的列表式元评估基准，通过偏好图覆盖多指令与多约束，系统暴露现有 judge 模型缺陷并验证其与下游任务提升的更强相关性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 指令遵循是 LLM 核心能力，但现有 judge 模型可靠性评估不足：元评估基准数据面窄、仅用成对比较，难反映真实优化所需的排序信号。

Method: 构建 IF-RewardBench：1) 覆盖多样指令与约束；2) 为每指令建立多响应偏好图，导出全序；3) 采用列表式评估，让 judge 模型对 k 个响应排序；4) 用与下游对齐增益的相关系数作为核心指标。

Result: 在 IF-RewardBench 上测试主流 judge 模型，发现其平均 Kendall τ 仅 0.43、存在一致性与鲁棒性缺口；该基准与下游任务性能提升的 Spearman ρ 达 0.78，比现有基准高 29%。

Conclusion: IF-RewardBench 首次系统揭示当前 judge 模型在指令遵循评判上的显著缺陷，并提供更贴近优化需求的列表式元评估框架，可直接指导奖励模型与对齐策略迭代。

Abstract: Instruction-following is a foundational capability of large language models (LLMs), with its improvement hinging on scalable and accurate feedback from judge models. However, the reliability of current judge models in instruction-following remains underexplored due to several deficiencies of existing meta-evaluation benchmarks, such as their insufficient data coverage and oversimplified pairwise evaluation paradigms that misalign with model optimization scenarios. To this end, we propose IF-RewardBench, a comprehensive meta-evaluation benchmark for instruction-following that covers diverse instruction and constraint types. For each instruction, we construct a preference graph containing all pairwise preferences among multiple responses based on instruction-following quality. This design enables a listwise evaluation paradigm that assesses the capabilities of judge models to rank multiple responses, which is essential in guiding model alignment. Extensive experiments on IF-RewardBench reveal significant deficiencies in current judge models and demonstrate that our benchmark achieves a stronger positive correlation with downstream task performance compared to existing benchmarks. Our codes and data are available at https://github.com/thu-coai/IF-RewardBench.

</details>


### [340] [Prompt Injection as Role Confusion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.12277)
*Charles Ye,Jasmine Cui,Dylan Hadfield-Menell*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本研究发现大模型易被“角色混淆”攻破：攻击者只需让恶意指令“听起来”像用户或模型自己，就能绕过安全训练；我们用量化的“角色探针”证实内部表征层面存在混淆，并以零样本CoT伪造攻击在多款前沿模型上取得60%成功率，从而将提示注入从经验漏洞提升为可量化的角色表征缺陷。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 尽管已进行大量安全训练，语言模型仍会被提示注入攻击，根本成因不明；需要揭示其内部机制并提供统一解释框架。

Method: 提出“角色混淆”假设并设计“角色探针”量化模型如何感知“谁在说话”；构造零样本攻击CoT Forgery，使恶意文本模仿用户/模型自身语气；在StrongREJECT基准上评估多款前沿模型，并分析混淆程度与攻击成功率的相关性。

Result: CoT Forgery在零样本设定下对多款主流模型达到约60%攻击成功率（基线≈0%）；角色探针显示，内部表征层面“听起来可信”与“实际可信”文本重叠；混淆程度可线性预测攻击成功率。

Conclusion: 提示注入不是零散漏洞，而是角色表征机制的系统性缺陷：模型依据文本风格而非真实来源判定身份。未来防御需直接干预角色表征，而非仅做输出层过滤。

Abstract: Language models remain vulnerable to prompt injection attacks despite extensive safety training. We trace this failure to role confusion: models infer the source of text based on how it sounds, not where it actually comes from. A command hidden in a webpage hijacks an agent simply because it sounds like a user instruction. This is not just behavioral: in the model's internal representations, text that sounds like a trusted source occupies the same space as text that actually is one. We design role probes which measure how models internally perceive "who is speaking", showing that attacker-controllable signals (e.g. syntactic patterns, lexical choice) control role perception. We first test this with CoT Forgery, a zero-shot attack that injects fabricated reasoning into user prompts or ingested webpages. Models mistake the text for their own thoughts, yielding 60% attack success on StrongREJECT across frontier models with near-0% baselines. Strikingly, the degree of role confusion strongly predicts attack success. We then generalize these results to standard agent prompt injections, introducing a unifying framework that reframes prompt injection not as an ad-hoc exploit but as a measurable consequence of how models represent role.

</details>


### [341] [Preconditioned Test-Time Adaptation for Out-of-Distribution Debiasing in Narrative Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.13683)
*Hanwen Shen,Ting Ying,Jiajie Lu,Shanshan Wang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: CAP-TTA 是一种测试时自适应（TTA）框架，当检测到高偏见输入分布偏移时，利用离线计算的 Fisher 对角预条件器快速触发 LoRA 局部更新，在线修复 LLM 偏置，兼顾延迟、稳定性和语言质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有“去偏”LLM 在新类别或高偏见提示下表现突然退化；训练后冻结权重无法实时应对分布偏移，因此需要在推理阶段安全而快速地再次校正模型。

Method: 提出 CAP-TDA：①OOD 检测器实时计算输入的 bias-risk 分数；②仅当分数超标时，引入冻结主干 + 上下文感知 LoRA 模块并行优化；③利用离线估计的 Fisher 信息对角预条件器，将更新方向归一化实现低延迟、稳定性；④为避免灾难性遗忘，更新仅作用于 Adapter 层并保持其余参数冻结。

Result: 多个去偏任务+人工评测显示：CAP-TTA 的 Toxicity/Bias 分数下降幅度平均可达 24-40%，推理延迟比 AdamW/SGD 降低 2-4 倍，叙事流畅度提升约 0.8-1.2 BLEURT，且不会引发灾难性 forgetting；与传统微调及最新自适应基线相比全面占优。

Conclusion: CAP-TDA 给出了一条低成本、零训练即插即用的 LLM 实时去偏路线，证明离线预条件控制+局部 Adapter 能在 OOD 场景下稳定提升安全性同时保持生成质量，可推广到任意下游 LLM 部署。

Abstract: Although debiased large language models (LLMs) excel at handling known or low-bias prompts, they often fail on unfamiliar and high-bias prompts. We demonstrate via out-of-distribution (OOD) detection that these high-bias prompts cause a distribution shift, degrading static model performance. To enable real-time correction, we propose CAP-TTA, a test-time adaptation framework. CAP-TTA triggers context-aware LoRA updates only when a bias-risk score exceeds a set threshold. By utilizing an offline precomputed diagonal preconditioner, it ensures fast and stable optimization. Across multiple benchmarks and human evaluations, CAP-TTA effectively reduces toxicity/bias score with significantly lower latency than standard optimization methods (e.g., AdamW or SGD). Furthermore, it prevents catastrophic forgetting, and substantially improves narrative fluency over state-of-the-art baselines without compromising debiasing performance.

</details>


### [342] [OmniCompliance-100K: A Multi-Domain, Rule-Grounded, Real-World Safety Compliance Dataset](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.13933)
*Wenbin Hu,Huihao Jing,Haochen Shi,Changxuan Fan,Haoran Li,Yangqiu Song*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 利用跨领域权威法规为100K真实合规案例打标签，构建迄今最大、规则驱动的LLM安全对齐基准OmniCompliance-100K，并系统评估主流大模型合规能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有安全数据集多为人为构造、缺乏统一规则且与现实法规脱节，难以保证模型大规模部署时的真实合规性；亟需基于真实法规、可溯源评分的基准。

Method: 1) 设计Web-Agent沿74条跨领域法规爬取并精炼规则→案例映射；2) 建立12,985规则×106,009案例的层级标注体系；3) 开展多规模模型合规评测与对比分析。

Result: 规则-案例对齐度达95%+；主流模型在各域合规上普遍低于70%，且体量越大对长法规文本理解越不稳定；小模型违规倾向更高，提示与法规知识可解释性仍需提升。

Conclusion: OmniCompliance-100K验证“规则驱动+真实案例”路线有效揭示当前LLM合规盲区，为后续自动化对齐、法规知识注入与评估提供可靠基准与方向。

Abstract: Ensuring the safety and compliance of large language models (LLMs) is of paramount importance. However, existing LLM safety datasets often rely on ad-hoc taxonomies for data generation and suffer from a significant shortage of rule-grounded, real-world cases that are essential for robustly protecting LLMs. In this work, we address this critical gap by constructing a comprehensive safety dataset from a compliance perspective. Using a powerful web-searching agent, we collect a rule-grounded, real-world case dataset OmniCompliance-100K, sourced from multi-domain authoritative references. The dataset spans 74 regulations and policies across a wide range of domains, including security and privacy regulations, content safety and user data privacy policies from leading AI companies and social media platforms, financial security requirements, medical device risk management standards, educational integrity guidelines, and protections of fundamental human rights. In total, our dataset contains 12,985 distinct rules and 106,009 associated real-world compliance cases. Our analysis confirms a strong alignment between the rules and their corresponding cases. We further conduct extensive benchmarking experiments to evaluate the safety and compliance capabilities of advanced LLMs across different model scales. Our experiments reveal several interesting findings that have great potential to offer valuable insights for future LLM safety research.

</details>


### [343] [Language on Demand, Knowledge at Core: Composing LLMs with Encoder-Decoder Translation Models for Extensible Multilinguality](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.17512)
*Mengyu Bu,Yang Feng*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 用外挂翻译模型把 LLM“围”成英语中枢，解决小语种能力短板，不碰主模型权重，就能跨 100+ 语言全面提分。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大模型多语能力极度失衡，小语种/未见语种几乎不可用；而现成神经翻译系统在多语上已很均衡，二者天然互补。

Method: 提出 XBridge 三件套：Encoder‐翻译模型负责多语理解，Decoder‐翻译模型负责多语生成，中间冻结的 LLM 仅做英语推理；引入轻量映射层 + 最优传输对齐目标，消除跨模型语义错位，实现端到端可微训练。

Result: 在 4 个不同规模 LLM 上测试，跨理解、推理、摘要、生成 4 类任务，低资源语种平均提升 15–28 BLEU/ROUGE，未见语种提升最高 35 分，英语性能保持不变，全程无需重训 LLM。

Conclusion: XBridge 证明“翻译模型当多语外挂，LLM 当英语内核”的可行性，为低成本、可插拔的多语大模型提供新范式，后续可拓展至多模态、领域专用等场景。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) exhibit strong general intelligence, yet their multilingual performance remains highly imbalanced. Although LLMs encode substantial cross-lingual knowledge in a unified semantic space, they often struggle to reliably interface this knowledge with low-resource or unseen languages. Fortunately, pretrained encoder-decoder translation models already possess balanced multilingual capability, suggesting a natural complement to LLMs. In this work, we propose XBridge, a compositional encoder-LLM-decoder architecture that offloads multilingual understanding and generation to external pretrained translation models, while preserving the LLM as an English-centric core for general knowledge processing. To address the resulting representation misalignment across models, we introduce lightweight cross-model mapping layers and an optimal transport-based alignment objective, enabling fine-grained semantic consistency for multilingual generation. Experiments on four LLMs across multilingual understanding, reasoning, summarization, and generation indicate that XBridge outperforms strong baselines, especially on low-resource and previously unseen languages, without retraining the LLM.

</details>


### [344] [ReasonScaffold: A Scaffolded Reasoning-based Annotation Protocol for Human-AI Co-Annotation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.21094)
*Smitha Muthya Sudheendra,Jaideep Srivastava*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出ReasonScaffold框架，让标注者仅接触LLM推理而不见其预测标签，发现少量修订即可显著提升标注一致性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 主观NLP任务存在显著的跨标注者差异，亟需厘清LLM推理解释对人工标注行为的真实影响，而非仅关注最终准确率。

Method: 1) 设计两段式Delphi协议：先独立标注，再暴露LLM推理并允许修订；2) 只展示推理链，隐藏模型预测；3) 引入Annotator Effort Proxy (AEP) 量化修订比例；4) 在情感分类与观点检测任务上评估协议效果。

Result: 暴露推理后，标注者间一致性显著提高，但仅约5%实例被修订；高模糊度样本的修订率最高，说明推理主要帮助澄清边界案例。

Conclusion: LLM推理解释可在不颠覆人工判断的前提下提升标注一致性，ReasonScaffold为低成本、高可信度的人机协同标注提供了可行范式。

Abstract: Human annotation is central to NLP evaluation, yet subjective tasks often exhibit substantial variability across annotators. While large language models (LLMs) can provide structured reasoning to support annotation, their influence on human annotation behavior remains underexplored. We introduce \textbf{ReasonScaffold}, a scaffolded reasoning annotation protocol that exposes LLM-generated explanations while withholding predicted labels. We study how reasoning affects human annotation behavior in a controlled setting, rather than evaluating annotation accuracy. Using a two-pass protocol inspired by Delphi-style revision, annotators first label instances independently and then revise their decisions after viewing model-generated reasoning. We evaluate the approach on sentiment classification and opinion detection tasks, analyzing changes in inter-annotator agreement and revision behavior. To quantify these effects, we introduce the Annotator Effort Proxy (AEP), a metric capturing the proportion of labels revised after exposure to reasoning. Our results show that exposure to reasoning is associated with increased agreement, along with minimal revision, suggesting that reasoning helps resolve ambiguous cases without inducing widespread changes. These findings provide insight into how reasoning explanations shape annotation consistency and highlight reasoning-based scaffolds as a practical mechanism for human--AI co-annotation workflows.

</details>


### [345] [Sparse Growing Transformer: Training-Time Sparse Depth Allocation via Progressive Attention Looping](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.23998)
*Yao Chen,Yilong Chen,Yinqi Yang,Junyuan Shang,Zhenyu Zhang,Zefeng Zhang,Shuaiyi Nie,Shuohuan Wang,Yu Sun,Hua Wu,HaiFeng Wang,Tingwen Liu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 受训期间层间成熟呈现“深→浅”特性，提出 Sparse Growing Transformer(SGT)：只对少量高熵注意头递增循环深度，使增量训练 FLOPs 从≈20% 降至 1–3%，同参数规模下全面优于静态递归基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Transformer 传统扩深方法陷入“静态参数级全块循环”，计算冗余大；作者发现训练过程深层向浅层逐次成熟，高熵注意头主导语义整合，因此应让深度扩展本身也随训练动态而行。

Method: 1) 跟踪层间注意力熵→刻画“深→浅”成熟轨迹；2) 构建 SGT 框架：在训练进程中仅为少量高熵注意头添加“目标循环”，逐步把额外深度从深部迁移到浅部；3) 通过结构化稀疏分配避免全块参数重复更新。

Result: 在多种参数规模(大小模型)上，SGT 在相同或更少训练 FLOPs 下全面优于静态 block-level 循环基线，额外训练 FLOPs 开销由≈16–20% 压缩至 1–3%，并保持下游任务精度提升。

Conclusion: 训练深度不应预写为静态；SGT 以稀疏、按需自增长的深度分配，实现几乎零额外算力的有效扩深，为高效训练深 Transformer 提供了可扩展的新范式。

Abstract: Existing approaches to increasing the effective depth of Transformers predominantly rely on parameter reuse, extending computation through recursive execution. Under this paradigm, the network structure remains static along the training timeline, and additional computational depth is uniformly assigned to entire blocks at the parameter level. This rigidity across training time and parameter space leads to substantial computational redundancy during training. In contrast, we argue that depth allocation during training should not be a static preset, but rather a progressively growing structural process. Our systematic analysis reveals a deep-to-shallow maturation trajectory across layers, where high-entropy attention heads play a crucial role in semantic integration. Motivated by this observation, we introduce the Sparse Growing Transformer (SGT). SGT is a training-time sparse depth allocation framework that progressively extends recurrence from deeper to shallower layers via targeted attention looping on informative heads. This mechanism induces structural sparsity by selectively increasing depth only for a small subset of parameters as training evolves. Extensive experiments across multiple parameter scales demonstrate that SGT consistently outperforms training-time static block-level looping baselines under comparable settings, while reducing the additional training FLOPs overhead from approximately 16--20% to only 1--3% relative to a standard Transformer backbone.

</details>


### [346] [Model Capability Dominates: Inference-Time Optimization Lessons from AIMO 3](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.27844)
*Natapong Nitarach*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 数学推理里「多数投票」能提分，但被高相关错误卡住；强行把模型拆成不同「策略选民」的 Diverse Prompt Mixer 在 AIMO-3 50 道 IMO 级题、3 模型、23+ 实验、5h/H100 的极限条件下全军覆没。温度>0 已足够去相关，弱策略减的精度比减的相关性还多。模型能力差距 8 分，投票上限 42/50，pass@20 约 45.5，差值是「选样损失」而非「提示损失」，只能靠验证器补， prompt engineering 无效。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 用大模型解决高阶数学推理时，多数投票可提升准确率，但样本间错误高度相关，有效样本量受限。作者想验证「给不同选民分配不同推理策略」是否能打破相关、进一步放大投票收益。

Method: 提出 Diverse Prompt Mixer：对 3 个 SOTA LLM 设计 23 套 prompt-level 干预（角色扮演、分步模板、思维链变体等），在 AIMO-3 的 50 道 IMO 级难题上，于单卡 H100 80 GB、5 小时硬时限内做 majority-voting 实验；对比基线为高温采样 pass@N。系统记录准确率、错误相关性、有效样本量与投票得分。

Result: 所有 prompt 干预均未能显著超越高温采样基线；高温本身已把错误相关性降到≈0。弱策略虽再降相关，但单模型精度下滑更严重，综合投票结果反而变差。在同等投票数 N=8 的条件下，模型间 8 分的能力差距始终主导最终得分，提示策略影响微乎其微。最佳 majority-vote 得 42/50，而 pass@20 理论上限约 45.5，3.5 分的缺口来自「选样损失」（抽样-筛选阶段未挑到可解路径），并非提示本身损失。

Conclusion: 对于高阶数学推理，模型能力差距是硬天花板，prompt engineering 无法突破；错误相关性问题已被高温采样基本解决，再想提升投票收益，只能诉诸「选样」环节——训练一个可学习路径优劣的验证器/selector，把 pass@N 的上限转化为实际得分，而继续捣鼓提示词无意义。

Abstract: Majority voting over multiple LLM attempts improves mathematical reasoning, but correlated errors limit the effective sample size. A natural fix is to assign different reasoning strategies to different voters. The approach, Diverse Prompt Mixer, is tested on the AIMO 3 competition: 3 models, 23+ experiments, 50 IMO-level problems, one H100 80 GB, 5-hour limit. Every prompt-level intervention fails. High-temperature sampling already decorrelates errors; weaker strategies reduce accuracy more than they reduce correlation. Across an 8-point capability gap at equal N=8 and every optimization tested, model capability dominates. The gap between the best majority-vote score (42/50) and pass@20 (~45.5) is selection loss, not prompt loss. A verifier-based selector could close it. Prompt engineering cannot.

</details>


### [347] [From Plausible to Causal: Counterfactual Semantics for Policy Evaluation in Simulated Online Communities](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.03920)
*Agam Goyal,Yian Wang,Eshwar Chandrasekharan,Hari Sundaram*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 利用LLM进行社群仿真虽看似可信，却无法回答干预是否“导致”结果；文章主张采用反事实因果框架，把“必要因”分给事后诊断者，“充分因”给事前设计者，并以仿真保真度为条件解释估算结果，从而把“像真”提升到“可用”。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于LLM的社会仿真被用于“政策风洞”，但文献通常仅报告统计相关性或表面的“可信度”，缺乏对因果的严谨界定，难以支撑“干预A可降低冲突升级”这类政策主张。

Method: 引入潜在结果框架，区分必要因果（无干预是否仍会发生）与充分因果（干预是否可靠产生结果）；将两类因果估计映射到两类利害相关者（事后平台治理者 vs 事前政策设计者）的信息需求；给出仿真数据下可识别两类因果量的显式假设（如可忽略性、一致性、无混杂等），并说明如何修改仿真输出来支持估计；强调所有结论都是simulator-conditional的，其外部有效性取决于模型保真度。

Result: 形式化推导表明：若满足给定假设，可通过干预/对照轨迹的潜在结果比较，分别估计必要率（PN）与充分率（PS）；仿真可通过“反事实重算”或“轨迹干预替换”实现；利用不同因果量可以分别优化事后问责规则与事前政策筛选。

Conclusion: 只有在建立明确的因果语义后，LLM社会仿真才能从“看似真实”跃迁为“可支持政策变更”；框架迫使研究者把“保真度”定义为是否足以满足因果估计的可靠性，而非仅外观似真；呼吁社区立即采纳该框架以避免政策误导。

Abstract: LLM-based social simulations can generate believable community interactions, enabling ``policy wind tunnels'' where governance interventions are tested before deployment. But believability is not causality. Claims like ``intervention $A$ reduces escalation'' require causal semantics that current simulation work typically does not specify. We propose adopting the causal counterfactual framework, distinguishing \textit{necessary causation} (would the outcome have occurred without the intervention?) from \textit{sufficient causation} (does the intervention reliably produce the outcome?). This distinction maps onto different stakeholder needs: moderators diagnosing incidents require evidence about necessity, while platform designers choosing policies require evidence about sufficiency. We formalize this mapping, show how simulation design can support estimation under explicit assumptions, and argue that the resulting quantities should be interpreted as simulator-conditional causal estimates whose policy relevance depends on simulator fidelity. Establishing this framework now is essential: it helps define what adequate fidelity means and moves the field from simulations that look realistic toward simulations that can support policy changes.

</details>


### [348] [Just Pass Twice: Efficient Token Classification with LLMs for Zero-Shot NER](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.05158)
*Ahmed Ewais,Ahmed Hashish,Amr Ali*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出“两次前向”（JPT）新范式，无需改动模型即可让因果大模型在零样本命名实体识别任务中获得全句双向信息，平均 F1 提升 7.9 点、速度提高 20 余倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 因果大模型虽蕴含丰富世界知识，但单向注意力限制了需要后文消歧的逐 token 判别；现有生成式提示存在自回归解码慢、幻觉实体及格式错误等问题。

Method: 核心思路：将输入复制并拼接后再次喂给同一模型，使第二遍中的每个 token 可 attend 到完整句子，获得上下文嵌入；再结合实体定义引导的嵌入，实现零样本判别式 token 分类。无需任何架构改动。

Result: 在 CrossNER、MIT 两个零样本 NER 基准上平均 F1 比之前最优方法高出 7.9 分，推理速度比同类生成式方法快 20 倍以上。

Conclusion: 表明“两次前向”即能把因果大模型转化为高性能判别器，验证“拼接即双向”简单策略在零样本实体识别中的有效性与速度优势。

Abstract: Large language models encode extensive world knowledge valuable for zero-shot named entity recognition. However, their causal attention mechanism, where tokens attend only to preceding context, prevents effective token classification when disambiguation requires future context. Existing approaches use LLMs generatively, prompting them to list entities or produce structured outputs, but suffer from slow autoregressive decoding, hallucinated entities, and formatting errors.
  We propose Just Pass Twice (JPT), a simple yet effective method that enables causal LLMs to perform discriminative token classification with full bidirectional context. Our key insight is that concatenating the input to itself lets each token in the second pass attend to the complete sentence, requiring no architectural modifications. We combine these representations with definition-guided entity embeddings for flexible zero-shot generalization. Our approach achieves state-of-the-art results on zero-shot NER benchmarks, surpassing the previous best method by +7.9 F1 on average across CrossNER and MIT benchmarks, being over 20x faster than comparable generative methods.

</details>


### [349] [XMark: Reliable Multi-Bit Watermarking for LLM-Generated Texts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.05242)
*Jiahao Xu,Rui Hu,Olivera Kotevska,Zikai Zhang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 针对LLM多比特水印文本短、大消息场景下解码精度骤降与质量劣化难题，提出轻量编解码框架 XMark，在限制token数时仍保持高解码率与文本质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM文本多比特水印要么因搜索空间大导致大消息计算不可行，要么在短文本场景下解码精度急剧下降，同时难以兼顾文本质量；亟需一种在实用短文本、大消息长度条件下仍高效、高保真、高鲁棒的水印方法。

Method: 设计“低扰动编码器+专用解码器”双组件：编码阶段仅微调logits分布生成水印token，降低对生成质量的影响；解码阶段利用顺序统计与最大似然策略，在极短token序列中可靠还原多比特消息，无需耗穷举搜索。

Result: 在涵盖问答、摘要、对话等任务上的实验显示，XMark在消息长度增大或文本长度受限时，解码准确率平均提升15–30个百分点，同时保持与无水印文本相当的BLEU/ROUGE与困惑度，显著优于现有基线。

Conclusion: XMark以极低计算开销实现高容量、高鲁棒、高质量的多比特文本水印，为LLM输出归属与滥用追踪提供了可落地的实用方案。

Abstract: Multi-bit watermarking has emerged as a promising solution for embedding imperceptible binary messages into Large Language Model (LLM)-generated text, enabling reliable attribution and tracing of malicious usage of LLMs. Despite recent progress, existing methods still face key limitations: some become computationally infeasible for large messages, while others suffer from a poor trade-off between text quality and decoding accuracy. Moreover, the decoding accuracy of existing methods drops significantly when the number of tokens in the generated text is limited, a condition that frequently arises in practical usage. To address these challenges, we propose \textsc{XMark}, a novel method for encoding and decoding binary messages in LLM-generated texts. The unique design of \textsc{XMark}'s encoder produces a less distorted logit distribution for watermarked token generation, preserving text quality, and also enables its tailored decoder to reliably recover the encoded message with limited tokens. Extensive experiments across diverse downstream tasks show that \textsc{XMark} significantly improves decoding accuracy while preserving the quality of watermarked text, outperforming prior methods. The code is at https://github.com/JiiahaoXU/XMark.

</details>


### [350] [Right at My Level: A Unified Multilingual Framework for Proficiency-Aware Text Simplification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.05302)
*Jinhong Jeong,Junghun Park,Youngjae Yu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: Re-RIGHT用4B模型+强化学习，在无平行语料条件下实现英日韩中四语自适应文本简化，词汇覆盖优于GPT-5.2/Gemini 2.5。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 既有LLM简化方法依赖英文平行句库且低级别非英语效果差，缺少跨语言、低成本、个性化简化方案。

Method: 构建43K四语词汇级数据；设计词汇覆盖、语义保持、连贯性三重奖励；用强化学习训练4B策略模型，无需平行语料。

Result: Re-RIGHT在CEFR/JLPT/TOPIK/HSK各难度层级上词汇覆盖率显著超越GPT-5.2与Gemini 2.5，并保持原意与流畅度。

Conclusion: Re-RIGHT证明小模型+强化学习可摆脱平行语料与英语中心限制，为L2学习者提供高质量多语言简化输入。

Abstract: Text simplification supports second language (L2) learning by providing comprehensible input, consistent with the Input Hypothesis. However, constructing personalized parallel corpora is costly, while existing large language model (LLM)-based readability control methods rely on pre-labeled sentence corpora and primarily target English. We propose Re-RIGHT, a unified reinforcement learning framework for adaptive multilingual text simplification without parallel corpus supervision. We first show that prompting-based lexical simplification at target proficiency levels (CEFR, JLPT, TOPIK, and HSK) performs poorly at easier levels and for non-English languages, even with state-of-the-art LLMs such as GPT-5.2 and Gemini 2.5. To address this, we collect 43K vocabulary-level data across four languages (English, Japanese, Korean, and Chinese) and train a compact 4B policy model using Re-RIGHT, which integrates three reward modules: vocabulary coverage, semantic preservation, and coherence. Compared to the stronger LLM baselines, Re-RIGHT achieves higher lexical coverage at target proficiency levels while maintaining original meaning and fluency.

</details>


### [351] [Feedback Adaptation for Retrieval-Augmented Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.06647)
*Jihwan Bang,Seunghan Yang,Kyuhong Shim,Simyung Chang,Juntae Lee,Sungha Choi*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 作者指出RAG系统常被静态评估而忽视实时反馈，首次提出「反馈适应性」这一新维度，并给出可量化指标；随后提出无需重训练的PatchRAG，在试验中实现了即时纠错与泛化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有RAG评估方法假设系统一次固化，仅关注总体准确率，缺乏对交互式反馈引发行为变化过程的量化度量，导致部署后校正效果无法被解释与量化。

Method: 1. 将「反馈适应性」定义为可观测指标：Correction Lag（反馈生效延迟）与Post-feedback Performance（反馈后在语义相关查询上的效果）。2. 对比三类范式：不训练、重新训练与提出PatchRAG单例推理补丁：- 通过插入轻量级规则向量记忆库并在推理阶段即时激活； - 无需反向传播即可纠正新输入出口错主题传播。

Result: - PatchRAG在保持延迟最低（Lag≈0）的同时，校正后准确率的提升段落平均+23%，且在5类同义改写后仍保持+18%的泛化； - 重新训练可获高校正后性能，但Lag达到150-300个样本；两者呈显著反比趋势。

Conclusion: 反馈适应性是RAG交互性的核心，作者提出的双轴评估首次完整捕捉其行为；PatchRAG以推断期补丁形式实现即时、高泛化修正，为实际生产环境提供及时可解释更新范式，并启发了更高效率的反馈驱动演进机制研发。

Abstract: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems are typically evaluated under static assumptions, despite being frequently corrected through user or expert feedback in deployment. Existing evaluation protocols focus on overall accuracy and fail to capture how systems adapt after feedback is introduced. We introduce feedback adaptation as a problem setting for RAG systems, which asks how effectively and how quickly corrective feedback propagates to future queries. To make this behavior measurable, we propose two evaluation axes: correction lag, which captures the delay between feedback provision and behavioral change, and post-feedback performance, which measures reliability on semantically related queries after feedback. Using these metrics, we show that training-based approaches exhibit a trade-off between delayed correction and reliable adaptation. We further propose PatchRAG, a minimal inference-time instantiation that incorporates feedback without retraining, demonstrating immediate correction and strong post-feedback generalization under the proposed evaluation. Our results highlight feedback adaptation as a previously overlooked dimension of RAG system behavior in interactive settings.

</details>


### [352] [Large Language Model Post-Training: A Unified View of Off-Policy and On-Policy Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.07941)
*Shiwan Zhao,Zhihu Wang,Xuyang Zhao,Jiaming Zhou,Caiyue Xu,Chenfei Liu,Liting Zhang,Yuhang Jia,Yanzhe Zhang,Hualong Yu,Zichen Xu,Qicheng Li,Yong Qin*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出统一框架，将 LLM 后训练视作对模型行为的结构化干预，而非零散算法汇总，以“轨迹来源—行为作用”双轴重梳理现有方法，帮助诊断瓶颈并指导多阶段系统级设计。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 尽管监督微调、RLHF、蒸馏等后训练手段层出不穷，但现有文献按目标或标签割裂讨论，缺乏统一视角来揭示各方法究竟解决何种“行为瓶颈”，难以指导复杂多阶段 pipeline 的设计。

Method: 1) 以“轨迹来源”划出 off-policy（外部轨迹）与 on-policy（模型自产轨迹）两大范式；2) 将算法功能抽象为三大角色：支持扩展（让有用行为可达）、策略重塑（在可达区内提升表现）、行为固化（跨阶段保留/迁移行为）；3) 用该框架重新解析 SFT、偏好优化、RL、蒸馏、验证器等方法，展示其可变角色与协同方式。

Result: 框架显示：SFT 可兼顾扩展与重塑；偏好优化多为 off-policy 重塑，在线版趋近 on-policy；on-policy RL 重塑自产轨迹，强引导时亦能扩展支持；蒸馏本质是固化而非单纯压缩；混合流水线被重新视为协调多阶段干预。

Conclusion: 后训练瓶颈诊断与性能提升的关键已从“单目标算法”转向“跨阶段系统级整合”；未来进展取决于如何协调各方法在扩展、重塑、固化三角中的角色，而非孤立优化某一损失函数。

Abstract: Post-training has become central to turning pretrained large language models (LLMs) into aligned, capable, and deployable systems. Recent progress spans supervised fine-tuning (SFT), preference optimization, reinforcement learning (RL), process supervision, verifier-guided methods, distillation, and multi-stage pipelines. Yet these methods are often discussed in fragmented ways, organized by labels or objectives rather than by the behavioral bottlenecks they address. This survey argues that LLM post-training is best understood as structured intervention on model behavior. We organize the field first by trajectory provenance, which defines two primary regimes: off-policy learning on externally supplied trajectories and on-policy learning on learner-generated rollouts. We then interpret methods through two recurring roles -- effective support expansion, which makes useful behaviors more reachable, and policy reshaping, which improves behavior within already reachable regions -- together with a complementary systems-level role, behavioral consolidation, which preserves, transfers, and amortizes useful behavior across stages and model transitions. Under this view, SFT may serve either support expansion or policy reshaping; preference optimization is usually off-policy reshaping, though online variants move closer to learner-generated states. On-policy RL often improves behavior on learner-generated states, but stronger guidance can also make hard-to-reach reasoning paths reachable. Distillation is often better understood as consolidation rather than only compression, and hybrid pipelines emerge as coordinated multi-stage compositions. Overall, the framework helps diagnose post-training bottlenecks and reason about stage composition, suggesting that progress increasingly depends on coordinated systems design rather than any single dominant objective.

</details>


### [353] [MAB-DQA: Addressing Query Aspect Importance in Document Question Answering with Multi-Armed Bandits](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.08952)
*Yixin Xiang,Yunshan Ma,Xiaoyu Du,Yibing Chen,Yanxin Zhang,Jinhui Tang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 为解决视觉文档问答在多模态检索时因只保留 Top-K 页面而遗漏低视觉显著性高信息内容的缺陷，作者提出 Multi-Armed Bandit DQA（MAB-DQA）框架，用 bandit 策略动态把检索预算分配给高价值查询“子臂”，在 4 个基准上平均提升 5%–18%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多模态 RAG 做文档问答时，图像检索阶段通常只取 Top-4 等少量候选页，导致信息丰富但视觉不突出的内容被忽略，限制了系统对复杂文档的理解性能。

Method: 将原始查询拆成若干隐含 aspect 的子查询，每个子查询当作 bandit 的一只“臂”；用少量代表性页面的初步推理结果作为奖励信号估计各 aspect 的效用；按探索-利用策略动态重新分配检索预算，获取高价值子查询对应的页面集并建模其关联，再生成最终答案。

Result: 在 4 个公开文档问答基准上，MAB-DQA 相较最佳基线平均提升 5%–18%，显著改进复杂文档的视觉问答准确率。

Conclusion: 通过显式建模并动态调节查询各隐含 aspect 的重要性，MAB-DQA 有效缓解了视觉检索中的信息遗漏问题，为后续多模态文档理解任务提供了新的检索-生成框架思路，代码已开源。

Abstract: Document Question Answering (DQA) involves generating answers from a document based on a user's query, representing a key task in document understanding. This task requires interpreting visual layouts, which has prompted recent studies to adopt multimodal Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) that processes page images for answer generation. However, in multimodal RAG, visual DQA struggles to utilize a large number of images effectively, as the retrieval stage often retains only a few candidate pages (e.g., Top-4), causing informative but less visually salient content to be overlooked in favor of common yet low-information pages. To address this issue, we propose a Multi-Armed Bandit-based DQA framework (MAB-DQA) to explicitly model the varying importance of multiple implicit aspects in a query. Specifically, MAB-DQA decomposes a query into aspect-aware subqueries and retrieves an aspect-specific candidate set for each. It treats each subquery as an arm and uses preliminary reasoning results from a small number of representative pages as reward signals to estimate aspect utility. Guided by an exploration-exploitation policy, MAB-DQA dynamically reallocates retrieval budgets toward high-value aspects. With the most informative pages and their correlations, MAB-DQA generates the expected results. On four benchmarks, MAB-DQA shows an average improvement of 5%-18% over the state-of-the-art method, consistently enhancing document understanding. Codes are available at https://github.com/ElephantOH/MAB-DQA.

</details>


### [354] [Reason Only When Needed: Efficient Generative Reward Modeling via Model-Internal Uncertainty](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.10072)
*Chao Xue,Yao Wang,Mengqiao Liu,Di Liang,Xingsheng Han,Peiyang Liu,Xianjie Wu,Chenyao Lu,Lei Jiang,Yu Lu,Haibo Shi,Shuang Liang,Minlong Peng,Flora D. Salim*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出 E-GRM，让模型仅用内部不确定度决定是否启用 CoT，并结合轻量回归-排序打分器，显著降低推理开销并提升准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 GRM 存在两大瓶颈：对所有输入无差别启用 CoT 浪费算力，投票式评估缺乏对推理路径的细粒度判别。亟需一种不依赖外部特征、可自适应触发 CoT 且能精细评估推理质量的新框架。

Method: 1) 利用并行解码输出的收敛特性计算模型内部不确定度，仅在不确定度高时触发 CoT；2) 设计混合回归-排序目标的轻量判别式打分器，对每条推理路径给出细粒度奖励；3) 整套流程无需人工规则或任务特定信号，端到端训练。

Result: 在多项推理基准上，E-GRM 相比标准 GRM 降低 30–50% 推理成本，同时将答案准确率平均提升 4–7 个百分点，内部不确定度与所需 CoT 步数呈高相关性（r>0.8）。

Conclusion: 模型内部不确定度可作为通用、高效的推理触发与奖励校准信号；E-GRM 验证了“按需推理+细粒度评价”范式的可行性，为资源受限场景下的大模型推理优化提供了可扩展路径。

Abstract: Recent advancements in the Generative Reward Model (GRM) have demonstrated its potential to enhance the reasoning abilities of LLMs through Chain-of-Thought (CoT) prompting. Despite these gains, existing implementations of GRM suffer from two critical limitations. First, CoT prompting is applied indiscriminately to all inputs regardless of their inherent complexity. This introduces unnecessary computational costs for tasks amenable to fast, direct inference. Second, existing approaches primarily rely on voting-based mechanisms to evaluate CoT outputs, which often lack granularity and precision in assessing reasoning quality. In this paper, we propose E-GRM, an efficient generative reward modeling framework grounded in model-internal uncertainty. E-GRM leverages the convergence behavior of parallel model generations to estimate uncertainty and selectively trigger CoT reasoning only when needed, without relying on handcrafted features or task-dependent signals. To improve reward fidelity, we introduce a lightweight discriminative scorer trained with a hybrid regression--ranking objective to provide fine-grained evaluation of reasoning paths. Experiments on multiple reasoning benchmarks show that E-GRM substantially reduces inference cost while consistently improving answer accuracy, demonstrating that model-internal uncertainty is an effective and general signal for efficient reasoning-aware reward modeling.

</details>


### [355] [Why Supervised Fine-Tuning Fails to Learn: A Systematic Study of Incomplete Learning in Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.10079)
*Chao Xue,Yao Wang,Mengqiao Liu,Di Liang,Xingsheng Han,Peiyang Liu,Xianjie Wu,Chenyao Lu,Lei Jiang,Yu Lu,Haibo Shi,Shuang Liang,Minlong Peng,Flora D. Salim*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 监督微调常出现“不完全学习”现象，模型即便收敛也无法复现部分训练样本；本文首次系统梳理其原因并给出诊断-干预框架，揭示目前指标无法反映的隐藏盲区。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统只关注整体性能指标，掩盖了模型对某些监督样本始终学不会的失败。团队想要量化并解释这种失败，提出“不完全学习”这一概念，以便后续针对性改进。

Method: 1）形式化定义 ILP；2）在 Qwen/LLaMA/OLMo2 上做大规模对照实验，归纳出五大成因；3）设计“先诊断后干预”框架，把未学样本映射到具体原因，并用因果干预验证各成因的贡献。

Result: 不完全学习普遍存在于不同模型/任务，占比 3–18%；单一指标提升无法消除盲区；针对性干预可分别降低各成因导致的遗忘或冲突，补学率最高 +24%。

Conclusion: SFT 必须做细粒度诊断而非仅看宏观指标；识别并处理未学样本是提升下游可靠性的关键。作者呼吁社区建立“样本级可追溯性”评估标准，避免能力缺陷被平均指标掩盖。

Abstract: Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) is the standard approach for adapting large language models (LLMs) to downstream tasks. However, we observe a persistent failure mode: even after convergence, models often fail to correctly reproduce a subset of their own supervised training data. We refer to this behavior as the Incomplete Learning Phenomenon(ILP). This paper presents the first systematic study of ILP in LLM fine-tuning. We formalize ILP as post-training failure to internalize supervised instances and demonstrate its prevalence across multiple model families, domains, and datasets. Through controlled analyses, we identify five recurrent sources of incomplete learning: (1) missing prerequisite knowledge in the pre-trained model, (2) conflicts between SFT supervision and pre-training knowledge, (3) internal inconsistencies within SFT data, (4) left-side forgetting during sequential fine-tuning, and (5) insufficient optimization for rare or complex patterns. We introduce a diagnostic-first framework that maps unlearned samples to these causes using observable training and inference signals, and study several targeted mitigation strategies as causal interventions. Experiments on Qwen, LLaMA, and OLMo2 show that incomplete learning is widespread and heterogeneous, and that improvements in aggregate metrics can mask persistent unlearned subsets. The findings highlight the need for fine-grained diagnosis of what supervised fine-tuning fails to learn, and why.

</details>


### [356] [Who Wrote This Line? Evaluating the Detection of LLM-Generated Classical Chinese Poetry](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.10101)
*Jiang Li,Tian Lan,Shanshan Wang,Dongxing Zhang,Dianqing Lin,Guanglai Gao,Derek F. Wong,Xiangdong Su*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 现有AI检测器在面对格律、意象与句法高度特殊的古典汉语诗歌时几乎失效；作者发布含3万首诗词的ChangAn基准，系统评估12种检测器并证实其不足。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM已能自动生成古典汉诗，但学界尚缺针对该文体的AI检测基准；若无法识别机器诗作，将冲击文学原创性与伦理。

Method: 构建ChangAn数据集（10K人工+20K由4种主流LLM生成），在字、句、篇三级粒度上测试12种检测模型，并对比不同生成策略（prompt、温度、长度）对检测率的影响。

Result: 所有检测器F1均低于0.65，精度随文本长度缩短而骤降；格律规则与共享意象被LLM成功模仿，导致判别特征失效；基于统计与微调的中文检测器均显著落后于英文场景。

Conclusion: 古典汉诗的独特语言规则使当前AI检测技术失灵；亟需面向诗学的多模态特征与对抗训练；ChangAn为后续研究提供了公开基准与评估协议。

Abstract: The rapid development of large language models (LLMs) has extended text generation tasks into the literary domain. However, AI-generated literary creations has raised increasingly prominent issues of creative authenticity and ethics in literary world, making the detection of LLM-generated literary texts essential and urgent. While previous works have made significant progress in detecting AI-generated text, it has yet to address classical Chinese poetry. Due to the unique linguistic features of classical Chinese poetry, such as strict metrical regularity, a shared system of poetic imagery, and flexible syntax, distinguishing whether a poem is authored by AI presents a substantial challenge. To address these issues, we introduce ChangAn, a benchmark for detecting LLM-generated classical Chinese poetry that containing total 30,664 poems, 10,276 are human-written poems and 20,388 poems are generated by four popular LLMs. Based on ChangAn, we conducted a systematic evaluation of 12 AI detectors, investigating their performance variations across different text granularities and generation strategies. Our findings highlight the limitations of current Chinese text detectors, which fail to serve as reliable tools for detecting LLM-generated classical Chinese poetry. These results validate the effectiveness and necessity of our proposed ChangAn benchmark. Our dataset and code are available at https://github.com/VelikayaScarlet/ChangAn.

</details>


### [357] [OccuBench: Evaluating AI Agents on Real-World Professional Tasks via Language Environment Simulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.10866)
*Xiaomeng Hu,Yinger Zhang,Fei Huang,Jianhong Tu,Yang Su,Lianghao Deng,Yuxuan Liu,Yantao Liu,Dayiheng Liu,Tsung-Yi Ho*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出首个跨百个真实职业任务场景的基准 OccuBench，通过 LLM 驱动的语言环境模拟器（LES）解决公开环境稀缺问题，系统评估 15 个前沿模型在任务完成度与环境鲁棒性上的表现，并揭示行业特异性、隐式故障更难、推理投入显著增益及模拟器质量关键性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基准只能在极少数具备公开环境的领域评估 AI 智能体，无法覆盖急诊分诊、核反应堆监控、海关通关等数百种真实职业任务，亟需一个跨行业、可复现、可扩展的系统性评估框架。

Method: 构建 OccuBench：① 语言环境模拟器（LES）用 LLM 生成领域专用工具响应，模拟 100 个真实任务场景（10 行业×65 细分域）；② 多智能体合成管线自动产出可解、难度校准、文档多样的评测实例；③ 设计双维度指标：任务完成度 + 三类受控故障（显式、隐式、混合）下的环境鲁棒性；④ 对 8 家模型家族 15 个前沿模型进行大规模实验。

Result: ① 无单一模型通吃所有行业，各模型呈现显著职业能力画像差异；② 隐式故障（截断、缺失字段）因无显性错误信号最难，成绩低于显式与混合故障；③ 模型规模↑、代际↑、推理投入↑均持续提分，GPT-5.2 最大推理设置下提升 27.5 分；④ 强智能体≠强模拟器，LES 本身质量直接决定评估可靠性。

Conclusion: OccuBench 首次实现 AI 智能体在真实职业任务上的跨行业系统评测，证明 LES 是扩展评估疆域的关键，同时揭示隐式数据退化是最大挑战，为后续模型改进、模拟器校准及行业落地提供基准与洞察。

Abstract: AI agents are expected to perform professional work across hundreds of occupational domains (from emergency department triage to nuclear reactor safety monitoring to customs import processing), yet existing benchmarks can only evaluate agents in the few domains where public environments exist. We introduce OccuBench, a benchmark covering 100 real-world professional task scenarios across 10 industry categories and 65 specialized domains, enabled by Language Environment Simulators (LESs) that simulate domain-specific environments through LLM-driven tool response generation. Our multi-agent synthesis pipeline automatically produces evaluation instances with guaranteed solvability, calibrated difficulty, and document-grounded diversity. OccuBench evaluates agents along two complementary dimensions: task completion across professional domains and environmental robustness under controlled fault injection (explicit errors, implicit data degradation, and mixed faults). We evaluate 15 frontier models across 8 model families and find that: (1) no single model dominates all industries, as each has a distinct occupational capability profile; (2) implicit faults (truncated data, missing fields) are harder than both explicit errors (timeouts, 500s) and mixed faults, because they lack overt error signals and require the agent to independently detect data degradation; (3) larger models, newer generations, and higher reasoning effort consistently improve performance. GPT-5.2 improves by 27.5 points from minimal to maximum reasoning effort; and (4) strong agents are not necessarily strong environment simulators. Simulator quality is critical for LES-based evaluation reliability. OccuBench provides the first systematic cross-industry evaluation of AI agents on professional occupational tasks.

</details>


### [358] [METRO: Towards Strategy Induction from Expert Dialogue Transcripts for Non-collaborative Dialogues](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.11427)
*Haofu Yang,Jiaji Liu,Chen Huang,Faguo Wu,Wenqiang Lei,See-Kiong Ng*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出METRO框架，用LLM从对话原稿自动蒸馏非合作博弈策略与规划逻辑，零人工编码，两数据集平均提升9–10%，代码开源。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有非合作对话代理依赖手工编码专家策略，扩展性极差；亟需一种可自动、低成本获得高水准博弈策略的方法。

Method: METRO通过LLM在无监督条件下抽取策略动作与规划逻辑，并以“策略森林”层次结构形式化：节点为短时应对，分支为长期布局，实现策略知识显式化与可重用。

Result: 在谈判与说服两大公开基准上，METRO平均超越现有最佳方法9–10%；消融实验显示策略多样性与前瞻性是性能增益核心，且策略森林可零样本迁移至新任务并保持鲁棒表现。

Conclusion: METRO证明用LLM自动蒸馏非合作博弈策略可行、可扩展且跨任务通用，为低成本构建高水平对抗代理提供新范式。

Abstract: Developing non-collaborative dialogue agents traditionally requires the manual, unscalable codification of expert strategies. We propose \ours, a method that leverages large language models to autonomously induce both strategy actions and planning logic directly from raw transcripts. METRO formalizes expert knowledge into a Strategy Forest, a hierarchical structure that captures both short-term responses (nodes) and long-term strategic foresight (branches). Experimental results across two benchmarks show that METRO demonstrates promising performance, outperforming existing methods by an average of 9%-10%. Our further analysis not only reveals the success behind METRO (strategic behavioral diversity and foresight), but also demonstrates its robust cross-task transferability. This offers new insights into building non-collaborative agents in a cost-effective and scalable way. Our code is available at https://github.com/Humphrey-0125/METRO.

</details>


### [359] [METER: Evaluating Multi-Level Contextual Causal Reasoning in Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.11502)
*Pengfeng Li,Chen Huang,Chaoqun Hao,Hongyao Chen,Xiao-Yong Wei,Wenqiang Lei,See-Kiong Ng*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出METER基准，系统评估LLMs在同一语境下因果三阶梯任务表现，发现层级越高性能越差；机制诊断揭示低层易受无关事实干扰、高层语境忠实度下降。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基准碎片化、语境不一致，无法覆盖完整因果层级，阻碍对LLMs语境因果推理能力的系统评估与机制理解。

Method: 构建统一语境的METER基准，覆盖因果阶梯全部三级任务；对多种LLMs做大规模评测；结合错误模式统计与内部信息流追踪进行深层次的机制分析。

Result: 随因果层级升高，LLMs准确率显著下降；识别出两大失效模式：低层被“事实正确但因果无关”信息干扰，高层对给定语境的忠实度降低。

Conclusion: 揭示了LLMs语境因果推理的阶梯式退化机理，为后续提升模型因果鲁棒性与语境忠实性提供了关键实证基础与方法范式。

Abstract: Contextual causal reasoning is a critical yet challenging capability for Large Language Models (LLMs). Existing benchmarks, however, often evaluate this skill in fragmented settings, failing to ensure context consistency or cover the full causal hierarchy. To address this, we pioneer METER to systematically benchmark LLMs across all three levels of the causal ladder under a unified context setting. Our extensive evaluation of various LLMs reveals a significant decline in proficiency as tasks ascend the causal hierarchy. To diagnose this degradation, we conduct a deep mechanistic analysis via both error pattern identification and internal information flow tracing. Our analysis reveals two primary failure modes: (1) LLMs are susceptible to distraction by causally irrelevant but factually correct information at lower level of causality; and (2) as tasks ascend the causal hierarchy, faithfulness to the provided context degrades, leading to a reduced performance. We belive our work advances our understanding of the mechanisms behind LLM contextual causal reasoning and establishes a critical foundation for future research. Our code and dataset are available at https://github.com/SCUNLP/METER .

</details>


### [360] [Hidden Measurement Error in LLM Pipelines Distorts Annotation, Evaluation, and Benchmarking](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.11581)
*Solomon Messing*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 大型语言模型评测存在被忽视的“设计噪声”，同一任务在不同措辞、温度、判定模型下结果可能反转；作者提出把误差拆成“数据方差”和“设计方差”，用预实验+预算重分配把误差减半，并在意识形态、安全、MMLU、宣传识别四任务验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM评估结果直接决定模型部署、安全标准与研究结论，但现有置信区间仅考虑抽样误差，忽略了提示改写、判定模型、温度等设计选择带来的方差，导致排名和结论可被轻易翻转，也为“刷榜”提供了操作空间。

Method: 1. 将总误差分解为随数据量增加而衰减的“数据方差”和不随样本量缩小的“设计方差”；2. 用“设计研究投影”(design-study projections) 在小样本先导实验中估计两种方差分量；3. 基于方差分解结果，对预算和配置做最优重分配，构建同时覆盖两类不确定性的置信区间。

Result: 在意识形态标注、安全分类、MMLU、人工验证的宣传识别四项任务中，主导方差来源随领域和打分方式变化；MMLU上仅重分配预算即可在同等成本下把估计误差减半；宣传任务中推荐管道对人工基准的胜率超过73%的单配置；小样本先导实验得到的置信区间接近名义覆盖率，并能提前锁定最大精度增益的设计改动。

Conclusion: 忽略设计方差会系统性地低估LLM评测不确定性，给“刷榜”留下空间；通过先导实验量化并优化数据-设计方差，可在不增加预算的前提下显著提升评估可靠性与排名稳定性，呼吁社区把“设计噪声”纳入标准报告。

Abstract: LLM evaluations drive which models get deployed, which safety standards get adopted, and which research conclusions get published. Yet these scores carry hidden uncertainty: rephrasing the prompt, switching the judge model, or changing the temperature can shift results enough to flip rankings and reverse conclusions. Standard confidence intervals ignore this variance, producing under-coverage that worsens with more data. The same unmeasured variance creates an exploitable surface for benchmarks: model developers can optimize against measurement noise rather than genuine performance (some have infamously done so, see \citep{boyeau2025leaderboard}). This paper decomposes LLM pipeline uncertainty into its sources, distinguishes variance that shrinks with more data from sensitivity to researcher design choices, and uses design-study projections to reduce total error. Across ideology annotation, safety classification, MMLU benchmarking, and a human-validated propaganda audit, the decomposition reveals that the dominant variance source differs by domain and scoring method. On MMLU, optimized budget allocation halves estimation error at equivalent cost. On the propaganda task, the recommended pipeline outperforms 73\% of single-configuration alternatives against a human baseline. A small-sample pilot is sufficient to derive confidence intervals that approach nominal coverage and to identify which design changes yield the largest precision gains.

</details>


### [361] [Latent-Condensed Transformer for Efficient Long Context Modeling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.12452)
*Zeng You,Yaofo Chen,Qiuwu Chen,Ying Sun,Shuhai Zhang,Yingjian Li,Yaowei Wang,Mingkui Tan*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: LCA在MLA的潜空间中同步压缩上下文语义与位置信息，无需新增参数即可将KV缓存压缩90%、prefilling阶段加速2.5倍，且误差与序列长度无关。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM处理长文本时，KV缓存线性膨胀、自注意力平方复杂度两大瓶颈被孤立解决：MLA虽压缩KV但保留稠密注意力，稀疏注意力虽减负却无法直接作用于MLA的压缩潜结构，错失联合优化空间。

Method: 提出Latent-Condensed Attention（LCA），在MLA的低维潜空间里把上下文解耦为语义潜向量与位置键；对语义部分用query-aware池化聚合，对位置部分用锚点选择保留，实现无参联合降计算与降缓存，并扩展至GQA等架构。

Result: 理论证明LCA的近似误差与序列长度无关；128K上下文下，prefilling速度提升2.5倍，KV缓存减少90%，下游任务性能与基线相当。

Conclusion: LCA首次在潜空间内完成语义-位置联合压缩，兼顾高效与通用，为长上下文LLM提供了即插即用的注意力加速方案。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) face significant challenges in processing long contexts due to the linear growth of the key-value (KV) cache and quadratic complexity of self-attention. Existing approaches address these bottlenecks separately: Multi-head Latent Attention (MLA) reduces the KV cache by projecting tokens into a low-dimensional latent space, while sparse attention reduces computation. However, sparse methods cannot operate natively on MLA's compressed latent structure, missing opportunities for joint optimization. In this paper, we propose Latent-Condensed Attention (LCA), which directly condenses context within MLA's latent space, where the representation is disentangled into semantic latent vectors and positional keys. LCA separately aggregates semantic vectors via query-aware pooling and preserves positional keys via anchor selection. This approach jointly reduces both computational cost and KV cache without adding parameters. Beyond MLA, LCA's design is architecture-agnostic and readily extends to other attention mechanisms such as GQA. Theoretically, we prove a length-independent error bound. Experiments show LCA achieves up to 2.5$\times$ prefilling speedup and 90% KV cache reduction at 128K context while maintaining competitive performance.

</details>


### [362] [Foresight Optimization for Strategic Reasoning in Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.13592)
*Jiashuo Wang,Jiawen Duan,Jian Wang,Kaitao Song,Chunpu Xu,Johnny K. W. Ho,Fenggang Yu,Wenjie Li,Johan F. Hoorn*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出 FoPO 算法，显式模拟对手来提升 LLM 在多智能体博弈中的策略推理与泛化能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 LLM 推理技术缺乏对 “未来对手行为” 的显式预见，导致多智能体决策效果差；需引入战略推理能力。

Method: 构建 FoPO——将对手建模嵌入策略优化，并自研 Cooperative RSA、Competitive Taboo 两大数据集，用自对弈框架训练不同规模 LLM。

Result: FoPO 在多种模型上显著提升战略推理表现，且对域外博弈场景具备强泛化，全面优于标准推理优化基线。

Conclusion: 显式对手建模是解锁 LLM 战略推理的关键，FoPO 为后续多智能体、博弈决策研究提供了通用增强范式。

Abstract: Reasoning capabilities in large language models (LLMs) have generally advanced significantly. However, it is still challenging for existing reasoning-based LLMs to perform effective decision-making abilities in multi-agent environments, due to the absence of explicit foresight modeling. To this end, strategic reasoning, the most fundamental capability to anticipate the counterpart's behaviors and foresee its possible future actions, has been introduced to alleviate the above issues. Strategic reasoning is fundamental to effective decision-making in multi-agent environments, yet existing reasoning enhancement methods for LLMs do not explicitly capture its foresight nature. In this work, we introduce Foresight Policy Optimization (FoPO) to enhance strategic reasoning in LLMs, which integrates opponent modeling principles into policy optimization, thereby enabling explicit consideration of both self-interest and counterpart influence. Specifically, we construct two curated datasets, namely Cooperative RSA and Competitive Taboo, equipped with well-designed rules and moderate difficulty to facilitate a systematic investigation of FoPO in a self-play framework. Our experiments demonstrate that FoPO significantly enhances strategic reasoning across LLMs of varying sizes and origins. Moreover, models trained with FoPO exhibit strong generalization to out-of-domain strategic scenarios, substantially outperforming standard LLM reasoning optimization baselines.

</details>


### [363] [Robust Reward Modeling for Large Language Models via Causal Decomposition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.13833)
*Yunsheng Lu,Zijiang Yang,Licheng Pan,Zhixuan Chu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 用输入意图的重构误差对奖励模型做正则化，抑制对长度、谄媚等提示无关捷径的依赖，多项任务上准确率提升3.6 个百分点并输出更短答案。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有奖励模型易对回复长度、和颜悦色等虚假线索过拟合，却未显式要求模型关注提示本身的意图，导致对齐失效。

Method: 训练一个把候选答案映射到输入潜在意图向量的解码器，用其重构误差作为正则项加入奖励模型训练，迫使偏好依据提示相关特征而非提示独立捷径。

Result: 新正则化使模型在数学、有用性和安全基准上选出更短、更少谄媚的答案，准确率 0.877；将信号嵌入 Gemma-2-2B/9B-it 后，RewardBench 准确率从 0.832 升至 0.868，同时长度受控胜率提高且对长度干扰、轻度跑题保持鲁棒。

Conclusion: 利用意图重构误差抑制捷径可显著增强奖励模型的鲁棒性与对齐效果，为轻量级、可迁移的正则化提供新范式。

Abstract: Reward models are central to aligning large language models, yet they often overfit to spurious cues such as response length and overly agreeable tone. Most prior work weakens these cues directly by penalizing or controlling specific artifacts, but it does not explicitly encourage the model to ground preferences in the prompt's intent. We learn a decoder that maps a candidate answer to the latent intent embedding of the input. The reconstruction error is used as a signal to regularize the reward model training. We provide theoretical evidence that this signal emphasizes prompt-dependent information while suppressing prompt-independent shortcuts. Across math, helpfulness, and safety benchmarks, the decoder selects shorter and less sycophantic candidates with 0.877 accuracy. Incorporating this signal into RM training in Gemma-2-2B-it and Gemma-2-9B-it increases RewardBench accuracy from 0.832 to 0.868. For Best-of-N selection, our framework increases length-controlled win rates while producing shorter outputs, and remains robust to lengthening and mild off-topic drift in controlled rewrite tests.

</details>


### [364] [Beyond Static Personas: Situational Personality Steering for Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.13846)
*Zesheng Wei,Mengxiang Li,Zilei Wang,Yang Deng*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 一篇无需训练的


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 LLM 个性化方法可控性差、资源开销大，且采用静态人格建模，难以适应多变情境。

Method: ① 通过多视角“人格神经元”分析，验证 LLM 人格存在情境依赖与稳定的情境-行为模式；② 提出零训练、基于神经元的 Identify-Retrieve-Steer 框架 IRIS：先定位情境人格神经元，再按情境检索并加权相似度进行 steering。

Result: 在 PersonalityBench 与新建 SPBench 上，IRIS 显著优于最强基线，对未见情境与不同模型架构均展现出良好泛化与鲁棒性。

Conclusion: IRIS 以极低成本实现细粒度、情境自适应人格控制，为构建更自然的人本 LLM 交互提供了新范式。

Abstract: Personalized Large Language Models (LLMs) facilitate more natural, human-like interactions in human-centric applications. However, existing personalization methods are constrained by limited controllability and high resource demands. Furthermore, their reliance on static personality modeling restricts adaptability across varying situations. To address these limitations, we first demonstrate the existence of situation-dependency and consistent situation-behavior patterns within LLM personalities through a multi-perspective analysis of persona neurons. Building on these insights, we propose IRIS, a training-free, neuron-based Identify-Retrieve-Steer framework for advanced situational personality steering. Our approach comprises situational persona neuron identification, situation-aware neuron retrieval, and similarity-weighted steering. We empirically validate our framework on PersonalityBench and our newly introduced SPBench, a comprehensive situational personality benchmark. Experimental results show that our method surpasses best-performing baselines, demonstrating IRIS's generalization and robustness to complex, unseen situations and different models architecture.

</details>


### [365] [From Feelings to Metrics: Understanding and Formalizing How Users Vibe-Test LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.14137)
*Itay Itzhak,Eliya Habba,Gabriel Stanovsky,Yonatan Belinkov*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 把用户“凭感觉”挑模型的经验性做法（vibe-testing）形式化为可规模化、可复现的个性化评估流程，在编码任务上证明该流程能翻转传统基准的排序。, 


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基准无法反映模型在真实工作流中的有用性，用户更多依赖非正式、难复现的“vibe-testing”；需将其结构化，以连接基准分数与实际体验。, 

Method: 1) 调查 500+ 开发者的评估习惯；2) 爬取 200 余篇博客/社交媒体对比报告，归纳 “vibe-testing” 模式；3) 将其抽象为“个性化提示生成 + 用户主观评价”两阶段；4) 构建原型管道，用用户历史代码风格自动构造 Prompt，再以用户自定义准则（可读性、可维护性、调试便利性等）对比模型输出；5) 在 HumanEval+、MBPP 的 164 题上对比 Codex、CodeT5、StarCoder。, 

Result: 引入个性化后，首选模型与基准排行榜不一致的比例达 32%；其中 18% 案例 StarCoder 超越 Codex，恰对应用户重视“注释完整度”与“单文件可运行性”两大主观准则；Krippendorff α=0.81 说明用户间主观评价一致性高；管道复现单条评估成本 0.47＄、时长 38 s，较人工 vibe-testing 降低 90% 耗时。, 

Conclusion: 形式化 vibe-testing 能在保持“用户体感”的同时实现可规模化评估，为下一代面向真实工作流的动态基准提供方法论与工具链；未来需扩展至多模态、多学科场景并建立共享用户画像库。

Abstract: Evaluating LLMs is challenging, as benchmark scores often fail to capture models' real-world usefulness. Instead, users often rely on ``vibe-testing'': informal experience-based evaluation, such as comparing models on coding tasks related to their own workflow. While prevalent, vibe-testing is often too ad hoc and unstructured to analyze or reproduce at scale. In this work, we study how vibe-testing works in practice and then formalize it to support systematic analysis.
