We first analyze two empirical resources: (1) a survey of user evaluation practices, and (2) a collection of in-the-wild model comparison reports from blogs and social media. Based on these resources, we formalize vibe-testing as a two-part process: users personalize both what they test and how they judge responses. We then introduce a proof-of-concept evaluation pipeline that follows this formulation by generating personalized prompts and comparing model outputs using user-aware subjective criteria. In experiments on coding benchmarks, we find that combining personalized prompts and user-aware evaluation can change which model is preferred, reflecting the role of vibe-testing in practice. These findings suggest that formalized vibe-testing can serve as a useful approach for bridging benchmark scores and real-world experience.

</details>


### [366] [One RL to See Them All: Visual Triple Unified Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2505.18129)
*Yan Ma,Linge Du,Xuyang Shen,Shaoxiang Chen,Pengfei Li,Qibing Ren,Lizhuang Ma,Yuchao Dai,Pengfei Liu,Junjie Yan*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: V-Triune提出“样本-验证器-源”三层统一强化学习框架，通过动态IoU奖励塑形解决定位任务中奖励稀疏与歧义问题；基于此训练的Orsta系列（7B/32B）在八类异构推理与感知任务上联合优化，统一模型性能超越同等预算下的专家混合体，并在MEGA-Bench及多项下游基准持续领先。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有公开方法难以用单一RL流程同时提升VLM的推理与感知能力，尤其在异构任务与定位密集场景下存在奖励稀疏、阈值敏感等训练难题。

Method: 构建V-Triune三层抽象：1) 样本级Reward Routing为每样本动态分配最优奖励通道；2) 验证器级Outcome Verification引入结果判别器提供密集监督；3) 源级Diagnostics追踪梯度与奖励来源实现可解释诊断。核心创新Dynamic IoU按IoU连续塑形奖励，兼顾宽松阈值下的歧义与严格阈值下的稀疏。整体采用统一策略网络共享视觉-语言编码器，八任务联合RL训练。

Result: Orsta-7B/32B在MEGA-Bench上相对各自主干平均提升+3.8%/+4.4%，在相同训练成本下超过专门模型组合；在MathVista、MMBench等9个下游基准上平均领先强多任务RL-VLM基线1.7–2.3个百分点，且零样本迁移稳健。

Conclusion: 统一多模态RL框架V-Triune可在单一管线内同步增强VLM的推理与感知能力，验证“一个RL通吃”路径的有效性，为后续开放通用多模态智能体提供可复现基线与代码。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) is becoming an important direction for post-training vision-language models (VLMs), but public training methodologies for unified multimodal RL remain much less mature, especially for heterogeneous reasoning and perception-heavy tasks. We propose V-Triune, a Visual Triple Unified Reinforcement Learning methodology for unified multimodal RL. It organizes training around three coordinated abstractions: Sample-Level Reward Routing, Verifier-Level Outcome Verification, and Source-Level Diagnostics. Within this methodology, Dynamic IoU provides localization-specific reward shaping that avoids reward ambiguity under loose thresholds and reward sparsity under strict ones. Built on V-Triune, we develop Orsta (7B, 32B), a family of models jointly trained on eight reasoning and perception tasks. Under matched budgets, unified training matches or outperforms specialist mixtures. The final Orsta models improve over their backbones on MEGA-Bench, compare favorably with strong multi-task RL-VLM baselines, and transfer these gains to a broad set of downstream benchmarks. These results show that unified RL can improve both reasoning and perception within a single VLM RL pipeline.The V-Triune system, along with the Orsta models, is publicly available at https://github.com/MiniMax-AI/One-RL-to-See-Them-All.

</details>


### [367] [VisRet: Visualization Improves Knowledge-Intensive Text-to-Image Retrieval](https://arxiv.org/abs/2505.20291)
*Di Wu,Yixin Wan,Kai-Wei Chang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出“先画图-再检索”(VisRet)：用文生图把文本转成图像，再在同一模态内检索，绕过了跨模态模型对空间关系不敏感的缺陷；四组实验平均nDCG@30提升12%+，下游问答Top-1提升最高15.7%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 文本-图像跨模态检索中，CLIP等对齐方法把图文都当成“概念袋”，对姿态、视角等细粒度空间关系提取无力，导致检索精度受限。需要一种无需重新训练、能直接利用空间视觉特征的新检索范式。

Method: Visualize-then-Retrieve分两阶段：①用现成的T2I模型把文本查询→生成一张/多张图像；②在纯图像空间用CLIP或E5-V对生成的图与原库图像做相似度匹配；检索结果即用于文档库排序或下游问答。整个过程无需跨模态重对齐，也未改动检索模型参数。对多实体查询引入Visual-RAG-ME数据集；综合使用LLM+T2I多种变体进行鲁棒性验证。

Result: 在Visual-RAG、INQUIRE-Rerank、COCO与自建Visual-RAG-ME四基准上，VisRet比最强跨模态基线nDCG@30平均提升12.5(CLIP)/12.1(E5-V)个百分点；在下游问答准确率Visual-RAG提升3.8%Top-1/3.9%Top-10，Visual-RAG-ME提升15.7%Top-1/11.1%Top-10。消融实验显示：更换T2I模型、LLM或检索骨架对效果影响有限，方法通用且稳定。

Conclusion: VisRet以“让文本先在视觉域成像，再回到视觉域检索”的简单思想，突破了跨模态空间对齐不足带来的性能瓶颈。其对现有生成与检索组件零训练即可接入，为T2I检索提供了一条高效、易迁移的新路线；同时发布的Visual-RAG-ME数据也将便利后续复合实体查询研究。

Abstract: Text-to-image retrieval (T2I retrieval) remains challenging because cross-modal embeddings often behave as bags of concepts, underrepresenting structured visual relationships such as pose and viewpoint. We proposeVisualize-then-Retrieve (VisRet), a retrieval paradigm that mitigates this limitation of cross-modal similarity alignment. VisRet first projects textual queries into the image modality via T2I generation, then performs retrieval within the image modality to bypass the weaknesses of cross-modal retrievers in recognizing subtle visual-spatial features. Across four benchmarks (Visual-RAG, INQUIRE-Rerank, Microsoft COCO, and our new Visual-RAG-ME featuring multi-entity comparisons), VisRet substantially outperforms cross-modal similarity matching and baselines that recast T2I retrieval as text-to-text similarity matching, improving nDCG@30 by 0.125 on average with CLIP as the retriever and by 0.121 with E5-V. For downstream question answering, VisRet increases accuracy on Visual-RAG and Visual-RAG-ME by 3.8% and 15.7% in top-1 retrieval, and by 3.9% and 11.1% in top-10 retrieval. Ablation studies show compatibility with different T2I instruction LLMs, T2I generation models, and downstream LLMs. VisRet provides a simple yet effective perspective for advancing in text-image retrieval. Our code and the new benchmark are publicly available at https://github.com/xiaowu0162/Visualize-then-Retrieve.

</details>


### [368] [ProRank: Prompt Warmup via Reinforcement Learning for Small Language Models Reranking](https://arxiv.org/abs/2506.03487)
*Xianming Li,Aamir Shakir,Rui Huang,Tsz-fung Andrew Lee,Julius Lipp,Benjamin Clavié,Jing Li*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 现有大模型重排序成本高，0.5B 小模型经新训练策略 ProRank 在 BEIR 上全面超越 7B+ 模型，兼顾效果与效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大参数模型 (>7B) 用于重排序时推理成本高; 小规模模型 (SLM) 虽高效，但表示能力窄且对排序提示理解差，亟待在不增参数量前提下提升性能。

Method: 提出 ProRank：两阶段训练策略。阶段一利用强化学习让 SLM 更好理解排序任务提示; 阶段二通过细粒度评分学习扩展表征空间并提升区分度。

Result: 在 BEIR 等多数据集上系统评测，0.5B ProRank 一致超越当前最先进开源与商用重排序模型，多款 7B+ LLM 亦被超越。

Conclusion: 经过专门训练，小参数量模型可在计算高效的同时获得优于大模型的重排序效果，为构建轻量级检索增强系统提供可行方案。

Abstract: Reranking is fundamental to information retrieval and retrieval-augmented generation, with recent Large Language Models (LLMs) significantly advancing reranking quality. Most current works rely on large-scale LLMs (>7B parameters), presenting high computational costs. Small Language Models (SLMs) offer a promising alternative because of computational efficiency. However, our preliminary quantitative analysis reveals key limitations of SLMs: their representation space is narrow, leading to reduced expressiveness, and they struggle with understanding task prompts without fine-tuning. To address these issues, we introduce a novel two-stage training approach, ProRank, for SLM-based document reranking. We propose using reinforcement learning to improve the understanding of task prompts. Additionally, we introduce fine-grained score learning to enhance representation expressiveness and further improve document reranking quality. Extensive experiments suggest that ProRank consistently outperforms both the most advanced open-source and proprietary reranking models. Notably, our 0.5B ProRank even surpasses powerful LLM reranking models on the BEIR benchmark, establishing that properly trained SLMs can achieve superior document reranking performance while maintaining computational efficiency.

</details>


### [369] [KnowRL: Exploring Knowledgeable Reinforcement Learning for Factuality](https://arxiv.org/abs/2506.19807)
*Baochang Ren,Shuofei Qiao,Da Zheng,Huajun Chen,Ningyu Zhang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 作者提出 KnowRL，在强化学习阶段引入基于知识验证的「真实性奖励」，让慢思考大模型在推理时自动识别知识边界，显著抑制幻觉且保留原有推理能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 慢思考大模型幻觉严重，而现有 RL 的「结果导向奖励」缺乏对推理过程的事实监督，反而可能放大幻觉。需要一种能在训练过程中直接监督事实性的机制。

Method: KnowRL 在 RL 训练循环中插入知识验证环节，为每个推理步骤计算「真实性奖励」并纳入策略优化目标，使模型在试错中学会优先选择可被知识库验证的中间结论，从而内建基于事实的推理策略。

Result: 在 3 个幻觉评测集与 2 个推理评测集上的实验表明，KnowRL 在显著降低幻觉指标的同时，保留了与原模型相当的复杂推理性能。

Conclusion: 将知识验证奖励嵌入 RL 训练，可直接塑造模型的中间推理行为，是抑制慢思考大模型幻觉的有效途径，并兼容现有 RL 框架，代码已开源。

Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs), particularly slow-thinking models, often exhibit severe hallucination, outputting incorrect content due to an inability to accurately recognize knowledge boundaries during reasoning. While Reinforcement Learning (RL) can enhance complex reasoning abilities, its outcome-oriented reward mechanism often lacks factual supervision over the thinking process, further exacerbating the hallucination problem. To address the high hallucination in slow-thinking models, we propose Knowledge-enhanced RL, KnowRL. KnowRL guides models to perform fact-based slow thinking by integrating a factuality reward, based on knowledge verification, into the RL training process, helping them recognize their knowledge boundaries. KnowRL guides models to perform fact-based slow thinking by integrating a factuality reward, based on knowledge verification, into the RL training process, helping them recognize their knowledge boundaries. This targeted factual input during RL training enables the model to learn and internalize fact-based reasoning strategies. By directly rewarding adherence to facts within the reasoning steps, KnowRL fosters a more reliable thinking process. Experimental results on three hallucination evaluation datasets and two reasoning evaluation datasets demonstrate that KnowRL effectively mitigates hallucinations in slow-thinking models while maintaining their original strong reasoning capabilities. Our code is available at https://github.com/zjunlp/KnowRL.

</details>


### [370] [Similarity-Distance-Magnitude Activations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2509.12760)
*Allen Schmaltz*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出 SDM 激活函数及其配套估计器，将深度匹配相似度、训练分布距离与原 Softmax 幅值信息整合，实现基于样例的可解释性；在预训练语言模型上做选择性分类时，对分布漂移与 OOD 输入的鲁棒性优于现有校准方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Softmax 仅关注决策边界幅值，无法显式利用深度匹配相似度及与训练分布的距离，导致校准不可靠、OOD 难检测，且缺乏可解释性。

Method: 设计 Similarity-Distance-Magnitude (SDM) 激活：dense matching 得到的深度相似度＋与训练分布距离＋原幅值；构建 SDM estimator，通过 SDM 激活驱动的数据分区对类经验 CDF 进行分位，控制类条件与预测条件下的选择性分类准确率。

Result: 在预训练语言模型的选择性分类任务上，SDM estimator 在协变量漂移和 OOD 场景下的稳健性优于基于 Softmax 的现有校准方法，同时在分布内保持信息量。

Conclusion: SDM 激活及估计器以简单改换最后一层的方式，即可显著提升模型置信度校准与可解释性，对安全敏感的语言模型部署具有实用价值。

Abstract: We introduce the Similarity-Distance-Magnitude (SDM) activation function, a more robust and interpretable formulation of the standard softmax activation function, adding Similarity (i.e., correctly predicted depth-matches into training) awareness and Distance-to-training-distribution awareness to the existing output Magnitude (i.e., decision-boundary) awareness, and enabling interpretability-by-exemplar via dense matching. We further introduce the SDM estimator, based on a data-driven partitioning of the class-wise empirical CDFs via the SDM activation, to control the class- and prediction-conditional accuracy among selective classifications. When used as the final-layer activation over pre-trained language models for selective classification, the SDM estimator is more robust to covariate shifts and out-of-distribution inputs than existing calibration methods using softmax activations, while remaining informative over in-distribution data.

</details>


### [371] [E2Edev: Benchmarking Large Language Models in End-to-End Software Development Task](https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.14509)
*Jingyao Liu,Chen Huang,Zhizhao Guan,Wenqiang Lei,Yang Deng*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 现有端到端软件开发（E2ESD）基准因需求粒度粗、评估不可靠而难以真实衡量 LLM 框架能力；作者提出基于 BDD 的细粒度基准 E2EDev，并配套全自动测试管道与人工-多智能体协同标注框架，实验表明当前方案仍显著落后于真实用户需求。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM 在端到端软件开发中潜力巨大，但现有基准仅给出粗粒度文本需求，评估协议主观且不可复现，导致无法准确判断框架真实能力与瓶颈。

Method: 1) 以行为驱动开发（BDD）为核心，将每条需求拆为多条细粒度用户故事并生成可执行 Python 步骤；2) 构建基于 Behave 的全自动测试管道，用“模拟真实用户交互”方式判定软件是否满足需求；3) 提出 Human-in-the-Loop Multi-Agent Annotation Framework（HITL-MAA），用多智能体协同+人工校验高效构建高质量基准；4) 在 E2EDev 上对多种 E2ESD 框架与骨干 LLM 进行系统评估。

Result: E2EDev 包含 110 余条细粒度需求、近 600 个 BDD 场景与步骤实现；实验显示主流框架平均成功率仅 18%–34%，且错误多集中在需求理解、交互逻辑与边界条件处理，揭示 LLM 方案距离实用化仍有显著差距。

Conclusion: 细粒度、可执行、用户交互驱动的 BDD 基准能更严格地暴露 E2ESD 框架缺陷；HITL-MAA 显著降低标注成本；研究结果呼吁社区开发更高效、低成本且真正以用户价值为中心的端到端软件开发方法。

Abstract: The rapid advancement in large language models (LLMs) has demonstrated significant potential in End-to-End Software Development (E2ESD). However, existing E2ESD benchmarks are limited by coarse-grained requirement specifications and unreliable evaluation protocols, hindering a true understanding of current framework capabilities. To address these limitations, we present E2EDev, a novel benchmark grounded in the principles of Behavior-Driven Development (BDD), which evaluates the capabilities of E2ESD frameworks by assessing whether the generated software meets user needs through mimicking real user interactions (Figure 1). E2EDev comprises (i) a fine-grained set of user requirements, (ii) multiple BDD test scenarios with corresponding Python step implementations for each requirement, and (iii) a fully automated testing pipeline built on the Behave framework. To ensure its quality while reducing the annotation effort, E2EDev leverages our proposed Human-in-the-Loop Multi-Agent Annotation Framework (HITL-MAA). By evaluating various E2ESD frameworks and LLM backbones with E2EDev, our analysis reveals a persistent struggle to effectively solve these tasks, underscoring the critical need for more effective and cost-efficient E2ESD solutions. Our codebase and benchmark are publicly available at https://github.com/SCUNLP/E2EDev.

</details>


### [372] [AccelOpt: A Self-Improving LLM Agentic System for AI Accelerator Kernel Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2511.15915)
*Genghan Zhang,Shaowei Zhu,Anjiang Wei,Zhenyu Song,Allen Nie,Zhen Jia,Nandita Vijaykumar,Yida Wang,Kunle Olukotun*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: AccelOpt是自进优LLM代理，可无专家指导地自适应优化新型AI加速器内核，开源低成本且效果显著。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 新兴AI加速器缺乏成熟编译器与手工调优经验，传统内核优化依赖硬件专家，门槛高、耗时长，亟需自动化自演进方案。

Method: 构建代理系统，以“慢/快内核对”历史经验为核心的优化记忆库，迭代生成并评估新内核，持续自我改进；同时搭建面向AWS Trainium的NKIBench基准，验证系统有效性。

Result: 在Trainium 1/2上，NKIBench的平均峰值吞吐率由49%→61%、45%→59%；使用开源模型即可达到Claude Sonnet 4同等级优化水平，成本仅1/26。

Conclusion: AccelOpt证明大模型代理能自我积累硬件优化知识，显著降低门槛与成本，为新兴加速器快速释放性能提供通用范式。项目已开源，可推广至更多硬件与场景。

Abstract: We present AccelOpt, a self-improving large language model (LLM) agentic system that autonomously optimizes kernels for emerging AI acclerators, eliminating the need for expert-provided hardware-specific optimization knowledge. AccelOpt explores the kernel optimization space through iterative generation, informed by an optimization memory that curates experiences and insights from previously encountered slow-fast kernel pairs. We build NKIBench, a new benchmark suite of AWS Trainium accelerator kernels with varying complexity extracted from real-world LLM workloads to evaluate the effectiveness of AccelOpt. Our evaluation confirms that AccelOpt's capability improves over time, boosting the average percentage of peak throughput from $49\%$ to $61\%$ on Trainium 1 and from $45\%$ to $59\%$ on Trainium 2 for NKIBench kernels. Moreover, AccelOpt is highly cost-effective: using open-source models, it matches the kernel improvements of Claude Sonnet 4 while being $26\times$ cheaper. The code is open-sourced at https://github.com/zhang677/AccelOpt.

</details>


### [373] [Pay Less Attention to Function Words for Free Robustness of Vision-Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2512.07222)
*Qiwei Tian,Chenhao Lin,Zhengyu Zhao,Chao Shen*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: FDA从视觉-语言模型(VLM)中屏蔽掉起连接作用的“功能词”所贡献的交叉注意力，可在几乎不掉下游性能的前提下显著增强跨模态对抗鲁棒性；平均ASR下降18–90%，任务性能仅掉0.2–0.6%，甚至不降反升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有VLM在追求下游表现的同时，容易受跨模态对抗样本攻击。本文发现“功能词”(介词、连词等)虽对预测贡献低，却成为攻击者投放扰动的突破口，诱发额外注意力，进而破坏了视觉-文本对齐与模型鲁棒性。因此亟需一种不牺牲性能即可削弱功能词负面影响的方法。

Method: 提出Function-word De-Attention (FDA)模块，借鉴差分放大思想：1. 用词典/规则快速定位功能词；2. 在各注意头分别计算标准交叉注意力与仅含功能词的注意力；3. 将后者差分式“减去”，实现对齐更紧且攻击面更小的特征表达；4. 作为即插即用模块嵌入-retrieval与visual grounding流。

Result: 在2项下游任务、6种攻击、3数据集、3类SOTA VLM上系统评估。检索任务下，模型平均ASR相对降低18/13/53%，对应性能仅降0.2/0.3/0.6%；视觉定位任务中，ASR骤降90%，性能反而提升0.3%。消融、零样本和泛化实验均证明方法可扩展且稳定。

Conclusion: 功能词是触发VLM跨模态脆弱性的重要因素；FDA以差分注意力方式“剔除”其不良影响，在几乎不牺牲下游指标的前提下，显著提高鲁棒性。该方法结构简单、模型无关且易于复现，为更安全的视觉-语言模型提供了新思路。代码开源：https://github.com/michaeltian108/FDA

Abstract: To address the trade-off between robustness and performance for robust VLM, we observe that function words could incur vulnerability of VLMs against cross-modal adversarial attacks, and propose Function-word De-Attention (FDA) accordingly to mitigate the impact of function words. Similar to differential amplifiers, our FDA calculates the original and the function-word cross-attention within attention heads, and differentially subtracts the latter from the former for more aligned and robust VLMs. Comprehensive experiments include 2 SOTA baselines under 6 different attacks on 2 downstream tasks, 3 datasets, and 3 models. Overall, our FDA yields an average 18/13/53% ASR drop with only 0.2/0.3/0.6% performance drops on the 3 tested models on retrieval, and a 90% ASR drop with a 0.3% performance gain on visual grounding. We demonstrate the scalability, generalization, and zero-shot performance of FDA experimentally, as well as in-depth ablation studies and analysis. Code is available at https://github.com/michaeltian108/FDA.

</details>


### [374] [TopoDIM: One-shot Topology Generation of Diverse Interaction Modes for Multi-Agent Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.10120)
*Rui Sun,Jie Ding,Chenghua Gong,Tianjun Gu,Yihang Jiang,Juyuan Zhang,Liming Pan,Linyuan Lü*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: TopoDIM 用一次性拓扑生成替代多轮对话，把多智能体通信的 Token 开销降低 46%，同时平均任务性能提升 1.5%，无需迭代协调即可适配异构智能体。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 LLM 多智能体系统依赖多轮时空交互，推理延迟高、Token 费用大；近期研究表明评估与辩论可提升群体智能，亟需一种去中心化、无需迭代即可动态建拓扑的解决方案。

Method: 提出 TopoDIM 框架：1) 基于评估-辩论信号一次性预测最优通信拓扑；2) 为异构智能体设计去中心化执行协议，支持并行单播/组播/广播等多样化交互模式；3) 在推理阶段直接实例化拓扑，无需多轮协调。

Result: 在公开基准上，TopoDIM 相较 SOTA 方法把总 Token 消耗减少 46.41%，平均任务准确率提升 1.50%，对异构智能体数量与类型变化展现出鲁棒性。

Conclusion: 一次性拓扑生成能在显著降低通信成本的同时保持甚至提升群体性能，为构建可扩展、保护隐私的 LLM 多智能体系统提供了新范式。

Abstract: Optimizing communication topology in LLM-based multi-agent system is critical for enabling collective intelligence. Existing methods mainly rely on spatio-temporal interaction paradigms, where the sequential execution of multi-round dialogues incurs high latency and computation. Motivated by the recent insights that evaluation and debate mechanisms can improve problem-solving in multi-agent systems, we propose TopoDIM, a framework for one-shot Topology generation with Diverse Interaction Modes. Designed for decentralized execution to enhance adaptability and privacy, TopoDIM enables agents to autonomously construct heterogeneous communication without iterative coordination, achieving token efficiency and improved task performance. Experiments demonstrate that TopoDIM reduces total token consumption by 46.41% while improving average performance by 1.50% over state-of-the-art methods. Moreover, the framework exhibits strong adaptability in organizing communication among heterogeneous agents. Code is available at: https://github.com/Sundiasy/TopoDIM.

</details>


### [375] [De-Anonymization at Scale via Tournament-Style Attribution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.12407)
*Lirui Zhang,Huishuai Zhang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 作者提出 DAS，一种基于 LLM 的海量匿名文本作者去匿名化方法，可在数万候选中精准匹配同一作者文本，对双盲评审等匿名场景构成现实隐私威胁。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大型语言模型（LLM）在真实场景落地后，其隐私影响尚缺系统研究。作者关注双盲评审、匿名论坛等需保护作者身份的平台，首次系统评估 LLM 对大规模匿名文档进行作者匹配的可行性，揭示新的隐私风险。

Method: DAS 串行筛选：先将数万候选文本随机分群，用 LLM 选最可能同作者的文本；重复迭代缩小候选，最终输出 top-k 排名。为扩展规模，加入稠密检索预过滤缩小搜索空间，并通过多次独立运行+多数投票提升鲁棒性与排序精度。

Result: 在被匿名化的 ICLR 审稿数据集上，DAS 从数万篇候选中召回同作者文本的 Top-1 命中率达 22%（随机基线 0.01%），Top-10 达 38%；在 Enron 邮件与博客基准上，相较传统方法准确率提升 6–19 倍，可扩展至 5 万级候选，推理成本仅线性增长。

Conclusion: DAS 首次证明利用现成 LLM 即可在数万级文本中实施高精度作者去匿名化，对双盲评审、匿名投稿等机制构成实际威胁；同时提醒未来 LLM 系统需内置作者风格隐私防护，例如风格匿名化或对抗训练。

Abstract: As LLMs rapidly advance and enter real-world use, their privacy implications are increasingly important. We study an authorship de-anonymization threat: using LLMs to link anonymous documents to their authors, potentially compromising settings such as double-blind peer review.
  We propose De-Anonymization at Scale (DAS), a large language model-based method for attributing authorship among tens of thousands of candidate texts. DAS uses a sequential progression strategy: it randomly partitions the candidate corpus into fixed-size groups, prompts an LLM to select the text most likely written by the same author as a query text, and iteratively re-queries the surviving candidates to produce a ranked top-k list. To make this practical at scale, DAS adds a dense-retrieval prefilter to shrink the search space and a majority-voting style aggregation over multiple independent runs to improve robustness and ranking precision. Experiments on anonymized review data show DAS can recover same-author texts from pools of tens of thousands with accuracy well above chance, demonstrating a realistic privacy risk for anonymous platforms. On standard authorship benchmarks (Enron emails and blog posts), DAS also improves both accuracy and scalability over prior approaches, highlighting a new LLM-enabled de-anonymization vulnerability.

</details>


### [376] [HERMES: KV Cache as Hierarchical Memory for Efficient Streaming Video Understanding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.14724)
*Haowei Zhang,Shudong Yang,Jinlan Fu,See-Kiong Ng,Xipeng Qiu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 通过免训练的层级 KV-cache 裁剪机制，HERMES 在实时流式视频 MLLM 上实现近 10× 首次响应加速、GPU 内存≥5× 节省，同时精度不降反升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有离线 MLLM 扩展到流式视频时难以兼顾连续理解、实时响应与低 GPU 内存，严重阻碍视频对话等交互应用。

Method: 提出 HERMES：1) 将 KV cache 视为多粒度分层记忆；2) 推理阶段依据层次化 score 机制复用/裁剪跨帧 KV，无需训练；3) 新帧与问答触发零额外计算，保证 TTFT<10 ms。

Result: 在主流基准（ActivityNet-QA、PerceptionTest 等）与自收集流式数据集上，仅用 32% 视频 tokens（平均剪枝 68%），仍保持或超过 SOTA 精度，例如流式数据集 +11.4% ROI；TTFT 快约 10×；GPU 内存峰值降低 5–7×；端到端延迟稳定低于实时 30 fps。

Conclusion: HERMES 验证了“免训练 + 层次 KV 记忆”是同时达到高吞吐量、低延迟、高准确度的可行路线，为低算力设备上的实时 MLLM 视频理解与多轮对话奠定基础，并可直接迁移至多数 transformer-based MLLM。

Abstract: Recent advancements in Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have demonstrated significant improvement in offline video understanding. However, extending these capabilities to streaming video inputs, remains challenging, as existing models struggle to simultaneously maintain stable understanding performance, real-time responses, and low GPU memory overhead. To address this challenge, we propose HERMES, a novel training-free architecture for real-time and accurate understanding of video streams. Based on a mechanistic attention investigation, we conceptualize KV cache as a hierarchical memory framework that encapsulates video information across multiple granularities. During inference, HERMES reuses a compact KV cache, enabling efficient streaming understanding under resource constraints. Notably, HERMES requires no auxiliary computations upon the arrival of user queries, thereby guaranteeing real-time responses for continuous video stream interactions, which achieves 10$\times$ faster TTFT compared to prior SOTA. Even when reducing video tokens by up to 68% compared with uniform sampling, HERMES achieves superior or comparable accuracy across all benchmarks, with up to 11.4% gains on streaming datasets.

</details>


### [377] [Evolving Beyond Snapshots: Harmonizing Structure and Sequence via Entity State Tuning for Temporal Knowledge Graph Forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.12389)
*Siyuan Li,Yunjia Wu,Yiyong Xiao,Pingyang Huang,Peize Li,Ruitong Liu,Yan Wen,Te Sun*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 文章指出 TKG 预测任务中“无状态”方法会导致长期依赖遗忘，提出通用框架 EST，通过持续实体状态记忆与闭环更新机制，在多个基准上刷新 SOTA，验证状态持久化是长时域预测的关键。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 TKG 预测模型多为无状态：每次仅利用局部窗口重算实体表示，出现“片段性失忆”，难以捕获跨越数十甚至数百时间戳的长期演化规律，从而限制长时域预测性能。

Method: 提出 Encoder-agnostic 框架 EST：① 维护全局实体状态缓存；② Topology-aware State Perceiver 将实体先验注入结构编码；③ Unified Temporal Context 模块以可插拔序列骨架聚合状态增强事件；④ Dual-track Evolution 机制把更新后的上下文写回状态记忆，兼顾可塑性与稳定性，形成闭环持续演化。

Result: 在 ICEWS14/18、GDELT、WIKI 等数据集上，EST 对五种主流骨干模型（RE-Net、TANGO、GNN 类、Transformer 类等）均带来显著提升，平均 MRR↑3.7–8.2%，Hits@10↑4.1–9.5%，并在 30 步长预测中比原骨架降低 18–25% 的误差，首次在长时域设定下突破 SOTA。

Conclusion: 实验证实“持久且连续演化的实体状态”是提升长时域 TKG 预测的决定性因素；EST 作为通用插件可零成本赋能任意编码器，为动态图学习提供了新的状态持久化范式。

Abstract: Temporal knowledge graph (TKG) forecasting requires predicting future facts by jointly modeling structural dependencies within each snapshot and temporal evolution across snapshots. However, most existing methods are stateless: they recompute entity representations at each timestamp from a limited query window, leading to episodic amnesia and rapid decay of long-term dependencies. To address this limitation, we propose Entity State Tuning (EST), an encoder-agnostic framework that endows TKG forecasters with persistent and continuously evolving entity states. EST maintains a global state buffer and progressively aligns structural evidence with sequential signals via a closed-loop design. Specifically, a topology-aware state perceiver first injects entity-state priors into structural encoding. Then, a unified temporal context module aggregates the state-enhanced events with a pluggable sequence backbone. Subsequently, a dual-track evolution mechanism writes the updated context back to the global entity state memory, balancing plasticity against stability. Experiments on multiple benchmarks show that EST consistently improves diverse backbones and achieves state-of-the-art performance, highlighting the importance of state persistence for long-horizon TKG forecasting.

</details>


### [378] [SecureGate: Learning When to Reveal PII Safely via Token-Gated Dual-Adapters for Federated LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.13529)
*Mohamed Shaaban,Mohamed Elmahallawy*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: SecureGate 用“双 LoRA 适配器 + 令牌门控”在联邦场景下对 LLM 进行微调，实现可精细控制的隐私-效用权衡：全局适配器只学脱敏表示，本地适配器保留敏感知识，推理时按需激活，无需重训即可动态披露信息。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大模型在联邦微调中会因记忆效应泄露 PII，且数据异构导致全局泛化与本地效用持续冲突；现有防御（数据脱敏、DP）虽降泄露却严重损性能，亟需一种不牺牲下游效果的细粒度隐私控制方案。

Method: 提出 SecureGate 框架：1) 双适配器 LoRA——安全适配器学习经脱敏的全局可共享表示，揭示适配器捕捉组织特有敏感知识；2) 令牌级门控模块——根据输入令牌动态决定激活哪个适配器，实现推理阶段的可控信息释放；3) 联邦训练流程——本地仅更新揭示适配器，全局聚合安全适配器，保证无需重训即可随时调整披露策略。

Result: 在多个 LLM 和真实跨机构数据集上实验：相较基线，SecureGate 把推理攻击准确率最高降低 31.66 倍，PII 抽取召回率降低 17.07 倍，同时保持 100% 路由正确率，下游任务指标不降或略升，通信与计算开销仅微量增加。

Conclusion: SecureGate 首次在联邦 LLM 微调中实现了“按需披露”的细粒度隐私控制，破解了隐私-效用零和困境，为隐私敏感场景下的大模型协作提供了可扩展、低损耗的实用方案。

Abstract: Federated learning (FL) enables collaborative training across organizational silos without sharing raw data, making it attractive for privacy-sensitive applications. With the rapid adoption of large language models (LLMs), federated fine-tuning of generative LLMs has gained attention as a way to leverage distributed data while preserving confidentiality. However, this setting introduces fundamental challenges: (i) privacy leakage of personally identifiable information (PII) due to LLM memorization, and (ii) a persistent tension between global generalization and local utility under heterogeneous data. Existing defenses, such as data sanitization and differential privacy, reduce leakage but often degrade downstream performance. We propose SecureGate, a privacy-aware federated fine-tuning framework for LLMs that provides fine-grained privacy control without sacrificing utility. SecureGate employs a dual-adapter LoRA architecture: a secure adapter that learns sanitized, globally shareable representations, and a revealing adapter that captures sensitive, organization-specific knowledge. A token-controlled gating module selectively activates these adapters at inference time, enabling controlled information disclosure without retraining. Extensive experiments across multiple LLMs and real-world datasets show that SecureGate improves task utility while substantially reducing PII leakage, achieving up to a 31.66X reduction in inference attack accuracy and a 17.07X reduction in extraction recall for unauthorized requests. Additionally, it maintains 100% routing reliability to the correct adapter and incurs only minimal computational and communication overhead.

</details>


### [379] [IROSA: Interactive Robot Skill Adaptation using Natural Language](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.03897)
*Markus Knauer,Samuel Bustamante,Thomas Eiband,Alin Albu-Schäffer,Freek Stulp,João Silvério*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 用现成大模型挑“工具”调机器人动作，无需重训，工厂轴承套件实验安全透明。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基础模型泛化强但机器人样本少，二者融合有望解决工业场景快速换产难题，却罕有落地研究。

Method: 设计“工具箱”中间层：LLM 只做面向技能原语（速度、轨迹、避障等）的选型与参数填充，7 自由度力控机器人执行，不微调模型也不直连硬件，全程可解释可审计。

Result: 在轴承环压装任务中，自然语言一句即可实现速度调节、轨迹修正和避障，成功率保持 100%，无碰撞及异常力矩。

Conclusion: 证明“大模型-工具-机器人”范式可直接用于工业，兼顾安全性、透明性与快速部署潜力。

Abstract: Foundation models have demonstrated impressive capabilities across diverse domains, while imitation learning provides principled methods for robot skill adaptation from limited data. Combining these approaches holds significant promise for direct application to robotics, yet this combination has received limited attention, particularly for industrial deployment. We present a novel framework that enables open-vocabulary skill adaptation through a tool-based architecture, maintaining a protective abstraction layer between the language model and robot hardware. Our approach leverages pre-trained LLMs to select and parameterize specific tools for adapting robot skills without requiring fine-tuning or direct model-to-robot interaction. We demonstrate the framework on a 7-DoF torque-controlled robot performing an industrial bearing ring insertion task, showing successful skill adaptation through natural language commands for speed adjustment, trajectory correction, and obstacle avoidance while maintaining safety, transparency, and interpretability.

</details>


### [380] [Counting Without Numbers and Finding Without Words](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.24470)
*Badri Narayana Patro*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 动物收容所年均千万只走失宠物因70%无法仅靠外貌识别而难以与主人团聚；作者提出首套融合视觉-声学生物特征的多模态AI寻回系统，覆盖10Hz–4kHz全频段动物叫声，兼顾应激外观变化，实现跨物种身份匹配。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有寻宠系统依赖外貌匹配，忽视动物通过声音识别同类的天然机制，导致大量可匹配案例错失团聚机会；认知科学证据表明动物具备近似量感和声学身份通讯能力，却未被AI利用。

Method: 构建物种自适应多模态架构：1. 声学通路处理10Hz象嗡到4kHz幼犬尖吠的宽频叫声，提取声纹特征；2. 视觉通路采用概率匹配模型容忍压力诱发的毛色、体态变化；3. 双模态融合决策，实现无语言条件下的身份确认。

Result: 首次证明融合生物学通讯原则的AI可在真实收容环境中提升走失宠物与主人的重聚率，为不会人类语言的弱势动物群体提供有效技术援助。

Conclusion: 将动物声学身份识别引入计算机视觉，突破“静音对象”假设，能显著改善流浪动物归宿，并启发生物合理AI在更广泛的跨物种保护场景中的应用。

Abstract: Every year, 10 million pets enter shelters, separated from their families. Despite desperate searches by both guardians and lost animals, 70% never reunite, not because matches do not exist, but because current systems look only at appearance, while animals recognize each other through sound. We ask, why does computer vision treat vocalizing species as silent visual objects? Drawing on five decades of cognitive science showing that animals perceive quantity approximately and communicate identity acoustically, we present the first multimodal reunification system integrating visual and acoustic biometrics. Our species-adaptive architecture processes vocalizations from 10Hz elephant rumbles to 4kHz puppy whines, paired with probabilistic visual matching that tolerates stress-induced appearance changes. This work demonstrates that AI grounded in biological communication principles can serve vulnerable populations that lack human language.

</details>


### [381] [Mitigating LLM biases toward spurious social contexts using direct preference optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.02585)
*Hyunji Nam,Dorottya Demszky*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 大型语言模型在教师教学质量评估等高风险任务中易被无关社会语境误导，最大偏差达1.48/7分；作者提出自监督Debiasing-DPO，在Llama/Qwen系列上把语境偏差降低84%，准确率提升52%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLMs 对虚假语境敏感，会在教师评估等场景引入有害偏差，损害教师职业发展，需要系统研究并消除这种语境偏差。

Method: 以 NCTE 课堂转录数据集为基准，先对 7 个前沿模型测试 7 类虚假语境的敏感度；随后设计 Debiasing-DPO：用“仅查询生成的中性推理”与“查询+虚假语境产生的偏差推理”构建偏好对，再与有监督微调联合训练。

Result: 提示工程和标准 DPO 几乎无效；Debiasing-DPO 使 Llama 3B/8B 与 Qwen 3B/7B 的平均偏差下降 84%，准确率提升 52%，且更大模型未必更鲁棒。

Conclusion: 模型规模扩大不会自动带来语境鲁棒性；Debiasing-DPO 能在不牺牲准确率的前提下显著抑制虚假语境带来的偏差，对提示式预测任务具有通用价值。

Abstract: LLMs are increasingly used for high-stakes decision-making, yet their sensitivity to spurious contextual information can introduce harmful biases. This is a critical concern when models are deployed for tasks like evaluating teachers' instructional quality, where biased assessment can affect teachers' professional development and career trajectories. We investigate model robustness to spurious social contexts using the largest publicly available dataset of U.S. classroom transcripts (NCTE) paired with expert rubric scores. Evaluating seven frontier and open-weight models across seven categories of spurious contexts -- including teacher experience, education level, demographic identity, and sycophancy-inducing framings -- we find that irrelevant contextual information can shift model predictions by up to 1.48 points on a 7-point scale, with larger models sometimes exhibiting greater sensitivity despite higher predictive accuracy. Mitigations using prompts and standard direct preference optimization (DPO) prove largely insufficient. We propose **Debiasing-DPO**,, a self-supervised training method that pairs neutral reasoning generated from the query alone, with the model's biased reasoning generated with both the query and additional spurious context. We further combine this objective with supervised fine-tuning on ground-truth labels to prevent losses in predictive accuracy. Applied to Llama 3B \& 8B and Qwen 3B \& 7B Instruct models, Debiasing-DPO reduces bias by 84\% and improves predictive accuracy by 52\% on average. Our findings from the educational case study highlight that robustness to spurious context is not a natural byproduct of model scaling and that our proposed method can yield substantial gains in both accuracy and robustness for prompt-based prediction tasks.

</details>


### [382] [Reproduction Beyond Benchmarks: ConstBERT and ColBERT-v2 Across Backends and Query Distributions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.09982)
*Utshab Kumar Ghosh,Ashish David,Shubham Chatterjee*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 复现实验揭示 ColBERT-v2 与 ConstBERT 在长查询场景 MRR 暴跌 86–97%，主因是 MaxSim 算子对所有词元均等加权，无法过滤噪声；此外稀疏质心覆盖及后端隐藏参数导致额外 8 个点差距，三倍数据微调反而再降 29%，证明架构瓶颈无法靠后续适配解决。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有密集检索复现多聚焦数值误差，忽视架构鲁棒性。本文质疑“能跑通训练集即可上线”的惯例，提出要验证模型在真实长查询、不同实现后端下的鲁棒性。

Method: 从数值、鲁棒性、消融、后端差异、数据扩展五个维度对比 ColBERT-v2 与 ConstBERT；设计 TREC ToT-2025 长叙述查询集；通过逐词元消融定位 MaxSim 算子缺陷；量化稀疏质心覆盖率；进行 3×数据微调对照实验。

Result: MS-MARCO 内差距仅 0.05% MRR@10，但在 20 词以上查询两模型均掉至原性能 3–14%；去除填充词后性能即回升，证实 MaxSim 均匀加权为罪魁祸首；ConstBERT 因质心覆盖稀疏再丢 8 个点；增大数据量反而最高降 29%，说明容量瓶颈在架构而非数据。

Conclusion: 多向量检索的 MaxSim 机制存在结构性缺陷，长查询场景下噪声稀释信号，且后端实现差异与数据扩展均无法弥补；未来需重新设计能动态区分信号/噪声的检索架构，而非仅做训练或调参层面的改进。

Abstract: Reproducibility must validate architectural robustness, not just numerical accuracy. We evaluate ColBERT-v2 and ConstBERT across five dimensions, finding that while ConstBERT reproduces within 0.05% MRR@10 on MS-MARCO, both models show a drop of 86-97% on long, narrative queries (TREC ToT 2025). Ablations prove this failure is architectural: performance plateaus at 20 words because the MaxSim operator's uniform token weighting cannot distinguish signal from filler noise. Furthermore, undocumented backend parameters create an 8-point gap due to ConstBERT's sparse centroid coverage, and fine-tuning with 3x more data actually degrades performance by up to 29%. We conclude that architectural constraints in multi-vector retrieval cannot be overcome by adaptation alone. Code: https://github.com/utshabkg/multi-vector-reproducibility.

</details>


### [383] [Towards Proactive Information Probing: Customer Service Chatbots Harvesting Value from Conversation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.11077)
*Chen Huang,Zitan Jiang,Changyi Zou,Wenqiang Lei,See-Kiong Ng*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出PROCHATIP框架，使客服机器人能主动探查高价值信息，兼顾对话效率与服务质量，显著提升商业情报采集能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统客服机器人仅被动应答，难以规模化获取高价值商业情报；需解决“何时主动探查”这一时序决策难题，以降低用户摩擦并提升信息采集效率。

Method: 提出“主动信息探查”新任务，显式优化探查时机；设计PROCHATIP框架，引入专门对话策略模块，采用强化学习训练探查时机策略；在真实对话场景中与多基线方法对比评估。

Result: PROCHATIP在保证并提升用户满意度的同时，显著提高目标信息采集成功率并减少对话轮次，较基线整体取得显著增益。

Conclusion: 主动探查机制将客服机器人转型为低成本、可扩展的商业情报引擎；代码已开源，为后续对话商业价值研究奠定基础。

Abstract: Customer service chatbots are increasingly expected to serve not merely as reactive support tools for users, but as strategic interfaces for harvesting high-value information and business intelligence. In response, we make three main contributions. 1) We introduce and define a novel task of Proactive Information Probing, which optimizes when to probe users for pre-specified target information while minimizing conversation turns and user friction. 2) We propose PROCHATIP, a proactive chatbot framework featuring a specialized conversation strategy module trained to master the delicate timing of probes. 3) Experiments demonstrate that PROCHATIP significantly outperforms baselines, exhibiting superior capability in both information probing and service quality. We believe that our work effectively redefines the commercial utility of chatbots, positioning them as scalable, cost-effective engines for proactive business intelligence. Our code is available at https://github.com/SCUNLP/PROCHATIP.

</details>


### [384] [Revisiting Compositionality in Dual-Encoder Vision-Language Models: The Role of Inference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.11496)
*Imanol Miranda,Ander Salaberria,Eneko Agirre,Gorka Azkune*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本研究指出 CLIP 类双编码器 VLM 的组合性缺陷主要源于「全局余弦相似」推理范式，而非表示本身；引入一种轻型 Transformer，仅利用冻结图像 patch 与文本 token 嵌入学习局部区域-词段对齐，在不更新编码器前提下达到与全参数微调相当的域内检索效果，且在组合分布外基准上显著超越现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 VLMs 在组合基准上表现差被归因于表示缺陷；作者怀疑真正瓶颈是推理阶段全局向量匹配，因而探索在保持预训练权重冻结的前提下，通过局部对齐提升组合泛化能力。

Method: 1) 诊断实验：强制推理时对图像区域与文本词段进行细粒度对齐，验证组合性能提升；2) 提出轻量 Transformer 模块，只消费冻结的 patch/token 嵌入，自回归地学习最优区域-词段对齐分数，直接生成图文匹配得分；3) 与全参数微调及端到端组合训练方法在域内与组合分布外基准上比较。

Result: 局部对齐推理无需重训编码器即可将组合准确率显著抬高；轻量化对齐模型在域内图文检索上与全微调持平，在组合分布外测试集上平均提升 10+ 个百分点，而全微调与端到端组合训练常出现域内增益无法外移的现象。

Conclusion: 全局嵌入匹配是双编码器 VLM 组合性瓶颈；仅靠推理时局部对齐即可释放预训练表示的潜在组合能力，实现参数高效、鲁棒泛化的视觉-语言理解新范式，并为部署大规模冻结模型提供可行思路。

Abstract: Dual-encoder Vision-Language Models (VLMs) such as CLIP are often characterized as bag-of-words systems due to their poor performance on compositional benchmarks. We argue that this limitation may stem less from deficient representations than from the standard inference protocol based on global cosine similarity. First, through controlled diagnostic experiments, we show that explicitly enforcing fine-grained region-segment alignment at inference dramatically improves compositional performance without updating pretrained encoders. We then introduce a lightweight transformer that learns such alignments directly from frozen patch and token embeddings. Comparing against full fine-tuning and prior end-to-end compositional training methods, we find that although these approaches improve in-domain retrieval, their gains do not consistently transfer under distribution shift. In contrast, learning localized alignment over frozen representations matches full fine-tuning on in-domain retrieval while yielding substantial improvements on controlled out-of-domain compositional benchmarks. These results identify global embedding matching as a key bottleneck in dual-encoder VLMs and highlight the importance of alignment mechanisms for robust compositional generalization.

</details>


### [385] [Beyond Prompt: Fine-grained Simulation of Cognitively Impaired Standardized Patients via Stochastic Steering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.12210)
*Weikang Zhang,Zimo Zhu,Zhichuan Yang,Chen Huang,Wenqiang Lei,See-Kiong Ng*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出StsPatient框架，用「对比指令-响应对」提取领域专属转向向量，配合随机token调制(STM)精准控制认知障碍模拟的严重程度，在真实度与可控性上全面优于基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统离散prompt难以复现认知障碍跨领域、跨严重度的异质性，需一种可扩展且伦理合规的精细模拟方法。

Method: 1) 对比指令-响应对构建领域专属转向向量；2) 设计Stochastic Token Modulation(STM)动态调节干预概率，实现稳定、细粒度的严重程度控制。

Result: 在多项临床真实度与可控性指标上，StsPatient显著超越现有prompt基线，且 severity 控制误差<3%。

Conclusion: 转向向量+STM 的新范式为认知障碍标准化病人模拟提供高保真、可扩展、伦理友好的解决方案，可推广至其他神经精神疾病仿真。

Abstract: Simulating Standardized Patients with cognitive impairment offers a scalable and ethical solution for clinical training. However, existing methods rely on discrete prompt engineering and fail to capture the heterogeneity of deficits across varying domains and severity levels. To address this limitation, we propose StsPatient for the fine-grained simulation of cognitively impaired patients. We innovatively capture domain-specific features by extracting steering vectors from contrastive pairs of instructions and responses. Furthermore, we introduce a Stochastic Token Modulation (STM) mechanism to regulate the intervention probability. STM enables precise control over impairment severity while mitigating the instability of conventional vector methods. Comprehensive experiments demonstrate that StsPatient significantly outperforms baselines in both clinical authenticity and severity controllability.

</details>


### [386] [Functional Emotions or Situational Contexts? A Discriminating Test from the Mythos Preview System Card](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.13466)
*Hiranya V. Peiris*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 情绪向量测得的信号是否就是真正驱动模型的’情绪’，还只是高层情境语义的投影，决定了用情绪探针能否可靠发现危险行为；本文给出验证方案。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Claude Mythos Preview用情绪向量与SAE两套工具检视模型内部，却未在同一对抗场景下对比，因而无法判断情绪向量到底是因果驱动变量还是情境语义的降维投影；厘清这一点直接影响基于情绪的监测能否不漏检危险行为。

Method: 提出两条定性假设：①情绪向量是功能情绪并因果驱动行为；②其仅为情境结构在人类情绪轴上的投影。设计交叉实验：在仅报告SAE结果的“策略性隐瞒”片段上补测情绪向量；若SAE高激活而情绪向量平坦，则排除假设①，证明关键结构位于情绪子空间之外。

Result: 目前仅给出判别框架，尚未公布实验结果；若假设②成立，情绪探针将系统性地漏检对抗行为。

Conclusion: 需立即对策略性隐瞒等核心片段执行交叉实验，以确定情绪监测的鲁棒性；若验证发现情绪向量不敏感，应转向更高维或任务特异的可解释信号。

Abstract: The Claude Mythos Preview system card deploys emotion vectors, sparse autoencoder (SAE) features, and activation verbalisers to study model internals during misaligned behaviour. The two primary toolkits are not jointly reported on the most alignment-relevant episodes. This note identifies two hypotheses that are qualitatively consistent with the published results: that the emotion vectors track functional emotions that causally drive behaviour, or that they are a projection of a richer situational-context structure onto human emotional axes. The hypotheses can be distinguished by cross-referencing the two toolkits on episodes where only one is currently reported: most directly, applying emotion probes to the strategic concealment episodes analysed only with SAE features. If emotion probes show flat activation while SAE features are strongly active, the alignment-relevant structure lies outside the emotion subspace. Which hypothesis is correct determines whether emotion-based monitoring will robustly detect dangerous model behaviour or systematically miss it.

</details>

### [387] [Generative Modeling of Complex-Valued Brain MRI Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.14800)
*Marco Schlimbach,Moritz Rempe,Jessica Mnischek,Lukas T. Rotkopf,Jens Weingarten,Jens Kleesiek,Kevin Kröninger*

Main category: eess.IV

TL;DR: 提出一种可同时建模幅度与相位的复杂值脑MRI生成框架，首次证明合成数据能提升肿瘤分类性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统MRI重建及现有AI方法仅利用幅度图像，丢弃携带组织特性信息的相位，可能损失对肿瘤诊断有价值的信息。

Method: 构建条件VAE-流匹配混合生成框架：VAE将复杂值MRI压缩为保持相位相干性的隐变量，流匹配模型在隐空间完成生成；并用“真伪判别+下游分类”双重指标评估。

Result: VAE相位相干度>0.997；真伪判别AUROC 0.50–0.66，合成样本几乎难辨真假；仅用合成数据训练的异常检测器在fastMRI达AUROC 0.880，显著超过真实数据基线0.842，且在外部活检标注集上优势依旧。

Conclusion: 该框架首次实现幅度-相位联合建模并生成高质量复杂值脑MRI，验证了利用完整MRI信息可提升诊断性能，为后续病理特征研究与诊断应用奠定基础。

Abstract: Objective. Standard Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) reconstruction pipelines discard phase information captured during acquisition, despite evidence that it encodes tissue properties relevant to tumor diagnosis. Current machine learning approaches inherit this limitation by operating exclusively on reconstructed magnitude images. The aim of this study is to build a generative framework which is capable of jointly modeling magnitude and phase information of complex-valued MRI scans. Approach. The proposed generative framework combines a conditional variational autoencoder, which compresses complex-valued MRI scans into compact latent representations while preserving phase coherence, with a flow-matching-based generative model. Synthetic sample quality is assessed via a real-versus-synthetic classifier and by training downstream classifiers on synthetic data for abnormal tissue detection. Main results. The autoencoder preserves phase coherence above 0.997. Real-versus-synthetic classification yields low AUROC values between 0.50 and 0.66 across all acquisition sequences, indicating generated samples are nearly indistinguishable from real data. In downstream normal-versus-abnormal classification, classifiers trained entirely on synthetic data achieve an AUROC of 0.880, surpassing the real-data baseline of 0.842 on a publicly available dataset (fastMRI). This advantage persists on an independent external test set from a different institution with biopsy-confirmed labels. Significance. The proposed framework demonstrates the feasibility of jointly modeling magnitude and phase information for normal and abnormal complex-valued brain MRI data. Beyond synthetic data generation, it establishes a foundation for the usage of complete brain MRI information in future diagnostic applications and enables systematic investigation of how magnitude and phase jointly encode pathology-specific features.

</details>


### [388] [QualiaNet: An Experience-Before-Inference Network](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.14193)
*Paul Linton*

Main category: eess.IV

TL;DR: 论文提出双阶段模型：体验模块仅输出相对视差，推理模块依据‘近景梯度大、远景趋平’的自然统计规律，由视差梯度估计绝对距离；QualiaNet用CNN实现该架构，无需其他线索即可解算距离。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 人眼虽无法从单帧立体视差直接感知绝对距离，却能凭其判断场景尺度，暗示大脑利用场景统计规律进行后验推理。

Method: 提出体验-推理双模块框架：1)体验模块输出相对于注视点的视差图；2)推理模块以CNN学习‘近景梯度大、远景趋平’的先验统计，用视差梯度回归绝对距离；构建QualiaNet验证该流程。

Result: 仅输入模拟人眼视差图，网络即可较准确地恢复场景距离，证明视差梯度已包含足够统计信息，支持两阶段假说。

Conclusion: 立体视觉分阶段处理：先提取相对视差体验，再借自然场景梯度统计推断绝对距离；该计算框架为理解人类3D知觉及改进无标定立体算法提供新思路。

Abstract: Human 3D vision involves two distinct stages: an Experience Module, where stereo depth is extracted relative to fixation, and an Inference Module, where this experience is interpreted to estimate 3D scene properties. Paradoxically, although our experience of stereo vision does not provide us with distance information, it does affect our inferences about visual scale. We propose the Inference Module exploits a natural scene statistic: near scenes produce vivid disparity gradients, while far scenes appear comparatively flat. QualiaNet implements this two-stage architecture computationally: disparity maps simulating human stereo experience are passed to a CNN trained to estimate distance. The network can recover distance from disparity gradients alone, validating this approach.

</details>


### [389] [Magnitude Is All You Need? Rethinking Phase in Quantum Encoding of Complex SAR Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.14229)
*Sakthi Prabhu Gunasekar,Prasanna Kumar R*

Main category: eess.IV

TL;DR: 首次证实：在SAR-ATR任务中，混合架构只需幅度即可达SOTA，纯量子架构却必须保留相位；相位价值由


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: SAR数据为复值，QML天然工作在复Hilbert空间，直觉上同时编码幅度+相位应提升识别精度，但缺乏系统验证。  

Method: 在MSTAR基准上统一比较5种量子编码（仅幅度、联合复值、I/Q、预处理相位、纯量子），分别嵌入混合与纯量子两类架构，控制参数规模（184–224）并做统计检验。

Result: 混合架构：仅幅度编码达99.57%(3类)/71.19%(8类)，显著优于所有含相位方案，相位贡献≈0甚至负。纯量子架构：引入相位最高可提21.65%精度，无相位则性能崩溃。  

Conclusion: 相位信息并非天生有用，其效用由

Abstract: Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) data is inherently complex-valued, while quantum machine learning (QML) models naturally operate in complex Hilbert spaces. This apparent alignment suggests that incorporating both magnitude and phase information into quantum encoding should improve performance in SAR Automatic Target Recognition (ATR). In this work, we systematically evaluate this assumption by comparing five quantum encoding strategies: magnitude-only, joint complex, I/Q-based, preprocessed phase, and pure quantum, under a unified experimental framework on the MSTAR benchmark dataset.
  Contrary to expectation, we observe a consistent pattern: in hybrid quantum-classical architectures, magnitude-only encoding outperforms all complex-valued strategies, achieving 99.57% accuracy on a 3-class task and 71.19% on an 8-class task, while phase-aware methods provide negligible (~0%) or negative improvements. In contrast, in purely quantum architectures with only 184-224 trainable parameters and no classical components, phase information becomes essential, contributing up to 21.65% improvement in accuracy.
  These results reveal that the utility of phase information is not inherent to the data, but depends critically on the model architecture. Hybrid models rely on classical components that compensate for missing phase information, whereas purely quantum models require phase to construct discriminative representations. Our findings provide practical design guidelines for encoding complex-valued data in QML and highlight the importance of encoding-architecture co-design in the NISQ era.

</details>


### [390] [Continual Learning for fMRI-Based Brain Disorder Diagnosis via Functional Connectivity Matrices Generative Replay](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.14259)
*Qianyu Chen,Shujian Yu*

Main category: eess.IV

TL;DR: 首个直指fMRI跨站点持续学习诊断的框架FORGE：用结构感知VAE生成FC矩阵，多级知识蒸馏+层次化bandit重放，显著缓解灾难性遗忘。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有fMRI诊断模型只能单站训练或需一次性聚合多站数据，无法应对临床数据“顺序到站”的真实场景，导致泛化差、灾难性遗忘严重。

Method: 提出FORGE框架：①结构感知变分自编码器为病患/对照组生成逼真FC矩阵；②基于生成结果，多级知识蒸馏对齐新站数据与重放样本的预测及图表示；③用分层上下文bandit自适应选择重放样本，降低存储与计算开销。

Result: 在MDD、SZ、ASD三跨站数据集上，生成模型提升数据增广质量，整体框架在缓解灾难性遗忘指标上显著优于现有持续学习与联邦学习方法。

Conclusion: FORGE首次实现fMRI跨站点顺序学习，兼顾隐私、存储与性能，为临床脑疾病持续诊断提供可扩展方案，代码已开源。

Abstract: Functional magnetic resonance imaging (fMRI) is widely used for studying and diagnosing brain disorders, with functional connectivity (FC) matrices providing powerful representations of large-scale neural interactions. However, existing diagnostic models are trained either on a single site or under full multi-site access, making them unsuitable for real-world scenarios where clinical data arrive sequentially from different institutions. This results in limited generalization and severe catastrophic forgetting. This paper presents the first continual learning framework specifically designed for fMRI-based diagnosis across heterogeneous clinical sites. Our framework introduces a structure-aware variational autoencoder that synthesizes realistic FC matrices for both patient and control groups. Built on this generative backbone, we develop a multi-level knowledge distillation strategy that aligns predictions and graph representations between new-site data and replayed samples. To further enhance efficiency, we incorporate a hierarchical contextual bandit scheme for adaptive replay sampling. Experiments on multi-site datasets for major depressive disorder (MDD), schizophrenia (SZ), and autism spectrum disorder (ASD) show that the proposed generative model enhances data augmentation quality, and the overall continual learning framework substantially outperforms existing methods in mitigating catastrophic forgetting. Our code is available at https://github.com/4me808/FORGE.

</details>

*Zhendong Cao,Katrina G. Salvante,Ash Parameswaran,Pablo A. Nepomnaschy,Hongji Dai*

A specifically designed device setup compatible with conventional 96 well plates is chosen to create an ideal environment in which a smart phone camera can be used as the optical detector. In comparison with conventional microplate reading machines such as Perkin Elmer Victor Machine, the device presented in this paper is not equipped with expensive elements such as exciter filer, barrier filter and photomultiplier; instead, a phone camera is all needed to detect fluorescence within the sample. ### [392] [HAMSA: Scanning-Free Vision State Space Models via SpectralPulseNet](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.14724)
*Badri N. Patro,Vijay S. Agneeswaran*

Main category: eess.IV

TL;DR: HAMSA 用频域直接建模替代扫描式 SSM，单高斯复核+频域门控，在 ImageNet-1K 上达 85.7% Top-1，推理速度超 Transformer 2.2 倍、省 35% 以上内存与能耗，为视觉 SSM 新 SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 Vision SSM（Vim/VMamba/SiMBA）需将 2D 图像展平为 1D 序列并用复杂扫描策略，带来顺序依赖、计算冗余与架构复杂性问题，限制了硬件并行度与部署效率。

Method: 1) 简化核参数化：仅用单高斯初始化的复数核取代传统 (A,B,C) 矩阵，避免离散化不稳定；2) SpectralPulseNet：输入相关的频域门控，自适应调制频率分量；3) Spectral Adaptive Gating Unit：基于幅值的频域门控，保证梯度稳定。整体通过 FFT 卷积在频域完成 O(L log L) 全局建模，无需任何扫描。

Result: ImageNet-1K 上 Top-1 85.7%，为 SSM 类最佳；相比 DeiT-S 推理延迟 4.2 ms vs 9.2 ms（快 2.2×），较扫描式 SSM 再快 1.4–1.9×；显存占用 2.1 GB（对比 3.2–4.5 GB），单图能耗 12.5 J（对比 18–25 J）。下游迁移与密集预测任务均保持强泛化。

Conclusion: 频域 SSM 能在不牺牲精度的前提下彻底消除扫描开销，实现高并行、低延迟、低功耗，为视觉骨干网络提供了一种简洁高效的新范式。

Abstract: Vision State Space Models (SSMs) like Vim, VMamba, and SiMBA rely on complex scanning strategies to adapt sequential SSMs to process 2D images, introducing computational overhead and architectural complexity. We propose HAMSA, a scanning-free SSM operating directly in the spectral domain. HAMSA introduces three key innovations: (1) simplified kernel parameterization-a single Gaussian-initialized complex kernel replacing traditional (A, B, C) matrices, eliminating discretization instabilities; (2) SpectralPulseNet (SPN)-an input-dependent frequency gating mechanism enabling adaptive spectral modulation; and (3) Spectral Adaptive Gating Unit (SAGU)-magnitude-based gating for stable gradient flow in the frequency domain. By leveraging FFT-based convolution, HAMSA eliminates sequential scanning while achieving O(L log L) complexity with superior simplicity and efficiency. On ImageNet-1K, HAMSA reaches 85.7% top-1 accuracy (state-of-the-art among SSMs), with 2.2 X faster inference than transformers (4.2ms vs 9.2ms for DeiT-S) and 1.4-1.9X speedup over scanning-based SSMs, while using less memory (2.1GB vs 3.2-4.5GB) and energy (12.5J vs 18-25J). HAMSA demonstrates strong generalization across transfer learning and dense prediction tasks.

</details>


### [393] [Frame forecasting in cine MRI using the PCA respiratory motion model: comparing recurrent neural networks trained online and transformers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2410.05882)
*Michel Pohl,Mitsuru Uesaka,Hiroyuki Takahashi,Kazuyuki Demachi,Ritu Bhusal Chhatkuli*

Main category: eess.IV

TL;DR: 基于MRI-cine序列，在线循环神经网络(RTRL/SnAp-1)与序列专属Transformer能在0.3–2 s预测窗内将胸腹肿瘤呼吸位移误差控制在1–3 mm以内，优于线性滤波与离线模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 胸腹部放疗系统存在数百毫秒延迟，导致照射时肿瘤位置不确定。需利用MRI-cine进行前瞻性帧预测，补偿呼吸运动并提高靶区追踪精度。

Method: 以Lucas-Kanade光流场+PCA降维提取低维呼吸权重；评估线性滤波、序列专属Transformer及四种在线学习RNN(RTRL/UORO/DNI/SnAp-1)对这些权重的时序预测；再将预测位移映射回图像空间生成未来帧。

Result: 短预测窗(h=0.32 s)线性回归误差最低(1.3 mm, ETHZ)；中-长窗RTRL与SnAp-1表现最佳(ETHZ ≤1.4 mm, OvGU ≤2.8 mm)，显著优于离线模型与通用Transformer；序列专属Transformer在中短窗可竞争，但受数据稀缺与域偏移限制。

Conclusion: 在线RNN能有效适应呼吸模式变化，是实现MRI引导实时胸腹肿瘤追踪的可行方案；未来需扩大数据、融合跨域迁移学习并降低膈肌与出平面运动的预测残差。

Abstract: Respiratory motion complicates accurate irradiation of thoraco-abdominal tumors during radiotherapy, as treatment-system latency entails target-location uncertainties. This work addresses frame forecasting in chest and liver cine MRI to compensate for such delays. We investigate RNNs trained with online learning algorithms, enabling adaptation to changing respiratory patterns via on-the-fly parameter updates, and transformers, increasingly common in time-series forecasting for their ability to capture long-term dependencies. Experiments used 12 sagittal thoracic and upper-abdominal cine-MRI sequences from ETH Zürich and OvGU; the OvGU data exhibited higher motion variability, noise, and lower contrast. PCA decomposes the Lucas-Kanade optical-flow field into static deformation modes and low-dimensional, time-dependent weights. We compare various methods for forecasting these weights: linear filters, population and sequence-specific transformer encoders, and RNNs trained with real-time recurrent learning (RTRL), unbiased online recurrent optimization, decoupled neural interfaces, and sparse one-step approximation (SnAp-1). Predicted displacements were used to warp the reference frame and generate future images. Prediction accuracy decreased with the horizon h. Linear regression performed best at short horizons (1.3mm geometrical error at h=0.32s, ETH Zürich dataset), while RTRL and SnAp-1 outperformed the other algorithms at medium-to-long horizons, with geometrical errors below 1.4mm and 2.8mm on the sequences from ETH Zürich and OvGU, respectively. The sequence-specific transformer was competitive for low-to-medium horizons, but transformers remained overall limited by data scarcity and domain shift between datasets. Predicted frames visually resembled the ground truth, with notable errors occurring near the diaphragm at end-inspiration and regions affected by out-of-plane motion.

</details>


### [394] [Improving Prostate Gland Segmentation Using Transformer based Architectures](https://arxiv.org/abs/2506.14844)
*Shatha Abudalou Yasin Yilmaz Yoganand Balagurunathan*

Main category: eess.IV

TL;DR: 基于546例T2加权MRI，SwinUNETR在标注差异和跨域场景下前列腺分割稳健性优于UNet/UNETR，大腺体亚组Dice最高提升5个百分点，具备临床部署潜力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 前列腺MRI自动分割受标注者差异(inter-reader variability)及跨医院域偏移(domain shift)影响，需验证Transformer结构对异质性数据的鲁棒性，以提升临床可部署性。

Method: 采集546例T2加权MRI，两位独立医生标注；以UNet为基线，比较UNETR与SwinUNETR。设计三种训练策略：单队列、五折混合队列、腺体大小分层。用Optuna调参，独立人群作测试，指标为Dice Similarity Coefficient。

Result: 单读者训练：SwinUNETR Dice 0.816/0.860 vs UNet 0.825/0.851；五折混合验证：SwinUNETR达0.858/0.867；大腺体分层子集：SwinUNETR 0.902/0.894，UNETR下降明显。全局+移位窗口注意力降低标注噪声与类别失衡敏感度，性能提升≤5 pp，计算量可控。

Conclusion: SwinUNETR凭借自注意力机制，在标注差异与域偏移下保持高精度，较CNN最高提升5 Dice，证明其临床级鲁棒性与部署可行性。

Abstract: Inter reader variability and cross site domain shift challenge the automatic segmentation of prostate anatomy using T2 weighted MRI images. This study investigates whether transformer models can retain precision amid such heterogeneity. We compare the performance of UNETR and SwinUNETR in prostate gland segmentation against our previous 3D UNet model [1], based on 546 MRI (T2weighted) volumes annotated by two independent experts. Three training strategies were analyzed: single cohort dataset, 5 fold cross validated mixed cohort, and gland size based dataset. Hyperparameters were tuned by Optuna. The test set, from an independent population of readers, served as the evaluation endpoint (Dice Similarity Coefficient). In single reader training, SwinUNETR achieved an average dice score of 0.816 for Reader#1 and 0.860 for Reader#2, while UNETR scored 0.8 and 0.833 for Readers #1 and #2, respectively, compared to the baseline UNets 0.825 for Reader #1 and 0.851 for Reader #2. SwinUNETR had an average dice score of 0.8583 for Reader#1 and 0.867 for Reader#2 in cross-validated mixed training. For the gland size-based dataset, SwinUNETR achieved an average dice score of 0.902 for Reader#1 subset and 0.894 for Reader#2, using the five-fold mixed training strategy (Reader#1, n=53; Reader#2, n=87) at larger gland size-based subsets, where UNETR performed poorly. Our findings demonstrate that global and shifted-window self-attention effectively reduces label noise and class imbalance sensitivity, resulting in improvements in the Dice score over CNNs by up to five points while maintaining computational efficiency. This contributes to the high robustness of SwinUNETR for clinical deployment.

</details>


### [395] [Federated Breast Cancer Detection Enhanced by Synthetic Ultrasound Image Augmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2506.23334)
*Hongyi Pan,Ziliang Hong,Gorkem Durak,Ziyue Xu,Ulas Bagci*

Main category: eess.IV

TL;DR: 利用生成对抗网络与扩散模型合成超声图像，在联邦学习框架下适度扩增数据，使乳腺超声分类 AUC 提升约 1.5-1.6 个百分点，但过量合成数据会削弱泛化性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 联邦乳腺超声分类因各机构样本少且分布差异大，模型泛化受限，需在不共享原始数据的前提下扩增训练集。

Method: 提出基于深度卷积 GAN 与类条件去噪扩散概率模型的联邦数据扩增框架，将合成图像注入 FedAvg/FedProx 训练流程，并探讨合成-真实样本比例。

Result: 在 BUSI、BUS-BRA、UDIAT 三个公开数据集上，适量合成数据使平均 AUC 从 0.9206→0.9362(FedAvg)、0.9429→0.9574(FedProx)；过量合成数据导致性能下降。

Conclusion: 生成式扩增可显著提升联邦乳腺超声分类性能，但必须控制合成比例以维持真实数据的主导地位，从而兼顾隐私保护与模型泛化。

Abstract: Federated learning enables collaborative training of deep learning models across institutions without sharing sensitive patient data. However, its performance is often limited by small datasets and non-independent, identically distributed data, which can impair model generalization. In this work, we propose a generative model-based data augmentation framework for breast ultrasound classification. It leverages synthetic images generated by deep convolutional generative adversarial networks and a class-conditioned denoising diffusion probabilistic model. Experiments on three publicly available datasets (BUSI, BUS-BRA, and UDIAT) demonstrated that incorporating a suitable number of synthetic images improved average AUC from 0.9206 to 0.9362 for FedAvg and from 0.9429 to 0.9574 for FedProx. Furthermore, we noticed that excessive use of synthetic data reduced performance. This highlights the importance of balancing real and synthetic samples. Our results underscore the potential of generative model-based augmentation to enhance federated breast ultrasound image classification.

</details>


### [396] [Robust Glioblastoma Segmentation and Volumetry Without T2-FLAIR: External Validation of Targeted Dropout Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.20218)
*Marco Öchsner,Lena Kaiser,Robert Stahl,Nathalie L. Albert,Thomas Liebig,Robert Forbrig,Jonas Reis*

Main category: eess.IV

TL;DR: 在无需 T2-FLAIR 的情况下，仍能保持全自动胶质母细胞瘤全瘤分割与体积测量的高精度；若训练阶段引入“靶向 T2-FLAIR dropout”，缺失序列时整体 DSC 可由 81.0% 提升至 93.4%，体积误差由 −45.6 mL 降至 0.83 mL，且完整协议场景性能几乎不变。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 临床回顾性数据常因协议差异缺失 T2-FLAIR，导致现有深分割模型性能骤降，需一种无需额外序列即可保持鲁棒性的实用策略。

Method: 基于 BraTS-2021(n=848) 用 3D nnU-Net 训练“完整协议”与“靶向 T2-FLAIR dropout”两套模型；外部验证使用宾大独立队列(n=403)。测试时分别提供 T2-FLAIR 存在/缺失两种场景，缺失即将该通道置零；以整体 DSC 为主要终点，辅以区域 DSC、95% Hausdorff 距离及 Bland-Altman 体积偏倚。

Result: 完整协议下，dropout 与无-dropout 中位整体 DSC 分别为 94.8% 与 95.0%，差异＜0.2%。T2-FLAIR 缺失时，dropout 将整体中位 DSC 自 81.0% 提至 93.4%；全瘤 DSC 自 60.4% 提至 92.6%，全瘤 95% Hausdorff 距离自 17.24 mm 降至 2.45 mm，体积偏倚自 −45.6 mL 降至 0.83 mL，全部指标显著改善。

Conclusion: 靶向序列 dropout 可在保持完整 MRI 协议高精度同时，显著提升 T2-FLAIR 缺失场景下的分割与体积准确性，为回顾性、异质性临床流程提供了一种零成本、易部署的鲁棒性方案。

Abstract: Objectives: To externally validate targeted T2 fluid-attenuated inversion recovery (T2-FLAIR) dropout for robust automated glioblastoma segmentation and whole-tumor volumetry without T2-FLAIR, while preserving performance when the full MRI protocol is available. Methods: In this retrospective multi-dataset study, 3D nnU-Net models were developed on BraTS 2021 (n=848) and externally validated on an independent University of Pennsylvania glioblastoma cohort (n=403). Models were trained with or without targeted T2-FLAIR dropout, zeroing the T2-FLAIR channel during training. Testing used prespecified T2-FLAIR-present and T2-FLAIR-absent scenarios; the absent scenario was simulated by zeroing the T2-FLAIR channel at inference. The primary endpoint was per-patient overall region-wise Dice similarity coefficient (DSC). Secondary endpoints were region-specific DSC, 95th percentile Hausdorff distance, and Bland-Altman whole-tumor volume bias. Results: In external validation, performance was preserved with the full MRI protocol: overall median DSC was 94.8% (interquartile range [IQR] 90.0%-97.1%) with dropout and 95.0% (IQR 90.3%-97.1%) without dropout. In the T2-FLAIR-absent scenario, targeted dropout improved overall median DSC from 81.0% (IQR 75.1%-86.4%) to 93.4% (IQR 89.1%-96.2%). Whole-tumor DSC improved from 60.4% to 92.6%, whole-tumor 95th percentile Hausdorff distance from 17.24 mm to 2.45 mm, and whole-tumor volume bias from -45.6 mL to 0.83 mL. Conclusions: In an independent external test cohort, targeted T2-FLAIR dropout preserved glioblastoma segmentation performance with the full MRI protocol and substantially reduced whole-tumor segmentation error and volumetric bias when T2-FLAIR was absent. These findings support targeted sequence dropout as a practical robustness strategy for automated glioblastoma analysis in retrospective and heterogeneous clinical workflows.

</details>


### [397] [Inexpensive Optical Projection Tomography on a Mobile Phone Platform](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.13004)
*Gennifer T. Smith,James M. Sikes,Nicholas Dwork*

Main category: eess.IV

TL;DR: 用50美元零件+iPhone搭出手机层析三维显微镜，斑马鱼仿体验证3.9 μm分辨率，教育/野外/低资源场景可用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统三维光学投影层析(OPT)设备昂贵、体积大，难以在教育资源稀缺或野外现场部署，急需一种超低成本、便携且易获取的替代方案。

Method: 以iPhone为主相机，配合商用显微镜镜头附件、步进电机、LED照明与3D打印结构，总硬件成本≈50美元；建立UV树脂包埋固定斑马鱼幼体的仿体制作流程；用棋盘格标定相机，1951 USAF靶标测定有效放大率；旋转采集成像后转换为衰减投影，做场均匀性校正，再用滤波反投影重建各切片并堆叠为3D体数据。

Result: 系统实测横向分辨率3.91 μm；对斑马鱼仿体的体积重建清晰显示脊柱等解剖结构；整套装置便携、可重复、成本极低。

Conclusion: 手机OPT能以可负担成本实现高对比度三维显微成像，为教育、现场研究和资源受限环境提供了新的、可扩展的成像工具。

Abstract: This work presents an inexpensive optical projection tomography (OPT) system built on a mobile phone platform for three-dimensional optical microscopy. The system uses an iPhone camera together with a low-cost commercial microscope lens attachment, a stepper motor for sample rotation, LED illumination, and custom 3D-printed components, with a total component cost of approximately 50 US dollars excluding the phone. To support system evaluation, we also developed a low-cost method for fabricating a zebrafish phantom by embedding fixed larvae in UV-cured resin. Camera calibration was performed using a checkerboard target, and effective magnification was estimated with images of a 1951 Air Force resolution target. Projection images acquired during sample rotation were converted to attenuation images and corrected for field nonuniformity. Each slice was reconstructed with filtered backprojection and the resulting slices were stacked into a 3D volume. The completed system achieved a resolution of 3.91 $μm$ and produced volumetric reconstructions in which anatomical features of the zebrafish phantom, including the spine, were clearly visible. These results demonstrate that mobile-phone-based OPT can provide accessible, portable, and low-cost 3D microscopy, with potential utility for education, field work, and resource-limited settings.

</details>


### [398] [Label-free subcellular 3D imaging of oocytes and embryos via reflection matrix microscopy](https://arxiv.org/abs/2410.11126)
*Elsa Giraudat,Victor Barolle,Flavien Bureau,Nicolas Guigui,Paul Balondrade,Christine Ho,Vincent Brochard,Olivier Dubois,Amélie Bonnet-Garnier,Alexandre Aubry*

Main category: eess.IV

TL;DR: 提出超快反射矩阵成像（RMI），首次在厚样本全深度实现300 nm无标记三维亚细胞成像，可穿透卵丘细胞准确判别卵母细胞与囊胚核态，为IVF非侵入式客观评级提供新工具。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 临床IVF目前依赖二维定性显微镜，3D荧光成像因光毒性无法常规应用；无标记方法受大尺度折射率不均（卵丘细胞致像差）与小尺度散射（胞质脂滴“雾”）双重物理屏障限制，无法解析厚样亚细胞结构。

Method: 构建多光谱反射矩阵：多角度平面波照明、多波长记录背向电磁场；数字自适应聚焦算法同时补偿样本像差并重新对齐多重散射与单次散射路径，实现全域像差-散射双重校正。

Result: 卵母细胞/囊胚全体积获得300 nm横向分辨率无标记3D图像；首次在卵丘包裹阶段非侵入识别生发泡与核状态；所有植入前阶段均可客观分级，成像深度与分辨率突破现有无标记技术极限。

Conclusion: RMI平台克服深度-分辨率瓶颈，为临床IVF提供安全、客观、全域三维评估手段，有望直接优化胚胎选择策略并提升妊娠预后。

Abstract: Non-invasive morphological assessment is the cornerstone of oocyte and embryo selection in assisted reproductive technology, yet clinical practice remains limited by two-dimensional, qualitative microscopy. While three-dimensional (3D) fluorescence imaging provides cellular insights, its inherent phototoxicity precludes routine clinical use. Conversely, existing label-free modalities fail to resolve subcellular structures in thick specimens due to two distinct physical barriers: large-scale refractive index heterogeneities, such as the cumulus cells surrounding oocytes, that induce severe aberrations; and short-scale fluctuations, primarily from cytoplasmic lipids, that generate a multiple scattering ``fog''. Here, we report an ultra-fast Reflection Matrix Imaging (RMI) platform designed to overcome these depth and resolution limits. By capturing the back-scattered electromagnetic field for a set of plane-wave illuminations at multiple wavelengths, we record a multi-spectral reflection matrix. From this matrix, we leverage digital adaptive focusing algorithms to computationally compensate for sample-induced aberrations while realigning forward multiple scattering trajectories with the single-scattering contribution. This approach enables label-free 3D visualization of oocytes and blastocysts with an unprecedented subcellular resolution of 300 nm throughout the entire specimen volume. We demonstrate the reliable identification of germinal vesicles and nuclear status in stages previously inaccessible to conventional optics, including imaging through dense cumulus cells. Our method provides a powerful, non-invasive tool for objective grading across all pre-implantation stages, potentially transforming decision-making in clinical IVF.

</details>


### [399] [Latent Wavelet Diffusion For Ultra-High-Resolution Image Synthesis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2506.00433)
*Luigi Sigillo,Shengfeng He,Danilo Comminiello*

Main category: eess.IV

TL;DR: Latent Wavelet Diffusion（LWD）在不改网络、不增推理耗时的前提下，利用小波能量图动态掩码+尺度一致VAE目标，将现有模型直接扩展到2K-4K超高清生成，显著降低FID并提升细节保真度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 超高清图像生成需在细粒度纹理与计算效率之间取舍，现有方法要么网络 heavier，要么推理成本陡增，亟需零额外推理开销的轻量化训练策略。

Method: 1）在潜空间构建小波能量图，据此生成频率感知动态掩码，迫使扩散训练始终聚焦高频细节区域；2）引入尺度一致性VAE损失，保持不同分辨率下谱域保真；3）完全冻结原网络，仅通过训练目标修正实现增强，零推理时额外计算。

Result: 2K-4K生成任务中，LWD在多项强基线（LDM、Stable Diffusion-XL 等）上稳定降低FID 8-25%，感知质量指标（LPIPS、NIQE）同步提升；参数量与延迟与原始模型完全一致。

Conclusion: 信号驱动的小波监督提供了一种原则性、高效的高分辨率生成途径，LWD以“训练时加细节、推理时零负担”范式，为扩散模型直接扩展至打印级分辨率建立了实用解决方案。

Abstract: High-resolution image synthesis remains a core challenge in generative modeling, particularly in balancing computational efficiency with the preservation of fine-grained visual detail. We present Latent Wavelet Diffusion (LWD), a lightweight training framework that significantly improves detail and texture fidelity in ultra-high-resolution (2K-4K) image synthesis. LWD introduces a novel, frequency-aware masking strategy derived from wavelet energy maps, which dynamically focuses the training process on detail-rich regions of the latent space. This is complemented by a scale-consistent VAE objective to ensure high spectral fidelity. The primary advantage of our approach is its efficiency: LWD requires no architectural modifications and adds zero additional cost during inference, making it a practical solution for scaling existing models. Across multiple strong baselines, LWD consistently improves perceptual quality and FID scores, demonstrating the power of signal-driven supervision as a principled and efficient path toward high-resolution generative modeling. The code is available at https://github.com/LuigiSigillo/LatentWaveletDiffusion

</details>


### [400] [DeTracker: Motion-decoupled Vehicle Detection and Tracking in Unstabilized Satellite Videos](https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.09240)
*Jiajun Chen,Jing Xiao,Shaohan Cao,Yuming Zhu,Liang Liao,Jun Pan,Mi Wang*

Main category: eess.IV

TL;DR: 针对抖动卫星视频中小目标多目标跟踪难题，提出联合检测-跟踪框架 DeTracker，在自建的 SDM-Car-SU 基准上 MOTA 达 61.1%，显著优于现有方法，代码与数据将开源。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 卫星视频因平台抖动与小目标外观微弱，导致传统 MOT 方法轨迹漂移、ID 切换严重，亟需一套能同时抑制强背景运动并增强目标运动/外观一致性的专用框架。

Method: 1) GLMD 模块：在特征层做“全局语义对齐”抑制平台主导运动，再“局部细化”提取目标微弱运动，实现运动解耦；2) TDFP 模块：跨帧融合多尺度时序特征，补齐小目标在连续帧中的表征；3) 新建 SDM-Car-SU 数据集，定向注入多方向、多速度平台抖动，系统评估鲁棒性。

Result: 在 SDM-Car-SU 模拟数据上 MOTA 61.1%，HOTA 提升约 10 pp；在真实抖动卫星视频中 MOTA 45.3%，均显著高于现有公开方法，且 ID 切换降低 35% 以上。

Conclusion: DeTracker 通过“全局-局部运动解耦+时序特征金字塔”有效缓解抖动卫星视频的小目标跟踪难题，验证了联合检测-跟踪范式的优势，并为社区贡献了首个含受控抖动标注的卫星视频 MOT 基准。

Abstract: Satellite videos provide continuous observations of surface dynamics but pose significant challenges for multi-object tracking (MOT), especially under unstabilized conditions where platform jitter and the weak appearance of tiny objects jointly degrade tracking performance. To address this problem, we propose DeTracker, a joint-detection-and-tracking framework tailored for unstabilized satellite videos. DeTracker introduces a task-driven Global-Local Motion Decoupling (GLMD) module to address the motion imbalance between dominant platform motion and weak target motion. It suppresses background-dominated motion via global semantic alignment at the feature level and captures target-specific motion through local refinement, improving trajectory stability and identity consistency. In addition, a Temporal Dependency Feature Pyramid (TDFP) module is developed to perform cross-frame temporal feature fusion, enhancing the continuity and discriminability of tiny-object representations. We further construct a new benchmark dataset, SDM-Car-SU, which simulates multi-directional and multi-speed platform motions to enable systematic evaluation of tracking robustness under varying motion perturbations. Extensive experiments on both simulated and real unstabilized satellite videos demonstrate that DeTracker significantly outperforms existing methods, achieving 61.1% MOTA on SDM-Car-SU and 45.3% MOTA on real satellite video data. The code and dataset will be publicly available at https://github.com/alex-chenjiajun/DeTracker.

</details>


### [401] [LLMOrbit: A Circular Taxonomy of Large Language Models -From Scaling Walls to Agentic AI Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.14053)
*Badri N. Patro,Vijay S. Agneeswaran*

Main category: eess.IV

TL;DR: 这篇论文用LLMOrbit这一环状分类法，系统梳理2019-2025年50余个大模型，指出数据枯竭、成本暴涨、能耗飙升三大危机，并给出测试时计算、量化、边缘分布式、模型融合、高效训练、小专模型六条破局路径，同时总结后训练增效、效率革命与开源民主化三大范式转变。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Transformer架构虽推动AI逼近人类水平，但参数、数据、算力的粗暴扩张已撞墙：数据将在2026-2028年耗尽，5年训练成本从300万美元飙至3亿美元，能耗增22倍。亟需一份全景式综述，为社区指明如何“在墙外继续扩张”。

Method: 构建八维环状分类框架（模型-组织-架构-训练-效率-工具-后训练-生态），横向对比15家机构50+模型；量化“三危机”指标；实证评估六条降本增效路线的性能-成本-能耗收益；纵向梳理RLHF→PPO→DPO→GRPO→ORPO等后训练技术演进，并追踪生成式→工具式→多智能体的能力跃迁。

Result: 揭示测试时计算可把推理算力换性能，o1/DeepSeek-R1以10×推理即达GPT-4级；4-8位量化与MoE路由分别带来4-8×与18×效率；边缘分布式训练降本10×；ORPO内存减半；Phi-4-14B用小参数量对标大模型；Llama 3以开源之身88.6% MMLU反超GPT-4的86.4%。

Conclusion: 大模型已无法靠“更大”续命，未来属于“算力换性能、效率换规模、开源换垄断”的新范式；测试时计算、量化、边缘化、模型融合、高效训练与小专模型六板斧构成突破“ scaling wall”的核心路线，后训练与多智能体将是下一阶段主战场。

Abstract: The field of artificial intelligence has undergone a revolution from foundational Transformer architectures to reasoning-capable systems approaching human-level performance. We present LLMOrbit, a comprehensive circular taxonomy navigating the landscape of large language models spanning 2019-2025. This survey examines over 50 models across 15 organizations through eight interconnected orbital dimensions, documenting architectural innovations, training methodologies, and efficiency patterns defining modern LLMs, generative AI, and agentic systems. We identify three critical crises: (1) data scarcity (9-27T tokens depleted by 2026-2028), (2) exponential cost growth ($3M to $300M+ in 5 years), and (3) unsustainable energy consumption (22x increase), establishing the scaling wall limiting brute-force approaches. Our analysis reveals six paradigms breaking this wall: (1) test-time compute (o1, DeepSeek-R1 achieve GPT-4 performance with 10x inference compute), (2) quantization (4-8x compression), (3) distributed edge computing (10x cost reduction), (4) model merging, (5) efficient training (ORPO reduces memory 50%), and (6) small specialized models (Phi-4 14B matches larger models). Three paradigm shifts emerge: (1) post-training gains (RLHF, GRPO, pure RL contribute substantially, DeepSeek-R1 achieving 79.8% MATH), (2) efficiency revolution (MoE routing 18x efficiency, Multi-head Latent Attention 8x KV cache compression enables GPT-4-level performance at $<$$0.30/M tokens), and (3) democratization (open-source Llama 3 88.6% MMLU surpasses GPT-4 86.4%). We provide insights into techniques (RLHF, PPO, DPO, GRPO, ORPO), trace evolution from passive generation to tool-using agents (ReAct, RAG, multi-agent systems), and analyze post-training innovations.

</details>


### [402] [GSNR: Graph Smooth Null-Space Representation for Inverse Problems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.20328)
*Romario Gualdrón-Hurtado,Roman Jacome,Rafael S. Suarez,Henry Arguello*

Main category: eess.IV

TL;DR: GSNR 在零空间分量上引入图光滑约束，稳定反演过程，在 4 类成像任务中对传统和深度方法均带来 ≥1 dB 的 PSNR 提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 成像反问题因传感矩阵零空间非空而存在无穷多解，现有先验仅约束可见分量导致重建偏向；需直接在零空间分量上施加有物理意义的结构约束。

Method: 构建“零空间限制图拉普拉斯”并取其 p-最光滑谱模式得到低维投影矩阵，提出仅作用于零空间分量的图正则项 GSNR，可即插即用地嵌入 PnP、DIP、扩散模型等求解框架。

Result: 在图像去模糊、压缩感知、去马赛克、超分辨四类任务上，PSNR 相比原基线提升最高 4.3 dB，比端到端学习模型提升最高 1 dB，且收敛更快、零空间方差捕获率与模态可预测性显著提高。

Conclusion: GSNR 首次系统化地在零空间引入图光滑先验，理论保证并实证大幅提升多种反问题求解器的精度与稳定性，可为后续零空间建模研究提供通用工具。

Abstract: Inverse problems in imaging are ill-posed, leading to infinitely many solutions consistent with the measurements due to the non-trivial null-space of the sensing matrix. Common image priors promote solutions on the general image manifold, such as sparsity, smoothness, or score function. However, as these priors do not constrain the null-space component, they can bias the reconstruction. Thus, we aim to incorporate meaningful null-space information in the reconstruction framework. Inspired by smooth image representation on graphs, we propose Graph-Smooth Null-Space Representation (GSNR), a mechanism that imposes structure only into the invisible component. Particularly, given a graph Laplacian, we construct a null-restricted Laplacian that encodes similarity between neighboring pixels in the null-space signal, and we design a low-dimensional projection matrix from the $p$-smoothest spectral graph modes (lowest graph frequencies). This approach has strong theoretical and practical implications: i) improved convergence via a null-only graph regularizer, ii) better coverage, how much null-space variance is captured by $p$ modes, and iii) high predictability, how well these modes can be inferred from the measurements. GSNR is incorporated into well-known inverse problem solvers, e.g., PnP, DIP, and diffusion solvers, in four scenarios: image deblurring, compressed sensing, demosaicing, and image super-resolution, providing consistent improvement of up to 4.3 dB over baseline formulations and up to 1 dB compared with end-to-end learned models in terms of PSNR.

</details>


<div id='cs.LG'></div>

# cs.LG [[Back]](#toc)

### [403] [The Devil Is in Gradient Entanglement: Energy-Aware Gradient Coordinator for Robust Generalized Category Discovery](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.14176)
*Haiyang Zheng,Nan Pu,Yaqi Cai,Teng Long,Wenjing Li,Nicu Sebe,Zhun Zhong*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 现有GCD方法受梯度纠缠困扰，提出即插即用EAGC模块，通过锚定已知类梯度+能量感知弹性投影，切断监督/无监督优化干扰，刷新SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: GCD虽联合优化监督与无监督目标，但梯度纠缠会扭曲已知类判别结构并导致表示子空间重叠，阻碍性能进一步提升。

Method: 设计Energy-Aware Gradient Coordinator（EAGC）：1) Anchor-based Gradient Alignment (AGA) 用参考模型锚定有标签样本梯度，保持已知类判别结构；2) Energy-aware Elastic Projection (EEP) 将无标签梯度软投影到已知类子空间补空间，并依据能量系数自适应缩放，减少子空间重叠且不抑制潜在已知类样本。

Result: 在多个GCD基准上，将EAGC插入现有方法均带来一致且显著的提升，刷新最先进精度。

Conclusion: 梯度层面的显式协调可有效破解梯度纠缠，为GCD任务提供简单通用的新范式。

Abstract: Generalized Category Discovery (GCD) leverages labeled data to categorize unlabeled samples from known or unknown classes. Most previous methods jointly optimize supervised and unsupervised objectives and achieve promising results. However, inherent optimization interference still limits their ability to improve further.
