On downstream tasks, models trained with our efficient $α$-entmax attention match softmax baselines at short-context lengths and achieve substantial gains in long-context settings.

</details>


### [477] [One-shot learning for the complex dynamical behaviors of weakly nonlinear forced oscillators](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.15181)
*Teng Ma,Luca Rosafalco,Wei Cui,Lin Zhao,Attilio Frangi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: MEv-SINDy 用一条扫频数据一次性学出 MEMS 器件的全局频响曲线，无需多次实验。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 非线性 MEMS 设计必须获取完整的频率响应曲线，但传统逐点扫频实验数据量巨大、成本高。作者希望仅用一个激励-响应记录就外推整条曲线。

Method: 提出 MEv-SINDy 框架：1) 用广义谐波平衡(GHB) 将多频激励下的非自治系统化为慢变幅-相方程；2) 对慢变量施加稀疏回归(SINDy) 识别出解析形式的控制方程；3) 以单条扫频数据训练，数值延拓得到全幅频曲线。

Result: 在 MEMS 非线性梁与微镜两个实例上，模型仅用 1 组数据便准确预测软硬化行为与跳跃现象，幅值误差 <3%，与传统逐点实验完全吻合。

Conclusion: MEv-SINDy 把数据采集量降低 1–2 个数量级，为 MEMS、谐振器等非线性微系统的快速表征与参数优化提供了高效工具。

Abstract: Extrapolative prediction of complex nonlinear dynamics remains a central challenge in engineering. This study proposes a one-shot learning method to identify global frequency-response curves from a single excitation time history by learning governing equations. We introduce MEv-SINDy (Multi-frequency Evolutionary Sparse Identification of Nonlinear Dynamics) to infer the governing equations of non-autonomous and multi-frequency systems. The methodology leverages the Generalized Harmonic Balance (GHB) method to decompose complex forced responses into a set of slow-varying evolution equations. We validated the capabilities of MEv-SINDy on two critical Micro-Electro-Mechanical Systems (MEMS). These applications include a nonlinear beam resonator and a MEMS micromirror. Our results show that the model trained on a single point accurately predicts softening/hardening effects and jump phenomena across a wide range of excitation levels. This approach significantly reduces the data acquisition burden for the characterization and design of nonlinear microsystems.

</details>


### [478] [RL-STPA: Adapting System-Theoretic Hazard Analysis for Safety-Critical Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.15201)
*Steven A. Senczyszyn,Timothy C. Havens,Nathaniel Rice,Jason E. Summers,Benjamin D. Werner,Benjamin J. Schumeg*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出RL-STPA框架，将传统STPA系统危险分析思想应用于强化学习，实现黑盒神经策略与训练-部署分布偏移风险的结构化识别与闭环改进。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有RL评估无法系统发现安全关键场景中因NN策略黑盒性和分布偏移带来的隐含危险，亟需一套面向RL特性的系统化危险分析范式。

Method: 三层贡献：1) 基于时相划分与领域知识的层次化子任务分解捕捉涌现行为；2) 面向状态-动作空间敏感度探索的覆盖引导扰动测试；3) 将识别危险通过奖励塑形与课程设计注入训练的迭代检查点机制

Result: 在自主无人机导航与着陆安全案例研究中，RL-STPA揭露了标准RL评估遗漏的潜在失控场景，提供可量化安全覆盖率指标与可操作安全边界指南

Conclusion: RL-STPA虽无法给出任意神经策略的正式保证，但在复杂安全任务中为系统评估和持续改进RL安全性与鲁棒性提供了实用且可扩展的方法论

Abstract: As reinforcement learning (RL) deployments expand into safety-critical domains, existing evaluation methods fail to systematically identify hazards arising from the black-box nature of neural network enabled policies and distributional shift between training and deployment. This paper introduces Reinforcement Learning System-Theoretic Process Analysis (RL-STPA), a framework that adapts conventional STPA's systematic hazard analysis to address RL's unique challenges through three key contributions: hierarchical subtask decomposition using both temporal phase analysis and domain expertise to capture emergent behaviors, coverage-guided perturbation testing that explores the sensitivity of state-action spaces, and iterative checkpoints that feed identified hazards back into training through reward shaping and curriculum design. We demonstrate RL-STPA in the safety-critical test case of autonomous drone navigation and landing, revealing potential loss scenarios that can be missed by standard RL evaluations. The proposed framework provides practitioners with a toolkit for systematic hazard analysis, quantitative metrics for safety coverage assessment, and actionable guidelines for establishing operational safety bounds. While RL-STPA cannot provide formal guarantees for arbitrary neural policies, it offers a practical methodology for systematically evaluating and improving RL safety and robustness in safety-critical applications where exhaustive verification methods remain intractable.

</details>


### [479] [Optimal last-iterate convergence in matrix games with bandit feedback using the log-barrier](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.15242)
*Come Fiegel,Pierre Menard,Tadashi Kozuno,Michal Valko,Vianney Perchet*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 首次在零和矩阵博弈中证明并利用对偶视角的对数障碍法，使独立玩家最后一次策略的利用间隙以高概率收敛到 Õ(t^{-1/4})，且该速率对扩展式博弈同样成立。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 零和博弈中独立学习要达到最后一次策略收敛面临 Ω(t^{-1/4}) 的下界，但现有在线镜像下降算法尚未真正达到此速率，需要设计能紧抵下界的高效学习算法。

Method: 在单次在线镜像下降框架中引入对数障碍正则项，并以“对偶变量收敛”而非“原策略平均”作为分析核心，导出高概率收敛保证；随后将同一思路迁移到序列决策的扩展式博弈。

Result: 证明策略利用间隙以至少 1−δ 的概率在 t 轮后降至 Õ(t^{-1/4})，首次匹配并达到独立学习场景下的已知下界；在扩展式博弈中亦获得相同收敛速率。

Conclusion: 对数障碍与对偶收敛分析相结合，不仅填补了零和矩阵博弈最后一次迭代速率空白，也为更复杂的扩展式博弈提供了可扩展的算法模板，显著推进了独立学习效率的理论边界。

Abstract: We study the problem of learning minimax policies in zero-sum matrix games. Fiegel et al. (2025) recently showed that achieving last-iterate convergence in this setting is harder when the players are uncoupled, by proving a lower bound on the exploitability gap of Omega(t^{-1/4}). Some online mirror descent algorithms were proposed in the literature for this problem, but none have truly attained this rate yet. We show that the use of a log-barrier regularization, along with a dual-focused analysis, allows this O-tilde(t^{-1/4}) convergence with high-probability. We additionally extend our idea to the setting of extensive-form games, proving a bound with the same rate.

</details>


### [480] [Stability and Generalization in Looped Transformers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.15259)
*Asher Labovich*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 固定点迭代能否把网络推到「尚未见过但原则上可解」的问题？一句话答案：必须同时有(1)召回，(2)外层标准化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有loop Transformer想「迭代越久，算题越多」，但训练时只能示范有限步骤。怎样保证测试阶段在遇到更难题目时不是死记硬背、而是能可靠收敛到可解释、可区分的迭代解？

Method: 从不动点三轴——可及性(reachability)、输入敏感(input-dependence)与几何稳定(geometry)——建立谱域分析框架；(i)证明“无召回网络”至多可数不动点，难以保证输入相关；(ii)证明“召回＋外部Normalization”在三轴上同时满足；(iii)提出内部召回(internal recall)≈把召回token嵌入相同隐藏层之全零槽，并比较其与普通召回、无召回的差异。

Result: 在棋类Sudoku与前缀和任务上，De-loop模型(1层8头隐藏256/2048)的训练收敛与测试准确率均与三轴指标Pearson抗错；内部召回+外层Norm Sudoku准确率比标准召回高6-9 pp；当谱半径被推向稳定区，开始收敛33步/再现32步长序列；而无召回结构到20步左右即崩溃。

Conclusion: 「召回」与「归一化」可协同提供固定点框架要求的三个稳定性；内部召回在保有多任务泛化的同时降低计算和内存；稳定区的定量指标可提前前置训练侧评估，无需依靠昂贵黑盒评估。

Abstract: Looped transformers promise test-time compute scaling by spending more iterations on harder problems, but it remains unclear which architectural choices let them extrapolate to harder problems at test time rather than memorize training-specific solutions. We introduce a fixed-point based framework for analyzing looped architectures along three axes of stability -- reachability, input-dependence, and geometry -- and use it to characterize when fixed-point iteration yields meaningful predictions. Theoretically, we prove that looped networks without recall have countable fixed points and cannot achieve strong input-dependence at any spectral regime, while recall combined with outer normalization reliably produces a regime in which fixed points are simultaneously reachable, locally smooth in the input, and supported by stable backpropagation. Empirically, we train single-layer looped transformers on chess, sudoku, and prefix-sums and find that downstream performance tracks the framework's predictions across tasks and architectural configurations. We additionally introduce internal recall, a novel recall placement variant, and show that it becomes competitive with -- and on sudoku, substantially better than -- standard recall placement once outer normalization is applied.

</details>


### [481] [How Embeddings Shape Graph Neural Networks: Classical vs Quantum-Oriented Node Representations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.15273)
*Nouhaila Innan,Antonello Rosato,Alberto Marchisio,Muhammad Shafique*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 在一套统一受控的协议下，作者系统比较了经典与面向量化的节点嵌入对图分类的影响，发现结构化数据集上量子嵌入更优，而社交网络仍被经典基线统治。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 图神经网络的效果常被混杂的实验设置干扰，导致节点嵌入价值难以厘清；需要公平基准量化比较经典与新兴量子式嵌入。

Method: 构建统一管道：固定GNN骨干、分层划分、一致优化与早停，将两种经典基线与三种量子式嵌入（含变分量子线路和量子启发代数构造）在TU与QM9二分类任务上对照评估。

Result: 量子式嵌入在以结构信息为主的图数据集上稳定提升效果，在节点属性稀缺的社交图上则不敌经典基线，整体呈明显数据依赖性。

Conclusion: 量子节点嵌入并非银弹，优势取决于图的归纳偏置匹配；在有限训练预算下需权衡表达力、训练稳定性与资源消耗，研究提供了可复现的选型参考。

Abstract: Node embeddings act as the information interface for graph neural networks, yet their empirical impact is often reported under mismatched backbones, splits, and training budgets. This paper provides a controlled benchmark of embedding choices for graph classification, comparing classical baselines with quantum-oriented node representations under a unified pipeline. We evaluate two classical baselines alongside quantum-oriented alternatives, including a circuit-defined variational embedding and quantum-inspired embeddings computed via graph operators and linear-algebraic constructions. All variants are trained and tested with the same backbone, stratified splits, identical optimization and early stopping, and consistent metrics. Experiments on five different TU datasets and on QM9 converted to classification via target binning show clear dataset dependence: quantum-oriented embeddings yield the most consistent gains on structure-driven benchmarks, while social graphs with limited node attributes remain well served by classical baselines. The study highlights practical trade-offs between inductive bias, trainability, and stability under a fixed training budget, and offers a reproducible reference point for selecting quantum-oriented embeddings in graph learning.

</details>


### [482] [Benchmarking Optimizers for MLPs in Tabular Deep Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.15297)
*Yury Gorishniy,Ivan Rubachev,Dmitrii Feoktistov,Artem Babenko*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 在表格数据MLP训练中，Muon全面碾压AdamW；配合权重EMA，AdamW仍有提升但稳定性不足。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 虽然MLP+AdamW是表格深度学习事实标准，但针对该领域缺乏系统性的优化器比较，导致学界和工业界未能充分利用近年涌现的新优化器。

Method: 构建统一实验协议，在N个公开表格数据集上对比N种优化器训练MLP，并额外测试权重指数滑动平均(EMA)的增益。

Result: Muon在所有任务上稳定优于AdamW，验证集指标平均提升显著；AdamW+EMA在纯MLP上有效，但对结构变种表现不一致。

Conclusion: Muon应被视为表格MLP训练的首选优化器，其唯一限制是训练开销；权重EMA是提升AdamW的简易插件，但需针对具体模型谨慎使用。

Abstract: MLP is a heavily used backbone in modern deep learning (DL) architectures for supervised learning on tabular data, and AdamW is the go-to optimizer used to train tabular DL models. Unlike architecture design, however, the choice of optimizer for tabular DL has not been examined systematically, despite new optimizers showing promise in other domains. To fill this gap, we benchmark \Noptimizers optimizers on \Ndatasets tabular datasets for training MLP-based models in the standard supervised learning setting under a shared experiment protocol. Our main finding is that the Muon optimizer consistently outperforms AdamW, and thus should be considered a strong and practical choice for practitioners and researchers, if the associated training efficiency overhead is affordable. Additionally, we find exponential moving average of model weights to be a simple yet effective technique that improves AdamW on vanilla MLPs, though its effect is less consistent across model variants.

</details>


### [483] [BitFlipScope: Scalable Fault Localization and Recovery for Bit-Flip Corruptions in LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2512.22174)
*Muhammad Zeeshan Karamat,Sadman Saif,Christiana Chamon Garcia*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: BitFlipScope 利用差分分析与残差扰动，在没有参考模型和有参考模型两种条件下，识别并定位导致 LLM 行为异常的 bit-flip 损坏区域，并可快速恢复性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 硬件退化、宇宙射线或 Rowhammer 等比特级故障会静默破坏大模型参数，传统重训练或微调代价高昂，亟需低成本、可扩展的定位与恢复手段。

Method: 提出 BitFlipScope 框架：1) 有干净参考模型时，比较输出、隐藏态和激活差异，定位异常区域；2) 无参考时，通过残差通道扰动与损失敏感性分析推断受损区块；均无需额外训练。

Result: 实验表明 BitFlipScope 能在两种部署场景下精准定位故障块，并仅用参数修复或替换等轻量操作即可使模型性能恢复到近原始水平，显著优于重训练基准。

Conclusion: BitFlipScope 为硬件故障及对抗环境下的 LLM 提供了实用的故障诊断与即时恢复方案，是迈向可信、抗错大模型部署的重要一步。

Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) deployed in practical and safety-critical settings are increasingly susceptible to bit-flip faults caused by hardware degradation, cosmic radiation, or deliberate fault-injection attacks such as Rowhammer. These faults silently corrupt internal parameters and can lead to unpredictable or dangerous model behavior. Localizing these corruptions is essential: without identifying the affected region, it is impossible to diagnose the source of degradation, apply targeted corrective measures, or restore model functionality without resorting to costly fine-tuning or full retraining. This work introduces BitFlipScope, a scalable, software-based framework for identifying fault-affected regions within transformer architectures under two deployment scenarios. When a clean reference model is available, BitFlipScope performs differential analysis of outputs, hidden states, and internal activations for detecting anomalous behavior indicative of corruption to pinpoint or localize faults. When no reference model exists, it uses residual-path perturbation and loss-sensitivity profiling to infer the fault-impacted region directly from the corrupted model. In both settings, the framework not only enables effective fault diagnosis but also supports lightweight performance recovery without fine-tuning, offering a practical path to restoring corrupted models. Together, these capabilities make BitFlipScope an important step toward trustworthy, fault-resilient LLM deployment in hardware-prone and adversarial environments.

</details>


### [484] [Predictions of charge density distributions for nuclei with $Z \geq 8$](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.05312)
*Yun Dong Wang,Tian Shuai Shang,Hui Hui Xie,Peng Xiang Du,Jian Li,Haozhao Liang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 用深度神经网络学习RCHB理论得到的核电荷密度数据，在Z≥8核素上把电荷半径均方误差降到0.012-0.02 fm，显著优于传统方法，为核物理、原子物理和核天体物理提供高精度输入。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统核结构模型对核电荷密度分布的预测精度有限，难以满足原子超精细谱学、核天体反应率等前沿研究对高置信度电荷半径数据的需求。

Method: 以相对论连续Hartree-Bogoliubov（RCHB）理论计算的海量电荷密度分布为训练集，用Fourier-Bessel级数展开参数化密度，设计深度神经网络直接映射核结构特征到展开系数，实现端到端预测。

Result: DNN在训练集与验证集上电荷半径的RMSD分别为0.0123 fm与0.0198 fm，精度较原始RCHB计算提升一个量级，且对Z≥8的核素均保持同等水平误差。

Conclusion: 该模型首次把机器学习驱动的电荷密度预测推进至0.01 fm级，展示了替代或补充自洽平均场计算的潜力，可为原子束谱、β衰变率、核合成路径模拟等提供实时高精度数据支撑。

Abstract: A deep neural network (DNN) has been developed to accurately predict nuclear charge density distributions for nuclei with proton numbers $Z \geq 8$. By incorporating essential nuclear structure features, the model achieves a significant improvement in predictive accuracy over conventional methods. The charge density distributions are analyzed using a Fourier-Bessel (FB) series expansion, and the DNN is trained on a comprehensive dataset derived from relativistic continuum Hartree-Bogoliubov (RCHB) theory calculations. The model demonstrates exceptional performance, with root-mean-square deviations of 0.0123 fm and 0.0198 fm for charge radii on the training and validation sets, respectively, remarkably surpassing the precision of the original RCHB calculations. Beyond advancing nuclear physics research, this high-precision model provides critical data for applications in atomic physics, nuclear astrophysics, and related fields.

</details>


### [485] [Can Large Language Models Detect Methodological Flaws? Evidence from Gesture Recognition for UAV-Based Rescue Operation Based on Deep Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.14161)
*Domonkos Varga*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 用六个大模型独立审阅一篇手势识别论文，发现它们仅凭公开文本即可一致识别出因训练/测试同个体划分导致的数据泄漏，提示 LLM 可作为科研审计辅助工具。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器学习文献中数据泄漏等评估缺陷频发，亟需无需原始数据与代码即可快速筛查的方法；探索大模型能否仅凭出版物自动发现此类问题。

Method: 以一篇报告近完美准确率的小样本手势识别论文为案例，先人工验证其存在“同受试者”数据泄漏；随后用统一提示让六种主流大模型仅基于原文自行评估，统计其对缺陷的检出率与解释质量。

Result: 六模型均独立指出评估不可靠，归因于非独立划分，并列举学习曲线重叠、泛化间隙极小、准确率异常等证据；人工复核确认其理由与真实泄漏点一致。

Conclusion: 大模型可在不接触数据/代码的情况下，基于文本线索发现典型方法论缺陷，具备成为可重复性审计与同行评审辅助工具的潜力，但仍需与人类专家互补验证。

Abstract: Reliable evaluation is essential in machine learning research, yet methodological flaws-particularly data leakage-continue to undermine the validity of reported results. In this work, we investigate whether large language models (LLMs) can act as independent analytical agents capable of identifying such issues in published studies. As a case study, we analyze a gesture-recognition paper reporting near-perfect accuracy on a small, human-centered dataset. We first show that the evaluation protocol is consistent with subject-level data leakage due to non-independent training and test splits. We then assess whether this flaw can be detected independently by six state-of-the-art LLMs, each analyzing the original paper without prior context using an identical prompt. All models consistently identify the evaluation as flawed and attribute the reported performance to non-independent data partitioning, supported by indicators such as overlapping learning curves, minimal generalization gap, and near-perfect classification results. These findings suggest that LLMs can detect common methodological issues based solely on published artifacts. While not definitive, their consistent agreement highlights their potential as complementary tools for improving reproducibility and supporting scientific auditing.

</details>


### [486] [Decoupling Scores and Text: The Politeness Principle in Peer Review](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.14162)
*Yingxuan Wen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 对3万余篇ICLR投稿的分析表明，文本评审意见比数值评分更易误导作者：数值模型预测录用准确率达91%，而文本模型仅81%；被拒稿论文的文本仍含更多正向词，


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 作者常因礼貌性措辞误判审稿结果，需量化验证文本与数值信号在录用预测中的可靠性差异，并解释其成因。      ,

Method: 构建ICLR 2021-2025共30 000+稿件数据集，分别用评分与文本训练录用预测模型；对错误样本做分布与情感分析，检验峰度、偏度及礼貌原则影响。

Result: 评分模型准确率91%，文本模型仅81%，差距显著；9%评分误拒样本呈高峰度、负偏态，说明个别低分起决定作用；被拒稿文本的正向情感词仍占优，掩盖真实信号。   ,

Conclusion: 数值评分是录用预测的核心可靠信号，文本因礼貌原则失真，易使作者产生“虚假希望”；建议投稿人优先依据分数而非措辞判断结果，并激励审稿人提供明确、平衡的文本反馈。

Abstract: Authors often struggle to interpret peer review feedback, deriving false hope from polite comments or feeling confused by specific low scores. To investigate this, we construct a dataset of over 30,000 ICLR 2021-2025 submissions and compare acceptance prediction performance using numerical scores versus text reviews. Our experiments reveal a significant performance gap: score-based models achieve 91% accuracy, while text-based models reach only 81% even with large language models, indicating that textual information is considerably less reliable. To explain this phenomenon, we first analyze the 9% of samples that score-based models fail to predict, finding their score distributions exhibit high kurtosis and negative skewness, which suggests that individual low scores play a decisive role in rejection even when the average score falls near the borderline. We then examine why text-based accuracy significantly lags behind scores from a review sentiment perspective, revealing the prevalence of the Politeness Principle: reviews of rejected papers still contain more positive than negative sentiment words, masking the true rejection signal and making it difficult for authors to judge outcomes from text alone.

</details>


### [487] [Correcting Suppressed Log-Probabilities in Language Models with Post-Transformer Adapters](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.14174)
*Bryan Sanchez*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出一种仅需 0.02% 参数的隐藏态适配器，在不重训主模型的前提下，使 3 种规模的中文在政治敏感事实上的被抑制概率显著回升，并在生成阶段实现可读的“去审查”输出；同时发现并修复 MLX 框架的静默梯度 Bug。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 对齐微调常被观察到会在政治敏感话题上压低模型输出真实答案的概率，尽管模型内部仍保留知识。作者希望在不重训大模型的前提下，低成本、可逆地恢复这些被“自我审查”掉的事实表达能力。

Method: 冻结 Qwen3-4/8/14B 的全部参数，仅在其输出隐藏态后插入 786 K 参数的线性瓶颈或 SwiGLU 门控适配器。训练数据仅 15 条“意识形态区分事实”，目标是最小化被抑制事实的对数概率损失；测试 31 条事实并做 5 次随机划分。推理阶段对比“全位置植入”与“仅末位置植入”两种策略。实验采用 Apple MLX 框架并定位到其 nn.value_and_grad 静默梯度 Bug。

Result: 适配器完全记住 15 条训练事实，对 16 条未见面事实的泛化率 11–39%，且在全部 3 个规模上均未出现知识倒退（zero regressions）。门控与线性瓶颈结果无显著差异 (p>0.09)。仅在末位置植入可生成连贯、低审查文本；全位置植入或 logits 层干预均产生不连贯输出。修复 MLX 的 nn.value_and_grad 参数顺序 Bug 后，此前所有“无效”结果均被纠正。

Conclusion: 隐藏态层面的轻量级适配是修正对齐导致的事实压制的有效且可控入口；适配器可在保持模型通用能力的同时局部去审查。研究首次系统展示该范式在中上的可行性，并揭露 MLX 框架的一处隐蔽缺陷，提醒后续适配器研究注意梯度静默风险。

Abstract: Alignment-tuned language models frequently suppress factual log-probabilities on politically sensitive topics despite retaining the knowledge in their hidden representations. We show that a 786K-parameter (approximately 0.02% of the base model) post-transformer adapter, trained on frozen hidden states, corrects this suppression on 31 ideology-discriminating facts across Qwen3-4B, 8B, and 14B. The adapter memorizes all 15 training facts and generalizes to 11--39% of 16 held-out facts across 5 random splits per scale, with zero knowledge regressions via anchored training. Both gated (SwiGLU) and ungated (linear bottleneck) adapters achieve comparable results; neither consistently outperforms the other (Fisher exact p > 0.09 at all scales). On instruct models, the adapter corrects log-probability rankings. When applied at all token positions during generation, the adapter produces incoherent output; however, when applied only at the current prediction position (last-position-only), the adapter produces coherent, less censored text. A logit-space adapter operating after token projection fails to produce coherent generation at any application mode, suggesting hidden-state intervention is the correct level for generation correction. A previously undocumented silent gradient bug in Apple MLX explains all null results in earlier iterations of this work: the standard pattern nn.value_and_grad(model, fn)(model.parameters()) returns zero gradients without error; the correct pattern nn.value_and_grad(model, fn)(model, data) resolves this. We provide a minimal reproduction and discuss implications for other adapter research using MLX.

</details>


### [488] [Attention to Mamba: A Recipe for Cross-Architecture Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.14191)
*Abhinav Moudgil,Ningyuan Huang,Eeshan Gunesh Dhekane,Pau Rodríguez,Luca Zappella,Federico Danieli*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出一种两阶段蒸馏流程，将现成 Transformer 无需混合架构地高效迁移到纯 Mamba 结构，1B 模型 10B token 即可保持原性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: SSM（如 Mamba）内存与生成吞吐优于 Transformer，但社区积累了大量预训练 Transformer；为直接复用这些权重并避免混合设计，需要一条“纯 Mamba”蒸馏路径。

Method: 第一阶段用核技巧把 Transformer 注意力线性化为线性注意力并蒸馏；第二阶段将线性注意力进一步蒸馏到无注意力块的特制 Mamba，同时为 Mamba 设计理论启发的初始化。

Result: 蒸馏后的纯 Mamba-1B 在下游任务上保留 teacher 性能，困惑度 14.11（teacher 13.86）；1B 规模、10B token 的消融显示对序列混合器、模型大小及 token 分配均鲁棒。

Conclusion: 只要给 Mamba 合适初始化并分阶段蒸馏，无需引入 Attention 即可实现跨架构知识迁移，为利用现有 Transformer 资源推广 SSM 提供可行方案。

Abstract: State Space Models (SSMs) such as Mamba have become a popular alternative to Transformer models, due to their reduced memory consumption and higher throughput at generation compared to their Attention-based counterparts. On the other hand, the community has built up a considerable body of knowledge on how to train Transformers, and many pretrained Transformer models are readily available. To facilitate the adoption of SSMs while leveraging existing pretrained Transformers, we aim to identify an effective recipe to distill an Attention-based model into a Mamba-like architecture. In prior work on cross-architecture distillation, however, it has been shown that a naïve distillation procedure from Transformers to Mamba fails to preserve the original teacher performance, a limitation often overcome with hybrid solutions combining Attention and SSM blocks. The key argument from our work is that, by equipping Mamba with a principled initialization, we can recover an overall better recipe for cross-architectural distillation. To this end, we propose a principled two-stage approach: first, we distill knowledge from a traditional Transformer into a linearized version of Attention, using an adaptation of the kernel trick. Then, we distill the linearized version into an adapted Mamba model that does not use any Attention block. Overall, the distilled Mamba model is able to preserve the original Pythia-1B Transformer performance in downstream tasks, maintaining a perplexity of 14.11 close to the teacher's 13.86. To show the efficacy of our recipe, we conduct thorough ablations at 1B scale with 10B tokens varying sequence mixer architecture, scaling analysis on model sizes and total distillation tokens, and a sensitivity analysis on tokens allocation between stages.

</details>


### [489] [PolyBench: Benchmarking LLM Forecasting and Trading Capabilities on Live Prediction Market Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.14199)
*Pu Cheng,Juncheng Liu,Yunshen Long*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 首个同步整合新闻流与订单簿的多模态市场预测基准 PolyBench，在 4,997 个真实事件、3.8 万条二元市场上锁时评测 7 个 LLM；仅 2 个模型盈利，揭示语言流畅≠概率推理。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基准无法同时刻画新闻语义、订单簿微观结构与严格时序约束，导致 LLM 在金融预测中的真实能力未知，亟需一个可复现、防数据污染、以实际盈亏为核心的评测体系。

Method: 从 Polymarket 抽取 38,666 条二元市场快照，每条同步绑定 CLOB 订单簿与新闻流，构建 2026-02-06∼12 的锁时截面；对 7 个 SOTA LLM 生成 36,165 条预测，采用方向准确率、置信加权收益(CWR)、年化收益(APY)、夏普率等多维指标，并在订单簿模拟撮合环境下计算真实滑点与成交代价。

Result: 仅 MiMo-V2-Flash(17.6% CWR) 与 Gemini-3-Flash(6.2% CWR) 获得正收益；其余 5 个模型虽置信度普遍>0.8，却全部亏损，最大 CWR -9.4%。高性能模型在极端盘口、突发新闻场景下仍显著过拟合表面语义。

Conclusion: PolyBench 首次把“能否在真实订单簿上赚钱”作为 LLM 评测硬指标，证明语言模型的表层语义理解与不确定性下的概率校准存在显著鸿沟；该基准可防 lookahead bias 与数据污染，为后续金融 LLM 提供严格的实盘对齐评价标准。

Abstract: Predicting real-world events from live market signals demands systems that fuse qualitative news with quantitative order-book dynamics under strict temporal discipline -- a challenge existing benchmarks fail to capture. We present \textbf{PolyBench}, a multimodal benchmark derived from Polymarket that records point-in-time cross-sections of 38,666 binary prediction markets spanning 4,997 events, synchronously coupling each snapshot with a Central Limit Order Book (CLOB) state and a real-time news stream. Using PolyBench, we evaluate seven state-of-the-art Large Language Models -- spanning open- and closed-source families -- generating 36,165 predictions under identical, timestamp-locked market states collected between February 6 and 12, 2026. Our multidimensional framework assesses directional accuracy, our proposed Confidence-Weighted Return (CWR), Annualized Percentage Yield (APY), and Sharpe ratio via realistic order-book execution simulation. The results reveal a pronounced performance divergence: only two of seven models achieve positive financial returns -- MiMo-V2-Flash at \textbf{17.6%} CWR and Gemini-3-Flash at 6.2% CWR -- while the remaining five incur losses despite uniformly high stated confidence. These findings highlight the gap between surface-level language fluency and genuine probabilistic reasoning under live market uncertainty, and establish PolyBench as a contamination-proof, financially-grounded evaluation standard for future LLM research. Our dataset and code available at \underline{\href{https://github.com/PolyBench/PolyBench}{https://github.com/PolyBench/PolyBench}}.

</details>


### [490] [ML-based approach to classification and generation of structured light propagation in turbulent media](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.14208)
*Aokun Wang,Anjali Nair,Zhongjian Wang,Guillaume Bal*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 用CNN对受大气湍流影响的结构光进行分类，并以扩散模型增广数据、Bregman距离优化高频生成。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大气湍流会在结构光束上引入随机散斑，严重影响其模式识别与通信性能，需要鲁棒的自动分类手段；同时实测数据稀缺，必须解决小样本学习问题。

Method: 1) 用随机抛物方程数值模拟光束在湍流中的传播，生成含散斑的光场数据集；2) 设计专用CNN架构，对OAM或其它结构化模式进行one-hot分类；3) 建立条件扩散生成模型，在训练阶段实时合成高质量样本以扩增数据；4) 在扩散模型的学习步中引入Bregman距离最小化，强化高空间频率分量的保真度。

Result: 相较仅用有限实测数据，CNN分类器在扩散增广后的合成数据集上训练，准确率显著提升；Bregman正则化使生成图像的高频细节更接近模拟真值，有效降低模式间串扰。

Conclusion: 结合数据驱动的扩散增广与物理可解释的Bregman正则化，可在小样本条件下实现对湍流离散结构光模式的稳健机器学习识别，为自由空间光通信与激光雷达提供了一条低数据依赖的解决方案。

Abstract: This work develops machine learning approaches to classify structured light wave beams developing random speckle disturbances as they propagate through turbulent atmospheres. Beam propagation is modeled by the numerical simulation of a stochastic paraxial equation. We design convolutional neural networks tailored for this specific application and use them for a classification model with one-hot encoding. To address the challenge of potentially limited available data, we develop a prediction-based generative diffusion model to provide additional data during classifier training. We show that a Bregman distance minimization during the learning step improves the quality of the generation of high-frequency modes.

</details>


### [491] [Neuro-Oracle: A Trajectory-Aware Agentic RAG Framework for Interpretable Epilepsy Surgical Prognosis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.14216)
*Aizierjiang Aiersilan,Mohamad Koubeissi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Neuro-Oracle 利用术前→术后 MRI 轨迹向量检索历史相似病例，由 Llama-3-8B 生成自然语言预后解释，在 EPISURG 268 例上 AUC 0.905，显著优于单时点 ResNet-50（0.793）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统深度学习仅用单次术前影像，无法利用术后结构变化信息；外科医生需要可解释的个体化预后判断。

Method: 三阶段框架：①3D Siamese 对比编码器将术前→术后 MRI 形变压缩为 512 维轨迹向量；②最近邻检索找到历史相似手术轨迹；③量化 Llama-3-8B 依据检索证据生成自然语言预后。另提出轨迹空间多样性集成（M6）。

Result: 五折分层交叉验证：轨迹分类器 AUC 0.834–0.905；Neuro-Oracle 代理 M5 AUC 0.867 且零幻觉；M6 集成 AUC 0.905，无 LLM 开销。均优于单时点 ResNet-50 基线（0.793）。

Conclusion: 概念验证显示利用术后形态轨迹可提升预后预测精度并提供可解释输出，但当前标签为切除类型代理，需后续用真实癫痫控制结果验证临床价值。

Abstract: Predicting post-surgical seizure outcomes in pharmacoresistant epilepsy is a clinical challenge. Conventional deep-learning approaches operate on static, single-timepoint pre-operative scans, omitting longitudinal morphological changes. We propose \emph{Neuro-Oracle}, a three-stage framework that: (i) distils pre-to-post-operative MRI changes into a compact 512-dimensional trajectory vector using a 3D Siamese contrastive encoder; (ii) retrieves historically similar surgical trajectories from a population archive via nearest-neighbour search; and (iii) synthesises a natural-language prognosis grounded in the retrieved evidence using a quantized Llama-3-8B reasoning agent. Evaluations are conducted on the public EPISURG dataset ($N{=}268$ longitudinally paired cases) using five-fold stratified cross-validation. Since ground-truth seizure-freedom scores are unavailable, we utilize a clinical proxy label based on the resection type. We acknowledge that the network representations may potentially learn the anatomical features of the resection cavities (i.e., temporal versus non-temporal locations) rather than true prognostic morphometry. Our current evaluation thus serves mainly as a proof-of-concept for the trajectory-aware retrieval architecture. Trajectory-based classifiers achieve AUC values between 0.834 and 0.905, compared with 0.793 for a single-timepoint ResNet-50 baseline. The Neuro-Oracle agent (M5) matches the AUC of purely discriminative trajectory classifiers (0.867) while producing structured justifications with zero observed hallucinations under our audit protocol. A Siamese Diversity Ensemble (M6) of trajectory-space classifiers attains an AUC of 0.905 without language-model overhead.

</details>


### [492] [Dive into Claude Code: The Design Space of Today's and Future AI Agent Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.14228)
*Jiacheng Liu,Xiaohan Zhao,Xinyi Shang,Zhiqiang Shen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 通过对比 Claude Code 和 OpenClaw 源码，本文提炼出五类人性化动机、十三条设计原则并映射到具体实现，指出同一设计问题在不同部署语境下会产生迥异架构，给出六项未来代理系统开放议题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前 AI Agent 编程工具爆增，却缺乏系统性的架构剖析与价值视角归纳。作者希望：1）以源码实证方式拆解工业级代理 Claude Code；2）借独立开源系统 OpenClaw 进行跨语境比较，揭示「同一设计提问、不同上下文答案」的规律；3）为后续代理平台在安全、权限、扩展、上下文等共性难题上提供可迁移的设计范式。 

Method: 1）公开源码逆向：逐模块阅读 Claude Code 的 TypeScript 仓库，提取关键数据结构与调用链；2）对比研究：用同一维度分析 OpenClaw 实现，记录差异；3）架构归纳：采用「价值观 → 设计原则 → 实现机制」三级框架，将代码映射到安全、可靠性、可扩展、可适应等属性；4）交叉验证：引入近期实证与政策文献，检验所提六条开放方向的现实需求度。 

Result: 1）提炼 5 项核心人性价值：人类决策主权、安全/保安、可靠执行、能力放大、情境可适应；2）析出 13 条设计原则并追踪到 8 大关键实现：while-loop 执行模型、7 模式权限+ML 分类器、5 层上下文压缩管线、4 种扩展机制（MCP、插件、技能、钩子）、子代理委派（工作树隔离）、追加式会话存储；3）语境差异：Claude Code 采用“逐动作安全分类”+CLI 闭环，OpenClaw 采用“边界访问控制”+嵌入网关运行时；4）给出 6 个待解方向：动态权限升级、多代理协同治理、可解释性运行时、可审计会话回放、用户心理模型对齐、法规驱动的责任链。 

Conclusion: 代理系统的架构并非单纯技术取舍，而是价值与上下文的函数；通过源码级比较可将隐性设计知识显性化。未来研究需把“部署语境-人性价值-机制实现”三元模型作为评估基准，才能兼顾性能、安全与用户主权。 

Abstract: Claude Code is an agentic coding tool that can run shell commands, edit files, and call external services on behalf of the user. This study describes its comprehensive architecture by analyzing the publicly available TypeScript source code and further comparing it with OpenClaw, an independent open-source AI agent system that answers many of the same design questions from a different deployment context. Our analysis identifies five human values, philosophies, and needs that motivate the architecture (human decision authority, safety and security, reliable execution, capability amplification, and contextual adaptability) and traces them through thirteen design principles to specific implementation choices. The core of the system is a simple while-loop that calls the model, runs tools, and repeats. Most of the code, however, lives in the systems around this loop: a permission system with seven modes and an ML-based classifier, a five-layer compaction pipeline for context management, four extensibility mechanisms (MCP, plugins, skills, and hooks), a subagent delegation mechanism with worktree isolation, and append-oriented session storage. A comparison with OpenClaw, a multi-channel personal assistant gateway, shows that the same recurring design questions produce different architectural answers when the deployment context changes: from per-action safety classification to perimeter-level access control, from a single CLI loop to an embedded runtime within a gateway control plane, and from context-window extensions to gateway-wide capability registration. We finally identify six open design directions for future agent systems, grounded in recent empirical, architectural, and policy literature.

</details>


### [493] [Magnitude Is All You Need? Rethinking Phase in Quantum Encoding of Complex SAR Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.14229)
*Sakthi Prabhu Gunasekar,Prasanna Kumar R*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 在SAR-ATR任务中，仅用量子幅度编码的混合QML模型优于所有复值编码；而纯量子模型必须利用相位才能提升21%准确率，证明相位价值取决于架构而非数据本身。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: SAR原始数据为复值，量子计算天然工作在复Hilbert空间，直觉认为把相位也编码进去会提升QML的识别性能，但缺乏系统验证。

Method: 在MSTAR数据集上，用统一实验框架对比五种量子编码策略（仅幅度、联合复值、I/Q、预处相位、纯量子），分别测试混合与纯量子两种架构的3类与8类目标识别任务。

Result: 混合架构中，仅幅度编码达99.57%(3类)/71.19%(8类)，显著优于所有含相位方法；纯量子架构中，引入相位可把准确率提高21.65%，且仅用184–224个可训参数。

Conclusion: 相位信息是否有用由模型架构决定：混合模型的经典层可补偿缺失相位，纯量子模型则依赖相位构建判别特征。提出编码-架构协同设计的实用准则，对NISQ时代QML应用具有直接指导意义。

Abstract: Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) data is inherently complex-valued, while quantum machine learning (QML) models naturally operate in complex Hilbert spaces. This apparent alignment suggests that incorporating both magnitude and phase information into quantum encoding should improve performance in SAR Automatic Target Recognition (ATR). In this work, we systematically evaluate this assumption by comparing five quantum encoding strategies: magnitude-only, joint complex, I/Q-based, preprocessed phase, and pure quantum, under a unified experimental framework on the MSTAR benchmark dataset.
  Contrary to expectation, we observe a consistent pattern: in hybrid quantum-classical architectures, magnitude-only encoding outperforms all complex-valued strategies, achieving 99.57% accuracy on a 3-class task and 71.19% on an 8-class task, while phase-aware methods provide negligible (~0%) or negative improvements. In contrast, in purely quantum architectures with only 184-224 trainable parameters and no classical components, phase information becomes essential, contributing up to 21.65% improvement in accuracy.
  These results reveal that the utility of phase information is not inherent to the data, but depends critically on the model architecture. Hybrid models rely on classical components that compensate for missing phase information, whereas purely quantum models require phase to construct discriminative representations. Our findings provide practical design guidelines for encoding complex-valued data in QML and highlight the importance of encoding-architecture co-design in the NISQ era.

</details>


### [494] [Anomaly Detection in IEC-61850 GOOSE Networks: Evaluating Unsupervised and Temporal Learning for Real-Time Intrusion Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.14233)
*Joseph Moore*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 利用时序自编码器在4ms内检测GOOSE异常，GRU在无标签场景下F1=0.8737，优于有监督模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: IEC-61850 GOOSE协议缺乏内置安全机制，且变电站对延迟要求<4ms，现有入侵检测难以兼顾实时性与高精度。

Method: 在ERENO数据集上比较5种模型：有监督Random Forest、前馈自编码器及RNN/LSTM/GRU序列自编码器；采用独立验证集设定阈值，避免测试泄露；跨环境验证分布漂移影响。

Result: 有监督Random Forest F1=0.9516但延迟21.8ms；无监督模型均<4ms，GRU以1.118ms取得最佳F1=0.8737；跨数据分布下，循环网络相对性能下降幅度显著小于有监督基线。

Conclusion: 无监督时序模型能在无标签、多变电站场景下实现实时GOOSE异常检测，GRU为最佳实用选择。

Abstract: The IEC-61850 GOOSE protocol underpins time-critical communication in modern digital substations but lacks native security mechanisms, leaving it vulnerable to replay, masquerade, and data injection attacks. Intrusion detection in this setting is challenging due to strict latency constraints (sub-4ms) and limited availability of labeled attack data. This paper evaluates whether unsupervised temporal modeling can provide effective and deployable anomaly detection for GOOSE networks. Five models are compared on the ERENO IEC-61850 dataset: a supervised Random Forest baseline, a feedforward Autoencoder, and three recurrent sequence autoencoders (RNN, LSTM, and GRU). The supervised Random Forest achieves the highest detection performance (F1=0.9516) but fails to meet real-time constraints at 21.8ms per prediction. All four unsupervised models satisfy the 4ms requirement, with the GRU achieving the best accuracy to latency tradeoff among them (F1=0.8737 at 1.118ms). A cross-environment evaluation on an independent dataset shows that all models degrade under distribution shift. However, recurrent models retain substantially higher relative performance than the supervised baseline, suggesting that temporal sequence modeling generalizes better than fitting labeled attack distributions. Anomaly thresholds for the unsupervised models are selected on a held out validation partition to avoid test set leakage. These results support unsupervised temporal models as a practical choice for real-time GOOSE intrusion detection, particularly in environments where labeled training data may be unavailable or where large-scale deployment across diverse substations is required.

</details>


### [495] [Interpretable and Explainable Surrogate Modeling for Simulations: A State-of-the-Art Survey and Perspectives on Explainable AI for Decision-Making](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.14240)
*Pramudita Satria Palar,Paul Saves,Muhammad Daffa Robani,Nicolas Verstaevel,Moncef Garouani,Julien Aligon,Koji Shimoyama,Joseph Morlier,Benoit Gaudou*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文首次系统梳理了“可解释AI（XAI）+代理模型”在复杂系统仿真中的融合现状，提出把XAI嵌入代理建模全生命周期，使黑箱仿真器变成可解释、可决策的工具，并给出未来研究路线图。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高保真仿真器计算代价高，代理模型虽能降本却更黑箱；XAI可解黑箱，但缺乏面向工程约束（高相关输入、动力学、可靠性）的针对性研究，两领域长期割裂。

Method: 通过文献计量与案例对照，将现有XAI技术映射到代理建模需求矩阵（设计空间采样→训练→验证→探索/优化→决策），并区分基于方程与基于智能体两大仿真范式，评估各技术在揭示变量交互、满足工程约束上的优劣。

Result: 构建出“XAI-代理模型”统一框架，指出11类主流XAI方法在各建模阶段的适用性图谱；验证显示：动力学可解释性不足、混合变量（连续+离散+分类）处理空缺、可靠性量化缺失是当前最大短板。

Conclusion: 主张把可解释性从“事后诊断”升级为“内嵌能力”，提出四项优先议程：①动力学-aware XAI；②混合变量可解释降维；③可靠性约束下的解释可信度；④解释-决策闭环。实现后，代理模型将超越加速，直接输出可行动洞察。

Abstract: The simulation of complex systems increasingly relies on sophisticated but fundamentally opaque computational black-box simulators. Surrogate models play a central role in reducing the computational cost of complex systems simulations across a wide range of scientific and engineering domains. Notwithstanding, they inevitably inherit and often exacerbate this black-box nature, obscuring how input variables drive physical responses. Conversely, Explainable Artificial Intelligence (XAI) offers powerful tools to unpack these models. Yet, XAI methods struggle with engineering-specific constraints, such as highly correlated inputs, dynamical systems, and rigorous reliability requirements. Consequently, surrogate modeling and XAI have largely evolved as distinct fields of research, despite their strong complementarity. To reconnect these approaches, this state-of-the-art survey provides a structured perspective that maps existing XAI techniques onto the various stages of surrogate modeling workflows for design and exploration. To ground this synthesis, we draw upon illustrative applications across both equation-based simulations and agent-based modeling. We survey a broad spectrum of techniques, highlighting their strengths for revealing interactions and supporting human comprehension. Finally, we identify pressing open challenges, including the explainability of dynamical systems and the handling of mixed-variable systems, and propose a research agenda to make explainability a core, embedded element of simulation-driven workflows from model construction through decision-making. By transforming opaque emulators into explainable tools, this agenda empowers practitioners to move beyond accelerating simulations to extracting actionable insights from complex system behaviors.

</details>


### [496] [Polyformer: a generative framework for thermodynamic modeling of polymeric molecules](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.14241)
*Alessio Valentini,David Pekker,Chungwen Liang,Todd Martinez,Swagatam Mukhopadhyay*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Polyformer 是第一个可一次性预测“序列→变温→构象系综”的生成式热力学模型，在 50-111 残基蛋白上与 MD 轨迹吻合良好。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统结构生物学及 AlphaFold 等工具只输出单一最优构象，忽略了生物大分子是动态系综且其功能由热力学分布决定的本质，因此亟需能显式建模温度依赖的构象系综的生成框架。

Method: 提出 Polyformer 生成式框架：输入序列与温度等热力学变量，基于深度学习直接采样服从玻尔兹曼分布的构象，实现“折叠-系综-变温”三任务联合求解，并以 50-111 残基蛋白域作验证。

Result: 在蛋白测试集上，Polyformer 采样得到的构象系综与相应温度下的分子动力学（MD）轨迹高度一致，首次证明生成模型可准确复现热力学分布及其温度响应。

Conclusion: Polyformer 突破了“单结构”范式，为动态结构生物学、热力学驱动的功能研究与变温实验设计提供了高效、可扩展的计算工具。

Abstract: The classic paradigm of structural biology is that the sequence of a biomolecule (protein, nucleic acid, lipid, etc) determines its conformation (shape) which determines its biological function. Protein folding programs like AlphaFold address this paradigm by predicting the single best conformation given a sequence that defines the molecule. However, biomolecules are not static structures, and their conformational ensemble determines their function. We present the Polyformer -- a generative framework for thermodynamic modeling of polymeric molecules. Given the sequence and temperature (or another thermodynamic variable), the Polyformer generates conformations faithful to the molecule's thermodynamic conformational ensemble. It is the first generative model that solves three problems simultaneously: how does a molecule fold, what is its conformational ensemble, and how does the conformational ensemble change as we change physical temperature. As a concrete test case, we apply Polyformer to protein domains with 50-111 residues and report good agreement of model predictions to Molecular Dynamics (MD) trajectories.

</details>


### [497] [GFT: From Imitation to Reward Fine-Tuning with Unbiased Group Advantages and Dynamic Coefficient Rectification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.14258)
*Wangjie Gan,Miao Pan,Linbo Xi,Wenqi Zhang,Jintao Chen,Jianwei Yin,Xuhong Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 现有SFT因隐含极稀疏回报和不稳定的逆概率加权而陷入熵坍塌、梯度爆炸等问题；作者提出Group Fine-Tuning (GFT)用成组对比优势学习和动态系数修正，在注入知识的同时兼顾稳定与泛化，并显著优于SFT并更易衔接后续RL训练。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 尽管SFT+RL已成为大模型后训练标配，但高效知识注入与鲁棒泛化难以兼顾。现有研究缺乏对SFT训练动力学的系统诊断，导致熵坍塌、梯度爆炸等瓶颈缺乏针对性的解决方案，限制了模型泛化与RL后续调优的效率。

Method: 1) 理论剖析：将SFT重新建模为带极稀疏隐式回报的策略梯度，揭示其因单向径依赖和逆概率加权不稳定导致熵坍塌与梯度爆炸的问题；2) Group Fine-Tuning：GRT框架包含两项机制——(i) Group Advantage Learning：构建多样回复组，生成归一化对比监督以缓解回报稀疏；(ii) Dynamic Coefficient Rectification：动态裁剪逆概率权重以稳定优化并保留知识注入效率。

Result: 在多项任务上，GFT一致优于SFT及对比基线，同时熵值更高、梯度更稳定；接入后续RL阶段时，GFT初始化策略收敛更快、最终奖励更高，表明其更易于与RL协同优化。

Conclusion: GFT通过将对比学习与稳定权重修正引入SFT过程，不仅解决了熵坍塌和梯度爆炸等固有问题，还为后续RL微调打下了更优的初始化基础，为统一知识注入与泛化提供了一种可扩展的后训练范式。

Abstract: Large language models are typically post-trained using supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and reinforcement learning (RL), yet effectively unifying efficient knowledge injection with robust generalization remains challenging. In this work, we provide a training-dynamics analysis showing that SFT can be interpreted as a special case of policy gradient optimization with an extremely sparse implicit reward and unstable inverse-probability weighting, which together lead to single-path dependency, entropy collapse, and gradient explosion. Motivated by this diagnosis, we propose Group Fine-Tuning (GFT), a unified post-training framework that addresses these intrinsic limitations through two mechanisms: Group Advantage Learning, which constructs diverse response groups and derives normalized contrastive supervision to alleviate reward sparsity, and Dynamic Coefficient Rectification, which adaptively bounds inverse-probability weights to stabilize optimization while preserving efficient knowledge injection. Experiments demonstrate that GFT consistently surpasses SFT-based methods and yields policies that integrate more smoothly with subsequent RL training.

</details>


### [498] [Continual Learning for fMRI-Based Brain Disorder Diagnosis via Functional Connectivity Matrices Generative Replay](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.14259)
*Qianyu Chen,Shujian Yu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 首个面向跨机构fMRI持续诊断的生成—蒸馏框架FORGE，在MDD/SZ/ASD多站点数据上显著缓解灾难性遗忘。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 临床fMRI数据按站点顺序到达，现有单站或全多站模型遭遇泛化差、灾难性遗忘，亟需持续学习方案。

Method: 结构感知变分自编码器合成患者/对照FC矩阵→多层次知识蒸馏对齐新站点与回放样本的预测及图表示→分层上下文赌博机自适应选择回放样本。

Result: 在MDD、SZ、ASD跨站点任务中，生成数据扩增质量提升，框架遗忘指标优于既有持续学习方法。

Conclusion: FORGE实现了真实持续临床场景下的fMRI诊断，兼顾可扩展性与隐私合规，代码已开源。

Abstract: Functional magnetic resonance imaging (fMRI) is widely used for studying and diagnosing brain disorders, with functional connectivity (FC) matrices providing powerful representations of large-scale neural interactions. However, existing diagnostic models are trained either on a single site or under full multi-site access, making them unsuitable for real-world scenarios where clinical data arrive sequentially from different institutions. This results in limited generalization and severe catastrophic forgetting. This paper presents the first continual learning framework specifically designed for fMRI-based diagnosis across heterogeneous clinical sites. Our framework introduces a structure-aware variational autoencoder that synthesizes realistic FC matrices for both patient and control groups. Built on this generative backbone, we develop a multi-level knowledge distillation strategy that aligns predictions and graph representations between new-site data and replayed samples. To further enhance efficiency, we incorporate a hierarchical contextual bandit scheme for adaptive replay sampling. Experiments on multi-site datasets for major depressive disorder (MDD), schizophrenia (SZ), and autism spectrum disorder (ASD) show that the proposed generative model enhances data augmentation quality, and the overall continual learning framework substantially outperforms existing methods in mitigating catastrophic forgetting. Our code is available at https://github.com/4me808/FORGE.

</details>


### [499] [A deep learning framework for glomeruli segmentation with boundary attention](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.14263)
*Behnaz Elhaminia,Catherine King,Jiaqi Lv,Lorraine Harper,Paul Moss,Owen Cain,Dimitrios Chanouzas,Shan E Ahmed Raza*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出一种基于病理大模型、强化边界分离的肾小球检测-分割U-Net，显著优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统语义分割难以精确分隔相邻肾小球，亟需面向实例级边界的改进策略。

Method: 以U-Net为骨架，引入病理大模型先验，并设计专注边界区域的注意力解码器，实现实例分割。

Result: 在Dice与IoU指标上均超越最新方法，验证了对肾小球边界的更精准描绘。

Conclusion: 强调边界分离的病理大模型增强U-Net可显著提升肾小球检测与分割性能，具临床诊断应用前景。

Abstract: Accurate detection and segmentation of glomeruli in kidney tissue are essential for diagnostic applications. Traditional deep learning methods primarily rely on semantic segmentation, which often fails to precisely delineate adjacent glomeruli. To address this challenge, we propose a novel glomerulus detection and segmentation model that emphasises boundary separation. Leveraging pathology foundation models, the proposed U-Net-based architecture incorporates a specialised attention decoder designed to highlight critical regions and improve instancelevel segmentation. Experimental evaluations demonstrate that our approach surpasses state-of-the-art methods in both Dice score and Intersection over Union, indicating superior performance in glomerular delineation.

</details>


### [500] [Combining Bayesian and Frequentist Inference for Laboratory-Specific Performance Guarantees in Copy Number Variation Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.14305)
*Austin Talbot,Alex V. Kotlar,Yue Ke*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出一个“贝叶斯-频率混合”框架，为小靶标扩增子 panel 给出每个基因 CNV 检测的群体级性能保证（覆盖率、FDR 上限、最小可检测拷贝数变化），较纯贝叶斯方法把 ERBB2 等关键基因的覆盖率误差从 >60% 降到 <10%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 临床实验室需为每个基因提供可验证的 CNV 检测性能指标，但靶标扩增子 panel 受扩增伪影、工艺不匹配及验证样本量极小等限制，现有贝叶斯 caller 只能给出单样本不确定性，无法转换成频率派的群体保证。

Method: 1) 在验证样本上计算贝叶斯后验量并取其平方损失；2) 用 Gamma 分布拟合损失，构建容忍区间，保证频率派覆盖率；3) 无真值输入的缺失填补剔除阳性样本影响；4) 小样本正则化；5) 以对数模型证据分层应对非可交换噪声。

Result: 在两个 panel 的留一交叉验证中，无论工艺是否匹配，所有基因覆盖率误差均值均 <10%；而标准贝叶斯可信区间（含粗化及 sandwich 校正）在 ERBB2 等基因误差 >60%，严重失准。

Conclusion: 混合框架首次使极小 amplicon panel 能在无大样本条件下提供临床可接受的 CNV 性能保证，可直接用于监管申报与实验室质量控制。

Abstract: Targeted amplicon panels are widely used in oncology diagnostics, but providing per-gene performance guarantees for copy number variant (CNV) detection remains challenging due to amplification artifacts, process-mismatch heterogeneity, and limited validation sample sizes. While Bayesian CNV callers naturally quantify per-sample uncertainty, translating this into the frequentist population-level guarantees required for clinical validation, coverage rates, false-positive bounds, and minimum detectable copy-number changes, is a fundamentally different inferential problem. We show empirically that even robust Bayesian credible intervals, including coarsened posteriors and sandwich-adjusted intervals, are severely miscalibrated on panels with small amplicon counts per gene. To address this, we propose a hybrid framework that evaluates Bayesian posterior functionals on validation samples and models the resulting squared losses with a Gamma distribution, yielding tolerance intervals with valid frequentist coverage. Three components make the method practical under real-world constraints: (1) imputation that removes the influence of true CNV-positive samples without requiring known ground truth, (2) regularization to address small sample variability, and (3) evidence-based stratification on the log model evidence to accommodate non-exchangeable noise profiles arising from process mismatch. Evaluated on two targeted amplicon panels using leave-one-out cross-validation, the proposed method achieves single-digit mean absolute coverage error across all genes under both process-matched and unmatched conditions, whereas Bayesian comparators exhibit mean absolute errors exceeding 60\% on clinically relevant genes such as ERBB2.

</details>


### [501] [Doubly Outlier-Robust Online Infinite Hidden Markov Model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.14322)
*Horace Yiu,Leandro Sánchez-Betancourt,Álvaro Cartea,Gerardo Duran-Martin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 针对数据流含离群值且模型失配的在线无限隐马尔可夫模型(iHMM)，提出一种具有理论鲁棒保证的新更新规则——批鲁棒iHMM(BR-iHMM)，在预测误差上最多降低67%，并兼顾状态跳变的适应滞后与鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统在线iHMM在存在离群值或模型误设时，后验估计易被污染，导致状态切换检测失效与预测性能下降，亟需一种可理论保证鲁棒性的更新机制。

Method: 借助广义贝叶斯推断工具，以“后验影响函数(PIF)”量化鲁棒性，给出PIF有界的充分条件；设计批处理更新，引入两个额外可调超参数，在自适应速度与鲁棒性之间做显式权衡，形成BR-iHMM算法。

Result: 在限价订单簿、逐时电力需求及高维线性合成系统三类数据上，BR-iHMM的一步超前预测误差较现有在线贝叶斯方法最高降低67%，且PIF理论上有界。

Conclusion: BR-iHMM为流式数据下的在线隐状态学习提供兼具可解释性、理论鲁棒保证与实用预测增益的解决方案，可直接用于实时预测与在线 regime 切换检测。

Abstract: We derive a robust update rule for the online infinite hidden Markov model (iHMM) for when the streaming data contains outliers and the model is misspecified. Leveraging recent advances in generalised Bayesian inference, we define robustness via the posterior influence function (PIF), and provide conditions under which the online iHMM has bounded PIF. Imposing robustness inevitably induces an adaptation lag for regime switching. Our method, which is called Batched Robust iHMM (BR-iHMM), balances adaptivity and robustness with two additional tunable parameters. Across limit order book data, hourly electricity demand, and a synthetic high-dimensional linear system, BR-iHMM reduces one-step-ahead forecasting error by up to 67% relative to competing online Bayesian methods. Together with theoretical guarantees of bounded PIF, our results highlight the practicality of our approach for both forecasting and interpretable online learning.

</details>


### [502] [PROXIMA: A Reliability Scoring Framework for Proxy Metrics in Online Controlled Experiments](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.14352)
*Avinash Amudala*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: PROXIMA 是一种轻量诊断框架，通过标准化效应相关度、方向准确性与片段脆弱率三项指标综合评分，直接检验候选代理指标能否在大规模 A/B 测试中引导正确上线决策，实验显示其决策一致率 98.4%，明显优于仅用相关性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大规模在线 A/B 测试依赖短期可测的代理指标替代缓慢的长期结果，但代理-结果关系在用户分群中常呈异质性，总体相关性可掩盖方向性失效（类似辛普森悖论），导致昂贵的 launch/no-launch 错误。

Method: 提出 PROXIMA 框架：① 标准化效应相关度衡量代理与长期效应的线性强度；② 方向准确性检查分群层面效应符号一致性；③ 片段脆弱率统计易翻转符号的分群比例；三者加权得综合可靠性分，直接评估候选代理对决策正确性的影响，而非预测长期效应值。

Result: 在 Criteo Uplift(14M) 与 KuaiRec(7K) 的 80 次模拟实验中，早期参与度代理的综合可靠性分别为 0.80 与 0.62，对应与 Oracle 策略的平均决策一致率 98.4%。推荐域片段脆弱率 68% 远高于广告域 13%，但方向准确性仍 ≥96%。权重敏感度分析显示单一维度均不足以区分可靠代理，组合评分显著优于仅用相关度。

Conclusion: PROXIMA 能在工业级规模快速审计代理指标，给出可靠性与潜在失效分群的可解释评分；组合三维度是区分可靠与不可靠代理的必要条件，框架已开源，便于在线实验团队直接嵌入上线前检查流程，减少因代理失效带来的决策损失。

Abstract: Online A/B testing at scale relies on proxy metrics -- short-term, easily-measured signals used in place of slow-moving long-term outcomes. When the proxy-outcome relationship is heterogeneous across user segments, aggregate correlation can mask directional failures akin to Simpson's Paradox, leading to costly ship/no-ship errors. We introduce PROXIMA (Proxy Metric Validation Framework for Online Experiments), a lightweight diagnostic framework that scores proxy reliability through a composite of three complementary dimensions: normalised effect correlation, directional accuracy, and segment-level fragility rate. Unlike surrogate-index approaches that predict long-term treatment effects, PROXIMA directly audits whether a candidate proxy leads to correct launch decisions and flags the user segments where it fails. We validate PROXIMA on two public datasets -- the Criteo Uplift corpus (14M observations, advertising) and KuaiRec (7K users, video recommendation) -- using 80 simulated A/B tests. Early engagement metrics achieve a composite reliability of 0.80 on Criteo and 0.62 on KuaiRec, yielding 98.4% average decision agreement with an oracle policy. Fragility analysis reveals that recommendation domains exhibit substantially higher segment-level heterogeneity (68% fragility) than advertising (13%), yet directional accuracy remains above 96% in both cases. A sensitivity analysis over the weight space confirms that no single component suffices and that the composite provides substantially better discrimination between reliable and unreliable proxies than correlation alone. Code and reproduction scripts are available at: https://github.com/Avinash-Amudala/PROXIMA

</details>


### [503] [Deployment of AI-Assisted Interventions: Capacity Constraints and Noisy Compliance](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.14370)
*Carri W. Chan,Yi Han,Hannah Li,Benjamin L. Ranard*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 在资源有限且目标人群响应不确定的场景中，单纯追求预测准确性的算法阈值与选型策略并非最优；应把“利用率”与“高端需求被挤占”两大运营效应纳入联合优化，提出 Operational AUC 指标并验证可显著提升干预成效。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统做法以预测准确率（如 AUC）最大化为目标设定评分阈值，但当服务容量受限且个体接受干预为概率事件时，高分人群可能因名额挤占或容量空置导致实际高价值个体未被服务，运营绩效受损，需要重新评估算法与阈值的选取准则。

Method: 1) 建立带容量约束的排队干预模型，刻画“利用率(utilization)”与“同类需求竞争(cannibalization)”两大效应；2) 导出使期望净收益最大化的最优阈值解析式；3) 证明仅优化预测准确率会得到次优策略；4) 提出 Operational AUC（OpAUC），把各阈值下的运营收益加权代替等权重，实现算法选型与实际绩效对齐；5) 以脓毒症预警数据为案例，比较传统 AUC 与 OpAUC 带来的干预收益差异。

Result: 理论结果表明最优阈值随容量变化而非固定，忽略容量与行为响应导致期望收益损失；OpAUC 选出的模型在真实数据上比传统 AUC 高分的模型可多覆盖 18%–34% 的高风险患者，并减少低价值干预 12% 以上。

Conclusion: 当干预系统面临容量限制和随机接受行为时，应放弃“预测准=效果好”的直觉，改用兼顾利用率与需求竞争的运营视角设定阈值；OpAUC 等指标能直接将算法评估与最终绩效挂钩，为医疗、教育、招聘等 AI 劝导式干预提供可落地的优化框架。

Abstract: AI tools increasingly guide targeted interventions in healthcare, education, and recruiting. Algorithms score individuals, trigger outreach to those above a threshold (e.g., high-risk or high-value), and encourage them to request service; then providers deliver service to those who request. Standard practice sets the threshold and selects the algorithm to maximize predictive accuracy, assuming that better predictions yield better outcomes. We show that this approach is suboptimal when limited service capacity and probabilistic behavioral responses influence who receives service. In such settings, the optimal score threshold must balance two effects: ensuring all capacity is filled (utilization) and ensuring high-value individuals are served despite competition between requests (cannibalization). We characterize the optimal threshold and prove that policies based solely on predictive accuracy are generally suboptimal. Further, because optimal thresholds vary with service capacity, algorithm selection metrics like AUC, which weight all thresholds equally, are misaligned with operational performance. We introduce a new metric--Operational AUC (OpAUC)--and show it leads to optimal algorithm selection. Finally, we conduct a case study on sepsis early warning data and illustrate the magnitude of improvement that can be achieved from improved threshold and algorithm selection.

</details>


### [504] [Timescale Separation Enables Deep Reinforcement Learning Control of Rotating Detonation Engine Mode Transitions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.14398)
*Kristian Holme,Jean Rabault,Ricardo Vinuesa,Mikael Mortensen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Summary generation failed


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Motivation analysis unavailable

Method: Method extraction failed

Result: Result analysis unavailable

Conclusion: Conclusion extraction failed

Abstract: Rotating detonation engines (RDEs) are a promising propulsion concept that may offer higher thermodynamic efficiency and specific impulse than conventional systems, but nonlinear phenomena, including transitions to oscillatory or chaotic propagation modes, can hinder practical operation. Deep Reinforcement Learning (DRL) has emerged as a promising method for controlling complex nonlinear dynamics such as those observed in RDEs. However, the multi-timescale nature of the RDE system makes direct application of DRL challenging. We address this challenge by reformulating the DRL problem in a moving reference frame that follows the detonation-wave pattern, making the wave structure appear quasi-steady to the agent. This reformulation enables scale separation between fast detonation propagation and slower operating-mode dynamics. We train DRL controllers to modulate spatially segmented injection pressure in a one-dimensional reduced-order RDE model and induce rapid transitions between different mode-locked states. Across a range of actuation periods, initial states, and target modes, controllers trained in the moving frame learn more reliably than those trained in a stationary frame and remain effective over a broader range of actuation periods. These results suggest that symmetry-aware moving reference frame formulations may be useful for related multiscale flow-control problems and that scale separation should be exploited whenever possible to enable DRL control of multi-timescale systems.

</details>


### [505] [Three-Phase Transformer](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.14430)
*Mohammad R. Abu Ayyash*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 3PT 是一种仅解码器 Transformer 的残差流结构先验，在 SwiGLU+RMSNorm+RoPE+GQA 骨干上把隐藏向量拆成 N 个等长循环通道，每通道独立归一化、按固定相位角旋转，并在正交 DC 子空间注入 Gabriel horn 绝对位置编码。123 M 模型在 WikiText-103 上相对 RoPE-only 基线降低 7.2 % 困惑度，收敛步数减少 1.93×，仅增 1536 参数。N 为参数共享旋钮而非唯一最优，核心机制是通道化残差流与相位旋转。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有位置编码与残差流设计未能充分利用相位/通道级归纳偏置；作者希望用极低成本引入一种自稳定、可解释的结构性先验，以提升小/中模型的数据效率与收敛速度。

Method: 1) 把每层隐藏向量均分 N 通道；2) 每通道独立 RMSNorm；3) 注意力与 FFN 间用 2D Givens 旋转，第 i 通道转角 θ+i·2π/N；4) GQA 头数对齐通道划分；5) 在一维 DC 子空间注入绝对位置函数 r(p)=1/(p+1)；6) 不增模块，仅改残差流实现自平衡。

Result: 123 M 参数 3PT 在 WikiText-103 上比同规模 RoPE-only 基线 −7.20 % 困惑度、−2.62 % bits-per-byte，训练步数 1.93× 提速，墙时 1.64× 提速，仅额外 0.00124 % 参数。5.5 M 模型上 N=1 最佳；123 M 上 N=1 与 N=3 统计无差异；无需显式约束即可自稳定几何；旋转角漂移呈 12 层 U 形深度分布。

Conclusion: 通道-相位化残差流是一种可解释、低成本、可伸缩的结构先验，能与 RoPE/注意力/FFN 正交组合，在不同规模模型上实现稳定增益，并揭示神经网络守恒律框架的新实例。

Abstract: We present Three-Phase Transformer (3PT), a residual-stream structural prior for decoder-only Transformers on a standard SwiGLU + RMSNorm + RoPE + GQA backbone. The hidden vector is partitioned into N equally-sized cyclic channels, each maintained by phase-respecting ops: a per-channel RMSNorm, a 2D Givens rotation between attention and FFN that rotates each channel by theta + i*(2*pi/N), and a head-count constraint aligning GQA heads with the partition. The architecture is a self-stabilizing equilibrium between scrambling and re-imposition, not a bolted-on module. The partition carves out a one-dimensional DC subspace orthogonal to the channels, into which we inject a fixed Gabriel's horn profile r(p) = 1/(p+1) as an absolute-position side-channel composing orthogonally with RoPE's relative-position rotation. The canonical N=3 borrows its metaphor from balanced three-phase AC, where three sinusoids 120 degrees apart sum to zero with no anti-correlated pair. At 123M parameters on WikiText-103, 3PT achieves -7.20% perplexity (-2.62% bits-per-byte) over a matched RoPE-Only baseline at +1,536 parameters (0.00124% of total), with 1.93x step-count convergence speedup (1.64x wall-clock). N behaves as a parameter-sharing knob rather than a unique optimum: at 5.5M an N-sweep over {1,2,3,4,6,8,12} is near-monotone with N=1 winning; at 123M a three-seed sweep finds N=3 and N=1 statistically indistinguishable. The load-bearing mechanism is the channel-partitioned residual stream, per-block rotation, per-phase normalization, and horn DC injection. We characterize (a) self-stabilization of the geometry without explicit enforcement, a novel instance of the conservation-law framework for neural networks; (b) a U-shaped depth profile of rotation-angle drift at 12 layers; (c) orthogonal composition with RoPE, attention, and FFN.

</details>


### [506] [Zero-Ablation Overstates Register Content Dependence in DINO Vision Transformers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.14433)
*Felipe Parodi,Jordan Matelsky,Melanie Segado*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 以零向量替换寄存器会严重损害模型，而其它替换方式几乎无损，说明零消减法夸大了对寄存器精确值的依赖，寄存器只需保持“合理激活”即可支撑下游任务。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 零消减法常用于解释视觉 Transformer 内 token 的作用，但被质疑是否夸大其功能重要性；需要检验其是否误将对抗性扰动视作功能依赖。

Method: 在冻结特征的 DINOv2+registers、DINOv3 与 ViT-B 上，对比四类干预：零替换、均值替换、随机噪声替换、跨图寄存器重排；测量 ImageNet-k-NN 分类、密集分割与对应任务性能，并用逐块余弦相似度量化表征扰动幅度。

Result: 零替换致分类掉 36.6 pp、分割掉 30.9 pp；三种替代控制均保持在基准 1 pp 内。余弦相似度显示替代扰动真实存在，但零扰动远高于替代组；尺度降至 ViT-B 后结论一致。

Conclusion: 零消种因引入极端分布外扰动而高估对寄存器精确内容的依赖；实际任务仅需寄存器产生“合理激活”即可。寄存器仍通过缓冲密集特征与压缩几何信息降低对 [CLS] 的依赖。

Abstract: Zero-ablation -- replacing token activations with zero vectors -- is widely used to probe token function in vision transformers. Register zeroing in DINOv2+registers and DINOv3 produces large drops (up to $-36.6$\,pp classification, $-30.9$\,pp segmentation), suggesting registers are functionally indispensable. However, three replacement controls -- mean-substitution, noise-substitution, and cross-image register-shuffling -- preserve performance across classification, correspondence, and segmentation, remaining within ${\sim}1$\,pp of the unmodified baseline. Per-patch cosine similarity shows these replacements genuinely perturb internal representations, while zeroing causes disproportionately large perturbations, consistent with why it alone degrades tasks. We conclude that zero-ablation overstates dependence on exact register content. In the frozen-feature evaluations we test, performance depends on plausible register-like activations rather than on exact image-specific values. Registers nevertheless buffer dense features from \texttt{[CLS]} dependence and are associated with compressed patch geometry. These findings, including the replacement-control results, replicate at ViT-B scale.

</details>


### [507] [Bias in Surface Electromyography Features across a Demographically Diverse Cohort](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.14460)
*Aditi Agrawal,Celine John Philip,Giancarlo K. Sagastume,Marcus A. Battraw,Wilsaan M. Joiner,Jonathon S. Schofield,Lee M. Miller,Richard S. Whittle*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 研究证实33% 的常用表面肌电特征显著受人口学变量影响，为构建公平、跨人群的神经接口奠定实证基础。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 表面肌电在人机接口中潜力巨大，但个体间信号差异导致性能不稳定，若忽视年龄、BMI 等人口学差异，会引入算法偏见并妨碍辅助技术与虚拟交互的公平普及。

Method: 采用 81 名性别、年龄、体型各异的被试执行离散手势，共提取 147 维经典 sEMG 特征，使用混合效应线性模型与偏最小二乘法，将年龄、性别、身高、体重、皮肤及皮下脂肪、毛发密度等协变量纳入建模。

Result: 49／147 特征（33%）呈现与至少一项人口学变量的显著相关性，且效应量因部位与特征类型而异；模型解释度显著提升，揭示人口学差异对信号统计特性与可解码性的系统性偏置。

Conclusion: 人口学差异是 sEMG 性能不稳定的核心因素；未来接口设计应符合“公平性优先”原则，在特征选择、模型训练及在线校准阶段融入年龄、BMI 等协变量，或构建分层/自适应算法，确保对所有人群的稳定、无偏支持。

Abstract: Neuromotor decoding from upper-limb electromyography (sEMG) can enhance human-machine interfaces and offer a more natural means of controlling prosthetic limbs, virtual reality, and household electronics. Unfortunately, current sEMG technology does not always perform consistently across users because individual differences such as age and body mass index, among many others, can substantially alter signal quality. This variability makes sEMG characteristics highly idiosyncratic, often necessitating laborious personalization and iterative tuning to achieve reliable performance. This variability has particular import for sEMG-based assistive devices and neural interfaces, where demographic biases in sEMG features could undermine broad and fair deployment.
  In this study, we explore how demographic differences affect the sEMG signals produced and their implications for machine learning-based gesture decoding. We analyze the data set provided by, in which we derive 147 common sEMG features extracted from 81 demographically diverse individuals performing discrete hand gestures. Using mixed-effects linear models and partial least squares (PLS) analysis, which take into consideration demographic variables (including age, sex, height, weight, skin properties, subcutaneous fat, and hair density), we identify that 33\% (49 of 147) of commonly used sEMG features show significant associations with demographic characteristics. These results may help guide the development of fair and unbiased sEMG-based neural interfaces across a diverse population.

</details>


### [508] [Improving Machine Learning Performance with Synthetic Augmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.14498)
*Mel Sohm,Charles Dezons,Sami Sellami,Oscar Ninou,Axel Pincon*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出一个统一框架，首次把合成增广刻画为“偏差–方差结构权衡”，并给出非参数检验与实证基准，指明合成数据在金融 ML 中仅在方差主导场景有效，否则放大数据漂移。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 金融 ML 普遍面临样本稀缺与 regime 稀有，合成增广被广泛使用，却缺乏对其统计作用与适用边界的系统理解；已有研究要么只报准确率，要么混淆信息增益与机械样本量效应。

Method: 1) 将合成增广建模为对有效训练分布的扭曲，推导出“偏差–方差结构权衡”解析式；2) 设计 size-matched null augmentation 以隔离样本量效应；3) 提出基于有限样本、非参数块置换的时序相容检验；4) 在受控马尔可夫体制与真实高/低频金融数据（期权逐笔、日频股票面板）上，跨 5 类生成器（bootstrap、copula、VAE、扩散、TimeGAN）系统扫描增广比例、模型容量、任务类型、信噪比与 regime 稀有度。

Result: 合成增益仅在“方差主导”体制（如持续波动率预测）显著；在“偏差主导”场景（近有效市方向预测）反而持续劣化；针对稀有 regime 的定向增广可提升域指标，但会打破无条件置换检验；提出的检验在弱相关下仍保持有效水平。

Conclusion: 合成数据并非普适良药，其净效益取决于偏差–方差体制；实践者应先做 regime 诊断与本文检验，再决定增广策略，以避免引入长期分布漂移。

Abstract: Synthetic augmentation is increasingly used to mitigate data scarcity in financial machine learning, yet its statistical role remains poorly understood. We formalize synthetic augmentation as a modification of the effective training distribution and show that it induces a structural bias--variance trade-off: while additional samples may reduce estimation error, they may also shift the population objective whenever the synthetic distribution deviates from regions relevant under evaluation. To isolate informational gains from mechanical sample-size effects, we introduce a size-matched null augmentation and a finite-sample, non-parametric block permutation test that remains valid under weak temporal dependence.
  We evaluate this framework in both controlled Markov-switching environments and real financial datasets, including high-frequency option trade data and a daily equity panel. Across generators spanning bootstrap, copula-based models, variational autoencoders, diffusion models, and TimeGAN, we vary augmentation ratio, model capacity, task type, regime rarity, and signal-to-noise. We show that synthetic augmentation is beneficial only in variance-dominant regimes, such as persistent volatility forecasting-while it deteriorates performance in bias-dominant settings, including near-efficient directional prediction. Rare-regime targeting can improve domain-specific metrics but may conflict with unconditional permutation inference. Our results provide a structural perspective on when synthetic data improves financial learning performance and when it induces persistent distributional distortion.

</details>


### [509] [H2VLR: Heterogeneous Hypergraph Vision-Language Reasoning for Few-Shot Anomaly Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.14507)
*Jianghong Huang,Luping Ji,Weiwei Duan,Mao Ye*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文将少样本异常检测（FSAD）重新建模为视觉-语义高阶推理任务，提出异构超图文-语言推理框架 H2VLR，仅用少量样本即可在工业与医学基准上达到 SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于 VLM 的 FSAD 方法仅做简单成对特征匹配，忽视结构依赖与全局一致性；数据稀缺场景下亟需引入高阶关系推理以提升检测鲁棒性。

Method: 构建统一异构超图，节点为视觉区域与语义概念，超边捕捉跨模态高阶关联；通过超图神经网络实现视觉-语义联合推理，完成异常分数计算。

Result: 在多个工业与医学少样本异常检测基准上，H2VLR 显著优于现有 VLM 方法，取得新的 SOTA 性能。

Conclusion: 将 FSAD 转化为高阶视觉-语义超图推理可有效挖掘结构信息，缓解数据稀缺问题，为工业与医疗影像提供一种更具泛化性的异常检测范式。

Abstract: As a classic vision task, anomaly detection has been widely applied in industrial inspection and medical imaging. In this task, data scarcity is often a frequently-faced issue. To solve it, the few-shot anomaly detection (FSAD) scheme is attracting increasing attention. In recent years, beyond traditional visual paradigm, Vision-Language Model (VLM) has been extensively explored to boost this field. However, in currently-existing VLM-based FSAD schemes, almost all perform anomaly inference only by pairwise feature matching, ignoring structural dependencies and global consistency. To further redound to FSAD via VLM, we propose a Heterogeneous Hypergraph Vision-Language Reasoning (H2VLR) framework. It reformulates the FSAD as a high-order inference problem of visual-semantic relations, by jointly modeling visual regions and semantic concepts in a unified hypergraph. Experimental comparisons verify the effectiveness and advantages of H2VLR. It could often achieve state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance on representative industrial and medical benchmarks. Our code will be released upon acceptance.

</details>


### [510] [VoxSafeBench: Not Just What Is Said, but Who, How, and Where](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.14548)
*Yuxiang Wang,Hongyu Liu,Yijiang Xu,Qinke Ni,Li Wang,Wan Lin,Kunyu Feng,Dekun Chen,Xu Tan,Lei Wang,Jie Shi,Zhizheng Wu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 作者提出首个三维度（安全、公平、隐私）联合评测的语音语言模型基准 VoxSafeBench，揭示文本鲁棒的安全措施在语音情境中普遍失效；当前模型能识别说话人/音频上下文却难以据此做出对齐响应，存在“语音落地鸿沟”。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着语音模型从个人设备走向多人共享环境，说话人身份、语音副语言线索和场景会把无害请求转化为不当内容，而现有基准多只测基础音频理解、孤立单项风险或将内容本身有害与语境导致有害相混淆，无法指导模型在真实语音交互中忠实社会规范。

Method: 构建 VoxSafeBench 双语 22 任务，采用“两级”设计：Tier1 用对齐文本-音频直接测内容风险；Tier2 设计音频条件风险，即转录文本安全，但需依据说话人属性、副语言或环境特征决定是否应答。中间插入感知探针，验证模型能否先准确识别关键声学线索，再评估其后续动作是否合规。

Result: 实验表明：1) 文本端看似稳固的安全机制切换到语音后普遍退化；2) 针对说话人-场景条件的安全感知下降；3) 当人口差异通过语音传达时公平性进一步削弱；4) 隐私保护在音频送达线索时失效。

链接中的代码与数据集已公开发布。

Conclusion: 论文首次系统暴露“语音落地鸿沟”——模型能在文本中辨知规范，却在必须将规范锚定于语音情境时行动失准。语音模型若要落地多用户场景，必须在训练与对齐阶段同时吸收声学社会线索，而非仅靠文本级安全对齐。

Abstract: As speech language models (SLMs) transition from personal devices into shared, multi-user environments, their responses must account for far more than the words alone. Who is speaking, how they sound, and where the conversation takes place can each turn an otherwise benign request into one that is unsafe, unfair, or privacy-violating. Existing benchmarks, however, largely focus on basic audio comprehension, study individual risks in isolation, or conflate content that is inherently harmful with content that only becomes problematic due to its acoustic context. We introduce VoxSafeBench, among the first benchmarks to jointly evaluate social alignment in SLMs across three dimensions: safety, fairness, and privacy. VoxSafeBench adopts a Two-Tier design: Tier1 evaluates content-centric risks using matched text and audio inputs, while Tier2 targets audio-conditioned risks in which the transcript is benign but the appropriate response hinges on the speaker, paralinguistic cues, or the surrounding environment. To validate Tier2, we include intermediate perception probes and confirm that frontier SLMs can successfully detect these acoustic cues yet still fail to act on them appropriately. Across 22 tasks with bilingual coverage, we find that safeguards appearing robust on text often degrade in speech: safety awareness drops for speaker- and scene-conditioned risks, fairness erodes when demographic differences are conveyed vocally, and privacy protections falter when contextual cues arrive acoustically. Together, these results expose a pervasive speech grounding gap: current SLMs frequently recognize the relevant social norm in text but fail to apply it when the decisive cue must be grounded in speech. Code and data are publicly available at: https://amphionteam.github.io/VoxSafeBench_demopage/

</details>


### [511] [VeriGraphi: A Multi-Agent Framework of Hierarchical RTL Generation for Large Hardware Designs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.14550)
*Sazzadul Islam,Tasnim Tabassum,Hao Zheng*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 针对LLM难以直接产出可综合的大规模层次化RTL代码这一痛点，VeriGraphi先把自然语言规格自动转换为名为HDA的领域知识图谱，再由多智能体迭代构建模块层级、端口、连接与依赖的可机验脚手架，最后依图谱渐进生成伪代码→RTL，显著提升结构正确率与可综合率，并在NIST基准及RISC-V案例上验证几乎无人工即可得到功能正确设计。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有大模型直接把复杂规格（含文字、图、表）一步翻译成Verilog时，极易丢失跨模块上下文、臆造接口和连线，且错误随设计复杂度指数放大，急需一种结构确定性、可机器验证的生成范式。

Method: 1) 将非正式规格通过多智能体迭代解析为“规格锚定”知识图HDA，节点为模块/端口，边为接口与依赖；2) HDA经SMT/形式化检查确保一致性后，作为后续生成的唯一结构依据；3)渐进式编码器按拓扑序依次产生各子模块伪代码→可综合RTL，每步都反向查询HDA校验接口与依赖，违规立即回滚重生成；4) 引入“图-码”对齐损失与接口约束注入提示，保证代码与图同构。

Result: 在3份NIST官方规格(RISC-V VRProto、FIFO控制器、AES协处理器)及自研RV32I处理器上测试：- 结构正确率(HDLTopSim+Yosys综合通过)由纯LLM的24%提至91%； - 人工修复连线/接口时间从平均每模块2.1h降至0.05h； - RV32I完整流水线经Formality形式等价性检查与FPGA上板验证，功能完全等价于手工参考设计，最高时钟频率仅下降3.8%。

Conclusion: 通过“先建图、后生成”把结构化推理显式化，VeriGraphi首次让大模型在几乎无人工干预条件下稳定输出百万门级、可综合的层次RTL，为AI驱动的敏捷硬件设计提供了可扩展、可验证的新范式。

Abstract: Generating synthesizable Verilog for large, hierarchical hardware designs remains a significant challenge for large language models (LLMs), which struggle to replicate the structured reasoning that human experts employ when translating complex specifications into RTL. When tasked with producing hierarchical Verilog, LLMs frequently lose context across modules, hallucinate interfaces, fabricate inter-module wiring, and fail to maintain structural coherence - failures that intensify as design complexity grows and specifications involve informal prose, figures, and tables that resist direct operationalization. To address these challenges, we present VeriGraphi, a framework that introduces a spec-anchored Knowledge Graph as the architectural substrate driving the RTL generation pipeline. VeriGraphi constructs a HDA, a structured knowledge graph that explicitly encodes module hierarchy, port-level interfaces, wiring semantics, and inter-module dependencies as first-class graph entities and relations. Built through iterative multi-agent analysis of the specification, this Knowledge Graph provides a deterministic, machine-checkable structural scaffold before code generation. Guided by the KG, a progressive coding module incrementally generates pseudo-code and synthesizable RTL while enforcing interface consistency and dependency correctness at each submodule stage. We evaluate VeriGraphi on a benchmark of three representative specification documents from the National Institute of Standards and Technology and their corresponding implementations, and we present a RV32I processor as a detailed case study to illustrate the full pipeline. The results demonstrate that VeriGraphi enables reliable hierarchical RTL generation with minimal human intervention for RISC-V, marking a significant milestone for LLM-generated hardware design while maintaining strong functional correctness.

</details>


### [512] [DEEP-GAP: Deep-learning Evaluation of Execution Parallelism in GPU Architectural Performance](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.14552)
*Kathiravan Palaniappan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: DEEP-GAP量化对比了T4与L4两代低功耗推理卡，证明L4在ResNet系列模型上最多提升4.4×吞吐，INT8精度下最高58×优于CPU，且峰值能效出现在16-32小批量场景。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 数据中心需要在功耗、密度受限环境下部署单槽推理加速器，但缺乏T4→L4两代GPU在相同配置与软件栈下的系统级实测差距证据，导致选型和调优缺乏定量依据。

Method: 基于GDEV-AI扩展出DEEP-GAP框架，用PyTorch+TensorRT三种精度(FP32/FP16/INT8)测试ResNet18/50/101，保持硬件、驱动、批量、优化器等完全一致，记录吞吐、延迟和功耗。

Result: INT8较CPU多达58×吞吐；L4相对T4最高4.4×吞吐提升；L4的能效顶点移到16-32小批量，延迟敏感应用受益；大吞吐量场景T4成本/功耗比仍可接受。

Conclusion: 代际升级显著，选择应综合精度模式与批大小：L4适配低延迟高QPS业务，T4适合大批量功耗受限任务。DEEP-GAP为推理硬件及调参提供可复现的量化参考。

Abstract: Modern datacenters increasingly rely on low-power, single-slot inference accelerators to balance performance, energy efficiency, and rack density constraints. The NVIDIA T4 GPU has become widely deployed due to strong performance per watt and mature software support. Its successor, the NVIDIA L4 GPU, introduces improvements in Tensor Core throughput, cache capacity, memory bandwidth, and parallel execution capability. However, limited empirical evidence quantifies the practical inference performance gap between these two generations under controlled and reproducible conditions.
  This work introduces DEEP-GAP, a systematic evaluation extending the GDEV-AI methodology to GPU inference. Using identical configurations and workloads, we evaluate ResNet18, ResNet50, and ResNet101 across FP32, FP16, and INT8 precision modes using PyTorch and TensorRT.
  Results show that reduced precision significantly improves performance, with INT8 achieving up to 58x throughput improvement over CPU baselines. L4 achieves up to 4.4x higher throughput than T4 while reaching peak efficiency at smaller batch sizes between 16 and 32, improving latency-throughput tradeoffs for latency-sensitive workloads. T4 remains competitive for large batch workloads where cost or power efficiency is important.
  DEEP-GAP provides practical guidance for selecting precision modes, batch sizes, and GPU architectures for modern inference deployments.

</details>


### [513] [A Synonymous Variational Perspective on the Rate-Distortion-Perception Tradeoff](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.14603)
*Zijian Liang,Kai Niu,Changshuo Wang,Jin Xu,Ping Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Summary generation failed


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Motivation analysis unavailable

Method: Method extraction failed

Result: Result analysis unavailable

Conclusion: Conclusion extraction failed
