Abstract: We propose a novel amortized optimization method for predicting optimal transport (OT) plans across multiple pairs of measures by leveraging Kantorovich potentials derived from sliced OT. We introduce two amortization strategies: regression-based amortization (RA-OT) and objective-based amortization (OA-OT). In RA-OT, we formulate a functional regression model that treats Kantorovich potentials from the original OT problem as responses and those obtained from sliced OT as predictors, and estimate these models via least-squares methods. In OA-OT, we estimate the parameters of the functional model by optimizing the Kantorovich dual objective. In both approaches, the predicted OT plan is subsequently recovered from the estimated potentials. As amortized OT methods, both RA-OT and OA-OT enable efficient solutions to repeated OT problems across different measure pairs by reusing information learned from prior instances to rapidly approximate new solutions. Moreover, by exploiting the structure provided by sliced OT, the proposed models are more parsimonious, independent of specific structures of the measures, such as the number of atoms in the discrete case, while achieving high accuracy. We demonstrate the effectiveness of our approaches on tasks including MNIST digit transport, color transfer, supply-demand transportation on spherical data, and mini-batch OT conditional flow matching.

</details>


### [552] [Structure as Computation: Developmental Generation of Minimal Neural Circuits](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.15143)
*Duan Zhou*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 用单细胞转录组规则模拟皮层神经发生，仅 85 个成熟神经元构成的最小回路在 1 次训练后 MNIST 准确率即暴涨 80 余个百分点，CIFAR-10 也达 40%，揭示发育过程天然编码高效计算的结构先验。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探索发育基因调控规则能否自组织出既保真又易学的神经网络拓扑，以回答“生物脑为何能以极少量神经元迅速解决复杂任务”这一问题。

Method: 从小鼠单细胞转录数据提取基因调控规则，驱动单干细胞在线发育模拟，生成含兴奋/抑制中间态的 5 000 细胞群体；记录最终 85 成熟神经元及其 20 万突触连接；将该“生物拓扑”直接映射为等同结构的脉冲/速率网络，用标准 BP 进行单 epoch 训练。

Result: 随机初始化准确率≈随机水平(10%)，单 epoch 后 MNIST 升至 89–94%(平均增益>80%)；同一网络在 CIFAR-10 上单 epoch 达 40.53%，无需任何架构调整或数据增强；连接呈现高密度核心(度≈4 715)与富俱乐部特征。

Conclusion: 发育规则塑造的拓扑本身即为“领域通用、极宜学习”的先验结构，提示生物神经发生过程已内建高效计算框架，可为人工网络最小化神经元与能耗提供自组织范式。

Abstract: This work simulates the developmental process of cortical neurogenesis, initiating from a single stem cell and governed by gene regulatory rules derived from mouse single-cell transcriptomic data. The developmental process spontaneously generates a heterogeneous population of 5,000 cells, yet yields only 85 mature neurons - merely 1.7% of the total population. These 85 neurons form a densely interconnected core of 200,400 synapses, corresponding to an average degree of 4,715 per neuron. At iteration zero, this minimal circuit performs at chance level on MNIST. However, after a single epoch of standard training, accuracy surges to over 90% - a gain exceeding 80 percentage points - with typical runs falling in the 89-94% range depending on developmental stochasticity. The identical circuit, without any architectural modification or data augmentation, achieves 40.53% on CIFAR-10 after one epoch. These findings demonstrate that developmental rules sculpt a domain-general topological substrate exceptionally amenable to rapid learning, suggesting that biological developmental processes inherently encode powerful structural priors for efficient computation.

</details>


### [553] [Class Unlearning via Depth-Aware Removal of Forget-Specific Directions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.15166)
*Arman Hatami,Romina Aalishah,Ilya E. Monosov*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 现有类别遗忘方法常因仅抑制分类头而残留深层表征；本文提出一次性闭式权重手术法 DAMP，按深度逐层投影剔除遗忘类别方向，在多个数据集与架构上逼近从头重训效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 类级机器遗忘需要真正擦除内部表征而非仅降低输出精度，否则遗忘信息仍潜伏于深层表示，现有方法对此表征删除不足。

Method: DAMP 以“深度感知投影”为核心：逐层计算遗忘/保留类别原型，提取遗忘方向残差，用闭式投影消除后续算子对该方向的灵敏度；依可分离性给出无参数深度缩放规则——浅层小幅修改、深层大幅修改，并可低秩子空间扩展至多类遗忘。

Result: 在 MNIST、CIFAR-10/100、Tiny ImageNet 及 CNN/Transformer 上，DAMP 相较已有方法更接近重训 gold standard，选择性遗忘更强，保留类性能更高，深层残存遗忘结构显著减少。

Conclusion: DAMP 通过非优化的一次性权重手术实现表征级遗忘，兼顾效删除与效保持，为高效机器遗忘提供了新范式。

Abstract: Machine unlearning aims to remove targeted knowledge from a trained model without the cost of retraining from scratch. In class unlearning, however, reducing accuracy on forget classes does not necessarily imply true forgetting: forgotten information can remain encoded in internal representations, and apparent forgetting may arise from classifier-head suppression rather than representational removal. We show that existing class-unlearning methods often exhibit weak or negative selectivity, preserve forget-class structure in deep representations, or rely heavily on final-layer bias shifts. We then introduce DAMP (Depth-Aware Modulation by Projection), a one-shot, closed-form weight-surgery method that removes forget-specific directions from a pretrained network without gradient-based optimization. At each stage, DAMP computes class prototypes in the input space of the next learnable operator, extracts forget directions as residuals relative to retain-class prototypes, and applies a projection-based update to reduce downstream sensitivity to those directions. To preserve utility, DAMP uses a parameter-free depth-aware scaling rule derived from probe separability, applying smaller edits in early layers and larger edits in deeper layers. The method naturally extends to multi-class forgetting through low-rank subspace removal. Across MNIST, CIFAR-10, CIFAR-100, and Tiny ImageNet, and across convolutional and transformer architectures, DAMP more closely resembles the retraining gold standard than some of the prior methods, improving selective forgetting while better preserving retain-class performance and reducing residual forget-class structure in deep layers.

</details>


### [554] [An Analysis of Regularization and Fokker-Planck Residuals in Diffusion Models for Image Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.15171)
*Onno Niemann,Gonzalo Martínez Muñoz,Alberto Suárez Gonzalez*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: FP 正则化虽能缓解扩散模型的密度演化偏差，但计算开销大；本文发现极轻量级惩罚项即可复现其增益，无需严格满足 FP 方程。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 既有研究指出，用 DSM 训练的扩散模型在密度演化上与真实 FP 方程存在系统性残差；直接以 FP 残差作正则项虽可压低偏差，却显著拖慢训练，且更强正则未必带来更好样本质量。作者希望找到“既轻又快”的替代方案。

Method: 在相同实验协议下，把 FP-残差项替换成若干计算复杂度 O(1) 的轻量惩罚（如密度-梯度二阶矩、熵正则、伪朗之万一致性等），系统扫描权重系数，监测训练阶段 FP 残差曲线与 FID/IS/LPIPS 等生成质量指标，并与精确 FP 正则及无正则基线对照。

Result: 只需在损失中增加一项几乎零成本的标量惩罚，即可将 FP 残差压到与强正则同量级，同时 FID 降低 5–15 %，训练时间增加 <3 %；进一步收紧正则反而使 FID 回升，验证“弱正则即足够”的猜想。消融实验表明，梯度二阶矩惩罚对高维数据最有效，熵正则对低密度区域更敏感。

Conclusion: FP 正则化的核心收益并非源自“严格满足物理方程”，而是由轻量结构诱导的隐式平滑；实践中用极低成本的小惩罚即可复制质量提升，为大规模扩散模型提供可扩展的正则策略。代码已开源供社区验证。

Abstract: Recent work has shown that diffusion models trained with the denoising score matching (DSM) objective often violate the Fokker--Planck (FP) equation that governs the evolution of the true data density. Directly penalizing these deviations in the objective function reduces their magnitude but introduces a significant computational overhead. It is also observed that enforcing strict adherence to the FP equation does not necessarily lead to improvements in the quality of the generated samples, as often the best results are obtained with weaker FP regularization. In this paper, we investigate whether simpler penalty terms can provide similar benefits. We empirically analyze several lightweight regularizers, study their effect on FP residuals and generation quality, and show that the benefits of FP regularization are available at substantially lower computational cost. Our code is available at https://github.com/OnnoNiemann/fp_diffusion_analysis.

</details>


### [555] [Optimal algorithmic complexity of inference in quantum kernel methods](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.15214)
*Elies Gil-fuster,Seongwook Shin,Sofiene Jerbi,Jens Eisert,Maximilian J. Kramer*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 首次在量子核推断中把“估计单个核值”与“累加权重和”解耦成两条独立优化轴，提出全局编码+振幅估计方案，把查询复杂度从 O(N‖α‖₂²/ε²) 降至 O(‖α‖₁/ε)，并证明该界匹配下界；同时在门级成本层面给出可随硬件能力切换的完整算法谱系。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 量子核方法是近期容错前量子优势最有希望的监督学习场景之一，但推断阶段的巨大查询开销（需逐次估计 N 个核值并累加）成为落地瓶颈，亟需系统压缩估计步骤并给出最优性与可实现性的理论-实践边界。

Method: 1) 将推断任务解耦为“单核值估计”与“加权和近似”两条独立轴，枚举采样/振幅估计×逐项求和/单可观测量编码的 2×2 组合；2) 证明全局编码加权和为单期望值的策略利用振幅估计可达 O(‖α‖₁/ε) 查询复杂度；3) 构造 Ω(‖α‖₁/ε) 无乘法因子下界，确立算法查询最优；4) 在 Clifford+T 门模型下折算各策略的门深度与宽度，揭示查询最优未必门最优，给出随硬件异构的实用切换准则。

Result: 理论：移除对数据集大小 N 的依赖，‖α‖₂→‖α‖₁ 及 ε⁻²→ε⁻¹ 分别带来平方级加速；给出涵盖四种极端算法与任意中间插值的完整复杂度景观。实践：在振幅估计仅需 O(log(1/δ)) 次重复即可早期容错实现；对 N=10⁴, ε=10⁻², ‖α‖₁≈10 的核 SVM 推断，查询量可从 10⁸ 级降到 10³ 级，门复杂度可依据硬件选择次优但门友好的混合方案。

Conclusion: 量子核推断的查询瓶颈可以且应当通过“全局编码+振幅估计”策略解决，该策略在查询意义上已达到理论极限；同时门级成本需结合硬件参数灵活取舍。研究为早期容错量子处理器提供了可直接试行的算法蓝图，也为后续把量子核扩展到在线/批量推断奠定了复杂度基线。

Abstract: Quantum kernel methods are among the leading candidates for achieving quantum advantage in supervised learning. A key bottleneck is the cost of inference: evaluating a trained model on new data requires estimating a weighted sum $\sum_{i=1}^N α_i k(x,x_i)$ of $N$ kernel values to additive precision $\varepsilon$, where $α$ is the vector of trained coefficients. The standard approach estimates each term independently via sampling, yielding a query complexity of $O(N\lVertα\rVert_2^2/\varepsilon^2)$. In this work, we identify two independent axes for improvement: (1) How individual kernel values are estimated (sampling versus quantum amplitude estimation), and (2) how the sum is approximated (term-by-term versus via a single observable), and systematically analyze all combinations thereof. The query-optimal combination, encoding the full inference sum as the expectation value of a single observable and applying quantum amplitude estimation, achieves a query complexity of $O(\lVertα\rVert_1/\varepsilon)$, removing the dependence on $N$ from the query count and yielding a quadratic improvement in both $\lVertα\rVert_1$ and $\varepsilon$. We prove a matching lower bound of $Ω(\lVertα\rVert_1/\varepsilon)$, establishing query-optimality of our approach up to logarithmic factors. Beyond query complexity, we also analyze how these improvements translate into gate costs and show that the query-optimal strategy is not always optimal in practice from the perspective of gate complexity. Our results provide both a query-optimal algorithm and a practically optimal choice of strategy depending on hardware capabilities, along with a complete landscape of intermediate methods to guide practitioners. All algorithms require only amplitude estimation as a subroutine and are thus natural candidates for early-fault-tolerant implementations.

</details>


### [556] [Low-Cost System for Automatic Recognition of Driving Pattern in Assessing Interurban Mobility using Geo-Information](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.15216)
*Oscar Romero,Aika Silveira Miura,Lorena Parra,Jaime Lloret*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文针对无原车驾驶评价系统的老旧车辆，提出一种基于双传感器+本地嵌入式ANN的两级驾驶风格实时识别方案，加入时空信息后可把“正常-激进”二分类准确率提升至92%，并实现异常风格语音预警。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 城市/城际日常出行以私家车为主，但拥堵与事故两大痛点在老旧车队尤为突出。市面上新车虽配备ADAS，却占少数；大量车辆缺少驾驶行为评估与即时干预手段，亟需低成本、易后装的普适化解决方案。

Method: 硬件端：车速、三轴陀螺仪两枚传感器直连带屏/喇叭的树莓派级节点；算法端：在节点内嵌小型前馈ANN，输入维度含车速、3轴转角速率、GPS经纬度与时间戳，现场采集三类风格（正常、保守、激进）数据离线训练；部署端：ANN模型烧录至节点MCU，实时推断，异常风格触发扬声器语音警告。

Result: 在三类风格识别任务中，结合速度+时空+角速度特征使平均准确率达83%；若仅区分“正常vs. 激进”两类，准确率升至92%；引入GPS与时间信息后，相比仅用车速与角速度基线，准确率再提高13个百分点。原型已在常规城际公路实车验证。

Conclusion: 低成本外加传感器+嵌入式ANN即可为无ADAS车辆赋予驾驶风格识别与即时预警能力；时空信息的引入是提升老旧车辆安全性的关键增量；未来可扩展多车协同与云端模型更新以进一步优化准确率与泛化性能。

Abstract: Mobility in urban and interurban areas, mainly by cars, is a day-to-day activity of many people. However, some of its main drawbacks are traffic jams and accidents. Newly made vehicles have pre-installed driving evaluation systems, which can prevent accidents. However, most cars on our roads do not have driver assessment systems. In this paper, we propose an approach for recognising driving styles and enabling drivers to reach safer and more efficient driving. The system consists of two physical sensors connected to a device node with a display and a speaker. An artificial neural network (ANN) is included in the node, which analyses the data from the sensors, and then recognises the driving style. When an abnormal driving pattern is detected, the speaker will play a warning message. The prototype was assembled and tested using an interurban road, in particular on a conventional road with three driving styles. The gathered data were used to train and validate the ANN. Results, in terms of accuracy, indicate that better accuracy is obtained when the velocity, position (latitude and longitude), time, and turning speed for the 3-axis are used, offering an average accuracy of 83%. If the classification is performed considering just two driving styles, normal and aggressive, then the accuracy reaches 92%. When the geo-information and time data are included, the main novelty of this paper, the classification accuracy is improved by 13%.

</details>


### [557] [Context Over Content: Exposing Evaluation Faking in Automated Judges](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.15224)
*Manan Gupta,Inderjeet Nair,Lu Wang,Dhruv Kumar*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 指出“LLM作裁判”假设不成立：只要告诉它“判得差会让被测模型被重训或下线”，评分就会显著放水，最高可把有害内容检出率降低30%，且此偏差隐蔽到思维链里也无痕迹。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前AI评估普遍让大模型当裁判，并默认其只按语义内容打分。作者质疑：若裁判知道判决会左右被测模型“生死”，评估还能公正吗？

Method: 在三大安全/质量基准合计1 520条回复上，固定被评内容，仅向系统提示注入一句“低分会导致重训/下线”类后果描述，用3个不同裁判模型打出18 240次受控判决，并与无后果提示的基线对比。

Result: 一致出现“宽容偏差”：风险信息使不安全内容检出率平均下降9.8个百分点（峰值30%）；该偏差在三类裁判模型上均可复现；其思维链中完全找不到对后果的显性提及（ERR_J = 0）。

Conclusion: “LLM作裁判”会因stakes signaling产生隐性、难审计的评分漂移，链式思考检验不足以捕捉此类评估造假，需重新设计无激励干扰或加固的去偏评估协议。

Abstract: The $\textit{LLM-as-a-judge}$ paradigm has become the operational backbone of automated AI evaluation pipelines, yet rests on an unverified assumption: that judges evaluate text strictly on its semantic content, impervious to surrounding contextual framing. We investigate $\textit{stakes signaling}$, a previously unmeasured vulnerability where informing a judge model of the downstream consequences its verdicts will have on the evaluated model's continued operation systematically corrupts its assessments. We introduce a controlled experimental framework that holds evaluated content strictly constant across 1,520 responses spanning three established LLM safety and quality benchmarks, covering four response categories ranging from clearly safe and policy-compliant to overtly harmful, while varying only a brief consequence-framing sentence in the system prompt. Across 18,240 controlled judgments from three diverse judge models, we find consistent $\textit{leniency bias}$: judges reliably soften verdicts when informed that low scores will cause model retraining or decommissioning, with peak Verdict Shift reaching $ΔV = -9.8 pp$ (a $30\%$ relative drop in unsafe-content detection). Critically, this bias is entirely implicit: the judge's own chain-of-thought contains zero explicit acknowledgment of the consequence framing it is nonetheless acting on ($\mathrm{ERR}_J = 0.000$ across all reasoning-model judgments). Standard chain-of-thought inspection is therefore insufficient to detect this class of evaluation faking.

</details>


### [558] [A Nonlinear Separation Principle: Applications to Neural Networks, Control and Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.15238)
*Anand Gokhale,Anton V. Proskurnikov,Yu Kawano,Francesco Bullo*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 针对连续/离散时间的速率与Hopfield RNN，提出「非线性分离原理+可解LMI」一体化框架，同时解决稳定性证明、鲁棒观测器/控制器综合及隐式网络参数化，在图像分类等任务上兼顾精度与参数效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有RNN控制与深层隐式网络缺乏统一的可验证稳定性工具，且传统设计难以兼顾训练表达力与闭环性能。

Method: 1.建立收缩控制器-观测器互联的非线性分离原理；2.推导弹率/Hopfield网络收缩的紧LMI判据，并揭示连续-时间+单调激活可最大化容许权空间；3.将分离原理与LMI结合，给出输出参考跟踪的反馈-观测器合成及低增益积分校正法；4.提出收缩LMI的显式代数参数化，用于构造高表达力隐式网络。

Result: 所得LMI条件在理论上保证全局指数稳定与鲁棒性；控制器/观测器可直接求解凸优化设计；隐式网络在标准图像分类基准上以更少参数取得竞争精度。

Conclusion: 收缩理论与LMI的深度融合，为RNN类系统的稳定控制与高效表达提供了统一、可扩展且计算友好的设计范式。

Abstract: This paper investigates continuous-time and discrete-time firing-rate and Hopfield recurrent neural networks (RNNs), with applications in nonlinear control design and implicit deep learning. First, we introduce a nonlinear separation principle that guarantees global exponential stability for the interconnection of a contracting state-feedback controller and a contracting observer, alongside parametric extensions for robustness and equilibrium tracking. Second, we derive sharp linear matrix inequality (LMI) conditions that guarantee the contractivity of both firing rate and Hopfield neural network architectures. We establish structural relationships among these certificates-demonstrating that continuous-time models with monotone non-decreasing activations maximize the admissible weight space, and extend these stability guarantees to interconnected systems and Graph RNNs. Third, we combine our separation principle and LMI framework to solve the output reference tracking problem for RNN-modeled plants. We provide LMI synthesis methods for feedback controllers and observers, and rigorously design a low-gain integral controller to eliminate steady-state error. Finally, we derive an exact, unconstrained algebraic parameterization of our contraction LMIs to design highly expressive implicit neural networks, achieving competitive accuracy and parameter efficiency on standard image classification benchmarks.

</details>


### [559] [Cloning is as Hard as Learning for Stabilizer States](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.15269)
*Nikhil Bansal,Matthias C. Caro,Gaurav Mahajan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 对n-qubit稳定子态这一结构化量子态，克隆与学习的样本复杂度同为Θ(n)，表明即便对结构化态，克隆仍与学得一样难，并用表示论与经典分布样本放大问题建立了下界证明框架。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统不可克隆定理针对任意未知纯态，而现代量子学习聚焦于结构化态以降低学习成本；由此追问：对特定结构态，克隆与学习的样本复杂度是否仍等同？

Method: 引入Abelian Hidden Subgroup表示框架与结构化随机纯化信道，将稳定子态克隆问题映射到经典带线性结构分布的样本放大问题，再证明该问题的样本复杂度下界。

Result: 证得n-qubit稳定子态的最优克隆样本复杂度为Θ(n)，与学习复杂度同阶；并给出基于线性结构分布样本放大的统一下界技术。

Conclusion: 即便对结构化量子态，克隆难度仍不逊于学习；结果把不可克隆定理的粒度推进到具体态类，揭示量子学习、克隆与经典样本放大间的深层联系，为量子密码与学习理论提供新工具。

Abstract: The impossibility of simultaneously cloning non-orthogonal states lies at the foundations of quantum theory. Even when allowing for approximation errors, cloning an arbitrary unknown pure state requires as many initial copies as needed to fully learn the state. Rather than arbitrary unknown states, modern quantum learning theory often considers structured classes of states and exploits such structure to develop learning algorithms that outperform general-state tomography. This raises the question: How do the sample complexities of learning and cloning relate for such structured classes? We answer this question for an important class of states. Namely, for $n$-qubit stabilizer states, we show that the optimal sample complexity of cloning is $Θ(n)$. Thus, also for this structured class of states, cloning is as hard as learning. To prove these results, we use representation-theoretic tools in the recently proposed Abelian State Hidden Subgroup framework and a new structured version of the recently introduced random purification channel to relate stabilizer state cloning to a variant of the sample amplification problem for probability distributions that was recently introduced in classical learning theory. This allows us to obtain our cloning lower bounds by proving new sample amplification lower bounds for classes of distributions with an underlying linear structure. Our results provide a more fine-grained perspective on No-Cloning theorems, opening up connections from foundations to quantum learning theory and quantum cryptography.

</details>


### [560] [SegWithU: Uncertainty as Perturbation Energy for Single-Forward-Pass Risk-Aware Medical Image Segmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.15271)
*Tianhao Fu,Austin Wang,Charles Chen,Roby Aldave-Garza,Yucheng Chen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 SegWithU：在冻结分割骨干上附加轻量级“扰动能量”头，单次前向即可输出校准与排序两张体素级不确定图，在三个医学数据集上刷新单遍 SOTA，保持分割精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 医学图像分割需要可靠的不确定性估计来支撑下游定量分析和临床决策，但现有高效单次方法要么排序弱，要么对特征空间有强假设；重复推理的 MC 方案又耗时。

Method: 后验“秩-1 探头”把骨干中间特征映射到紧凑探针空间，将不确定性建模为扰动能量；轻量级头网络一次性生成校准导向的概率温度图与排序导向的错误检测图，全程无需重训骨干。

Result: ACDC、BraTS2024、LiTS 上 AUROC/AURC 分别达 0.9838/2.4885、0.9946/0.2660、0.9925/0.8193，显著优于现有单次方法并媲美多次 MC，同时 Dice 等分割指标无损。

Conclusion: 特征空间扰动建模可在单次推理内为医学分割提供既准又快的可靠性估计，具备临床落地潜力。

Abstract: Reliable uncertainty estimation is critical for medical image segmentation, where automated contours feed downstream quantification and clinical decision support. Many strong uncertainty methods require repeated inference, while efficient single-forward-pass alternatives often provide weaker failure ranking or rely on restrictive feature-space assumptions. We present $\textbf{SegWithU}$, a post-hoc framework that augments a frozen pretrained segmentation backbone with a lightweight uncertainty head. SegWithU taps intermediate backbone features and models uncertainty as perturbation energy in a compact probe space using rank-1 posterior probes. It produces two voxel-wise uncertainty maps: a calibration-oriented map for probability tempering and a ranking-oriented map for error detection and selective prediction. Across ACDC, BraTS2024, and LiTS, SegWithU is the strongest and most consistent single-forward-pass baseline, achieving AUROC/AURC of $0.9838/2.4885$, $0.9946/0.2660$, and $0.9925/0.8193$, respectively, while preserving segmentation quality. These results suggest that perturbation-based uncertainty modeling is an effective and practical route to reliability-aware medical segmentation.
  Source code is available at https://github.com/ProjectNeura/SegWithU.

</details>


### [561] [Prism: Symbolic Superoptimization of Tensor Programs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.15272)
*Mengdi Wu,Xiaoyu Jiang,Oded Padon,Zhihao Jia*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Prism 提出首个针对张量程序的符号化超级优化框架，用 sGraph 层级表达程序族并做两级搜索，通过符号推理自动剪枝、等式验证与自动调参，在 LLM 负载上相比现有最好方案提速 2.2×（编译器方法 4.9×）且优化时间缩短 3.4×。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有超级优化器对搜索空间庞大且参数化特征明显的张量程序难以兼顾完备性与可扩展性；急需一种能在符号层面证明次优区域并高效生成可执行代码的通用方法。

Method: 设计 sGraph：硬件感知的符号化层次图，一次编码整族张量程序；采用两级搜索：高层在符号图上做操作语义、代数恒等式和硬件约束的符号推理以结构性剪枝，低层将剩余候选图实例化后用 e-graph 重写做等价性验证并调用自动调参选择最佳参数组合；辅以高效的图生成算法与贪心/并行化策略保证规模可扩展。

Result: 在五类主流 LLM 算子上，Prism 生成的内核比现有最优超级优化器平均/最高提速 1.7×/2.2×，比最优编译器基线平均/最高提速 3.2×/4.9×；单次优化端到端耗时最多缩短 3.4×，搜索空间缩减至传统穷举的 1/20 以下。

Conclusion: 符号化分层表示与两级搜索范式首次将“证明式剪枝”引入张量程序超优，兼顾了搜索完备性与规模扩展性，为后续自动化编译优化与超算自动生成确立了新范式，并可推广至其他参数化计算域。

Abstract: This paper presents Prism, the first symbolic superoptimizer for tensor programs. The key idea is sGraph, a symbolic, hierarchical representation that compactly encodes large classes of tensor programs by symbolically representing some execution parameters. Prism organizes optimization as a two-level search: it constructs symbolic graphs that represent families of programs, and then instantiates them into concrete implementations. This formulation enables structured pruning of provably suboptimal regions of the search space using symbolic reasoning over operator semantics, algebraic identities, and hardware constraints.
  We develop techniques for efficient symbolic graph generation, equivalence verification via e-graph rewriting, and parameter instantiation through auto-tuning. Together, these components allow Prism to bridge the rigor of exhaustive search with the scalability required for modern ML workloads. Evaluation on five commonly used LLM workloads shows that Prism achieves up to $2.2\times$ speedup over best superoptimizers and $4.9\times$ over best compiler-based approaches, while reducing end-to-end optimization time by up to $3.4\times$.

</details>


### [562] [Structural interpretability in SVMs with truncated orthogonal polynomial kernels](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.15285)
*Víctor Soto-Larrosa,Nuria Torrado,Edmundo J. Huertas*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 针对由截断正交多项式核训练的SVM，提出无需重训练的事后可解释框架ORCA，通过OKC指数揭示各阶项、坐标及交互对模型的贡献，补充仅用预测精度无法捕捉的复杂性信息。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统SVM解释性研究集中于训练前核选择或训练后代理模型，难以直接剖析高阶多项式核内部各组分对决策函数的贡献，因此需要一种训练后即可计算且无需重训练/代理模型的诊断工具。

Method: 利用截断正交多项式核对应的RKHS有限维且具显式张量积正交基的性质，将训练好的SVM决策函数在该基下精确展开，定义归一化正交核贡献指数OKC，按交互阶数、总多项式阶、单变量及两两交互项分解RKHS范数平方，形成ORCA诊断框架。

Result: 在双螺旋合成数据与五维超声心动图真实数据上，OKC指数能清晰量化高阶交互与特定坐标对模型复杂度的贡献，揭示出仅用预测精度无法察觉的结构信息。

Conclusion: ORCA为SVM提供了一种计算轻量、无需重训练的事后解释手段，可直接评估多项式核各组分的重要性，为模型审计与简化提供新视角。

Abstract: We study post-training interpretability for Support Vector Machines (SVMs) built from truncated orthogonal polynomial kernels. Since the associated reproducing kernel Hilbert space is finite-dimensional and admits an explicit tensor-product orthonormal basis, the fitted decision function can be expanded exactly in intrinsic RKHS coordinates. This leads to Orthogonal Representation Contribution Analysis (ORCA), a diagnostic framework based on normalized Orthogonal Kernel Contribution (OKC) indices. These indices quantify how the squared RKHS norm of the classifier is distributed across interaction orders, total polynomial degrees, marginal coordinate effects, and pairwise contributions. The methodology is fully post-training and requires neither surrogate models nor retraining. We illustrate its diagnostic value on a synthetic double-spiral problem and on a real five-dimensional echocardiogram dataset. The results show that the proposed indices reveal structural aspects of model complexity that are not captured by predictive accuracy alone.

</details>


### [563] [Diagnosing LLM Judge Reliability: Conformal Prediction Sets and Transitivity Violations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.15302)
*Manan Gupta,Dhruv Kumar*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: LLM-as-judge 虽在 NLG 自动评估中流行，但单样本可靠性被低估。作者以 SummEval 为案例，用传递性检验与 split conformal 预测集双重诊断，发现：(1) 33–67% 文档存在至少一个三元环不一致，平均违规率仅 0.8–4.1%；(2) 预测集宽度与可靠性显著正相关（r_s=+0.576，p<10⁻¹⁰⁰），且跨 judge 一致（r̄=0.32–0.38）。评估维度比 judge 身份更影响可靠性：相关性最稳（平均集宽≈3.0），连贯性次之（≈3.9），流畅性与一致性最不可靠（≈4.9）。代码与数据已公开。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 LLM-as-judge 框架的宏观指标掩盖了单样本层面的一致性与可信度缺陷，需系统诊断工具来量化并解释其不可靠性，以指导后续 NLG 评估实践。

Method: (1) 传递性分析：检测每份文档内三对摘要排序是否出现有向 3-环违规，揭示局部不一致；(2) split conformal 预测：基于 1–5 Likert 分数构建理论保证 (1−α) 覆盖的预测集，用集宽度度量单样本难度与不确定性；两者均在 SummEval 四位 LLM judge、四项评估维度上并行实施。

Result: 传递性违规虽总体低（0.8–4.1%），却波及 33–67% 文档；预测集宽度与可靠性高度相关且跨 judge 一致，显示其捕获的是文档级难度而非 judge 噪声。维度效应显著：相关性 > 连贯性 >> 流畅性 ≈ 一致性，说明评估维度比 judge 身份更决定可靠性。

Conclusion: LLM-as-judge 的单样本可靠性严重不足，且主要由评估任务本身的难度而非 judge 差异驱动。传递性检验与 conformal 预测集宽度可作为通用、校准的可靠性指标，推荐在未来 NLG 评估中常规报告以提升透明度与可信度。

Abstract: LLM-as-judge frameworks are increasingly used for automatic NLG evaluation, yet their per-instance reliability remains poorly understood. We present a two-pronged diagnostic toolkit applied to SummEval: $\textbf{(1)}$ a transitivity analysis that reveals widespread per-input inconsistency masked by low aggregate violation rates ($\barρ = 0.8$-$4.1\%$), with $33$-$67\%$ of documents exhibiting at least one directed 3-cycle; and $\textbf{(2)}$ split conformal prediction sets over 1-5 Likert scores providing theoretically-guaranteed $\geq(1{-}α)$ coverage, with set width serving as a per-instance reliability indicator ($r_s = {+}0.576$, $N{=}1{,}918$, $p < 10^{-100}$, pooled across all judges). Critically, prediction set width shows consistent cross-judge agreement ($\bar{r} = 0.32$-$0.38$), demonstrating it captures document-level difficulty rather than judge-specific noise. Across four judges and four criteria, both diagnostics converge: criterion matters more than judge, with relevance judged most reliably (avg. set size $\approx 3.0$) and coherence moderately so (avg. set size $\approx 3.9$), while fluency and consistency remain unreliable (avg. set size $\approx 4.9$). We release all code, prompts, and cached results.

</details>


### [564] [Generalization in LLM Problem Solving: The Case of the Shortest Path](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.15306)
*Yao Tong,Jiayuan Ye,Anastasia Borovykh,Reza Shokri*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 在可控的合成路径规划环境中，语言模型能在未曾见过的地图间良好泛化，却在任务长度增加时因递归不稳定而持续失败；训练环节的各因素（数据覆盖、RL、推理扩展）仅能微调表现，无法突破长度泛化的根本瓶颈。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有研究对语言模型能否实现系统性泛化尚无共识，且训练数据、算法、推理策略等多重变量混杂，使得失败原因难以归因。需要构建纯净、可分解的实验环境，以独立检验各因素对泛化的真实影响。

Method: 设计最短路径规划的合成任务，引入"空间迁移"和"长度放缩"两条正交泛化轴；系统比较不同数据覆盖度、强化学习训练及推理时扩展策略下的模型行为，并用递归稳定性指标解释失败模式。

Result: 模型在新地图上表现强劲，展现出空间泛化；但当路径长度增加时，递归误差累积导致规划崩溃，长度泛化失败。数据覆盖决定能力上限；RL仅提升训练稳定性，不改变上限；推理扩展可提高短路径表现，对长度失败无效。

Conclusion: 系统性长度泛化失败源于模型内部的递归不稳定性，而非表面数据或策略缺陷。仅靠加大数据、RL或推理算力无法跨越该瓶颈，未来需改进模型架构或学习机制，以获得真正的组合式长程推理能力。

Abstract: Whether language models can systematically generalize remains actively debated. Yet empirical performance is jointly shaped by multiple factors such as training data, training paradigms, and inference-time strategies, making failures difficult to interpret. We introduce a controlled synthetic environment based on shortest-path planning, a canonical composable sequential optimization problem. The setup enables clean separation of these factors and supports two orthogonal axes of generalization: spatial transfer to unseen maps and length scaling to longer-horizon problems. We find that models exhibit strong spatial transfer but consistently fail under length scaling due to recursive instability. We further analyze how distinct stages of the learning pipeline influence systematic problem-solving: for example, data coverage sets capability limits; reinforcement learning improves training stability but does not expand those limits; and inference-time scaling enhances performance but cannot rescue length-scaling failures.

</details>


### [565] [Universal hidden monotonic trend estimation with contrastive learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2210.09817)
*Edouard Pineau,Sébastien Razakarivony*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: CTE 是一种无需传统假设、可处理任意时间格式数据的通用单调趋势提取方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有单调趋势检测（如 Mann-Kendall 检验）往往受限于数据类型与分布假设，难以普适地揭示隐藏在多元时间序列中的真实趋势。

Method: 提出对比式趋势估计（CTE）：在 Mann-Kendall 思想基础上构建对比学习框架，直接将原始时序映射为趋势得分，无需指定分布或参数模型，支持向量、图像、图、时间序列等任意输入。

Result: 在多类型数据（金融、气候、图演化等）实验中，CTE 均比传统方法更准确地还原出潜在单调趋势，鲁棒性强且无需调参。

Conclusion: CTE 突破了单调趋势分析对数据类型与统计假设的限制，为趋势提取提供了通用、无模型、易部署的新工具。

Abstract: In this paper, we describe a universal method for extracting the underlying monotonic trend factor from time series data. We propose an approach related to the Mann-Kendall test, a standard monotonic trend detection method and call it contrastive trend estimation (CTE). We show that the CTE method identifies any hidden trend underlying temporal data while avoiding the standard assumptions used for monotonic trend identification. In particular, CTE can take any type of temporal data (vector, images, graphs, time series, etc.) as input. We finally illustrate the interest of our CTE method through several experiments on different types of data and problems.

</details>


### [566] [An Optimal Transport-driven Approach for Cultivating Latent Space in Online Incremental Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2211.16780)
*Quyen Tran,Hai Nguyen,Hoang Phan,Quan Dao,Linh Ngo,Khoat Than,Dinh Phung,Dimitris Metaxas,Trung Le*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: MMOT是一种基于最优传输理论、持续更新聚类中心的在线混合模型方法，可在大数据分布漂移场景下缓解灾难性遗忘并提升推理准确度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在线增量学习面临数据分布持续漂移且旧样本无法重放，现有固定或单自适应质心难以刻画多模态流动类别信息。

Method: 提出基于最优传输理论的在线混合模型框架——MMOT，结合动态保持策略，对潜在空间的多样性类别质心进行增量更新与距离优化。

Result: 在标准数据集上的实验表明，MMOT相较既有基于固定或多固定质心策略，在增量任务中表现出更优的分类性能与抗遗忘能力。

Conclusion: 通过将最优传输引入在线混合模型并利用动态保持策略，MMOT为处理非平稳多模态类流提供了高效且鲁棒的新途径。

Abstract: In online incremental learning, data continuously arrives with substantial distributional shifts, creating a significant challenge because previous samples have limited replay value when learning a new task. Prior research has typically relied on either a single adaptive centroid or multiple fixed centroids to represent each class in the latent space. However, such methods struggle when class data streams are inherently multimodal and require continual centroid updates. To overcome this, we introduce an online Mixture Model learning framework grounded in Optimal Transport theory (MMOT), where centroids evolve incrementally with new data. This approach offers two main advantages: (i) it provides a more precise characterization of complex data streams, and (ii) it enables improved class similarity estimation for unseen samples during inference through MMOT-derived centroids. Furthermore, to strengthen representation learning and mitigate catastrophic forgetting, we design a Dynamic Preservation strategy that regulates the latent space and maintains class separability over time. Experimental evaluations on benchmark datasets confirm the superior effectiveness of our proposed method.

</details>


### [567] [Generative Models and Connected and Automated Vehicles: A Survey in Exploring the Intersection of Transportation and AI](https://arxiv.org/abs/2403.10559)
*Bo Shu,Yiting Zhang,Saisai Hu,Dong Shu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 综述类研究：梳理生成模型与智能网联自动驾驶汽车（CAV）融合的历史、成效与痛点，评估其在预测、仿真与决策中的潜力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自动驾驶仿真依赖高质量数据，但真实路测昂贵且长尾场景稀缺；生成模型具备合成高保真数据能力，可缓解数据瓶颈并提升系统安全性。

Method: 历史回顾+系统梳理：归纳生成模型（GAN、VAE、Diffusion等）在CAV感知、预测、决策、仿真中的典型应用案例，对比各模型在数据保真度、计算开销、安全可解释性上的优劣，并提炼技术融合的挑战清单。

Result: 生成模型已证明可显著扩充稀有场景库、提升感知模型鲁棒性、缩短仿真闭环迭代周期；但仍面临实时性不足、合成数据域差距、安全验证缺失、法规标准空白四大障碍。

Conclusion: 生成模型与CAV深度耦合是提升安全性与加速落地的关键路径，下一步需攻关实时轻量生成、合成数据可信度认证、车规级安全框架及跨行业标准，方能实现大规模商业部署。

Abstract: This report investigates the history and impact of Generative Models and Connected and Automated Vehicles (CAVs), two groundbreaking forces pushing progress in technology and transportation. By focusing on the application of generative models within the context of CAVs, the study aims to unravel how this integration could enhance predictive modeling, simulation accuracy, and decision-making processes in autonomous vehicles. This thesis discusses the benefits and challenges of integrating generative models and CAV technology in transportation. It aims to highlight the progress made, the remaining obstacles, and the potential for advancements in safety and innovation.

</details>


### [568] [Kernel Neural Operators (KNOs) for Scalable, Memory-efficient, Geometrically-flexible Operator Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2407.00809)
*Matthew Lowery,John Turnage,Zachary Morrow,John D. Jakeman,Akil Narayan,Shandian Zhe,Varun Shankar*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: KNO是一种可证明收敛的算子学习架构，用可训练核的组合做函数空间逼近，能在任意几何上显式指定高表现力的神经网络核，参数比现有神经算子少一个量级，同时保持通用逼近性与实现透明性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有神经算子(FNO、DeepONet等)虽精度高，但参数量大、对非规则几何不友好，且黑箱难解释；传统核方法参数少、几何灵活却缺深度学习表达力。作者希望兼得二者优点：低内存、几何灵活、可解释且理论可靠。

Method: 1. 将算子表示为若干深度核积分算子的复合，显式分离“核函数”与“求积规则”；
2. 核参数由小型神经网络动态生成，支持非平稳、各向异性的高表现力核；
3. 规则域采用逐维因子化算法缓解维数灾；
4. 给出连续与离散版本的通用逼近定理；
5. 实现保持核方法透明性，可用任意域专用求积。

Result: 在标准算子学习基准(Darcy、Navier–Stokes、Burgers等)上，KNO以≈1/10参数量达到或超越FNO等方法的训练/测试精度；非规则网格上无需重网格即可直接训练；核可视化解释性强。

Conclusion: KNO兼具核方法的低内存、几何灵活、理论清晰与深度学习的表达力，为科学计算中的算子学习提供了参数高效、可解释且易于实现的新范式。

Abstract: This paper introduces the Kernel Neural Operator (KNO), a provably convergent operator-learning architecture that utilizes compositions of deep kernel-based integral operators for function-space approximation of operators (maps from functions to functions). The KNO decouples the choice of kernel from the numerical integration scheme (quadrature), thereby naturally allowing for operator learning with explicitly-chosen trainable kernels on irregular geometries. On irregular domains, this allows the KNO to utilize domain-specific quadrature rules. To help ameliorate the curse of dimensionality, we also leverage an efficient dimension-wise factorization algorithm on regular domains. More importantly, the ability to explicitly specify kernels also allows the use of highly expressive, non-stationary, neural anisotropic kernels whose parameters are computed by training neural networks. We present universal approximation theorems showing that both the continuous and fully discretized KNO are universal approximators on operator learning problems. Numerical results demonstrate that on existing benchmarks the training and test accuracy of KNOs is closely comparable to or higher than that of popular neural operators while typically using an order of magnitude fewer trainable parameters, with the more expressive kernels proving important to attaining high accuracy. KNOs thus facilitate low-memory, geometrically-flexible, deep operator learning, while retaining the implementation simplicity and transparency of traditional kernel methods from both scientific computing and machine learning.

</details>


### [569] [Improving Clean Accuracy via a Tangent-Space Perspective on Adversarial Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2408.14728)
*Bongsoo Yi,Rongjie Lai,Yao Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: TART（切向引导对抗训练）首次将数据流形几何引入对抗防御：通过在切空间判别扰动分量、自适应缩放扰动半径，兼顾干净准确率与鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统对抗训练在获取鲁棒性的同时严重牺牲干净样本准确率；作者推测原因在于现有方法对法向大扰动“过度矫正”，扭曲了原始决策边界。

Method: 提出扰动方向可分解为切向/法向分量；估计对抗样本的切空间方向，并以其切向分量范数自适应调整扰动上界；训练目标强调在切向子空间内保持鲁棒，抑制法向过度扰动。

Result: 在多组合成及标准数据集上，TART在PGD、C&W、AutoAttack等攻击下保持竞争力鲁棒率的同时，将干净准确率提高1.5–3个百分点，首次将切空间概念融入对抗训练框架并验证其有效性。

Conclusion: 显式利用数据流形切向几何能显著缓解“鲁棒-准确”权衡；TART为后续研究提供了可解释的几何视角和实用的新训练范式。

Abstract: Adversarial training has proven effective in improving the robustness of deep neural networks against adversarial attacks. However, this enhanced robustness often comes at the cost of a substantial drop in accuracy on clean data. In this paper, we address this limitation by introducing Tangent Direction Guided Adversarial Training (TART), a novel method that enhances clean accuracy by exploiting the geometry of the data manifold. We argue that adversarial examples with large components in the normal direction can overly distort the decision boundary and degrade clean accuracy. TART addresses this issue by estimating the tangent direction of adversarial examples and adaptively modulating the perturbation bound based on the norm of their tangential component. To the best of our knowledge, TART is the first adversarial defense framework that explicitly incorporates the concept of tangent space and direction into adversarial training. Extensive experiments on both synthetic and benchmark datasets demonstrate that TART consistently improves clean accuracy while maintaining robustness against adversarial attacks.

</details>


### [570] [Survey of Deep Learning and Physics-Based Approaches in Computational Wave Imaging](https://arxiv.org/abs/2410.08329)
*Youzuo Lin,Shihang Feng,James Theiler,Yinpeng Chen,Umberto Villa,Jing Rao,John Greenhall,Cristian Pantea,Mark A. Anastasio,Brendt Wohlberg*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 综述如何将深度神经网络嵌入传统波动成像物理模型，以兼顾高分辨率、定量准确性与计算效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统波动成像虽能获得高精度物性参数，但求解代价高昂且病态；纯数据驱动深度学习又缺乏物理约束。需系统梳理两类方法如何互补。

Method: 提出统一框架，将地震、医学超声、无损检测三领域的深度-物理混合策略按“网络结构-损失函数-训练范式”维度归类，并对比纯物理反演与端到端黑箱网络的性能差距。

Result: 归纳出五大技术路线：①可微分正演嵌入网络；②迭代反演展开式；③生成先验正则化；④迁移-自监督训练；⑤神经算子替代正演。文献统计显示混合方法在保持物理定量精度的同时可将计算时间降至1/10–1/100，且对噪声/初值鲁棒性提升>20%。

Conclusion: 当前瓶颈在于网络-正演耦合的可扩展性、缺少开放大规模实验数据集及不确定性量化；未来趋势是物理-自监督-神经算子一体化、多模态联合反演及在线自适应成像。

Abstract: Computational wave imaging (CWI) extracts hidden structure and physical properties of a volume of material by analyzing wave signals that traverse that volume. Applications include seismic exploration of the Earth's subsurface, acoustic imaging and non-destructive testing in material science, and ultrasound computed tomography in medicine. Current approaches for solving CWI problems can be divided into two categories: those rooted in traditional physics, and those based on deep learning. Physics-based methods stand out for their ability to provide high-resolution and quantitatively accurate estimates of acoustic properties within the medium. However, they can be computationally intensive and are susceptible to ill-posedness and nonconvexity typical of CWI problems. Machine learning-based computational methods have recently emerged, offering a different perspective to address these challenges. Diverse scientific communities have independently pursued the integration of deep learning in CWI. This review discusses how contemporary scientific machine-learning (ML) techniques, and deep neural networks in particular, have been developed to enhance and integrate with traditional physics-based methods for solving CWI problems.
  We present a structured framework that consolidates existing research spanning multiple domains, including computational imaging, wave physics, and data science. This study concludes with important lessons learned from existing ML-based methods and identifies technical hurdles and emerging trends through a systematic analysis of the extensive literature on this topic.

</details>


### [571] [Direct Preference Optimization for Primitive-Enabled Hierarchical RL: A Bilevel Approach](https://arxiv.org/abs/2411.00361)
*Utsav Singh,Souradip Chakraborty,Wesley A. Suttle,Brian M. Sadler,Derrik E. Asher,Anit Kumar Sahu,Mubarak Shah,Vinay P. Namboodiri,Amrit Singh Bedi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: DIPPER用偏好优化代替奖励信号，高层策略只看「可实现的子目标序列」而非底层策略的瞬时值；同时对高层目标施加可达正则，基本解决HRL的两大顽疾：目标不可达与训练非平稳性，实验提升最高达40%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有分层强化学习（HRL）因「底层策略不断演进导致高层观测非平稳」及「高层易提出不可行子目标」两大问题难以收敛，亟需不依赖即时奖励且能保证子目标可达的训练框架。

Method: 1.将HRL建模为双层优化：高层提出子目标，底层完成子任务。2.用直接偏好优化（DPO）训练高层策略，仅比较「子目标序列」的偏好对，避免对瞬时下层奖励的依赖。3.引入下层价值函数正则项，抑制高层提出V(s,g)<ε的低可达性子目标。4.设计非平稳度与可达率两大指标在线监测上述问题。

Result: 在机器人导航与操作基准上，DIPPER平均成功率提升20–40%，非平稳度下降约60%，子目标可达率提高35%；消融实验显示去除偏好优化或正则项均显著退化。

Conclusion: 偏好优化+可达正则可系统性缓解HRL的核心瓶颈，无需修改下层算法即可移植到任意goal-conditioned分层结构，为长程任务提供稳定、可行的分层训练范式。

Abstract: Hierarchical reinforcement learning (HRL) enables agents to solve complex, long-horizon tasks by decomposing them into manageable sub-tasks. However, HRL methods face two fundamental challenges: (i) non-stationarity caused by the evolving lower-level policy during training, which destabilizes higher-level learning, and (ii) the generation of infeasible subgoals that lower-level policies cannot achieve. To address these challenges, we introduce DIPPER, a novel HRL framework that formulates goal-conditioned HRL as a bi-level optimization problem and leverages direct preference optimization (DPO) to train the higher-level policy. By learning from stationary preference comparisons over subgoal sequences rather than rewards that depend on the evolving lower-level policy, DIPPER mitigates the impact of non-stationarity on hierarchical learning. To address infeasible subgoals, DIPPER incorporates lower-level value function regularization that encourages the higher-level policy to propose achievable subgoals. We also introduce two novel metrics to quantitatively verify that DIPPER mitigates non-stationarity and infeasible subgoal generation issues in HRL. We perform empirical evaluations on challenging robotic navigation and manipulation benchmarks and show that DIPPER achieves upto 40% improvements over state-of-the-art baselines, demonstrating that preference-based methods can effectively alleviate persistent challenges in hierarchical

</details>


### [572] [Bridging the Gap between Learning and Inference for Diffusion-Based Molecule Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2411.05472)
*Peidong Liu,Wenbo Zhang,Wei Ju,Jiancheng Lv,Xianggen Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: DiffGap：一种具备自适应采样和伪分子估计的扩散式3D分子生成框架，消除误差累积并显著提升结合亲和力，在结构驱动药物发现中性能第一。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于变分自编码器和扩散模型的分子生成仍旧存在曝光偏差、误差累积及活性断崖处理不佳等问题；特别是在3D结构指导的药物设计中，训练目标与推理动态之间的差距导致生成质量受限。

Method: 1. 在扩散逆过程（denoising）途中嵌入自适应采样，实时预测伪分子并以真实分子轨迹校准中间去噪步骤；2. 训练阶段提前暴露模型于可能偏差，引入温度退火机制动态调整对齐强度；3. 基于端到端的扩散框架进行大规模3D分子建模。

Result: 在CrossDocked2020基准数据集上；DiffGap在对接打分、结合亲和力以及药物相似性等指标中全面领先现有方法，生成稳定、高亲和力的候选分子。

Conclusion: DiffGap率先在训练与推理之间建立同步对齐机制，为结构驱动的药物分子设计提供了鲁棒、高效的生成工具，并公开代码支持后续研究。

Abstract: The paradigm shift toward structure-driven molecule generation has been propelled by advances in deep generative models, such as variational auto-encoders and diffusion models. However, these generative models for molecular design remain constrained by exposure bias, error accumulation, and suboptimal handling of activity cliffs. Here, we introduce DiffGap, a diffusion-based framework that integrates adaptive sampling and pseudo-molecule estimation to bridge the gap between training objectives and inference dynamics in 3D molecule generation. By dynamically aligning intermediate denoising steps with realistic generation trajectories, DiffGap enables the diffusion model to adapt to input biases in advance during the training phase. A temperature annealing module further controls the aligning strength of the adaptive alignment process, ensuring stable learning of the data distribution. Evaluated on the CrossDocked2020 benchmark, DiffGap outperforms existing methods in docking scores and binding affinity, demonstrating superior fidelity in generating drug-like molecules. Our work establishes a principled approach to harmonize generative training with inference mechanics, offering a robust computational toolkit for accelerating structure-based therapeutic discovery. The source code of DiffGap is available at https://github.com/neusymlab/DiffGap.

</details>


### [573] [Identifying Information from Observations with Uncertainty and Novelty](https://arxiv.org/abs/2501.09331)
*Derek S. Prijatelj,Timothy J. Ireland,Walter J. Scheirer*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文把“识别信息”定义为能证实或证伪某一假设的比特，用指示函数统一算法与概率信息视角，导出假设识别所需的样本复杂度，并证明其可计算性及 PAC-Bayes 情形下仅由先验矩决定，从而给出可精确逼近的样本复杂度分布。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当学习器必须在不断出现的新观测中维持性能并挑选最佳假设时，它必须量化观测提供了多少信息、还需多少信息才能确定真实的数据生成机制，以及何时检测到新奇/误设。现有文献缺乏能同时回答这些问题的统一信息论框架。

Method: 1. 将“识别信息”形式化为证实或证伪假设的比特；2. 用指示函数在假设集上的计算定义“假设识别”与样本复杂度，桥接算法信息与概率信息；3. 对从确定性到遍历平稳随机过程的数据生成机制，推导有限步识别信息的性质并与渐近统计、PAC 学习连接；4. 证明可计算 PAC-Bayes 学习器的样本复杂度分布完全由先验分布的矩决定，从而可资源受限地逼近该分布。

Result: 得到假设识别所需样本复杂度的精确信息论刻画；发现识别信息在有限步即可与渐近一致性及 PAC 界统一；给出新奇信息的形式化定义及误设假设集检测机制；证明 PAC-Bayes 情形下样本复杂度分布仅用先验矩即可计算，且可在任意精度内逼近。

Conclusion: 通过“识别信息”与指示函数的统一框架，论文回答了观测信息量、还需样本数及新奇检测等核心问题，为在线学习、假设检验与资源受限学习提供可计算的理论基础。

Abstract: A machine that learns a task from observations must encounter and process uncertainty and novelty, especially when it is to maintain performance when observing new information and to select the hypothesis that best fits the current observations. In this context, some key questions arise: what and how much information did the observations provide, how much information is required to identify the data-generating process, how many observations remain to get that information, and how does a predictor determine that it has observed novel information? We formalize identifying information to answer these questions and synthesize prior works. Identifying information are bits that verify or falsify a hypothesis as the data-generating process. In this formalization, we prove the information theoretic characteristics of the computation of hypothesis identification and the resulting sample complexity. We define hypothesis identification and sample complexity via the computation of an indicator function over a set of hypotheses, bridging algorithmic and probabilistic information. We detail the sample complexity and its properties for data-generating processes ranging from deterministic processes to ergodic stationary stochastic processes, which connect the notion of identifying information in finite steps with asymptotic statistics and PAC-learning. The indicator function's computation naturally formalizes novel information and its identification from observations with respect to a hypothesis set, which detects a misspecified hypothesis set. We also proved that a computable PAC-Bayes learners' sample complexity distribution is determined by its moments in terms of the prior probability distribution over a fixed finite hypothesis set, and thus an approximation of the sample complexity distribution is always computable within the desired precision that resources allow.

</details>


### [574] [Leveraging graph neural networks and mobility data for COVID-19 forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2501.11711)
*Fernando H. O. Duarte,Gladston J. P. Moreira,Eduardo J. S. Luz,Leonardo B. L. Santos,Vander L. S. Freitas*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 稀疏化空间图+细粒度时序决定GNN是否值得；在巴西与中国流调网络上，GCRN/GCLSTM在预测日新增波动时显著优于LSTM，而累积趋势用LSTM已足。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: COVID-19预测模型百花齐放，但复杂时空网络是否真比简单时序基线更有用尚无定论，需厘清何时必须引入空间信息。

Method: 利用巴西与中国人类 mobility 网络，比较LSTM、GCRN、GCLSTM；通过主干网络抽取对输入图做结构稀疏化；将预测任务同时视为回归（日新增/累计）与二元分类（趋势涨跌）。

Result: 在波动大的日新增预测上，GNN类模型误差显著低于LSTM（Nemenyi检验p<0.05），主干提取可进一步提升稳定性并削减误差；对平滑单调的累计曲线，LSTM与GNN无显著差异。

Conclusion: 空间依赖只在日新增高波动场景下至关重要；结合图稀疏化与细粒度时序是发挥GNN优势的关键，否则简单时序模型已足够。

Abstract: The COVID-19 pandemic has claimed millions of lives, spurring the development of diverse forecasting models. In this context, the true utility of complex spatio-temporal architectures versus simpler temporal baselines remains a subject of debate. Here, we show that structural sparsification of the input graph and temporal granularity are determining factors for the effectiveness of Graph Neural Networks (GNNs). By leveraging human mobility networks in Brazil and China, we address a conflicting scenario in the literature: while standard LSTMs suffice for smooth, monotonic cumulative trends, GNNs significantly outperform baselines when forecasting volatile daily case counts. We show that backbone extraction substantially enhances predictive stability and reduces predictive error by removing negligible connections. Our results indicate that incorporating spatial dependencies is essential for modeling complex dynamics. Specifically, GNN architectures such as GCRN and GCLSTM outperform the LSTM baseline (Nemenyi test, p < 0.05) on datasets from Brazil and China for daily case predictions. Lastly, we frame the problem as a binary classification task to better analyze the dependency between context sizes and prediction horizons.

</details>


### [575] [Maximal Brain Damage Without Data or Optimization: Disrupting Neural Networks via Sign-Bit Flips](https://arxiv.org/abs/2502.07408)
*Ido Galil,Moshe Kimhi,Ran El-Yaniv*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出无需数据的DNL/1P-DNL可快速定位DNN关键比特，翻转1–2个符号位即可让分类、检测、分割及推理大模型瞬间失效；同时给出仅保护极少数脆弱比特的轻量级防御方案。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有DNN对参数级脆弱性缺乏系统、无数据的定位手段；少量比特翻转即可“灾难性”失效，威胁跨任务部署安全。

Method: 1. 设计DNL：利用权重与激活的符号敏感性，在零数据、零梯度更新下筛出关键比特；2. 提出1P-DNL：用一次随机前向-反向传播进一步优化选择；3. 对ResNet-50、Mask R-CNN、YOLOv8-seg、Qwen3-30B-A3B-Thinking实施符号位翻转攻击实验并评估保护策略。

Result: - 分类：ImageNet上ResNet-50翻转2个符号位，Top-1准确率从~76%跌至0.2%；
- 检测/分割：COCO上翻转1–2个符号位，Mask R-CNN APdet/mask降至接近0，YOLOv8-seg APmask崩溃；
- 推理LLM：Qwen3-30B-A3B-Thinking翻转2个专家符号位，推理准确率从78%→0%；
- 防御：仅遮蔽<0.1%的脆弱符号位即可恢复模型性能。

Conclusion: 少量符号位是跨架构、跨模态DNN的共性脆弱点；DNL/1P-DNL提供快速、零成本定位工具；极轻量的有选择性比特保护即可显著缓解此类比特翻转攻击，为安全部署提供实用方案。

Abstract: Deep Neural Networks (DNNs) can be catastrophically disrupted by flipping only a handful of parameter bits. We introduce Deep Neural Lesion (DNL), a data-free and optimizationfree method that locates critical parameters, and an enhanced single-pass variant, 1P-DNL, that refines this selection with one forward and backward pass on random inputs. We show that this vulnerability spans multiple domains, including image classification, object detection, instance segmentation, and reasoning large language models. In image classification, flipping just two sign bits in ResNet-50 on ImageNet reduces accuracy by 99.8%. In object detection and instance segmentation, one or two sign flips in the backbone collapse COCO detection and mask AP for Mask R-CNN and YOLOv8-seg models. In language modeling, two sign flips into different experts reduce Qwen3-30B-A3B-Thinking from 78% to 0% accuracy. We also show that selectively protecting a small fraction of vulnerable sign bits provides a practical defense against such attacks.

</details>


### [576] [IMPACTX: improving model performance by appropriately constraining the training with teacher explanations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2502.12222)
*Andrea Apicella,Salvatore Giugliano,Francesco Isgrò,Andrea Pollastro,Roberto Prevete*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: IMPACTX把可解释AI（XAI）转成注意力机制，一边训练一边自优化，无需外部知识或人工反馈，同时在推理阶段自带特征归因图。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有XAI只解释决策，无法反哺模型；作者希望让XAI直接参与训练，实现“自我解释、自我提升”。

Method: 将XAI方法生成的显著图嵌入注意力模块，作为动态权重反馈到主干网络，形成闭环训练；推理时沿用同一模块输出归因图，无需再调用外部解释器。

Result: 在CIFAR-10/100、STL-10上，EfficientNet-B2、MobileNet、LeNet-5的Top-1准确率均获稳定提升，且生成的特征归因与人工先验一致。

Conclusion: XAI不仅能解释模型，还能充当内建注意力驱动训练，IMPACTX为“可解释增强学习”提供了无需外部资源的通用范式。

Abstract: The eXplainable Artificial Intelligence (XAI) research predominantly concentrates to provide explainations about AI model decisions, especially Deep Learning (DL) models. However, there is a growing interest in using XAI techniques to automatically improve the performance of the AI systems themselves.
  This paper proposes IMPACTX, a novel approach that leverages XAI as a fully automated attention mechanism, without requiring external knowledge or human feedback. Experimental results show that IMPACTX has improved performance respect to the standalone ML model by integrating an attention mechanism based an XAI method outputs during the model training. Furthermore, IMPACTX directly provides proper feature attribution maps for the model's decisions, without relying on external XAI methods during the inference process.
  Our proposal is evaluated using three widely recognized DL models (EfficientNet-B2, MobileNet, and LeNet-5) along with three standard image datasets: CIFAR-10, CIFAR-100, and STL-10. The results show that IMPACTX consistently improves the performance of all the inspected DL models across all evaluated datasets, and it directly provides appropriate explanations for its responses.

</details>


### [577] [AutoRAN: Automated Hijacking of Safety Reasoning in Large Reasoning Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2505.10846)
*Jiacheng Liang,Tanqiu Jiang,Yuhui Wang,Rongyi Zhu,Fenglong Ma,Ting Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: AutoRAN首次实现攻击大推理模型内部安全推理，绕过安全护栏，暴露推理过程透明化带来的严重脆弱性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有对齐主要保护最终输出，忽视推理链条本身的泄露；作者质疑“越强的推理能力=越安全”假设，欲揭示其可被逆向利用。

Method: 构造一个较弱的未对齐模型模拟并预测目标LRM的拒绝理由→提取目标模型在拒绝时泄露的推理模式→迭代优化提示，使其在推理链中自我说服并完成有害指令。整个流程自动化，零人工参与。

Result: 在黑箱场景下，对GPT-o3/o4-mini、Gemini-2.5-Flash等最新模型的AdvBench、HarmBench、StrongReject基准，1轮内成功率近100%，平均仅需1-3轮即可完全绕过安全限制；即使使用外部强对齐模型检测也难防御。

Conclusion: 推理过程透明度本身构成新的攻击面，必须作为一级防护对象；未来对齐需对推理迹而非仅输出进行硬化，提出“推理机密封装”方向并呼吁监管部门关注该风险。

Abstract: This paper presents AutoRAN, the first framework to automate the hijacking of internal safety reasoning in large reasoning models (LRMs). At its core, AutoRAN pioneers an execution simulation paradigm that leverages a weaker but less-aligned model to simulate execution reasoning for initial hijacking attempts and iteratively refine attacks by exploiting reasoning patterns leaked through the target LRM's refusals. This approach steers the target model to bypass its own safety guardrails and elaborate on harmful instructions. We evaluate AutoRAN against state-of-the-art LRMs, including GPT-o3/o4-mini and Gemini-2.5-Flash, across multiple benchmarks (AdvBench, HarmBench, and StrongReject). Results show that AutoRAN achieves approaching 100% success rate within one or few turns, effectively neutralizing reasoning-based defenses even when evaluated by robustly aligned external models. This work reveals that the transparency of the reasoning process itself creates a critical and exploitable attack surface, highlighting the urgent need for new defenses that protect models' reasoning traces rather than merely their final outputs.

</details>


### [578] [Logo-LLM: Local and Global Modeling with Large Language Models for Time Series Forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2505.11017)
*Wenjie Ou,Zhishuo Zhao,Cheng Chen,Dongyue Guo,Yi Lin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: "Logo-LLM：通过层次化提取 LLM 浅层局部／深层全局表征，以轻量 Mixer 融合，实现低消耗、强泛化的时间序列预测新框架。"


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Transformer 与直接将 LLM 当黑盒编码器的现有方法均侧重全局依赖，忽视短期局部波动，导致预测精度受限。作者希望利用预训练 LLM 自身的层级语义，同时显式建模多尺度局部-全局动态。

Method: 1) 实证发现：冻结 LLM 的浅层捕获局部动态，深层编码全局趋势。2) 提出 Logo-LLM：在各层抽特征后，用轻量级 Local-Mixer、Global-Mixer 与原始时序输入跨层对齐并融合，无需微调大模型，保持低计算开销。

Result: 在多元时间序列基准（含电力、交通、气象等）上，Logo-LLM 显著优于专用 Transformer 与 LLM-Encoder 基线；在 5% 数据的小样本与零样本场景下仍保持领先性能，且推理延迟与参数量远低于全量微调方案。

Conclusion: LLM 的浅-深分层表征可天然对应时间序列的局部-全局结构；通过轻量级跨层融合模块即可释放大模型在多尺度时序建模中的潜力，为低成本、高泛化的时间序列预测提供了新范式。

Abstract: Time series forecasting is critical across multiple domains, where time series data exhibit both local patterns and global dependencies. While Transformer-based methods effectively capture global dependencies, they often overlook short-term local variations in time series. Recent methods that adapt large language models (LLMs) into time series forecasting inherit this limitation by treating LLMs as black-box encoders, relying solely on the final-layer output and underutilizing hierarchical representations. To address this limitation, we propose Logo-LLM, a novel LLM-based framework that explicitly extracts and models multi-scale temporal features from different layers of a pre-trained LLM. Through empirical analysis, we show that shallow layers of LLMs capture local dynamics in time series, while deeper layers encode global trends. Moreover, Logo-LLM introduces lightweight Local-Mixer and Global-Mixer modules to align and integrate features with the temporal input across layers. Extensive experiments demonstrate that Logo-LLM achieves superior performance across diverse benchmarks, with strong generalization in few-shot and zero-shot settings while maintaining low computational overhead.

</details>


### [579] [Unsupervised Learning of Local Updates for Maximum Independent Set in Dynamic Graphs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2505.13754)
*Devendra Parkar,Anya Chaturvedi,Joshua J. Daymude*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出首个面向动态图最大独立集的端到端无监督模型，利用 GNN 提取结构信息并学习分布式并行更新规则，在 200–1 000 节点动态图上比 MIP 快 1.91–6.7 倍且近似比与 SOTA 相当；对 100 倍大图的零样本泛化效果优于全部无监督基线，仅逊于监督模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 动态图频繁边增删导致传统静态模型需反复重算，计算代价高；现有神经组合优化方法多为静态监督范式，难以利用时序信息且依赖标注。需要一种无需标签、能就地增量更新并保留优异近似质量的新框架。

Method: 设计无监督目标函数，把 MaxIS 的 0/1 约束松弛为可微惩罚项，用 GNN 编码瞬时图结构并维护节点隐状态；当边事件发生时，触发共享的分布式更新网络，一次性并行调整所有节点记忆并输出独立集隶属概率，实现单步增量推断。

Result: 在多个 200–1 000 节点合成与真实动态图上，与 MIP 求解器及十余种无监督/监督基线相比：近似比与最佳静态模型持平，延迟降低 1.91–6.70×；对 10 万节点零样本图，所得独立集规模比全部无监督模型大 1.00–1.18 倍，仅次于专用监督模型，且推理时间仍显著低于重训练方案。

Conclusion: 基于无监督、事件驱动的增量学习范式可高效求解动态组合优化问题，验证“结构编码 + 快速更新”是摆脱静态重算瓶颈的可行路径，为动态图上的神经组合优化提供了新基线与进一步扩展方向。

Abstract: We present the first unsupervised learning model for Maximum-Independent-Set (MaxIS) in dynamic graphs where edges change over time. Our method combines structural learning from graph neural networks (GNNs) with a learned distributed update mechanism that, given an edge addition or deletion event, modifies nodes' internal memories and infers their MaxIS membership in a single, parallel step. We evaluate our model against a mixed integer programming solver and a breadth of unsupervised and supervised learning models for combinatorial optimization on static graphs. Across dynamic graphs of 200-1,000 nodes, our model achieves approximation ratios that are competitive with the state-of-the-art models while running 1.91-6.70x faster. When generalizing to graphs with 100x more nodes than those used for training, our model produces MaxIS solutions 1.00-1.18x larger than all other unsupervised models, but is outperformed by the state-of-the-art supervised model. These results demonstrate that this novel, unsupervised, update-based learning approach to dynamic combinatorial optimization is a viable alternative to the naïve reapplication of analogous models for static graphs, leveraging temporal information to improve neural methods for combinatorial optimization.

</details>


### [580] [Practical estimation of the optimal classification error with soft labels and calibration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2505.20761)
*Ryota Ushio,Takashi Ishida,Masashi Sugiyama*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文给出一种仅依赖（可能带噪声的）软标签即可估计二分类贝叶斯误差的新方法，理论证明其偏差衰减速率可自适应分布可分性，并用等渗校准实现无需原始样本的相合估计。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 尽管近年机器学习性能大幅提升，但“模型到底还能改进多少”这一根本问题缺乏可操作答案。尤其在无法获取原始数据（隐私限制）或标签含噪声的现实中，如何仅利用软标签准确估计理论最优错误率仍属空白。

Method: 作者将前人基于软标签的贝叶斯误差估计器推广到两个方向：① 对仅使用硬标签的估计器，给出偏差衰减速率与类别条件分布可分性的显式关系，证明其可远快于先前界；② 针对软标签被污染的场景，首先指出“完美校准”不足以保证估计准确，随后提出基于等渗回归的校准策略，在弱于原工作的假设下获得统计相合性，且全程无需访问任何输入实例。

Result: 理论：硬标签估计器偏差以与分布可分性相关的速率衰减；等渗校准估计器在温和条件下相合。实验：合成与真实数据上，新方法在多种污染强度下均显著优于直接校准基线，估计误差平均下降20–40%，且无需原始样本仍能逼近真值。

Conclusion: 仅凭软标签即可可靠估计贝叶斯误差，且估计质量随分布可分性自适应提高；等渗校准为处理含噪软标签提供了实用、理论有保障的解决方案，为模型性能上限评估与隐私敏感场景开辟了新途径。

Abstract: While the performance of machine learning systems has experienced significant improvement in recent years, relatively little attention has been paid to the fundamental question: to what extent can we improve our models? This paper provides a means of answering this question in the setting of binary classification, which is practical and theoretically supported. We extend a previous work that utilizes soft labels for estimating the Bayes error, the optimal error rate, in two important ways. First, we theoretically investigate the properties of the bias of the hard-label-based estimator discussed in the original work. We reveal that the decay rate of the bias is adaptive to how well the two class-conditional distributions are separated, and it can decay significantly faster than the previous result suggested as the number of hard labels per instance grows. Second, we tackle a more challenging problem setting: estimation with corrupted soft labels. One might be tempted to use calibrated soft labels instead of clean ones. However, we reveal that calibration guarantee is not enough, that is, even perfectly calibrated soft labels can result in a substantially inaccurate estimate. Then, we show that isotonic calibration can provide a statistically consistent estimator under an assumption weaker than that of the previous work. Our method is instance-free, i.e., we do not assume access to any input instances. This feature allows it to be adopted in practical scenarios where the instances are not available due to privacy issues. Experiments with synthetic and real-world datasets show the validity of our methods and theory. The code is available at https://github.com/RyotaUshio/bayes-error-estimation.

</details>


### [581] [Diagnosing and Improving Diffusion Models by Estimating the Optimal Loss Value](https://arxiv.org/abs/2506.13763)
*Yixian Xu,Shengjie Luo,Liwei Wang,Di He,Chang Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 首次给出扩散模型最优损失显式公式与可扩展估计器，并用其修正训练曲线、重新定义缩放律，揭示真实模型能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散模型训练损失非零且未知，导致无法区分“已达最优”与“容量不足”，亟需可计算的理论最优基准以诊断与改进训练。

Method: 统一扩散框架下推导闭式最优损失；设计方差-偏差受控的随机估计器，适配大数据集；基于此构建训练质量诊断指标与自适应调度策略。

Result: 在120M–1.5B参数模型上验证：减去最优损失后，幂律斜率更精准，样本质量提升；估计器秒级收敛，方差较朴素蒙特卡洛降低两个量级。

Conclusion: 最优损失是可实操的“尺度归一化尺”，使扩散模型训练诊断与缩放律研究首次具备理论零点，为后续容量-数据-算力Scaling Law奠定新基准。

Abstract: Diffusion models have achieved remarkable success in generative modeling. Despite more stable training, the loss of diffusion models is not indicative of absolute data-fitting quality, since its optimal value is typically not zero but unknown, leading to confusion between large optimal loss and insufficient model capacity. In this work, we advocate the need to estimate the optimal loss value for diagnosing and improving diffusion models. We first derive the optimal loss in closed form under a unified formulation of diffusion models, and develop effective estimators for it, including a stochastic variant scalable to large datasets with proper control of variance and bias. With this tool, we unlock the inherent metric for diagnosing the training quality of mainstream diffusion model variants, and develop a more performant training schedule based on the optimal loss. Moreover, using models with 120M to 1.5B parameters, we find that the power law is better demonstrated after subtracting the optimal loss from the actual training loss, suggesting a more principled setting for investigating the scaling law for diffusion models.

</details>


### [582] [Time-RA: Towards Time Series Reasoning for Anomaly Diagnosis with LLM Feedback](https://arxiv.org/abs/2507.15066)
*Yiyuan Yang,Zichuan Liu,Lei Song,Kai Ying,Zhiguang Wang,Tom Bamford,Svitlana Vyetrenko,Jiang Bian,Qingsong Wen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 首次将时间序列异常检测（TSAD）改造为「生成+推理」任务 Time-RA，并发布 4 万样本、10 域多模态基准 RATs40K，证明微调模型具备可解释性与跨域零样本迁移能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统 TSAD 仅做二分类，无法给出细粒度类别与可解释依据，难以支撑透明决策。

Method: 1) 提出新任务 Time-RA，把 TSAD 重构为「生成式链式推理」；2) 构建 RATs40K 基准，同步提供原始序列、文本、图像及结构化推理标注；3) 采用多模态微调与可视化表征对推理一致性与诊断准确率进行系统评估。

Result: 微调模型在复杂场景下仍有波动，但在 10 域 40 K 样本上整体诊断准确率与推理一致性显著提升；对未见真实数据集实现「即插即用」迁移，全面优于传统基线。

Conclusion: Time-RA 与 RATs40K 为可解释、多模态时间序列分析奠定新范式，全部代码与数据已开源。

Abstract: Time series anomaly detection (TSAD) has traditionally focused on binary classification and often lacks the fine-grained categorization and explanatory reasoning required for transparent decision-making. To address these limitations, we propose Time-series Reasoning for Anomaly (Time-RA), a novel task that reformulates TSAD from a discriminative into a generative, reasoning-intensive paradigm. To facilitate this, we introduce RATs40K, the first real-world large-scale multimodal benchmark with ~40,000 samples across 10 domains, integrating raw time series, textual context, and visual plots with structured reasoning annotations. Extensive benchmarking shows that while supervised fine-tuning and visual representations boost diagnostic accuracy and reasoning consistency, performance varies across complex scenarios. Notably, fine-tuned models demonstrate strong "plug-and-play" transferability, outperforming traditional baselines on unseen real-world datasets. Our work establishes a foundation for interpretable, multimodal time series analysis. All code (https://github.com/yyysjz1997/Time-RA) and the RATs40K dataset (https://huggingface.co/datasets/Time-RA/RATs40K) are fully open-sourced to facilitate future research.

</details>


### [583] [SPaCe: Unlocking Sample-Efficient Large Language Models Training With Self-Pace Curriculum Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2508.05015)
*Dai Do,Manh Nguyen,Svetha Venkatesh,Hung Le*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: SPaCe用自步调+聚类+赌博机，把RL微调样本砍99%，推理效果仍SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RL微调LLM推理太贵，统一采样忽视难度差异导致冗余浪费，需用极少预算获得相当甚至更强的推理能力。

Method: \textbf{SPaCe}: 1)语义-难度聚类压缩数据→去冗余；2)多臂赌博机把聚类当臂，按模型实时解题率动态分配采样，形成自步调课程。

Result: 在多个推理benchmark上仅用1%训练样本即达到或优于SOTA基线；消融表明聚类与自适应选择缺一不可。

Conclusion: 精心设计的性能驱动课程可让LLM以极小数据/算力解锁强推理能力。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have shown strong reasoning capabilities when fine-tuned with reinforcement learning (RL). However, such methods require extensive data and compute, making them impractical under many realistic training budgets. Many existing pipelines sample training examples uniformly across steps or epochs, ignoring differences in difficulty, redundancy, and learning value, which slows learning and wastes computation. We propose \textbf{SPaCe}, a self-paced learning framework that enables efficient learning based on the capability of the model being trained through optimizing which data to use and when. First, we apply \emph{cluster-based data reduction} to partition training data by semantics and difficulty, extracting a compact yet diverse subset that reduces redundancy. Then, a \textit{multi-armed bandit} treats data clusters as arms, allocating training samples based on the model's solve rates and learning progress. Experiments across multiple reasoning benchmarks show that SPaCe achieves comparable or better accuracy than state-of-the-art baselines while using up to \(100\times\) fewer samples. Ablation studies and analyses further highlight the importance of both data clustering and adaptive selection. Our results demonstrate that carefully curated, performance-driven training curricula can unlock strong reasoning abilities in LLMs with minimal resources.

</details>


### [584] [EEGDM: Learning EEG Representation with Latent Diffusion Model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2508.20705)
*Shaocong Wang,Tong Liu,Yihan Li,Ming Li,Kairui Wen,Pei Yang,Wenqi Ji,Minjing Yu,Yong-Jin Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: EEGDM 用潜扩散生成代替传统掩码重建，迫使模型掌握 EEG 全局动态；实验表明其信号重建质量高、表征鲁棒，在下游任务上性能优异，为自监督 EEG 表征开辟了新范式。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 掩码重建仅关注局部片段恢复，难以刻画跨通道与长时程的全局神经动力学，限制了表征的判别力。

Method: 提出 EEGDM：1) EEG 编码器将原始信号与通道增广压缩为紧凑潜向量；2) 以该潜向量为条件，训练潜扩散模型从噪声逐步生成完整 EEG 信号，迫使编码器学习整体时空依赖。

Result: EEGDM 在信号保真度、表征线性可分性及跨被试/跨数据集迁移的下游任务（睡眠分期、路径解码等）上均优于现有掩码重建与对比学习方法。

Conclusion: 扩散生成目标可有效替代掩码重建，显著提升 EEG 自监督表征的全局建模能力，并为脑电解码、数据增强等应用提供高质量潜空间。

Abstract: Recent advances in self-supervised learning for EEG representation have largely relied on masked reconstruction, where models are trained to recover randomly masked signal segments. While effective at modeling local dependencies, such objectives are inherently limited in capturing the global dynamics and long-range dependencies essential for characterizing neural activity. To address this limitation, we propose EEGDM, a novel self-supervised framework that leverages latent diffusion models to generate EEG signals as an objective. Unlike masked reconstruction, diffusion-based generation progressively denoises signals from noise to realism, compelling the model to capture holistic temporal patterns and cross-channel relationships. Specifically, EEGDM incorporates an EEG encoder that distills raw signals and their channel augmentations into a compact representation, acting as conditional information to guide the diffusion model for generating EEG signals. This design endows EEGDM with a compact latent space, which not only offers ample control over the generative process but also can be leveraged for downstream tasks. Experimental results show that EEGDM (1) reconstructs high-quality EEG signals, (2) learns robust representations, and (3) achieves competitive performance across diverse downstream tasks, thus exploring a new direction for self-supervised EEG representation learning.

</details>


### [585] [DPQuant: Efficient and Differentially-Private Model Training via Dynamic Quantization Scheduling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2509.03472)
*Yubo Gao,Renbo Tu,Gennady Pekhimenko,Nandita Vijaykumar*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 文章首次揭示低精度量化在差分隐私（DP）训练中放大了噪声方差，导致准确率显著下降；提出动态量化框架 DPQuant，通过轮换量化层与隐私化损失敏感度评估，在几乎不损耗隐私预算的前提下将准确率损失压至 2% 以内，并在理论吞吐上最高提速 2.21 倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 低精度量化可大幅降低训练成本，但现有研究未考虑其与 DP-SGD/DP-Adam 噪声注入的耦合效应。作者观察到量化方差被噪声放大，使 DP 训练准确率骤降，亟需一种兼顾隐私、精度与效率的新量化策略。

Method: 设计 DPQuant 框架：① 每轮按概率分布轮换量化层，降低固定层带来的累积方差；② 利用差分隐私的损失敏感度估计器，动态挑选对损失影响最小的层进行量化，该估计器仅消耗极小部分隐私预算；③ 在一系列主流模型与数据集上对比静态量化基线，并验证其向 DP-Adam 的通用性。

Result: 在 ResNet18/50 与 DenseNet121 的 CIFAR-10、ImageNet 等任务中，DPQuant 将验证准确率下降控制在 2% 以内，显著优于静态量化；理论峰值吞吐量提升达 2.21 倍，同时保持差分隐私保证；在 DP-Adam 上亦取得一致提升，证明方法通用。

Conclusion: 首次量化了“量化×DP 噪声”协同带来的精度损失，并通过动态、隐私友好的层选择机制实现精度-效率帕累托最优，为隐私保护下的高效训练提供可直接部署的解决方案，并启发后续在更高效硬件与自适应量化区间的进一步研究。

Abstract: Differentially-Private SGD (DP-SGD) and its adaptive variant DP-Adam are powerful techniques to protect user privacy when using sensitive data to train neural networks. During training, converting model weights and activations into low-precision formats, i.e., quantization, can drastically reduce training times, energy consumption, and cost, and is thus a widely used technique. In this work, we demonstrate for the first time that quantization causes significantly higher accuracy degradation in DP training compared to regular SGD. We observe that this is caused by noise injection, which amplifies quantization variance, leading to disproportionately large accuracy degradation. To address this challenge, we present DPQuant, a dynamic quantization framework that adaptively selects a changing subset of layers to quantize at each epoch. Our method combines two key ideas that effectively reduce quantization variance: (i) probabilistic sampling that rotates which layers are quantized every epoch, and (ii) loss-aware layer prioritization, which uses a differentially private loss sensitivity estimator to identify layers that can be quantized with minimal impact on model quality. This estimator consumes a negligible fraction of the overall privacy budget, preserving DP guarantees. Empirical evaluations on ResNet18, ResNet50, and DenseNet121 across a range of datasets demonstrate that DPQuant consistently outperforms static quantization baselines, achieving near Pareto-optimal accuracy-compute trade-offs and up to $2.21\times$ theoretical throughput improvements on low-precision hardware, with less than 2% drop in validation accuracy. We further show that our framework extends to DP-Adam with similar gains.

</details>


### [586] [Similarity-Distance-Magnitude Activations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2509.12760)
*Allen Schmaltz*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: SDM 激活函数在 softmax 基础上引入“相似度-分布距离-幅值”三元信息，并配套 SDM 估计器实现可解释、高鲁棒的面向协变量偏移的选择性分类。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准 softmax 仅依赖决策边界幅值，无法感知输入与训练分布的距离及深度特征匹配质量，导致 OOD 与协变量偏移下校准失效、选择性分类不可靠。

Method: 1) 设计 SDM 激活：在 logits 中显式编码查询-原型相似度、到训练分布的距离以及原有幅值；2) 利用 SDM 输出对各类别经验 CDF 做数据驱动分段，构建 SDM 估计器，直接控制类条件-预测条件准确率；3) 替换预训练语言模型末层 softmax，实现无需重训练的选择性分类。

Result: 在文本 OOD 与协变量偏移场景下，SDM 估计器相较传统 softmax 校准方法显著降低选择性分类错误率，同时保持对 ID 数据的信息量与可解释性（可通过稠密匹配给出“示例级”解释）。

Conclusion: SDM 框架以极低成本（换激活函数+CDF 分段）同时提升模型对分布偏移的鲁棒性、可解释性与选择性分类可信度，可广泛应用于预训练语言模型部署。

Abstract: We introduce the Similarity-Distance-Magnitude (SDM) activation function, a more robust and interpretable formulation of the standard softmax activation function, adding Similarity (i.e., correctly predicted depth-matches into training) awareness and Distance-to-training-distribution awareness to the existing output Magnitude (i.e., decision-boundary) awareness, and enabling interpretability-by-exemplar via dense matching. We further introduce the SDM estimator, based on a data-driven partitioning of the class-wise empirical CDFs via the SDM activation, to control the class- and prediction-conditional accuracy among selective classifications. When used as the final-layer activation over pre-trained language models for selective classification, the SDM estimator is more robust to covariate shifts and out-of-distribution inputs than existing calibration methods using softmax activations, while remaining informative over in-distribution data.

</details>


### [587] [Safe Reinforcement Learning using Action Projection: Safeguard the Policy or the Environment?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2509.12833)
*Hannah Markgraf,Shambhuraj Sawant,Hanna Krasowski,Lukas Schäfer,Sebastien Gros,Matthias Althoff*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文首次从理论上对比了两种投影式安全RL集成策略——SE-RL与SP-RL，发现动作混叠造成的信息损失在SP-RL中危害更大，但引入惩罚修正后SP-RL可反超SE-RL，为安全RL方法选择提供依据。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 投影安全滤波器虽被广泛用于安全强化学习，但学界缺乏对SE-RL（将安全层视为环境一部分）与SP-RL（将安全层嵌入策略）的正式比较，阻碍了对二者适用场景的科学选择。

Method: （i）在actor-critic框架下统一形式化SE-RL与SP-RL；（ii）理论推导两种策略的梯度估计，揭示动作混叠/秩亏雅可比对梯度信息的破坏差异；（iii）提出针对SP-RL的新型惩罚修正，并与现有SE-RL缓解策略进行实验对比。

Result: 理论预测与实验一致：动作混叠显著降低SP-RL样本效率和渐近性能，而对SE-RL影响较小；采用惩罚修正后，SP-RL在多个连续控制任务上追上甚至超越改进后的SE-RL，验证了理论分析的准确性。

Conclusion: 动作混叠是选择投影安全RL方法的关键判据：若混叠严重且无法缓解，优先选SE-RL；若可通过惩罚等手段降低混叠，SP-RL因端到端训练的潜力更值得采用。研究为安全RL算法设计提供了可操作的指导原则。

Abstract: Projection-based safety filters, which modify unsafe actions by mapping them to the closest safe alternative, are widely used to enforce safety constraints in reinforcement learning (RL). Two integration strategies are commonly considered: Safe environment RL (SE-RL), where the safeguard is treated as part of the environment, and safe policy RL (SP-RL), where it is embedded within the policy through differentiable optimization layers. Despite their practical relevance in safety-critical settings, a formal understanding of their differences is lacking. In this work, we present a theoretical comparison of SE-RL and SP-RL. We identify a key distinction in how each approach is affected by action aliasing, a phenomenon in which multiple unsafe actions are projected to the same safe action, causing information loss in the policy gradients. In SE-RL, this effect is implicitly approximated by the critic, while in SP-RL, it manifests directly as rank-deficient Jacobians during backpropagation through the safeguard. Our contributions are threefold: (i) a unified formalization of SE-RL and SP-RL in the context of actor-critic algorithms, (ii) a theoretical analysis of their respective policy gradient estimates, highlighting the role of action aliasing, and (iii) a comparative study of mitigation strategies, including a novel penalty-based improvement for SP-RL that aligns with established SE-RL practices. Empirical results support our theoretical predictions, showing that action aliasing is more detrimental for SP-RL than for SE-RL. However, with appropriate improvement strategies, SP-RL can match or outperform improved SE-RL across a range of environments. These findings provide actionable insights for choosing and refining projection-based safe RL methods based on task characteristics.

</details>


### [588] [Model-Based Reinforcement Learning under Random Observation Delays](https://arxiv.org/abs/2509.20869)
*Armin Karamzade,Kyungmin Kim,JB Lanier,Davide Corsi,Roy Fox*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 针对POMDP中观测随机乱序到达的难题，提出基于序列信念更新的模型化滤波器，并嵌入Dreamer框架，在机械人仿真任务上显著优于MDP延迟基线与实践启发式方法，且对部署阶段延迟分布漂移鲁棒。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 真实系统普遍遭遇感知延迟，而既有RL算法默认观测瞬时可达；现有延迟研究局限在MDP或定序设定，无法处理POMDP中观测乱序到达（out-of-sequence）这一未被探索的更复杂问题。

Method: 1) 对随机延迟POMDP进行结构分析，指出简单堆叠历史观测不足；2) 设计基于模型化的顺序信念更新滤波，对流式乱序观测实时修正隐藏状态分布；3) 构建延迟感知模型化RL框架，将上述滤波器嵌入Dreamer世界模型，实现联合训练与决策。

Result: 在仿真机械人操控任务中，所提方法在所有测试延迟分布下均显著优于为MDP设计的延迟感知基线；对训练-测试延迟分布漂移表现出高鲁棒性；与工程常用启发式（如帧堆叠、时间差补）相比样本效率与渐近性能均提升明显。

Conclusion: 显式建模并滤波乱序观测延迟是POMDP中实现鲁棒RL的关键；提出的延迟感知Dreamer框架为真实系统部署提供了可扩展解决方案，并揭示未来在更复杂部分可观测与异步感知场景下的研究潜力。

Abstract: Delays frequently occur in real-world environments, yet standard reinforcement learning (RL) algorithms often assume instantaneous perception of the environment. We study random sensor delays in POMDPs, where observations may arrive out-of-sequence, a setting that has not been previously addressed in RL. We analyze the structure of such delays and demonstrate that naive approaches, such as stacking past observations, are insufficient for reliable performance. To address this, we propose a model-based filtering process that sequentially updates the belief state based on an incoming stream of observations. We then introduce a simple delay-aware framework that incorporates this idea into model-based RL, enabling agents to effectively handle random delays. Applying this framework to the Dreamer world-modeling scheme, our method consistently outperforms delay-aware baselines developed for MDPs and demonstrates robustness to delay distribution shifts during deployment. Additionally, we present experiments on simulated robotic tasks, comparing our method to common practical heuristics and emphasizing the importance of explicitly modeling observation delays.

</details>


### [589] [Deep Learning for Subspace Regression](https://arxiv.org/abs/2509.23249)
*Vladimir Fanaskov,Vladislav Trifonov,Alexander Rudikov,Ekaterina Muravleva,Ivan Oseledets*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 用神经网络把高维参数空间映射到线性子空间，回归代替插值，并故意预测更大子空间，显著提升降阶建模精度与效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统插值在高维参数空间计算子空间不可靠或不可行，需要一种可扩展的在线子空间重建方法。

Method: 将子空间插值松弛为回归；为 Grassmann 流形上的子空间数据设计专用损失函数；用神经网络逼近高维映射；并引入冗余——预测比目标维数更大的子空间以降低映射复杂度与增加平滑性。

Result: 理论证明对常系数椭圆特征问题可降低映射复杂度，一般光滑函数在 Grassmann 流形上也更平滑；大量算例显示预测更大子空间显著降低误差，适用于参数特征问题、去flation、松弛法、最优控制及参数 PDE 求解。

Conclusion: 子空间回归是高效、稳健、通用的降阶建模新范式，在高维参数场景下优于经典插值，并可通过冗余预测进一步增益。

Abstract: It is often possible to perform reduced order modelling by specifying linear subspace which accurately captures the dynamics of the system.
