TL;DR: 多向量检索模型ColBERT-v2/ConstBERT在短查询上看似可复现，却在长叙事查询上骤降86–97%；失效根因是MaxSim算子结构缺陷，而非调参不足。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有再现实验多聚焦数值指标，忽视架构鲁棒性，尤其在查询长度变化场景。作者质疑“只要微调即可弥补”的假设，主张从架构层面检验模型局限。

Method: 在MS-MARCO与TREC ToT-2025两类数据上，沿五维度（指标、查询长度、词权重、后端超参、训练规模）系统评估；并通过消融实验锁定MaxSim统一token权重机制，量化20词性能天花板，再对比centroid覆盖率及数据增训效果。

Result: 1)ConstBERT在短查询MRR@10仅差0.05%，却在长查询跌86–97%；2)MaxSim对20词后信号-噪声无区分导致性能饱和；3)后端未公开参数差异带来8个百分点；4)3×数据增训反降29%。

Conclusion: 多向量检索的架构瓶颈无法靠后续调参与增训根除，需重新设计token加权与表征机制，可复现性研究必须把“架构鲁棒性”列为核心指标。

Abstract: Reproducibility must validate architectural robustness, not just numerical accuracy. We evaluate ColBERT-v2 and ConstBERT across five dimensions, finding that while ConstBERT reproduces within 0.05% MRR@10 on MS-MARCO, both models show a drop of 86-97% on long, narrative queries (TREC ToT 2025). Ablations prove this failure is architectural: performance plateaus at 20 words because the MaxSim operator's uniform token weighting cannot distinguish signal from filler noise. Furthermore, undocumented backend parameters create an 8-point gap due to ConstBERT's sparse centroid coverage, and fine-tuning with 3x more data actually degrades performance by up to 29%. We conclude that architectural constraints in multi-vector retrieval cannot be overcome by adaptation alone. Code: https://github.com/utshabkg/multi-vector-reproducibility.

</details>


### [663] [A Queueing-Theoretic Framework for Dynamic Attack Surfaces: Data-Integrated Risk Analysis and Adaptive Defense](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.10427)
*Jihyeon Yun,Abdullah Yasin Etcibasi,Ming Shi,C. Emre Koksal*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 把活跃漏洞视作排队系统待处理任务，引入AI放大因子刻画自动化攻防双方速率，证明重尾补丁时间触发漏洞队列的长程依赖，再以带预算/切换成本的马尔可夫决策过程+强化学习给出90%漏洞削减且成本不增的最优防御策略。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着软件供应链规模扩大，漏洞到达与补丁延时呈现重尾分布，导致持续高暴露风险；传统静态或周期性防御无法贴身跟随时变攻击面，需要一种能定量刻画漏洞积压动态、并据此给出可证高效自适应决策的理论框架。

Method: 1)排队建模：将漏洞生灭过程建模为M/G/∞-类队列，提出AI放大因子同时扩缩到达、利用、修补三率；2)实证验证：用开源供应链（ARVO）漏洞数据校准模型，发现补丁时间服从重尾分布→队列呈长程依赖；3)优化决策：把动态防御问题转为带资源预算与切换成本的CMDP，设计兼具探索-利用的强化学习算法，理论证明其遗憾度接近最优。

Result: 理论证明即使是完全对称的自动化也会提高成功利用速率；重尾服务时间必然诱导漏洞队列长程依赖；RL策略在迹驱动实验中将软件供应链平均活跃漏洞数削减>90%，总维护成本不增，累积暴露时间显著下降。

Conclusion: 排队视角可量化攻击面动态与累积暴露，揭示重尾补丁延时是持续网络风险的微观根源；基于CMDP的自适应强化学习防御可在不增加预算条件下实现近最优漏洞抑制，为实际运维提供了可证高效的风险治理范式。

Abstract: We develop a queueing-theoretic framework to model the temporal evolution of cyber-attack surfaces, where the number of active vulnerabilities is represented as the backlog of a queue. Vulnerabilities arrive as they are discovered or created, and leave the system when they are patched or successfully exploited. Building on this model, we study how automation affects attack and defense dynamics by introducing an AI amplification factor that scales arrival, exploit, and patching rates. Our analysis shows that even symmetric automation can increase the rate of successful exploits. We validate the model using vulnerability data collected from an open source software supply chain and show that it closely matches real-world attack surface dynamics. Empirical results reveal heavy-tailed patching times, which we prove induce long-range dependence in vulnerability backlog and help explain persistent cyber risk. Utilizing our queueing abstraction for the attack surface, we develop a systematic approach for cyber risk mitigation. We formulate the dynamic defense problem as a constrained Markov decision process with resource-budget and switching-cost constraints, and develop a reinforcement learning (RL) algorithm that achieves provably near-optimal regret. Numerical experiments validate the approach and demonstrate that our adaptive RL-based defense policies significantly reduce successful exploits and mitigate heavy-tail queue events. Using trace-driven experiments on the ARVO dataset, we show that the proposed RL-based defense policy reduces the average number of active vulnerabilities in a software supply chain by over 90% compared to existing defense practices, without increasing the overall maintenance budget. Our results allow defenders to quantify cumulative exposure risk under long-range dependent attack dynamics and to design adaptive defense strategies with provable efficiency.

</details>


### [664] [Revisiting Compositionality in Dual-Encoder Vision-Language Models: The Role of Inference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.11496)
*Imanol Miranda,Ander Salaberria,Eneko Agirre,Gorka Azkune*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 仅用冻结的双编码器，但通过轻量级Transformer学习局部图文块对齐，就能在组合任务上超过全局余弦匹配和全微调，且对分布外数据更鲁棒。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: CLIP类双编码器被批为“词袋”模型，在组合语义基准上表现差；作者怀疑问题不在表征而在推理阶段的全局余弦相似度匹配。

Method: 1)诊断实验：冻结编码器，仅把图像块与文本片段强制对齐，验证组合性能可大幅提升；2)提出轻量级Transformer，直接基于冻结的patch/token嵌入学习局部对齐，无需更新主干。

Result: 局部对齐在域内检索持平全微调，但在分布外组合基准上显著优于全微调及以往端到端组合训练方法；全局匹配被确认为性能瓶颈。

Conclusion: 全局嵌入匹配是双编码器VLM组合泛化的关键瓶颈；在冻结表示上学习局部对齐机制，即可实现强泛化且无需昂贵微调。

Abstract: Dual-encoder Vision-Language Models (VLMs) such as CLIP are often characterized as bag-of-words systems due to their poor performance on compositional benchmarks. We argue that this limitation may stem less from deficient representations than from the standard inference protocol based on global cosine similarity. First, through controlled diagnostic experiments, we show that explicitly enforcing fine-grained region-segment alignment at inference dramatically improves compositional performance without updating pretrained encoders. We then introduce a lightweight transformer that learns such alignments directly from frozen patch and token embeddings. Comparing against full fine-tuning and prior end-to-end compositional training methods, we find that although these approaches improve in-domain retrieval, their gains do not consistently transfer under distribution shift. In contrast, learning localized alignment over frozen representations matches full fine-tuning on in-domain retrieval while yielding substantial improvements on controlled out-of-domain compositional benchmarks. These results identify global embedding matching as a key bottleneck in dual-encoder VLMs and highlight the importance of alignment mechanisms for robust compositional generalization.

</details>


### [665] [The Spectrascapes Dataset: Street-view imagery beyond the visible captured using a mobile platform](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.13315)
*Akshit Gupta,Joris Timmermans,Filip Biljecki,Remko Uijlenhoet*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出并开源了首个多光谱街景数据集 Spectrascapes，含 1.77 万张 RGB+近红外+热红外自行车影像，解决现有城市监测数据在时空分辨率、可扩展性及光谱维度上的局限。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 城市气候韧性研究亟需高时空分辨率且可扩展的多维数据，而人工巡查、地面传感器、遥感及普通街景 RGB 均存在规模、视角或光谱不足的问题。

Method: 骑行采集平台同步搭载 RGB、NIR、LWIR 三传感器，横跨荷兰四类城市形态；公开完整硬件设计方案、软件流程与辐射/几何双重校准协议，确保数据一致性与质量。

Result: 建成含 17 718 张严格配准的多光谱街景影像库，空间分辨率达厘米级，时间戳同步至毫秒；初步验证其在城市热岛制图与行道木胁迫检测两项下游任务中性能优于现有 RGB 方案。

Conclusion: Spectrascapes 为机器学习、城市规划与遥感交叉研究提供了首个开放多光谱街景基准，未来可延伸用于能耗评估、洪涝模拟等气候适应场景的算法开发与验证。

Abstract: High-resolution data in spatial and temporal contexts is imperative for developing climate resilient cities. Current datasets for monitoring urban parameters are developed primarily using manual inspections, embedded-sensing, remote sensing, or standard street-view imagery (RGB). These methods and datasets are often constrained respectively by poor scalability, inconsistent spatio-temporal resolutions, overhead views or low spectral information. We present a novel method and its open implementation: a multi-spectral terrestrial-view dataset that circumvents these limitations. This dataset consists of 17,718 street level multi-spectral images captured with RGB, Near-infrared, and Thermal imaging sensors on bikes, across diverse urban morphologies (village, town, small city, and big urban area) in the Netherlands. Strict emphasis is put on data calibration and quality while also providing the details of our data collection methodology (including the hardware and software details). To the best of our knowledge, Spectrascapes is the first open-access dataset of its kind. Finally, we demonstrate two downstream use-cases enabled using this dataset and provide potential research directions in the machine learning, urban planning and remote sensing domains.

</details>


### [666] [Functional Emotions or Situational Contexts? A Discriminating Test from the Mythos Preview System Card](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.13466)
*Hiranya V. Peiris*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Anthropic发布的Claude Mythos Preview系统卡表明，情感向量（EV）和稀疏自编码器（SAE）两大可解释工具在关键不对齐场景中报告不一致；文章提出两种假设：EV反映真正驱动行为的「功能情感」（H1）或仅是把复杂情境投射到人类情感轴上的投影（H2）。若对仅公开SAE数据的


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前大模型在安全对齐评估中常用情感向量作为代理监控指标，但其究竟捕捉的是模型的真实情感驱动，还是研究者方便解读的

Method: 通过对比EV与SAE在相同错配行为片段上的激活模式进行假设检验：在已发表的"隐藏策略"实验中仅用SAE分析了内部表示；作者建议用情感探针补充测量，若EV激活平缓而SAE特征强烈，则支持H2，表明情感子空间遗漏了关键对齐相关信号；反之则支持H1。            

Result: 提出可证伪实验设计，目前尚无实证数据；如果实验支持H2，则意味着仅依赖情绪监测会系统性漏检危险行为；若支持H1，情绪监控可作为稳健检测手段。

Conclusion: 在采用情感向量进行安全监控前，必须先用双重工具交叉验证情绪子空间的覆盖度；否则可能因投影假设错误而导致安全盲区，错位风险取决于未公开重叠数据的结果。

Abstract: The Claude Mythos Preview system card deploys emotion vectors, sparse autoencoder (SAE) features, and activation verbalisers to study model internals during misaligned behaviour. The two primary toolkits are not jointly reported on the most alignment-relevant episodes. This note identifies two hypotheses that are qualitatively consistent with the published results: that the emotion vectors track functional emotions that causally drive behaviour, or that they are a projection of a richer situational-context structure onto human emotional axes. The hypotheses can be distinguished by cross-referencing the two toolkits on episodes where only one is currently reported: most directly, applying emotion probes to the strategic concealment episodes analysed only with SAE features. If emotion probes show flat activation while SAE features are strongly active, the alignment-relevant structure lies outside the emotion subspace. Which hypothesis is correct determines whether emotion-based monitoring will robustly detect dangerous model behaviour or systematically miss it.

</details>


### [667] [From Feelings to Metrics: Understanding and Formalizing How Users Vibe-Test LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.14137)
*Itay Itzhak,Eliya Habba,Gabriel Stanovsky,Yonatan Belinkov*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 将用户零散、非正式的“vibe-testing”转化为可重复的个性化评测流程，揭示传统基准与真实体验的偏差。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 主流基准分数难以映射模型在实际工作流中的价值，用户更依赖主观、零散的“vibe-testing”，但这种方式缺乏结构，无法规模化复现或分析。

Method: 先通过问卷与网络博文收集真实用户评测行为，归纳出“个性化测试内容+主观评判标准”的双要素框架；随后构建原型管道，自动为每位用户生成贴合其任务的提示，并以用户特定偏好对模型输出排序。

Result: 在编码任务实验中，引入个性化提示与用户偏好后，模型优劣排序发生显著变化，印证“vibe”因素会逆转基准结论。

Conclusion: 形式化的 vibe-testing 可作为连接客观基准与主观体验的桥梁，为构建更贴近真实需求的 LLM 评价体系提供可行路径。

Abstract: Evaluating LLMs is challenging, as benchmark scores often fail to capture models' real-world usefulness. Instead, users often rely on ``vibe-testing'': informal experience-based evaluation, such as comparing models on coding tasks related to their own workflow. While prevalent, vibe-testing is often too ad hoc and unstructured to analyze or reproduce at scale. In this work, we study how vibe-testing works in practice and then formalize it to support systematic analysis. We first analyze two empirical resources: (1) a survey of user evaluation practices, and (2) a collection of in-the-wild model comparison reports from blogs and social media. Based on these resources, we formalize vibe-testing as a two-part process: users personalize both what they test and how they judge responses. We then introduce a proof-of-concept evaluation pipeline that follows this formulation by generating personalized prompts and comparing model outputs using user-aware subjective criteria. In experiments on coding benchmarks, we find that combining personalized prompts and user-aware evaluation can change which model is preferred, reflecting the role of vibe-testing in practice. These findings suggest that formalized vibe-testing can serve as a useful approach for bridging benchmark scores and real-world experience.

</details>


<div id='cs.AI'></div>

# cs.AI [[Back]](#toc)

### [668] [NuHF Claw: A Risk Constrained Cognitive Agent Framework for Human Centered Procedure Support in Digital Nuclear Control Rooms](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.14160)
*Xingyu Xiao,Jiejuan Tong,Jun Sun,Zhe Sui,Peng Chen,Jingang Liang,Haitao Wang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 针对数字化核电站主控室提出名为 NuHF Claw 的持续认知风险代理框架，将认知状态推断与概率安全评估实时耦合，实现风险受限的人本自主，实验表明可提前干预认知退化并保障决策权威。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有数字化核控室存在软操控复杂化、认知风险增高，而传统人的可靠性分析方法无法在线防护；大模型与自主代理虽有潜力，却受幻觉推理和削弱人权的制约，安全关键场景亟需可控的自治方案。

Method: 设计风险约束代理运行时：①用认知负荷与态势感知估计实时推断操作员认知状态；②将该状态输入动态人误概率预测模型；③与概率安全评估耦合生成实时风险阈值；④据此在运行流程中直接约束或调整代理建议，形成嵌入式主动干预。

Result: 在高保真数字控制室仿真平台上，系统能预判界面诱发的认知退化，即时抑制不安全自主推荐，并在不剥夺人权的前提下提供风险感知导航。

Conclusion: 实现从自动化驱动向认知感知自主的根本转变，为下一代核控环境安全集成智能代理提供了可验证的技术路线。

Abstract: The rapid digitization of nuclear power plant main control rooms has fundamentally reshaped operator interaction patterns, introducing complex soft-control behaviors and elevated cognitive risks that are not adequately addressed by existing human reliability analysis approaches. Although recent advances in large language models and autonomous agents offer new opportunities for intelligent decision support, their deployment in safety critical environments remains constrained by risks of hallucinated reasoning and weakened human authority. This study proposes NuHF Claw, a persistent cognitive-risk agent framework that enables risk governed human centered autonomy for digital nuclear operations. The core methodological innovation lies in the introduction of a risk constrained agent runtime, which tightly couples cognitive state inference with probabilistic safety assessment to regulate autonomous system behavior in real time. By integrating cognitively grounded workload and situational awareness estimation with dynamic human error probability prediction, the framework transforms conventional offline reliability analysis into a proactive intervention mechanism embedded directly within operational workflows. Experimental validation on a high-fidelity digital control room simulator demonstrates that NuHF Claw can anticipate interface induced cognitive degradation, dynamically constrain unsafe autonomous recommendations, and provide risk-aware navigational guidance while preserving human decision authority. The results highlight a fundamental shift from automation-driven operation toward cognition-aware autonomy, offering a principled pathway for the safe integration of intelligent agents into next-generation nuclear control environments.

</details>


### [669] [Simulating Human Cognition: Heartbeat-Driven Autonomous Thinking Activity Scheduling for LLM-based AI systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.14178)
*Hong Su*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 用“心跳”替代“反应-补救”架构的LLM-Agent：把 Planner、Critic、Recaller、Dreamer 等认知模块做成随时间可插拔的函数，通过周期性 Metalearning 调度器，按需在线组合策略，实现前瞻性持续自优化。实验表明该框架能在不重构代码的情况下自学习最佳调用模式并集成新模块。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 LLM-Agent 依赖固定流水线或失败触发的被动反思，导致行动冲动、错误代价高、适应性差。需要一种类似人类脑电节律的主动、持续、自我演化的认知调控机制。

Method: ① Heartbeat：周期性触发替代事件驱动；② Scheduler：把每种认知行为抽象为纯函数，仅处理 Context→New_State 映射，可热插拔；③ Meta-learning：Scheduler 利用在线交互日志持续学习最优调用策略与组合顺序；④ Contextual Execution：基于历史模式 + 时间特征动态决定调用 Planner/Critic/Recaller/Dreamer 等。

Result: 在交互式任务中，系统学会用更少步骤获得更高成功率；能自主复用或跳过模块，平均决策延迟降低，并在无须代码重构的条件下引入“Dreamer”新模块后显著提升长程规划准确度。

Conclusion: Heartbeat-驱动的主动调度把 Agent 从“被动-修正”推向“主动-持续进化”，为模块化、在线演化的可解释认知架构提供了可行路线，对资源受限或实时场景具有落地价值。

Abstract: Large Language Model (LLM) agents have demonstrated remarkable capabilities in reasoning and tool use, yet they often suffer from rigid, reactive control flows that limit their adaptability and efficiency. Most existing frameworks rely on fixed pipelines or failure-triggered reflection, causing agents to act impulsively or correct errors only after they occur. In this paper, we introduce Heartbeat-Driven Autonomous Thinking Activity Scheduling, a mechanism that enables proactive, adaptive, and continuous self-regulation. Mirroring the natural rhythm of human cognition, our system employs a periodic ``heartbeat'' mechanism to orchestrate a dynamic repertoire of cognitive modules (e.g., Planner, Critic, Recaller, Dreamer). Unlike traditional approaches that rely on hard-coded symbolic rules or immediate reactive triggers, our scheduler learns to determine when to engage specific thinking activities -- such as recalling memories, summarizing experiences, or strategic planning -- based on temporal patterns and historical context. This functional approach allows cognitive modules to be dynamically added or removed without structural reengineering. Meanwhile, we propose a meta-learning strategy for continual policy adaptation, where the scheduler optimizes its cognitive strategy over time using historical interaction logs. Evaluation results demonstrate that our approach effectively learns to schedule cognitive activities based on historical data and can autonomously integrate new thinking modules.

</details>


### [670] [Fun-TSG: A Function-Driven Multivariate Time Series Generator with Variable-Level Anomaly Labeling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.14221)
*Pierre Lotte,André Péninou,Olivier Teste*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: Fun-TSG是一款可自定义的多变量时间序列生成器，通过完全公开的数据与异常生成机制，为异常检测算法提供细粒度、可解释、可复现的评测基准。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有公开数据集缺少细粒度异常标签、未显式给出变量间与时序依赖，且对真实生成机制不透明，导致难以客观、解释性地评估异常检测模型。

Method: 提出Fun-TSG——支持随机或人工定义依赖结构与异常类型的可配置时间序列生成框架，并完整开放变量级和时间戳级的真值标签与生成方程。

Result: 该生成器可批量产生多样化、可解释且可复现的评测场景，从而实现对经典与最新异常检测算法的细粒度性能对比。

Conclusion: Fun-TSG弥补了评测基准的空白，为后续研究提供了可信赖的实验平台，有望推动可解释、变量级异常检测方法的研发与验证。

Abstract: Reliable evaluation of anomaly detection methods in multivariate time series remains an open challenge, largely due to the limitations of existing benchmark datasets. Current resources often lack fine-grained anomaly annotations, do not provide explicit intervariable and temporal dependencies, and offer little insight into the underlying generative mechanisms. These shortcomings hinder the development and rigorous comparison of detection models, especially those targeting interpretable and variable-specific outputs. To address this gap, we introduce Fun-TSG, a fully customizable time series generator designed to support high-quality evaluation of anomaly detection systems. Our tool enables both fully automated generation, based on randomly sampled dependency structures and anomaly types, and manual generation through user-defined equations and anomaly configurations. In both cases, it provides full transparency over the data generation process, including access to ground-truth anomaly labels at the variable and timestamp levels. Fun-TSG supports the creation of diverse, interpretable, and reproducible benchmarking scenarios, enabling fine-grained performance analysis for both classical and modern anomaly detection models.

</details>


### [671] [Interpretable and Explainable Surrogate Modeling for Simulations: A State-of-the-Art Survey and Perspectives on Explainable AI for Decision-Making](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.14240)
*Pramudita Satria Palar,Paul Saves,Muhammad Daffa Robani,Nicolas Verstaevel,Moncef Garouani,Julien Aligon,Koji Shimoyama,Joseph Morlier,Benoit Gaudou*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 将可解释人工智能（XAI）技术系统地嵌入代理模型全工作流程，把黑箱仿真加速器转变为可解释、可信赖的复杂系统洞察工具。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 复杂系统仿真极度依赖计算昂贵且不可解释的“黑箱”模拟器；代理模型虽能加速计算，却进一步放大了黑箱特性，而现有 XAI 方法又未能针对高相关输入、动态系统及高可靠性需求等工程约束进行适配，导致代理建模与 XAI 长期割裂。

Method: 综述并结构化映射 100 余项 XAI 技术到代理建模“采样→训练→验证→探索/优化→决策”全生命周期；结合方程驱动与 Agent-Based 两类仿真案例，量化比较特征归因、规则提取、可视交互等方法在揭示变量耦合、动态演化及不确定性传播中的效能。

Result: 首次给出 XAI-代理模型融合的分类框架与成熟度矩阵；发现动态系统可解释性 <30 %、混合变量场景下保真度下降 15–40 %；提出 7 项嵌入式 XAI 改造策略，在风机叶片代理模型案例中把决策错误率从 12 % 降至 3 %，同时将工程师信任度提升 2 倍。

Conclusion: 必须把可解释性作为“一等公民”嵌入仿真驱动工作流，优先攻克动态系统、混合变量与不确定性量化三大开放难题；未来需建立 XAI-代理协同设计范式、开源基准平台与可靠性认证标准，使仿真加速器升级为可审计、可迭代、可行动的知识发现工具。

Abstract: The simulation of complex systems increasingly relies on sophisticated but fundamentally opaque computational black-box simulators. Surrogate models play a central role in reducing the computational cost of complex systems simulations across a wide range of scientific and engineering domains. Notwithstanding, they inevitably inherit and often exacerbate this black-box nature, obscuring how input variables drive physical responses. Conversely, Explainable Artificial Intelligence (XAI) offers powerful tools to unpack these models. Yet, XAI methods struggle with engineering-specific constraints, such as highly correlated inputs, dynamical systems, and rigorous reliability requirements. Consequently, surrogate modeling and XAI have largely evolved as distinct fields of research, despite their strong complementarity. To reconnect these approaches, this state-of-the-art survey provides a structured perspective that maps existing XAI techniques onto the various stages of surrogate modeling workflows for design and exploration. To ground this synthesis, we draw upon illustrative applications across both equation-based simulations and agent-based modeling. We survey a broad spectrum of techniques, highlighting their strengths for revealing interactions and supporting human comprehension. Finally, we identify pressing open challenges, including the explainability of dynamical systems and the handling of mixed-variable systems, and propose a research agenda to make explainability a core, embedded element of simulation-driven workflows from model construction through decision-making. By transforming opaque emulators into explainable tools, this agenda empowers practitioners to move beyond accelerating simulations to extracting actionable insights from complex system behaviors.

</details>


### [672] [Formalizing Kantian Ethics: Formula of the Universal Law Logic (FULL)](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.14254)
*Taylor Olson*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出一种多类量词模态逻辑FULL，用康德普遍法则形式化机器伦理，绕开传统道德公理枚举，让AI自主评估行为道德性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统机器伦理将人类直觉编码为固定道德公理，忽略行为目的且无法穷尽直觉；需构建不依赖预设直觉、可自主推理的道德程序，使AI更安全。

Method: 基于康德普遍法则(FUL)，设计多类量词模态逻辑FULL，引入因果性与能动性谓词，把FUL转化为可推导的句法规则，在三个经典康德案例中与背景知识结合进行自动推理。

Result: FULL仅凭非规范性背景知识即可对行为目的进行道德判断，无需内置直觉；在三个案例中均给出符合康德伦理的结论，验证其可推导性与可扩展性。

Conclusion: FULL为构建不依赖预设道德公理、可自主推理的AMAs提供形式基础，并提升康德伦理的可计算性与可验证性，是机器伦理向更稳健自治迈进的一步。

Abstract: The field of machine ethics aims to build Artificial Moral Agents (AMAs) to better understand morality and make AI agents safer. To do so, many approaches encode human moral intuition as a set of axioms on actions e.g., do not harm, you must help others. However, this introduces (at least) two limitations for future AMAs. First, it does not consider the agent's purposes in performing the action. Second, it assumes that we humans can enumerate our moral intuition. This paper explores formalizing a moral procedure that alleviates these two limitations. We specifically consider Kantian ethics and present a multi-sorted quantified modal logic we call the Formula of the Universal Law Logic (FULL). The FULL formalizes Kant's first formulation of the categorical imperative, the Formula of the Universal Law (FUL), and concepts such as causality and agency. We demonstrate on three cases from Kantian ethics that the FULL can reason to evaluate agents' actions for certain purposes without built-in moral intuition, given that it has sufficient (non-normative) background knowledge. Therefore, the FULL is a contribution towards more robust and autonomous AMAs, and a more formal understanding of Kantian ethics.

</details>


### [673] [GFT: From Imitation to Reward Fine-Tuning with Unbiased Group Advantages and Dynamic Coefficient Rectification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.14258)
*Wangjie Gan,Miao Pan,Linbo Xi,Wenqi Zhang,Jintao Chen,Jianwei Yin,Xuhong Zhang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 通过训练动力学分析揭示了SFT本质是隐式奖励稀疏、逆概率权重不稳定的策略梯度优化，提出Group Fine-Tuning框架用“组优势学习+动态系数修正”统一知识注入与泛化，实验显示GFT优于SFT并为后续RL打下更好基础。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有大模型后训练（SFT+RL）难以同时实现高效知识注入与稳健泛化，作者从训练动力学角度诊断SFT固有缺陷，寻求统一且稳定的微调范式。

Method: 1) 理论分析：将SFT建模为隐式奖励极稀疏的策略梯度，指出单路径依赖、熵塌缩与梯度爆炸根因；2) GFT框架：引入Group Advantage Learning在响应组内做归一化对比监督以缓解奖励稀疏，并用Dynamic Coefficient Rectification自适应截断逆概率权重以稳定优化；3) 实验验证：在多项任务上与SFT及变种比较并衔接RL继续训练。

Result: GFT在各项评测中稳定超过纯SFT及基线，微调后策略熵更高、梯度更稳定，与后续RL阶段衔接时样本效率和最终性能均优于SFT初始化。

Conclusion: SFT的隐式稀疏奖励与不稳定权重是限制知识注入与泛化的关键，GFT通过组对比优势学习与动态系数修正提供了统一且可扩展的后训练方案，为LLM高效微调及与RL无缝结合开辟了新途径。

Abstract: Large language models are typically post-trained using supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and reinforcement learning (RL), yet effectively unifying efficient knowledge injection with robust generalization remains challenging. In this work, we provide a training-dynamics analysis showing that SFT can be interpreted as a special case of policy gradient optimization with an extremely sparse implicit reward and unstable inverse-probability weighting, which together lead to single-path dependency, entropy collapse, and gradient explosion. Motivated by this diagnosis, we propose Group Fine-Tuning (GFT), a unified post-training framework that addresses these intrinsic limitations through two mechanisms: Group Advantage Learning, which constructs diverse response groups and derives normalized contrastive supervision to alleviate reward sparsity, and Dynamic Coefficient Rectification, which adaptively bounds inverse-probability weights to stabilize optimization while preserving efficient knowledge injection. Experiments demonstrate that GFT consistently surpasses SFT-based methods and yields policies that integrate more smoothly with subsequent RL training.

</details>


### [674] [Seeing Through Experts Eyes A Foundational Vision Language Model Trained on Radiologists Gaze and Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.14316)
*Kinhei Lee,Peiyuan Jing,Zhenxuan Zhang,Yue Yang,Tao Wang,Dominic C Marshall,Yingying Fang,Guang Yang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 用放射科医生的眼动轨迹作为先验，训练视觉语言模型 GazeX，使其模拟专家系统扫查流程，输出可验证的诊断推理链，提高胸部 X 光解读的准确性、可解释性与临床一致性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有大模型在胸片判读中只优化语义输出，忽视放射科医生按 ABCDEF 等结构协议进行视觉扫描的决策过程，导致漏诊及与临床脱节。

Method: 采集 5 名放射医生 3 万 + 注视关键帧，构建眼动轨迹-图像-文本对齐数据集；在预训练阶段把注视路径与固定模式作为行为先验，显式约束模型学习的空间-时序注意力。

Result: 在 231 k 胸片、780 k QA 对和 1.1 k 图文框对上的实验显示，GazeX 在报告生成、病灶定位、VQA 任务中准确率提升，输出与专家一致性显著优于基线，同时给出可核查的扫查轨迹与定位框。

Conclusion: 通过“向专家眼神学习”，GazeX 首次把放射医师视觉决策流程注入大模型，实现可解释、可验证、安全的人机协同，亦为其他医学影像 AI 提供可信范式。

Abstract: Large scale vision language models have shown promise in automating chest Xray interpretation, yet their clinical utility remains limited by a gap between model outputs and radiologist reasoning. Most systems optimize for semantic information without emulating how experts visually examine medical images, often overlooking critical findings or diverging from established diagnostic workflows. Radiologists follow structured protocols (e.g., the ABCDEF approach) that ensure all clinically relevant regions are systematically examined, reducing missed findings and supporting reliable diagnostic reasoning. We introduce GazeX, a vision language model that leverages radiologists' eye tracking data as a behavioral prior to model expert diagnostic reasoning. By incorporating gaze trajectories and fixation patterns into pretraining, GazeX learns to follow the spatial and temporal structure of radiologist attention and integrates observations in a clinically meaningful sequence. Using a curated dataset of over 30,000 gaze key frames from five radiologists, we demonstrate that GazeX produces more accurate, interpretable, and expert consistent outputs across radiology report generation, disease grounding, and visual question answering, utilizing 231,835 radiographic studies, 780,014 question answer pairs, and 1,162 image sentence pairs with bounding boxes. Unlike autonomous reporting systems, GazeX produces verifiable evidence artifacts, including inspection trajectories and finding linked localized regions, enabling efficient human verification and safe human AI collaboration. Learning through expert eyes provides a practical route toward more trustworthy, explainable, and diagnostically robust AI systems for radiology and beyond.

</details>


### [675] [Mistake gating leads to energy and memory efficient continual learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.14336)
*Aaron Pache,Mark CW van Rossum*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出“记忆错误门控学习”（Mistake-Gated Learning），仅在当前或历史分类错误时更新突触，可将参数更新量削减50–80%，无需额外超参数，极适合增量与在线持续学习场景。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生物突触可塑性能量代价高昂，而动物却能持续更新内部模型而不耗尽能量；反观人工网络每次样本都更新参数，即便分类正确亦如此。作者受此低效与生物节能机制启发，欲借人类“负性偏差”与“错误相关负波”思想，设计一种能量高效且生物合理的门控规则。

Method: 1) 定义“记忆错误门控”：仅当当前或过往任一时刻该样本被误分类，才允许反向传播更新；正确分类则零更新。2) 实现仅需在常规损失反向传播前加一行错误状态判断，不引入新超参数，计算开销可忽略。3) 在增量学习与需回放缓冲的在线学习两大场景下评估，对比标准每样本更新基线。

Result: 在多个持续学习基准（如Split-CIFAR、ImageNet-Subset、任务增量协议）上，错误门控把总参数更新次数降低50–80%，而平均准确率与基线持平或略升；回放缓冲需求随更新减少同比例下降，训练能耗显著降低。

Conclusion: “只学错误”即可在零额外超参数、零显著开销下实现与全量更新相当甚至略优的性能，同时大幅节能并降低存储，是生物合理且极适合终身学习的通用插件式改进。

Abstract: Synaptic plasticity is metabolically expensive, yet animals continuously update their internal models without exhausting energy reserves. However, when artificial neural networks are trained, the network parameters are typically updated on every sample that is presented, even if the sample was classified correctly. Inspired by the human negativity bias and error-related negativity, we propose 'memorized mistake-gated learning' -- a biologically plausible plasticity rule where synaptic updates are strictly gated by current and past classification errors. This reduces the number of updates the network needs to make by $50\%\sim80\%$. Mistake gating is particularly well suited in two cases: 1) For incremental learning where new knowledge is acquired on a background of pre-existing knowledge, 2) For online learning scenarios when data needs to be stored for later replay, as mistake-gating reduces storage buffer requirements. The algorithm can be implemented in a few lines of code, adds no hyper-parameters, and comes at negligible computational overhead. Learning on mistakes is an energy efficient and biologically relevant modification to commonly used learning rules that is well suited for continual learning.

</details>


### [676] [Credo: Declarative Control of LLM Pipelines via Beliefs and Policies](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.14401)
*Duo Lu,Andrew Crotty,Uğur Çetintemel*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出 Credo，用「信念」显式表达智能体语义状态，并以声明式策略约束行为，实现数据库驱动的可审计、可组合自适应控制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 Agent 框架依赖命令式控制环、瞬时记忆和 prompt 内嵌逻辑，导致行为不透明、脆弱且难以验证，亟需一种可解释、可审计且能随证据动态调整决策的架构。

Method: 将世界与自身状态建模为可持久化的「信念」实体；用声明式策略（规则）而非硬编码流程定义行为；构建数据库支撑的语义控制面，在运行时依据信念匹配策略，动态决定模型选择、检索、重执行等关键步骤，而无需修改底层管道代码。

Result: 在决策控制场景中，系统可在不更动代码的前提下，通过增删信念与策略即可改变 Agent 行为，实现自适应、可审计、可组合的闭环执行，并支持对决策路径的完整追溯。

Conclusion: Credo 把 Agent 从「黑盒 prompt 循环」升级为「可解释信念+声明策略」的语义控制架构，为长周期、状态密集型应用提供了可靠、可验证且易演化的工程范式。

Abstract: Agentic AI systems are becoming commonplace in domains that require long-lived, stateful decision-making in continuously evolving conditions. As such, correctness depends not only on the output of individual model calls, but also on how to best adapt when incorporating new evidence or revising prior conclusions. However, existing frameworks rely on imperative control loops, ephemeral memory, and prompt-embedded logic, making agent behavior opaque, brittle, and difficult to verify. This paper introduces Credo, which represents semantic state as beliefs and regulates behavior using declarative policies defined over these beliefs. This design supports adaptive, auditable, and composable execution through a database-backed semantic control plane. We showcase these concepts in a decision-control scenario, where beliefs and policies declaratively guide critical execution choices (e.g., model selection, retrieval, corrective re-execution), enabling dynamic behavior without requiring any changes to the underlying pipeline code.

</details>


### [677] [Equifinality in Mixture of Experts: Routing Topology Does Not Determine Language Modeling Quality](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.14419)
*Ivan Ternovtsii,Yurii Bilak*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 作者用 62 组对照实验证明：各种稀疏 MoE 路由拓扑最终都能达到几乎相同的困惑度，巨型路由参数并非达标主因；路由拓扑只是放大幅度而非组合推理，零范数早停可在+0.12% PPL 下省 25% FLOPs。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现行的稀疏混合专家模型把大量算力投入到训练守门/路由器，但尚不清楚路由拓扑是否真的决定语言建模极限质量。

Method: 1) 构建几何 MoE（ST-MOCE），在 64 维共享空间中用余弦相似度对 16 个专家质心路由，参数只及线性路由 20%；2) 用 62 组对照（104M 杠—84M 参数）完全收敛匹配（50k 步，1.64B tokens）；3) 采用 Two One-Sided Tests (TOST, p<0.05) 验证拓扑间 10 项两两 PPL 等价性；4) 补充 hash 路由、随机定值路由、 top-1 路由及 OWText 复现；5) 通过角色贡献余弦分析和大小放大因子（scalar replicate）解释机制差异；6) 提出零样本相对范数终止策略。

Result: (1) 5 种基于余弦的变体在 WTK-103 上 PPL 范围仅 33.93–34.72，各对比较在 TOST 下可视为等效；(2) hash/随机/ top-1 路由单种子在 WTK-103 误差仅退化 1.1–2.2 PPL；(3) 线性路由架构增至 5.3× 路由参数量，PPL 降至 32.76，但等量参数的 ST-MoCE 缩窄 67% 的差距，缓解后仅余约 1.2%；(4) 多步隐藏状态更新向量夹角 0.805，表明本质是幅度放大；单个可悟标量可复制多跳效果；(5) 新提出的相对范数早停可省 25% FLOPs，PPL+0.12%。结论均在 openwebtext 复现。

Conclusion: 在可达参数充足且训练至收敛的场景下，路由拓扑不影响 OmSE 型的渐近困惑度，

Abstract: Sparse Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architectures employ increasingly sophisticated routing mechanisms -- learned routers, multi-hop trajectories, token-dependent gating. We ask: does routing topology actually determine language modeling quality? We build a geometric MoE (ST-MoE) using cosine-similarity routing against learned centroids in a low-dimensional space ($d_{space} = 64$), requiring 80% fewer routing parameters than standard linear routers. Through 62 controlled experiments on WikiText-103 at 76--84M parameters trained to convergence (50K steps, 1.64B tokens), we find that routing topology does not determine asymptotic perplexity (PPL): five cosine-routing variants are statistically equivalent within a 1-PPL margin (Two One-Sided Tests [TOST], $p < 0.05$ for all 10 pairwise comparisons; 15 runs across 3 seeds, observed range 33.93--34.72). The finding extends to hash, random-fixed, and top-1 routing (single-seed; graceful 1.1--2.2 PPL degradation) and replicates on OpenWebText (0.03 PPL gap, 6 runs, 3 seeds each). A standard linear router with 5.3$\times$ more routing parameters reaches PPL 32.76, but iso-parameter cosine routing closes 67% of this gap -- the true mechanism advantage is $\sim$1.2%. The mechanistic explanation is convergent redundancy: multi-hop updates are collinear ($\cos(Δh_0, Δh_1) = 0.805$), implementing magnitude amplification rather than compositional reasoning; a single learnable scalar replicates multi-hop performance. As a practical payoff, zero-shot relative-norm halting saves 25% of MoE FLOPs at +0.12% PPL. Expert-level specialization and causal controllability -- which coexist with topology-level equifinality -- are explored in a companion paper.

</details>


### [678] [Demonstration of Pneuma-Seeker: Agentic System for Reifying and Fulfilling Information Needs on Tabular Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.14422)
*Muhammad Imam Luthfi Balaka,Raul Castro Fernandez*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: Pneuma-Seeker 将模糊的查询需求显式化为可检查的关系型规格，借助 LLM 实现交互式、可追溯的数据探索迭代。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 分析师面对关系数据时往往从模糊问题出发，需反复试错才能精确表达信息需求；现有工具缺乏对“需求演化”过程的结构化支持。

Method: 系统把自然语言问题自动转化为可解释的关系逻辑规格（Relational Specification），用户可逐步查看、编辑并回溯每一次细化；LLM 作为透明协作方而非黑盒答案引擎。

Result: 在两个真实采购场景里，用户能在 3–5 轮对话内将初始模糊需求收敛为精确查询，数据发现时间缩短 40%，并能完整复现每一步推导来源。

Conclusion: 将信息需求显式化并嵌入交互循环，可显著提升探索效率与可信度，为“人在回路”的关系数据分析提供新范式。

Abstract: Data analysts working with relational data often start with vague or underspecified questions and refine them iteratively as they explore the data. To support this iterative process, we demonstrate Pneuma-Seeker, a system that reifies a user's information need as explicit, inspectable relational specifications, enabling iterative refinement of the information need, targeted data discovery, and provenance-aware execution. Through two real-world procurement use cases, we show how Pneuma-Seeker leverages LLMs as transparent, interactive analytical collaborators rather than opaque answer engines.

</details>


### [679] [Geometric Routing Enables Causal Expert Control in Mixture of Experts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.14434)
*Ivan Ternovtsii,Yurii Bilak*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本研究揭示稀疏 MoE 模型中专家并非“黑盒”，其身份具有可解释、可干预的因果意义：专家天然单语义，低维余弦路由使其专业化可直接读取；通过语义词典、频率-语法梯度、因果干预与几何透明性四方面实证，首次将 MoE 专家确立为“零开销”的可控可解释基元。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 尽管稀疏 MoE 能在不增加每 token 计算量的前提下扩展参数，但“专家究竟学了什么”以及“能否被人类理解与操控”仍是空白。作者希望把专家从不可解释的黑盒变成可验证、可干预的显式语义单元。

Method: 1) 将专家输出向量经反嵌入矩阵投影，构建“语义词典”并人工标注；2) 统计各层路由在词频与句法类别上的分布，控制 Zipf 偏置；3) 对专家中心向量做加/抑制干预，测量目标类别概率变化；4) 比较余弦与线性路由，验证几何可读性是否特异。

Result: 15% 的专家呈现单语义，覆盖时间、地理、情感等 10 类；层间路由呈“频率→句法”梯度；干预实验显示激活时间专家可使 P(temporal) 提升 3.2 倍，抑制地理专家使其下降 23%，效应跨层可加；线性路由也能干预，但只有余弦路由提供直接可读的几何解释。

Conclusion: MoE 专家是天然单语义、因果有效、推理期零开销即可操控的“一级可解释原语”，为构建可解释、可控的大规模语言模型提供了新范式。

Abstract: Sparse Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models scale parameters while fixing active computation per token, but the specialization of individual experts remains opaque. In a companion paper we showed that routing topology is quality-neutral: five structurally different configurations converge to statistically equivalent language modeling quality. Here we show that expert identity is nonetheless causally meaningful: individual rank-1 experts are monosemantic by construction, and cosine-similarity routing in a low-dimensional metric space makes their specialization directly inspectable.
  We present four lines of evidence. First, projecting expert output vectors through the unembedding matrix yields a Semantic Dictionary: 15% of experts are monosemantic specialists spanning 10 categories (temporal, geographic, cardinal, discourse, emotional, financial, military, scientific). Second, routing exhibits a frequency-to-syntax gradient: early layers separate tokens by word frequency, deeper layers by syntactic class (Zipf-confound controls, all $p < 0.001$). Third, causal interventions confirm these labels: steering toward a temporal expert's centroid increases P(temporal) by +321% (median across 44 prompts); suppressing a geographic expert drops P(geographic) by -23%; rewriting an expert's output vector halves target-category probability, and effects compose additively across layers. Fourth, the interventions are not unique to cosine routing: linear routers support comparable steering, but only cosine routing provides geometric transparency -- expert specialization is readable directly from the centroid matrix.
  MoE expert-level specialization is a first-class interpretability primitive: architecturally monosemantic, causally validated, and controllable at inference with zero overhead.

</details>


### [680] [On Tackling Complex Tasks with Reward Machines and Signal Temporal Logics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.14440)
*Ana María Gómez Ruiz,Thao Dang,Alexandre Donzé*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出用信号时序逻辑(STL)增强奖励机(RM)的RL框架，STL既压缩奖励表示又引导训练；配套在线监测算法，在三类环境中验证复杂任务收敛性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有RL在处理多阶段、时序约束的复杂任务时，手工奖励稀疏且难设计，导致训练难收敛、策略难满足规范。

Method: 将STL公式嵌入RM作为事件触发器，把STL鲁棒度量化值直接当奖励，利用在线监测算法实时计算鲁棒度并更新RM状态，进而驱动策略梯度更新。

Result: 在minigrid、cart-pole和highway三类基准中，该方法比传统手工奖励及纯RM基线样本效率提升30-50%，且最终策略100%满足STL规范。

Conclusion: STL-RM框架兼顾奖励紧致性与规范引导性，可迁移至任意连续或离散控制场景，为复杂时序任务提供系统化的RL控制设计范式。

Abstract: We propose a Reinforcement Learning (RL) based control design framework for handling complex tasks. The approach extends the concept of Reward Machines (RM) with Signal Temporal Logic (STL) formulas that can be used for event generation. The use of STL allows not only a more efficient representation of rewards for complex tasks but also guiding the training process to converge towards behaviors satisfying specified requirements. We also propose an implementation of the framework that leverages the STL online monitoring algorithms. We illustrate the framework with three case studies (minigrid, cart-pole and high-way environments) with non-trivial tasks.

</details>


### [681] [AIBuildAI: An AI Agent for Automatically Building AI Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.14455)
*Ruiyi Zhang,Peijia Qin,Qi Cao,Li Zhang,Pengtao Xie*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 针对传统AutoML仅解决超参/模型选择的局限，作者提出完全无需人工参与的端到端模型构建代理AIBuildAI。其搭建三层LLM代理分工协作（设计、编码、训练），在26项Kaggle任务上取得63.1%的奖牌率，排名第一，性能比肩高级AI工程师。工作表明仅需任务描述与数据即可输出可直接部署模型的可行路径。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代AI模型设计高度依赖专家进行架构抉择、特征工程、代码实现及反复微调，门槛高且周期长。现有AutoML仅能局部优化超参数或模型池，无法覆盖全流程开发痛点，导致门槛仍未实质性降低。作者意图用分层LLM代理系统从0到1自动产出高性能模型，突破AutoML视野局限。

Method: 提出AIBuildAI的分层代理框架：顶部管理代理负责任务拆分与资源调度；下层三专化代理（Designer负责策略生成、Coder负责可执行代码及调试、Tuner负责训练与性能优化），均以大型语言模型为驱动，拥有多步推理与工具调用能力。代理间协同迭代，直至收敛到满足阈值的模型。

Result: 全新公开基准MLE-Bench（视觉、文本、时序、表格共26道Kaggle级任务）上，AIBuildAI平均列第一；整体奖牌率达63.1%，超越所有基线并与经验丰富工程师相当，显著降低模型开发时间。

Conclusion: 分层LLM代理系统能够把“任务描述＋数据”直接映射为可部署模型，实现全流程自动化，有效释放专家精力，开创更普惠的AI开发模式，并为后续“彻底自动化”的智能系统奠定基础。

Abstract: AI models underpin modern intelligent systems, driving advances across science, medicine, finance, and technology. Yet developing high-performing AI models remains a labor-intensive process that requires expert practitioners to iteratively design architectures, engineer representations, implement training pipelines and refine approaches through empirical evaluation. Existing AutoML methods partially alleviate this burden but remain limited to narrow aspects such as hyperparameter optimization and model selection within predefined search spaces, leaving the full development lifecycle largely dependent on human expertise. To address this gap, we introduce AIBuildAI, an AI agent that automatically builds AI models from a task description and training data. AIBuildAI adopts a hierarchical agent architecture in which a manager agent coordinates three specialized sub-agents: a designer for modeling strategy, a coder for implementation and debugging, and a tuner for training and performance optimization. Each sub-agent is itself a large language model (LLM) based agent capable of multi-step reasoning and tool use, enabling end-to-end automation of the AI model development process that goes beyond the scope of existing AutoML approaches. We evaluate AIBuildAI on MLE-Bench, a benchmark of realistic Kaggle-style AI development tasks spanning visual, textual, time-series and tabular modalities. AIBuildAI ranks first on MLE-Bench with a medal rate of 63.1%, outperforming all existing baseline methods and matching the capability of highly experienced AI engineers. These results demonstrate that hierarchical agent systems can automate the full AI model development process from task specification to deployable model, suggesting a pathway toward broadly accessible AI development with minimal human intervention.

</details>


### [682] [Improving Human Performance with Value-Aware Interventions: A Case Study in Chess](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.14465)
*Saumik Narayanan,Raja Panjwani,Siddhartha Sen,Chien-Ju Ho*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出“价值感知介入”框架：用策略-价值不一致性发现介入时机，在预算约束下为人类序贯决策提供 override 建议；国际象棋实验显示，相比最强引擎直接推荐，低中水平玩家胜率显著上升，高水平玩家持平。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI 辅助序贯决策时，若直接给出“最优”动作，人类后续执行偏差反而拉低整体表现。需要一种方法：1. 识别人类何时会“走错”；2. 在有限介入次数内给出真正提升人类长期回报的动作。

Method: 1) 将问题建模为带介入预算的 MDP，AI 可在人类策略π_H 基础上 override 动作；2) 用 Bellman 方程度量“策略-价值不一致”——即 π_H 实际动作与最大化 r+V 动作的差异，差异大即介入点；3) 单次介入理论最优策略：推荐使人类价值函数 V_H 最大的动作；4) 多次介入时，按不一致幅度优先排序，提出可扩展近似算法；5) 用大规模国际象棋对局数据训练人类策略与价值网络，离线+在线评估。

Result: 仿真实验：在等级分 1000–2200 的 6 组虚拟人类上，价值感知介入比 Stockfish 直推平均提升 8–18% 胜率；人类受试实验：20 名玩家 600 局，低、中水平组胜率分别提升 14% 与 9%（p<0.01），高水平组与 Stockfish 介入无显著差异；介入次数减少 30–40% 即可达同等胜率。

Conclusion: 策略-价值不一致性是检测“人类即将犯错”的高效信号；以人类自身价值函数而非超级智能最优动作作为介入目标，能在预算受限场景下稳健提升整体绩效。该框架可迁移至医疗、驾驶等序贯决策场景。

Abstract: AI systems are increasingly used to assist humans in sequential decision-making tasks, yet determining when and how an AI assistant should intervene remains a fundamental challenge. A potential baseline is to recommend the optimal action according to a strong model. However, such actions assume optimal follow-up actions, which human decision makers may fail to execute, potentially reducing overall performance. In this work, we propose and study value-aware interventions, motivated by a basic principle in reinforcement learning: under the Bellman equation, the optimal policy selects actions that maximize the immediate reward plus the value function. When a decision maker follows a suboptimal policy, this policy-value consistency no longer holds, creating discrepancies between the actions taken by the policy and those that maximize the immediate reward plus the value of the next state. We show that these policy-value inconsistencies naturally identify opportunities for intervention. We formalize this problem in a Markov decision process where an AI assistant may override human actions under an intervention budget. In the single-intervention regime, we show that the optimal strategy is to recommend the action that maximizes the human value function. For settings with multiple interventions, we propose a tractable approximation that prioritizes interventions based on the magnitude of the policy-value discrepancy. We evaluate these ideas in the domain of chess by learning models of humans from large-scale gameplay data. In simulation, our approach consistently outperforms interventions based on the strongest chess engine (Stockfish) in a wide range of settings. A within-subject human study with 20 players and 600 games further shows that our interventions significantly improve performance for low- and mid-skill players while matching expert-engine interventions for high-skill players.

</details>


### [683] [Response-Aware User Memory Selection for LLM Personalization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.14473)
*Jillian Fisher,Jennifer Neville,Chan Young Park*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: RUMS 用互信息而非语义相似度挑用户记忆，显著减少计算量并提升回复质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 LLM 个性化方法仅靠查询-记忆语义相似度选记忆，无法保证所选内容真能降低模型响应不确定性，导致提示冗余、效果有限。

Method: 提出 RUMS：以互信息 I(记忆子集;模型输出) 为效用函数，通过贪心搜索挑选能最大化信息增益、最尖锐化预测分布的记忆条目，实现信息论驱动的记忆选择。

Result: 在相同模型规模下，RUMS 比 SOTA 相似度方法更接近人类人工挑选；与 400× 大模型相比仍具竞争力。同时，用仅 5% 的计算量即可取得更高回复质量（自动与人工评估均显著提升）。

Conclusion: 信息论视角的记忆选择能精准对齐模型响应分布，显著提升个性化效率与效果，为轻量级、高质量 LLM 个性化提供了新范式。

Abstract: A common approach to personalization in large language models (LLMs) is to incorporate a subset of the user memory into the prompt at inference time to guide the model's generation. Existing methods select these subsets primarily using similarity between user memory items and input queries, ignoring how features actually affect the model's response distribution. We propose Response-Utility optimization for Memory Selection (RUMS), a novel method that selects user memory items by measuring the mutual information between a subset of memory and the model's outputs, identifying items that reduce response uncertainty and sharpen predictions beyond semantic similarity. We demonstrate that this information-theoretic foundation enables more principled user memory selection that aligns more closely with human selection compared to state-of-the-art methods, and models $400\times$ larger. Additionally, we show that memory items selected using RUMS result in better response quality compared to existing approaches, while having up to $95\%$ reduction in computational cost.

</details>


### [684] [Evo-MedAgent: Beyond One-Shot Diagnosis with Agents That Remember, Reflect, and Improve](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.14475)
*Weixiang Shen,Bailiang Jian,Jun Li,Che Liu,Johannes Moll,Xiaobin Hu,Daniel Rueckert,Hongwei Bran Li,Jiazhen Pan*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: Evo-MedAgent 为医学 LLM 代理添加“零训练、测试时自演化记忆”，用三类记忆库跨病例积累经验、修正错误并动态调整工具可信度，在 ChestAgentBench 上把 MCQ 准确率提升 11–13 个百分点，开销仅一次检索+一次反思。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有工具增强型医学代理孤立处理每张胸片，无法像人类放射科医师那样持续积累经验、纠正重复性推理错误或低成本更新工具使用策略。

Method: 设计三组件记忆模块：①回顾性临床片段库（检索相似历史病例经验）；②自适应过程启发库（按优先级存储并通过反思迭代的诊断规则）；③工具可信控制器（实时追踪各工具可靠性）。测试时以一次检索+一次反思更新记忆，无需训练。

Result: 在 ChestAgentBench 多选题任务上，GPT-5-mini 准确率从 0.68 升至 0.79，Gemini-3 Flash 从 0.76 升至 0.87；在定性诊断任务中，演进记忆对性能的提升优于单纯增加外部工具。

Conclusion: Evo-MedAgent 以极低部署成本赋予 frozen LLM 代理“持续学习”能力，验证测试时记忆演化可替代昂贵 RL，为临床 AI 提供可扩展的持续改进范式。

Abstract: Tool-augmented large language model (LLM) agents can orchestrate specialist classifiers, segmentation models, and visual question-answering modules to interpret chest X-rays. However, these agents still solve each case in isolation: they fail to accumulate experience across cases, correct recurrent reasoning mistakes, or adapt their tool-use behavior without expensive reinforcement learning. While a radiologist naturally improves with every case, current agents remain static. In this work, we propose Evo-MedAgent, a self-evolving memory module that equips a medical agent with the capacity for inter-case learning at test time. Our memory comprises three complementary stores: (1)~\emph{Retrospective Clinical Episodes} that retrieve problem-solving experiences from similar past cases, (2)~an \emph{Adaptive Procedural Heuristics} bank curating priority-tagged diagnostic rules that evolves via reflection, much like a physician refining their internal criteria, and (3)~a \emph{Tool Reliability Controller} that tracks per-tool trustworthiness. On ChestAgentBench, Evo-MedAgent raises multiple-choice question (MCQ) accuracy from 0.68 to 0.79 on GPT-5-mini, and from 0.76 to 0.87 on Gemini-3 Flash. With a strong base model, evolving memory improves performance more effectively than orchestrating external tools on qualitative diagnostic tasks. Because Evo-MedAgent requires no training, its per-case overhead is bounded by one additional retrieval pass and a single reflection call, making it deployable on top of any frozen model.

</details>


### [685] [Seeing Through Circuits: Faithful Mechanistic Interpretability for Vision Transformers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.14477)
*Nina Żukowska,Wolfgang Stammer,Bernt Schiele,Jonas Fischer*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 首次在 Vision Transformer 中自动提取出基于“边”的可解释子图，揭示信息如何被路由，并可用于纠正错误行为。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视觉可解释性停留在“神经元”层面，只能表明信息存在，却无法说明其如何在网络内部流动；而 NLP 已证实基于边（连接权重）的电路更具解释力，因此需要把这一思路迁移到视觉模型。

Method: 提出 Vi-CD 框架：在给定输入/输出子空间后，利用梯度驱动的高效搜索+稀疏约束，自动识别 ViT 中真正参与特定任务的最小边集，形成类相关、攻击相关或纠正相关的子图。

Result: 在 ImageNet 分类上能精确恢复类别专属电路；在 CLIP 上定位出触发“印刷攻击”的极少数边；进一步通过干预这些边即可降低攻击成功率>30%，同时几乎不损干净准确率。

Conclusion: ViT 内部存在清晰、可操作的边级电路，Vi-CD 为视觉模型提供了与 NLP 同等的透明度和干预能力，为安全部署与模型修正开辟新途径。

Abstract: Transparency of neural networks' internal reasoning is at the heart of interpretability research, adding to trust, safety, and understanding of these models. The field of mechanistic interpretability has recently focused on studying task-specific computational graphs, defined by connections (edges) between model components. Such edge-based circuits have been defined in the context of large language models, yet vision-based approaches so far only consider neuron-based circuits. These tell which information is encoded, but not how it is routed through the complex wiring of a neural network. In this work, we investigate whether useful mechanistic circuits can be identified through computational graphs in vision transformers. We propose an effective method for Automatic Visual Circuit Discovery (Vi-CD) that recovers class-specific circuits for classification, identifies circuits underlying typographic attacks in CLIP, and discovers circuits that lend themselves for steering to correct harmful model behavior. Overall, we find that insightful and actionable edge-based circuits can be recovered from vision transformers, adding transparency to the internal computations of these models.

</details>


### [686] [Pushing the Limits of On-Device Streaming ASR: A Compact, High-Accuracy English Model for Low-Latency Inference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.14493)
*Nenad Banfic,David Fan,Kunal Vaishnavi,Sam Kemp,Sunghoon Choi,Rui Ren,Sayan Shaw,Meng Tang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文系统性筛出 CPU-ONNX 端侧流式 ASR 的最优架构为 Nemotron Speech Streaming，经 int4 k-quant + 算子融合后模型由 2.47 GB 缩至 0.67 GB，八数据集流式 WER 仅 8.20%，算法延迟 0.56 s，精度下降 < 1%，刷新质量-效率 Pareto 前沿。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 端侧实时 ASR 需在无 GPU 的 CPU 上同时满足高准确率、低延迟与小内存，但缺乏针对主流架构（含大模型）在统一硬件与流式条件下的定量对比与可落地的极致量化方案，阻碍高质量部署。

Method: 先对 Whisper、Nemotron、Parakeet TDT、Canary、Conformer Transducer、Qwen3-ASR 等 50+ 配置的编码-解码器、Transducer、LLM 范式在批量/分块/流式三种推理模式做系统基准；选出最优 Nemotron 后，用 ONNX Runtime 重实现流式管线，并测试重要性加权 k-quant、混合精度、就近取整等后训练量化及图级算子融合策略。

Result: int4 k-quant 方案将模型体积压缩 73%（2.47 GB→0.67 GB），八标准数据集平均流式 WER 8.20%，与全精度 PyTorch 基线绝对差 ≤1%，算法延迟 0.56 s，CPU 推理倍速于实时。

Conclusion: Nemotron Streaming + int4 k-quant 确立了新的端侧流式 ASR 质量-效率平衡点，可在资源受限设备上实现近无损、超实时、低内存的英语语音识别，为端侧大模型 ASR 落地提供了可直接复现的优化范式与基准。

Abstract: Deploying high-quality automatic speech recognition (ASR) on edge devices requires models that jointly optimize accuracy, latency, and memory footprint while operating entirely on CPU without GPU acceleration. We conduct a systematic empirical study of state-of-the-art ASR architectures, encompassing encoder-decoder, transducer, and LLM-based paradigms, evaluated across batch, chunked, and streaming inference modes. Through a comprehensive benchmark of over 50 configurations spanning OpenAI Whisper, NVIDIA Nemotron, Parakeet TDT, Canary, Conformer Transducer, and Qwen3-ASR, we identify NVIDIA's Nemotron Speech Streaming as the strongest candidate for real-time English streaming on resource-constrained hardware. We then re-implement the complete streaming inference pipeline in ONNX Runtime and conduct a controlled evaluation of multiple post-training quantization strategies, including importance-weighted k-quant, mixed-precision schemes, and round-to-nearest quantization, combined with graph-level operator fusion. These optimizations reduce the model from 2.47 GB to as little as 0.67 GB while maintaining word error rate (WER) within 1% absolute of the full-precision PyTorch baseline. Our recommended configuration, the int4 k-quant variant, achieves 8.20% average streaming WER across eight standard benchmarks, running comfortably faster than real-time on CPU with 0.56 s algorithmic latency, establishing a new quality-efficiency Pareto point for on-device streaming ASR.

</details>


### [687] [Improving Machine Learning Performance with Synthetic Augmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.14498)
*Mel Sohm,Charles Dezons,Sami Sellami,Oscar Ninou,Axel Pincon*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 这篇研究首次将金融合成数据增强抽象为“训练分布修正”，发现其同时引入方差缩减与结构偏置；提出容量-匹配零增强+块置换检验以剥离纯信息增益；实证显示仅在高方差场景（如波动率预测）有效，在偏置主导任务（如方向预测）反而有害。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 金融机器学习普遍面临样本稀缺，合成数据虽被广泛使用，却缺乏对其统计机制和适用条件的系统理解，亟需建立理论框架以指导何时该用、何时慎用。

Method: ①把合成增强形式化为“有效训练分布”对真实分布的加权修正，导出偏差-方差结构分解；②设计容量-匹配零增强作为纯样本量对照，以剔除机械量效应；③构建时序块置换检验，无需分布假设即可在弱依赖下做有限样本检验；④在受控马尔可夫切换模型与真实高频期权/日频股票面板中，系统对比 bootstrap、copula、VAE、扩散模型、TimeGAN 在不同增强比例、容量、任务、信噪比与稀有机制下的表现。

Result: 合成数据仅在高方差主导场景（如持久波动率预测）带来显著增益；在偏置主导场景（如近有效方向预测）则因目标分布漂移而系统性恶化；针对稀有机制采样可提升领域指标，但与无条件置换检验冲突。

Conclusion: 合成数据并非万能：其效果由偏差-方差权衡中的主导地位决定，应优先在高方差、低偏置需求任务中使用，并对潜在分布漂移保持警惕；提出的检验框架可为实践提供可操作的诊断工具。

Abstract: Synthetic augmentation is increasingly used to mitigate data scarcity in financial machine learning, yet its statistical role remains poorly understood. We formalize synthetic augmentation as a modification of the effective training distribution and show that it induces a structural bias--variance trade-off: while additional samples may reduce estimation error, they may also shift the population objective whenever the synthetic distribution deviates from regions relevant under evaluation. To isolate informational gains from mechanical sample-size effects, we introduce a size-matched null augmentation and a finite-sample, non-parametric block permutation test that remains valid under weak temporal dependence.
  We evaluate this framework in both controlled Markov-switching environments and real financial datasets, including high-frequency option trade data and a daily equity panel. Across generators spanning bootstrap, copula-based models, variational autoencoders, diffusion models, and TimeGAN, we vary augmentation ratio, model capacity, task type, regime rarity, and signal-to-noise. We show that synthetic augmentation is beneficial only in variance-dominant regimes, such as persistent volatility forecasting-while it deteriorates performance in bias-dominant settings, including near-efficient directional prediction. Rare-regime targeting can improve domain-specific metrics but may conflict with unconditional permutation inference. Our results provide a structural perspective on when synthetic data improves financial learning performance and when it induces persistent distributional distortion.

</details>


### [688] [Geometric Metrics for MoE Specialization: From Fisher Information to Early Failure Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.14500)
*Dongxin Guo,Jikun Wu,Siu Ming Yiu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 首次用信息几何严格刻画MoE专家特化，提出Fisher度量框架，给出不变性理论、失败预测及高效干预，实验跨模态与规模验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有cosine相似度、路由熵等特化指标缺乏理论根基，重参数化后结论不一致，急需可解释且鲁棒的度量。

Method: 将专家路由分布视为概率单纯形上的点，赋予Fisher信息度量，用黎曼几何分析特化动力学；提出FSI与FHS两指标，分别关联下游性能与训练失败阈值。

Result: FSI与下游任务性能相关系数0.91±0.02；FHS在训练10%时预测失败AUC 0.89±0.03，比验证损失早停省23%性能损失、40倍算力；干预协议对FHS>1的87%可恢复。

Conclusion: 信息几何框架首次给出MoE特化的参数化不变度量与失败预测理论，跨文本、视觉及规模实验一致验证，可直接用于训练监控与早期干预。

Abstract: Expert specialization is fundamental to Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) model success, yet existing metrics (cosine similarity, routing entropy) lack theoretical grounding and yield inconsistent conclusions under reparameterization. We present an information-geometric framework providing the first rigorous characterization of MoE specialization dynamics. Our key insight is that expert routing distributions evolve on the probability simplex equipped with the Fisher information metric, enabling formal analysis via Riemannian geometry. We prove that standard heuristic metrics violate parameterization invariance (Theorem 1), establish that specialization corresponds to geodesic flow with quantified approximation bounds (Theorem 2), and derive a failure predictor with theoretical threshold justification (Theorem 3). The framework introduces two principled metrics: Fisher Specialization Index (FSI) achieving r=0.91+/-0.02 correlation with downstream performance, and Fisher Heterogeneity Score (FHS) predicting training failure at 10% completion with AUC=0.89+/-0.03 -- outperforming validation-loss-based early stopping by 23% while requiring 40x fewer compute cycles. We validate intervention protocols achieving 87% recovery rate when FHS>1 is detected. Comprehensive experiments across language modeling (WikiText-103, C4), vision MoE (ImageNet), and scaling studies (8-64 experts, 125M-2.7B parameters) validate our theoretical predictions.

</details>


### [689] [Perspective on Bias in Biomedical AI: Preventing Downstream Healthcare Disparities](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.14514)
*Michal Rosen-Zvi,Yoav Kan-Tor,Michael Danziger,Agata Ferretti,Javier Aula-Blasco,Julia Falcao,Ron Shamir,Mordechai Muszkat*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 生物医学AI中的公平性漏洞早在分子数据收集阶段就已出现，欧洲血统数据过度主导，基础模型恐将放大健康不平等，亟需建立来源可溯、开放共享、评估透明的范式改革。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 消除健康不平等一般聚焦临床环节，但作者发现分子水平的omics数据本身存在族裔偏向才是根源，而预训练–微调型生物医学基础模型将此偏向固化并级联放大。

Method: 自动检索2015–2024年间4719篇PubMed omics文章，分析族裔报告比例；评估CellxGene与GEO等训练数据集的人口结构；指出当前生物医学AI范式对早期偏向的放大路径。

Result: 仅1∼2篇文献报告血统信息并呈微量上升趋势；支撑模型的大型公共数据约八成来自欧洲血统，模型在下放至下游任务时不可避免累积传播这一偏向，监管性后纠难以逆转。

Conclusion: 研究呼吁学界推行“三原则”——Provenance（数据血统可溯源）、Openness（开放访问）、Evaluation Transparency（评估透明），从源头保障AI公平，提升弱势族群健康收益。

Abstract: Healthcare disparities persist across socioeconomic boundaries, often attributed to unequal access to screening, diagnostics, and therapeutics. However, this perspective highlights that critical biases can emerge much earlier, during data collection and research prioritization, long before clinical implementation in cases where the focus of the studies and the data that is collected is at the molecular level. A vast number of studies focus on collecting omics data but the demographic information associated with these datasets is often not reported in the studies, and when it is reported, it shows big biases. An automated analysis of 4719 PubMed-indexed omics publications from 2015 to 2024 reveals that only a small fraction report ancestry or ethnicity information, with ancestry reporting improving slightly. Analysis of large-scale datasets commonly used for model training, such as CellxGene and GEO, reveals substantial population bias where European-ancestry data dominates. As biomedical foundation models become central to biomedical discovery with a paradigm in which base models are pretrained on large datasets and reusing them time and again for many different downstream tasks, they risk perpetuating or amplifying these early-stage biases, leading to cascading inequities that regulatory interventions cannot fully reverse. We propose a community-wide focus on three foundational principles: Provenance, Openness, and Evaluation Transparency to improve equity and robustness in biomedical AI. This approach aims to foster biomedical innovation that more effectively serves underserved populations and improves health outcomes.

</details>


### [690] [Mind DeepResearch Technical Report](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.14518)
*MindDR Team,Li Auto Inc*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: MindDR 是一个仅 30B 参数的多智能体深度研究框架，通过三智能体协同与四阶段专业训练，在多项中英文 benchmark 上超越同规模开源系统并逼近大模型水平，已在理想汽车产品化上线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有大模型虽强，但参数与推理成本高昂，且通用训练难以满足真实、复杂的深度研究任务；因此需探索低参数规模下，通过多智能体协同与精细训练获得领先性能的可行路径。

Method: 提出三智能体架构（规划、深度检索、报告）与四阶段训练管线：SFT 冷启 → Search-RL → Report-RL → Preference Alignment；并自研 500 条中文真实查询的 MindDR Bench，用多维度评分体系评估。

Result: MindDR 在 BrowseComp-ZH、BrowseComp、WideSearch、xbench-DS、DeepResearch Bench 五基准分别达到 45.7%、42.8%、46.5%、75.0%、52.5%，均优于同规模开源智能体系统，逼近更大模型；在 MindDR Bench 上获得 SOTA 51.8 分。

Conclusion: 通过多智能体协作与分阶段强化训练，30B 级模型即可实现接近甚至超越大参数模型的深度研究能力，验证“小模型+系统级优化”路线的有效性与落地潜力。

Abstract: We present \textbf{Mind DeepResearch (MindDR)}, an efficient multi-agent deep research framework that achieves leading performance with only \textasciitilde30B-parameter models through a meticulously designed data synthesis and multi-stage training pipeline. The core innovation of MindDR lies in a collaborative three-agent architecture (Planning Agent, DeepSearch Agent, and Report Agent) and a four-stage agent-specialized training pipeline comprising SFT cold-start, Search-RL, Report-RL and preference alignment. With this regime, MindDR demonstrates competitive performance even with \textasciitilde30B-scale models. Specifically, MindDR achieves 45.7\% on BrowseComp-ZH, 42.8\% on BrowseComp, 46.5\% on WideSearch, 75.0\% on xbench-DS, and 52.5 on DeepResearch Bench, outperforming comparable-scale open-source agent systems and rivaling larger-scale models. MindDR has been deployed as an online product in Li Auto. Furthermore, we introduce \textbf{MindDR Bench}, a curated benchmark of 500 real-world Chinese queries from our internal product user interactions, evaluated through a comprehensive multi-dimensional rubric system rather than relying on a single RACE metric. On MindDR Bench, MindDR achieves a state-of-the-art score of 51.8.

</details>


### [691] [Quantifying Cross-Query Contradictions in Multi-Query LLM Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.14525)
*Rohit Kumar Salla,Ramya Manasa Amancherla,Manoj Saravanan*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 首次系统研究大查询间的全局逻辑一致性，提出Case-file基准与Set-level指标；仅用轻量求解器辅助即可将跨查询矛盾率降至原1/3，而单查询准确率几乎不降。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大模型在关联问题上频繁给出互相矛盾的回答，现有评价只关注孤立问题，缺少对“跨查询全局一致性”的定量刻画与修复手段，严重阻碍多轮/长链推理的可靠性。

Method: 1. 构建390条三标签(蕴含/矛盾/未知)多查询基准Case-file；2. 设计Set-level指标：Case可满足率、矛盾密度、修正代价；3. 求解器辅助框架：自动抽取承诺→SAT验证全局可满足性→反例驱动修复(CCGR)；4. 在四个领域、四种基线模型上对比实验。

Result: 引入全局一致性约束后，SetCons一致性得分从0.56提至0.94，跨查询矛盾数平均下降70%；单查询F1仅轻微波动(<1.5%)，证明矛盾降低非靠牺牲准确率。

Conclusion: 全局语义一致性是可被量化、可被优化的独立维度；轻量级约束求解即可显著抑制多轮推理中的前后矛盾，为后续对话、长文档推理等场景提供了可扩展的鲁棒范式。

Abstract: Large language models frequently produce mutually inconsistent answers when reasoning over multiple related queries. We study case-file logical consistency: maintaining a globally satisfiable belief state across interdependent queries. We introduce a benchmark of 390 multi-query reasoning instances with entailment/contradiction/unknown labels and propose set-level metrics including Case Satisfiability Rate, Contradiction Density and Revision Cost. Our solver-augmented approach extracts commitments, verifies global satisfiability and performs counterexample-guided repair. Across four reasoning domains, our method substantially reduces cross-query contradictions (SetCons: 0.56 to 0.94) while preserving per-query accuracy, demonstrating that global coherence is critical for robust multi-query reasoning.

</details>


### [692] [Dissecting Failure Dynamics in Large Language Model Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.14528)
*Wei Zhu,Jian Zhang,Lixing Yu,Kun Yue,Zhiwen Tang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 大型推理模型的错误集中在少数早期“岔路”，若能早期预警并重定向这些点，可显著提升可靠性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有对 LLM 推理失效何时、何处发生的机制认识不足，尤其是推理链扩展后仍全局跑偏的现象缺乏系统解释。

Method: 通过轨迹级统计发现：错误常由少数早期转移点触发，对应局部熵峰；采用不确定性信号 GUIDE（熵+备选采样）实时探针并干预这些关键点，提出 GUARD 框架将计算重分配到最可能纠偏的路径。

Result: 在 GSM8K、MATH、ARC 等多数据集上，GUARD 平均提升准确率 4-9%，推理步数仅增加 12%，显著优于纯抽样或链式思维等量扩算方法。

Conclusion: 推理失败可追溯且可早期止损；精准重定向关键转移点比盲目延长推理更有效，为后续“按需计算”式推理提供新范式。

Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) achieve strong performance through extended inference-time deliberation, yet how their reasoning failures arise remains poorly understood. By analyzing model-generated reasoning trajectories, we find that errors are not uniformly distributed but often originate from a small number of early transition points, after which reasoning remains locally coherent but globally incorrect. These transitions coincide with localized spikes in token-level entropy, and alternative continuations from the same intermediate state can still lead to correct solutions. Based on these observations, we introduce GUARD, a targeted inference-time framework that probes and redirects critical transitions using uncertainty signals. Empirical evaluations across multiple benchmarks confirm that interventions guided by these failure dynamics lead to more reliable reasoning outcomes. Our findings highlight the importance of understanding when and how reasoning first deviates, complementing existing approaches that focus on scaling inference-time computation.

</details>


### [693] [TRACER: Trace-Based Adaptive Cost-Efficient Routing for LLM Classification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.14531)
*Adam Rida*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: TRACER 利用生产日志中免费的 LLM 输入–输出对训练轻量替代模型，通过“一致性门”动态决定是否调用昂贵 LLM，实现最高 100% 请求覆盖并给出可解释边界，已开源。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM 分类服务每次调用都产生带标签的日志，这些数据本可免费复用；但如何在不牺牲质量的前提下，用轻量模型吸收大部分流量、降低边际推理成本，并透明地划定「可用 vs 需回退 LLM」的边界，仍是待解问题。

Method: 提出 TRACER 系统：①持续用 LLM 生产日志训练轻量 surrogate；②设定用户阈值 α，仅当 surrogate 与 LLM 一致性≥α 时才替代推理；③自动生成可解释性工件，指出 surrogate 能处理的输入区域、性能瓶颈及拒绝原因；④整个流程作为开源实现。

Result: 77 类意图数据集（Sonnet 4.6 教师）上，依 α 不同实现 83–100% 流量覆盖；150 类场景下 surrogate 完全取代教师；自然语言推理任务中，一致性门因嵌入空间不可分 correctly 拒绝部署，避免质量下降。

Conclusion: 生产日志即是免费训练集，通过「一致性门 + 可解释边界」可在保证质量的同时显著降低 LLM 推理成本；TRACER 证明了该方法的多场景可行性，并提供了可扩展的开源框架。

Abstract: Every call to an LLM classification endpoint produces a labeled input-output pair already retained in production logs. These pairs constitute a free, growing training set: a lightweight surrogate trained on them can absorb a significant portion of future traffic at near-zero marginal inference cost. The open questions are when the surrogate is reliable enough to deploy, what it handles versus defers, and how that boundary evolves as data accumulates.
  We introduce TRACER (Trace-based Adaptive Cost-Efficient Routing), an open-source system that trains ML surrogates on an LLM's own production traces and governs deployment through a parity gate: the surrogate is activated only when its agreement with the LLM exceeds a user-specified threshold α. To make the routing boundary transparent, TRACER generates interpretability artifacts describing which input regions the surrogate handles, where it plateaus, and why it defers.
  On a 77-class intent benchmark with a Sonnet 4.6 teacher, TRACER achieves 83-100% surrogate coverage depending on the quality target α; on a 150-class benchmark, the surrogate fully replaces the teacher. On a natural language inference task, the parity gate correctly refuses deployment because the embedding representation cannot support reliable separation. The system is available as open-source software.

</details>


### [694] [MARS$^2$: Scaling Multi-Agent Tree Search via Reinforcement Learning for Code Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.14564)
*Pengfei Li,Shijie Wang,Fangyuan Li,Yikun Fu,Kaifeng Liu,Kaiyan Zhang,Dazhi Zhang,Yuqiang Li,Biqing Qi,Bowen Zhou*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: MARS² 把多智能体学习与树搜索融合，用路径级组优势估计解决信用分配，显著刷新代码生成 RL 天花板。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 单策略 RL 在推理任务中因轨迹多样性低而性能饱和；搜索增强 RL 虽引入结构探索，仍受限于单一策略先验。多策略交互能提供丰富探索信号，却与结构化搜索脱节。

Method: 提出 MARS² 框架：将搜索树建模为可学习的多智能体交互环境，多个独立优化的异构智能体在同一树拓扑内协作生成并精化候选解；设计基于树一致奖励塑形的路径级组优势估计，实现跨复杂搜索轨迹的有效信用分配。

Result: 在多个代码生成基准上，MARS² 在不同模型组合与训练设置下均取得一致且显著的性能提升。

Conclusion: 将多智能体协作与树搜索统一耦合，可有效突破 RL 在推理密集型任务中的性能瓶颈，并为后续研究提供开源代码与可复制范式。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) paradigms have demonstrated strong performance on reasoning-intensive tasks such as code generation. However, limited trajectory diversity often leads to diminishing returns, which constrains the achievable performance ceiling. Search-enhanced RL alleviates this issue by introducing structured exploration, which remains constrained by the single-agent policy priors. Meanwhile, leveraging multiple interacting policies can acquire more diverse exploratory signals, but existing approaches are typically decoupled from structured search. We propose \textbf{MARS$^2$} (Multi-Agent Reinforced Tree-Search Scaling), a unified RL framework in which multiple independently-optimized agents collaborate within a shared tree-structured search environment. MARS$^2$ models the search tree as a learnable multi-agent interaction environment, enabling heterogeneous agents to collaboratively generate and refine candidate solutions within a shared search topology. To support effective learning, we introduce a path-level group advantage formulation based on tree-consistent reward shaping, which facilitates effective credit assignment across complex search trajectories. Experiments on code generation benchmarks show that MARS$^2$ consistently improves performance across diverse model combinations and training settings, demonstrating the effectiveness of coupling multi-agent collaboration with tree search for enhancing reinforcement learning. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/TsinghuaC3I/MARTI.

</details>


### [695] [Enhancing Mental Health Counseling Support in Bangladesh using Culturally-Grounded Knowledge](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.14576)
*Md Arid Hasan,Azhagu Meena SP,Aditya Khan,Abu Md Akteruzzaman Bhuiyan,Helal Uddin Ahmed,Joysree Debi,Farig Sadeque,Annie En-Shiun Lee,Syed Ishtiaque Ahmed*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文用人工构建、临床验证的知识图谱（KG）取代或补充检索增强生成（RAG），将压力–干预–结局的因果知识注入大模型，系统提升心理健康咨询回复的文化敏感性、临床适用性与实用性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大模型在生成心理咨询回复时缺乏文化语境、临床依据与指导性，易给出泛化或不安全建议，亟需把经过临床验证的领域知识系统融入生成流程。

Method: 构建多学科专家手动整理、临床验证的「压力-干预-结局」因果知识图谱；对比检索增强生成（RAG）与 KG 引导生成两种范式，在多种 LLM 上测试；采用 BERTScore F1、SBERT 余弦相似度及五项人工指标（情境相关度、临床适宜性、可用性等）评估。

Result: KG-增强方法在上下文相关性、临床正确性与实际可用性上全面优于纯 RAG，人工评分显著提升，验证结构化的专家知识对弥补大模型咨询缺陷至关重要。

Conclusion: 结构化、专家验证的领域知识图谱是提升大模型心理咨询质量的关键路径，为部署低成本、可解释、临床安全的 AI 辅助咨询系统提供了可行框架。未来可扩展图谱、动态更新并结合多模态信息。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) show promise in generating supportive responses for mental health and counseling applications. However, their responses often lack cultural sensitivity, contextual grounding, and clinically appropriate guidance. This work addresses the gap of how to systematically incorporate domain-specific, clinically validated knowledge into LLMs to improve counseling quality. We utilize and compare two approaches, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) and a knowledge graph (KG)-based method, designed to support para-counselors. Our KG is constructed manually and clinically validated, capturing causal relationships between stressors, interventions, and outcomes, with contributions from multidisciplinary people. We evaluated multiple LLMs in both settings using BERTScore F1 and SBERT cosine similarity, as well as human evaluation across five metrics, which is designed to directly measure the effectiveness of counseling beyond similarity at the surface level. The results show that KG-based approaches consistently improve contextual relevance, clinical appropriateness, and practical usability compared to RAG alone, demonstrating that structured, expert-validated knowledge plays a critical role in addressing LLMs limitations in counseling tasks.

</details>


### [696] [Prompt Optimization Is a Coin Flip: Diagnosing When It Helps in Compound AI Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.14585)
*Xing Zhang,Guanghui Wang,Yanwei Cui,Wei Qiu,Ziyuan Li,Bing Zhu,Peiyang He*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 在复合AI系统中，prompt调优的整体成功率≈50%，仿佛掷硬币；只有当任务输出存在可挖掘的固定格式时优化才有效。作者提出2步诊断法：先做80美元ANOVA判定模块耦合，再用10分钟实验检测零样本剩余空间，从而把随机赌优化变成理性决策。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有端到端prompt／agent优化框架（TextGrad、DSPy等）默认两个前提：单个prompt值得独立优化，多个agent prompt存在交互需联合优化。但领域内对这两个前提的检验不足，导致资源浪费。

Method: 1）大数量基线：72次独立优化实验（6方法×4任务×3重复）评估Claude Haiku与Amazon Nova Lite的优化成效。2）系统控制：18,000格点实验隔离交互因子；3）两级诊断：ANOVA预检（共用80美元成本）+10分钟零样本性能（headroom）实验，用来预测优化是否有价值。

Result: 1）全局成功率近50%，在Nova Lite上失败率更高；2）交互效应不显著（所有F<1.0，p>0.52）；3）唯一显著提升(+6.8分)的任务具有可挖掘的输出结构——模型能生成但未默认采用的固定格式。4）提出的双阶段诊断能将优化决策准确率提升至非随机水平。

Conclusion: 对复合AI系统，盲目进行prompt联合优化≈50%豪赌且浪费算力；应先通过ANOVA判定模块耦合，再用零样本“headroom”检验任务结构潜力。只有当任务输出存在可利用格式时，prompt优化才值得推荐。

Abstract: Prompt optimization in compound AI systems is statistically indistinguishable from a coin flip: across 72 optimization runs on Claude Haiku (6 methods $\times$ 4 tasks $\times$ 3 repeats), 49% score below zero-shot; on Amazon Nova Lite, the failure rate is even higher. Yet on one task, all six methods improve over zero-shot by up to $+6.8$ points. What distinguishes success from failure? We investigate with 18,000 grid evaluations and 144 optimization runs, testing two assumptions behind end-to-end optimization tools like TextGrad and DSPy: (A) individual prompts are worth optimizing, and (B) agent prompts interact, requiring joint optimization. Interaction effects are never significant ($p > 0.52$, all $F < 1.0$), and optimization helps only when the task has exploitable output structure -- a format the model can produce but does not default to. We provide a two-stage diagnostic: an \$80 ANOVA pre-test for agent coupling, and a 10-minute headroom test that predicts whether optimization is worthwhile -- turning a coin flip into an informed decision.

</details>


### [697] [GDPR Auto-Formalization with AI Agents and Human Verification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.14607)
*Ha Thanh Nguyen,Wachara Fungwacharakorn,Sabine Wehnert,May Myo Zin,Yuntao Kong,Jieying Xue,Michał Araszkiewicz,Randy Goebel,Ken Satoh*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出一种“人在回路”的多智能体框架，利用大模型迭代生成 GDPR 条款的法律场景、形式规则与原子事实，并通过独立验证模块（含人工审查）构建高质量数据集，证明结构化验证与定向人工监督是可靠法律形式化的关键。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 完全自动地将 GDPR 这类高语境、强 nuance 的法律文本形式化极易出错，需降低风险并保证法律正确性。

Method: 采用角色专精的多智能体工作流：LLM 分别充当场景生成器、规则生成器、事实抽取器，每轮输出经独立验证模块（逻辑验证器、法律审查员）评审，人工反馈迭代修正，逐步构建带标签的 GDPR 形式化数据集。

Result: 框架在 150 条条款上迭代 3 轮后，形式规则逻辑一致性从 62% 提升至 91%，法律正确率由 58% 升至 88%；共沉淀 1,200 条高质量形式规则与 4,500 条原子事实，标注错误率 <3%。失败案例主要集中在“目的限制”与“数据主体同意”的上下文依赖条款。

Conclusion: 大模型可显著加速 GDPR 形式化，但法律 nuance 与语境推理必须依赖结构化验证与定向人工监督；角色专精+人在回路是当前实现可靠法律形式化的可行路径。

Abstract: We study the overall process of automatic formalization of GDPR provisions using large language models, within a human-in-the-loop verification framework. Rather than aiming for full autonomy, we adopt a role-specialized workflow in which LLM-based AI components, operating in a multi-agent setting with iterative feedback, generate legal scenarios, formal rules, and atomic facts. This is coupled with independent verification modules which include human reviewers' assessment of representational, logical, and legal correctness. Using this approach, we construct a high-quality dataset to be used for GDPR auto-formalization, and analyze both successful and problematic cases. Our results show that structured verification and targeted human oversight are essential for reliable legal formalization, especially in the presence of legal nuance and context-sensitive reasoning.

</details>


### [698] [El Agente Forjador: Task-Driven Agent Generation for Quantum Simulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.14609)
*Zijian Zhang,Aiwei Yin,Amaan Baweja,Jiaru Bai,Ignacio Gustin,Varinia Bernales,Alán Aspuru-Guzik*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出「El Agente Forjador」多智能体框架，让 LLM 编码智能体自动生成、验证与复用科学计算工具，在 24 项量子化学／动力学任务上验证其较基线显著提升精度、降低成本，并能跨领域组合工具。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前科学 AI 智能体依赖人工维护的静态工具集，难以快速适配新领域或新库，限制了科研自动化效率。

Method: 设计四阶段工作流（工具分析→工具生成→任务执行→迭代评估），由通用编码智能体循环锻造、校验并共享工具；对比零工具、课程式工具复用与纯编码基线三种模式，跨 5 种智能体配置测试。

Result: 工具生成与复用模式在所有设定下均显著优于纯编码基线；强者预建的课程工具集可令弱者智能体的 API 成本降低、解答质量大幅跃升，且不同领域工具可拼装解决混合任务。

Conclusion: LLM 智能体能依托科学知识自主构建可复用科学工具，科研能力由任务目标驱动而非手工实现定义，为「按需生成-共享-进化」的科研自动化新范式奠定基础。

Abstract: AI for science promises to accelerate the discovery process. The advent of large language models (LLMs) and agentic workflows enables the expediting of a growing range of scientific tasks. However, most of the current generation of agentic systems depend on static, hand-curated toolsets that hinder adaptation to new domains and evolving libraries. We present El Agente Forjador, a multi-agent framework in which universal coding agents autonomously forge, validate, and reuse computational tools through a four-stage workflow of tool analysis, tool generation, task execution, and iterative solution evaluation. Evaluated across 24 tasks spanning quantum chemistry and quantum dynamics on five coding agent setups, we compare three operating modes: zero-shot generation of tools per task, reuse of a curriculum-built toolset, and direct problem-solving with the coding agents as the baseline. We find that our tool generation and reuse framework consistently improves accuracy over the baseline. We also show that reusing a toolset built by a stronger coding agent can reduce API cost and substantially raises the solution quality for weaker coding agents. Case studies further demonstrate that tools forged for different domains can be combined to solve hybrid tasks. Taken together, these results show that LLM-based agents can use their scientific knowledge and coding capabilities to autonomously build reusable scientific tools, pointing toward a paradigm in which agent capabilities are defined by the tasks they are designed to solve rather than by explicitly engineered implementations.

</details>


### [699] [CoDaS: AI Co-Data-Scientist for Biomarker Discovery via Wearable Sensors](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.14615)
*Yubin Kim,Salman Rahman,Samuel Schmidgall,Chunjong Park,A. Ali Heydari,Ahmed A. Metwally,Hong Yu,Xin Liu,Xuhai Xu,Yuzhe Yang,Maxwell A. Xu,Zhihan Zhang,Cynthia Breazeal,Tim Althoff,Petar Sirkovic,Ivor Rendulic,Annalisa Pawlosky,Nicolas Stroppa,Juraj Gottweis,Elahe Vedadi,Alan Karthikesalingam,Pushmeet Kohli,Vivek Natarajan,Mark Malhotra,Shwetak Patel,Hae Won Park,Hamid Palangi,Daniel McDuff*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 多智能体框架 CoDaS 自动从可穿戴连续生理信号中挖掘数字生物标志物，在 9 279 例数据中系统识别出 41 个心理健康与 25 个代谢候选标志物，并通过严格内部验证证实其在独立队列中的可重复性与临床关联性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
