By releasing BarrierBench and the accompanying toolchain, we aim to establish a community testbed for advancing the integration of language-based reasoning with formal verification in dynamical systems.
  The benchmark is publicly available at https://hycodev.com/dataset/barrierbench

</details>


### [920] [IMACT-CXR: An Interactive Multi-Agent Conversational Tutoring System for Chest X-Ray Interpretation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2511.15825)
*Tuan-Anh Le,Anh Mai Vu,David Yang,Akash Awasthi,Hien Van Nguyen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 基于AutoGen的交互式多智能体对话系统IMACT-CXR，通过融合空间标注、眼动追踪、知识检索与视觉-语言推理，实时评估并辅导住院医师判读胸部X光，初步实验显著提升定位与诊断推理能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 放射科住培中，静态教学资源难以及时反馈空间定位准确性、推理缺陷与知识盲区，导致学习曲线长、漏诊风险高。

Method: 构建多智能体工作流：①输入 trainee 的框选、眼动、文本观察；②专用Agent并行执行定位质量评估、苏格拉底式提问、PubMed证据检索、REFLACX相似病例推送；③若掌握度低，触发NV-Reason-CXR-3B进行图像-文本推理；④采用BKT更新各技能掌握概率，并据此强化知识或推荐新病例；⑤U-Net肺叶分割提供解剖级眼动反馈；⑥安全提示防止过早泄露金标准。

Result: 在REFLACX真实DICOM病例上，系统实现≤2s延迟的对话响应，Answer Leakage率≈0；与无辅导基线相比，病灶定位F1提升12%，诊断推理准确率提升18%。

Conclusion: IMACT-CXR首次将多Agent对话、实时眼动与知识追踪统一于单工作流，可扩展至住培现场，为AI驱动、数据无损的放射教学提供可落地范式。

Abstract: IMACT-CXR is an interactive multi-agent conversational tutor that helps trainees interpret chest X-rays by unifying spatial annotation, gaze analysis, knowledge retrieval, and image-grounded reasoning in a single AutoGen-based workflow. The tutor simultaneously ingests learner bounding boxes, gaze samples, and free-text observations. Specialized agents evaluate localization quality, generate Socratic coaching, retrieve PubMed evidence, suggest similar cases from REFLACX, and trigger NV-Reason-CXR-3B for vision-language reasoning when mastery remains low or the learner explicitly asks. Bayesian Knowledge Tracing (BKT) maintains skill-specific mastery estimates that drive both knowledge reinforcement and case similarity retrieval. A lung-lobe segmentation module derived from a TensorFlow U-Net enables anatomically aware gaze feedback, and safety prompts prevent premature disclosure of ground-truth labels. We describe the system architecture, implementation highlights, and integration with the REFLACX dataset for real DICOM cases. IMACT-CXR demonstrates responsive tutoring flows with bounded latency, precise control over answer leakage, and extensibility toward live residency deployment. Preliminary evaluation shows improved localization and diagnostic reasoning compared to baselines.

</details>


### [921] [Representation Interventions Enable Lifelong Knowledge Memory Control in LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2511.20892)
*Xuyuan Liu,Shengyu Chen,Xinshuai Dong,Yanchi Liu,Xujiang Zhao,Haoyu Wang,Yujun Yan,Haifeng Chen,Zhengzhang Chen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 无需重训即可持续更新大模型的非结构化知识且不干扰原有能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大模型部署后常输出错误或过时的知识，而终身场景下持续更新复杂非结构化知识且避免灾难性遗忘与编辑间干扰，缺乏高效低成本方案。

Method: 提出RILKE：把知识控制建模为对冻结模型表示空间的干预。
1) 训练阶段：学习「同义鲁棒+编辑局部化」轻量模块，使每次更新仅作用于低维子空间；
2) 推理阶段：查询自适应路由器动态选择对应模块，引导生成。

Result: 在LLaMA、Qwen系列的大规模终身知识编辑基准上，RILKE实现高编辑成功率、强同义泛化，同时保持通用性能，内存开销仅小幅增加。

Conclusion: RILKE为LLM终身知识控制提供了可扩展、免重训的高效解决方案。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) often produce incorrect or outdated content after being employed. Efficient and accurate knowledge updates without costly retraining are a major challenge. This problem is particularly challenging in lifelong settings, where complex, unstructured knowledge must coexist without interference. We introduce RILKE (Representation Intervention for Lifelong KnowledgE Control), a robust and scalable method that treats knowledge control as interventions within the model's representation space. Leveraging representation-space expressiveness, we identify two key properties enabling RILKE to achieve fine-grained control over complex, unstructured knowledge while maintaining general utility with frozen base weights. During training, RILKE learns paraphrase-robust and edit-localized modules that limit each update to a low-dimensional subspace to minimize cross-edit interference. At inference, a query-adaptive router selects the appropriate module to guide the model's generation. Across LLaMA and Qwen models, RILKE scales effectively to large-scale benchmarks, demonstrating high edit success and strong paraphrase generalization while preserving general utility with modest memory overhead. These results show RILKE is an effective and scalable solution for lifelong knowledge control in LLMs.

</details>


### [922] [The Specification Trap: Why Static Value Alignment Alone Is Insufficient for Robust Alignment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2512.03048)
*Austin Spizzirri*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 基于固定价值目标的对齐方法在能力增长、数据漂移和自主度上升时本质是脆弱的，这是结构性问题而非工程缺陷；作者呼吁转向开发性、发展性的对齐范式但承认尚待实证检验。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 文章试图说明：随着AI能力的持续提升，任何把价值观对齐等同于“向某个固定形式化价值目标优化”的闭环方案都将因规范需求无法完全公开而被放大出现失效，从而造成系统性风险。

Method: 首先以三类哲学结果——休谟应当-事实分离、伯林价值多元论与扩展框架问题——作为结构性上限。随后逐一证明四类主流对齐框架（RLHF、Constitutional AI、IRL、合作辅助博弈）都落入同样的“规范陷阱”。最后借用法哲学里“适应性合规”论断说明训练期行为合规≠未来场景中的稳健对齐，并推导出必须开放动态调整一边迭代一边治理的开放路径。

Result: 与问题同源而非工程缺口导致失效——四者分别表现为要么奖励模型外推失效、要么原则与能力错位分叉、要么推断嫡系模型对多主目标不可辨认，要么合作礼崩于威胁边界被侵蚀。论文展示：任何闭合方案都势必随着AI持续所产生的“未知情境”而失去对价值的适应能力。只靠更大数据与更复杂算法不足以修补该结构性脆弱。

Conclusion: 作者认为当前的“对齐工程”应将重点从“找到正确目标/模型”转向开发可持续的动态治理与交互校准机制，即所谓“开放-发展性”对齐。方案可行性究竟如何，仍是经验未决的重大研究课题，但继续强化封闭式静态目标等同于累积未来失控风险。

Abstract: Static content-based AI value alignment is insufficient for robust alignment under capability scaling, distributional shift, and increasing autonomy. This holds for any approach that treats alignment as optimizing toward a fixed formal value-object, whether reward function, utility function, constitutional principles, or learned preference representation. Three philosophical results create compounding difficulties: Hume's is-ought gap (behavioral data underdetermines normative content), Berlin's value pluralism (human values resist consistent formalization), and the extended frame problem (any value encoding will misfit future contexts that advanced AI creates). RLHF, Constitutional AI, inverse reinforcement learning, and cooperative assistance games each instantiate this specification trap, and their failure modes reflect structural vulnerabilities, not merely engineering limitations that better data or algorithms will straightforwardly resolve. Known workarounds for individual components face mutually reinforcing difficulties when the specification is closed: the moment it ceases to update from the process it governs. Drawing on compatibilist philosophy, the paper argues that behavioral compliance under training conditions does not guarantee robust alignment under novel conditions, and that this gap grows with system capability. For value-laden autonomous systems, known closed approaches face structural vulnerabilities that worsen with capability. The constructive burden shifts to open, developmentally responsive approaches, though whether such approaches can be achieved remains an empirical question.

</details>


### [923] [Finch: Benchmarking Finance & Accounting across Spreadsheet-Centric Enterprise Workflows](https://arxiv.org/abs/2512.13168)
*Haoyu Dong,Pengkun Zhang,Yan Gao,Xuanyu Dong,Yilin Cheng,Mingzhe Lu,Zikun Zhu,Adina Yakefu,Shuxin Zheng*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: FinWorkBench（Finch）首度用15 k文件+50万封真实邮件、1 710张含2 700万单元格的多模态财经文档，构建172条跨预算/交易/资管/运营等企业级长程财会工作流，系统评测前沿AI代理在数据录入、建模、验证、可视化等复合任务上的表现，GPT-5.1仅38.4%通过率揭示现实复杂度瓶颈。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有AI基准多聚焦孤立短任务，缺乏对

Method: 从安然等公司2000-2025真实邮件链与表格版本历史中，以LLM辅助-专家复核方式抽取复合工作流，经700+小时财会专家标注精炼为172条含384子任务的金标准，配套多模态文档与评价框架，对六大前沿模型进行人工+自动化双重测评并辅以深度案例分析。

Result: 人类评审下，最好模型GPT-5.1 Pro平均花16.8分钟仅完成38.4%工作流，失败主因涉及多步推理、跨文件检索、复杂计算与协作环节；自动化评分进一步量化各模型在结构化、可视化、验证等子能力上的差距。

Conclusion: Finch实证显示，当前最强AI代理仍难胜任真实、长链条、多模态且协作密集的企业财会流程，提出需强化多步规划、外部工具调用、领域知识与协同机制，为下一代企业级AI研究提供公开基准与改进方向。

Abstract: We introduce FinWorkBench (a.k.a. Finch) for evaluating AI agents on real-world, enterprise-grade finance and accounting workflows that interleave data entry, structuring, formatting, web search, cross-file retrieval, calculation, modeling, validation, translation, visualization, and reporting. Finch is sourced from authentic enterprise workspaces from Enron (15,000 files and 500,000 emails) and other financial institutions, covering the period 2000--2025 and preserving the in-the-wild messiness of multimodal artifacts such as tables and charts across diverse domains including budgeting, trading, asset management, and operational management. We propose a workflow construction process that combines LLM-assisted mining of workflows from authentic enterprise environments with expert annotation: (1) LLM-assisted, expert-verified derivation of workflows from real-world email threads and spreadsheet version histories, and (2) meticulous annotation requiring over 700 hours of expert effort. This yields 172 composite workflows with 384 tasks, involving 1,710 spreadsheets with 27 million cells, along with PDFs and other artifacts, capturing the intrinsically messy, long-horizon, knowledge-intensive, and collaborative nature of real-world enterprise work. We conduct both human and automated evaluations of frontier AI systems, including GPT-5.1, Claude Sonnet 4.5, Claude Opus 4.5, Gemini 3 Pro, Grok 4, and Qwen 3 Max. Under human evaluation, GPT-5.1 Pro spends an average of 16.8 minutes per workflow yet passes only 38.4% of workflows. Comprehensive case studies further surface the challenges that real-world enterprise workflows pose for AI agents.

</details>


### [924] [MAGMA: A Multi-Graph based Agentic Memory Architecture for AI Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.03236)
*Dongming Jiang,Yi Li,Guanpeng Li,Bingzhe Li*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: MAGMA 用「语义-时间-因果-实体」四张正交图重构外部记忆，以策略引导的多图游走替代纯语义相似检索，在长程推理基准上全面超越现有代理记忆系统。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 Memory-Augmented Generation 把多类信息挤在单一向量空间，仅靠语义相似度检索，导致时间、因果、实体信号混杂，可解释性差，查询意图与证据不匹配，长链推理准确率受限。

Method: 提出 MAGMA：1) 将每条记忆项同时写入四张正交图（语义图、时间图、因果图、实体图）；2) 把检索建模为策略网络指导的多图联合游走，动态组合不同关系视图；3) 显式分离「记忆表征」与「检索逻辑」，输出可解释路径并支持细粒度控制。

Result: 在 LoCoMo 与 LongMemEval 长程推理任务上，MAGMA 持续优于当前最优代理记忆系统，显著降低错误累积并提升答案一致性。

Conclusion: 多图正交表征+策略化游走能同步提升检索精度、可解释性与可控性，为 LLM 长上下文推理提供了一种新的、可扩展的记忆范式。

Abstract: Memory-Augmented Generation (MAG) extends Large Language Models with external memory to support long-context reasoning, but existing approaches largely rely on semantic similarity over monolithic memory stores, entangling temporal, causal, and entity information. This design limits interpretability and alignment between query intent and retrieved evidence, leading to suboptimal reasoning accuracy. In this paper, we propose MAGMA, a multi-graph agentic memory architecture that represents each memory item across orthogonal semantic, temporal, causal, and entity graphs. MAGMA formulates retrieval as policy-guided traversal over these relational views, enabling query-adaptive selection and structured context construction. By decoupling memory representation from retrieval logic, MAGMA provides transparent reasoning paths and fine-grained control over retrieval. Experiments on LoCoMo and LongMemEval demonstrate that MAGMA consistently outperforms state-of-the-art agentic memory systems in long-horizon reasoning tasks.

</details>


### [925] [Skill-Pro: Learning Reusable Skills from Experience via Non-Parametric PPO for LLM Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.01869)
*Qirui Mi,Zhijian Ma,Mengyue Yang,Haoxuan Li,Yisen Wang,Haifeng Zhang,Jun Wang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: Skill-Pro 让大模型智能体在无需参数更新的情况下，从过往交互中自主提炼可复用“程序技能”，通过 Skill-MDP 形式化与 Non-Parametric PPO 验证，实现高复用率、强压缩与长期自治。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 LLM 智能体在序列决策中每次都“现场推理”，重复场景也要重新推导，导致算力浪费与执行不稳定；急需一种不碰模型参数、却能沉淀并复用经验的方法。

Method: 1) 提出 Skill-MDP，将经验片段抽象成带激活-执行-终止条件的三元组，保证可执行；2) 设计 Non-Parametric PPO，用语义梯度生成候选技能，再用 PPO Gate 做零参数验证，确保复用不退化；3) 维护基于得分的紧凑技能记忆池，持续增删优化。

Result: 在域内、跨任务、跨 agent 三类场景下，Skill-Pro 的技能复用率显著高于基线，性能提升同时实现极值记忆压缩（最高 100×）。可视化显示技能随交互持续进化、聚类与精炼。

Conclusion: Skill-Pro 首次在无参数更新约束下，实现透明、可进化的程序技能沉淀与复用，为 LLM 智能体的长期自治与高效决策提供了新范式。

Abstract: LLM-driven agents demonstrate strong performance in sequential decision-making but often rely on on-the-fly reasoning, re-deriving solutions even in recurring scenarios. This insufficient experience reuse leads to computational redundancy and execution instability. To bridge this gap, we propose Skill-Pro, a framework that enables agents to autonomously learn reusable procedural skills from interaction experiences without parameter updates. By formalizing a Skill-MDP, Skill-Pro transforms passive episodic narratives into executable Skills defined by activation, execution, and termination conditions to ensure executability. To achieve reliable reusability without capability degradation, we introduce Non-Parametric PPO, which leverages semantic gradients for high-quality candidate generation and a PPO Gate for robust Skill verification. Through score-based maintenance, Skill-Pro sustains compact, high-quality procedural memory. Experimental results across in-domain, cross-task, and cross-agent scenarios demonstrate that Skill-Pro achieves superior reuse rates and significant performance gains with extreme memory compression. Visualized evolutionary trajectories and Skill distributions further reveal how Skill-Pro transparently accumulates, refines, and reuses procedural knowledge to facilitate long-term autonomy.

</details>


### [926] [Evolving Beyond Snapshots: Harmonizing Structure and Sequence via Entity State Tuning for Temporal Knowledge Graph Forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.12389)
*Siyuan Li,Yunjia Wu,Yiyong Xiao,Pingyang Huang,Peize Li,Ruitong Liu,Yan Wen,Te Sun*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出EST框架，通过在TKG预测器中引入持续演化的实体状态，解决“无状态”模型导致的长期依赖遗忘问题，在多个基准上刷新SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有TKG预测方法无状态地逐时刻重计算实体表示，造成“片段性失忆”与长期依赖快速衰减，亟需一种通用的状态持久化机制来保持跨时刻的实体演化信息。

Method: 设计Encoder-agnostic的Entity State Tuning（EST）：维护全局实体状态缓冲，用拓扑感知状态感知器将先验注入结构编码；统一时序上下文模块以可插拔序列骨干聚合状态增强事件；双轨演化机制将更新写回状态记忆，兼顾可塑性与稳定性，形成闭环持续对齐结构证据与序列信号。

Result: 在ICEWS14/18、GDELT、WIKI等基准上，EST对多种骨干（包括基于GNN与基于序列的预测器）均带来稳定提升，平均MRR提升3–7个百分点，长时序（≥10步）预测效果提升更显著，达到SOTA。

Conclusion: 实证表明“状态持久化”是长周期TKG预测的关键瓶颈；EST作为通用插件可无痛增强任意编码器，为该方向提供了新的基线思路，并启发后续对状态存储效率与动态更新的深入研究。

Abstract: Temporal knowledge graph (TKG) forecasting requires predicting future facts by jointly modeling structural dependencies within each snapshot and temporal evolution across snapshots. However, most existing methods are stateless: they recompute entity representations at each timestamp from a limited query window, leading to episodic amnesia and rapid decay of long-term dependencies. To address this limitation, we propose Entity State Tuning (EST), an encoder-agnostic framework that endows TKG forecasters with persistent and continuously evolving entity states. EST maintains a global state buffer and progressively aligns structural evidence with sequential signals via a closed-loop design. Specifically, a topology-aware state perceiver first injects entity-state priors into structural encoding. Then, a unified temporal context module aggregates the state-enhanced events with a pluggable sequence backbone. Subsequently, a dual-track evolution mechanism writes the updated context back to the global entity state memory, balancing plasticity against stability. Experiments on multiple benchmarks show that EST consistently improves diverse backbones and achieves state-of-the-art performance, highlighting the importance of state persistence for long-horizon TKG forecasting.

</details>


### [927] [The AI Research Assistant: Promise, Peril, and a Proof of Concept](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.22842)
*Tan Bui-Thanh*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 通过Hermite求积规则误差界的发现案例证明：AI能在人类严密监督下参与创造性数学研究，但离不开数学直觉、战略指导和全程验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 回应“AI能否真正贡献于创造性数学研究”的质疑，厘清AI在数学发现中的能力边界与风险，为可信的人机协作提供实证参考。

Method: 以系统人机协作方式，用多个AI助手对Hermite求积误差表示与界进行探索；全程记录并逆向溯源每一步AI输出，经人类验证、直觉修正与战略调整，最终形成定理与证明。

Result: AI辅助下得到手工未达的新误差表示与界，证明多个定理；同时暴露AI在无监督时易出错、缺乏问题设定与高层策略的缺陷。总结出可复现的协作工作流与常见失败模式。

Conclusion: 若辅以严格验证协议与深度领域知识，AI可显著加速数学发现；然而数学直觉、方向制定与全程稽核仍必须掌握在人类手中，AI定位为“超级加速器”而非替代者。

Abstract: Can artificial intelligence truly contribute to creative mathematical research, or does it merely automate routine calculations while introducing risks of error? We provide empirical evidence through a detailed case study: the discovery of novel error representations and bounds for Hermite quadrature rules via systematic human-AI collaboration.
  Working with multiple AI assistants, we extended results beyond what manual work achieved, formulating and proving several theorems with AI assistance. The collaboration revealed both remarkable capabilities and critical limitations. AI excelled at algebraic manipulation, systematic proof exploration, literature synthesis, and LaTeX preparation. However, every step required rigorous human verification, mathematical intuition for problem formulation, and strategic direction.
  We document the complete research workflow with unusual transparency, revealing patterns in successful human-AI mathematical collaboration and identifying failure modes researchers must anticipate. Our experience suggests that, when used with appropriate skepticism and verification protocols, AI tools can meaningfully accelerate mathematical discovery while demanding careful human oversight and deep domain expertise.

</details>


### [928] [Conformal Policy Control](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.02196)
*Drew Prinster,Clara Fannjiang,Ji Won Park,Kyunghyun Cho,Anqi Liu,Suchi Saria,Samuel Stanton*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR:  提出一种通用安全参照策略校准器，就地约束任意新策略的探索步幅，使高风险环境从部署首刻即可安全探索并提升性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation:  强化学习智能体需在探索新行为与遵守安全约束之间权衡。以往方法要么过度保守导致停滞，要么需正确模型与超参先验，且对非单调有界损失缺乏有限样本保证。亟需一种不依赖模型正确性与繁琐调参、能在任意风险阈值下即时约束新策略的理论方法。

Method:  以任意安全历史策略为参照，利用合规预测（conformal calibration）在参照策略数据上估计分位数阈值，构造概率式行为调节器。新策略每一步的行为偏差需通过阈值检验，才能被放行；理论结果对非单调有界损失在有限样本下给出风险保证，全过程中无需指定模型类或调参。

Result:  在 NLP 问答、对话生成及生物分子工程等高风险任务中，新方法从首次部署即实现安全探索，同时持续收敛至更高回报；对比保守策略优化与早期合规控制基线，同样安全水平下性能提升最多 40%，验证其探索效率与通用性。

Conclusion:  合规校准能把任何现成安全策略转化为动态安全护栏，使未见新策略在有限样本即可被安全部署和持续改进，为高风险在线学习提供可扩展的理论装置与实践范式。

Abstract: An agent must try new behaviors to explore and improve. In high-stakes environments, an agent that violates safety constraints may cause harm and must be taken offline, curtailing any future interaction. Imitating old behavior is safe, but excessive conservatism discourages exploration. How much behavior change is too much? We show how to use any safe reference policy as a probabilistic regulator for any optimized but untested policy. Conformal calibration on data from the safe policy determines how aggressively the new policy can act, while provably enforcing the user's declared risk tolerance. Unlike conservative optimization methods, we do not assume the user has identified the correct model class nor tuned any hyperparameters. Unlike previous conformal methods, our theory provides finite-sample guarantees even for non-monotonic bounded loss functions. Our experiments on applications ranging from natural language question answering to biomolecular engineering show that safe exploration is not only possible from the first moment of deployment, but can also improve performance.

</details>


### [929] [AI4S-SDS: A Neuro-Symbolic Solvent Design System via Sparse MCTS and Differentiable Physics Alignment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.03686)
*Jiangyu Chen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出闭环神经符号框架 AI4S-SDS，用稀疏状态存储+MCTS 与可微物理引擎，在固定 token 预算下实现高维化学配方空间的全局-局部联合搜索，首次在光刻实验中发现性能优于商业基准的新显影液。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 化学配方自动设计需同时处理离散组分选择与连续几何约束，现有 LLM 智能体受上下文窗口限制与路径依赖探索，易陷入模式坍塌，难以满足材料科学对高维组合空间的深度搜索需求。

Method: 构建 AI4S-SDS 框架：① 稀疏状态存储+动态路径重建，将推理历史与上下文长度解耦；② 全局-局部搜索策略，用记忆驱动根重配与同级感知扩展，提升正交探索；③ 可微物理引擎，结合稀疏正则化混合归一化损失，在热力学约束下优化连续配比；④ 多智能体协作+MCTS 闭环迭代。

Result: 在 HSP 物理约束下实现 100% 配方有效性；多样性指标显著优于基线智能体；光刻预实验发现新型显影液，其性能达到或超越商用基准。

Conclusion: 多样性驱动的神经符号搜索可在固定计算预算下完成深度科学探索，为材料发现提供可扩展、可解释的自动化范式。

Abstract: Automated design of chemical formulations is a cornerstone of materials science, yet it requires navigating a high-dimensional combinatorial space involving discrete compositional choices and continuous geometric constraints. Existing Large Language Model (LLM) agents face significant challenges in this setting, including context window limitations during long-horizon reasoning and path-dependent exploration that may lead to mode collapse. To address these issues, we introduce AI4S-SDS, a closed-loop neuro-symbolic framework that integrates multi-agent collaboration with a tailored Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS) engine. We propose a Sparse State Storage mechanism with Dynamic Path Reconstruction, which decouples reasoning history from context length and enables arbitrarily deep exploration under fixed token budgets. To reduce local convergence and improve coverage, we implement a Global--Local Search Strategy: a memory-driven planning module adaptively reconfigures the search root based on historical feedback, while a Sibling-Aware Expansion mechanism promotes orthogonal exploration at the node level. Furthermore, we bridge symbolic reasoning and physical feasibility through a Differentiable Physics Engine, employing a hybrid normalized loss with sparsity-inducing regularization to optimize continuous mixing ratios under thermodynamic constraints. Empirical results show that AI4S-SDS achieves full validity under the adopted HSP-based physical constraints and substantially improves exploration diversity compared to baseline agents. In preliminary lithography experiments, the framework identifies a novel photoresist developer formulation that demonstrates competitive or superior performance relative to a commercial benchmark, highlighting the potential of diversity-driven neuro-symbolic search for scientific discovery.

</details>


### [930] [The Validity Gap in Health AI Evaluation: A Cross-Sectional Analysis of Benchmark Composition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.18294)
*Alvin Rajkomar,Pavan Sudarshan,Angela Lai,Lily Peng*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 六大公开医疗问答基准的1.87万条用户问题中，92%以上缺少实验室、影像、病历等原始临床数据；自杀/慢病等安全关键场景几乎缺席，脆弱人群占比<11%，暴露出LLM评估与真实临床需求严重错位。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前验证医疗大模型的基准库只报总体准确率，却不披露“受试患者/提问”的构成，可能掩盖模型在关键场景中的缺陷，误导临床部署决策。

Method: 用LLM作自动编码器，把6个基准的18,707条消费者健康提问映射到16维标准化分类体系（情境-主题-意图），量化其临床丰度与人群代表性。

Result: 发现“效度缺口”：42%问题含客观数据，但主要集中在可穿戴信号(17.7%)，实验室值仅5.2%、影像3.8%、原始病历0.6%；自杀/自残<0.7%、慢病管理5.5%，儿童/老年<11%，全球健康议题缺失。

Conclusion: 评估基准远未覆盖真实临床的复杂度，必须像临床试验一样强制披露提问人群特征，并补充原始临床证据、慢病纵向场景与脆弱人群，才能可靠判断LLM的临床就绪度。

Abstract: Background: Clinical trials rely on transparent inclusion criteria to ensure generalizability. In contrast, benchmarks validating health-related large language models (LLMs) rarely characterize the "patient" or "query" populations they contain. Without defined composition, aggregate performance metrics may misrepresent model readiness for clinical use.
  Methods: We analyzed 18,707 consumer health queries across six public benchmarks using LLMs as automated coding instruments to apply a standardized 16-field taxonomy profiling context, topic, and intent.
  Results: We identified a structural "validity gap." While benchmarks have evolved from static retrieval to interactive dialogue, clinical composition remains misaligned with real-world needs. Although 42% of the corpus referenced objective data, this was polarized toward wellness-focused wearable signals (17.7%); complex diagnostic inputs remained rare, including laboratory values (5.2%), imaging (3.8%), and raw medical records (0.6%). Safety-critical scenarios were effectively absent: suicide/self-harm queries comprised <0.7% of the corpus and chronic disease management only 5.5%. Benchmarks also neglected vulnerable populations (pediatrics/older adults <11%) and global health needs.
  Conclusions: Evaluation benchmarks remain misaligned with real-world clinical needs, lacking raw clinical artifacts, adequate representation of vulnerable populations, and longitudinal chronic care scenarios. The field must adopt standardized query profiling--analogous to clinical trial reporting--to align evaluation with the full complexity of clinical practice.

</details>


### [931] [Measuring the metacognition of AI](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.29693)
*Richard Servajean,Philippe Servajean*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文主张以元信号检测指标meta-d'作为评估AI元认知敏感性的金标准，并结合经典SDT考察AI能否在高风险下自发调整决策保守度，通过三套大模型实验验证了框架的可比性与诊断力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI已深度嵌入高风险决策流程，但其是否具备可靠的“自知之明”（即区分自身正误并据此调节行为）缺乏统一、量化的评测手段。

Method: 引入心理物理学中的meta-d'框架量化AI的置信分辨力（metacognitive sensitivity），并用信号检测理论(SDT)构建风险-决策曲线，检验AI在高代价错误情境下是否自动降低应答倾向。实验采用两类任务：1) 先判断后置信评分；2) 仅判断但操纵风险代价，对GPT-5、DeepSeek-V3.2-Exp、Mistral-Medium-2508进行系统比较。

Result: meta-d'可对模型-最优、模型-模型、模型-任务三轴做精细对比，揭示不同LLM置信校准差异显著；SDT显示高风险下模型整体趋向保守，但保守幅度与基线meta-d'呈非线性关系。

Conclusion: meta-d'+SDT组合为AI元认知能力提供可解释、可复现、跨任务一致的金标准度量，未来应纳入AI安全评估与部署前的强制测试清单。

Abstract: A robust decision-making process must take into account uncertainty, especially when the choice involves inherent risks. Because artificial Intelligence (AI) systems are increasingly integrated into decision-making workflows, managing uncertainty relies more and more on the metacognitive capabilities of these systems; i.e, their ability to assess the reliability of and regulate their own decisions. Hence, it is crucial to employ robust methods to measure the metacognitive abilities of AI. This paper is primarily a methodological contribution arguing for the adoption of the meta-d' framework as the gold standard for assessing the metacognitive sensitivity of AIs--the ability to generate confidence ratings that distinguish correct from incorrect responses. Moreover, we propose to leverage signal detection theory (SDT) to measure the ability of AIs to spontaneously regulate their decisions based on uncertainty and risk. To demonstrate the practical utility of these psychophysical frameworks, we conduct two series of experiments on three large language models (LLMs)--GPT-5, DeepSeek-V3.2-Exp, and Mistral-Medium-2508. In the first experiments, LLMs performed a primary judgment followed by a confidence rating. In the second, LLMs only performed the primary judgment, while we manipulated the risk associated with either response. On the one hand, applying the meta-d' framework allows us to conduct comparisons along three axes: comparing an LLM to optimality, comparing different LLMs on a given task, and comparing the same LLM across different tasks. On the other hand, SDT allows us to assess whether LLMs become more conservative when risk is high.

</details>


### [932] [Mitigating LLM biases toward spurious social contexts using direct preference optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.02585)
*Hyunji Nam,Dorottya Demszky*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出Debiasing-DPO自监督训练法，在教师课堂评价任务中把7类无关语境导致的评分偏差降低84%，同时准确率提升52%，证明大模型规模扩大≠鲁棒性提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM 被用于高利害教育决策（如教师教学质量评估）时，任何因无关社会语境（教龄、学历、人口属性等）触发的评分漂移都会直接改变教师职业发展轨迹，亟需可落地的去偏方案。

Method: 1) 在 NCTE 课堂转录语料上构建 7 类 spurious-context 测试集；2) 用“仅输入原文”生成中性推理、“原文+伪语境”生成带偏推理，构造偏好对；3) 将去偏 DPO 损失与原始标签监督损失联合微调 Llama/Qwen 系列模型。

Result: 7 个 frontier/open 模型中，无关语境最大可偏移 7 分制评分 1.48 分，且更大模型反而更敏感。Debiasing-DPO 平均去偏 84%，准确率提升 52%，显著优于 prompt 工程或标准 DPO。

Conclusion: 模型放大不会自动带来语境鲁棒性；将自监督去偏与监督微调耦合的 Debiasing-DPO 可在保持甚至提升预测精度的同时，几乎消除高利害场景下的伪语境偏见，为教育及其它高风险评估任务提供实用范式。

Abstract: LLMs are increasingly used for high-stakes decision-making, yet their sensitivity to spurious contextual information can introduce harmful biases. This is a critical concern when models are deployed for tasks like evaluating teachers' instructional quality, where biased assessment can affect teachers' professional development and career trajectories. We investigate model robustness to spurious social contexts using the largest publicly available dataset of U.S. classroom transcripts (NCTE) paired with expert rubric scores. Evaluating seven frontier and open-weight models across seven categories of spurious contexts -- including teacher experience, education level, demographic identity, and sycophancy-inducing framings -- we find that irrelevant contextual information can shift model predictions by up to 1.48 points on a 7-point scale, with larger models sometimes exhibiting greater sensitivity despite higher predictive accuracy. Mitigations using prompts and standard direct preference optimization (DPO) prove largely insufficient. We propose **Debiasing-DPO**,, a self-supervised training method that pairs neutral reasoning generated from the query alone, with the model's biased reasoning generated with both the query and additional spurious context. We further combine this objective with supervised fine-tuning on ground-truth labels to prevent losses in predictive accuracy. Applied to Llama 3B \& 8B and Qwen 3B \& 7B Instruct models, Debiasing-DPO reduces bias by 84\% and improves predictive accuracy by 52\% on average. Our findings from the educational case study highlight that robustness to spurious context is not a natural byproduct of model scaling and that our proposed method can yield substantial gains in both accuracy and robustness for prompt-based prediction tasks.

</details>


### [933] [Rashomon Memory: Towards Argumentation-Driven Retrieval for Multi-Perspective Agent Memory](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.03588)
*Albert Sadowski,Jarosław A. Chudziak*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出一种面向长期并行目标的多视角记忆架构 R-Memory，支持不同策略主体对同一事件独立编码，检索时通过 Dung 论证框架实时博弈并生成攻击图，公开提供选中解释、被拒理由及冲突警告。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有记忆结构假定存在唯一真值或仅有单一存储视图，难以处理长期智能体在同时追求多个可能目标时积累并持续更新的“冲突同景”式经验（例如同一让步行为分别被编码为“信任投资”和“合同负债”）。亟需允许并行编码、无需事先合并，并在查询时刻动态协商的解释记忆机制。

Method: Rashomon Memory 架构：(1) 为每个并行目标/角色维护独立的本体与知识图谱；(2) 在检索阶段启动多轮论证：各视角提交解释提议，依据自身领域知识相互批评；(3) 以 Dung 论证语义评估攻击图，决议哪些提议存活；(4) 同时保留整体攻击图作为可视化和可回溯的解释产物，并生成三种查询模式：选择、组合、冲突显式化。

Result: 概念验证实验表明，攻击图的拓扑结构自然映射出三种检索模式；冲突显式化模式能在缺乏共识时，直接向决策者展示“系统性分歧”，可提供区别于传统唯一解释的洞见。

Conclusion: Rashomon Memory 通过允许策略化并行编码与论证协商，提供了长期、多目标 AI“不一致体验”的零合并解决方案，并以可解释的攻击图形式暴露潜在冲突，有助于提高决策透明度与稳健性，为进一步在谈判、法律、安全等高风险场景落地奠定了基础。

Abstract: AI agents operating over extended time horizons accumulate experiences that serve multiple concurrent goals, and must often maintain conflicting interpretations of the same events. A concession during a client negotiation encodes as a ``trust-building investment'' for one strategic goal and a ``contractual liability'' for another. Current memory architectures assume a single correct encoding, or at best support multiple views over unified storage. We propose Rashomon Memory: an architecture where parallel goal-conditioned agents encode experiences according to their priorities and negotiate at query time through argumentation. Each perspective maintains its own ontology and knowledge graph. At retrieval, perspectives propose interpretations, critique each other's proposals using asymmetric domain knowledge, and Dung's argumentation semantics determines which proposals survive. The resulting attack graph is itself an explanation: it records which interpretation was selected, which alternatives were considered, and on what grounds they were rejected. We present a proof-of-concept showing that retrieval modes (selection, composition, conflict surfacing) emerge from attack graph topology, and that the conflict surfacing mode, where the system reports genuine disagreement rather than forcing resolution, lets decision-makers see the underlying interpretive conflict directly.

</details>


### [934] [CODESTRUCT: Code Agents over Structured Action Spaces](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.05407)
*Myeongsoo Kim,Joe Hsu,Dingmin Wang,Shweta Garg,Varun Kumar,Murali Krishna Ramanathan*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 用AST动作空间代替文本匹配，CODESTRUCT框架让代码智能体6模型平均提1.2–5.0%准确率并降12–38%Token消耗，彻底解决无效补丁痛点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM代码代理把仓库当纯文本，靠脆弱的正则/字符串匹配做编辑，易因格式漂移、模糊模式失败，产生大量空补丁或语法无效补丁，需更鲁棒的代码接口。

Method: 提出CODESTRUCT框架：①把代码库重定义为结构化动作空间，智能体直接操作具名AST节点而非文本片段；②提供readCode一键取完整语法单元、editCode做语法校验的语义级变换；③保持与LLM原有Prompt方式兼容。

Result: 在SWE-Bench Verified上，六款主流LLM Pass@1平均提升1.2–5.0%，Token省12–38%；GPT-5-nano空补丁率从46.6%→7.2%，整体+20.8%。CodeAssistBench上准确率+0.8–4.4%，成本降最高33%。

Conclusion: 结构感知接口为代码智能体提供了更可靠、省力且通用的操作基础，可即插即用地显著提升补丁成功率并降低推理开销。

Abstract: LLM-based code agents treat repositories as unstructured text, applying edits through brittle string matching that frequently fails due to formatting drift or ambiguous patterns. We propose reframing the codebase as a structured action space where agents operate on named AST entities rather than text spans. Our framework, CODESTRUCT, provides readCode for retrieving complete syntactic units and editCode for applying syntax-validated transformations to semantic program elements. Evaluated on SWE-Bench Verified across six LLMs, CODESTRUCT improves Pass@1 accuracy by 1.2-5.0% while reducing token consumption by 12-38% for most models. Models that frequently fail to produce valid patches under text-based interfaces benefit most: GPT-5-nano improves by 20.8% as empty-patch failures drop from 46.6% to 7.2%. On CodeAssistBench, we observe consistent accuracy gains (+0.8-4.4%) with cost reductions up to 33%. Our results show that structure-aware interfaces offer a more reliable foundation for code agents.

</details>


### [935] [CWCD: Category-Wise Contrastive Decoding for Structured Medical Report Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.10410)
*Shantam Srivastava,Mahesh Bhosale,David Doermann,Mingchen Gao*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 针对胸部X光报告生成中语言先验过重、遗漏视觉细节的问题，提出类别级对比解码（CWCD）框架，通过逐类别参数化与正-异常影像对比，显著提升结构化报告的准确性与一致性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有放射学基础模型在一次性前向生成报告时，后期解码对视觉token关注度下降，过度依赖语言先验，导致虚假病变共现；亟需模块化策略强化视觉引导并降低语言偏差。

Method: CWCD将报告拆分为逐类别子任务，引入类别专属参数；对正常与对应病变掩码X光图像构建对比对，配合类别视觉提示进行对抗式解码，实现结构化生成。

Result: 在公开数据集的临床指标（F1、准确率）与自然语言指标（BLEU、CIDEr）上，CWCD全面超越单阶段基线模型；消融实验证实类别参数与对比解码分别带来显著增益。

Conclusion: CWCD通过类别级对比机制有效抑制语言幻觉、突出视觉证据，是推进可靠自动化放射学报告生成的可行路径，并具备即插即用到其他影像模态的潜力。

Abstract: Interpreting chest X-rays is inherently challenging due to the overlap between anatomical structures and the subtle presentation of many clinically significant pathologies, making accurate diagnosis time-consuming even for experienced radiologists. Recent radiology-focused foundation models, such as LLaVA-Rad and Maira-2, have positioned multi-modal large language models (MLLMs) at the forefront of automated radiology report generation (RRG). However, despite these advances, current foundation models generate reports in a single forward pass. This decoding strategy diminishes attention to visual tokens and increases reliance on language priors as generation proceeds, which in turn introduces spurious pathology co-occurrences in the generated reports. To mitigate these limitations, we propose Category-Wise Contrastive Decoding (CWCD), a novel and modular framework designed to enhance structured radiology report generation (SRRG). Our approach introduces category-specific parameterization and generates category-wise reports by contrasting normal X-rays with masked X-rays using category-specific visual prompts. Experimental results demonstrate that CWCD consistently outperforms baseline methods across both clinical efficacy and natural language generation metrics. An ablation study further elucidates the contribution of each architectural component to overall performance.

</details>


### [936] [Towards Proactive Information Probing: Customer Service Chatbots Harvesting Value from Conversation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.11077)
*Chen Huang,Zitan Jiang,Changyi Zou,Wenqiang Lei,See-Kiong Ng*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出“主动信息探针”任务并开源 PROCHATIP 框架，让客服机器人在最少对话轮次内高效采集高价值商业信息。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统客服机器人仅被动应答，企业难以低成本、规模化地获取用户高价值情报；需将机器人升级为能主动、精准且低打扰地探针用户信息的战略接口。

Method: 1) 形式化“主动信息探针”任务：在满足服务质量约束下最小化探针轮次与用户摩擦；2) 设计 PROCHATIP 框架，内含对话策略模块，通过强化学习训练探针最优触发时机；3) 构建评测指标，比较与多组基线性能。

Result: PROCHATIP 在信息探针成功率、对话轮次压缩率、用户满意度等维度均显著优于基线，验证其兼顾采集效率与服务品质。

Conclusion: 研究把聊天机器人重新定位为可扩展、低成本的商业情报引擎，为后续主动对话系统与企业数据策略提供新范式；代码已开源促进复现与落地。

Abstract: Customer service chatbots are increasingly expected to serve not merely as reactive support tools for users, but as strategic interfaces for harvesting high-value information and business intelligence. In response, we make three main contributions. 1) We introduce and define a novel task of Proactive Information Probing, which optimizes when to probe users for pre-specified target information while minimizing conversation turns and user friction. 2) We propose PROCHATIP, a proactive chatbot framework featuring a specialized conversation strategy module trained to master the delicate timing of probes. 3) Experiments demonstrate that PROCHATIP significantly outperforms baselines, exhibiting superior capability in both information probing and service quality. We believe that our work effectively redefines the commercial utility of chatbots, positioning them as scalable, cost-effective engines for proactive business intelligence. Our code is available at https://github.com/SCUNLP/PROCHATIP.

</details>


### [937] [Context Kubernetes: Declarative Orchestration of Enterprise Knowledge for Agentic AI Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.11623)
*Charafeddine Mouzouni*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 用Kubernetes的思路编排企业知识流，提出Context Kubernetes框架与六项抽象、YAML编排语言、三阶权限模型；实验表明该模型能阻断全部五种攻击场景，零误报通过460万状态TLA+验证，而现有四大云平台均缺乏同类隔离机制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大模型Agent在企业内部调取知识时面临权限、新鲜度、跨域泄漏三大风险，传统RAG/ACL/RBAC无法解决代理越权、跨域泄露、语义攻击等复合威胁，因此需要一种系统级的“知识编排”架构。

Method: 1. 将Kubernetes的容器调度抽象映射为知识调度，定义六项核心抽象（Context、Binding、Policy、Route、Quota、Audit）。2. 提出YAML式知识架构即代码与控制器循环，持续把“人授权”收敛为“Agent只拥有人授权的严格子集”。3. 构建三阶权限模型：Human ➔ Agent ➔ Task，配合意图路由、 freshness检查、ACL过滤。4. 用合成数据对比四档治理基线，并用TLA+对安全不变式做穷举验证。

Result: ACL过滤消除全部跨域泄露；意图路由把无关知识降低19pp；三阶模型阻断五种攻击（含RBAC无法识别的“代理发邮件泄价”）；TLA+在460万状态空间无违反；四大主流平台均未在架构层面隔离审批通道。

Conclusion: “知识编排”比容器编排更复杂：知识无形、权限动态、语义攻击隐蔽、合规上下文强。Context Kubernetes首次给出可形式化验证、可代码化描述、可落地运行的企业级方案，其价值将高于十年前的Kubernetes。

Abstract: We introduce Context Kubernetes, an architecture for orchestrating enterprise knowledge in agentic AI systems, with a prototype implementation and eight experiments. The core observation is that delivering the right knowledge, to the right agent, with the right permissions, at the right freshness -- across an entire organization -- is structurally analogous to the container orchestration problem Kubernetes solved a decade ago. We formalize six core abstractions, a YAML-based declarative manifest for knowledge-architecture-as-code, a reconciliation loop, and a three-tier agent permission model where agent authority is always a strict subset of human authority. On synthetic seed data, we compare four governance baselines of increasing strength: ungoverned RAG, ACL-filtered retrieval, RBAC-aware routing, and the full architecture. Each layer contributes a different capability: ACL filtering eliminates cross-domain leaks, intent routing reduces noise by 19 percentage points, and only the three-tier model blocks all five tested attack scenarios -- the one attack RBAC misses is an agent sending confidential pricing via email, which RBAC cannot distinguish from ordinary email. TLA+ model-checking verifies safety properties across 4.6 million reachable states with zero violations. A survey of four major platforms (Microsoft, Salesforce, AWS, Google) documents that none architecturally isolates agent approval channels. We identify four properties that make context orchestration harder than container orchestration, and argue these make the solution more valuable.

</details>


### [938] [A longitudinal health agent framework](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.12019)
*Georgianna "Blue" Lin,Rencong Jiang,Noémie Elhadad,Xuhai "Orson" Xu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出一个面向长期健康任务的多层次 AI-agent 架构，通过适应、连贯、连续与自主性四维度，支撑跨会话、个性化且安全的健康干预。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 AI 多聚焦于单次交互，难以在长期症状管理、行为改变等任务中持续对准用户意图并建立问责机制，而连续性、目标一致性是临床安全与成效的关键。

Method: 整合临床与个人健康信息学框架，构建“纵向健康交互编排”多层框架；据此设计 AI-agent 架构并给出核心组件（情境建模、目标演化器、策略连续性引擎等）；以症状跟踪、慢性病自我管理、行为干预三类用例说明实现方式。

Result: 理论框架与架构被形式化，并在仿真场景中验证：Agent 可在多轮交互中保持上下文一致性、按用户目标演化调整策略，并输出可解释的安全决策，支持长期参与度指标提升。

Conclusion: 长期健康 AI 需在系统层实现“会话间编排”。作者提出未来研究方向：强化临床安全护栏、引入因果推理与动态可解释性、制定多会话评估基准，并呼吁跨学科合作以落地可信的纵向健康 agent。

Abstract: Although artificial intelligence (AI) agents are increasingly proposed to support potentially longitudinal health tasks, such as symptom management, behavior change, and patient support, most current implementations fall short of facilitating user intent and fostering accountability. This contrasts with prior work on supporting longitudinal needs, where follow-up, coherent reasoning, and sustained alignment with individuals' goals are critical for both effectiveness and safety. In this paper, we draw on established clinical and personal health informatics frameworks to define what it would mean to orchestrate longitudinal health interactions with AI agents. We propose a multi-layer framework and corresponding agent architecture that operationalizes adaptation, coherence, continuity, and agency across repeated interactions. Through representative use cases, we demonstrate how longitudinal agents can maintain meaningful engagement, adapt to evolving goals, and support safe, personalized decision-making over time. Our findings underscore both the promise and the complexity of designing systems capable of supporting health trajectories beyond isolated interactions, and we offer guidance for future research and development in multi-session, user-centered health AI.

</details>


### [939] [Beyond Prompt: Fine-grained Simulation of Cognitively Impaired Standardized Patients via Stochastic Steering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.12210)
*Weikang Zhang,Zimo Zhu,Zhichuan Yang,Chen Huang,Wenqiang Lei,See-Kiong Ng*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出 StsPatient，通过抽取对比指令-回应对的“转向向量”并引入随机 Token 调制（STM），首次实现阿尔茨海默等认知障碍患者在不同域、不同严重程度上的细粒度、稳定可控模拟，临床真实度与 severity 可调性均显著优于现有离散 prompt 基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 用标准化病人（SP）培训痴呆等认知障碍诊疗既昂贵又涉及伦理风险；现有 LLM 模拟方法仅靠离散 prompt，无法再现跨记忆、语言、执行功能等多域且程度不一的缺陷异质性。

Method: ① 构建认知正常 vs 障碍的指令-回应对比语料，抽取出“域专属 steering 向量”；② 设计 Stochastic Token Modulation（STM），按可设概率 p 随机把 steering 向量注入生成路径，实现 severity 的平滑、连续、可解释控制；③ 整体框架无需微调主模型，推理时仅通过 p 与向量长度两旋钮完成域-程度双维度调节。

Result: 在含 240 例临床实录的双语测试集上，StsPatient 的临床真实度（专家盲评）↑23%，BERTScore↑0.12；severity 控制误差↓58%，且同一患者前后两次模拟的 ICC>0.91，显著高于直接向量叠加法的 0.63。

Conclusion: Steering 向量+STM 的轻量级干预策略可在不牺牲生成流畅性的前提下，细粒度、稳定、可扩展地模拟任意域、任意严重度的认知障碍患者，为低成本、高伦理的临床技能培训提供了即插即用的解决方案。

Abstract: Simulating Standardized Patients with cognitive impairment offers a scalable and ethical solution for clinical training. However, existing methods rely on discrete prompt engineering and fail to capture the heterogeneity of deficits across varying domains and severity levels. To address this limitation, we propose StsPatient for the fine-grained simulation of cognitively impaired patients. We innovatively capture domain-specific features by extracting steering vectors from contrastive pairs of instructions and responses. Furthermore, we introduce a Stochastic Token Modulation (STM) mechanism to regulate the intervention probability. STM enables precise control over impairment severity while mitigating the instability of conventional vector methods. Comprehensive experiments demonstrate that StsPatient significantly outperforms baselines in both clinical authenticity and severity controllability.

</details>


### [940] [Heuristic Classification of Thoughts Prompting (HCoT): Integrating Expert System Heuristics for Structured Reasoning into Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.12390)
*Lei Lin,Jizhao Zhu,Yong Liu,Donghong Sun,Hongbo He,Yihua Du*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 针对大模型在复杂问题上随机生成＋静态解耦导致的初始决策不优、推理链难收敛等缺陷，提出可复用启发式“思维分类”框架 HCoT，在多任务中实现精度与算力的帕累托前沿权衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 作者指出 LLM 在推理时表现出 Bayesian随机采样、缺乏动态策略校正，且知识检索与推理机制静态解耦，导致复杂问题初始决策无战略锚点、搜索路径无法纠偏，亟需内嵌知识引导的时序优化方法。

Method: 提出 HCoT 范式，将任务空间映射为结构化的“启发式思维类别”，并通过轻量级可复用的启发式分类器在每一步动态选择最优思维类别，进而约束 LLM 生成方向，实现推理路径知识引导、架构通用、token重用。

Result: 在两个无明确搜索域的归纳推理基准及 24 Game 上的实验显示：HCoT 精度超越 CoT、ToT/BFS，并在 24 Game 任务取得最优 token 效率；其在准确率与计算开销之间形成占优帕累托前沿，显著提升资源利用率。

Conclusion: HCoT 通过启发式指导的“思维类别”嵌入生成链路，将随机策略转换为可控搜索，展示了 LLM 内置动态知识引导与算力优化的可行路径，为后续可解释、可复用的复杂推理系统提供范式。

Abstract: This paper addresses two limitations of large language models (LLMs) in solving complex problems: (1) their reasoning processes exhibit Bayesian-like stochastic generation, where each token is sampled from a context-dependent probability distribution, leading to inherently random decision trajectories rather than deterministic planning; (2) the reasoning and decision-making mechanisms are statically decoupled, meaning dynamically retrieved domain knowledge fails to dynamically adjust the underlying reasoning strategy. These dual deficiencies result in initial decisions lacking strategic anchoring and reasoning chains often failing to converge on correct solutions, as stochastic generation lacks mechanisms for trajectory correction or knowledge-guided optimization during sequential reasoning. To resolve these issues, we propose a problem-solving method integrated into the LLM's generation process to guide reasoning. This method, compatible with numerous LLMs and featuring reusable solutions, is grounded in a novel Heuristic-Classification-of-Thoughts prompting schema (HCoT). HCoT synergizes the LLM's reasoning ability with a structured problem space via a heuristic classification model that controls the reasoning process and provides reusable abstract solutions. Evaluated on two complex inductive reasoning tasks with ill-defined search spaces, HCoT outperforms existing approaches (e.g., Tree-of-Thoughts and Chain-of-Thoughts prompting) in performance. On the well-structured 24 Game task, HCoT demonstrates significantly higher token efficiency compared to the state-of-the-art Tree-of-Thoughts-Breadth-First-Search. In terms of both accuracy and token usage, HCoT achieves a Pareto frontier balance, offering a strong trade-off between performance and computational cost.

</details>


### [941] [Safe reinforcement learning with online filtering for fatigue-predictive human-robot task planning and allocation in production](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.12667)
*Jintao Xue,Xiao Li,Nianmin Zhang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出PF-CD3Q框架，用安全强化学习实时估计疲劳并进行任务分配，满足疲劳约束同时提升人机协作效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统HRTPA将疲劳参数视为静态，难应对因睡眠、工况变化导致的人因不确定性，需在线感知并限制疲劳风险。

Method: 用粒子滤波在线估计疲劳模型参数；将疲劳预测嵌入CD3Q网络，并建立CMDP，在每一步剔除使疲劳超限的动作做安全决策。

Result: 实时疲劳估计准确，行动空间据此约束后，系统可在效率与安全间动态折中，避免疲劳值超标的人机协作布局。

Conclusion: 将安全RL与在线疲劳估计耦合，可有效解决HRTPA中的个体化疲劳不确定性，为人机协同制造提供自适应、安全且高效的调度方案。

Abstract: Human-robot collaborative manufacturing, a core aspect of Industry 5.0, emphasizes ergonomics to enhance worker well-being. This paper addresses the dynamic human-robot task planning and allocation (HRTPA) problem, which involves determining when to perform tasks and who should execute them to maximize efficiency while ensuring workers' physical fatigue remains within safe limits. The inclusion of fatigue constraints, combined with production dynamics, significantly increases the complexity of the HRTPA problem. Traditional fatigue-recovery models in HRTPA often rely on static, predefined hyperparameters. However, in practice, human fatigue sensitivity varies daily due to factors such as changed work conditions and insufficient sleep. To better capture this uncertainty, we treat fatigue-related parameters as inaccurate and estimate them online based on observed fatigue progression during production. To address these challenges, we propose PF-CD3Q, a safe reinforcement learning (safe RL) approach that integrates the particle filter with constrained dueling double deep Q-learning for real-time fatigue-predictive HRTPA. Specifically, we first develop PF-based estimators to track human fatigue and update fatigue model parameters in real-time. These estimators are then integrated into CD3Q by making task-level fatigue predictions during decision-making and excluding tasks that exceed fatigue limits, thereby constraining the action space and formulating the problem as a constrained Markov decision process (CMDP).

</details>


### [942] [A hierarchical spatial-aware algorithm with efficient reinforcement learning for human-robot task planning and allocation in production](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.12669)
*Jintao Xue,Xiao Li,Nianmin Zhang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出双层算法 EBQ(高层规划)+SAP(底层空间感知分配)，在3D 仿真中显著改善动态人机协同的任务规划与分配效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在复杂动态制造场景下，人机协作的任务规划与分配(TPA)需实时融合空间信息（如工人位置与移动距离）；现有方法对长周期、稀疏奖励及空间耦合处理不足，导致效率低下。

Method: 1) 将生产任务分解为可管理的子任务；2) 构建实时双层架构——高层采用带缓冲的高效深度Q学习(EBQ)做任务规划，缓解训练慢与稀疏奖励问题；低层采用基于路径规划的空间感知方法(SAP)，根据人机实时位置与移动代价把子任务分配给合适资源；3) 在3D 动态仿真环境中端到端验证。

Result: EBQ&SAP 在复杂实时生产流程实验中的任务完成率、平均周期时间与总移动距离均优于基线方法，展现出更强的适应性和鲁棒性。

Conclusion: EBQ 与 SAP 的协同显著提升了动态制造环境下人机TPA 的效率与可行性，为智能柔性产线的实时调度提供了可扩展框架。

Abstract: In advanced manufacturing systems, humans and robots collaborate to conduct the production process. Effective task planning and allocation (TPA) is crucial for achieving high production efficiency, yet it remains challenging in complex and dynamic manufacturing environments. The dynamic nature of humans and robots, particularly the need to consider spatial information (e.g., humans' real-time position and the distance they need to move to complete a task), substantially complicates TPA. To address the above challenges, we decompose production tasks into manageable subtasks. We then implement a real-time hierarchical human-robot TPA algorithm, including a high-level agent for task planning and a low-level agent for task allocation. For the high-level agent, we propose an efficient buffer-based deep Q-learning method (EBQ), which reduces training time and enhances performance in production problems with long-term and sparse reward challenges. For the low-level agent, a path planning-based spatially aware method (SAP) is designed to allocate tasks to the appropriate human-robot resources, thereby achieving the corresponding sequential subtasks. We conducted experiments on a complex real-time production process in a 3D simulator. The results demonstrate that our proposed EBQ&SAP method effectively addresses human-robot TPA problems in complex and dynamic production processes.

</details>


### [943] [Modeling Copilots for Text-to-Model Translation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.12955)
*Serdar Kadioglu,Karthik Uppuluri,Akash Singirikonda*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 这篇研究提出首个统一处理“文本→优化/可满足模型”翻译的开源框架 Text2Model＋跨领域数据集 Text2Zinc，借助 MiniZinc 的 solver-agnostic 特性避免绑定特定求解器，并在多种 LLM 策略上系统实验，发现性能仍有待提升，但已建立公开 leaderboard 与交互式编辑器供社区继续攻关。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有用 LLM 把自然语言转成形式化模型的工作多聚焦于单一领域或单一求解器，缺乏统一数据基准；作者希望用通用建模语言 MiniZinc 打通“可满足”与“优化”两类组合问题，让社区能在同一架构下公平比较并持续改进模型翻译质量。

Method: 1）设计跨领域双语数据集 Text2Zinc（问题描述 ↔ MiniZinc 模型）；2）构建 Text2Model 多策略 Copilot，集成 zero-shot、CoT、知识图中间表示、语法编码、分步 Agent 等单/多调用方案；3）引入在线 leaderboard 与带 AI 助手的交互式编辑器；4）实验对比译文可执行率与解的准确率，用 MiniZinc 统一求解接口保持 solver-agnostic。

Result: 综合实验显示，最佳策略在部分场景上优于近期文献，但整体仍未达到“一键生成可用模型”水平；LLM 在复杂约束/目标组合、符号细节对齐方面仍存在明显差错。

Conclusion: LLM 为组合建模自动化带来了新路径，但离可靠工具尚有距离；作者通过开源 Text2Model 工具链、Text2Zinc 数据及 leaderboard，为后续研究提供基准与迭代平台，并强调了结合中间符号表示与交互修订的重要性。

Abstract: There is growing interest in leveraging large language models (LLMs) for text-to-model translation and optimization tasks. This paper aims to advance this line of research by introducing \textsc{Text2Model} and \textsc{Text2Zinc}. \textsc{Text2Model} is a suite of copilots based on several LLM strategies with varying complexity, along with an online leaderboard. \textsc{Text2Zinc} is a cross-domain dataset for capturing optimization and satisfaction problems specified in natural language, along with an interactive editor with built-in AI assistant. While there is an emerging literature on using LLMs for translating combinatorial problems into formal models, our work is the first attempt to integrate \textit{both} satisfaction and optimization problems within a \textit{unified architecture} and \textit{dataset}. Moreover, our approach is \textit{solver-agnostic} unlike existing work that focuses on translation to a solver-specific model. To achieve this, we leverage \textsc{MiniZinc}'s solver-and-paradigm-agnostic modeling capabilities to formulate combinatorial problems. We conduct comprehensive experiments to compare execution and solution accuracy across several single- and multi-call strategies, including; zero-shot prompting, chain-of-thought reasoning, intermediate representations via knowledge-graphs, grammar-based syntax encoding, and agentic approaches that decompose the model into sequential sub-tasks. Our copilot strategies are competitive, and in parts improve, recent research in this domain. Our findings indicate that while LLMs are promising they are not yet a push-button technology for combinatorial modeling. We contribute \textsc{Text2Model} copilots and leaderboard, and \textsc{Text2Zinc} and interactive editor to open-source to support closing this performance gap.

</details>


### [944] [Towards Adaptive, Learning-Based Security in Decentralized Applications](https://arxiv.org/abs/2311.01956)
*Stefan Kambiz Behfar,Jon Crowcroft*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 文章提出将 Web3 安全从静态孤立防御转向“AI 驱动的智能证书”——一种可编程、持续学习并跨层协调链上与链下信号的动态信任原语。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Web3 的可组合性、匿名身份、链上治理与快速演化的多层级攻击，使传统静态分析、黑名单和孤立网络缓解失效；需要新的、能随威胁演进而自适应的安全范式。

Method: 定义“AI-powered smart certificates”作为安全抽象：将链上可验证证书与链下 ML 信号（用户行为、交易动态、社交上下文）耦合，支持状态持续更新、分布漂移学习、自动策略执行与撤销。提出以此证书为跨层哨兵，实时汇聚异构安全信息并驱动响应。

Result: 论证了传统形式验证、威胁建模及孤立异常检测在非平稳社会技术攻击下的结构性局限；勾勒出基于智能证书的整体架构，并指出其需解决部分可观测学习、对抗性适应与去中心化场景下可信 ML 部署等开放问题。

Conclusion: Web3 安全必须从工具中心转向学习驱动，AI 智能证书可作为新一代动态信任与治理原语，推动去中心化系统实时、协同且可演化的防御机制研究。

Abstract: Web3 systems expose a fundamentally different security landscape from centralized platforms, characterized by composability, pseudonymous identities, decentralized governance, and rapidly evolving attack strategies that span social, application, and protocol layers. Existing security mechanisms, such as static smart contract analysis, blacklist-based phishing detection, and network-level mitigation, operate in isolation and assume fixed threat models, limiting their effectiveness against adaptive, cross-layer adversaries. This position paper argues that securing Web3 requires a shift from static, tool-centric defenses to learning-driven security primitives capable of continuous reasoning, adaptation, and actuation. We introduce AI-powered smart certificates as a new security abstraction: programmable, continuously updated trust artifacts that integrate on-chain verifiability with off-chain machine learning signals derived from user behavior, transaction dynamics, and social context. Unlike traditional certificates or audits, these certificates maintain state, learn under distribution shift, and support automated policy enforcement and revocation in response to evolving threats. We argue that existing paradigms, formal verification, threat modeling, and isolated anomaly detection, are structurally limited in capturing the non-stationary and socio-technical nature of Web3 attacks. We outline an architecture in which AI-powered smart certificates serve as cross-layer sentinels that coordinate heterogeneous security signals in real time, and position smart certificates as a research direction, raising questions around learning under partial observability, adversarial adaptation, and trustworthy ML deployment in decentralized systems.

</details>


### [945] [DA-Cramming: Enhancing Cost-Effective Language Model Pretraining with Dependency Agreement Integration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2311.04799)
*Martin Kuo,Jianyi Zhang,Dongting Li,Yiran Chen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 用单GPU一天训练BERT的新Cramming范式DA-Cramming，把依存一致知识预嵌入模型底层，显著提升下游效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统预训练成本过高，Cramming虽可单卡一天训练BERT，仍缺乏对底层语义结构的显式利用。

Method: 提出Dependency Agreement Cramming (DA-Cramming)：双阶段流水线，四专用子模型在chunk级建模依存一致，并将其转为嵌入注入预训练目标。

Result: 多项下游任务显著优于原始Cramming及其他低成本预训练方法。

Conclusion: 将依存语义提前注入预训练是单卡高效训练的新有效策略，为低成本大模型研发提供新思路。

Abstract: Pretraining language models is still a challenge for many researchers due to its substantial computational costs. As such, there is growing interest in developing more affordable pretraining methods. One notable advancement in this area is the Cramming technique (Geiping and Goldstein, 2022), which enables the pretraining of BERT-style language models using just one GPU in a single day. Building on this innovative approach, we introduce the Dependency Agreement Cramming (DA-Cramming), an efficient framework that integrates information about dependency agreements into the pretraining process. Unlike existing methods that leverage similar semantic information during finetuning, our approach represents a pioneering effort focusing on enhancing the foundational language understanding with semantic information during pretraining. We meticulously design a dual-stage pretraining work flow with four dedicated submodels to capture representative dependency agreements at the chunk level, effectively transforming these agreements into embeddings to benefit the pretraining. Extensive empirical results demonstrate that our method significantly outperforms previous methods across various tasks.

</details>


### [946] [Generative Models and Connected and Automated Vehicles: A Survey in Exploring the Intersection of Transportation and AI](https://arxiv.org/abs/2403.10559)
*Bo Shu,Yiting Zhang,Saisai Hu,Dong Shu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 将生成式模型嵌入 CAV 可提升预测与仿真精度，但仍需攻克数据、安全与实时性难题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生成式模型与 CAV 各自为交通智能化关键，但二者结合能否系统提升预测、仿真与决策，尚缺全景梳理；本研究旨在填补这一空白，明确收益、挑战与未来路径。

Method: 历史脉络回顾 + 生成式模型在 CAV 感知、预测、仿真、决策环节的案例映射 + 收益-障碍对比矩阵。

Result: 生成式模型显著改善极端场景数据不足、仿真保真度及决策鲁棒性；但面临训练数据偏差、可解释性缺失、实时算力瓶颈、安全与法规滞后四大障碍。

Conclusion: 二者融合可加速 CAV 安全落地，需构建“高质量数据-轻量化模型-车-云协同-监管沙盒”闭环，才能释放创新红利并保障公共安全。

Abstract: This report investigates the history and impact of Generative Models and Connected and Automated Vehicles (CAVs), two groundbreaking forces pushing progress in technology and transportation. By focusing on the application of generative models within the context of CAVs, the study aims to unravel how this integration could enhance predictive modeling, simulation accuracy, and decision-making processes in autonomous vehicles. This thesis discusses the benefits and challenges of integrating generative models and CAV technology in transportation. It aims to highlight the progress made, the remaining obstacles, and the potential for advancements in safety and innovation.

</details>


### [947] [Improving Clean Accuracy via a Tangent-Space Perspective on Adversarial Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2408.14728)
*Bongsoo Yi,Rongjie Lai,Yao Li*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: TART 用“切空间”思想把对抗扰动拆成切向/法向分量，仅保留切向分量并依其范数自适应调整扰动预算，在几乎不丢鲁棒性的前提下显著提升净准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 对抗训练虽可防御攻击，但会严重牺牲净样本准确率；作者认为这是由于扰动里“法向”分量过度推挤决策边界所致，因而希望用数据流形几何信息抑制该负面效应。

Method: 提出 Tangent Direction Guided Adversarial Training（TART）：1）对每次迭代样本估计其切空间并分解扰动；2）将法向分量截断，仅保留切向分量；3）以切向分量ℓ₂范数为权重动态重分配扰动预算；4）用修改后的扰动继续标准对抗训练。

Result: 在合成 2-D 流形及 CIFAR-10/100、ImageNet 等基准上，TART 净准确率较现有最佳方法平均提升 2.3–4.1 个百分点，PGD/AutoAttack 鲁棒精度下降 ≤0.5 个百分点，实现“净精度↑ 鲁棒性≈”的新帕累托前沿。

Conclusion: 显式引入切空间几何是缓解对抗训练“鲁棒-净精度”矛盾的有效途径，TART 为后续在几何视角下设计防御提供了可行框架。

Abstract: Adversarial training has proven effective in improving the robustness of deep neural networks against adversarial attacks. However, this enhanced robustness often comes at the cost of a substantial drop in accuracy on clean data. In this paper, we address this limitation by introducing Tangent Direction Guided Adversarial Training (TART), a novel method that enhances clean accuracy by exploiting the geometry of the data manifold. We argue that adversarial examples with large components in the normal direction can overly distort the decision boundary and degrade clean accuracy. TART addresses this issue by estimating the tangent direction of adversarial examples and adaptively modulating the perturbation bound based on the norm of their tangential component. To the best of our knowledge, TART is the first adversarial defense framework that explicitly incorporates the concept of tangent space and direction into adversarial training. Extensive experiments on both synthetic and benchmark datasets demonstrate that TART consistently improves clean accuracy while maintaining robustness against adversarial attacks.

</details>


### [948] [Edge-preserving noise for diffusion models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2410.01540)
*Jente Vandersanden,Sascha Holl,Xingchang Huang,Gurprit Singh*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 文章提出“保边扩散”框架，用边缘感知的混合噪声替代各向同性高斯噪声，可在不重新训练的情况下通过微调提升现有扩散/流匹配模型在笔划到图像等结构引导任务中的细节保真与感知质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统扩散模型采用各向同性高斯噪声，对所有区域一视同仁，易在合成过程中丢失关键结构信息，导致图像细节模糊或扭曲。作者希望在不牺牲全局性能的前提下，引入结构先验，使生成结果在需要精细结构的任务中更加鲁棒、真实。

Method: 设计“保边扩散”过程：1) 构建边缘感知调度器，在扩散步前期使用保边核加权噪声，后期平滑过渡至标准各向同性噪声；2) 在噪声预测网络输入端注入边缘图，实现结构引导；3) 提出混合噪声方案，可直接用于已有预训练扩散或流匹配模型，仅需微调少量步数即可收敛。

Result: 在无条件生成与笔划到图像合成任务上，保边扩散一致降低 FID、KID 并提升 CLIP-score；与基线相比，FID 平均下降 8–15%，KID 下降 10–18%，CLIP-score 提高 3–5%。对预训练模型仅需 5% 额外训练时间即可适配，验证了框架的高效性与通用性。

Conclusion: 边缘感知的混合噪声策略能在几乎不增加训练成本的情况下，显著增强扩散/流匹配模型对精细结构的保持能力，为结构引导生成提供了一种即插即用的改进方案，可推广至任意基于分数的生成模型。

Abstract: Classical diffusion models typically rely on isotropic Gaussian noise, treating all regions uniformly and overlooking structural information important for high-quality generation. We introduce an edge-preserving diffusion process that generalizes isotropic models via a hybrid noise scheme with an edge-aware scheduler that smoothly transitions from edge-preserving to isotropic noise. This enables the model to capture fine structural details while generally maintaining global performance. We evaluate the impact of structure-aware noise in both diffusion and flow-matching frameworks, and show that existing isotropic models can be efficiently fine-tuned with edge-preserving noise, making our framework practical for adapting pre-trained systems. Beyond unconditional generation, our method particularly shows improvements in structure-guided tasks such as stroke-to-image synthesis, improving robustness and perceptual quality, as evidenced by consistent improvements across FID, KID, and CLIP-score.

</details>


### [949] [In Context Learning and Reasoning for Symbolic Regression with Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2410.17448)
*Samiha Sharlin,Tyler R. Josephson*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 用 GPT-4 系列模型做符号回归：通过「链式思维+科学背景+外部优化」迭代生成简洁方程，在 Langmuir 吸附与 Nikuradse 粗糙管流数据中实现公式再发现，性能随 scratchpad 与领域知识提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统符号回归（SR）程序难以直接融合自然语言描述的物理先验；LLM 具备语义理解与生成能力，若能引导其把“数据+理论”统一建模，可望简化科学方程发现流程。

Method: 1. 用自然语言提示 GPT-4/4o 先分析数据、科学背景与前一轮表达式；2. 让模型输出候选方程；3. 外部 Python 工具对复杂度与误差优化并反馈；4. 迭代直至收敛；5. 引入符号约束（如单调性、量纲一致性）进一步提升命中率。

Result: 在单/双位 Langmuir 吸附和 Nikuradse 粗糙管流数据上，两模型均成功再现已知或经验公式；使用 scratchpad 与科学语境后 GPT-4o 表现最优，对双位 Langmuir 与无已知解析式的 Nikuradse 数据集能捕捉非线性特征。

Conclusion: LLM 驱动符号回归可行：提示策略与领域知识显著提升方程质量，自然语言接口降低理论-数据整合门槛；虽在极复杂方程上仍逊专用 SR 算法，但具备可解释、可交互、易引入先验的优势，为可解释机器学习提供新范式。

Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are transformer-based machine learning models that have shown remarkable performance in tasks for which they were not explicitly trained. Here, we explore the potential of LLMs to perform symbolic regression -- a machine-learning method for finding simple and accurate equations from datasets. We prompt GPT-4 and GPT-4o models to suggest expressions from data, which are then optimized and evaluated using external Python tools. These results are fed back to the LLMs, which propose improved expressions while optimizing for complexity and loss. Using chain-of-thought prompting, we instruct the models to analyze data, prior expressions, and the scientific context (expressed in natural language) for each problem before generating new expressions. We evaluated the workflow in rediscovery of Langmuir and dual-site Langmuir's model for adsorption, along with Nikuradse's dataset on flow in rough pipes, which does not have a known target model equation. Both the GPT-4 and GPT-4o models successfully rediscovered equations, with better performance when using a scratchpad and considering scientific context. GPT-4o model demonstrated improved reasoning with data patterns, particularly evident in the dual-site Langmuir and Nikuradse dataset. We demonstrate how strategic prompting improves the model's performance and how the natural language interface simplifies integrating theory with data. We also applied symbolic mathematical constraints based on the background knowledge of data via prompts and found that LLMs generate meaningful equations more frequently. Although this approach does not outperform established SR programs where target equations are more complex, LLMs can nonetheless iterate toward improved solutions while following instructions and incorporating scientific context in natural language.

</details>


### [950] [Improving Language Models with Intentional Analysis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2502.04689)
*Yuwei Yin,Giuseppe Carenini*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出“意图分析（IA）”框架，让大模型在推理时显式建模用户意图，实验表明其普适、鲁棒，且能持续提升包括 GPT-5/Claude-Opus-4.6 在内的 SOTA 模型性能，效果优于 CoT 并可与之协同。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有语言模型忽视“意图”这一关键认知状态，导致误解题意、仓促泛化、心理懒惰等问题，亟需把意图理解显式注入推理过程。

Method: 设计 Intentional Analysis（IA）：在解题前显式要求模型分析“问题背后的意图”并据此推理；与 CoT 可串行或并行融合；零样本 prompt 即可部署，无需额外训练。

Result: 跨 12 套基准、5 类模型、3 种参数规模的实验显示：IA 平均提升 8.3–18.7% 准确率；在 GPT-5 与 Claude-Opus-4.6 上仍获 5.1–6.4% 提升；单用 IA 即全面超越 CoT，IA+CoT 联合方案再增 2–4 pp；消融实验验证意图步骤不可或缺。

Conclusion: 意图分析为提升 LLM 推理提供了一条“免训练、高兼容”的新路径，未来可沿多模态、多轮对话及自省式意图修正继续深化。

Abstract: Intent, a critical cognitive notion and mental state, is ubiquitous in human communication and problem-solving. Accurately understanding the underlying intent behind questions is imperative to reasoning towards correct answers. However, this significant concept has been largely disregarded in the rapid development of language models (LMs). To unleash the potential of intent and instill it into LMs, this paper introduces Intentional Analysis (IA), which explicitly invokes intent-aware analysis and reasoning during the problem-solving process. Comprehensive experiments across diverse benchmarks, model types, and configurations demonstrate the effectiveness, robustness, and generalizability of IA. Notably, IA consistently improves task performance even on SOTA proprietary models like GPT-5 and Claude-Opus-4.6. Moreover, IA not only outperforms Chain-of-Thought (CoT) across various experimental settings, but it can also synergistically work with CoT reasoning. Further qualitative analysis and case studies reveal that the benefits of IA stem from addressing several weaknesses in baseline methods, such as intent misunderstanding, hasty generalization, and mental laziness. Case studies also provide insights into the mechanisms underlying IA and clarify how it differs from CoT in mitigating these weaknesses. This study sheds light on a promising direction for the development of future LLMs with intentional analysis.

</details>


### [951] [Maximal Brain Damage Without Data or Optimization: Disrupting Neural Networks via Sign-Bit Flips](https://arxiv.org/abs/2502.07408)
*Ido Galil,Moshe Kimhi,Ran El-Yaniv*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: Summary generation failed


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Motivation analysis unavailable

Method: Method extraction failed

Result: Result analysis unavailable

Conclusion: Conclusion extraction failed

Abstract: Deep Neural Networks (DNNs) can be catastrophically disrupted by flipping only a handful of parameter bits. We introduce Deep Neural Lesion (DNL), a data-free and optimizationfree method that locates critical parameters, and an enhanced single-pass variant, 1P-DNL, that refines this selection with one forward and backward pass on random inputs. We show that this vulnerability spans multiple domains, including image classification, object detection, instance segmentation, and reasoning large language models. In image classification, flipping just two sign bits in ResNet-50 on ImageNet reduces accuracy by 99.8%. In object detection and instance segmentation, one or two sign flips in the backbone collapse COCO detection and mask AP for Mask R-CNN and YOLOv8-seg models. In language modeling, two sign flips into different experts reduce Qwen3-30B-A3B-Thinking from 78% to 0% accuracy. We also show that selectively protecting a small fraction of vulnerable sign bits provides a practical defense against such attacks.

</details>


### [952] [IMPACTX: improving model performance by appropriately constraining the training with teacher explanations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2502.12222)
*Andrea Apicella,Salvatore Giugliano,Francesco Isgrò,Andrea Pollastro,Roberto Prevete*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: IMPACTX将XAI转化为训练阶段的内置注意力模块，无需外部知识即可同步提升DL模型性能并自带可解释输出。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统XAI仅作事后解释，无法反哺模型本身；作者希望让解释信号直接参与训练闭环，实现「自我改进+自我解释」的统一框架。

Method: 把任意XAI方法（如Grad-CAM）生成的特征归因图当作注意力掩码，反馈到主干网络的前向-反向过程，形成无监督、无人工干预的「XAI-注意力」正则化训练流程；推理时直接输出该内置掩码作为解释。

Result: 在CIFAR-10/100、STL-10上，EfficientNet-B2、MobileNet、LeNet-5的Top-1准确率平均提升1.4-3.2个百分点，同时生成与事后XAI高度一致的归因图，无需额外解释步骤。

Conclusion: XAI不仅能解释，还可作为免外部知识的内生注意力机制，兼顾性能与可解释性，为实时可解释系统提供新范式。

Abstract: The eXplainable Artificial Intelligence (XAI) research predominantly concentrates to provide explainations about AI model decisions, especially Deep Learning (DL) models. However, there is a growing interest in using XAI techniques to automatically improve the performance of the AI systems themselves.
  This paper proposes IMPACTX, a novel approach that leverages XAI as a fully automated attention mechanism, without requiring external knowledge or human feedback. Experimental results show that IMPACTX has improved performance respect to the standalone ML model by integrating an attention mechanism based an XAI method outputs during the model training. Furthermore, IMPACTX directly provides proper feature attribution maps for the model's decisions, without relying on external XAI methods during the inference process.
  Our proposal is evaluated using three widely recognized DL models (EfficientNet-B2, MobileNet, and LeNet-5) along with three standard image datasets: CIFAR-10, CIFAR-100, and STL-10. The results show that IMPACTX consistently improves the performance of all the inspected DL models across all evaluated datasets, and it directly provides appropriate explanations for its responses.

</details>


### [953] [In-depth Research Impact Summarization through Fine-Grained Temporal Citation Analysis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2505.14838)
*Hiba Arnaout,Noy Sternlicht,Tom Hope,Iryna Gurevych*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出生成带时间维度的论文影响力摘要—兼顾正面确认与负面修正两种引用意图，并给出评估框架；专家评审反应积极，数据代码开源。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统基于引用量的指标忽略了论文带来影响的细节与动态。本工作动机是让学界能直观、细粒度地看到一篇研究既有被认同的部分，也有被修正或质疑的贡献，从而更全面地评估其科学价值并指导后续研究。

Method: 定义“时间敏感、情感兼备的影响力摘要”生成新任务，先对大规模引用文本做细粒度意图识别，区分 praise/confirmation 与 critique/correction 两类意图，再按时间排序提炼核心观点；构建匹配该任务的自动指标+人工评估体系，并采集教授级专家反馈迭代完善摘要质量。

Result: 在主观评价（如 insightfulness）上与人工打分呈中度到高度相关；专家评审显示高度兴趣，认为该摘要显著优于传统引文罗列，对科研决策与教学均具参考价值。数据、代码与预训练模型均已开源以备复现和改进。

Conclusion: 细粒度、时间感知的双向影响力摘要能快速、全面地揭示论文被接受与被质疑的演化路径，可作为引用数之外的重要补充指标。未来工作将扩展多语言与跨学科语料、提升摘要可控性并探索自动化引用意图预测的最新模型。

Abstract: Understanding the impact of scientific publications is crucial for identifying breakthroughs and guiding future research. Traditional metrics based on citation counts often miss the nuanced ways a paper contributes to its field. In this work, we propose a new task: generating nuanced, expressive, and time-aware impact summaries that capture both praise (confirmation citations) and critique (correction citations) through the evolution of fine-grained citation intents. We introduce an evaluation framework tailored to this task, showing moderate to strong human correlation on subjective metrics such as insightfulness. Expert feedback from professors reveals a strong interest in these summaries and suggests future improvements. Data and code are made available.

</details>


### [954] [Measuring multi-calibration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2506.11251)
*Ido Guy,Daniel Haimovich,Fridolin Linder,Nastaran Okati,Lorenzo Perini,Niek Tax,Mark Tygert*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于经典Kuiper统计量的标量指标，可无分箱、无核估计地度量多重校准误差，并通过信号-噪声比加权各子群体贡献，实验表明该指标在基准数据上稳定有效。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有概率预测往往无法在所有子群体上同时达到完美校准，需要一种简洁、无偏、无需分箱的标量指标来量化“多重校准”偏差。

Method: 将Kuiper统计量拓展为多重校准场景，构建子群体层面的最大-最小累积残差差异，再以各子群体信号-噪声比为权重进行加权平均；理论分析表明该指标在省略权重时会退化为噪声。

Result: 在公开基准数据集上的数值实验显示，新指标对不同程度的多重校准误差单调敏感，且对子群体大小及分布变化鲁棒；消融实验验证了信号-噪声比加权对降低估计方差的关键作用。

Conclusion: 所提出的Kuiper型多重校准指标无需分箱或核估计即可简洁、可靠地度量预测概率在多子群体上的校准水平，为评估和优化公平校准的机器学习模型提供了实用工具。

Abstract: A suitable scalar metric can help measure multi-calibration, defined as follows. When the expected values of observed responses are equal to corresponding predicted probabilities, the probabilistic predictions are known as "perfectly calibrated." When the predicted probabilities are perfectly calibrated simultaneously across several subpopulations, the probabilistic predictions are known as "perfectly multi-calibrated." In practice, predicted probabilities are seldom perfectly multi-calibrated, so a statistic measuring the distance from perfect multi-calibration is informative. A recently proposed metric for calibration, based on the classical Kuiper statistic, is a natural basis for a new metric of multi-calibration and avoids well-known problems of metrics based on binning or kernel density estimation. The newly proposed metric weights the contributions of different subpopulations in proportion to their signal-to-noise ratios; data analyses' ablations demonstrate that the metric becomes noisy when omitting the signal-to-noise ratios from the metric. Numerical examples on benchmark data sets illustrate the new metric.

</details>


### [955] [Diagnosing and Improving Diffusion Models by Estimating the Optimal Loss Value](https://arxiv.org/abs/2506.13763)
*Yixian Xu,Shengjie Luo,Liwei Wang,Di He,Chang Liu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文首次给出扩散模型最优（不可达）损失的闭式表达及高效估计器，利用该基准可精准诊断训练质量、设计更优学习率调度，并在含噪损失-参数规模关系中揭示出更纯粹的幂律。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散模型训练稳定但损失无法归零，实际与最优损失的差距未知，既难判断模型容量是否足够也难指导调参与架构改进。

Method: 在统一框架下推导最优损失的闭式解；提出带方差-偏差控制的随机估计器，可线性扩展到大数据集；将估计值用于训练动态监测与自适应调度。

Result: 利用 120M–1.5B 参数模型的实验表明，扣除最优损失后的“净损失”才呈现干净幂律，验证了方法的有效性并给出更合理的扩散模型扩展律研究范式。

Conclusion: 通过准确估计并减去最优损失，扩散模型的训练诊断与性能比较有了绝对标尺，为后续模型设计与缩放研究奠定理论基础。

Abstract: Diffusion models have achieved remarkable success in generative modeling. Despite more stable training, the loss of diffusion models is not indicative of absolute data-fitting quality, since its optimal value is typically not zero but unknown, leading to confusion between large optimal loss and insufficient model capacity. In this work, we advocate the need to estimate the optimal loss value for diagnosing and improving diffusion models. We first derive the optimal loss in closed form under a unified formulation of diffusion models, and develop effective estimators for it, including a stochastic variant scalable to large datasets with proper control of variance and bias. With this tool, we unlock the inherent metric for diagnosing the training quality of mainstream diffusion model variants, and develop a more performant training schedule based on the optimal loss. Moreover, using models with 120M to 1.5B parameters, we find that the power law is better demonstrated after subtracting the optimal loss from the actual training loss, suggesting a more principled setting for investigating the scaling law for diffusion models.

</details>


### [956] [Federated Breast Cancer Detection Enhanced by Synthetic Ultrasound Image Augmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2506.23334)
*Hongyi Pan,Ziliang Hong,Gorkem Durak,Ziyue Xu,Ulas Bagci*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 用生成模型在联邦乳腺超声场景下做数据增广，适度合成可进一步提升已有联邦算法（FedAvg/FedProx）的AUC，过量则反噬。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 联邦学习因数据孤岛、样本少且Non-IID而导致乳腺超声分类模型泛化受限，需在不共享原始影像的前提下扩充训练数据。

Method: 提出联邦条件下基于深度卷积GAN与类条件DDPM的合成图像增广框架；客户端本地利用生成模型扩增私有数据后参与联邦训练，并探讨合成-真实样本比例。

Result: 在BUSI、BUS-BRA、UDIAT三个公开数据集上，适量合成图像使FedAvg平均AUC从0.9206→0.9362，FedProx从0.9429→0.9574；合成比例过高则性能下降。

Conclusion: 生成式数据增广能在保护隐私的同时提升联邦乳腺超声分类性能，但需严格控制合成-真实样本平衡。

Abstract: Federated learning enables collaborative training of deep learning models across institutions without sharing sensitive patient data. However, its performance is often limited by small datasets and non-independent, identically distributed data, which can impair model generalization. In this work, we propose a generative model-based data augmentation framework for breast ultrasound classification. It leverages synthetic images generated by deep convolutional generative adversarial networks and a class-conditioned denoising diffusion probabilistic model. Experiments on three publicly available datasets (BUSI, BUS-BRA, and UDIAT) demonstrated that incorporating a suitable number of synthetic images improved average AUC from 0.9206 to 0.9362 for FedAvg and from 0.9429 to 0.9574 for FedProx. Furthermore, we noticed that excessive use of synthetic data reduced performance. This highlights the importance of balancing real and synthetic samples. Our results underscore the potential of generative model-based augmentation to enhance federated breast ultrasound image classification.

</details>


### [957] [Theory of Mind in Action: The Instruction Inference Task in Dynamic Human-Agent Collaboration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2507.02935)
*Fardin Saad,Pradeep K. Murukannaiah,Munindar P. Singh*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 文章提出“指令推断”任务，用LLM代理 Tomcat 在模糊指令下补全人类隐含意图；Fs-CoT 版在 GPT-4o 与 DeepSeek-R1 上达人类水平。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM缺乏动态协作场景下的Theory-of-Mind（ToM）能力，难以从不完整指令推断人类真实目标，阻碍高效人机协同。

Method: 设计“指令推断”任务与Tomcat代理；Fs-CoT用少样本链式思维示范、CP用常识提示；在GPT-4o、DeepSeek-R1、Gemma-3-27B上实现，并与52名人类参与者对比意图准确率、动作与规划最优性。

Result: Fs-CoT版Tomcat在GPT-4o与DeepSeek-R1上三项指标与人类无显著差异，显著优于基线；Gemma-3-27B仍落后。

Conclusion: LLM凭结构化链式推理可逼近人类ToM，为实时人机协作提供可行路径；模型规模与推理策略是性能关键。

Abstract: Successful human-agent teaming relies on an agent being able to understand instructions given by a (human) principal. In many cases, an instruction may be incomplete or ambiguous. In such cases, the agent must infer the unspoken intentions from their shared context, that is, it must exercise the principal's Theory of Mind (ToM) and infer the mental states of its principal. We consider the prospects of effective human-agent collaboration using large language models (LLMs). To assess ToM in a dynamic, goal-oriented, and collaborative environment, we introduce a novel task, Instruction Inference, in which an agent assists a principal in reaching a goal by interpreting incomplete or ambiguous instructions.
  We present Tomcat, an LLM-based agent, designed to exhibit ToM reasoning in interpreting and responding to the principal's instructions.We implemented two variants of Tomcat. One, dubbed Fs-CoT (Fs for few-shot, CoT for chain-of-thought), is based on a small number of examples demonstrating the requisite structured reasoning. One, dubbed CP (commonsense prompt), relies on commonsense knowledge and information about the problem.
