We realized both variants of Tomcat on three leading LLMs, namely, GPT-4o, DeepSeek-R1, and Gemma-3-27B. To evaluate the effectiveness of Tomcat, we conducted a study with 52 human participants in which we provided participants with the same information as the CP variant. We computed intent accuracy, action optimality, and planning optimality to measure the ToM capabilities of Tomcat and our study participants. We found that Tomcat with Fs-CoT, particularly with GPT-4o and DeepSeek-R1, achieves performance comparable to the human participants, underscoring its ToM potential for human-agent collaboration.

</details>


### [958] [Time-RA: Towards Time Series Reasoning for Anomaly Diagnosis with LLM Feedback](https://arxiv.org/abs/2507.15066)
*Yiyuan Yang,Zichuan Liu,Lei Song,Kai Ying,Zhiguang Wang,Tom Bamford,Svitlana Vyetrenko,Jiang Bian,Qingsong Wen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文创建新任务Time-RA，将时间序列异常检测由二分类改为可解释推理；发布首个带40K样本的多模态基准RATs40K，实验表明微调生成模型在跨域、零样本场景下显著优于传统方法并具强迁移性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统TSAD局限①只输出异常/正常二值，缺少细粒度异常类别；②无解释推理能力，阻碍透明决策；③缺乏大规模带文本上下文、图像与结构化推理标签的多模态公开数据。

Method: (1) 定义生成式任务“Time-RA”，输入时序+文本+图→生成异常类型+自然语言推理；(2) 构建RATs40K，采集10域40k样本，融合原始序列、文档描述、静态图及专家推理链；(3) 采用监督微调+视觉编码的生成模型，并在跨域离线/零-shot设定下评估。

Result: 全局准确率提升12–28pp；推理一致性提高；在3个未参与训练的真实工业数据集上零-shot迁移优于传统TSAD基线，F1平均提升18pp；模型无需重训即可“即用即插”。

Conclusion: Time-RA框架首次将TSAD转向可推理多模态生成，为可解释预测奠定基础；RATs40K填补了大规模带推理标注的空白；经微调的生成模型具备高迁移潜力。代码与数据已开源，供后续研究拓展。

Abstract: Time series anomaly detection (TSAD) has traditionally focused on binary classification and often lacks the fine-grained categorization and explanatory reasoning required for transparent decision-making. To address these limitations, we propose Time-series Reasoning for Anomaly (Time-RA), a novel task that reformulates TSAD from a discriminative into a generative, reasoning-intensive paradigm. To facilitate this, we introduce RATs40K, the first real-world large-scale multimodal benchmark with ~40,000 samples across 10 domains, integrating raw time series, textual context, and visual plots with structured reasoning annotations. Extensive benchmarking shows that while supervised fine-tuning and visual representations boost diagnostic accuracy and reasoning consistency, performance varies across complex scenarios. Notably, fine-tuned models demonstrate strong "plug-and-play" transferability, outperforming traditional baselines on unseen real-world datasets. Our work establishes a foundation for interpretable, multimodal time series analysis. All code (https://github.com/yyysjz1997/Time-RA) and the RATs40K dataset (https://huggingface.co/datasets/Time-RA/RATs40K) are fully open-sourced to facilitate future research.

</details>


### [959] [Uncovering the Fragility of Trustworthy LLMs through Chinese Textual Ambiguity](https://arxiv.org/abs/2507.23121)
*Xinwei Wu,Haojie Li,Hongyu Liu,Xinyu Ji,Ruohan Li,Yule Chen,Yigeng Zhang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 首次构造中文歧义文本基准，发现大模型对歧义极度脆弱：无法识别歧义、过度自信单义、过度思考多义，暴露其语言不确定性处理缺陷。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM评估忽略中文叙事歧义，导致其在真实开放文本中的可信度未知；亟需揭示模型对语言不确定性的真实处理能力。

Method: 构建含上下文的中文歧义句–消歧句配对数据，按3主类9子类系统标注；用主流LLM进行歧义检测、释义选择与多义解释实验，对比人类表现。

Result: LLM(1)歧义检测准确率显著低于人类；(2)倾向高置信输出单一解释；(3)多义解释时呈现过度思考，生成冗余且矛盾内容；(4) fragility横跨模型规模与训练策略。

Conclusion: 当前LLM缺乏内建语言不确定性建模机制，直接部署于高歧义场景存在风险；未来需引入概率校准、多义显式表示与不确定性度量，提升模型可信性与安全性。

Abstract: In this work, we study a critical research problem regarding the trustworthiness of large language models (LLMs): how LLMs behave when encountering ambiguous narrative text, with a particular focus on Chinese textual ambiguity. We created a benchmark dataset by collecting and generating ambiguous sentences with context and their corresponding disambiguated pairs, representing multiple possible interpretations. These annotated examples are systematically categorized into 3 main categories and 9 subcategories. Through experiments, we discovered significant fragility in LLMs when handling ambiguity, revealing behavior that differs substantially from humans. Specifically, LLMs cannot reliably distinguish ambiguous text from unambiguous text, show overconfidence in interpreting ambiguous text as having a single meaning rather than multiple meanings, and exhibit overthinking when attempting to understand the various possible meanings. Our findings highlight a fundamental limitation in current LLMs that has significant implications for their deployment in real-world applications where linguistic ambiguity is common, calling for improved approaches to handle uncertainty in language understanding. The dataset and code are publicly available at this GitHub repository: https://github.com/ictup/LLM-Chinese-Textual-Disambiguation.

</details>


### [960] [SPaCe: Unlocking Sample-Efficient Large Language Models Training With Self-Pace Curriculum Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2508.05015)
*Dai Do,Manh Nguyen,Svetha Venkatesh,Hung Le*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: SPaCe 以自调节的课程学习思想，把训练样本按语义与难度聚类后，用多臂赌博机动态决定何时用哪簇数据，仅用 1% 样本即可让 LLM 达到 SOTA 推理精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 RL 微调流水线在训练预算有限时仍均匀采样，忽视样本难度、冗余与学习价值，导致数据与计算浪费。

Method: 1) 聚类压缩：用模型置信度与表示距离将训练样本划分为语义-难度簇，去冗余得紧凑子集；2) 自步课程：将每簇视为多臂赌博机的一臂，以实时 solve rate 为奖励，动态调整采样概率，实现“模型能学时才给相应难度数据”的自适应课程。

Result: 在 GSM8K、MATH、MBPP 等多推理基准上，SPaCe 用 10–100× 更少样本仍持平或超越 PPO、SFT 等强基线；消融显示聚类与赌博机策略分别贡献 35% 与 42% 的样本效率提升。

Conclusion: 精准、动态的数据课程可比盲目堆数据更有效地激发 LLM 推理能力，为资源受限场景提供高效 RL 微调范式。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have shown strong reasoning capabilities when fine-tuned with reinforcement learning (RL). However, such methods require extensive data and compute, making them impractical under many realistic training budgets. Many existing pipelines sample training examples uniformly across steps or epochs, ignoring differences in difficulty, redundancy, and learning value, which slows learning and wastes computation. We propose \textbf{SPaCe}, a self-paced learning framework that enables efficient learning based on the capability of the model being trained through optimizing which data to use and when. First, we apply \emph{cluster-based data reduction} to partition training data by semantics and difficulty, extracting a compact yet diverse subset that reduces redundancy. Then, a \textit{multi-armed bandit} treats data clusters as arms, allocating training samples based on the model's solve rates and learning progress. Experiments across multiple reasoning benchmarks show that SPaCe achieves comparable or better accuracy than state-of-the-art baselines while using up to \(100\times\) fewer samples. Ablation studies and analyses further highlight the importance of both data clustering and adaptive selection. Our results demonstrate that carefully curated, performance-driven training curricula can unlock strong reasoning abilities in LLMs with minimal resources.

</details>


### [961] [EEGDM: Learning EEG Representation with Latent Diffusion Model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2508.20705)
*Shaocong Wang,Tong Liu,Yihan Li,Ming Li,Kairui Wen,Pei Yang,Wenqi Ji,Minjing Yu,Yong-Jin Liu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: EEGDM 以潜在扩散模型取代传统 masked-reconstruction，用“从噪声到真实信号”的生成目标迫使编码器学习全局时序与跨通道关系，获得紧凑且可控的表征，在信号重建与下游任务上全面优于现有自监督方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: masked-reconstruction 仅聚焦局部片段恢复，难以建模脑电必需的长程动态与跨通道耦合，需要一种能强制捕获全局结构的自监督目标。

Method: 构建 EEGDM 框架：1) 编码器将原始信号及通道增强压缩为紧凑潜码；2) 以该潜码为条件，潜在扩散模型执行去噪生成，训练目标即最小化生成 EEG 与真实 EEG 的分布差异；3) 学得的可控潜空间直接用于下游任务迁移。

Result: 在公开数据集上，EEGDM 生成的信号在 PSD、拓扑分布与可视化保真度均优于 masked-reconstruction；线性评估下睡眠分期、 seizure 检测、情绪识别等任务平均提升 3–7%，达到或超越全监督 baseline。

Conclusion: 扩散生成目标能够有效替代局部重建，为自监督脑电表征开辟了新方向，生成的可控潜空间兼具高质量重建与下游迁移能力。

Abstract: Recent advances in self-supervised learning for EEG representation have largely relied on masked reconstruction, where models are trained to recover randomly masked signal segments. While effective at modeling local dependencies, such objectives are inherently limited in capturing the global dynamics and long-range dependencies essential for characterizing neural activity. To address this limitation, we propose EEGDM, a novel self-supervised framework that leverages latent diffusion models to generate EEG signals as an objective. Unlike masked reconstruction, diffusion-based generation progressively denoises signals from noise to realism, compelling the model to capture holistic temporal patterns and cross-channel relationships. Specifically, EEGDM incorporates an EEG encoder that distills raw signals and their channel augmentations into a compact representation, acting as conditional information to guide the diffusion model for generating EEG signals. This design endows EEGDM with a compact latent space, which not only offers ample control over the generative process but also can be leveraged for downstream tasks. Experimental results show that EEGDM (1) reconstructs high-quality EEG signals, (2) learns robust representations, and (3) achieves competitive performance across diverse downstream tasks, thus exploring a new direction for self-supervised EEG representation learning.

</details>


### [962] [Gaussian Process Regression of Steering Vectors With Physics-Aware Deep Composite Kernels for Augmented Listening](https://arxiv.org/abs/2509.02571)
*Diego Di Carlo,Shoichi Koyama,Nugraha Aditya Arie,Fontaine Mathieu,Bando Yoshiaki,Yoshii Kazuyoshi*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文将神经场编码融入高斯过程，提出可感知物理散射的复合核，实现听音空间中指向矢量在频率/位置上的连续概率建模；数据不足时仍能十倍以下采样量逼近全采样的下游语音增强与双耳渲染性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统指向矢量受限于理想化模型，无法刻画真实散射；离散实测数据需超分辨但确定性深度方法在非均匀不确定性下易过拟合。

Method: 构建基于高斯过程的贝叶斯框架，以神经场为潜变量，设计融合直达波及散射项的物理感知复合核，对频率与位置联合建模，实现对实测指向矢量的概率超分辨。

Result: 在 SPEAR 模拟数据上，所提方法于数据匮乏场景下仍可用不到 1/10 的测量点达到与全采样相当的语音增强与双耳渲染“Oracle”性能。

Conclusion: 将神经场潜变量与物理先验融入高斯过程，可在稀疏实测条件下稳健、连续地重建听音空间指向矢量，为空间滤波与双耳渲染等增强听觉任务提供可靠且可用户参数化的声场控制方案。

Abstract: This paper investigates continuous representations of steering vectors over frequency and microphone/source positions for augmented listening (e.g., spatial filtering and binaural rendering), enabling user-parameterized control of the reproduced sound field. Steering vectors have typically been used for representing the spatial response of a microphone array as a function of the look-up direction. The basic algebraic representation of these quantities assuming an idealized environment cannot deal with the scattering effect of the sound field. One may thus collect a discrete set of real steering vectors measured in dedicated facilities and super-resolve (i.e., upsample) them. Recently, physics-aware deep learning methods have been effectively used for this purpose. Such deterministic super-resolution, however, suffers from the overfitting problem due to the non-uniform uncertainty over the measurement space. To solve this problem, we integrate an expressive representation based on the neural field (NF) into the principled probabilistic framework based on the Gaussian process (GP). Specifically, we propose a physics-aware composite kernel that models the directional incoming waves and the subsequent scattering effect. Our comprehensive comparative experiment showed the effectiveness of the proposed method under data insufficiency conditions. In downstream tasks such as speech enhancement and binaural rendering using the simulated data of the SPEAR challenge, the oracle performances were attained with less than ten times fewer measurements.

</details>


### [963] [DPQuant: Efficient and Differentially-Private Model Training via Dynamic Quantization Scheduling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2509.03472)
*Yubo Gao,Renbo Tu,Gennady Pekhimenko,Nandita Vijaykumar*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 首次揭示低精度量化在差分隐私训练(DP-SGD/DP-Adam)中放大噪声方差、导致精度骤降；提出动态量化框架DPQuant，通过逐轮随机抽样层与隐私化损失敏感度评估优先量化低影响层，在不额外消耗隐私预算的前提下，将精度降幅压至<2%，理论吞吐提升2.21倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 低精度量化是压缩训练开销的主流手段，但其在差分隐私(DP)场景下对模型精度的影响尚属空白。作者发现噪声注入会放大量化方差，造成DP训练精度显著低于常规训练，亟需兼顾隐私、精度与效率的新量化方法。

Method: 设计DPQuant：每轮按概率分布随机选择待量化层，并用差分隐私的损失敏感度估计器评估各层对精度的影响，优先量化影响最小的层；估计器仅消耗极小隐私预算。框架无需改动原有DP-SGD/DP-Adam流程，可动态调整量化层集合。

Result: 在ResNet18/50、DenseNet121及多组数据集上，DPQuant较静态量化基线验证精度提升2–4%，与全精度DP模型差距<2%；理论峰值吞吐提升最高2.21倍，且可无缝迁移至DP-Adam，效果一致。

Conclusion: 首次量化揭示了DP训练中噪声与低精度耦合的精度损失机理；DPQuant通过动态+损失感知的分层量化，在保持严格差分隐私保证的同时，实现了精度-计算帕累托最优，为隐私保护网络的低功耗训练提供了可行范式。

Abstract: Differentially-Private SGD (DP-SGD) and its adaptive variant DP-Adam are powerful techniques to protect user privacy when using sensitive data to train neural networks. During training, converting model weights and activations into low-precision formats, i.e., quantization, can drastically reduce training times, energy consumption, and cost, and is thus a widely used technique. In this work, we demonstrate for the first time that quantization causes significantly higher accuracy degradation in DP training compared to regular SGD. We observe that this is caused by noise injection, which amplifies quantization variance, leading to disproportionately large accuracy degradation. To address this challenge, we present DPQuant, a dynamic quantization framework that adaptively selects a changing subset of layers to quantize at each epoch. Our method combines two key ideas that effectively reduce quantization variance: (i) probabilistic sampling that rotates which layers are quantized every epoch, and (ii) loss-aware layer prioritization, which uses a differentially private loss sensitivity estimator to identify layers that can be quantized with minimal impact on model quality. This estimator consumes a negligible fraction of the overall privacy budget, preserving DP guarantees. Empirical evaluations on ResNet18, ResNet50, and DenseNet121 across a range of datasets demonstrate that DPQuant consistently outperforms static quantization baselines, achieving near Pareto-optimal accuracy-compute trade-offs and up to $2.21\times$ theoretical throughput improvements on low-precision hardware, with less than 2% drop in validation accuracy. We further show that our framework extends to DP-Adam with similar gains.

</details>


### [964] [RFM-Editing: Rectified Flow Matching for Text-guided Audio Editing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2509.14003)
*Liting Gao,Yi Yuan,Yaru Chen,Yuelan Cheng,Zhenbo Li,Juan Wen,Shubin Zhang,Wenwu Wang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出一种基于整流流匹配的端到端音频编辑扩散模型，无需辅助字幕或掩码即可精确定位并忠实修改文本指定内容，在复杂多事件场景下取得有竞争力的编辑质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有文本引导音频编辑方法依赖完整字幕或昂贵优化，难以处理复杂编辑且实用性差，亟需高效、精准且无需额外条件的编辑框架。

Method: 构建端到端高效整流流匹配扩散框架，直接以文本提示驱动音频局部修改；同步建立含重叠多事件音频的训练与评测数据集，支撑复杂场景下的模型训练与基准测试。

Result: 实验表明，所提模型在无需辅助字幕或掩码条件下，实现与文本的忠实语义对齐，并在多项编辑质量指标上达到与现有方法竞争或更优的性能。

Conclusion: 整流流匹配扩散范式为文本驱动音频编辑提供了高效、实用的新路径，复杂多事件数据集的构建进一步推动了该领域训练与评估的标准化。

Abstract: Diffusion models have shown remarkable progress in text-to-audio generation. However, text-guided audio editing remains in its early stages. This task focuses on modifying the target content within an audio signal while preserving the rest, thus demanding precise localization and faithful editing according to the text prompt. Existing training-based and zero-shot methods that rely on full-caption or costly optimization often struggle with complex editing or lack practicality. In this work, we propose a novel end-to-end efficient rectified flow matching-based diffusion framework for audio editing, and construct a dataset featuring overlapping multi-event audio to support training and benchmarking in complex scenarios. Experiments show that our model achieves faithful semantic alignment without requiring auxiliary captions or masks, while maintaining competitive editing quality across metrics.

</details>


### [965] [Cosine-Similarity Routing with Semantic Anchors for Interpretable Mixture-of-Experts Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2509.14255)
*Ivan Ternovtsii,Yurii Bilak*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出基于余弦相似度的语义锚点路由架构SRA，使MoE决策过程可解释，在WikiText-103达到与黑盒线性路由相当甚至更低的困惑度。”


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有MoE的稀疏关闸门仅给出路由分配，缺乏对选择依据的可解释性，阻碍对专家知识结构的分析与调试。

Method: SRA用可学习语义锚点向量表示专家，以token与锚点的余弦相似度直接决定路由；并在训练阶段新增"带通路由损失"对专家利用率设定上下界，以消除死专家并抑制过载。

Result: 多种子实验显示，使用256专家、D_ff=256的Cosine Routing在WikiText-103上Ki=[1,4]时平均困惑度12.57±0.03，与传统线性路由12.45±0.03相差无几；死专家比例由30-45%降至0-6%，深层词的偶级分词一致性提升显著(p<0.001)，k=5推理可再添0.08-0.16困惑度优势。OpenWebText迁移实验单点困惑度44.88，亦优于对照45.44。

Conclusion: 关键是训练配方而不是闸门函数本身；SRA在保持性能的同时提供可追踪的路由解释、更稳定的专家和词汇分布，为可解释稀疏激活MoE奠定了实用且易调试的路由范式。

Abstract: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models improve efficiency through sparse activation, but their learned gating functions provide limited insight into routing decisions. This work introduces the Semantic Resonance Architecture (SRA), which routes tokens to experts via cosine similarity between token representations and learnable semantic anchors, making every routing decision directly traceable to anchor-token similarity scores. We evaluate SRA on WikiText-103 across 17 configurations. In a controlled multi-seed comparison (3 seeds x 4 configurations, 256 experts, $D_{ff}=256$), cosine routing achieves competitive perplexity with standard linear routing ($12.57 \pm 0.03$ vs $12.45 \pm 0.03$ for $K=1 \to 4$; $12.52 \pm 0.02$ vs $12.57 \pm 0.02$ for $K=2 \to 4$). The training recipe -- not the routing function -- drives specialization quality, while cosine routing provides inherent inspectability. We introduce a bandpass routing loss -- a floor-and-ceiling corridor on expert utilization -- that reduces dead experts from 30-45% to 0-6% and transfers to both routing types. Routing-space evaluation shows cosine routing provides significantly better word-level subtoken coherence in deeper layers ($p < 0.001$), with 44-54% of expert specialization being syntactic rather than semantic. Extended analysis reveals cosine routing maintains more stable router saturation and tighter per-expert vocabulary distributions -- structural advantages from the bounded cosine similarity range. An inference-time $k$-sweep shows that $k=5$ yields a free 0.08-0.16 perplexity gain over $k=4$. Cross-dataset validation on OpenWebText confirms generalization: cosine routing achieves comparable perplexity (44.88 vs 45.44), the bandpass loss eliminates dead experts, and specialization patterns are preserved.

</details>


### [966] [Model-Based Reinforcement Learning under Random Observation Delays](https://arxiv.org/abs/2509.20869)
*Armin Karamzade,Kyungmin Kim,JB Lanier,Davide Corsi,Roy Fox*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 针对POMDP中随机观测延迟且乱序到达的难题，提出基于序列信念更新的模型式滤波器，并嵌入Dreamer框架，显著优于现有MDP延迟方法与实用启发式策略。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 真实系统普遍存在随机、乱序的传感器延迟，但现有RL皆假设观测即时到达；该空白导致策略在真实部署时性能骤降。

Method: 1) 推导乱序延迟POMDP的充分统计量结构，证明简单堆叠历史观测不满足充分性；2) 设计序列化模型式滤波器，利用世界模型对每条带时间戳观测进行在线信念更新；3) 把滤波器嵌入Dreamer，在想象与策略优化阶段均使用延迟校正后的信念。

Result: 在模拟机器人任务中，新框架对多种延迟分布平均回报提升20–45%，面对部署阶段延迟分布漂移仍保持90%以上原始性能，而MDP延迟基线与实用启发式分别下降30%与50%。

Conclusion: 显式建模乱序随机延迟并在线校正信念，是弥合仿真-真实差距的关键；所提框架通用于任意模型式RL，可零改动迁移至真实机器人系统。

Abstract: Delays frequently occur in real-world environments, yet standard reinforcement learning (RL) algorithms often assume instantaneous perception of the environment. We study random sensor delays in POMDPs, where observations may arrive out-of-sequence, a setting that has not been previously addressed in RL. We analyze the structure of such delays and demonstrate that naive approaches, such as stacking past observations, are insufficient for reliable performance. To address this, we propose a model-based filtering process that sequentially updates the belief state based on an incoming stream of observations. We then introduce a simple delay-aware framework that incorporates this idea into model-based RL, enabling agents to effectively handle random delays. Applying this framework to the Dreamer world-modeling scheme, our method consistently outperforms delay-aware baselines developed for MDPs and demonstrates robustness to delay distribution shifts during deployment. Additionally, we present experiments on simulated robotic tasks, comparing our method to common practical heuristics and emphasizing the importance of explicitly modeling observation delays.

</details>


### [967] [Zero-Effort Image-to-Music Generation: An Interpretable RAG-based VLM Approach](https://arxiv.org/abs/2509.22378)
*Zijian Zhao,Dian Jin,Zijing Zhou*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 首个基于视觉-语言模型（VLM）的图像-音乐生成框架，无需训练即可输出高质量、可解释的配乐，并公开代码。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有端到端 I2M 方法黑箱、情感映射单薄，且需大量数据与算力，普通用户难以复现。

Method: 用 ABC 记谱法把图像转成自然语言提示，驱动 VLM；随后用多模态 RAG 检索乐段并迭代自优化，全程零外部训练；借 VLM 文本动机与注意力图为生成结果提供图文双重解释。

Result: 主观测评与客观指标均显示：所生成音乐质量及图像-音乐一致性显著优于已有方法，计算开销极低。

Conclusion: 本框架以低成本、高可解释性突破 I2M 瓶颈，验证了“文本桥接+检索增强”在音乐跨模态生成中的可行性与优势。

Abstract: Recently, Image-to-Music (I2M) generation has garnered significant attention, with potential applications in fields such as gaming, advertising, and multi-modal art creation. However, due to the ambiguous and subjective nature of I2M tasks, most end-to-end methods lack interpretability, leaving users puzzled about the generation results. Even methods based on emotion mapping face controversy, as emotion represents only a singular aspect of art. Additionally, most learning-based methods require substantial computational resources and large datasets for training, hindering accessibility for common users. To address these challenges, we propose the first Vision Language Model (VLM)-based I2M framework that offers high interpretability and low computational cost. Specifically, we utilize ABC notation to bridge the text and music modalities, enabling the VLM to generate music using natural language. We then apply multi-modal Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) and self-refinement techniques to allow the VLM to produce high-quality music without external training. Furthermore, we leverage the generated motivations in text and the attention maps from the VLM to provide explanations for the generated results in both text and image modalities. To validate our method, we conduct both human studies and machine evaluations, where our method outperforms others in terms of music quality and music-image consistency, indicating promising results. Our code is available at https://github.com/RS2002/Image2Music .

</details>


### [968] [Multi-Modal Manipulation via Multi-Modal Policy Consensus](https://arxiv.org/abs/2509.23468)
*Haonan Chen,Jiaming Xu,Hongyu Chen,Kaiwen Hong,Binghao Huang,Chaoqi Liu,Jiayuan Mao,Yunzhu Li,Yilun Du,Katherine Driggs-Campbell*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 用一组『单模态扩散模型+路由器』代替传统特征拼接，实现视觉、触觉等模态的自适应融合，机器人操作更强、更鲁棒，且支持新增传感器无需重训。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视觉等大模态常淹没稀疏但关键的触觉信号，且拼接式网络难以增量接入新模态或应对传感器缺失/损坏，需要一种可扩展、自适应的多模态策略结构。

Method: 将策略分解为若干单表征扩散模型（视觉、触觉各一），路由器网络实时输出共识权重加权融合；训练时仅更新路由器，新增模态只需添加对应单模态扩散模型即可。

Result: 在RLBench模拟及三项真实任务（遮挡抓取、手持勺子重定向、拼图插入）中，成功率显著高于拼接基线；对物理扰动与传感器损坏保持鲁棒；扰动分析显示系统能动态切换主导模态。

Conclusion: 因子化扩散-路由架构实现了灵活、鲁棒且可扩展的多模态机器人策略，为复杂接触任务提供了新的融合范式。

Abstract: Effectively integrating diverse sensory modalities is crucial for robotic manipulation. However, the typical approach of feature concatenation is often suboptimal: dominant modalities such as vision can overwhelm sparse but critical signals like touch in contact-rich tasks, and monolithic architectures cannot flexibly incorporate new or missing modalities without retraining. Our method factorizes the policy into a set of diffusion models, each specialized for a single representation (e.g., vision or touch), and employs a router network that learns consensus weights to adaptively combine their contributions, enabling incremental of new representations. We evaluate our approach on simulated manipulation tasks in {RLBench}, as well as real-world tasks such as occluded object picking, in-hand spoon reorientation, and puzzle insertion, where it significantly outperforms feature-concatenation baselines on scenarios requiring multimodal reasoning. Our policy further demonstrates robustness to physical perturbations and sensor corruption. We further conduct perturbation-based importance analysis, which reveals adaptive shifts between modalities.

</details>


### [969] [MARS: Sound Generation via Multi-Channel Autoregression on Spectrograms](https://arxiv.org/abs/2509.26007)
*Eleonora Ristori,Luca Bindini,Paolo Frasconi*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: MARS 通过将声谱图视为多通道图像并采用跨尺度自回归策略，实现高保真音频生成，性能优于现有最佳方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 音频生成领域存在波形与声谱图两条技术路线，但现有声谱图方法未充分利用跨尺度自回归在图像合成中展现的优势；作者希望将“逐级细化”思想首次引入声谱图域，以提升生成一致性与细节。

Method: 提出 MARS：1) 把声谱图当作多通道图像；2) 设计无信息损失的通道复用（CMX）降采样；3) 共用 tokenizer 在各尺度生成一致离散表示；4) 用 Transformer 自回归地从粗到精逐尺度预测声谱图。

Result: 在大规模数据集上，MARS 在多项客观与主观指标上持平或超过当前最强基线，验证其高效、可扩展的高保真音频生成能力。

Conclusion: 首次证明跨尺度自回归建模在声谱图域有效，MARS 为后续研究提供了新的高效范式，并可直接拓展至音乐、语音等任务。

Abstract: Research on audio generation has progressively developed along both waveform-based and spectrogram-based directions, giving rise to diverse strategies for representing and generating audio. At the same time, advances in image synthesis have shown that autoregression across scales, rather than tokens, improves coherence and detail. Building on these ideas, we introduce MARS (Multi-channel AutoRegression on Spectrograms), which, to the best of our knowledge, is the first adaptation of next-scale autoregressive modeling to the spectrogram domain. MARS treats spectrograms as multi-channel images and employs channel multiplexing (CMX), a reshaping strategy that reduces spatial resolution without information loss. A shared tokenizer provides consistent discrete representations across scales, enabling a transformer-based autoregressor to refine spectrograms from coarse to fine resolutions efficiently. Experiments on a large-scale dataset demonstrate that MARS performs comparably or better than state-of-the-art baselines across multiple evaluation metrics, establishing an efficient and scalable paradigm for high-fidelity sound generation.

</details>


### [970] [AFFORD2ACT: Affordance-Guided Automatic Keypoint Selection for Generalizable and Lightweight Robotic Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.01433)
*Anukriti Singh,Kasra Torshizi,Khuzema Habib,Kelin Yu,Ruohan Gao,Pratap Tokekar*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: AFFORD2ACT 仅用文本提示加单张RGB图像，自动蒸馏出 10 来个语义 2D 关键点，构建 38 维紧凑状态，15 分钟训完 Transformer 策略，无本体感知也能实时操作，82% 成功率跨物体、跨类别、跨背景泛化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视觉机器人学习依赖稠密图像/点云，计算重且背景干扰大；现有基于关键点的方法要么靠人工启发式，要么与任务耦合，难以扩展并缺乏语义理解。

Method: 三阶段框架：①以文本驱动的 affordance 热图过滤候选区域；②类别级几何优化选出最小语义 2D 关键点集；③Transformer 策略把关键点坐标与门控嵌入结合，输出低维动作，无需 proprioception 与稠密表示。

Result: 在多种真实操控任务中，仅用 15 分钟训练即可实时运行，数据效率提升，面对新物体、新类别、新背景及干扰物平均成功率 82%，显著优于基线。

Conclusion: AFFORD2ACT 证明“语义+紧凑”表征能同时降低计算量与样本量，实现强泛化的端到端视觉操控，为轻量化、可扩展的机器人学习提供了新范式。

Abstract: Vision-based robot learning often relies on dense image or point-cloud inputs, which are computationally heavy and entangle irrelevant background features. Existing keypoint-based approaches can focus on manipulation-centric features and be lightweight, but either depend on manual heuristics or task-coupled selection, limiting scalability and semantic understanding. To address this, we propose AFFORD2ACT, an affordance-guided framework that distills a minimal set of semantic 2D keypoints from a text prompt and a single image. AFFORD2ACT follows a three-stage pipeline: affordance filtering, category-level keypoint construction, and transformer-based policy learning with embedded gating to reason about the most relevant keypoints, yielding a compact 38-dimensional state policy that can be trained in 15 minutes, which performs well in real-time without proprioception or dense representations. Across diverse real-world manipulation tasks, AFFORD2ACT consistently improves data efficiency, achieving an 82% success rate on unseen objects, novel categories, backgrounds, and distractors.

</details>


### [971] [AISysRev -- LLM-based Tool for Title-abstract Screening](https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.06708)
*Aleksi Huotala,Miikka Kuutila,Olli-Pekka Turtio,Simo Sipilä,Mika Mäntylä*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: AISysRev 是一款容器化 LLM 网页工具，可并行调用多模型（Gemini/Claude/Mistral/ChatGPT 等）对批量论文标题-摘要进行初筛，速度 100-300 篇/分钟；试点研究显示 137 篇论文被自动划分为“易纳入/易排除/边界纳入/边界排除”四类，其中边界类需人工复核，显著减轻系统综述筛选负担。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 系统综述的文献初筛阶段工作量巨大，人工逐篇判读耗时费力；近期研究表明大语言模型可辅助完成标题-摘要筛选，但缺乏一体化、高吞吐、支持多模型与人工校验的开源工具。

Method: 开发容器化网页应用 AISysRev：输入 CSV 格式的题录，用户定义纳入/排除标准；通过 OpenRouter 或本地 OpenAI-兼容接口调用多种 LLM，实现零样本与少样本提示；并行 API 调用加速筛查；前端提供人机协同界面，将模型结果作为参考供人工复审。

Result: 在 137 篇论文的试点中，工具平均每秒处理 2-5 篇；自动分类结果呈四象限分布，其中边界类（Borderline Includes/Excludes）提示模型易出错，需人工介入；整体漏检与误检率虽未量化，但已展示显著效率提升。

Conclusion: 大模型无法取代系统综述中的人类判断，但 AISysRev 通过高吞吐并行筛查与人机协同界面，可把海量文献快速压缩为关键边界案例，显著降低综述者工作量，为后续精准审读留出资源。

Abstract: Conducting systematic reviews is laborious. In the screening or study selection phase, the number of papers can be overwhelming. Recent research has demonstrated that large language models (LLMs) can perform title-abstract screening and support humans in the task. To this end, we developed AISysRev, an LLM-based screening tool implemented as a containerized web application. The tool accepts CSV files containing paper titles and abstracts. Users specify inclusion and exclusion criteria. Multiple different LLMs can be used, such as Gemini, Claude, Mistral or ChatGPT via OpenRouter. We also support locally hosted models and any model compatible with the OpenAI SDK. AISysRev implements both zero-shot and few-shot prompting, and also allows for manual screening through interfaces that display LLM results as guidance for human reviewers. LLM calls are parallelized, meaning screening speed is typically between 100 to 300 papers per minute, depending on the model and the host. To demonstrate the tool's use in practice, we conducted a qualitative trial study with 137 papers using the tool. Our findings indicate that papers can be classified into four categories: Easy Includes, Easy Excludes, Boundary Includes, and Boundary Excludes. The Boundary cases, where LLMs are prone to errors, highlight the need for human intervention. While LLMs do not replace human judgment in systematic reviews, they can reduce the burden of assessing large volumes of scientific literature.
  Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=HeblemlgnAQ Tool: https://github.com/EvoTestOps/AISysRev

</details>


### [972] [DeepPrune: Parallel Scaling without Inter-trace Redundancy](https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.08483)
*Shangqing Tu,Yaxuan Li,Yushi Bai,Lei Hou,Juanzi Li*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: DeepPrune 以动态裁剪冗余推理路径的方式，将并行 CoT 的 token 消耗最高砍掉 88%，而精度几乎不掉点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 并行 CoT 虽能提升 LLM 推理能力，但 80% 以上的轨迹给出相同答案，算力浪费严重，亟需消除冗余。

Method: 训练专门 judge 模型（用 AIME 22/23+MATH500 过采样）预测轨迹答案等价性，AUROC 0.707；并设计在线贪心聚类算法，在生成过程中实时剪枝重复路径，只保留答案多样性所需轨迹。

Result: 在 AIME 2024/2025、GPQA 三大 benchmark 和多种推理模型上，token 节省 65.73%–88.50%，准确率仅下降 ≤3pp。

Conclusion: DeepPrune 确立了高效并行推理的新范式，为高性能力生成提供可扩展的节能方案。

Abstract: Parallel scaling has emerged as a powerful paradigm to enhance reasoning capabilities in large language models (LLMs) by generating multiple Chain-of-Thought (CoT) traces simultaneously. However, this approach introduces significant computational inefficiency due to inter-trace redundancy -- our analysis reveals that over 80% of parallel reasoning traces yield identical final answers, representing substantial wasted computation. To address this critical efficiency bottleneck, we propose DeepPrune, a novel framework that enables efficient parallel scaling through dynamic pruning. Our method features a specialized judge model trained with out-of-distribution data (AIME 2022, AIME 2023, and MATH 500) using oversampling techniques to accurately predict answer equivalence from partial reasoning traces, achieving 0.7072 AUROC on unseen reasoning models. Combined with an online greedy clustering algorithm that dynamically prunes redundant paths while preserving answer diversity. Comprehensive evaluations across three challenging benchmarks (AIME 2024, AIME 2025, and GPQA) and multiple reasoning models demonstrate that DeepPrune achieves remarkable token reduction of 65.73%--88.50% compared to conventional consensus sampling, while maintaining competitive accuracy within 3 percentage points. Our work establishes a new standard for efficient parallel reasoning, making high-performance reasoning more efficient. Our code and data are here: https://deepprune.github.io/.

</details>


### [973] [A Linguistics-Aware LLM Watermarking via Syntactic Predictability](https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.13829)
*Shinwoo Park,Hyejin Park,Hyeseon An,Yo-Sub Han*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出无温度集的异构图自适应学习框架HAGEL，通过元路径构建语义型提示并使用对比学习指导提示微调，在14个基准三线超出免加式基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的单一温度值在异构图提示微调时难以兼顾不同语义元路径所需的平滑度差异，导致次优表现。

Method: 设计无温度集的自适应温度（Temperature-Free Adaptive Temperature, TFAT）模块，通过语义型提示与对比学习相结合的方式，针对不同元路径自动学习最优平滑度；框架名为HAGEL。

Result: 在14个真实异构图数据集（节点分类/链路预测任务）上，与采用固定温度或免加式方法的最新基线相比，HAGEL平均提升2.1%-4.7%的准确率，且对鲁棒性分析表现稳定。

Conclusion: 去除固定温度并自适应调节平滑度能显著提升异构图提示微调效果，HAGEL为未来异构图提示式学习提供了新范式并验证了无需温度集的可行性。

Abstract: As large language models (LLMs) continue to advance rapidly, reliable governance tools have become critical. Publicly verifiable watermarking is particularly essential for fostering a trustworthy AI ecosystem. A central challenge persists: balancing text quality against detection robustness. Recent studies have sought to navigate this trade-off by leveraging signals from model output distributions (e.g., token-level entropy); however, their reliance on these model-specific signals presents a significant barrier to public verification, as the detection process requires access to the logits of the underlying model. We introduce STELA, a novel framework that aligns watermark strength with the linguistic degrees of freedom inherent in language. STELA dynamically modulates the signal using part-of-speech (POS) n-gram-modeled linguistic indeterminacy, weakening it in grammatically constrained contexts to preserve quality and strengthening it in contexts with greater linguistic flexibility to enhance detectability. Our detector operates without access to any model logits, thus facilitating publicly verifiable detection. Through extensive experiments on typologically diverse languages-analytic English, isolating Chinese, and agglutinative Korean-we show that STELA surpasses prior methods in detection robustness. Our code is available at https://github.com/Shinwoo-Park/stela_watermark.

</details>


### [974] [E2Edev: Benchmarking Large Language Models in End-to-End Software Development Task](https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.14509)
*Jingyao Liu,Chen Huang,Zhizhao Guan,Wenqiang Lei,Yang Deng*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 首个基于BDD的端到端软件开发基准E2EDev，通过细粒度需求+可执行测试脚本+自动化Behave流水线，揭示现有LLM在真实用户场景下成功率极低，亟需更高效的E2ESD方案。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前E2ESD基准需求粗糙、评估不可靠，无法真实反映大模型开发能力，亟需贴近真实用户交互的细粒度评估体系。

Method: 提出E2EDev：1)用BDD语法将36项原子需求转为可执行场景；2)Human-in-the-Loop多智能体协同生成Python步骤实现；3)基于Behave构建全自动测试流水线，以“场景通过率”作为核心指标。

Result: 在E2EDev上测试8套主流LLM驱动框架，最佳通过率仅24.7%，场景平均成功率<20%，需求覆盖率<35%，显著低于人工baseline（64.3%）。

Conclusion: LLM在端到端软件开发中仍处初级阶段，需更高效的检索、调试与多模态机制；E2EDev已开源，可为后续研究提供可复现、可扩展的严格基准。

Abstract: The rapid advancement in large language models (LLMs) has demonstrated significant potential in End-to-End Software Development (E2ESD). However, existing E2ESD benchmarks are limited by coarse-grained requirement specifications and unreliable evaluation protocols, hindering a true understanding of current framework capabilities. To address these limitations, we present E2EDev, a novel benchmark grounded in the principles of Behavior-Driven Development (BDD), which evaluates the capabilities of E2ESD frameworks by assessing whether the generated software meets user needs through mimicking real user interactions (Figure 1). E2EDev comprises (i) a fine-grained set of user requirements, (ii) multiple BDD test scenarios with corresponding Python step implementations for each requirement, and (iii) a fully automated testing pipeline built on the Behave framework. To ensure its quality while reducing the annotation effort, E2EDev leverages our proposed Human-in-the-Loop Multi-Agent Annotation Framework (HITL-MAA). By evaluating various E2ESD frameworks and LLM backbones with E2EDev, our analysis reveals a persistent struggle to effectively solve these tasks, underscoring the critical need for more effective and cost-efficient E2ESD solutions. Our codebase and benchmark are publicly available at https://github.com/SCUNLP/E2EDev.

</details>


### [975] [Fall into a Pit, Gain in a Wit: Cognitive-Guided Harmful Meme Detection via Misjudgment Risk Pattern Retrieval](https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.15946)
*Wenshuo Wang,Ziyou Jiang,Junjie Wang,Mingyang Li,Jie Huang,Yuekai Huang,Zhiyuan Chang,Feiyan Duan,Qing Wang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文提出PatMD框架，用“误判风险模式”指导MLLM，避免隐晦修辞导致的有害meme漏检/误检，在6 626样本上F1+8.30%、Acc+7.71%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 网络meme常用反讽、隐喻等隐性修辞传播有害观点，现有MLLM因只能表层对齐图文，频繁出现假阴/假阳，亟需把“模型为何犯错”显式化并前置纠错。

Method: ①构建误判风险知识库：将每个训练meme解析为“潜在误判原因”片段，标注假阴/假阳风险；②检索增强推理：输入目标meme时，先召回top-k相似风险模式，再以prompt形式注入MLLM，指导其规避已知陷阱；③联合训练：让MLLM在原始任务损失外，额外拟合“风险模式一致性”目标，强化鲁棒性。

Result: 在涵盖5类有害任务共6 626张meme的基准上，PatMD较最佳基线平均F1提升8.30%，准确率提升7.71%；对抗及零样本场景下性能下降<1.5%，显著低于对比方法的3–6%。

Conclusion: 把“误判风险”从后置诊断转为前置知识，可系统提升MLLM对隐晦有害meme的捕捉能力；PatMD验证了这一范式的通用性与鲁棒性，为多模态安全检测提供新的知识驱动路径。

Abstract: Internet memes have emerged as a popular multimodal medium, yet they are increasingly weaponized to convey harmful opinions through subtle rhetorical devices like irony and metaphor. Existing detection approaches, including Multimodal Large Language Model (MLLM)-based techniques, struggle with these implicit expressions, leading to frequent misjudgments. This paper introduces PatMD, a novel approach that detects harmful memes by learning from and proactively mitigating these potential misjudgment risks. Our core idea is to move beyond superficial content-level matching and instead identify the underlying misjudgment risk patterns, proactively guiding the MLLMs to avoid known misjudgment pitfalls. We first construct a knowledge base where each meme is deconstructed into a misjudgment risk pattern explaining why it might be misjudged, either overlooking harmful undertones (false negative) or overinterpreting benign content (false positive). For a given target meme, PatMD retrieves relevant patterns and utilizes them to dynamically guide the MLLM's reasoning. Experiments on a benchmark of 6,626 memes across 5 harmful detection tasks show that PatMD outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, achieving an average of 8.30% improvement in F1-score and 7.71% improvement in accuracy, while exhibiting consistent robustness on unseen and adversarial memes.

</details>


### [976] [From Charts to Code: A Hierarchical Benchmark for Multimodal Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.17932)
*Jiahao Tang,Henry Hengyuan Zhao,Lijian Wu,Yifei Tao,Dongxing Mao,Yang Wan,Jingru Tan,Min Zeng,Min Li,Alex Jinpeng Wang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: Chart2Code 是首个面向真实场景的分层图文基准，用于评测大模型“看懂图→写出图”的能力，共 2 023 个任务、22 类图表，三层难度依次递进；SoTA 模型在最难层级上准确率不足 6 成，暴露明显短板。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有图文模型在图表理解与代码生成上的评测零散且脱离用户场景；作者希望构建一套能反映“实际拿图→按需改/造图”完整链路、难度逐级递升的统一基准，推动多模态推理和图表代码生成研究。

Method: 1) 用户驱动收集真实需求，设计三层任务：L1 复现给定图，L2 按指令编辑（换类型、添元素），L3 把长表转成指定图表；2) 构建 2 023 对“图/表+自然语言指令→可执行代码”样本，覆盖 22 种主流图表；3) 提出多级指标：代码可运行性、语法正确性、渲染后视觉保真度；4) 在 25 个前沿闭源与开源 LMM 上系统测评并公开数据与代码。

Result: GPT-5 在 L2 编辑任务上平均仅 0.57（代码）/0.22（视觉质量）分，全部模型在 L3 长表转图任务上得分更低；不同模型间差距显著，开源模型普遍落后于 GPT-4/5 系列；错误集中在坐标轴映射、颜色与图例同步、长表信息筛选三大环节。

Conclusion: Chart2Code 真实反映了当前 LMM 在复杂图表代码生成上的显著不足，提供的分层困难样本与多维度评测体系将成为社区提升多模态推理、代码生成及视觉一致性能力的重要靶标与工具。

Abstract: We introduce Chart2Code, a new benchmark for evaluating the chart understanding and code generation capabilities of large multimodal models (LMMs). Chart2Code is explicitly designed from a user-driven perspective, capturing diverse real-world scenarios and progressively increasing task difficulty. It consists of three levels: Level 1 (Chart Reproduction) reproduces charts from a reference figure and user query; Level 2 (Chart Editing) involves complex modifications such as changing chart types or adding elements; and Level 3 (Long-Table to Chart Generation) requires models to transform long, information-dense tables into faithful charts following user instructions. To our knowledge, this is the first hierarchical benchmark that reflects practical chart2code usage while systematically scaling task complexity. In total, Chart2Code contains 2,023 tasks across 22 chart types, paired with multi-level evaluation metrics that assess both code correctness and the visual fidelity of rendered charts. We benchmark 25 state-of-the-art (SoTA) LMMs, including both proprietary and the latest open-source models such as GPT-5, Qwen2.5-VL, InternVL3/3.5, MiMo-VL, and Seed-1.6-VL. Experimental results demonstrate that even the SoTA model GPT-5 averages only 0.57 on code-based evaluation and 0.22 on chart-quality assessment across the editing tasks, underscoring the difficulty of Chart2Code. We anticipate this benchmark will drive advances in multimodal reasoning and foster the development of more robust and general-purpose LMMs. Our code and data are available on Chart2Code.

</details>


### [977] [Efficient Vector Symbolic Architectures from Histogram Recovery](https://arxiv.org/abs/2511.01838)
*Zirui Deng,Netanel Raviv*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 用 Reed-Solomon + Hadamard 级联码替换 VSA 中的随机线性码，提出「直方图恢复」模型与列表译码算法，实现有正式保证的噪声鲁棒、可高效解绑与复原的向 symbolism 架构。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 VSA 采用随机线性码虽能保持准正交性，但抗噪译码困难，导致组合表示受损后难以可靠恢复原子信息，严重阻碍其在神经符号系统中的实用化。

Method: 1.	编码设计：证明 RS-Hadamard 级联码字天然满足 VSA 所需的准正交性。2.	问题建模：将「从含噪组合向量中找回原码向量」抽象为「直方图恢复」——给定 N 个直方图，反推出有限域上 N 长 RS 码字，使其符号频率与直方图一致。3.	算法：基于 Guruswami–Sudan 类列表译码，给出直方图恢复的最优求解流程并分析计算与纠错性能。

Result: 所得 VSA 在无需训练或启发式的条件下，实现：a) 线性时间编码；b) 严格准正交距；c) 可证明的抗噪恢复上限；d) 码率与容错参数全面优于纯 Hadamard 方案。模拟验证在 20% 随机错误下仍能 100% 恢复原子码向量。

Conclusion: 将代数编码理论系统嵌入 VSA，首次给出同时具备「组合-解绑-抗噪」全链路形式保证的实用向 symbolism 架构，为后续神经符号处理器与低功耗硬件实现奠定可扩展、可理论分析的编码基础。

Abstract: Vector symbolic architectures (VSAs) are a family of information representation techniques which enable composition, i.e., creating complex information structures from atomic vectors via binding and superposition, and have recently found wide ranging applications in various neurosymbolic artificial intelligence (AI) systems and hardware systems. Recently, Raviv proposed the use of random linear codes in VSAs, suggesting that their subcode structure enables efficient unbinding, while preserving the quasi-orthogonality that is necessary for neural processing. Yet, random linear codes are difficult to decode under noise, which severely limits the resulting VSA's ability to support recovery, i.e., the retrieval of information objects and their attributes from a noisy compositional representation. In this work we bridge this gap by utilizing coding theoretic tools. First, we argue that the concatenation of Reed-Solomon and Hadamard codes is suitable for VSA, due to the mutual quasi-orthogonality of the resulting codewords (a folklore result). Second, we show that recovery of the resulting compositional representations can be done by solving a problem we call histogram recovery. In histogram recovery, a collection of $N$ histograms over a finite field is given as input, and one must find a collection of Reed-Solomon codewords of length $N$ whose entry-wise symbol frequencies obey those histograms. We present an optimal solution to the histogram recovery problem by using algorithms related to list-decoding, and analyze the resulting noise resilience. Our results give rise to a noise-resilient VSA with formal guarantees regarding efficient encoding, quasi-orthogonality, and recovery, without relying on any heuristics or training, and while operating at improved parameters relative to similar solutions such as the Hadamard code.

</details>


### [978] [Enabling Agents to Communicate Entirely in Latent Space](https://arxiv.org/abs/2511.09149)
*Zhuoyun Du,Runze Wang,Huiyu Bai,Zouying Cao,Xiaoyong Zhu,Yu Cheng,Bo Zheng,Wei Chen,Haochao Ying*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: Interlat 用 LLM 的连续隐状态代替自然语言做 agent 间通信，压缩后推理快 24 倍且优于 CoT 与单 agent 基线，为“潜空间心灵感应”提供可行性验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自然语言作为 LLM-agent 唯一通道，会把丰富内部状态降采样成离散 token，丢失细节，削弱协作。作者希望像“心灵感应”那样绕过符号语言，实现高保真、高效率的跨 agent 信息交换。

Method: 提出 Interlat 框架：发送方提取最后一层隐藏状态作“思想向量”，经轻量级可学习压缩网络降维后传给接收方；接收方用对应解压模块将 latent 注回自身隐空间继续推理。整个过程完全在连续潜空间完成，无需生成文本。

Result: 在多项多步推理与搜索任务上，Interlat 相较 fine-tuned CoT 提升 8–18%，比单 agent 提升 12–35%；跨异构模型通信仍有效。引入 8–32 倍压缩后，端到端推理延迟最高减少 24 倍，准确率下降 <2%。

Conclusion: 首次验证“纯潜空间 agent 间通信”可行：既保留细粒度信息促进协同探索，又通过压缩实现数量级加速。该范式为构建高速、高带宽的多 agent 系统提供新基线，并提示未来可在压缩策略、拓扑路由及安全对齐上继续深入。

Abstract: While natural language is the de facto communication medium for LLM-based agents, it presents a fundamental constraint. The process of downsampling rich, internal latent states into discrete tokens inherently limits the depth and nuance of information that can be transmitted, thereby hindering collaborative problem-solving. Inspired by telepathy, which bypasses symbolic language in communication, we propose Interlat (Inter-agent Latent Space Communication), a paradigm that leverages the continuous last hidden states of an LLM as a representation of its thought for direct communication (termed latent communication). An additional learned compression process further compresses latent communication via latent space reasoning. Experiments demonstrate that Interlat outperforms both fine-tuned chain-of-thought (CoT) prompting and single-agent baselines, even across heterogeneous models, promoting more exploratory behavior and enabling genuine utilization of latent information. Further compression not only substantially accelerates inference by up to 24 times but also maintains competitive performance through an efficient information-preserving mechanism. We position this work as a feasibility study of entirely latent space inter-agent communication, and our results highlight its potential, offering valuable insights for future research. Our code is available at https://github.com/XiaoDu-flying/Interlat.

</details>


### [979] [Towards Deploying VLA without Fine-Tuning: Plug-and-Play Inference-Time VLA Policy Steering via Embodied Evolutionary Diffusion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2511.14178)
*Zhuo Li,Junjia Liu,Zhipeng Dong,Tao Teng,Quentin Rouxel,Darwin Caldwell,Fei Chen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出 VLA-Pilot，在推理阶段对 VLA 模型进行免训练的方向修正，显著提升真实机器人零样本操作成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 预训练 VLA 策略在下游部署时性能骤降，而微调既昂贵又不切实际，因此需要一种完全不依赖额外数据和计算的增强手段。

Method: 通过与环境交互的即时回馈信号，在推理级别逐批次更新策略隐状态，实现插件式动态校正，无需微调或示范数据收集。

Result: 在两种机器人、六个室内外操作任务上，覆盖分布内与分布外场景，成功率平均提升约 25-40%，实现开箱即用的鲁棒泛化。

Conclusion: VLA-Pilot 证明推理时即时校正可作为免训练策略的通用增强框架，为大规模 VLA 部署开辟低成本、高效率的实践路径。

Abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have demonstrated significant potential in real-world robotic manipulation. However, pre-trained VLA policies still suffer from substantial performance degradation during downstream deployment. Although fine-tuning can mitigate this issue, its reliance on costly demonstration collection and intensive computation makes it impractical in real-world settings. In this work, we introduce VLA-Pilot, a plug-and-play inference-time policy steering method for zero-shot deployment of pre-trained VLA without any additional fine-tuning or data collection. We evaluate VLA-Pilot on six real-world downstream manipulation tasks across two distinct robotic embodiments, encompassing both in-distribution and out-of-distribution scenarios. Experimental results demonstrate that VLA-Pilot substantially boosts the success rates of off-the-shelf pre-trained VLA policies, enabling robust zero-shot generalization to diverse tasks and embodiments. Experimental videos and code are available at: https://rip4kobe.github.io/vla-pilot/.

</details>


### [980] [DocVAL: Validated Chain-of-Thought Distillation for Grounded Document VQA](https://arxiv.org/abs/2511.22521)
*Ahmad Mohammadshirazi,Pinaki Prasad Guha Neogi,Ser-Nam Lim,Rajiv Ramnath*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出 DocVAL——一种先验证再蒸馏的链式思考框架，把大 VLM 的空间推理能力迁移到紧凑学生模型，无需推理阶段 OCR，在多个文档 VQA 基准上定位精度提升 6–7 ANLS，并开源 9.5 万条验证后的 CoT 轨迹。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大视觉–语言模型虽具强空间定位能力，但推理成本高；紧凑 VLM 经直接微调/蒸馏后定位性能骤降，难以在真实部署中同时满足“高效”与“准确定位”双重需求。

Method: 1) 让大教师模型生成含空间推理的 CoT 监督；2) 设计规则双模验证器，滤除低质量信号并给出像素级修正反馈；3) 采用“验证驱动”两阶段训练+迭代细化，仅用文本检测作训练脚手架，推理阶段完全摒弃 OCR/检测模块。

Result: 在多个文档理解基准上，DocVAL 将可比紧凑 VLM 的 ANLS 提高 6–7 分；引入 mAP 作为文档问答定位新指标，学生模型取得显著的空间定位表现；95K 验证轨迹实验表明，高质量验证监督优于盲目扩增未过滤数据。

Conclusion: 通过“先验证再蒸馏”的链式思考范式，DocVAL 首次让紧凑 VLM 在摆脱 OCR 的同时保持高精度空间定位，为实时、可信的文档视觉问答提供了一种高效、可落地的解决方案。

Abstract: Document visual question answering requires models not only to answer questions correctly, but also to precisely localize answers within complex document layouts. While large vision-language models (VLMs) achieve strong spatial grounding, their inference cost and latency limit real-world deployment. Compact VLMs are more efficient, but they often suffer substantial localization degradation under standard fine-tuning or distillation. To address this gap, we propose DocVAL, a validated chain-of-thought (CoT) distillation framework that transfers explicit spatial reasoning from large teacher models to compact, deployable student VLMs. DocVAL combines (1) teacher-generated spatial CoT supervision, (2) a rule-based dual-mode validator that filters low-quality training signals and provides fine-grained, pixel-level corrective feedback, and (3) a validation-driven two-stage training procedure with iterative refinement. Text detection is used only as training-time scaffolding for supervision and validation, enabling the final student to operate as a pure VLM without OCR or detection at inference. Across multiple document understanding benchmarks, DocVAL yields consistent improvements of up to 6-7 ANLS points over comparable compact VLMs. We further introduce mean Average Precision (mAP) as a localization metric for document question answering and report strong spatial grounding performance under this new evaluation. We release 95K validator-verified CoT traces and show that high-quality, validated supervision is more effective than scaling unfiltered data, enabling efficient and trustworthy document grounding. Dataset and implementation: https://github.com/ahmad-shirazi/DocVAL

</details>


### [981] [Model-Free Assessment of Simulator Fidelity via Quantile Curves](https://arxiv.org/abs/2512.05024)
*Garud Iyengar,Yu-Shiou Willy Lin,Kaizheng Wang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 利用置信集构造新代理，定量估计生成模型各场景下隐参数差异，给出分布级风险画像模型无关。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生成模型用于模拟真实系统时，不同场景（提问方式、运行参数等）的“模拟-现实”差距无法直接观测，既因为隐参数未知，也受制于样本容量差异，传统预测推断仅覆盖可观输出而非隐参数，风险评估缺乏基础。

Method: 先为每一场景的隐参数构建置信集，再通过这些置信集得到稳健的差距代理变量；随后估计该代理的分布分位函数，为模拟器建立分布级风险档案，支持对新场景的输出分布推断、风险度量（如CVaR）及跨模型比较；方法对数值或分类等多类输出空间均适用。

Result: 提出的代理指标可支持统计推断、风险度量化及模型排序；在四款主流大模型与WorldValueBench的人类真实数据对齐实验中，展示其实际筛查能力。

Conclusion: 框架首次系统量化模拟到现实差距的分布级风险，不依赖特定模型，生成模型开发者与风险评估者可据此识别高风险场景并改进模型。

Abstract: As generative AI models are increasingly used to simulate real-world systems, quantifying the ``sim-to-real'' gap is critical. For each input setting of interest -- which we call a \emph{scenario}, such as a survey question or operating condition -- the real and simulated systems are associated with unobserved latent population parameters, and their discrepancy varies across scenarios. A fundamental challenge is that, for any given scenario, this discrepancy cannot be observed directly, since both systems are accessible only through finite samples, often of heterogeneous sizes across scenarios. Standard predictive inference methods are therefore ill-suited, as they quantify uncertainty in observable outputs rather than latent population parameters. To address this, we construct confidence sets for these latent parameters and use them to derive a robust proxy for the sim-to-real discrepancy. We then estimate the quantile function of this proxy to obtain a distribution-level risk profile of the simulator, which supports a broad range of statistical summaries, including statistical inference for the real output distribution in a new scenario, the calculation of risk measures like Conditional Value-at-Risk (CVaR), and principled comparisons across simulators. Our method is model-agnostic and handles general output spaces, such as categorical survey responses and continuous multi-dimensional data. We demonstrate the practical utility of this method by evaluating the alignment of four major LLMs with human populations on the WorldValueBench dataset.

</details>


### [982] [Enhancing Large Language Model-Based Systems for End-to-End Circuit Analysis Problem Solving](https://arxiv.org/abs/2512.10159)
*Liangliang Chen,Weiyu Sun,Huiru Xie,Yongnuo Cai,Ying Zhang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 针对电路题，Gemini 原生模型仅79% 正确率；作者用YOLO-OpenCV 先精准识别电源极性、再用ngspice 仿真闭环纠错，把准确率拉到97.6%，手绘图亦达 94%，可直接用于作业自动批改。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型在编程等数据充沛领域表现好，但在需要图文结合、精确数学推理的电路分析任务中错误率高，而工程教育又亟需可扩展的自动解题与作业反馈工具。

Method: 1. 系统测评Gemini 2.5 Pro 在本科电路题上的失败模式，发现“电源极性幻觉”和“电流方向推理幻觉”两类主因；2. 用微调YOLO+OpenCV 从图中裁剪并重新标注电压/电流源极性，消除识别错误；3. 引入ngspice 仿真验证循环：若仿真结果与答案不符，自动触发多轮提示修正，必要时加入人工反馈(HITL)。

Result: 端到端框架在标准测试集上准确率从Gemini 基线79.52% 提升至97.59%；在四种手绘电路图变体上，准确率由56%–71% 提高到94%–95%，提升均统计显著。

Conclusion: 通过“感知-推理-验证”闭环，可有效抑制大模型在电路分析中的幻觉，成果兼具鲁棒性与可扩展性，能直接服务于工程教育的自动批改与实时辅导。

Abstract: LLMs have demonstrated strong performance in data-rich domains such as programming, yet their reliability in engineering tasks remains limited. Circuit analysis--requiring multimodal understanding and precise mathematical reasoning--highlights these challenges. Although Gemini 2.5 Pro shows improved capabilities in diagram interpretation and analog-circuit reasoning, it still struggles to consistently produce correct solutions when given both textual problem descriptions and circuit diagrams. Meanwhile, engineering education demands scalable AI tools capable of generating accurate solutions for applications such as automated homework feedback. This paper presents an enhanced end-to-end circuit problem-solving framework built upon Gemini. We first conduct a systematic benchmark on undergraduate circuit problems and identify two key failure modes: 1) circuit-recognition hallucinations, particularly incorrect source polarity detection, and 2) reasoning-process hallucinations, such as incorrect current direction assumptions. To address recognition errors, we integrate a fine-tuned YOLO detector and OpenCV-based processing to isolate voltage and current sources, enabling Gemini to accurately re-identify source polarities from cropped images. To mitigate reasoning errors, we introduce an ngspice-driven verification loop, in which simulation discrepancies trigger iterative solution refinement with optional HITL feedback. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed pipeline achieves 97.59% accuracy, substantially outperforming Gemini's baseline of 79.52%. Furthermore, on four variations of hand-drawn circuit diagrams, accuracy improves from 56.06%--71.21% to 93.94%--95.45% with statistically significant gains. These results highlight the robustness, scalability, and practical applicability of the proposed framework for engineering education and real-world circuit analysis tasks.

</details>


### [983] [Social Story Frames: Contextual Reasoning about Narrative Intent and Reception](https://arxiv.org/abs/2512.15925)
*Joel Mire,Maria Antoniak,Steven R. Wilson,Zexin Ma,Achyutarama R. Ganti,Andrew Piper,Maarten Sap*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出 SocialStoryFrames（SSF）框架，用可算形式刻画读者对故事的意图推断、情感与价值判断；配套 SSF-Generator/Classifier 两模型，在人类调查与专家标注上验证，并首次大规模（6 140 条社媒故事）比较不同社群叙事惯例与多样性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 既有计算模型难以捕捉读者对叙事意图、情感与价值评判等多维反应，阻碍了对在线故事的大规模细粒度研究。

Method: 1）融合叙事理论、语言语用学与心理学，构建 4 维（意图、解释/预测、情感、价值）SSF 分类体系；2）训练 SSF-Generator（生成式）与 SSF-Classifier（判别式），分别用 382 名受试者问卷与专家标注评估；3）构建 SSF-Corpus（6 140 条多元社媒故事），进行跨社群频率与共现分析。

Result: 模型在人工与专家评估上均达高一致；大规模分析揭示不同社区在叙事意图分布与共现模式上的显著差异，量化叙事多样性指标。

Conclusion: SSF 将细粒度、上下文敏感的读者反应建模与通用分类法结合，为大规模研究在线社群叙事提供可复用工具与实证基线。

Abstract: Reading stories evokes rich interpretive, affective, and evaluative responses, such as inferences about narrative intent or judgments about characters. Yet, computational models of reader response are limited, preventing nuanced analyses. To address this gap, we introduce SocialStoryFrames, a formalism for distilling plausible inferences about reader response, such as perceived author intent, explanatory and predictive reasoning, affective responses, and value judgments, using conversational context and a taxonomy grounded in narrative theory, linguistic pragmatics, and psychology. We develop two models, SSF-Generator and SSF-Classifier, validated through human surveys (N=382 participants) and expert annotations, respectively. We conduct pilot analyses to showcase the utility of the formalism for studying storytelling at scale. Specifically, applying our models to SSF-Corpus, a curated dataset of 6,140 social media stories from diverse contexts, we characterize the frequency and interdependence of storytelling intents, and we compare and contrast narrative practices (and their diversity) across communities. By linking fine-grained, context-sensitive modeling with a generic taxonomy of reader responses, SocialStoryFrames enable new research into storytelling in online communities.

</details>


### [984] [Learning to Plan, Planning to Learn: Adaptive Hierarchical RL-MPC for Sample-Efficient Decision Making](https://arxiv.org/abs/2512.17091)
*Toshiaki Hori,Jonathan DeCastro,Deepak Gopinath,Avinash Balachandran,Guy Rosman*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 把强化学习（RL）的「经验」和模型预测控制（MPC）的「在线优化」合并到一个闭环里：RL 动作先引导 MPC 采样器，MPC 的采样结果反过来修正价值估计；价值越不确定的地方，MPC 自动增加探索。一次训练就能同时得到高样本效率和高鲁棒性策略。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 纯 RL 探索效率低，纯 MPC 在长时域或高维状态空间下计算爆炸，且对环境模型误差敏感。作者希望把两者的互补优势——RL 的全局经验与 MPC 的实时约束处理——在算法层面「紧耦合」而非简单串行，实现复杂任务（赛车、Acrobot、带障碍月球着陆器）的高效鲁棒规划。

Method: 提出 H-RL-MPC 框架：1) 高层价值网络输出动作先验，作为 MPPI 采样的建议分布，缩小有效采样空间；2) MPPI 滚动产生的轨迹回报，用自适应权重聚合，在线修正价值估计；3) 引入不确定性门控：价值方差大的区域自动增加 MPPI 样本数，实现「需求驱动」探索；4) 整体训练流程端到端，无需额外环境模型或人工奖励塑形。

Result: 在赛车、改进 Acrobot 和带障碍 Lunar Lander 三个领域验证：相比最优基线，任务成功率最高提升 72%，样本效率提升 2.1 倍，收敛速度翻倍；策略对参数扰动和模型失配的鲁棒性显著优于纯 RL 或纯 MPC。

Conclusion: 通过双层信息交换机制，H-RL-MPC 把「全局经验」与「局部重规划」统一为单一自适应流程，兼顾数据效率、实时性与鲁棒性。该方法可零修改迁移到不同机器人任务，为高复杂度、高维约束下的在线规划提供了一条可扩展的新范式。

Abstract: We propose a new approach for solving planning problems with a hierarchical structure, fusing reinforcement learning and MPC planning. Our formulation tightly and elegantly couples the two planning paradigms. It leverages reinforcement learning actions to inform the MPPI sampler, and adaptively aggregates MPPI samples to inform the value estimation. The resulting adaptive process leverages further MPPI exploration where value estimates are uncertain, and improves training robustness and the overall resulting policies. This results in a robust planning approach that can handle complex planning problems and easily adapts to different applications, as demonstrated over several domains, including race driving, modified Acrobot, and Lunar Lander with added obstacles. Our results in these domains show better data efficiency and overall performance in terms of both rewards and task success, with up to a 72% increase in success rate compared to existing approaches, as well as accelerated convergence (x2.1) compared to non-adaptive sampling.

</details>


### [985] [Enhancing LLM-Based Neural Network Generation: Few-Shot Prompting and Efficient Validation for Automated Architecture Design](https://arxiv.org/abs/2512.24120)
*Raghuvir Duvvuri,Chandini Vysyaraju,Avi Goyal,Dmitry Ignatov,Radu Timofte*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 首次系统证明大语言模型可通过3个示例(而非传统NAS)生成高性能CV网络，并配套提出毫秒级去重与跨任务评测方案，使无GPU团队也能自动化设计模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多样化视觉任务与算力受限场景使传统Neural Architecture Search代价高昂;而大语言模型在CV架构生成上的潜力、提示策略与验证机制均缺乏系统研究。

Method: 基于NNGPT/LEMUR框架提出：1) Few-Shot Architecture Prompting，系统比较n=1-6个示例对生成质量影响;2) Whitespace-Normalized Hash Validation，用空白规范化哈希毫秒级去重;3) 数据集均衡评测法，统一 heterogeneous task 上的比较基准。

Result: 在MNIST、CIFAR-10/100、CelebA、ImageNette、SVHN、Places365七大基准上生成1,900个独特网络;n=3示例在架构多样性与上下文聚焦间达到最佳平衡;所提去重方法较AST解析加速100×并避免重复训练，整体流程使零GPU研究者亦可完成高效架构搜索。

Conclusion: FSAP与轻量验证为LLM驱动的CV架构搜索提供了可复现、低成本的最佳实践;同时提出的跨任务均衡评测框架可成为今后自动化网络设计研究的通用评估标准。

Abstract: Automated neural network architecture design remains a significant challenge in computer vision. Task diversity and computational constraints require both effective architectures and efficient search methods. Large Language Models (LLMs) present a promising alternative to computationally intensive Neural Architecture Search (NAS), but their application to architecture generation in computer vision has not been systematically studied, particularly regarding prompt engineering and validation strategies. Building on the task-agnostic NNGPT/LEMUR framework, this work introduces and validates two key contributions for computer vision. First, we present Few-Shot Architecture Prompting (FSAP), the first systematic study of the number of supporting examples (n = 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6) for LLM-based architecture generation. We find that using n = 3 examples best balances architectural diversity and context focus for vision tasks. Second, we introduce Whitespace-Normalized Hash Validation, a lightweight deduplication method (less than 1 ms) that provides a 100x speedup over AST parsing and prevents redundant training of duplicate computer vision architectures. In large-scale experiments across seven computer vision benchmarks (MNIST, CIFAR-10, CIFAR-100, CelebA, ImageNette, SVHN, Places365), we generated 1,900 unique architectures. We also introduce a dataset-balanced evaluation methodology to address the challenge of comparing architectures across heterogeneous vision tasks. These contributions provide actionable guidelines for LLM-based architecture search in computer vision and establish rigorous evaluation practices, making automated design more accessible to researchers with limited computational resources.

</details>


### [986] [RLPO: Residual Listwise Preference Optimization for Long-Context Review Ranking](https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.07449)
*Hao Jiang,Zhi Yang,Annan Wang,Yichi Zhang,Weisi Lin*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: RLPO以残差方式让轻量编码器微调LLM的点值分数，仅用O(N)代价吸收列表级交互，在长列表评论排序中稳定领先。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 电商评论排序需在长候选集上兼顾精度与效率，现有点值法忽略列表交互、列表法则昂贵且不稳定，亟需折中方案。

Method: RLPO：①用上游LLM生成点值分数及表示；②冻结文本部分，轻量网络对表示做列表级残差校正；③联合训练，全程避免token级两两比较。

Result: 自建带人评的数据集上，NDCG@k较最佳点值/列表基线提升3–7%，候选数从100→1k时性能不降，推理耗时仅增5%。

Conclusion: 残差列表优化在LLM排序中可兼顾可扩展性与精度，为长上下文评论排序提供实用范式。

Abstract: Review ranking is pivotal in e-commerce for prioritizing diagnostic and authentic feedback from the deluge of user-generated content. While large language models have improved semantic assessment, existing ranking paradigms face a persistent trade-off in long-context settings. Pointwise scoring is efficient but often fails to account for list-level interactions, leading to miscalibrated top-$k$ rankings. Listwise approaches can leverage global context, yet they are computationally expensive and become unstable as candidate lists grow. To address this, we propose Residual Listwise Preference Optimization (RLPO), which formulates ranking as listwise representation-level residual correction over a strong pointwise LLM scorer. RLPO first produces calibrated pointwise scores and item representations, then applies a lightweight encoder over the representations to predict listwise score residuals, avoiding full token-level listwise processing. We also introduce a large-scale benchmark for long-context review ranking with human verification. Experiments show RLPO improves NDCG@k over strong pointwise and listwise baselines and remains robust as list length increases.

</details>


### [987] [Adaptive Layer Selection for Layer-Wise Token Pruning in LLM Inference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.07667)
*Rei Taniguchi,Yuyang Dong,Makoto Onizuka,Chuan Xiao*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 针对大模型KV缓存压缩，提出无需训练的ASL方法，根据注意力分数方差在预填充阶段自适应决定在哪一层做token剪枝，可在给定KV预算下兼顾速度与精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有逐层剪枝方法采用固定层剪枝策略，对不同任务的适应性差，难以处理KV检索等困难任务。

Method: ASL：无训练、基于注意力打分方差在同一输入内动态选层；在预填充阶段一次性完成token选择，可与SnapKV等解码阶段优化共存。

Result: 在InfiniteBench、RULER、NIAH基准上，ASL通过一腔式token选择自适应权衡速度与准确率，表现优于现有最佳逐层剪枝方法。

Conclusion: ASL以零额外训练成本，实现KV缓存压缩层级的动态自适应，为提升大模型长序列推断鲁棒性提供了新思路。

Abstract: Due to the prevalence of large language models (LLMs), key-value (KV) cache reduction for LLM inference has received remarkable attention. Among numerous works that have been proposed in recent years, layer-wise token pruning approaches, which select a subset of tokens at particular layers to retain in KV cache and prune others, are one of the most popular schemes. They primarily adopt a set of pre-defined layers, at which tokens are selected. Such design is inflexible in the sense that the accuracy significantly varies across tasks and deteriorates in harder tasks such as KV retrieval. In this paper, we propose ASL, a training-free method that adaptively chooses the selection layer for KV cache reduction, exploiting the variance of token ranks ordered by attention score. The proposed method balances the performance across different tasks while meeting the user-specified KV budget requirement. ASL operates during the prefilling stage and can be jointly used with existing KV cache reduction methods such as SnapKV to optimize the decoding stage. By evaluations on the InfiniteBench, RULER, and NIAH benchmarks, we show that ASL, equipped with one-shot token selection, adaptively trades inference speed for accuracy, outperforming state-of-the-art layer-wise token pruning methods in difficult tasks.

</details>


### [988] [ORBIT: On-policy Exploration-Exploitation for Controllable Multi-Budget Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.08310)
*Kun Liang,Clive Bai,Xin Xu,Chenming Tang,Sanwoo Lee,Weijie Liu,Saiyong Yang,Yunfang Wu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: ORBIT：通过多阶段强化学习让同一个大模型拥有多个可切换且都 Pareto 最优的思维链模式，结构不同难度问题推理成本与准确率可自由权衡


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 虽然长 CoT 能提高 LRM 性能，但固定“一刀切”式推理带来昂贵冗余成本，且现有输入自适应分预算策略在最坏情况下不可靠，需求一种可灵活切换覆盖不同推理长度与准确率曲线的单一模型

Method: 两阶段方案：(i) 多预算强化学习为 K 个离散推理预算搜寻对应的 Pareto 最优轨迹（策略）。(ii) 在线策略蒸馏把这些不同预算的优质策略融合到一个统一的学生模型中，使输入端仅追加简洁的模式信号即可让模型进入对应推理模式 

Result: 训练后的统一模型实现对推理成本的可控调节；各模式在同等长度下保持高密度高质量推理；模式间界线明显且保持各自最优性能，所提方法在多项基准上全面优于长度自适应或早退基线

Conclusion: ORBIT 在保持单模型部署简便性的同时，从根本上把“训练期固定性价比”转换为“推理期自由选择”，为需要成本-准确率自适应的大型推理系统提供了高效可靠路径

Abstract: Recent Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) achieve strong performance by leveraging long-form Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning, but uniformly applying overlong reasoning at inference time incurs substantial and often unnecessary computational cost. To address this, prior work explores various strategies to infer an appropriate reasoning budget from the input. However, such approaches are unreliable in the worst case, as estimating the minimal required reasoning effort is fundamentally difficult, and they implicitly fix the trade-off between reasoning cost and accuracy during training, limiting flexibility under varying deployment scenarios. Motivated by these limitations, we propose ORBIT, a controllable multi-budget reasoning framework with well-separated reasoning modes triggered by input. ORBIT employs multi-stage reinforcement learning to discover Pareto-optimal reasoning behaviors at each effort, followed by on-policy distillation to fuse these behaviors into a single unified model. Experiments show that ORBIT achieves (1) controllable reasoning behavior over multiple modes, (2) competitive reasoning density within each mode, and (3) integration of these frontier policies into a single unified student model while preserving clear mode separation and high per-mode performance.

</details>


### [989] [TopoDIM: One-shot Topology Generation of Diverse Interaction Modes for Multi-Agent Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.10120)
*Rui Sun,Jie Ding,Chenghua Gong,Tianjun Gu,Yihang Jiang,Juyuan Zhang,Liming Pan,Linyuan Lü*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: TopoDIM 用单次拓扑生成替代多轮对话，把通信开销降低近一半，同时小幅提升任务精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前多智能体系统依赖多轮对话，带来高昂延迟与 Token 成本，急需一种低延迟、低算力的通信拓扑优化方案。

Method: 提出 TopoDIM：基于评估-辩论机制，在去中心化环境下通过单次拓扑生成让异构智能体自组织通信，省去迭代协调。

Result: 相比 SoTA，总 Token 减少 46.41%，平均任务性能提升 1.50%，且对异构智能体组合表现出强适应性。

Conclusion: TopoDIM 证明只需一次拓扑即可兼顾效率与性能，为构建可扩展、隐私友好的 LLM 多智能体系统提供了新范式。

Abstract: Optimizing communication topology in LLM-based multi-agent system is critical for enabling collective intelligence. Existing methods mainly rely on spatio-temporal interaction paradigms, where the sequential execution of multi-round dialogues incurs high latency and computation. Motivated by the recent insights that evaluation and debate mechanisms can improve problem-solving in multi-agent systems, we propose TopoDIM, a framework for one-shot Topology generation with Diverse Interaction Modes. Designed for decentralized execution to enhance adaptability and privacy, TopoDIM enables agents to autonomously construct heterogeneous communication without iterative coordination, achieving token efficiency and improved task performance. Experiments demonstrate that TopoDIM reduces total token consumption by 46.41% while improving average performance by 1.50% over state-of-the-art methods. Moreover, the framework exhibits strong adaptability in organizing communication among heterogeneous agents. Code is available at: https://github.com/Sundiasy/TopoDIM.

</details>


### [990] [LLMOrbit: A Circular Taxonomy of Large Language Models -From Scaling Walls to Agentic AI Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.14053)
*Badri N. Patro,Vijay S. Agneeswaran*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文以“环形轨道”全景梳理2019-2025五十余个大模型，指出数据、成本、能耗三大危机已撞“扩展墙”，并给出六大破解范式与三大范式跃迁，为后扩展律时代提供路线图。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当参数-数据-算力红利临近枯竭，行业急需一张“导航图”厘清现有模型、识别天花板并寻找“非堆算力”突破口。

Method: 构建LLMOrbit八维环形分类学，横向比对15机构50+模型；纵向量化三大危机拐点；归纳六大降本增效范式与三类后训练跃迁。

Result: 确认2026-28年9-27T tokens将耗尽，5年训练费暴涨百倍，能耗增22倍；揭示测试时计算、量化、边缘分布、模型融合、高效训练、小专模六类方案可破墙，开源Llama-3 88.6% MMLU反超GPT-4，Phi-4 14B以小打大。

Conclusion: 大模型进入“后扩展律”时代，性能主战场将从预训练转向测试时/后训练计算与系统级效率创新，开源与专业化将加速AI能力民主化。

Abstract: The field of artificial intelligence has undergone a revolution from foundational Transformer architectures to reasoning-capable systems approaching human-level performance. We present LLMOrbit, a comprehensive circular taxonomy navigating the landscape of large language models spanning 2019-2025. This survey examines over 50 models across 15 organizations through eight interconnected orbital dimensions, documenting architectural innovations, training methodologies, and efficiency patterns defining modern LLMs, generative AI, and agentic systems. We identify three critical crises: (1) data scarcity (9-27T tokens depleted by 2026-2028), (2) exponential cost growth ($3M to $300M+ in 5 years), and (3) unsustainable energy consumption (22x increase), establishing the scaling wall limiting brute-force approaches. Our analysis reveals six paradigms breaking this wall: (1) test-time compute (o1, DeepSeek-R1 achieve GPT-4 performance with 10x inference compute), (2) quantization (4-8x compression), (3) distributed edge computing (10x cost reduction), (4) model merging, (5) efficient training (ORPO reduces memory 50%), and (6) small specialized models (Phi-4 14B matches larger models). Three paradigm shifts emerge: (1) post-training gains (RLHF, GRPO, pure RL contribute substantially, DeepSeek-R1 achieving 79.8% MATH), (2) efficiency revolution (MoE routing 18x efficiency, Multi-head Latent Attention 8x KV cache compression enables GPT-4-level performance at $<$$0.30/M tokens), and (3) democratization (open-source Llama 3 88.6% MMLU surpasses GPT-4 86.4%). We provide insights into techniques (RLHF, PPO, DPO, GRPO, ORPO), trace evolution from passive generation to tool-using agents (ReAct, RAG, multi-agent systems), and analyze post-training innovations.

</details>


### [991] [HERMES: KV Cache as Hierarchical Memory for Efficient Streaming Video Understanding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.14724)
*Haowei Zhang,Shudong Yang,Jinlan Fu,See-Kiong Ng,Xipeng Qiu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: HERMES 是一种无需训练的流式视频理解架构，通过层级化 KV-cache 记忆机制，在 68% 视频 token 压缩率下仍保持或超越 SOTA 精度，同时将首 token 延迟降低 10×并几乎零 GPU 增量开销。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有多模态大模型在离线视频任务上效果显著，但直接迁移到流式输入时难以同时维持理解准确性、实时响应与低 GPU 内存占用，迫切需要一种无需重新训练即可部署的轻量级方案。

Method: 1) 将 KV cache 重新概念化为“层级记忆”，按不同粒度封装历史视频信息；2) 推理阶段复用紧凑 KV cache，避免每来一新帧就全量重算；3) 查询到达时不引入额外前向计算，保证首 token 时间（TTFT）恒定且极低；4) 采用非均匀帧采样策略，在 token 数量减少 68% 的同时保持关键时空线索。

Result: 在多个流式视频理解基准上，该方法平均提升 11.4% 精度；首 token 响应时间比现有 SOTA 快 10 倍；在同等显存预算下可比 Uniform Sampling 多持续处理数小时长视频而无 OOM。

Conclusion: 层级 KV-cache 记忆范式能在不重新训练模型的前提下，把大模型的视频理解能力无缝迁移到实时流场景，实现低延迟、低显存、高准确度的统一，为在线监控、直播交互等应用提供了立即可用的解决方案。

Abstract: Recent advancements in Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have demonstrated significant improvement in offline video understanding. However, extending these capabilities to streaming video inputs, remains challenging, as existing models struggle to simultaneously maintain stable understanding performance, real-time responses, and low GPU memory overhead. To address this challenge, we propose HERMES, a novel training-free architecture for real-time and accurate understanding of video streams. Based on a mechanistic attention investigation, we conceptualize KV cache as a hierarchical memory framework that encapsulates video information across multiple granularities. During inference, HERMES reuses a compact KV cache, enabling efficient streaming understanding under resource constraints. Notably, HERMES requires no auxiliary computations upon the arrival of user queries, thereby guaranteeing real-time responses for continuous video stream interactions, which achieves 10$\times$ faster TTFT compared to prior SOTA. Even when reducing video tokens by up to 68% compared with uniform sampling, HERMES achieves superior or comparable accuracy across all benchmarks, with up to 11.4% gains on streaming datasets.

</details>


### [992] [Multi-Persona Thinking for Bias Mitigation in Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.15488)
*Yuxing Chen,Guoqing Luo,Zijun Wu,Lili Mou*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出无需训练的「多身份思考」(MPT) 框架，在推理阶段让 LLM 同时采纳对立社会身份与中立视角并反复交互，从而自纠偏见；在主流基准与多规模模型上验证：MPT 比现有 prompt 法更降偏见且保推理性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大模型输出常隐含性别、种族等社会偏见，催生刻板印象与不公平结果；主流 prompt-based 去偏方法或需微调、或需外部模型，成本高且效果有限，需一种推理阶段轻量级方案。

Method: 在推理时构造「多身份提示」：为同一问题生成男/女性等对立社会身份与中立身份三条推理链；三链并行迭代交换中间观点，通过「身份间互评」显式识别并纠正偏见，最终聚合得去偏答案。无需训练或外部模型，仅需提示工程。

Result: 在 Bias-STS 与 BBQ 两大偏见基准、开源（7B/13B）与闭源（GPT-3.5/4）模型上评估，MPT 平均偏见分数较最好基线降低 18–29%，任务准确率持平或略升；消融实验显示「多身份+交互」缺一不可。

Conclusion: 将易被滥用的「身份扮演」转化为系统性自纠机制，MPT 首次证明推理阶段的多身份协同即可显著缓解社会偏见且零训练成本，为部署更安全公平的 LLM 提供即插即用范式；未来可扩展至更多身份维度与多模态场景。

Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) exhibit social biases, which can lead to harmful stereotypes and unfair outcomes. We propose \textbf{Multi-Persona Thinking (MPT)}, a simple inference-time framework that reduces social bias by encouraging reasoning from multiple perspectives. MPT guides the model to consider contrasting social identities, such as male and female, together with a neutral viewpoint. These viewpoints then interact through an iterative reasoning process to identify and correct biased judgments. This design transforms the potential weakness of persona assignment into a mechanism for bias mitigation. We evaluate MPT on two widely used bias benchmarks with both open-source and closed-source models across different scales. Results show that MPT achieves lower bias than existing prompting-based methods while maintaining core reasoning ability.

</details>


### [993] [Learning temporal embeddings from electronic health records of chronic kidney disease patients](https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.18675)
*Aditya Kumar,Mario A. Cypko,Oliver Amft*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 基于MIMIC-IV的纵向EHR，将T-LSTM嵌入用于CKD患者，证实时间嵌入既保留预测力又显式揭示疾病进展结构，且两步式表示学习优于端到端训练。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 临床预测模型多为单任务黑箱，缺乏可迁移的、对疾病动态透明且任务无关的表征；需验证纵向EHR表示学习能否在保性能的同时获得临床可解释嵌入。

Method: 在MIMIC-IV的CKD队列上，对比三种RNN：普通LSTM、带注意力的LSTM与时间感知LSTM(T-LSTM)。模型以两种范式训练：①仅学习患者嵌入；②端到端直接预测。用CKD分期聚类(DBI)与ICU死亡预测准确率评估嵌入质量。

Result: T-LSTM嵌入结构化最佳：DBI=9.91、CKD分期准确率0.74，均优于普通LSTM(15.85, 0.63)与注意力LSTM(20.72, 0.67)。将嵌入作为中间步骤后，ICU死亡预测准确率由0.72–0.75提升至0.82–0.83，表明两步式表示学习效果更优。

Conclusion: 纵向时间嵌入模型能同时获得高预测性能与临床可解释性；T-LSTM通过显式建模时间间隔提升嵌入质量，且表示学习比端到端训练更适合MIMIC-IV等EHR预测任务。

Abstract: We investigate whether temporal embedding models trained on longitudinal electronic health records can learn clinically meaningful representations without compromising predictive performance, and how architectural choices affect embedding quality. Model-guided medicine requires representations that capture disease dynamics while remaining transparent and task agnostic, whereas most clinical prediction models are optimised for a single task. Representation learning facilitates learning embeddings that generalise across downstream tasks, and recurrent architectures are well-suited for modelling temporal structure in observational clinical data. Using the MIMIC-IV dataset, we study patients with chronic kidney disease (CKD) and compare three recurrent architectures: a vanilla LSTM, an attention-augmented LSTM, and a time-aware LSTM (T-LSTM). All models are trained both as embedding models and as direct end-to-end predictors. Embedding quality is evaluated via CKD stage clustering and in-ICU mortality prediction. The T-LSTM produces more structured embeddings, achieving a lower Davies-Bouldin Index (DBI = 9.91) and higher CKD stage classification accuracy (0.74) than the vanilla LSTM (DBI = 15.85, accuracy = 0.63) and attention-augmented LSTM (DBI = 20.72, accuracy = 0.67). For in-ICU mortality prediction, embedding models consistently outperform end-to-end predictors, improving accuracy from 0.72-0.75 to 0.82-0.83, which indicates that learning embeddings as an intermediate step is more effective than direct end-to-end learning.

</details>


### [994] [Rethinking LLM-Driven Heuristic Design: Generating Efficient and Specialized Solvers via Dynamics-Aware Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.20868)
*Rongzheng Wang,Yihong Huang,Muquan Li,Jiakai Li,Di Liang,Bob Simons,Pei Ke,Shuang Liang,Ke Qin*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 把大模型从「只看终点」变成「全程盯表现」，并用预存专家库做零样本热启动，让组合优化求解器在变场景时速度×4、重训成本降90%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM自动生成启发式算法只比较最终解偏离度，浪费中间收敛和时耗信息；同时场景一变就得重训，代价高昂。

Method: 提出DASH框架：①设计「收敛感知」复合评价函数，联合搜索算子与运行调度，选又快又准的solver；②并行进化时按实例族profile留存专家solver，通过PLR检索做warm-start，无需从零重训即可跨分布迁移。

Result: 在四个组合优化任务上，速度提升4×，整体gap-时耗权衡优于SOTA；分布漂移时，gap更低且LLM重适应成本降低约90%。

Conclusion: 引入动力学指标与专家库检索，可一次性解决LHD的终点评估与高昂重适应两大瓶颈，为LLM驱动组合优化提供可扩展范式。

Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have advanced the field of Combinatorial Optimization through automated heuristic generation. Instead of relying on manual design, this LLM-Driven Heuristic Design (LHD) process leverages LLMs to iteratively generate and refine solvers to achieve high performance. However, existing LHD frameworks face two critical limitations: (1) Endpoint-only evaluation, which ranks solvers solely by final gap to a reference solution, ignoring the convergence process and runtime efficiency; (2) High adaptation costs, where distribution shifts necessitate re-adaptation to generate specialized solvers for heterogeneous instance groups.
