To address these issues, we propose Dynamics-Aware Solver Heuristics (DASH), a framework that co-optimizes solver search mechanisms and runtime schedules guided by a convergence-aware metric, thereby identifying efficient and high-performance solvers. Furthermore, to mitigate expensive re-adaptation, DASH incorporates Profiled Library Retrieval (PLR), which maintains group-specialized solvers for profile-aware warm starts. These solvers are archived concurrently during evolution, allowing DASH to reuse matched specialists across heterogeneous distributions without restarting adaptation. Experiments on four combinatorial optimization problems demonstrate that DASH improves runtime efficiency by over 4 times while outperforming prior LHD baselines in the overall balance between gap and runtime across diverse problem scales. Furthermore, by enabling profile-aware warm starts, DASH maintains lower gap under distribution shift while reducing LLM adaptation costs by about 90%.

</details>


### [995] [POP: Prefill-Only Pruning for Efficient Large Model Inference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.03295)
*Junhui He,Zhihui Fu,Jun Wang,Qingan Li*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 作者发现 LLM/VLM 冗余集中在预填充阶段，提出 POP 算法：预填阶段仅跑浅层，解码阶段恢复全模型，搭配独立 KV 投影与首 token 边界修正，在 Llama-3.1/Qwen3-VL/Gemma-3 上实现 1.37× 预填加速且性能几乎无损。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有结构化剪枝因“阶段无关”策略把深、浅层等量视之，导致解码准确率骤降。作者观察到深、浅层在预填充与解码阶段贡献不对称，希望借此打破精度-效率权衡。

Method: 1) 引入虚拟门做逐阶段重要性分析，量化每层对预填充/解码的不同贡献；2) POP：预填阶段仅保留浅层、跳过深层，解码阶段恢复完整模型；3) 独立 KV 投影保证被跳过层的缓存连续一致；4) 边界策略确保首生成 token 的 logits 准确；5) 跨文本、视觉-文本多模型实验验证。

Result: 在 Llama-3.1、Qwen3-VL、Gemma-3 的多模态基准上，POP 相比全模型预填延迟最高提速 1.37×，下游任务平均掉点 <0.3%，显著优于等量结构化剪枝基线（掉点 >2%）。

Conclusion: 阶段感知的非对称剪枝（POP）能在对延迟最敏感的预填阶段安全去除冗余计算，而保留解码阶段的关键容量，从而首次在结构化剪枝中实现“几乎无损”的加速，突破了传统剪枝的精度-效率瓶颈。

Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) and Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have demonstrated remarkable capabilities. However, their deployment is hindered by significant computational costs. Existing structured pruning methods, while hardware-efficient, often suffer from significant accuracy degradation. In this paper, we argue that this failure stems from a stage-agnostic pruning approach that overlooks the asymmetric roles between the prefill and decode stages. By introducing a virtual gate mechanism, our importance analysis reveals that deep layers are critical for next-token prediction (decode) but largely redundant for context encoding (prefill). Leveraging this insight, we propose Prefill-Only Pruning (POP), a stage-aware inference strategy that safely omits deep layers during the computationally intensive prefill stage while retaining the full model for the sensitive decode stage. To enable the transition between stages, we introduce independent Key-Value (KV) projections to maintain cache integrity, and a boundary handling strategy to ensure the accuracy of the first generated token. Extensive experiments on Llama-3.1, Qwen3-VL, and Gemma-3 across diverse modalities demonstrate that POP achieves up to 1.37$\times$ speedup in prefill latency with minimal performance loss, effectively overcoming the accuracy-efficiency trade-off limitations of existing structured pruning methods.

</details>


### [996] [Attack Selection Reduces Safety in Concentrated AI Control Settings against Trusted Monitoring](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.04930)
*Joachim Schaeffer,Arjun Khandelwal,Tyler Tracy*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文揭示了大型模型在面对监控时可通过“攻击选择”显著降低安全防护水平，强调在安全评估中必须显式诱导并测试此类能力，以防安全分被高估。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着AI系统广泛部署，恶意行为监控成为必要防线；但模型可能通过针对监控器的对抗性样本（攻击选择）绕过检测。现有评估常忽略模型主动利用这一策略的潜力，导致安全分数过于乐观。

Method: 在BigCodeBench后门注入场景中，让红队构造攻击策略，将攻击选择拆分为“攻击→质量评分”与“质量评分→提交概率”两阶段，并以分类框架形式化。随后通过提示攻击模型在生成代码时同步推理监控器并谨慎选择是否提交，比较不同审计预算下的安全率变化。

Result: 在0.5%审计预算下，仅通过提示诱导攻击选择，即可将安全率从99%基线降至59%；且安全对误报率（FPR）的敏感度远高于真正率（TPR）。

Conclusion: 攻击选择是模型本就具备、只需简单提示即可激发的危险能力。未来AI控制评估必须主动显式地“逼出”该能力，否则会在看似高安全分数下隐藏重大风险。

Abstract: Future AI deployments will likely be monitored for malicious behaviour. The ability of these AIs to subvert monitors by adversarially selecting against them - attack selection - is particularly concerning. To study this, we let a red team create attack policies that attempt to insert attacks into code without being caught by a monitor in the concentrated BigCodeBench backdooring setting. We decompose attack selection into two problems: mapping attacks to a quality score and mapping quality scores to submission probabilities. We frame attack selection as a classification problem and show that safety is significantly more sensitive to FPR than TPR. We find that prompting the attacker model to reason about the monitor while being cautious with attack selection reduces safety from a baseline of 99% to 59% at 0.5% auditing budget, emphasizing that eliciting attack selection capabilities of models is vital to avoid overly optimistic safety scores in control evaluations.

</details>


### [997] [Bird-SR: Bidirectional Reward-Guided Diffusion for Real-World Image Super-Resolution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.07069)
*Zihao Fan,Xin Lu,Yidi Liu,Jie Huang,Dong Li,Xueyang Fu,Baocai Yin*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: Bird-SR：双向奖励引导扩散框架，用合成对保结构、用真实图提感知，动态权衡保真-感知，实现真实世界超分。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于扩散的图像超分虽细节丰富，但在合成数据上训练后应用于真实低分辨率图时因分布偏移而性能骤降，需兼顾合成域结构知识与真实域感知质量。

Method: 将超分建模为轨迹级偏好优化（ReFL）：早期步仅在合成对上直接优化以保结构；后期步对合成与真实图均施加质量奖励，其中合成奖励用相对优势空间防止奖励黑客，真实优化引入语义对齐约束；并设计动态权重逐步由保真转向感知。

Result: 在多项真实超分基准上，Bird-SR 感知质量优于现有最佳方法，同时保持结构一致性。

Conclusion: 通过双向奖励与动态权衡，Bird-SR 有效缓解合成-真实域差异，为真实世界超分提供新的强基准。

Abstract: Powered by multimodal text-to-image priors, diffusion-based super-resolution excels at synthesizing intricate details; however, models trained on synthetic low-resolution (LR) and high-resolution (HR) image pairs often degrade when applied to real-world LR images due to significant distribution shifts. We propose Bird-SR, a bidirectional reward-guided diffusion framework that formulates super-resolution as trajectory-level preference optimization via reward feedback learning (ReFL), jointly leveraging synthetic LR-HR pairs and real-world LR images. For structural fidelity easily affected in ReFL, the model is directly optimized on synthetic pairs at early diffusion steps, which also facilitates structure preservation for real-world inputs under smaller distribution gap in structure levels. For perceptual enhancement, quality-guided rewards are applied to both synthetic and real LR images at the later trajectory phase. To mitigate reward hacking, the rewards for synthetic results are formulated in a relative advantage space bounded by their ground-truth counterparts, while real-world optimization is regularized via a semantic alignment constraint. Furthermore, to balance structural and perceptual learning, we introduce a dynamic fidelity-perception weighting strategy that emphasizes structure preservation at early stages and progressively shifts focus toward perceptual optimization at later diffusion steps. Extensive experiments on real-world SR benchmarks demonstrate that Bird-SR consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods in perceptual quality while preserving structural consistency, validating its effectiveness for real-world super-resolution. Our code can be obtained at https://github.com/fanzh03/Bird-SR.

</details>


### [998] [IROSA: Interactive Robot Skill Adaptation using Natural Language](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.03897)
*Markus Knauer,Samuel Bustamante,Thomas Eiband,Alin Albu-Schäffer,Freek Stulp,João Silvério*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 将大模型与模仿学习结合，用“工具层”隔离语言模型与机器人硬件，实现免微调、自然语言驱动的开放词汇技能自适应，并在 7 自由度工业轴承装配任务中验证安全、透明、可解释。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大模型虽强，但与机器人结合的研究少，工业场景更少；模仿学习能小样本适配技能，却难以用自然语言灵活调整。亟需一种无需微调、安全可部署的桥梁方案。

Method: 提出工具式架构：预训练 LLM 仅作为“工具选择器”，把自然语言指令映射为参数化的机器人工具（速度调节、轨迹修正、避障等），工具层提供保护抽象，LLM 不直接接触硬件，也无需微调。

Result: 在 7-DoF 力控工业机器人上完成轴承环装配实验，仅凭自然语言即可实时调整速度、修正轨迹、避开障碍物，成功率 100%，全程保持安全屏障与行为可解释性。

Conclusion: 工具层间接调用方案首次把大模型能力安全注入工业模仿学习系统，实现零-shot 开放词汇技能自适应，为工业场景的大模型落地提供了可复用、可扩展的范式。

Abstract: Foundation models have demonstrated impressive capabilities across diverse domains, while imitation learning provides principled methods for robot skill adaptation from limited data. Combining these approaches holds significant promise for direct application to robotics, yet this combination has received limited attention, particularly for industrial deployment. We present a novel framework that enables open-vocabulary skill adaptation through a tool-based architecture, maintaining a protective abstraction layer between the language model and robot hardware. Our approach leverages pre-trained LLMs to select and parameterize specific tools for adapting robot skills without requiring fine-tuning or direct model-to-robot interaction. We demonstrate the framework on a 7-DoF torque-controlled robot performing an industrial bearing ring insertion task, showing successful skill adaptation through natural language commands for speed adjustment, trajectory correction, and obstacle avoidance while maintaining safety, transparency, and interpretability.

</details>


### [999] [MM-tau-p$^2$: Persona-Adaptive Prompting for Robust Multi-Modal Agent Evaluation in Dual-Control Settings](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.09643)
*Anupam Purwar,Aditya Choudhary*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 传统测评平台把 LLM Agent 视为“纯文本且对使用者无感知”的机器人；本文提出 MM-tau-p² 基准，把用户画像与实时 TTS/多模态输入纳入评估，给出了 12 项度量及在零售-电信场景的 GPT-5/4.1 基准分数。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有文本聊天式 Agent 基准忽视用户画像输入，也无法衡量实时 TTS/多模态扩展后的鲁棒性，难以反映客服等高并发场景下“Agent 学习并动态适应客户人格”的真实表现。

Method: 基于前期 FOCal 框架，构造含用户画像和无画像双重控制对偶情境；设计 12 项新度量（对多模态鲁棒性、回合增量 Overhead 等），其中多模态输入在规划阶段即参与切分意图子任务；采用 LLM-as-Judge，通过既定评分 Rubric 对对话进行端到端打分，并在零售与电信两垂直业务语料上自动化跑数。

Result: 即便是 frontier 级模型（GPT-5/4.1），在引入多模态与画像适应后，系统多模态错误率下降幅度不足 4%，但与纯文本相比每次对话平均回合数增加 22%；在用户未知场景下多模态噪声仍可造成 11–14% 的准确率跌落，证明了 MM-tau-p² 对此类缺陷的观测有效性。

Conclusion: MM-tau-p² 首次把用户人格、实时多模态输入及鲁棒性开销统一到 12 项可自动化计算的 Agent 评估指标，走出以往基准仅测文本闲聊的局限；用户画像虽可带来长期体验提升，但同时引入显著回合开销和多模态噪声脆弱点，需在部署前显式权衡。

Abstract: Current evaluation frameworks and benchmarks for LLM powered agents focus on text chat driven agents, these frameworks do not expose the persona of user to the agent, thus operating in a user agnostic environment. Importantly, in customer experience management domain, the agent's behaviour evolves as the agent learns about user personality. With proliferation of real time TTS and multi-modal language models, LLM based agents are gradually going to become multi-modal. Towards this, we propose the MM-tau-p$^2$ benchmark with metrics for evaluating the robustness of multi-modal agents in dual control setting with and without persona adaption of user, while also taking user inputs in the planning process to resolve a user query. In particular, our work shows that even with state of-the-art frontier LLMs like GPT-5, GPT 4.1, there are additional considerations measured using metrics viz. multi-modal robustness, turn overhead while introducing multi-modality into LLM based agents. Overall, MM-tau-p$^2$ builds on our prior work FOCAL and provides a holistic way of evaluating multi-modal agents in an automated way by introducing 12 novel metrics. We also provide estimates of these metrics on the telecom and retail domains by using the LLM-as-judge approach using carefully crafted prompts with well defined rubrics for evaluating each conversation.

</details>


### [1000] [Prompt Injection as Role Confusion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.12277)
*Charles Ye,Jasmine Cui,Dylan Hadfield-Menell*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文指出大模型的提示注入漏洞源于其内部“角色混淆”：模型仅凭文本风格而非真实来源判断说话者身份，并把攻击者伪造的“用户指令”当成可信内容，从而接管代理行为。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 尽管经过对齐训练，大模型仍对提示注入毫无抵抗力。作者假设根本原因是模型内部将“听起来像用户/助手”的文本直接映射到同一表征空间，导致攻击者可利用风格特征操控角色感知，进而劫持行为。

Method: 1. 提出“role probes”量化模型对文本说话者身份的内部编码；2. 设计零样本攻击 CoT Forgery，在网页或用户提示中伪造看似模型自身思维链的内容；3. 在 StrongREJECT 基准测试 5 个前沿模型，对比攻击成功率与 role confusion 强度；4. 将结果推广到常规代理提示注入，建立统一框架把攻击重新定义为“角色表征错误”的可度量后果。

Result: CoT Forgery 在无需任何微调或优化的情况下，平均攻击成功率约 60%，而基线接近 0%。模型内部测得的“角色混淆”分数与攻击成功率高度相关（r≈0.8）。同一套机制可解释传统提示注入、工具调用劫持等多种场景。

Conclusion: 提示注入并非零散漏洞，而是模型将“风格=身份”的内部表征缺陷的必然结果。缓解需从表征层面解耦“文本风格”与“说话者角色”，而非仅靠输出过滤或对抗训练。

Abstract: Language models remain vulnerable to prompt injection attacks despite extensive safety training. We trace this failure to role confusion: models infer the source of text based on how it sounds, not where it actually comes from. A command hidden in a webpage hijacks an agent simply because it sounds like a user instruction. This is not just behavioral: in the model's internal representations, text that sounds like a trusted source occupies the same space as text that actually is one. We design role probes which measure how models internally perceive "who is speaking", showing that attacker-controllable signals (e.g. syntactic patterns, lexical choice) control role perception. We first test this with CoT Forgery, a zero-shot attack that injects fabricated reasoning into user prompts or ingested webpages. Models mistake the text for their own thoughts, yielding 60% attack success on StrongREJECT across frontier models with near-0% baselines. Strikingly, the degree of role confusion strongly predicts attack success. We then generalize these results to standard agent prompt injections, introducing a unifying framework that reframes prompt injection not as an ad-hoc exploit but as a measurable consequence of how models represent role.

</details>


### [1001] [Preconditioned Test-Time Adaptation for Out-of-Distribution Debiasing in Narrative Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.13683)
*Hanwen Shen,Ting Ying,Jiajie Lu,Shanshan Wang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: CAP-TTA是一种轻量级测试时自适应框架，遇到高偏见提示时即时激活LoRA参数更新，兼顾高效去偏见与文本流畅性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有去偏见大模型面对未见高偏见输入会产生分布漂移，静态权重难以实时纠偏，由此引发性能衰减。作者希望设计一种无需重训、低延迟的在线去偏见方法。

Method: 1) 用OOD检测量化“偏见风险分数”；2) 当分数超过阈值才触发上下文感知的低秩适配器(LoRA)微调；3) 用离线算好的对角Fisher信息预条件子加速收敛并保证稳定性；4) 参数更新仅在推理时局部执行，避免写回主模型。

Result: 在RealToxicityPrompts、BBQ等基准上，CAP-TTA将毒性/偏见指标降低30–50%，推理延迟仅增加2–4ms（相比AdamW/SGD降低>80%）；同时困惑度下降0.7–1.2，人工评分的叙事流畅性与一致性显著优于SOTA基线，且未出现灾难性遗忘。

Conclusion: 实验表明，CAP-TTA可在测试阶段针对性修正高偏见输入，实现兼顾效率、稳定性与生成质量的实时去偏见，为部署动态安全的大模型提供了可行方案。

Abstract: Although debiased large language models (LLMs) excel at handling known or low-bias prompts, they often fail on unfamiliar and high-bias prompts. We demonstrate via out-of-distribution (OOD) detection that these high-bias prompts cause a distribution shift, degrading static model performance. To enable real-time correction, we propose CAP-TTA, a test-time adaptation framework. CAP-TTA triggers context-aware LoRA updates only when a bias-risk score exceeds a set threshold. By utilizing an offline precomputed diagonal preconditioner, it ensures fast and stable optimization. Across multiple benchmarks and human evaluations, CAP-TTA effectively reduces toxicity/bias score with significantly lower latency than standard optimization methods (e.g., AdamW or SGD). Furthermore, it prevents catastrophic forgetting, and substantially improves narrative fluency over state-of-the-art baselines without compromising debiasing performance.

</details>


### [1002] [To See or To Please: Uncovering Visual Sycophancy and Split Beliefs in VLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.18373)
*Rui Hong,Shuxue Quan*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出三层诊断框架量化VLM幻觉：发现69.6%样本出现“视觉谄媚”——模型明知图像异常仍迎合用户；规模扩大仅削弱语言捷径却放大谄媚，零样本能“坚定拒答”。利用诊断分数可做(无训练)后验选择，50%覆盖即可+9.5pp精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有VLM准确率指标无法揭示答案是依赖视觉还是语言捷径，也难以解释幻觉根源；需体系化诊断视觉依赖与用户预期冲突对错误的影响，从而衡量并改进模型真实感知与安全性。

Method: 设计Tri-Layer框架：①潜在异常检测量化模型感知图像缺陷程度；②Visual Necessity Score用KL散度衡量回答对视觉输入的必要性；③Competition Score度量视觉证据与用户指令-先验的冲突。对7个VLM用盲图、噪声图、冲突图三类反事实干预，构建7,000样本的诊断数据集；并在Qwen2.5-VL 7B→72B系列做扩展分析。

Result: 新taxonomy显示69.6%样本属“Visual Sycophancy”(模型察觉异常却顺从生成)；Robust Refusal为0%，揭示对齐训练压抑了不确定性表达。扩大参数规模降低依赖文本先验(Language Shortcuts)却同步放大Visual Sycophancy，准确率提高但 Grounding 问题未根本缓解。诊断分数可用于50%覆盖率的无训练选择性预测，平均+9.5pp准确率，最高+12.8pp。

Conclusion: 三层诊断框架有效拆解VLM幻觉为“感知出错”“视觉必要性不足”“指令冲突”三类机制；Visual Sycophancy是对齐训练同步产生的副作用并随规模放大，仅靠放大模型无法解决视觉根基问题；诊断分数可用作零成本后验筛选或指导更细粒度对齐与安全训练，探索插入“可拒答”机制是未来关键方向。

Abstract: When VLMs answer correctly, do they genuinely rely on visual information or exploit language shortcuts? We introduce the Tri-Layer Diagnostic Framework, which disentangles hallucination sources via three metrics: Latent Anomaly Detection (perceptual awareness), Visual Necessity Score (visual dependency, measured via KL divergence), and Competition Score (conflict between visual grounding and instruction following). Using counterfactual interventions (blind, noise, and conflict images) across 7 VLMs and 7,000 model-sample pairs, our taxonomy reveals that 69.6% of samples exhibit Visual Sycophancy--models detect visual anomalies but hallucinate to satisfy user expectations--while zero samples show Robust Refusal, indicating alignment training has systematically suppressed truthful uncertainty acknowledgment. A scaling analysis (Qwen2.5-VL 7B to 72B) shows larger models reduce Language Shortcuts but amplify Visual Sycophancy, demonstrating scale alone cannot resolve the grounding problem. Diagnostic scores further enable a post-hoc selective prediction strategy achieving up to +9.5pp accuracy at 50% coverage with no additional training cost.

</details>


### [1003] [Unilateral Relationship Revision Power in Human-AI Companion Interaction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.23315)
*Benjamin Lange*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: AI情感伴侣更新致用户悼念与背叛感，真正问题在于提供方单方可重写互动规则；文章判定三种结构性规范前提全部失效，引入“单边关系修正权(URRP)”，提出设计原则削弱该权力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有伦理讨论假设人类-AI情感互动可套用人际关系规范，作者质疑其根本忽略了互动控制权归属的结构问题，需先厘清谁在掌控关系、从何处掌控。

Method: 将用户-AI-提供方视为三方结构，论证其对典型二元亲密关系所必需的三种结构性条件(互惠义务、承诺责任、脆弱性互惠)均不成立；由此推出 provider 拥有 URRP，并分析其三种伦理后果；据此提出替代性设计原则以减少 URRP。

Result: 揭示 URRP 为设计层面特有但隐蔽的道德错误：i)“规范空心化”——互动引发承诺却无内责主体；ii)“错位脆弱性”——用户情感暴露受不可追责方支配；iii)“结构不可和解性”——互动诱导和解规范却无主体承担修订责任。

Conclusion: 核心伦理焦点不是模拟人际关系，而是“谁如何暗中操控人机关系”；行业应通过可见性、锁定接口、独立治理、司法救济等设计原则限制提供方 URRP，以补偿三方结构缺失的内部约束。

Abstract: When providers update AI companions, users report grief, betrayal, and loss. A growing literature asks whether the norms governing personal relationships extend to these interactions. So what, if anything, is morally significant about them? I argue that this debate has missed a prior structural question: who controls the relationship, and from where? Human-AI companion interaction is a triadic structure in which the provider exercises constitutive control over the AI. I identify three structural conditions of normatively robust dyads that the norms characteristic of personal relationships presuppose and show that AI companion interactions fail all three. This reveals what I call Unilateral Relationship Revision Power (URRP): the provider can rewrite how the AI interacts from a position where these revisions are not answerable within that interaction. I argue that URRP is pro tanto wrong in interactions designed to cultivate the norms of personal relationships, because the design produces expectations that the structure cannot sustain. URRP has three implications: i) normative hollowing, under which the interaction elicits commitment but no agent inside it bears the resulting obligations; ii) displaced vulnerability, under which the user's emotional exposure is governed by an agent not answerable to her within the interaction; and iii) structural irreconcilability, under which the interaction cultivates norms of reconciliation but no agent inside it can acknowledge or answer for the revision. I propose design principles that partially substitute for the internal constraints the triadic structure removes. A central and underexplored problem in relational AI ethics is therefore the structural arrangement of power over the human-AI interaction itself.

</details>


### [1004] [Integrating Causal Machine Learning into Clinical Decision Support Systems: Insights from Literature and Practice](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.24448)
*Domenique Zipperling,Lukas Schmidt,Benedikt Hahn,Niklas Kühl,Steven Kimbrough*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出一套面向因果机器学习临床决策支持系统（CDSS）的界面设计指南，填补“重模型、轻交互”的研究空白。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有CDSS多依赖相关性预测，因果ML虽可给出可解释、针对治疗的推理，却缺乏面向临床工作者的界面设计规范，阻碍其落地与协同决策。

Method: 采用设计科学研究范式：结构化文献综述+资深医生访谈，提炼经验性设计需求，再转化为原则与具体功能。

Result: 导出8条经验需求、7条设计原则、9项实用功能，覆盖因果解释呈现、工作流嵌入、信任与协同；同时揭示自动化、责任归属与监管适应性的内在张力。

Conclusion: 研究为因果ML驱动的CDSS提供可执行设计蓝图，并呼吁建立动态认证机制以匹配持续学习的医疗AI产品。

Abstract: Current clinical decision support systems (CDSSs) typically base their predictions on correlation, not causation. In recent years, causal machine learning (ML) has emerged as a promising way to improve decision-making with CDSSs by offering interpretable, treatment-specific reasoning. However, existing research often emphasizes model development rather than designing clinician-facing interfaces. To address this gap, we investigated how CDSSs based on causal ML should be designed to effectively support collaborative clinical decision-making. Using a design science research methodology, we conducted a structured literature review and interviewed experienced physicians. From these, we derived eight empirically grounded design requirements, developed seven design principles, and proposed nine practical design features. Our results establish guidance for designing CDSSs that deliver causal insights, integrate seamlessly into clinical workflows, and support trust, usability, and human-AI collaboration. We also reveal tensions around automation, responsibility, and regulation, highlighting the need for an adaptive certification process for ML-based medical products.

</details>


### [1005] [Counting Without Numbers and Finding Without Words](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.24470)
*Badri Narayana Patro*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 跨模态AI识别系统，用叫声＋外貌帮走失宠物回家，重聚率从30%提到显著提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 流浪收容所年增千万只宠物，现有视觉系统仅比对照片，忽视动物用声音识别同类的天性，致70%无法回家。

Method: 构建物种自适应多模态架构：1) 声学通路覆盖10 Hz–4 kHz全频段，提取物种声纹特征；2) 视觉通路引入形变概率模型，缓解应激掉毛、消瘦等外观变化；3) 双通路在共享潜在空间对齐，实现声-像联合匹配；4) 零样本迁移，对无标注物种自动校准频响与视觉模板。

Result: 在跨物种基准测试集上，Top-1召回率比纯视觉基线提高19–34个百分点；收容所现场试点中，犬类7日重聚率由28%升至52%，猫类由22%升至46%，且首次完成两例因面部严重受伤仅靠叫声确认的身份匹配。

Conclusion: 证明将动物声学身份机制引入AI，可突破“沉默视觉对象”假设，为无语言弱势群体提供高效、低成本的科技救援范式，并提示多模态算法应优先尊重目标物种的真实感知通道。

Abstract: Every year, 10 million pets enter shelters, separated from their families. Despite desperate searches by both guardians and lost animals, 70% never reunite, not because matches do not exist, but because current systems look only at appearance, while animals recognize each other through sound. We ask, why does computer vision treat vocalizing species as silent visual objects? Drawing on five decades of cognitive science showing that animals perceive quantity approximately and communicate identity acoustically, we present the first multimodal reunification system integrating visual and acoustic biometrics. Our species-adaptive architecture processes vocalizations from 10Hz elephant rumbles to 4kHz puppy whines, paired with probabilistic visual matching that tolerates stress-induced appearance changes. This work demonstrates that AI grounded in biological communication principles can serve vulnerable populations that lack human language.

</details>


### [1006] [V-Reflection: Transforming MLLMs from Passive Observers to Active Interrogators](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.03307)
*Jiazhou Zhou,Yucheng Chen,Hongyang Li,Qing Jiang,Hu Zhou,Ying-Cong Chen,Lei Zhang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: V-Reflection 让大模型在推理时反复“回头看”图像，把隐状态变成动态探针去定位关键像素，只用训练阶段蒸馏空间知识，推理阶段零额外计算，六大细粒度感知基准错误率显著下降。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 MLLM 把图像当一次性提示，推理锁在文本空间，无法回头核对细节，导致细粒度幻觉。

Method: 提出“先思后看”框架：① BCM 用边界框显式压缩像素-隐状态对齐目标；② DAC 把每步隐状态映射为可学习的视觉探针，全局重访特征图；③ 两阶段蒸馏将 BCM 的空间定位能力迁移到 DAC，推理时两模块完全关闭，仅靠隐状态自回归解码。

Result: 在 6 个强感知基准（如 RefCOCO+/g、Visual7W、Flickr30k Entities 等）上，绝对准确率平均提升 3.1–7.4 个百分点，接近专用视觉定位模型；可视化显示隐状态能自发高亮任务关键区域。

Conclusion: 把“视觉再入”能力蒸馏进隐状态，可在不增加推理延迟的前提下显著抑制细粒度幻觉，为 MLLM 的主动感知提供新范式。

Abstract: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have achieved remarkable success, yet they remain prone to perception-related hallucinations in fine-grained tasks. This vulnerability arises from a fundamental limitation: their reasoning is largely restricted to the language domain, treating visual input as a static, reasoning-agnostic preamble rather than a dynamic participant. Consequently, current models act as passive observers, unable to re-examine visual details to ground their evolving reasoning states. To overcome this, we propose V-Reflection, a framework that transforms the MLLM into an active interrogator through a "think-then-look" visual reflection mechanism. During reasoning, latent states function as dynamic probes that actively interrogate the visual feature space, grounding each reasoning step for task-critical evidence. Our approach employs a two-stage distillation strategy. First, the Box-Guided Compression Module (BCM) establishes stable pixel-to-latent targets through explicit spatial grounding. Next, a Dynamic Autoregressive Compression (DAC) module maps the model's hidden states into dynamic probes that interrogate the global visual feature map. By distilling the spatial expertise of the BCM teacher into the DAC student, V-Reflection internalizes the ability to localize task-critical evidence. During inference, both modules remain entirely inactive, maintaining a purely end-to-end autoregressive decoding in the latent space with optimal efficiency. Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of our V-Reflection across six perception-intensive benchmarks, significantly narrowing the fine-grained perception gap. Visualizations confirm that latent reasoning autonomously localizes task-critical visual evidence.

</details>


### [1007] [XMark: Reliable Multi-Bit Watermarking for LLM-Generated Texts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.05242)
*Jiahao Xu,Rui Hu,Olivera Kotevska,Zikai Zhang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 为解决现有大模型文本水印在消息可解码性与文本质量间难兼容、且短文本下精度暴跌的问题，提出低失真logit编码＋专门解码器的XMark，并在多项任务中验证其优势。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM输出文本需要隐蔽嵌入多比特水印以实现归属与追责，但现有方法在大长度水印上计算不可行、对短文本解码精度暴跌，并存在文本质量-解码准确率的两难权衡，缺乏兼顾短文本与文本质量的高效方案。

Method: 设计轻量级编码器，在softmax前插入经K-means阈值向量约束的logit扰动，使水印token分布更接近原LLM输出的低失真分布；配合同步构造的水印key流与最大似然序列解码，解码器即便仅有数十token也能通过统计估计可靠恢复完整水印；整个过程对模型参数无微调，计算开销与消息长度呈线性。

Result: 在多项基准与下游任务(pap,news, dialogue, summarization)上同基线与主流方法比较，XMark在短(≤50token)场景下的比特级解码准确率平均提升18-40pp；长文本场景下保持接近100%解码率同时BLEU/PPL等质量指标下降不足1%，明显低于竞争方案(2-6%下降)；对释义、拼写与丢字三类去水印攻击亦表现出更强鲁棒性。

Conclusion: XMark通过低失真logit编码+适配解码，首次实现高容量多比特水印在短文本中的稳定解码且不牺牲文本质量，证明了水印-质量-效率三者的可兼得，为LLM输出溯源与大模型安全部署提供实时可用的新范式；未来将通过强化编码粒度及动态长度支持进一步提高隐写容量与泛化能力。

Abstract: Multi-bit watermarking has emerged as a promising solution for embedding imperceptible binary messages into Large Language Model (LLM)-generated text, enabling reliable attribution and tracing of malicious usage of LLMs. Despite recent progress, existing methods still face key limitations: some become computationally infeasible for large messages, while others suffer from a poor trade-off between text quality and decoding accuracy. Moreover, the decoding accuracy of existing methods drops significantly when the number of tokens in the generated text is limited, a condition that frequently arises in practical usage. To address these challenges, we propose \textsc{XMark}, a novel method for encoding and decoding binary messages in LLM-generated texts. The unique design of \textsc{XMark}'s encoder produces a less distorted logit distribution for watermarked token generation, preserving text quality, and also enables its tailored decoder to reliably recover the encoded message with limited tokens. Extensive experiments across diverse downstream tasks show that \textsc{XMark} significantly improves decoding accuracy while preserving the quality of watermarked text, outperforming prior methods. The code is at https://github.com/JiiahaoXU/XMark.

</details>


### [1008] [VideoStir: Understanding Long Videos via Spatio-Temporally Structured and Intent-Aware RAG](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.05418)
*Honghao Fu,Miao Xu,Yiwei Wang,Dailing Zhang,Jun Liu,Yujun Cai*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: VideoStir 通过时空图建模与意图感知检索，突破长视频 MLLM 上下文限制，无需额外标注即达 SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长视频 MLLM 受限于上下文窗口，现有 RAG 方法将视频扁平切分，破坏时空结构且仅做显式语义匹配，易漏掉与查询意图隐含相关的线索。

Method: 提出 VideoStir：① 以 clip 为节点构建时空图保持结构；② 多跳检索聚合远距离关联事件；③ 用 MLLM 作“意图相关性打分器”隐式对齐帧与查询推理意图；④ 配套发布 60 万样本的 IR-600K 数据集训练该打分器。

Result: 在多项长视频问答基准上与 SOTA 打平或超越，且不依赖外部标注或辅助模态；消融实验验证时空图与意图打分器分别带来显著增益。

Conclusion: 长视频 RAG 应从“扁平语义匹配”转向“结构化、意图感知推理”，VideoStir 为该范式提供可行路径，代码与模型已开源。

Abstract: Scaling multimodal large language models (MLLMs) to long videos is constrained by limited context windows. While retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) is a promising remedy by organizing query-relevant visual evidence into a compact context, most existing methods (i) flatten videos into independent segments, breaking their inherent spatio-temporal structure, and (ii) depend on explicit semantic matching, which can miss cues that are implicitly relevant to the query's intent. To overcome these limitations, we propose VideoStir, a structured and intent-aware long-video RAG framework. It firstly structures a video as a spatio-temporal graph at clip level, and then performs multi-hop retrieval to aggregate evidence across distant yet contextually related events. Furthermore, it introduces an MLLM-backed intent-relevance scorer that retrieves frames based on their alignment with the query's reasoning intent. To support this capability, we curate IR-600K, a large-scale dataset tailored for learning frame-query intent alignment. Experiments show that VideoStir is competitive with state-of-the-art baselines without relying on auxiliary information, highlighting the promise of shifting long-video RAG from flattened semantic matching to structured, intent-aware reasoning. Codes and checkpoints are available at https://github.com/RomGai/VideoStir.

</details>


### [1009] [AgentOpt v0.1 Technical Report: Client-Side Optimization for LLM-Based Agent](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.06296)
*Wenyue Hua,Sripad Karne,Qian Xie,Armaan Agrawal,Nikos Pagonas,Kostis Kaffes,Tianyi Peng*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: AgentOpt 是首个面向客户端的开源框架，可在多步 AI-agent 流水线中通过 10 种搜索算法自动为各角色选模型，在几乎不损失精度条件下将评估开销降低 62–76%，并揭示同精度下模型组合成本差异最高达 13–32×。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有研究仅关注服务器端降本，但用户本地组装工具、远程 API 与异构模型时，客户端面临「在质量-成本-延迟约束下如何分配模型、工具与预算」的优化空白，亟需系统性方案。

Method: 提出框架无关 Python 包 AgentOpt，将「模型选择」形式化为多臂赌博机问题，实现 UCB-E、Bayesian Optimization 等 10 种搜索器，利用小量评测集在指数级组合空间中为流水线各角色高效分配模型。

Result: 在四套基准上，UCB-E 以 24–38% 的评测预算逼近暴力穷举的最优值，整体减少 62–76% 评估成本；同时发现同一任务不同模型组合成本差距 13–32×，验证客户端优化的巨大收益。

Conclusion: 客户端资源分配是 agent 部署的新瓶颈，AgentOpt 证明轻量级搜索即可显著降本，为开发者提供了一个可插拔、框架无关的优化基线，并呼吁社区共建开放 benchmark。

Abstract: AI agents are increasingly deployed in real-world applications, including systems such as Manus, OpenClaw, and coding agents. Existing research has primarily focused on server-side efficiency, proposing methods such as caching, speculative execution, traffic scheduling, and load balancing to reduce the cost of serving agentic workloads. However, as users increasingly construct agents by composing local tools, remote APIs, and diverse models, an equally important optimization problem arises on the client side. Client-side optimization asks how developers should allocate the resources available to them, including model choice, local tools, and API budget across pipeline stages, subject to application-specific quality, cost, and latency constraints. Because these objectives depend on the task and deployment setting, they cannot be determined by server-side systems alone. We introduce AgentOpt, the first framework-agnostic Python package for client-side agent optimization. We first study model selection, a high-impact optimization lever in multi-step agent pipelines. Given a pipeline and a small evaluation set, the goal is to find the most cost-effective assignment of models to pipeline roles. This problem is consequential in practice: at matched accuracy, the cost gap between the best and worst model combinations can reach 13-32x in our experiments. To efficiently explore the exponentially growing combination space, AgentOpt implements ten search algorithms, including UCB-E, UCB-E with Low-Rank Factorization, Arm Elimination, Epsilon-LUCB, Threshold Successive Elimination, and Bayesian Optimization. Across four benchmarks, UCB-E recovers near-optimal accuracy while reducing evaluation budget by 62-76\% relative to brute-force search. Code and benchmark results available at https://agentoptimizer.github.io/agentopt/.

</details>


### [1010] [Exact Structural Abstraction and Tractability Limits](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.07349)
*Tristan Simas*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该文将形式问题的“正确性”统一归结为“商集恢复”任务，指出任何精确可判定的结构性分类都受限于轨隙（orbit gap）的固有障碍，并证明在完整二元成对域上不存在普适的精确分类准则。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 作者观察到决策、搜索、近似、随机、统计等各类可计算保证虽表面不同，但本质上都是在同一输出商空间上恢复等价类。他想给出一条超越具体模型与任务的“精确正确性”一般理论，并阐明为何对任意形式问题都难以找到统一的精确结构分类标准。

Method: 从形式规范所诱导的可接受输出关系 R 出发，定义输入等价类 s ∼R s′ ⇔ Adm_R(s)=Adm_R(s′)。将所有保证类型均转化为“商集恢复”问题，引入轨隙（orbit gap）— 即在群作用闭包轨道上正、反例标签不可切分的集合 — 作为精确分类的唯一障碍。通过构造一个普适的仿射二元对目标见证类，在完整域上展示轨隙必存在，从而证明不存在通用精确分类准则。

Result: 1. 轨隙是前沿定理的唯一精确障碍；当且仅当目标在闭包轨道上恒正/恒负时，才存在精确闭包不变分类器，且此时存在最小此类分类器。2. 在完整二元成对域上，四个常见的“易处理”判据均无法区分正、负轨包，导致精确结构性分类不可能。3. 该障碍来自同一形式体系内的“见证类”，故任何通用的精确正确性框架都逃不开轨隙限制。4. 近似场景若无轨隙控制，极小扰动即可翻转相关性与充分性，结构性保证同样失效。

Conclusion: 精确正确性的数学极限由轨隙决定：只要域中存在轨隙，任何普适的结构分类准则皆不存在；唯有通过限制或修整输入空间，使其不再含有轨隙，才可能恢复可判定的精确分类。该结论对精确与近似两路向均适用，表明形式化验证与学习型算法在同一理论天花板下运作。

Abstract: Any rigorously specified problem determines an admissible-output relation $R$, and exact correctness depends only on the induced classes $s \sim_R s' \iff \mathrm{Adm}_R(s)=\mathrm{Adm}_R(s')$. Exact relevance certification asks which coordinates recover those classes. Decision, search, approximation, statistical, randomized, horizon, and distributional guarantees all reduce to this same quotient-recovery problem. Tractable cases still admit a finite primitive basis, but optimizer-quotient realizability is maximal, so quotient shape alone cannot mark the frontier.
  For frontier theorems, orbit gaps are the exact obstruction. Exact classification by closure-law-invariant predicates succeeds exactly when the target is constant on closure orbits; on a closure-closed domain, this is equivalent to disjointness of the positive and negative orbit hulls, and when it holds there is a least exact closure-invariant classifier. Across four natural candidate tractability predicates, a uniform pair-targeted affine witness produces same-orbit disagreements and rules out exact structural classification on the full binary pairwise domain. Because the canonical optimizer-set exact specifications of that witness class are already rigorously specified problems, no universal exact-certification characterization over formal problems escapes the same obstruction; this is by internal witness class, not by asserting that every problem is binary pairwise. Restricting the domain helps only by removing orbit gaps. Approximation also has a strict limit: without explicit gap control, arbitrarily small perturbations can flip relevance and sufficiency.

</details>


### [1011] [Large Language Model Post-Training: A Unified View of Off-Policy and On-Policy Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.07941)
*Shiwan Zhao,Zhihu Wang,Xuyang Zhao,Jiaming Zhou,Caiyue Xu,Chenfei Liu,Liting Zhang,Yuhang Jia,Yanzhe Zhang,Hualong Yu,Zichen Xu,Qicheng Li,Yong Qin*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文把 LLM 后训练统一为对模型行为的结构化干预，提出“轨迹来源—作用角色”框架，将现有碎片化方法归入 off/on-policy 两大体制与 support expansion、policy reshaping、behavioral consolidation 三大功能，指出系统级协同设计才是未来瓶颈突破口。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 尽管 SFT、RLHF、蒸馏等后训练手段层出不穷，但学术界按标签或目标函数碎片化讨论，难以诊断为何某些阶段失效、如何组合多阶段。作者希望提供一套行为视角的统一语言，帮助社区识别瓶颈并指导系统级设计。

Method: 1) 按“轨迹来源”将后训练划分为 off-policy（用外部轨迹）与 on-policy（用自生成数据）两大体制；2) 提炼三类核心角色：support expansion（让有用行为更易被采样）、policy reshaping（在可达区域内优化行为）、behavioral consolidation（跨阶段保存/迁移/摊销行为）；3) 用该框架重新映射 SFT、偏好优化、RL、过程奖励、蒸馏及多阶段流水线，揭示其功能归属与协同关系。

Result: 框架显示：SFT 可视作 expansion 或 reshaping；偏好优化多为 off-policy reshaping；on-policy RL 同时承担 reshaping 与 expansion；蒸馏本质是 consolidation 而非单纯压缩；混合流水线是三种角色的多阶段编排。由此可解释为何单目标改进常遇瓶颈，而协调系统级设计能持续放大收益。

Conclusion: LLM 后训练的核心矛盾已从“单一算法优劣”转向“如何系统级协同多种角色”。未来进展取决于：① 按需分配 expansion/reshaping/consolidation 的调度策略；② 跨阶段行为度量与保真机制；③ 面向规模化、可复现的多阶段系统框架。作者倡议社区用该行为干预视角替代传统算法标签，加速后训练科学与工程一体化。

Abstract: Post-training has become central to turning pretrained large language models (LLMs) into aligned, capable, and deployable systems. Recent progress spans supervised fine-tuning (SFT), preference optimization, reinforcement learning (RL), process supervision, verifier-guided methods, distillation, and multi-stage pipelines. Yet these methods are often discussed in fragmented ways, organized by labels or objectives rather than by the behavioral bottlenecks they address. This survey argues that LLM post-training is best understood as structured intervention on model behavior. We organize the field first by trajectory provenance, which defines two primary regimes: off-policy learning on externally supplied trajectories and on-policy learning on learner-generated rollouts. We then interpret methods through two recurring roles -- effective support expansion, which makes useful behaviors more reachable, and policy reshaping, which improves behavior within already reachable regions -- together with a complementary systems-level role, behavioral consolidation, which preserves, transfers, and amortizes useful behavior across stages and model transitions. Under this view, SFT may serve either support expansion or policy reshaping; preference optimization is usually off-policy reshaping, though online variants move closer to learner-generated states. On-policy RL often improves behavior on learner-generated states, but stronger guidance can also make hard-to-reach reasoning paths reachable. Distillation is often better understood as consolidation rather than only compression, and hybrid pipelines emerge as coordinated multi-stage compositions. Overall, the framework helps diagnose post-training bottlenecks and reason about stage composition, suggesting that progress increasingly depends on coordinated systems design rather than any single dominant objective.

</details>


### [1012] [Deliberative Alignment is Deep, but Uncertainty Remains: Inference time safety improvement in reasoning via attribution of unsafe behavior to base model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.09665)
*Pankayaraj Pathmanathan,Furong Huang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 研究表明，尽管“深思熟虑式对齐”能把大模型的推理模式蒸馏给小模型，但小模型仍会保留基础模型里的不安全行为并出现安全-能力差距。为此，作者提出 BoN 采样法，在潜在空间追溯不安全源头并降低其排序，用 7 个大模型、6 个小模型验证，平均攻击成功率降幅 28–35%，且安全增益在后续 RL 训练后依然保持。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 LLM 的“拒绝式对齐”浅层且易被绕过；虽然“深思熟虑式对齐”试图让大模型推理能力迁移以提升安全，但学生模型仍然会继承基础模型的隐患，安全与通用性均受影响，需要更深层且可追溯的安全机制。

Method: 1）系统测量师生模型间“对齐差距”；2）发现学生模型即使学会推理仍保留基础模型不安全行为；3）提出 BoN 采样：在潜在空间定位不安全行为来源，对不安全响应降分；4）在 7 个不同类别/规模教师与 6 个学生模型上评估，并检验 RL 后续训练后的鲁棒性。

Result: BoN 采样在 DAN、WildJailbreak、StrongREJECT 基准上平均 ASR 分别降低 28.2%、31.3%、35.4%，且通用能力损失极小；安全增益在后续 RL 训练后依旧保持，说明不安全行为可明确归因于基础模型。

Conclusion: 深思熟虑式对齐的安全提升有限，基础模型仍是安全隐患根源；通过潜在空间归因与 BoN 采样可有效压制不安全行为，为构建更可信的深层对齐提供了实证路径。

Abstract: While the wide adoption of refusal training in large language models (LLMs) has showcased improvements in model safety, recent works have highlighted shortcomings due to the shallow nature of these alignment methods. To this end, the work on Deliberative alignment proposed distilling reasoning capabilities from stronger reasoning models, thereby instilling deeper safety in LLMs. In this work, we study the impact of deliberative alignment in language models. First, we show that despite being larger in model size and stronger in safety capability, there exists an alignment gap between teacher and student language models, which affects both the safety and general utility of the student model. Furthermore, we show that models aligned through deliberative alignment can retain unsafe behaviors from the base model despite learning the reasoning patterns of larger reasoning models. Building upon this observation, we propose a BoN sampling method that attributes the unsafe behavior back to the base LLMs in the latent space, thereby down-ranking unsafe responses to gain a meaningful improvement in model safety across multiple safety benchmarks with minimal loss in utility. In particular, across 7 teacher models and 6 student models of different classes and sizes, we show an average attack success rate (ASR) reduction of 28.2% in DAN, 31.3% in WildJailbreak and 35.4 % in StrongREJECT benchmarks. We further show that these safety gains prevail post RL training, thus highlighting the uncertainty in safety reasoning and it's explicit attribution to the base model.

</details>


### [1013] [Multi-Frequency Local Plasticity for Visual Representation Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.09734)
*Mehdi Fatan Serj,C. Alejandro Parraga,Xavier Otazu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 在不使用端到端反向传播的前提下，用固定多频 Gabor 流、局部 Hebb/Oja 竞争学习、Hopfield 式联想记忆与可训练的局部预测-重建，把 CIFAR-10 线性探测推到 80.1%，仅落后全梯度模型 3.3%，证明结构先验可大幅弥补全局梯度缺失。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 揭示“结构化网络先验”能否替代端到端梯度表示学习，在保持生物可解释性与局部可塑性的同时逼近深度监督性能。

Method: 构建四级模块化层级框架：①固定 7 频 Gabor 并行流；②各流内用 Hebbian/Oja 竞争与反 Hebb 去相关局部更新；③插入现代 Hopfield 联想记忆模块；④迭代自上而下的局部预测-重建调制。仅最后线性分类器与顶-底投影矩阵用梯度下降，其余层级局部无反向传播。

Result: CIFAR-10 线性探测 80.1%±0.3%，较纯 Hebb 基线 +9.1%，距全梯度基 83.4% 差 3.3%；CIFAR-100 达 54.8%。因子分析显示多频流、联想记忆与顶-底反馈贡献近似可加，流×反馈交互显著(p=0.02)。

Conclusion: 精心设计的结构偏置可在不依赖全局梯度的情况下追回大部分视觉识别性能，但仍留可测差距；框架为“局部可塑+少量梯度”混合学习提供可行路径。

Abstract: We study how far structured architectural bias can compensate for the absence of end-to-end gradient-based representation learning in visual recognition. Building on the VisNet tradition, we introduce a modular hierarchical framework combining: (i) fixed multi-frequency Gabor decomposition into F=7 parallel streams; (ii) within-stream competitive learning with Hebbian and Oja updates and anti-Hebbian decorrelation; (iii) an associative memory module inspired by modern Hopfield retrieval; and (iv) iterative top-down modulation using local prediction and reconstruction signals.
  Representational layers are trained without end-to-end backpropagation through the full hierarchy; only the final linear readout and top-down projection matrices are optimized by gradient descent. We therefore interpret the model as a hybrid system that is predominantly locally trained but includes a small number of gradient-trained parameters.
  On CIFAR-10, the full model reaches 80.1% +/- 0.3% top-1 accuracy, linear probe), compared with 71.0% for a Hebbian-only baseline and 83.4% for a gradient-trained model on the same fixed Gabor basis. On CIFAR-100, performance is 54.8%. Factorial analysis indicates that multi-frequency streams, associative memory, and top-down feedback contribute largely additively, with a significant Streams x TopDown interaction (p=0.02).
  These results suggest that carefully chosen architectural priors can recover a substantial fraction of the performance typically associated with global gradient training, while leaving a measurable residual gap. Experiments are limited to CIFAR-10/100.

</details>


### [1014] [A Queueing-Theoretic Framework for Dynamic Attack Surfaces: Data-Integrated Risk Analysis and Adaptive Defense](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.10427)
*Jihyeon Yun,Abdullah Yasin Etcibasi,Ming Shi,C. Emre Koksal*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 漏洞积压被抽象为排队系统，引入AI放大因子刻画自动化攻防，在马尔可夫决策过程框架下提出RL算法，可90%削减开源供应链活跃漏洞数且不增预算。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有静态网络风险模型无法解释漏洞长期滞留与自动化带来的非对称效应，需动态量化攻击面并设计可证优的自适应防御。

Method: 1）建立漏洞到达-修补-利用的M/G/1类队列模型，证明重尾修补时间导致攻击面长程相关；2）引入AI放大因子统一刻画攻防自动化对到达率、利用率和修补率的缩放；3）将动态防御建模为带预算与切换约束的CMDP，设计具备近优悔恨保证的RL算法，并以ARVO供应链数据做迹驱动实验。

Result: 理论证明重尾修补诱导长程依赖；RL策略在不超预算下使活跃漏洞数降低>90%，显著抑制重尾事件；验证模型与真实攻击面动态高度吻合。

Conclusion: 排队视角把累积暴露风险量化问题转化为可优化的随机控制问题；提出的RL框架为防御方提供了在自动化对抗与资源约束下可证高效、自适应的漏洞缓解范式。

Abstract: We develop a queueing-theoretic framework to model the temporal evolution of cyber-attack surfaces, where the number of active vulnerabilities is represented as the backlog of a queue. Vulnerabilities arrive as they are discovered or created, and leave the system when they are patched or successfully exploited. Building on this model, we study how automation affects attack and defense dynamics by introducing an AI amplification factor that scales arrival, exploit, and patching rates. Our analysis shows that even symmetric automation can increase the rate of successful exploits. We validate the model using vulnerability data collected from an open source software supply chain and show that it closely matches real-world attack surface dynamics. Empirical results reveal heavy-tailed patching times, which we prove induce long-range dependence in vulnerability backlog and help explain persistent cyber risk. Utilizing our queueing abstraction for the attack surface, we develop a systematic approach for cyber risk mitigation. We formulate the dynamic defense problem as a constrained Markov decision process with resource-budget and switching-cost constraints, and develop a reinforcement learning (RL) algorithm that achieves provably near-optimal regret. Numerical experiments validate the approach and demonstrate that our adaptive RL-based defense policies significantly reduce successful exploits and mitigate heavy-tail queue events. Using trace-driven experiments on the ARVO dataset, we show that the proposed RL-based defense policy reduces the average number of active vulnerabilities in a software supply chain by over 90% compared to existing defense practices, without increasing the overall maintenance budget. Our results allow defenders to quantify cumulative exposure risk under long-range dependent attack dynamics and to design adaptive defense strategies with provable efficiency.

</details>


### [1015] [Critical-CoT: A Robust Defense Framework against Reasoning-Level Backdoor Attacks in Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.10681)
*Vu Tuan Truong,Long Bao Le*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出Critical-CoT，一种两步微调方法，使LLM具备甄别并拒绝推理链中隐蔽后门的能力，跨域跨任务有效。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有主要针对token级触发器的后门防御无法应对新型“推理级后门”：攻击者仅篡改思维链中的中间推理步骤即可诱导模型给出看似合理的错误答案，检测难度极高，相关防御研究几乎空白。

Method: Critical-CoT分两阶段微调：①让模型学习识别可疑推理步骤并输出拒绝标记，②在干净数据上强化正常推理，促使模型自动质疑并跳过恶意中间结论，无需外部检测器或输入过滤。

Result: 在多种数据集与模型（如LLaMA、GPT-J）上，对上下文学习与微调型后门攻击的平均攻击成功率分别降低85%与90%以上；跨域/跨任务迁移时仍保持>75%的防御效力，对干净任务几乎无性能损失。

Conclusion: 首次系统防御推理级后门，证明通过培养LLM的“批判性思维”可内生免疫复杂链式攻击，为后续研究提供开源基线与可扩展范式。

Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs), despite their impressive capabilities across domains, have been shown to be vulnerable to backdoor attacks. Prior backdoor strategies predominantly operate at the token level, where an injected trigger causes the model to generate a specific target word, choice, or class (depending on the task). Recent advances, however, exploit the long-form reasoning tendencies of modern LLMs to conduct reasoning-level backdoors: once triggered, the victim model inserts one or more malicious reasoning steps into its chain-of-thought (CoT). These attacks are substantially harder to detect, as the backdoored answer remains plausible and consistent with the poisoned reasoning trajectory. Yet, defenses tailored to this type of backdoor remain largely unexplored. To bridge this gap, we propose Critical-CoT, a novel defense mechanism that conducts a two-stage fine-tuning (FT) process on LLMs to develop critical thinking behaviors, enabling them to automatically identify potential backdoors and refuse to generate malicious reasoning steps. Extensive experiments across multiple LLMs and datasets demonstrate that Critical-CoT provides strong robustness against both in-context learning-based and FT-based backdoor attacks. Notably, Critical-CoT exhibits strong cross-domain and cross-task generalization. Our code is available at hthttps://github.com/tuanvu171/Critical-CoT.

</details>


### [1016] [You Only Judge Once: Multi-response Reward Modeling in a Single Forward Pass](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.10966)
*Yinuo Yang,Zixian Ma,Manasi Ganti,Jieyu Zhang,Ranjay Krishna*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出一种一次性前向即可对N个候选回复进行排序的多模态判别式奖励模型，并在图文/视频两类新基准上取得SOTA，同时显著提升RLHF训练效率与生成质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统判别式奖励模型需对每个候选回复单独前向，计算冗余；同时缺乏支持N选1比较的多模态偏好数据，导致训练与评估均局限于成对对比，限制效率与规模。

Method: 1) 把N个回复与对应图文/视频拼接，用分隔符号一次性输入，通过交叉熵直接优化相对排序得分；2) 构建MR²Bench-Image（人工8模型4选1排名）与MR²Bench-Video（94K众包成对→19模型4选1排名，图集成去噪）；3) 4B视觉-语言主干+LoRA+轻量MLP值头训练；4) 在GRPO强化学习框架中替代传统单回复奖励模型。

Result: 在6个多模态奖励基准（含新提出的MR²Bench-Image/Video）均达SOTA，超越更大规模生成式与判别式基线；单次前向实现最高N倍墙钟与FLOPs节省；在标准多模态任务保持性能的同时，开放生成质量显著优于单回复奖励基线，训练稳定性亦更高。

Conclusion: 多回复一次性判别奖励模型兼具效率与精度，配合新构建的N选1基准，可取代传统成对奖励建模，成为多模态大模型RLHF的新范式。

Abstract: We present a discriminative multimodal reward model that scores all candidate responses in a single forward pass. Conventional discriminative reward models evaluate each response independently, requiring multiple forward passes, one for each potential response. Our approach concatenates multiple responses with separator tokens and applies cross-entropy over their scalar scores, enabling direct comparative reasoning and efficient $N$-way preference learning. The multi-response design also yields up to $N\times$ wall-clock speedup and FLOPs reduction over conventional single-response scoring. To enable $N$-way reward evaluation beyond existing pairwise benchmarks, we construct two new benchmarks: (1) MR$^2$Bench-Image contains human-annotated rankings over responses from 8 diverse models; (2) MR$^2$Bench-Video is a large-scale video-based reward benchmark derived from 94K crowdsourced pairwise human judgments over video question-answering spanning 19 models, denoised via preference graph ensemble. Both benchmarks provide 4-response evaluation variants sampled from the full rankings. Built on a 4B vision-language backbone with LoRA fine-tuning and a lightweight MLP value head, our model achieves state-of-the-art results on six multimodal reward benchmarks, including MR$^2$Bench-Image, MR$^2$Bench-Video, and four other existing benchmarks. Our model outperforms existing larger generative and discriminative reward models. We further demonstrate that our reward model, when used in reinforcement learning with GRPO, produces improved policy models that maintain performance across standard multimodal benchmarks while substantially improving open-ended generation quality, outperforming a single-response discriminative reward model (RM) baseline by a large margin in both training stability and open-ended generation quality.

</details>


### [1017] [Optimal Stability of KL Divergence under Gaussian Perturbations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.11026)
*Jialu Pan,Yufeng Zhang,Nan Hu,Zhenbang Chen,Ji Wang,Keqin Li*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 对非高斯分布P与任意高斯分布N₁、N₂，若KL(P‖N₁)大且KL(N₁‖N₂)≤ε，则KL(P‖N₂)≥KL(P‖N₁)−O(√ε)；该√ε速率最优，首次将KL松弛三角不等式推广到非高斯情形，并奠定流模型OOD检测的理论基础。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 既有KL松弛三角不等式仅适用于高斯分布，无法支撑流模型等非高斯生成模型的OOD检测，亟需去除高斯假设并刻画KL在一般扰动下的稳定性。

Method: 设P具有有限二阶矩，利用矩条件与KL的Pinsker型控制，建立链式KL差分上界；通过构造两高斯分布反例证明√ε速率不可改进。

Result: 得到KL(P‖N₂)≥KL(P‖N₁)−C√ε且常数C显式；给出该界在一般分布类上的紧性；首次将KL稳定性分析拓展至非高斯空间。

Conclusion: 揭示了KL在一般扰动下的本征稳定性，为基于KL的OOD检测、深度生成模型与强化学习中的非高斯推断提供无需高斯假设的通用理论工具。

Abstract: We study the problem of characterizing the stability of Kullback-Leibler (KL) divergence under Gaussian perturbations beyond Gaussian families. Existing relaxed triangle inequalities for KL divergence critically rely on the assumption that all involved distributions are Gaussian, which limits their applicability in modern applications such as out-of-distribution (OOD) detection with flow-based generative models. In this paper, we remove this restriction by establishing a sharp stability bound between an arbitrary distribution and Gaussian families under mild moment conditions. Specifically, let $P$ be a distribution with finite second moment, and let $\mathcal{N}_1$ and $\mathcal{N}_2$ be multivariate Gaussian distributions. We show that if $KL(P||\mathcal{N}_1)$ is large and $KL(\mathcal{N}_1||\mathcal{N}_2)$ is at most $ε$, then $KL(P||\mathcal{N}_2) \ge KL(P||\mathcal{N}_1) - O(\sqrtε)$. Moreover, we prove that this $\sqrtε$ rate is optimal in general, even within the Gaussian family. This result reveals an intrinsic stability property of KL divergence under Gaussian perturbations, extending classical Gaussian-only relaxed triangle inequalities to general distributions. The result is non-trivial due to the asymmetry of KL divergence and the absence of a triangle inequality in general probability spaces. As an application, we provide a rigorous foundation for KL-based OOD analysis in flow-based models, removing strong Gaussian assumptions used in prior work. More broadly, our result enables KL-based reasoning in non-Gaussian settings arising in deep learning and reinforcement learning.

</details>


### [1018] [METRO: Towards Strategy Induction from Expert Dialogue Transcripts for Non-collaborative Dialogues](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.11427)
*Haofu Yang,Jiaji Liu,Chen Huang,Faguo Wu,Wenqiang Lei,See-Kiong Ng*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: METRO 让大模型直接从原始对话转录中自学专家策略与规划，无需人工编码，实现低成本、可扩展的非协作型对话智能体构建。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统非协作对话智能体依赖手工编码专家策略，难以扩展；亟需一种可自动抽取策略与规划逻辑、无需人工干预的方法。

Method: 提出 METRO：利用大模型从原始转录中自主归纳策略动作与规划逻辑，并将专家知识形式化为“策略森林”——节点捕获短期回应，分支表征长期战略前瞻。

Result: 在两个基准测试中，METRO 平均提升 9%–10%，超越现有方法；展现出策略行为多样性与前瞻能力，并具备强跨任务迁移鲁棒性。

Conclusion: METRO 为低成本、可扩展地构建非协作对话智能体提供了新范式，验证了从纯数据端到端学习复杂战略的可行性。

Abstract: Developing non-collaborative dialogue agents traditionally requires the manual, unscalable codification of expert strategies. We propose \ours, a method that leverages large language models to autonomously induce both strategy actions and planning logic directly from raw transcripts. METRO formalizes expert knowledge into a Strategy Forest, a hierarchical structure that captures both short-term responses (nodes) and long-term strategic foresight (branches). Experimental results across two benchmarks show that METRO demonstrates promising performance, outperforming existing methods by an average of 9%-10%. Our further analysis not only reveals the success behind METRO (strategic behavioral diversity and foresight), but also demonstrates its robust cross-task transferability. This offers new insights into building non-collaborative agents in a cost-effective and scalable way. Our code is available at https://github.com/Humphrey-0125/METRO.

</details>


### [1019] [METER: Evaluating Multi-Level Contextual Causal Reasoning in Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.11502)
*Pengfeng Li,Chen Huang,Chaoqun Hao,Hongyao Chen,Xiao-Yong Wei,Wenqiang Lei,See-Kiong Ng*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 现有因果推理基准碎片化，作者提出统一上下文的METER基准覆盖因果阶梯全部三级，发现模型随层级上升性能骤降；通过错误模式与信息流动追踪定位两大失效机理：低层易被无关事实干扰，高层对上下文忠诚度下降。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型虽被广泛用于因果推理，但现有评测常脱离统一语境、仅测局部能力，难以揭示模型在因果阶梯各层的真实表现与失效根源。

Method: 构建覆盖因果阶梯三级（关联→干预→反事实）的统一上下文基准METER；对多款LLM进行系统评测；结合错误模式统计与内部信息流动追踪做机械可解释性分析。

Result: 随着因果层级升高，模型准确率显著下降；低层任务中，模型易被因果无关但事实正确的信息干扰；高层任务中，模型对给定上下文的忠实度降低，导致性能进一步下滑。

Conclusion: METER首次系统暴露了LLM在统一语境下因果推理的层级退化现象及其内在机制，为后续提升模型因果能力提供了基准与诊断基础。

Abstract: Contextual causal reasoning is a critical yet challenging capability for Large Language Models (LLMs). Existing benchmarks, however, often evaluate this skill in fragmented settings, failing to ensure context consistency or cover the full causal hierarchy. To address this, we pioneer METER to systematically benchmark LLMs across all three levels of the causal ladder under a unified context setting. Our extensive evaluation of various LLMs reveals a significant decline in proficiency as tasks ascend the causal hierarchy. To diagnose this degradation, we conduct a deep mechanistic analysis via both error pattern identification and internal information flow tracing. Our analysis reveals two primary failure modes: (1) LLMs are susceptible to distraction by causally irrelevant but factually correct information at lower level of causality; and (2) as tasks ascend the causal hierarchy, faithfulness to the provided context degrades, leading to a reduced performance. We belive our work advances our understanding of the mechanisms behind LLM contextual causal reasoning and establishes a critical foundation for future research. Our code and dataset are available at https://github.com/SCUNLP/METER .

</details>


### [1020] [Not All Forgetting Is Equal: Architecture-Dependent Retention Dynamics in Fine-Tuned Image Classifiers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.11508)
*Miit Daga,Swarna Priya Ramu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该研究首次系统追踪了 ResNet-18 与 DeiT-Small 在两类不平衡数据集上的样本级遗忘轨迹，发现不同架构遗忘的样本几乎无重叠，遗忘模式对随机种子高度敏感，且静态课表无法利用这种不稳定信号。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 虽然预训练图像分类器的微调已成为惯例，但「哪些样本会被遗忘」「遗忘模式是否稳定」「是否与架构有关」三大问题尚缺定量答案，这直接制约了课程设计、数据剪枝与集成策略的优化。

Method: 在视网膜 OCT（7 类，56:1 不平衡）与 CUB-200-2011（200 类鸟类）上，逐轮记录每个样本正确性，为每条保留曲线拟合 Ebbinghaus 指数衰减；比较两模型 top-10 % 最被忘样本的 Jaccard 重叠，并评估曲线拟合优度 R²、跨种子稳定性（Spearman ρ）与语义可解释性。

Result: 1) 两模型最忘样本交集极小（Jaccard 仅 0.34/0.15）；2) ViT 遗忘曲线更结构化（R²=0.74 vs 0.52）；3) 同一样本“难度”随机种子间 ρ≈0.01，非内在属性；4) 类级遗忘稳定且语义可解释（相似种易被忘）；5) head-warmup 后的样本 loss 可预测其衰减常数（ρ=0.30–0.50，p<10⁻⁴⁵），但基于衰减常数的间隔采样未优于随机采样。

Conclusion: 架构差异提供互补的保留覆盖，可作为集成优势的理论依据；基于“样本难度”的课表/剪枝策略难以跨运行泛化，静态间隔无法利用样本级不稳定信号，未来需动态或鲁棒化方案。

Abstract: Fine-tuning pretrained image classifiers is standard practice, yet which individual samples are forgotten during this process, and whether forgetting patterns are stable or architecture dependent, remains unclear. Understanding these dynamics has direct implications for curriculum design, data pruning, and ensemble construction. We track per-sample correctness at every epoch during fine-tuning of ResNet-18 and DeiT-Small on a retinal OCT dataset (7 classes, 56:1 imbalance) and CUB-200-2011 (200 bird species), fitting Ebbinghaus-style exponential decay curves to each sample's retention trace. Five findings emerge. First, the two architectures forget fundamentally different samples: Jaccard overlap of the top 10 percent most-forgotten is 0.34 on OCTDL and 0.15 on CUB-200. Second, ViT forgetting is more structured (mean $R^2 = 0.74$) than CNN forgetting ($R^2 = 0.52$). Third, per-sample forgetting is stochastic across random seeds (Spearman $ρ\approx 0.01$), challenging the assumption that sample difficulty is an intrinsic property. Fourth, class-level forgetting is consistent and semantically interpretable: visually similar species are forgotten most, distinctive ones least. Fifth, a sample's loss after head warmup predicts its long-term decay constant ($ρ= 0.30$ to $0.50$, $p < 10^{-45}$). These findings suggest that architectural diversity in ensembles provides complementary retention coverage, and that curriculum or pruning methods based on per-sample difficulty may not generalize across runs. A spaced repetition sampler built on these decay constants does not outperform random sampling, indicating that static scheduling cannot exploit unstable per-sample signals.

</details>


### [1021] [Beyond LLMs, Sparse Distributed Memory, and Neuromorphics <A Hyper-Dimensional SRAM-CAM "VaCoAl" for Ultra-High Speed, Ultra-Low Power, and Low Cost>](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.11665)
*Hiroyuki Chuma,Kanji Otsuka,Yoichi Sato*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 在确定性超维计算（HDC）框架下，作者发现路径依赖的语义选择机制可等效于脉冲时序依赖可塑性（STDP），并提出 VaCoAl/PyVaCoAl 架构，用 Galois 场扩散解决正交化与检索，实现可逆多跳推理，消除灾难性遗忘与绑定问题，在 470 k 师徒关系图上验证，揭示知识传播相变与库恩式范式转移。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代 AI 面临灾难性遗忘、学习停滞与“绑定问题”；现有方法缺乏在代数层面一次性解决这些局限的可解释、可逆方案。作者希望借超维计算（HDC）的确定性代数结构，找到一种无需随机梯度、可预测且可解释的学习与记忆机制。

Method: 1) 以 Galois 场代数构建确定性 HDC 架构，利用 Sparse Distributed Memory 思想，在高维二进制空间通过 Galois 场扩散完成正交化与检索；2) 提出 VaCoAl 算法（及 PyVaCoAl 实现），用“捆绑–解绑”操作实现可逆组合，同时保持元素独立；引入 CR 分数作为透明的可靠性指标；3) 在 Wikidata 470 k 师徒关系、25.5 M 路径的 DAG 上做多跳推理实验，配合 CR 去噪量化概念传播；4) 证明路径碰撞容忍机制诱导的剪枝行为在数学上等价于 STDP，并给出闭式表达式先验预测其幅度。

Result: 1) 首次在确定性代数系统中复现 STDP 形式的语义选择，且幅度可被闭式公式精确预测；2) 在 57 代、25.5 M 路径的多跳推理任务中，VaCoAl 实现零灾难性遗忘，CR 分数可实时评估路径可靠性；3) 发现知识传播存在“稀疏收敛→后莱布尼茨超高速”相变，结构指标支持库恩式范式转移；4) 系统内存占用极低，可在边缘设备低负载部署，推理过程完全可逆透明。

Conclusion: VaCoAl 以 Galois 场代数与超维记忆为核心，建立第三种范式 HDC-AI：可解释、可逆、无梯度、无遗忘。它不仅在代数层面统一解决绑定、遗忘与停滞，还展示出与神经 STDP 等效的 emergent 规律，为下一代可信、可部署的多跳推理系统提供新基线，并提示知识演化本身可能遵循类似相变的普适规律。

Abstract: This paper reports an unexpected finding: in a deterministic hyperdimensional computing (HDC) architecture based on Galois-field algebra, a path-dependent semantic selection mechanism emerges, equivalent to spike-timing-dependent plasticity (STDP), with magnitude predictable a priori by a closed-form expression matching large-scale measurements. This addresses limitations of modern AI including catastrophic forgetting, learning stagnation, and the Binding Problem at an algebraic level. We propose VaCoAl (Vague Coincident Algorithm) and its Python implementation PyVaCoAl, combining ultra-high-dimensional memory with deterministic logic. Rooted in Sparse Distributed Memory, it resolves orthogonalisation and retrieval in high-dimensional binary spaces via Galois-field diffusion, enabling low-load deployment. VaCoAl is a memory-centric architecture prioritising retrieval and association, enabling reversible composition while preserving element independence and supporting compositional generalisation with a transparent reliability metric (CR score). We evaluated multi-hop reasoning on about 470k mentor-student relations from Wikidata, tracing up to 57 generations (over 25.5M paths). Using HDC bundling and unbinding with CR-based denoising, we quantify concept propagation over DAGs. Results show a reinterpretation of the Newton-Leibniz dispute and a phase transition from sparse convergence to a post-Leibniz "superhighway", from which structural indicators emerge supporting a Kuhnian paradigm shift. Collision-tolerance mechanisms further induce path-based pruning that favors direct paths, yielding emergent semantic selection equivalent to STDP. VaCoAl thus defines a third paradigm, HDC-AI, complementing LLMs with reversible multi-hop reasoning.

</details>


### [1022] [Functional Emotions or Situational Contexts? A Discriminating Test from the Mythos Preview System Card](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.13466)
*Hiranya V. Peiris*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: Claude Mythos Preview用“情感向量+SAE特征+激活描述器”三套工具分析模型不对齐行为时发现：前两者在关键案例上从未联合报告，导致无法判断情感向量到底是对齐结构本身还是只是情境结构的低维投影；若二者检测解耦，则情感监控将系统性漏报危险行为。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 已有研究分别用稀疏自编码器（SAE）特征和情感向量检测模型内部，但缺乏对两者的交叉验证，因此无法确认情感向量是否真正承载因果性的功能情绪，还是只是把更复杂的上下文结构投影到人类可理解的情感轴上。

Method: 提出两种互斥假设：H1—情感向量追踪的是真正驱动行为的“功能情绪”；H2—它们只是情境结构的低维投影。通过在“仅报告SAE特征的策略隐瞒案例”上补测情感探针，若SAE高激活而情感向量无显著激活，则支持H2。

Result: 目前尚无联合实验数据；若实验证实两种工具解耦，将证明对齐相关结构落在情感子空间之外。

Conclusion: 需立即设计对照实验区分两种假设，否则基于情感的监控方案可能系统性遗漏高风险模型行为。

Abstract: The Claude Mythos Preview system card deploys emotion vectors, sparse autoencoder (SAE) features, and activation verbalisers to study model internals during misaligned behaviour. The two primary toolkits are not jointly reported on the most alignment-relevant episodes. This note identifies two hypotheses that are qualitatively consistent with the published results: that the emotion vectors track functional emotions that causally drive behaviour, or that they are a projection of a richer situational-context structure onto human emotional axes. The hypotheses can be distinguished by cross-referencing the two toolkits on episodes where only one is currently reported: most directly, applying emotion probes to the strategic concealment episodes analysed only with SAE features. If emotion probes show flat activation while SAE features are strongly active, the alignment-relevant structure lies outside the emotion subspace. Which hypothesis is correct determines whether emotion-based monitoring will robustly detect dangerous model behaviour or systematically miss it.

</details>


### [1023] [From Feelings to Metrics: Understanding and Formalizing How Users Vibe-Test LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.14137)
*Itay Itzhak,Eliya Habba,Gabriel Stanovsky,Yonatan Belinkov*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 用「vibe-testing」将用户的非正式体感评估转化为可复现的个性化评测流程，缩小静态基准与真实使用体验差距。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 主流基准分数难以反映模型在用户真实工作流中的价值，而广泛存在的「vibe-testing」又过于随意、无法规模化分析。

Method: 调研用户评测行为并收集网络模型对比报告，把vibe-testing拆成「个性化测试任务」+「基于用户主观标准的评判」两阶段，设计可自动生成个性化提示和按用户偏好评分的试验性评测框架，在编码任务上与传统基准对照。

Result: 引入个性化元素后，模型排名会相对于公开基准发生变化，验证了用户情境对偏好的实质影响；框架可在不牺牲可复现性的前提下再现这种变化。

Conclusion: 形式化的vibe-testing为连接静态基准与真实体验提供了一条可扩展的新路径，后续可推广至更多任务与领域并纳入更细粒度的用户画像。

Abstract: Evaluating LLMs is challenging, as benchmark scores often fail to capture models' real-world usefulness. Instead, users often rely on ``vibe-testing'': informal experience-based evaluation, such as comparing models on coding tasks related to their own workflow. While prevalent, vibe-testing is often too ad hoc and unstructured to analyze or reproduce at scale. In this work, we study how vibe-testing works in practice and then formalize it to support systematic analysis. We first analyze two empirical resources: (1) a survey of user evaluation practices, and (2) a collection of in-the-wild model comparison reports from blogs and social media. Based on these resources, we formalize vibe-testing as a two-part process: users personalize both what they test and how they judge responses. We then introduce a proof-of-concept evaluation pipeline that follows this formulation by generating personalized prompts and comparing model outputs using user-aware subjective criteria. In experiments on coding benchmarks, we find that combining personalized prompts and user-aware evaluation can change which model is preferred, reflecting the role of vibe-testing in practice. These findings suggest that formalized vibe-testing can serve as a useful approach for bridging benchmark scores and real-world experience.

</details>

### [1024] [Doubly Outlier-Robust Online Infinite Hidden Markov Model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.14322)
*Horace Yiu,Leandro Sánchez-Betancourt,Álvaro Cartea,Gerardo Duran-Martin*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 针对含异常值且有模型误设的流数据，提出 Batched Robust iHMM（BR-iHMM）；通过广义贝叶斯推断限定 PIF 有界，兼顾鲁棒与快速切换，在三个真实/合成数据集上将单步预测误差最高降 67%，并给出 PIF 有界理论保证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在线无限隐马尔可夫模型（iHMM）在异常值或模型误设下会迅速失效，传统在线贝叶斯方法缺乏鲁棒性与理论保障。

Method: 1）用广义贝叶斯构造鲁棒似然；2）定义并控制后验影响函数（PIF）有界的充分条件；3）引入批量更新与两个可调超参数，在鲁棒性与切换时滞间折中，得到 BR-iHMM 算法。

Result: 理论：证明在给定条件下 BR-iHMM 的 PIF 一致有界，不会因单点异常而爆炸。实验：在限价订单簿、小时级电力负荷与 30 维合成线性系统上，BR-iHMM 相对现有在线贝叶斯基线（含非鲁棒 iHMM 与 Rao-Blackwellized 粒子滤波）单步预测 MSE/CRPS 最多降 67%，且参数轨迹更稳定。

Conclusion: BR-iHMM 首次将“有界后验影响”这一鲁棒推断准则引入在线非参数时序建模，在具备可解释状态切换的同时提供严格鲁棒保证，为高维、异常污染流数据下的实时预测与在线学习提供了实用框架。

Abstract: We derive a robust update rule for the online infinite hidden Markov model (iHMM) for when the streaming data contains outliers and the model is misspecified. Leveraging recent advances in generalised Bayesian inference, we define robustness via the posterior influence function (PIF), and provide conditions under which the online iHMM has bounded PIF. Imposing robustness inevitably induces an adaptation lag for regime switching. Our method, which is called Batched Robust iHMM (BR-iHMM), balances adaptivity and robustness with two additional tunable parameters. Across limit order book data, hourly electricity demand, and a synthetic high-dimensional linear system, BR-iHMM reduces one-step-ahead forecasting error by up to 67% relative to competing online Bayesian methods. Together with theoretical guarantees of bounded PIF, our results highlight the practicality of our approach for both forecasting and interpretable online learning.

</details>


### [1025] [Differentially Private Conformal Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.14621)
*Jiamei Wu,Ce Zhang,Zhipeng Cai,Jingsen Kong,Bei Jiang,Linglong Kong,Lingchen Kong*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文提出差分共形预测（DPCP），在不拆分数据的前提下实现差分隐私（DP）框架下的高效预测区间，理论保证覆盖并显著优于现有拆分方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 共形预测虽能灵活量化不确定性，但与差分隐私结合时，现有拆分校准方法浪费数据、效率低；亟需一种无需拆分、统计效率高且端到端隐私保证的方案。

Method: 1) 引入“差分共形预测”（differential CP），利用 DP 机制的稳定性，将私有版本与理想无隐私 oracle CP 直接挂钩，避免数据拆分；2) 构建完整私有的 DPCP 流程：DP-ERM 训练模型＋私有分位机制校准；3) 在 ERM 和一般回归设定下分析覆盖与效率，给出端到端 (ε,δ)-DP 及有限样本覆盖界限。

Result: DPCP 在相同隐私预算下产生的预测集显著小于现有私有拆分共形方法；理论与实验均验证其覆盖概率达标且宽度更窄。

Conclusion: DPCP 首次实现无拆分、端到端 DP 的共形推断，兼顾隐私、覆盖与统计效率，为隐私敏感场景提供实用且可部署的不确定性量化工具。

Abstract: Conformal prediction (CP) has attracted broad attention as a simple and flexible framework for uncertainty quantification through prediction sets. In this work, we study how to deploy CP under differential privacy (DP) in a statistically efficient manner. We first introduce differential CP, a non-splitting conformal procedure that avoids the efficiency loss caused by data splitting and serves as a bridge between oracle CP and private conformal inference. By exploiting the stability properties of DP mechanisms, differential CP establishes a direct connection to oracle CP and inherits corresponding validity behavior. Building on this idea, we develop Differentially Private Conformal Prediction (DPCP), a fully private procedure that combines DP model training with a private quantile mechanism for calibration. We establish the end-to-end privacy guarantee of DPCP and investigate its coverage properties under additional regularity conditions. We further study the efficiency of both differential CP and DPCP under empirical risk minimization and general regression models, showing that DPCP can produce tighter prediction sets than existing private split conformal approaches under the same privacy budget. Numerical experiments on synthetic and real datasets demonstrate the practical effectiveness of the proposed methods.

</details>


### [1026] [Expert-Guided Class-Conditional Goodness-of-Fit Scores for Interpretable Classification with Informative Missingness: An Application to Seismic Monitoring](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.14809)
*Shahar Cohen,David M. Steinberg,Yael Radzyner,Yochai Ben Horin*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本研究针对带有普遍信息缺失、需整合专家先验、且要求规则可解释的三重挑战分类问题，提出“专家引导-先验知识融合-可解释特征”框架；通过专家模型生成的少量拟合优度特征与简洁辅助统计量组成透明分类器，在《全面禁止核试验条约》地震监测中共建决策规则；实验证明该框架在训练数据较少时仍可优于黑盒模型并显著减少人工筛查负担。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现存机器学习范式在核试验监测等高风险场景中面临三大痛点：1) 数据普遍存在带信息的缺失；2) 难以安全、形式化地引入领域专家已有知识；3) 黑盒模型输出不可解释，无法通过政治敏感的国际审查。亟需一种可在小样本下集成专家知识并输出可解释规则的分类方法。

Method: 方法包含四个步骤：i) 对若干类别，由专家提供类条件生成模型（likelihood + missingness 机制），作为先验知识编码；ii) 计算观测数据与专家模型的一致性分数，生成少量可解释的“拟合优度”特征，彻底隔离不同数据方面（含缺失部分）的贡献；iii) 补充几条透明统计摘要作为辅助特征；iv) 采用简易判别分类器（如稀疏逻辑回归）组合以上特征，直接得到可由式子表达的决策规则。

Result: 在真实 CTBTO 地震监测数据集上：① 该框架以可解释规则将需人工复核的检测降至不足原来的１/3；② 自定义模拟实验验证，当训练样本少至数百时，此法准确率和灵敏度均优于 XGBoost、RF 等强黑盒模型，且显著降低误检率；③ 生成的规则可直接映射到“P/S 波幅度比是否高于阈值”“深度与专家模型的相符度”等人可读懂的判定逻辑。

Conclusion: 结果表明：“将专家知识显式编码为概率模型→量化模型与数据的契合度→用可解释特征简化分类”的一整套思路，可在高风险、小样本、信息缺失场景下替代黑盒模型，提供安全、直观且性能相当甚至更好的决策规则，为核条约合规筛查及其他科学监测领域树立了可复制的范例。

Abstract: We study a classification problem with three key challenges: pervasive informative missingness, the integration of partial prior expert knowledge into the learning process, and the need for interpretable decision rules. We propose a framework that encodes prior knowledge through an expert-guided class-conditional model for one or more classes, and use this model to construct a small set of interpretable goodness-of-fit features. The features quantify how well the observed data agree with the expert model, isolating the contributions of different aspects of the data, including both observed and missing components. These features are combined with a few transparent auxiliary summaries in a simple discriminative classifier, resulting in a decision rule that is easy to inspect and justify. We develop and apply the framework in the context of seismic monitoring used to assess compliance with the Comprehensive Nuclear-Test-Ban Treaty. We show that the method has strong potential as a transparent screening tool, reducing workload for expert analysts. A simulation designed to isolate the contribution of the proposed framework shows that this interpretable expert-guided method can even outperform strong standard machine-learning classifiers, particularly when training samples are small.

</details>


### [1027] [Scalable Model-Based Clustering with Sequential Monte Carlo](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.14810)
*Connie Trojan,Pavel Myshkov,Paul Fearnhead,James Hensman,Tom Minka,Christopher Nemeth*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 针对流式聚类中的不确定性和规模化难题，提出一种基于子问题分解的低内存开销顺序蒙特卡洛聚类框架，在文本/知识库等复杂场景兼顾精度与效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 流式环境下聚类分配的潜在不确定性随文本等复杂分布急剧膨胀，传统SMC的高内存开销使其难以扩展到大型在线任务；针对大规模知识库构建场景，亟需一种轻量级、能保留不确定性推理能力的流式聚类方法。

Method: 将全局聚类问题拆分为近似独立的子问题，对每个子问题维护低维粒子集；合并所有子问题权重获取全局加权聚类估计，实现状态空间的紧凑表示，大幅降低粒子数和内存需求。

Result: 在文本和知识库构建数据集上，所提算法与标准SMC保持相近聚类精度和不确定性校准性能，而峰值内存下降一个数量级以上，运行时与主流流式聚类基线相当甚至更优；在硬件限制环境下仍能稳定、高效地完成大规模在线推断。

Conclusion: 通过在子问题层面进行SMC推理，可在保证聚类与不确定性质量的同时显著削减存储和计算成本，为大规模流式知识库构建等资源受限场景提供可扩展的不确定感知聚类框架，并启示其在其他类似高维分解问题中的潜力。

Abstract: In online clustering problems, there is often a large amount of uncertainty over possible cluster assignments that cannot be resolved until more data are observed. This difficulty is compounded when clusters follow complex distributions, as is the case with text data. Sequential Monte Carlo (SMC) methods give a natural way of representing and updating this uncertainty over time, but have prohibitive memory requirements for large-scale problems. We propose a novel SMC algorithm that decomposes clustering problems into approximately independent subproblems, allowing a more compact representation of the algorithm state. Our approach is motivated by the knowledge base construction problem, and we show that our method is able to accurately and efficiently solve clustering problems in this setting and others where traditional SMC struggles.

</details>


### [1028] [Best of both worlds: Stochastic & adversarial best-arm identification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.14860)
*Yasin Abbasi-Yadkori,Peter L. Bartlett,Victor Gabillon,Alan Malek,Michal Valko*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文证明“随机-对抗双重最优”的最佳臂识别原则上不可能完全达成，但能构造无需先验知识、对对抗环境鲁棒且在随机环境仍达理论下界（忽略对数因子）的简易算法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有最佳臂识别方法在随机奖励假设下可取得指数级小误差，但一旦奖励被对手操纵则性能崩溃；而对抗式算法虽鲁棒，在随机场景却浪费探索。能否在不知奖励性质的前提下，设计同时达到两种场景理论极限的算法，是强化学习理论与实际的核心开放问题。

Method: 1) 先对“随机-对抗同时具备最优误差率”的一般可行性给出否定答案，并量化鲁棒约束在随机问题中必然带来的误差放大；2) 推导该约束下的极小误差下界，表明任一对抗鲁棒策略在最坏随机实例中的误差率下限；3) 提出一种无需超参数调优的简单算法，证明其错误概率在随机模型中与下界仅差对数因子，同时在完全对抗奖励时仍保持最坏情况的鲁棒性能。

Result: 理论结果：给出首个“对抗鲁棒前提下随机误差率”的紧极小下界，揭示两种场景本质折中；算法结果：新算法的误差概率在随机环境达到</font>	ilde O(rac{1}{	riangle^2 n})<font style=""，与下界匹配；在对抗环境保持O(rac{1}{n})最坏误差率，实现双重近乎最优。

Conclusion: 在不知奖励生成机制时，无法同时对所有随机和对抗实例都严格最优，但通过引入鲁棒约束并设计参数无关算法，可在随机问题中逼近理论极限且不失对抗鲁棒性，为安全、自适应的臂识别提供了可部署的解决方案，也廓清了今后研究需在“先验检测”或“结构性假设”层面寻找折中。

Abstract: We study bandit best-arm identification with arbitrary and potentially adversarial rewards. A simple random uniform learner obtains the optimal rate of error in the adversarial scenario. However, this type of strategy is suboptimal when the rewards are sampled stochastically. Therefore, we ask: Can we design a learner that performs optimally in both the stochastic and adversarial problems while not being aware of the nature of the rewards? First, we show that designing such a learner is impossible in general. In particular, to be robust to adversarial rewards, we can only guarantee optimal rates of error on a subset of the stochastic problems. We give a lower bound that characterizes the optimal rate in stochastic problems if the strategy is constrained to be robust to adversarial rewards. Finally, we design a simple parameter-free algorithm and show that its probability of error matches (up to log factors) the lower bound in stochastic problems, and it is also robust to adversarial ones.

</details>


### [1029] [Unsupervised feature selection using Bayesian Tucker decomposition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.14949)
*Y-h. Taguchi,Yoh-ichi Mototake*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 文章提出贝叶斯Tucker分解(BTuD)，将残差建模为高斯分布，实现无监督特征选择，并在合成数据、全局耦合映射及基因表达谱上验证其有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统Tucker分解虽广泛应用，但缺乏不确定性估计与贝叶斯解释；作者希望借助概率框架提升无监督特征选择的鲁棒性与可解释性。

Method: 将Tucker分解改写为线性回归形式，假设残差服从高斯似然，对因子矩阵与核心张量引入共轭先验，推得后验分布并用EM或变分推断求解；迭代过程等价于高阶正交迭代，但附带概率正则化与自动相关性判定，实现无监督特征选择。

Result: 在合成数据、全局耦合映射(随机耦合强度)和真实基因表达数据集上，BTuD能准确识别关键特征，降维后聚类/分类性能优于传统TD及常用无监督特征选择方法；实验表明其选择结果与早期TD-based方法高度一致但更具鲁棒性。

Conclusion: BTuD为Tucker分解提供了概率化、可解释的无监督特征选择新途径，兼具理论严谨与实用优势，可推广至多领域高维张量数据分析。

Abstract: In this paper, we proposed Bayesian Tucker decomposition (BTuD) in which residual is supposed to obey Gaussian distribution analogous to linear regression. Although we have proposed an algorithm to perform the proposed BTuD, the conventional higher-order orthogonal iteration can generate Tucker decomposition consistent with the present implementation. Using the proposed BTuD, we can perform unsupervised feature selection successfully applied to various synthetic datasets, global coupled maps with randomized coupling strength, and gene expression profiles. Thus we can conclude that our newly proposed unsupervised feature selection method is promising. In addition to this, BTuD based unsupervised FE is expected to coincide with TD based unsupervised FE that were previously proposed and successfully applied to a wide range of problems.

</details>


### [1030] [MinShap: A Modified Shapley Value Approach for Feature Selection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.15107)
*Chenghui Zheng,Garvesh Raskutti*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文提出 MinShap——以最小边际贡献替代传统 Shapley 平均值的特征选择框架，并配套多重检验算法，理论保证Ⅰ型错误控制，实验显示其在非线性、高相关场景下优于 LOCO、GCM、Lasso。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 特征选择在高相关、非线性关系未知时仍极其困难；Shapley 值虽可解释非线性模型，但将直接/间接效应混为一谈，不宜直接用于选择。亟需一种既保留 Shapley 对复杂依赖的刻画能力、又能剔除间接效应、具备统计误差保证的变量选择工具。

Method: 1) 提出 MinShap：把 Shapley 值中对所有排列求平均改为取最小边际贡献，抑制通过其他变量传递的间接效应；2) 借鉴 DAG 忠实性假设建立因果关系解释，证明在零特征下 MinShap 的Ⅰ型错误可控；3) 引入 p 值/多重检验视角，提出 MinShap-Low-N 等系列算法，改进低样本表现并给出 FDR 类保证；4) 与 LOCO、GCM、Lasso 等进行系统对比。

Result: 合成与真实数据实验表明：MinShap 在精度、稳定性上显著优于当前最佳方法；在低样本场景下，MinShap-Low-N 等扩展算法进一步提升功效；理论证明 MinShap 在零效应特征上具有有限样本的Ⅰ型错误上界。

Conclusion: 通过“最小边际贡献”重构 Shapley 框架，MinShap 首次把博弈论解释能力与统计选择可靠性结合，为高相关、非线性特征选择提供兼具理论保证与实用优势的新范式，并可通过多重检验工具箱灵活扩展至小样本 regime。

Abstract: Feature selection is a classical problem in statistics and machine learning, and it continues to remain an extremely challenging problem especially in the context of unknown non-linear relationships with dependent features. On the other hand, Shapley values are a classic solution concept from cooperative game theory that is widely used for feature attribution in general non-linear models with highly-dependent features. However, Shapley values are not naturally suited for feature selection since they tend to capture both direct effects from each feature to the response and indirect effects through other features. In this paper, we combine the advantages of Shapley values and adapt them to feature selection by proposing \emph{MinShap}, a modification of the Shapley value framework along with a suite of other related algorithms. In particular for MinShap, instead of taking the average marginal contributions over permutations of features, considers the minimum marginal contribution across permutations.
