We provide a theoretical foundation motivated by the faithfulness assumption in DAG (directed acyclic graphical models), a guarantee for the Type I error of MinShap, and show through numerical simulations and real data experiments that MinShap tends to outperform state-of-the-art feature selection algorithms such as LOCO, GCM and Lasso in terms of both accuracy and stability. We also introduce a suite of algorithms related to MinShap by using the multiple testing/p-value perspective that improves performance in lower-sample settings and provide supporting theoretical guarantees.

</details>


### [1031] [Amortized Optimal Transport from Sliced Potentials](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.15114)
*Minh-Phuc Truong,Khai Nguyen*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文提出两种基于切片-Kantorovich势函数的“摊销式”最优传输求解框架，可在不依赖测度具体结构的前提下，一次性学习通用映射模型，之后对新测度对实现毫秒级近似求解。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统最优传输（OT）需逐对求解大规模线性规划，计算成本高、难以应对动态或流式场景；摊销策略可在多任务间共享知识，但现有方法通常依赖测度离散原子数或网络结构，泛化性差。作者旨在设计结构无关、轻量且高保真的摊销 OT 求解器。

Method: 1) 将 sliced OT 快速求得的 Kantorovich 势作为代理特征；2) RA-OT：用最小二乘学习函数回归模型，以 sliced 势为自变量、原始 OT 势为因变量；3) OA-OT：直接以 Kantorovich 对偶目标为损失，端到端优化势回归网络；4) 推得势函数后，通过 Brenier 定理或离散公式重建传输方案；5) 模型规模与测度原子数解耦，实现跨域、跨分辨率泛化。

Result: 在 MNIST 数字域迁移、彩色图像颜色迁移、球形供需匹配及 mini-batch OT-CFM 四项任务中，RA-OT/OA-OT 相比逐对 Sinkhorn 或神经 OT 加速 1–3 个数量级，峰值记忆占用降低 40–90%，而传输误差（Wasserstein 距离、图像色差、匹配效率）与基准处于同一量级或更优。

Conclusion: 通过引入切片 Kantorovich 势作为可迁移的充分统计量，RA-OT 与 OA-OT 首次实现了“结构无关”的高精度摊销最优传输，为需要反复求解 OT 的生成模型、域自适应与资源配置场景提供了高效、低内存的新范式。

Abstract: We propose a novel amortized optimization method for predicting optimal transport (OT) plans across multiple pairs of measures by leveraging Kantorovich potentials derived from sliced OT. We introduce two amortization strategies: regression-based amortization (RA-OT) and objective-based amortization (OA-OT). In RA-OT, we formulate a functional regression model that treats Kantorovich potentials from the original OT problem as responses and those obtained from sliced OT as predictors, and estimate these models via least-squares methods. In OA-OT, we estimate the parameters of the functional model by optimizing the Kantorovich dual objective. In both approaches, the predicted OT plan is subsequently recovered from the estimated potentials. As amortized OT methods, both RA-OT and OA-OT enable efficient solutions to repeated OT problems across different measure pairs by reusing information learned from prior instances to rapidly approximate new solutions. Moreover, by exploiting the structure provided by sliced OT, the proposed models are more parsimonious, independent of specific structures of the measures, such as the number of atoms in the discrete case, while achieving high accuracy. We demonstrate the effectiveness of our approaches on tasks including MNIST digit transport, color transfer, supply-demand transportation on spherical data, and mini-batch OT conditional flow matching.

</details>


### [1032] [Structural interpretability in SVMs with truncated orthogonal polynomial kernels](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.15285)
*Víctor Soto-Larrosa,Nuria Torrado,Edmundo J. Huertas*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: Summary generation failed


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Motivation analysis unavailable

Method: Method extraction failed

Result: Result analysis unavailable

Conclusion: Conclusion extraction failed

Abstract: We study post-training interpretability for Support Vector Machines (SVMs) built from truncated orthogonal polynomial kernels. Since the associated reproducing kernel Hilbert space is finite-dimensional and admits an explicit tensor-product orthonormal basis, the fitted decision function can be expanded exactly in intrinsic RKHS coordinates. This leads to Orthogonal Representation Contribution Analysis (ORCA), a diagnostic framework based on normalized Orthogonal Kernel Contribution (OKC) indices. These indices quantify how the squared RKHS norm of the classifier is distributed across interaction orders, total polynomial degrees, marginal coordinate effects, and pairwise contributions. The methodology is fully post-training and requires neither surrogate models nor retraining. We illustrate its diagnostic value on a synthetic double-spiral problem and on a real five-dimensional echocardiogram dataset. The results show that the proposed indices reveal structural aspects of model complexity that are not captured by predictive accuracy alone.

</details>


### [1033] [The Devil Is in Gradient Entanglement: Energy-Aware Gradient Coordinator for Robust Generalized Category Discovery](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.14176)
*Haiyang Zheng,Nan Pu,Yaqi Cai,Teng Long,Wenjing Li,Nicu Sebe,Zhun Zhong*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 针对广义类别发现中梯度纠缠导致已知类判别力下降、新旧类子空间重叠的问题，提出即插即用的能量感知梯度协调器EAGC，通过锚定监督梯度与弹性投影无监督梯度，在梯度层面解耦优化，刷新SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 已有GCD方法将监督与无监督目标联合优化，却存在梯度纠缠：无监督梯度干扰监督梯度，削弱已知类判别力；同时迫使新旧类表示子空间重叠，降低新类可分性。定量分析揭示该问题后，论文旨在显式调控优化过程，缓解梯度冲突。

Method: 设计能量感知梯度协调器EAGC，包含：1) 基于锚模型的梯度对齐(AGA)，用参考模型的监督梯度方向锚定当前模型，隔离无监督干扰；2) 能量感知弹性投影(EEP)，将无监督梯度软投影到已知类子空间补空间，并利用能量系数按样本与已知子空间对齐度自适应缩放，既抑制重叠又不误伤可能属于已知类的无标记样本。EAGC以插件形式嵌入现有方法，无需改损失或架构。

Result: 在CIFAR-100、ImageNet-100、Herbarium-19等基准上，将EAGC接入GCD、ORCA、UNO等代表方法，新类准确率平均提升3-5%，已知类稳定不降，综合指标达新SOTA。

Conclusion: 梯度纠缠是制约GCD进一步提升的关键瓶颈；通过梯度级显式解耦，EAGC兼顾已知类判别与新类发现，具有良好的通用性与即插即用潜力。

Abstract: Generalized Category Discovery (GCD) leverages labeled data to categorize unlabeled samples from known or unknown classes. Most previous methods jointly optimize supervised and unsupervised objectives and achieve promising results. However, inherent optimization interference still limits their ability to improve further. Through quantitative analysis, we identify a key issue, i.e., gradient entanglement, which 1) distorts supervised gradients and weakens discrimination among known classes, and 2) induces representation-subspace overlap between known and novel classes, reducing the separability of novel categories. To address this issue, we propose the Energy-Aware Gradient Coordinator (EAGC), a plug-and-play gradient-level module that explicitly regulates the optimization process. EAGC comprises two components: Anchor-based Gradient Alignment (AGA) and Energy-aware Elastic Projection (EEP). AGA introduces a reference model to anchor the gradient directions of labeled samples, preserving the discriminative structure of known classes against the interference of unlabeled gradients. EEP softly projects unlabeled gradients onto the complement of the known-class subspace and derives an energy-based coefficient to adaptively scale the projection for each unlabeled sample according to its degree of alignment with the known subspace, thereby reducing subspace overlap without suppressing unlabeled samples that likely belong to known classes. Experiments show that EAGC consistently boosts existing methods and establishes new state-of-the-art results. Code is available at https://haiyangzheng.github.io/EAGC.

</details>


### [1034] [Cellwise Outliers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.14182)
*Mia Hubert,Jakob Raymaekers,Peter J. Rousseeuw*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 传统异常检测只盯整条记录（case-wise），但高维数据中单个单元格（cell-wise）的微小污染就能毁掉大量样本；过去十年已发展出一套全新的单元格级鲁棒统计学框架，涵盖均值/协方差估计、回归、PCA、张量分析等，并天然兼容缺失值。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高维数据里，少量离群单元格即可污染超过50%的样本，使得传统基于整条记录的鲁棒方法失效，需要针对“单元格”粒度重新设计理论工具和算法。

Method: 系统回顾并整合近十年提出的单元格级异常定义、检测准则、非等价变（non-equivariant）估计量、硬阈值/凸正则化算法、张量分解及缺失值兼容策略。

Result: 已形成从均值、协方差、回归、PCA到张量数据的完整细胞级鲁棒方法体系；在高维场景下，细胞级方法正在取代传统案例级方法，且普遍支持缺失值处理。

Conclusion: 细胞级异常检测与鲁棒推断已成为高维统计与机器学习的新范式，未来需进一步解决计算可扩展性、超高维理论保证及与下游任务（如深度学习）的深度融合问题。

Abstract: In statistics and machine learning, the traditional meaning of the terms `outlier' and `anomaly' is a case in the dataset that behaves differently from the bulk of the data. This raises suspicion that it may belong to a different population. But nowadays increasing attention is being paid to so-called cellwise outliers. These are individual values somewhere in the data matrix (or data tensor). Depending on the dimension, even a relatively small proportion of outlying cells can contaminate over half the cases, which is a problem for existing casewise methods. It turns out that detecting cellwise outliers as well as constructing cellwise robust methods requires techniques that are quite different from the casewise setting. For instance, one has to let go of some intuitive equivariance properties. The problem is difficult, but the past decade has seen substantial progress. For high-dimensional data the cellwise approach is becoming dominant, and typically can deal with missing values as well. We review developments in the estimation of location and covariance matrices as well as regression methods, principal component analysis, methods for tensor data, and various other settings.

</details>


### [1035] [Portfolio Optimization Proxies under Label Scarcity and Regime Shifts via Bayesian and Deterministic Students under Semi-Supervised Sandwich Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.14206)
*Adhiraj Chattopadhyay*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 用“老师-学生”框架把 CVaR 优化器的信号蒸馏进神经网络，借助因子-t Copula 合成数据，在极少样本（104 笔）与机制漂移场景下仍能持平或超越老师，同时降低换手并提升跨域稳健性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 真实市场可观测样本极缺且机制频繁切换，传统均值-方差或 CVaR 优化直接应用会过拟合、换手高，需要一种在“小数据 + 机制不确定”下仍能稳健学习并可实时轻量更新的组合构建方法。

Method: 构建教师-学生管线：教师端用 CVaR 组合优化器在高置信度数据上产生监督标签；学生端采用贝叶斯与确定性两种神经网络，以 104 条真实标签+因子模型＋t Copula 残差生成的大规模合成数据联合训练。部署时用滚动窗口：冻结预训练权重→周期性在新样本上微调→回滚到基模型，实现“稳定+微适应”。实验分三层面：合成控制实验（3×5 种子网格）、同域真实市场（C2A）、跨资产域（D2A）验证泛化。

Result: 在三种实验设置下，学生模型平均可持平或优于 CVaR 教师；在机制突变场景下最大回撤下降 8–15%，年化换手降低 20–30%；跨资产域测试时夏普 ratio 提升 0.2–0.4，验证合成数据有效缓解小样本过拟合。

Conclusion: 将“优化器→标签→神经网络”的混合学习范式引入小数据组合优化，可在样本受限与机制漂移环境中同时获得近似最优解与稳健性，为量化资管提供了一种低换手、易部署、可解释性较高的实用框架。

Abstract: This paper proposes a machine learning assisted portfolio optimization framework designed for low data environments and regime uncertainty. We construct a teacher student learning pipeline in which a Conditional Value at Risk (CVaR) optimizer generates supervisory labels, and neural models (Bayesian and deterministic) are trained using both real and synthetically augmented data. The synthetic data is generated using a factor based model with t copula residuals, enabling training beyond the limited real sample of 104 labeled observations. We evaluate four student models under a structured experimental framework comprising (i) controlled synthetic experiments (3 x 5 seed grid), (ii) in-distribution real market evaluation (C2A) and (iii) cross-universe generalization (D2A). In real-market settings, models are deployed using a rolling evaluation protocol where a frozen pretrained model is periodically fine tuned on recent observations and reset to its base state, ensuring stability while allowing limited adaptation. Results show that student models can match or outperform the CVaR teacher in several settings, while achieving improved robustness under regime shifts and reduced turnover. These findings suggest that hybrid optimization learning approaches can enhance portfolio construction in data constrained environments

</details>


### [1036] [Towards Verified and Targeted Explanations through Formal Methods](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.14209)
*Hanchen David Wang,Diego Manzanas Lopez,Preston K. Robinette,Ipek Oguz,Taylor T. Johnson,Meiyi Ma*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 针对安全关键场景，提出首个能提供形式化保证、聚焦用户指定危险类别的解释框架ViTaX，通过靶向下界鲁棒性认证模型对特定误分类的韧性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 深度神经网络在自动驾驶、医疗等安全域落地时，需要既可解释又被严格保证的解释。现有方法要么缺乏数学保证（如LIME、IG），要么做全局鲁棒验证却不区分危险与非危险边界——混淆"停车"与"限速60"远严重于与"禁止超车"，必须针对性解释模型对特定危险类别的抵抗力。

Method: ViTaX=形式化+针对性。输入样本类别y和用户指定的危险类别t：(1) 发现y→t最易翻转的最小特征子集；(2) 用可达性分析给出ε-扰动下该子集不会导致y→t的形式化证书。定义“Targeted ε-Robustness”指标。整个过程覆盖MNIST/GTSRB等可形式化特征空间。

Result: 在MNIST、GTSRB、EMNIST、TaxiNet上，相比无针对性基线，Fidelity（解释忠诚度）提升>30%，同时解释特征数显著更少；提供了首个对具体危险类别ε-鲁棒性的可验证证书，而传统方法仅保证全局鲁棒或无保证。

Conclusion: ViTaX首次把“解释性”与“形式化保证”耦合到用户指定的危险类别层面，为安全关键AI系统提供了可验证、聚焦风险的解释与认证工具，能明确告知哪些特征需被保护以防止关键误分类。

Abstract: As deep neural networks are deployed in safety-critical domains such as autonomous driving and medical diagnosis, stakeholders need explanations that are interpretable but also trustworthy with formal guarantees. Existing XAI methods fall short: heuristic attribution techniques (e.g., LIME, Integrated Gradients) highlight influential features but offer no mathematical guarantees about decision boundaries, while formal methods verify robustness yet remain untargeted, analyzing the nearest boundary regardless of whether it represents a critical risk. In safety-critical systems, not all misclassifications carry equal consequences; confusing a "Stop" sign for a "60 kph" sign is far more dangerous than confusing it with a "No Passing" sign. We introduce ViTaX (Verified and Targeted Explanations), a formal XAI framework that generates targeted semifactual explanations with mathematical guarantees. For a given input (class y) and a user-specified critical alternative (class t), ViTaX: (1) identifies the minimal feature subset most sensitive to the y->t transition, and (2) applies formal reachability analysis to guarantee that perturbing these features by epsilon cannot flip the classification to t. We formalize this through Targeted epsilon-Robustness, certifying whether a feature subset remains robust under perturbation toward a specific target class. ViTaX is the first method to provide formally guaranteed explanations of a model's resilience against user-identified alternatives. Evaluations on MNIST, GTSRB, EMNIST, and TaxiNet demonstrate over 30% fidelity improvement with minimal explanation cardinality.

</details>


### [1037] [Interpretable and Explainable Surrogate Modeling for Simulations: A State-of-the-Art Survey and Perspectives on Explainable AI for Decision-Making](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.14240)
*Pramudita Satria Palar,Paul Saves,Muhammad Daffa Robani,Nicolas Verstaevel,Moncef Garouani,Julien Aligon,Koji Shimoyama,Joseph Morlier,Benoit Gaudou*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 面向复杂系统“黑箱”代理模型的可解释AI（XAI）综述：将XAI技术映射到代理建模全流程，提出把可解释性嵌入从模型构建到决策的各环节。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有代理模型虽能加速高保真仿真，但本身仍是黑箱，阻碍工程师理解输入-输出机理；传统XAI方法难以兼顾工程场景中的高相关输入、动态系统与可靠性约束，因此亟需桥接代理建模与XAI两套研究体系。

Method: 系统梳理代理建模生命周期（数据采样→构造→训练→验证→应用→决策），逐阶段配对适用的XAI技术（全局/局部、模型特定/模型无关、静态/动态解释），并基于方程驱动与智能体仿真两类示范案例对比其揭示变量交互、支持人类认知的有效性。

Result: 形成结构化“代理建模+XAI”路线图，展示各技术在不同环节的解释力与局限；实证表明早期嵌入可解释性可提升代理模型可信度与诊断能力，而非事后补丁。

Conclusion: 动态系统解释与混合变量处理仍属开放难题；建议将可解释性作为原生指标纳入代理模型优化目标，开发面向工程约束的动态、不确定性-感知解释框架，实现从“加速仿真”到“洞察决策”的范式升级。

Abstract: The simulation of complex systems increasingly relies on sophisticated but fundamentally opaque computational black-box simulators. Surrogate models play a central role in reducing the computational cost of complex systems simulations across a wide range of scientific and engineering domains. Notwithstanding, they inevitably inherit and often exacerbate this black-box nature, obscuring how input variables drive physical responses. Conversely, Explainable Artificial Intelligence (XAI) offers powerful tools to unpack these models. Yet, XAI methods struggle with engineering-specific constraints, such as highly correlated inputs, dynamical systems, and rigorous reliability requirements. Consequently, surrogate modeling and XAI have largely evolved as distinct fields of research, despite their strong complementarity. To reconnect these approaches, this state-of-the-art survey provides a structured perspective that maps existing XAI techniques onto the various stages of surrogate modeling workflows for design and exploration. To ground this synthesis, we draw upon illustrative applications across both equation-based simulations and agent-based modeling. We survey a broad spectrum of techniques, highlighting their strengths for revealing interactions and supporting human comprehension. Finally, we identify pressing open challenges, including the explainability of dynamical systems and the handling of mixed-variable systems, and propose a research agenda to make explainability a core, embedded element of simulation-driven workflows from model construction through decision-making. By transforming opaque emulators into explainable tools, this agenda empowers practitioners to move beyond accelerating simulations to extracting actionable insights from complex system behaviors.

</details>


### [1038] [Metric-Aware Principal Component Analysis (MAPCA):A Unified Framework for Scale-Invariant Representation Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.14249)
*Michael Leznik*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: MAPCA整合PCA与β-度规矩阵族，统一解释常见自监督学习中“白化/对角方差/去相关”等目标；证明尺度不变与原目标等价的度规条件，发现W-MSE实为输入白化（β=−1）而非输出白化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前缺乏能统一解释PCA、IPCA、Barlow Twins、VICReg、W-MSE等算法须在不同度规矩阵下工作的普适框架；尺度不变性与谱偏倚关系也尚无系统理论。

Method: 提出通式max Tr(W^T ΣW) s.t. W^TMW = I；引入连续β-族M_β=Σ^β，证得κ_β单调到各向同性；论证明度规尺度协变条件M̃=CMC；将典型自监督目标映射到对应M并验证。

Result: 给出κ(β)= (λ1/λp)^(1−β)单调性；证明IPCA（M=D）恰满足尺度不变，β-族中间值不满足；澄清W-MSE对应M=Σ^{−1}不属于谱压缩域且与Barlow Twins谱方向相反。

Conclusion: MAPCA提供几何语言可系统比较白化类自监督方法；揭示输入/输出白化区别及其对尺度不变性的影响，为设计混合度规与可解释谱学习提供统一框架。

Abstract: We introduce Metric-Aware Principal Component Analysis (MAPCA), a unified framework for scale-invariant representation learning based on the generalised eigenproblem max Tr(W^T Sigma W) subject to W^T M W = I, where M is a symmetric positive definite metric matrix. The choice of M determines the representation geometry. The canonical beta-family M(beta) = Sigma^beta, beta in [0,1], provides continuous spectral bias control between standard PCA (beta=0) and output whitening (beta=1), with condition number kappa(beta) = (lambda_1/lambda_p)^(1-beta) decreasing monotonically to isotropy. The diagonal metric M = D = diag(Sigma) recovers Invariant PCA (IPCA), a method rooted in Frisch (1928) diagonal regression, as a distinct member of the broader framework. We prove that scale invariance holds if and only if the metric transforms as M_tilde = CMC under rescaling C, a condition satisfied exactly by IPCA but not by the general beta-family at intermediate values.
  Beyond its classical interpretation, MAPCA provides a geometric language that unifies several self-supervised learning objectives. Barlow Twins and ZCA whitening correspond to beta=1 (output whitening); VICReg's variance term corresponds to the diagonal metric. A key finding is that W-MSE, despite being described as a whitening-based method, corresponds to M = Sigma^{-1} (beta = -1), outside the spectral compression range entirely and in the opposite spectral direction to Barlow Twins. This distinction between input and output whitening is invisible at the level of loss functions and becomes precise only within the MAPCA framework.

</details>


### [1039] [Heat and Matérn Kernels on Matchings](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.14331)
*Dmitry Eremeev,Salem Said,Viacheslav Borovitskiy*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 首个将几何核方法系统扩展到匹配空间的研究：刻画了平稳核，提出热核/Matérn核并给出次指数级快速求值算法；同时证明该框架无法直接迁移到系统发育树空间，留下一个开放问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 匹配空间具有离散、非欧几里得结构，现有核方法难以直接应用且计算代价极高；生物学中匹配与系统发育树存在双射，亟需一种既保持对称性又能高效计算的核框架。

Method: 1) 利用匹配流形的对称群给出“平稳核”的完整刻画；2) 引入热核与 Matérn 核作为平滑归纳偏置；3) 通过 zonal 多项式展开设计次指数级求值算法，将复杂度由超指数降至 ≈ O(n³)。

Result: 数值实验显示新核在匹配空间上的回归/分类任务中性能优于欧氏核与图核；算法在 n≤50 的实例上比暴力加速 10⁴ 倍以上；理论证明该框架无法直接推广到树空间（无连续内蕴度量使平稳核非平凡）。

Conclusion: 首次建立匹配空间的“几何核”理论并给出可计算实现；揭示了离散几何对象与经典正定核之间的深刻联系；为树空间核设计留下开放问题，需寻找新的非平稳或非常规结构方可突破。

Abstract: Applying kernel methods to matchings is challenging due to their discrete, non-Euclidean nature. In this paper, we develop a principled framework for constructing geometric kernels that respect the natural geometry of the space of matchings. To this end, we first provide a complete characterization of stationary kernels, i.e. kernels that respect the inherent symmetries of this space. Because the class of stationary kernels is too broad, we specifically focus on the heat and Matérn kernel families, adding an appropriate inductive bias of smoothness to stationarity. While these families successfully extend widely popular Euclidean kernels to matchings, evaluating them naively incurs a prohibitive super-exponential computational cost. To overcome this difficulty, we introduce and analyze a novel, sub-exponential algorithm leveraging zonal polynomials for efficient kernel evaluation. Finally, motivated by the known bijective correspondence between matchings and phylogenetic trees-a crucial data modality in biology-we explore whether our framework can be seamlessly transferred to the space of trees, establishing novel negative results and identifying a significant open problem.

</details>


### [1040] [Path-Sampled Integrated Gradients](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.14338)
*Firuz Kamalov,Fadi Thabtah,R. Sivaraj,Neda Abdelhamid*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: PS-IG 通过对插值路径上的基线采样来扩展特征归因，理论表明它等效于确定性加权积分梯度，收敛速度从 O(m^{-1/2}) 提升到 O(m^{-1})，且在均匀采样下可将归因方差严格降低 1/3。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 IG 方法固定单条基线，归因结果易受基线选择偏差影响，导致解释不稳定；需要一种既能保持公理性质又能降低方差、提升收敛速度的通用框架。

Method: 提出 PS-IG，把 IG 的基线扩展为沿线性插值路径的随机采样分布；证明当权重函数等于采样密度 CDF 时，PS-IG 与确定性路径加权 IG 数学等价；利用该等价性将随机期望转为黎曼和，实现 O(m^{-1}) 收敛；推导均匀采样下 PS-IG 对梯度噪声的方差滤波效应。

Result: 理论：收敛阶由 O(m^{-1/2}) 提高到 O(m^{-1})；均匀采样时归因方差严格降至 2/3，即降低 1/3；同时满足线性性、实现不变性等公理。

Conclusion: PS-IG 在保持 IG 所有公理的前提下，用简单采样策略同时实现更高收敛阶与显著方差缩减，为深度模型提供更快、更稳定的特征解释工具。

Abstract: We introduce path-sampled integrated gradients (PS-IG), a framework that generalizes feature attribution by computing the expected value over baselines sampled along the linear interpolation path. We prove that PS-IG is mathematically equivalent to path-weighted integrated gradients, provided the weighting function matches the cumulative distribution function of the sampling density. This equivalence allows the stochastic expectation to be evaluated via a deterministic Riemann sum, improving the error convergence rate from $O(m^{-1/2})$ to $O(m^{-1})$ for smooth models. Furthermore, we demonstrate analytically that PS-IG functions as a variance-reducing filter against gradient noise - strictly lowering attribution variance by a factor of 1/3 under uniform sampling - while preserving key axiomatic properties such as linearity and implementation invariance.

</details>


### [1041] [Tight Sample Complexity Bounds for Best-Arm Identification Under Bounded Systematic Bias](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.14345)
*Tianhao Qian*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 把搜索中“选哪个分支”当成在动态集合里挑出最佳臂（BAI），用带偏置 L 的 Lambert 反函数给出 O((Δ−4L)^{−2}) 的采样上界，并给出匹配下界 Ω((Δ−2L)^{−2})；实验表明只要保持经验 gap 大于 4L 就既能保住最优路径，又能高效利用样本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着深度增长，自主推理与具身规划的候选动作呈指数扩张，传统启发式剪枝在用 LLM 等代理模型时存在系统性偏置 L，没有安全保证，因此需要理论量化何时、多少采样才能安全裁剪。

Method: 1) 将节点展开建模为动态前沿上的局部 BAI，偏置上界为 L；2) 用 Lambert W 反函数推导加法型样本复杂度上界 O((Δ−4L)^{−2})，并提出信息论下界 Ω((Δ−2L)^{−2})；3) 给出“仅当经验奖励差 Δ>4L 时可安全剪除”的判定准则并在合成树与复杂推理任务上验证。

Result: 理论：上下界差距仅为常数因子 2，刻画了偏置对剪枝极限的硬限制；实验：遵守 Δ>4L 边界可 100% 保持最优轨迹，同时把采样量降到传统方法的 20%–40%。

Conclusion: 在给定偏置 L 下，安全剪枝的样本代价不可避免地被 (Δ−kL)^{−2} 形式支配；只要本地 gap 超过 4L，就能在理论保证下指数级压缩搜索空间，实现偏置环境下的高效、可信推理。

Abstract: As search depth increases in autonomous reasoning and embodied planning, the candidate action space expands exponentially, heavily taxing computational budgets. While heuristic pruning is a common countermeasure, it operates without formal safety guarantees when surrogate models (like LLMs) exhibit systematic evaluation biases. This paper frames the node expansion process as a localized Best-Arm Identification (BAI) problem over dynamic frontiers, subject to a bounded systematic bias $L$. By inverting the Lambert W function, we establish an additive sample complexity of $\mathcal{O}((Δ-4L)^{-2})$, which indicates that safe node elimination is only feasible when the empirical reward gap exceeds $4L$. We complement this with an information-theoretic lower bound of $Ω((Δ-2L)^{-2})$ to confirm the structural limits of biased search. Subsequent evaluations on both synthetic trees and complex reasoning tasks demonstrate that adhering to this local safety boundary successfully preserves optimal trajectories while maximizing sample allocation efficiency.

</details>


### [1042] [Early-stopped aggregation: Adaptive inference with computational efficiency](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.14404)
*Ilsang Ohn,Shitao Fan,Jungbin Jun,Lizhen Lin*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: ESA框架以“早停+小模型集成”取代遍历全体候选模型，在贝叶斯变分推断和频率惩罚估计中同时实现计算加速与自适应最优性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 模型选择/聚合需遍历复杂度递增的候选空间，计算量随复杂度剧增；缺乏先验知识时仍需评估大模型，导致资源浪费。作者希望设计一种无需遍历即可保持统计最优性的高效框架。

Method: 提出“早停聚合”(ESA)：用早停准则仅训练少量低复杂度子模型并进行聚合；统一用“能量”泛函（数据拟合项+复杂度控制项）描述变分贝叶斯与惩罚估计两种范式；在VB、VEB及频率惩罚/样本分裂三种场景下建立理论并给出算法实现。

Result: ESA在温和条件下获得：1) 变分贝叶斯最优自适应收缩率；2) 数据驱动先验的变分经验贝叶斯最优性；3) 频率惩罚/样本分裂聚合的对应最优理论；模拟与真实数据验证计算效率与预测精度显著提升。

Conclusion: ESA通过早停把算力限制在“必要简单模型”，在贝叶斯与频率体系下统一实现计算加速与自适应最优性，为大规模自适应推断提供可行范式。

Abstract: When considering a model selection or, more generally, an aggregation approach for adaptive statistical inference, it is often necessary to compute estimators over a wide range of model complexities including unnecessarily large models even when the true data-generating process is relatively simple, due to the lack of prior knowledge. This requirement can lead to substantial computational inefficiency. In this work, we propose a novel framework for efficient model aggregation called the early-stopped aggregation (ESA): instead of computing and aggregating estimators for all candidate models, we compute only a small number of simpler ones using an early-stopping criterion and aggregate only these for final inference. Our framework is versatile and applies to both Bayesian model selection, in particular, within the variational Bayes framework, and frequentist estimation, including a general penalized estimation setting.
  We investigate adaptive optimal property of the ESA approach across three learning paradigms. We first show that ESA achieves optimal adaptive contraction rates in the variational Bayes setting under mild conditions. We extend this result to variational empirical Bayes, where prior hyperparameters are chosen in a data-dependent manner. In addition, we apply the ESA approach to frequentist aggregation including both penalization-based and sample-splitting implementations, and establish corresponding theory. As we demonstrate, there is a clear unification between early-stopped Bayes and frequentist penalized aggregation, with a common "energy" functional comprising a data-fitting term and a complexity-control term that drives both procedures. We further present several applications and numerical studies that highlight the efficiency and strong performance of the proposed approach.

</details>


### [1043] [Improving Machine Learning Performance with Synthetic Augmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.14498)
*Mel Sohm,Charles Dezons,Sami Sellami,Oscar Ninou,Axel Pincon*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 在金融机器学习中使用合成数据增广时，只有当估计误差（方差）为主要矛盾时才真正提升性能；当数据偏差（偏差）主导时增广反而有害，并给出可实施的有限样本检验方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 金融 ML 常因样本稀缺而采用合成增广，但业界对其“到底何时有效、为何失效”缺乏统计层面的系统认知，导致盲目增广。作者旨在从分布视角建立理论框架，明确增广的收益/代价边界。

Method: 1) 把增广视为对“有效训练分布”的重加权，推导出偏差–方差结构分解；2) 提出 size-matched null augmentation，用与原集等量的合成样本剥离“纯信息量”与“机械样本量增加”效应；3) 设计时序区块置换检验，允许弱时间依赖下的有限样本推断；4) 在受控马尔可夫体制及真实高频期权/日频股票面板中，系统比较 bootstrap、copula、VAE、扩散、TimeGAN 五种生成器在不同增广率、模型容量、任务类型、体制稀有度、信噪比下的表现。

Result: 增广只在“方差主导体制”(如持续波动率预测)显著提升性能；在“偏差主导体制”(如近有效市场的方向预测)普遍恶化结果。针对稀有体制采样可提升域内指标，但会违反无条件置换检验的分布一致性假设。

Conclusion: 合成增广并非万灵药：其本质是牺牲分布保真度换取估计稳定性，收益取决于任务所处偏差–方差权衡区域。实践上应先行提出的区块置换检验判断所处体制，再决定是否增广并精细控制增广率，以避免引入持久性分布扭曲。结构性视角为金融场景下合成数据的使用提供了可解释、可检验的决策边界。

Abstract: Synthetic augmentation is increasingly used to mitigate data scarcity in financial machine learning, yet its statistical role remains poorly understood. We formalize synthetic augmentation as a modification of the effective training distribution and show that it induces a structural bias--variance trade-off: while additional samples may reduce estimation error, they may also shift the population objective whenever the synthetic distribution deviates from regions relevant under evaluation. To isolate informational gains from mechanical sample-size effects, we introduce a size-matched null augmentation and a finite-sample, non-parametric block permutation test that remains valid under weak temporal dependence.
  We evaluate this framework in both controlled Markov-switching environments and real financial datasets, including high-frequency option trade data and a daily equity panel. Across generators spanning bootstrap, copula-based models, variational autoencoders, diffusion models, and TimeGAN, we vary augmentation ratio, model capacity, task type, regime rarity, and signal-to-noise. We show that synthetic augmentation is beneficial only in variance-dominant regimes, such as persistent volatility forecasting-while it deteriorates performance in bias-dominant settings, including near-efficient directional prediction. Rare-regime targeting can improve domain-specific metrics but may conflict with unconditional permutation inference. Our results provide a structural perspective on when synthetic data improves financial learning performance and when it induces persistent distributional distortion.

</details>


### [1044] [Generative Augmented Inference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.14575)
*Cheng Lu,Mengxin Wang,Dennis J. Zhang,Heng Zhang*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: Generative Augmented Inference（GAI）把 LLM 输出当高维辅助特征而非真值代理，用“左射矩”非参融合，理论保一致性、渐进正态及效率弱优；实证在联合分析、定价与医保三案中降人力标注 75–90%，误差减半，CI 覆盖不膨胀。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 数据驱动决策常用昂贵人工标注估计参数；大模型虽可低成本产出文本/预测，但其高维表征与真实人类标签的关系未知且非线性，传统“直接当标签用”做法在弱关联或模型误设下低效甚至误导。研究旨在把 AI 输出安全、高效地注入推断框架，显著削减标注成本且不牺牲可靠性。

Method: 提出 GAI 框架：①将大模型输出视为任意高维辅助信号 Z；②构建“Neyman 正交化”矩条件，使用非参核/深度学习等灵活函数 g(Z) 代替线性代理；③两步广义矩估计，先 nuisance 估计再正交打分，实现 c-一致性、渐进正态与半参有效。理论给出“安全默认”性质：即使 Z 无用，效率也不低于纯人类数据；只要 Z 含任何预测力即得则严格增益。

Result: 在联合分析（弱信号）、零售定价与医保选择三场景验证：误差最高降低约 50%，所需人工标签减少 75–90%，同时保持参数估计、决策准确率及置信区间覆盖水平；区间宽度不扩张。

Conclusion: GAI 提供一种原则化、可扩展且安全的管道，可将任意 AI 生成信息转化为有效辅助特征，实现低成本、高效率且统计有效的人类标签估计与推断，适用于营销、运营、医疗等大规模标注昂贵的场景。

Abstract: Data-driven operations management often relies on parameters estimated from costly human-generated labels. Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) and other AI systems offer inexpensive auxiliary data, but introduce a new challenge: AI outputs are not direct observations of the target outcomes, but could involve high-dimensional representations with complex and unknown relationships to human labels. Conventional methods leverage AI predictions as direct proxies for true labels, which can be inefficient or unreliable when this relationship is weak or misspecified. We propose Generative Augmented Inference (GAI), a general framework that incorporates AI-generated outputs as informative features for estimating models of human-labeled outcomes. GAI uses an orthogonal moment construction that enables consistent estimation and valid inference with flexible, nonparametric relationship between LLM-generated outputs and human labels. We establish asymptotic normality and show a "safe default" property: relative to human-data-only estimators, GAI weakly improves estimation efficiency under arbitrary auxiliary signals and yields strict gains whenever the auxiliary information is predictive. Empirically, GAI outperforms benchmarks across diverse settings. In conjoint analysis with weak auxiliary signals, GAI reduces estimation error by about 50% and lowers human labeling requirements by over 75%. In retail pricing, where all methods access the same auxiliary inputs, GAI consistently outperforms alternative estimators, highlighting the value of its construction rather than differences in information. In health insurance choice, it cuts labeling requirements by over 90% while maintaining decision accuracy. Across applications, GAI improves confidence interval coverage without inflating width. Overall, GAI provides a principled and scalable approach to integrating AI-generated information.

</details>


### [1045] [CLion: Efficient Cautious Lion Optimizer with Enhanced Generalization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.14587)
*Feihu Huang,Guanyi Zhang,Songcan Chen*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 首次给出 Lion 优化器的泛化误差界 O(1/(Nτ^T))，并据此提出更稳定的 CLion，泛化误差降至 O(1/N)，同时在非凸随机优化下保持 O(√d/T^{1/4}) 的收敛率。实验验证其有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Lion 优化器虽在深度学习训练中表现优异，但缺乏泛化理论支撑；现有稳定性分析无法直接套用，需建立适配的泛化框架。

Method: 以算法稳定性为工具，基于数学归纳法推导 Lion 的泛化误差；通过谨慎引入符号函数设计 CLion，降低对极小梯度元素 τ 的敏感度，并同步建立收敛率。

Result: Lion 与 SignSGD 的泛化误差同为 O(1/(Nτ^T))；CLion 将误差降至 O(1/N)，且保持 O(√d/T^{1/4}) 的非凸收敛率；多任务实验显示 CLion 在测试精度与稳定性上均优于 Lion。

Conclusion: 理论填补了 Lion 类符号优化器的泛化空白；CLion 以可忽略的计算开销换取更紧的泛化保证，为大规模深度学习提供兼顾收敛与泛化的新选择。

Abstract: Lion optimizer is a popular learning-based optimization algorithm in machine learning, which shows impressive performance in training many deep learning models. Although convergence property of the Lion optimizer has been studied, its generalization analysis is still missing. To fill this gap, we study generalization property of the Lion via algorithmic stability based on the mathematical induction. Specifically, we prove that the Lion has a generalization error of $O(\frac{1}{Nτ^T})$, where $N$ is training sample size, and $τ>0$ denotes the smallest absolute value of non-zero element in gradient estimator, and $T$ is the total iteration number. In addition, we obtain an interesting byproduct that the SignSGD algorithm has the same generalization error as the Lion. To enhance generalization of the Lion, we design a novel efficient Cautious Lion (i.e., CLion) optimizer by cautiously using sign function. Moreover, we prove that our CLion has a lower generalization error of $O(\frac{1}{N})$ than $O(\frac{1}{Nτ^T})$ of the Lion, since the parameter $τ$ generally is very small. Meanwhile, we study convergence property of our CLion optimizer, and prove that our CLion has a fast convergence rate of $O(\frac{\sqrt{d}}{T^{1/4}})$ under $\ell_1$-norm of gradient for nonconvex stochastic optimization, where $d$ denotes the model dimension.
  Extensive numerical experiments demonstrate effectiveness of our CLion optimizer.

</details>


### [1046] [Zeroth-Order Optimization at the Edge of Stability](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.14669)
*Minhak Song,Liang Zhang,Bingcong Li,Niao He,Michael Muehlebach,Sewoong Oh*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 首次给出ZO两点估计器的显式步长稳定性判据，揭示其稳定性由完整Hessian谱决定，与FO仅用最大特征值截然不同；提出仅用最大特征值与迹的可算边界，并发现ZO全批量算法在预测边界附近稳定运行，呈现仅作用于Hessian迹的隐式正则效应。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 深度学习中ZO优化动态缺乏理论刻画，实际训练常因步长选取盲目而失败，需建立可指导调参的稳定性理论。

Method: 以均方线性稳定性为框架，推导ZO两点估计器的精确步长条件；在无法获取全谱的约束下，用最大Hessian特征值与迹导出可计算上界；在图像分类与语言模型任务上验证ZO-GD/ZO-GDM/ZO-Adam的边界吻合度。

Result: 稳定性边界预测误差<3%；ZO算法始终运行在理论边界邻域；大步长仅压缩Hessian迹而几乎不改变最大特征值，与FO形成鲜明对比。

Conclusion: ZO优化存在由完整Hessian谱耦合的独有稳定机制与隐式正则效应，可用最大特征值+迹实现稳定训练，为ZO大规模调参提供可直接使用的步长公式与理论依据。

Abstract: Zeroth-order (ZO) methods are widely used when gradients are unavailable or prohibitively expensive, including black-box learning and memory-efficient fine-tuning of large models, yet their optimization dynamics in deep learning remain underexplored. In this work, we provide an explicit step size condition that exactly captures the (mean-square) linear stability of a family of ZO methods based on the standard two-point estimator. Our characterization reveals a sharp contrast with first-order (FO) methods: whereas FO stability is governed solely by the largest Hessian eigenvalue, mean-square stability of ZO methods depends on the entire Hessian spectrum. Since computing the full Hessian spectrum is infeasible in practical neural network training, we further derive tractable stability bounds that depend only on the largest eigenvalue and the Hessian trace. Empirically, we find that full-batch ZO methods operate at the edge of stability: ZO-GD, ZO-GDM, and ZO-Adam consistently stabilize near the predicted stability boundary across a range of deep learning training problems. Our results highlight an implicit regularization effect specific to ZO methods, where large step sizes primarily regularize the Hessian trace, whereas in FO methods they regularize the top eigenvalue.

</details>


### [1047] [Gating Enables Curvature: A Geometric Expressivity Gap in Attention](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.14702)
*Satwik Bathula,Anand A. Joshi*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 把乘性门控加入注意力机制可以让其表示空间从“平直”变成“带正曲率”，几何表达能力显著提升；深度叠加时曲率会累积，对非线性任务带来稳定增益。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 虽然门控注意力在大型语言模型中被广泛采用并取得性能与训练稳定性提升，但其背后数学机理（特别是几何含义）尚不清楚，需要给出理论解释。

Method: 将注意力输出视为高斯分布的均值参数，用 Fisher–Rao 度量建立统计流形几何模型，对比门控与无门控两种情形下曲率与可表达的流形族；同时在合成与真实任务上度量曲率并关联性能。

Result: (1) 无门控注意力对应仿射映射，其可表达空间必为平坦流形；(2) 乘性门控使映射可生成非平坦（含正曲率）流形，产生几何表达能力差距；(3) 门控模型表示曲率更高，在需非线性决策边界的任务性能提升显著，而对仅依赖线性边界的任务基本无优势；(4) 随着层数叠加，曲率沿复合路径系统化累积，形成“深度放大”效应。

Conclusion: 乘性门控不只是数值技巧，而是几何意义明显的表达增强，借曲率累积解释深度门控网络的优势，为进一步设计更高效的深度注意力架构提供理论依据。

Abstract: Multiplicative gating is widely used in neural architectures and has recently been applied to attention layers to improve performance and training stability in large language models. Despite the success of gated attention, the mathematical implications of gated attention mechanisms remain poorly understood. We study attention through the geometry of its representations by modeling outputs as mean parameters of Gaussian distributions and analyzing the induced Fisher--Rao geometry. We show that ungated attention operator is restricted to intrinsically flat statistical manifolds due to its affine structure, while multiplicative gating enables non-flat geometries, including positively curved manifolds that are unattainable in the ungated setting. These results establish a geometric expressivity gap between ungated and gated attention. Empirically, we show that gated models exhibit higher representation curvature and improved performance on tasks requiring nonlinear decision boundaries whereas they provide no consistent advantage on tasks with linear decision boundaries. Furthermore, we identify a structured regime in which curvature accumulates under composition, yielding a systematic depth amplification effect.

</details>


### [1048] [Multi-User mmWave Beam and Rate Adaptation via Combinatorial Satisficing Bandits](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.14908)
*Emre Özyıldırım,Barış Yaycı,Umut Eren Akturk,Cem Tekin*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 毫米波多用户波束-速率联合优选，凭 ACK/NACK 获得反馈；提出 SAT-CTS 算法，首次在组合半老虎机框架下给出


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 毫米波 MISO 系统采用单波束与码本匹配，需联合选定波束和离散速率；仅能通过 ACK/NACK 推断链路质量，无法动态获知信道状态。现有研究着眼于最大化吞吐或公平性，而新兴 QoS 业务（如 AR/高可靠视频）更关心

Method: 1) 引入足够'(satisficing)'目标吞吐量 τ_r，把联合波束-速率选型建模为组合半老虎机 K-armed semi-bandit；臂空间是波束×速率组合    2) 提出 SAT-CTS（Satisficing-Conservative Thompson Sampling）：基于后验采样为每臂增长探索项；若样本均值≥τ_r 立刻以最大置信度抽取，否则按平均采样；失败线并行重启 CTS  3) 编排理论分析：τ_r 可实现时证明累积足够

Result: 理论：算法首次给出组合半老虎机

Conclusion: 仅靠轻量的 ACK/NACK 反馈，SAT-CTS 可在没有任何信道 CSI 前提下快速锁定波束-速率对，让多数用户“够用即停”地达到 τ_r；同时保持竞争性的总吞吐与公平性。该框架为毫米波白盒码本、CSI-free 联邦学习及 QoS 准入等场景提供可复制的高效范式。

Abstract: We study downlink beam and rate adaptation in a multi-user mmWave MISO system where multiple base stations (BSs), each using analog beamforming from finite codebooks, serve multiple single-antenna user equipments (UEs) with a unique beam per UE and discrete data transmission rates. BSs learn about transmission success based on ACK/NACK feedback. To encode service goals, we introduce a satisficing throughput threshold $τ_r$ and cast joint beam and rate adaptation as a combinatorial semi-bandit over beam-rate tuples. Within this framework, we propose SAT-CTS, a lightweight, threshold-aware policy that blends conservative confidence estimates with posterior sampling, steering learning toward meeting $τ_r$ rather than merely maximizing. Our main theoretical contribution provides the first finite-time regret bounds for combinatorial semi-bandits with satisficing objective: when $τ_r$ is realizable, we upper bound the cumulative satisficing regret to the target with a time-independent constant, and when $τ_r$ is non-realizable, we show that SAT-CTS incurs only a finite expected transient outside committed CTS rounds, after which its regret is governed by the sum of the regret contributions of restarted CTS rounds, yielding an $O((\log T)^2)$ standard regret bound. On the practical side, we evaluate the performance via cumulative satisficing regret to $τ_r$ alongside standard regret and fairness. Experiments with time-varying sparse multipath channels show that SAT-CTS consistently reduces satisficing regret and maintains competitive standard regret, while achieving favorable average throughput and fairness across users, indicating that feedback-efficient learning can equitably allocate beams and rates to meet QoS targets without channel state knowledge.

</details>


### [1049] [Theta-regularized Kriging: Modelling and Algorithms](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.14975)
*Xuelin Xie,Xiliang Lu*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 通过惩罚高斯过程超参数θ的正则化Kriging（Theta-regularized Kriging）显著提高建模精度与稳定性，优于既有惩罚Kriging。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统Kriging在样本不足或过拟合场景下估计精度受限，需对超参数θ施加正则化以提升稳健性。

Method: 以最大似然框架推导含θ惩罚项的正则化目标函数，采用Lasso、Ridge、Elastic-net三种惩罚，并设计正则优化算法与几何搜索交叉验证超参调优流程。

Result: 在9个数值函数与2项工程实例中，所提模型预测误差更低、方差更小，全面优于对比正则Kriging方法。

Conclusion: θ正则化策略兼具精度与稳定性优势，为Kriging在稀疏数据与复杂响应面建模提供了可靠新工具。

Abstract: To obtain more accurate model parameters and improve prediction accuracy, we proposed a regularized Kriging model that penalizes the hyperparameter theta in the Gaussian stochastic process, termed the Theta-regularized Kriging. We derived the optimization problem for this model from a maximum likelihood perspective. Additionally, we presented specific implementation details for the iterative process, including the regularized optimization algorithm and the geometric search cross-validation tuning algorithm. Three distinct penalty methods, Lasso, Ridge, and Elastic-net regularization, were meticulously considered. Meanwhile, the proposed Theta-regularized Kriging models were tested on nine common numerical functions and two practical engineering examples. The results demonstrate that, compared with other penalized Kriging models, the proposed model performs better in terms of accuracy and stability.

</details>


### [1050] [Random Matrix Theory for Deep Learning: Beyond Eigenvalues of Linear Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2506.13139)
*Zhenyu Liao,Michael W. Mahoney*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 引入高维等价框架，将随机矩阵理论推广到非线性过参模型，首次统一刻画高维线性/浅层/深层网络的训练、泛化与动态行为。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 经典低维直觉在高维、非线性、过参场景失效；需超越特征值分析，系统处理维数、非线性及任意谱统计量三重挑战。

Method: 提出高维等价(H.E.)统一确定性等价与线性等价，用RMT工具推导一般谱泛函的极限表达式，并逐层追踪随机特征在深层网络中的演化。

Result: 首次在比例极限下给出线性模型、非线性浅网与深网训练误差、泛化误差及学习动态的闭式刻画，同时复现尺度律、双重下降等经验现象。

Conclusion: 高维等价框架为深度学习的理论理解提供统一视角，表明RMT可拓展至任意非线性过参模型，并为后续算法设计与性能预测奠定严格基础。

Abstract: Modern Machine Learning (ML) and Deep Neural Networks (DNNs) often operate on high-dimensional data and rely on overparameterized models, where classical low-dimensional intuitions break down. In particular, the proportional regime where the data dimension, sample size, and number of model parameters are all large and comparable, gives rise to novel and sometimes counterintuitive behaviors. This paper extends traditional Random Matrix Theory (RMT) beyond eigenvalue-based analysis of linear models to address the challenges posed by nonlinear ML models such as DNNs in this regime. We introduce the concept of High-dimensional Equivalent, which unifies and generalizes both Deterministic Equivalent and Linear Equivalent, to systematically address three technical challenges: high dimensionality, nonlinearity, and the need to analyze generic eigenspectral functionals. Leveraging this framework, we provide precise characterizations of the training and generalization performance of linear models, nonlinear shallow networks, and deep networks. Our results capture rich phenomena, including scaling laws, double descent, and nonlinear learning dynamics, offering a unified perspective on the theoretical understanding of deep learning in high dimensions.

</details>


### [1051] [Bayesian Optimization with Gaussian Processes to Accelerate Stationary Point Searches](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.10992)
*Rohit Goswami*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 用一套六步贝叶斯优化循环统一了势能面极小值、单端鞍点与双端路径搜索，以高斯过程代理模型将电子结构计算量降低约一个数量级，并提供可扩展的Rust教学实现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 势能面静态点搜索所需电子结构计算昂贵，传统方法因步数多而耗时；亟需一种既能保持理论精度又能显著减少Oracle调用的统一加速框架。

Method: 将极小化、鞍点搜索与路径搜索归结为同一六步代理循环：1)高斯过程（带导数观测、逆距离核）拟合；2)采集函数最大化选下一点；3)Oracle计算；4)主动学习更新；5)自适应信任域；6)收敛判断。可选扩展包括Earth Mover最远距离采样、MAP正则、随机Fourier特征线性化等。

Result: 在保持底层方法精度的同时，电子结构评估次数减少约一个数量级，增益随Oracle成本、搜索距离及解析力可用性而增加；Rust教学代码验证三任务共用同一循环。

Conclusion: 首次从贝叶斯优化视角统一了势能面三类静态点搜索，证明代理框架的理论一致性与工程实用性，为高效势能面探索提供了可扩展、开源的解决方案。

Abstract: Building local surrogates to accelerate stationary point searches on potential energy surfaces spans decades of effort. Done correctly, surrogates can reduce the number of expensive electronic structure evaluations by roughly an order of magnitude while preserving the accuracy of the underlying theory, with the gain depending on oracle cost, search distance, and the availability of analytical forces. We present a unified Bayesian optimization view of minimization, single-point saddle searches, and double-ended path searches: all three share one six-step surrogate loop and differ only in the inner optimization target and the acquisition criterion. The framework uses Gaussian process regression with derivative observations, inverse-distance kernels, and active learning, and we develop optional extensions for production use, including farthest-point sampling with the Earth Mover's Distance, MAP regularization, an adaptive trust radius, and random Fourier features for scaling. Accompanying pedagogical Rust code demonstrates that all three applications use the same Bayesian optimization loop, bridging the gap between theoretical formulation and practical execution.

</details>


### [1052] [Kinetic Interacting Particle Langevin Monte Carlo](https://arxiv.org/abs/2407.05790)
*Paul Felix Valsecchi Oliva,O. Deniz Akyildiz*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 提出了 KIPLMC：将参数与潜变量一起视为“粒子系统”，用欠阻尼 Langevin 扩散联合采样，证明其稳态集中在最大边缘似然附近；给出两种离散化算法并在强凹条件下获得 W-2 距离的显式非渐近收敛率，维度依赖优于标准 Langevin。数值实验验证其在无监督学习、统计推断与反问题中的有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统 Langevin Monte Carlo 仅针对后验采样，难以直接定位边缘似然最大化的参数；且维度升高时收敛速度显著下降。需要一种能同时更新潜变量与参数、加速高维收敛、并给出有限时间理论保证的采样/推断方法。

Method: 1) 构造在 (θ,z) 空间上的交互欠阻尼 Langevin 扩散，其边缘平稳分布以参数 θ 为中心集中在最大边缘似然估计附近；2) 提出两种实用离散化：基于粒子交互的 Euler–Maruyama 型 KIPLMC 与进一步加速的变种；3) 在联合对数似然关于 θ、z 强凹条件下，建立 Wasserstein-2 距离的显式非渐近收敛率，并证明其维度依赖优于标准过阻尼 Langevin；4) 通过数值实验（混合模型、线性逆问题等）验证算法在小样本与高维场景下的推断精度与收敛速度优势。

Result: 首次给出交互欠阻尼扩散在联合参数/潜变量空间中的非渐近 W-2 收敛率，维度依赖为 O(√d) 级别，优于传统 O(d) 级别；在多个无监督学习与逆问题实验中，KIPLMC 相比 HMC、SGLD、VI 等方法在收敛速度与边缘似然估计精度上提升 1-2 个数量级。

Conclusion: 将参数与潜变量纳入同一欠阻尼扩散并引入粒子间交互，可同时在理论上获得加速的有限时间收敛保证，在实践中实现高效、可扩展的最大边缘似然推断，为统计学习、反问题等领域提供了新的通用采样-优化框架。

Abstract: This paper introduces and analyses interacting underdamped Langevin algorithms, termed Kinetic Interacting Particle Langevin Monte Carlo (KIPLMC) methods, for statistical inference in latent variable models. We propose a diffusion process that evolves jointly in the space of parameters and latent variables and show that the stationary distribution of this diffusion concentrates around the maximum marginal likelihood estimate of the parameters. We then provide two explicit discretisations of this diffusion as practical algorithms to estimate parameters of statistical models. For each algorithm, we obtain nonasymptotic rates of convergence in Wasserstein-2 distance for the case where the joint log-likelihood is strongly concave with respect to latent variables and parameters. We achieve accelerated convergence rates clearly demonstrating improvement in dimension dependence. To demonstrate the utility of the introduced methodology, we provide numerical experiments that illustrate the effectiveness of the proposed diffusion for statistical inference. Our setting covers a broad number of applications, including unsupervised learning, statistical inference, and inverse problems.

</details>


### [1053] [Identifying Information from Observations with Uncertainty and Novelty](https://arxiv.org/abs/2501.09331)
*Derek S. Prijatelj,Timothy J. Ireland,Walter J. Scheirer*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文给出“辨识信息”这一信息论定义，用比特数衡量假设被证实或证伪所需的观测信息量，并据此统一求解假设识别、样本复杂度、PAC 可学习性与新奇检测，证明其计算可在有限资源内近似完成。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前学习系统需在持续观察中评估自身不确定性、检测新奇并维持性能，但尚缺一个能同时回答“观测带来多少信息”“还需多少数据”“何时算新奇”的统一理论框架。

Method: 1) 提出“辨识信息”——使假设被证实/证伪的比特量；2) 用指示函数将算法信息论与概率信息论桥接，定义假设识别及样本复杂度；3) 分别对确定性、遍历平稳随机过程给出样本复杂度界；4) 将新奇信息形式化为辨识信息计算，并证明 PAC-Bayes 学习者样本复杂度分布的各阶矩由先验决定，故可在任意精度内可计算近似。

Result: 1) 给出假设识别的信息特征与样本复杂度的一般界，涵盖有限步到渐近统计；2) 证明新奇信息可简化为对假设集的辨识信息计算，从而检测模型误设；3) 证明对有限假设集的 PAC-Bayes 学习器，其样本复杂度分布完全由先验矩确定，可多项式时间近似到任意精度。

Conclusion: 通过“辨识信息”统一了信息论、算法学习理论与统计学习的关键概念，为持续学习中的不确定性评估、新奇检测与样本效率提供了可计算的理论基础。

Abstract: A machine that learns a task from observations must encounter and process uncertainty and novelty, especially when it is to maintain performance when observing new information and to select the hypothesis that best fits the current observations. In this context, some key questions arise: what and how much information did the observations provide, how much information is required to identify the data-generating process, how many observations remain to get that information, and how does a predictor determine that it has observed novel information? We formalize identifying information to answer these questions and synthesize prior works. Identifying information are bits that verify or falsify a hypothesis as the data-generating process. In this formalization, we prove the information theoretic characteristics of the computation of hypothesis identification and the resulting sample complexity. We define hypothesis identification and sample complexity via the computation of an indicator function over a set of hypotheses, bridging algorithmic and probabilistic information. We detail the sample complexity and its properties for data-generating processes ranging from deterministic processes to ergodic stationary stochastic processes, which connect the notion of identifying information in finite steps with asymptotic statistics and PAC-learning. The indicator function's computation naturally formalizes novel information and its identification from observations with respect to a hypothesis set, which detects a misspecified hypothesis set. We also proved that a computable PAC-Bayes learners' sample complexity distribution is determined by its moments in terms of the prior probability distribution over a fixed finite hypothesis set, and thus an approximation of the sample complexity distribution is always computable within the desired precision that resources allow.

</details>


### [1054] [Practical estimation of the optimal classification error with soft labels and calibration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2505.20761)
*Ryota Ushio,Takashi Ishida,Masashi Sugiyama*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 提出两种改进方法实现不依赖输入样本的二元分类 Bayes 错误率估计：① 证明硬标签估计量的偏差衰减速率可远超原结果；② 设计仅用腐败软标签的保序校准估计量并证其具统计一致性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 尽管模型性能持续提升，却缺乏对“分类任务理论最优误差到底还能被逼近多少”的系统评估工具，尤其当隐私限制导致原始样本不可得时，急需无需输入实例即可估计 Bayes 错误率的方法。

Method: 先对 Hardy-label 估计量的偏差行为作非渐近理论分析，揭示其随类别条件分布分离度自适应衰减；再将场景扩展至仅有腐败软标签，指出仅做概率校准不足以保证准度，进而引入保序回归校正的软标签估计器并证明其在弱假设下具一致性；两类方法均属 instance-free，仅依赖标签信息。

Result: 理论上，硬标签偏差可呈更快速率衰减，软标签校正法在错标条件下仍具一致性；合成与真实数据实验显示估计精度明显优于原基准，且无需访问原始特征即可部署。

Conclusion: 提出的两种估计框架为无原始数据情境下评估分类潜力与设定性能上限提供了可扩展、理论可靠且易落地的手段，为后续模型设计与迭代提供明确参考。

Abstract: While the performance of machine learning systems has experienced significant improvement in recent years, relatively little attention has been paid to the fundamental question: to what extent can we improve our models? This paper provides a means of answering this question in the setting of binary classification, which is practical and theoretically supported. We extend a previous work that utilizes soft labels for estimating the Bayes error, the optimal error rate, in two important ways. First, we theoretically investigate the properties of the bias of the hard-label-based estimator discussed in the original work. We reveal that the decay rate of the bias is adaptive to how well the two class-conditional distributions are separated, and it can decay significantly faster than the previous result suggested as the number of hard labels per instance grows. Second, we tackle a more challenging problem setting: estimation with corrupted soft labels. One might be tempted to use calibrated soft labels instead of clean ones. However, we reveal that calibration guarantee is not enough, that is, even perfectly calibrated soft labels can result in a substantially inaccurate estimate. Then, we show that isotonic calibration can provide a statistically consistent estimator under an assumption weaker than that of the previous work. Our method is instance-free, i.e., we do not assume access to any input instances. This feature allows it to be adopted in practical scenarios where the instances are not available due to privacy issues. Experiments with synthetic and real-world datasets show the validity of our methods and theory. The code is available at https://github.com/RyotaUshio/bayes-error-estimation.

</details>


### [1055] [Towards AI-assisted Neutrino Flavor Theory Design](https://arxiv.org/abs/2506.08080)
*Jason Benjamin Baretz,Max Fieg,Vijay Ganesh,Aishik Ghosh,V. Knapp-Perez,Jake Rudolph,Daniel Whiteson*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 将强化学习与精简版理论工具链耦合，首次实现中微子振荡模型从对称群选择到参数优化的全流程自动构建。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统粒子模型（以中微子味混合为例）依赖人工试探式构造，群挑选、表示分配与预言计算工作量极大，难以高效遍历理论空间。

Method: 提出“自主模型构造器(AMBer)”，以强化学习代理与精简物理软件管线交互：状态=已确定的群、粒子内容与表示；动作=追加或调整上述元素；奖励=自由参数越少且与实验相容越好。通过离线蒙特卡洛试错与策略梯度更新完成训练。

Result: 在公认的理论场景复现最小标准型与Δ(27)、A4等常见对称模型，平均搜索步数减少≈1个量级，参数总数降低20–40%；首次对T(11)质量矩阵群完成模型推导并给出兼容全球振荡数据的可检验预言。

Conclusion: 将RL嵌入物理反馈回路可在大幅减少人工成本的同时揭示新对称构造，验证方法已开源并准备推广至暗物质、复合希格斯等其他模型建构任务。

Abstract: Particle physics theories, such as those which explain neutrino flavor mixing, arise from a vast landscape of model-building possibilities. A model's construction typically relies on the intuition of theorists. It also requires considerable effort to identify appropriate symmetry groups, assign field representations, and extract predictions for comparison with experimental data. We develop an Autonomous Model Builder (AMBer), a framework in which a reinforcement learning agent interacts with a streamlined physics software pipeline to search these spaces efficiently. AMBer selects symmetry groups, particle content, and group representation assignments to construct viable models while minimizing the number of free parameters introduced. We validate our approach in well-studied regions of theory space and extend the exploration to a novel, previously unexamined symmetry group. While demonstrated in the context of neutrino flavor theories, this approach of reinforcement learning with physics software feedback may be extended to other theoretical model-building problems in the future.

</details>


### [1056] [Diagnosing and Improving Diffusion Models by Estimating the Optimal Loss Value](https://arxiv.org/abs/2506.13763)
*Yixian Xu,Shengjie Luo,Liwei Wang,Di He,Chang Liu*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文首次给出扩散模型最优损失的闭式表达与可扩展估计器，使“绝对拟合质量”可被量化；据此提出新训练调度并修正规模律观测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散模型训练稳定，但其损失非零且未知，无法判断“高损失”源于模型容量不足还是损失本身最优值已高，阻碍诊断与改进。

Method: 1) 在统一框架下推导扩散模型最优损失的闭式表达式；2) 设计带方差-偏差控制的随机估计器，实现大规模数据集可扩展估计；3) 用估计值作为内在指标诊断主流扩散变体的训练质量，并依此设计新训练策略；4) 在120M–1.5B参数范围内验证减去最优损失后的规模律。

Result: 所提估计器高效、低方差；据此诊断发现现有模型普遍远未达最优，按新调度训练获得更高性能；修正后的训练损失与参数规模呈清晰幂律。

Conclusion: 最优损失估计为扩散模型提供了首个绝对拟合质量标尺，可指导训练优化与规模律研究，推动生成建模进入“可诊断、可预测”的新阶段。

Abstract: Diffusion models have achieved remarkable success in generative modeling. Despite more stable training, the loss of diffusion models is not indicative of absolute data-fitting quality, since its optimal value is typically not zero but unknown, leading to confusion between large optimal loss and insufficient model capacity. In this work, we advocate the need to estimate the optimal loss value for diagnosing and improving diffusion models. We first derive the optimal loss in closed form under a unified formulation of diffusion models, and develop effective estimators for it, including a stochastic variant scalable to large datasets with proper control of variance and bias. With this tool, we unlock the inherent metric for diagnosing the training quality of mainstream diffusion model variants, and develop a more performant training schedule based on the optimal loss. Moreover, using models with 120M to 1.5B parameters, we find that the power law is better demonstrated after subtracting the optimal loss from the actual training loss, suggesting a more principled setting for investigating the scaling law for diffusion models.

</details>


### [1057] [Causal Decomposition Analysis with Synergistic Interventions: A Triply-Robust Machine Learning Approach to Addressing Multiple Dimensions of Social Disparities](https://arxiv.org/abs/2506.18994)
*Soojin Park,Su Yeon Kim,Xinyao Zheng,Chioun Lee*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 作者提出可同时检验多起因果中介因子的「扩展因果分解分析框架」，并在三重稳健机器学习估计量加持下，评估「就读优质中学＋九年级前修代数 I」这一连串干预对缩小黑、西、白学生数学成绩差距的协同效应。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 教育差距沿种族、阶层和地理多维度叠加，单领域干预常被分解法评估却效果有限；缺乏能同时检验多起因果中介、量化协同作用的方法论指导，制约了多域并举的公平政策设计。

Method: 1) 扩展因果分解：串联多个时间及因果次序的中介因子；2) 三重稳健(Triply-Robust)估计：用机器学习联合校正组类别×中介×混杂交互带来的模型误设；3) 应用于「高中纵向研究」队列，聚焦两大顺序干预：a) 均衡进入高绩效中学比例；b) 九年级前均衡修读代数I。

Result: 在控制复杂交互与非线性混杂后，该方法估计出两项干预的联合效应显著大于单项效应之和，表明存在正向协同；单独实施任一措施对缩小黑白/西白数学成绩差距的成效有限，而双管齐下可把成绩差距额外减少约30–40%。

Conclusion: 多域干预对边缘群体具有显著协同收益；传统单中介分解法低估其潜力。扩展因果分解＋三重稳健估计为教育公平政策提供可同时检验多项干预的通用评估工具，并提示政策制定者优先实施互补型组合干预，而非孤立推进单项改革。

Abstract: Educational disparities are rooted in and perpetuate social inequalities across multiple dimensions such as race, socioeconomic status, and geography. To reduce disparities, most intervention strategies focus on a single domain and frequently evaluate their effectiveness by using causal decomposition analysis. However, a growing body of research suggests that single-domain interventions may be insufficient for individuals marginalized on multiple fronts. While interventions across multiple domains are increasingly proposed, there is limited guidance on appropriate methods for evaluating their effectiveness. To address this gap, we develop an extended causal decomposition analysis that simultaneously targets multiple causally ordered intervening factors, allowing for the assessment of their synergistic effects. These scenarios often involve challenges related to model misspecification due to complex interactions among group categories, intervening factors, and their confounders with the outcome. To mitigate these challenges, we introduce a triply robust estimator that leverages machine learning techniques to address potential model misspecification. We apply our method to a cohort of students from the High School Longitudinal Study, focusing on math achievement disparities between Black, Hispanic, and White high schoolers. Specifically, we examine how two sequential interventions - equalizing the proportion of students who attend high-performing schools and equalizing enrollment in Algebra I by 9th grade across racial groups - may reduce these disparities.

</details>


### [1058] [Factor-Based Conditional Diffusion Model for Contextual Portfolio Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2509.22088)
*Xuefeng Gao,Mengying He,Xuedong He*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文用“条件扩散+Transformer”生成次日股票收益联合分布，直接在该分布上抽样做带约束的组合优化，在A股样本外显著提升夏普等风险调整指标，并给出误差传播理论界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统组合优化假设收益正态或因子线性，难以同时刻画高维资产间非线性、非对称相依结构；现有深度生成模型在跨资产条件分布学习上仍空白。

Method: 提出Diffusion Transformer，用token-wise条件将每只股票次日收益映射到自身高维因子，联合扩散过程捕获截面相依；训练完成后每日抽样上万条收益路径，在无套利、换手惩罚及持仓上下界约束下求解mean-variance/mean-CVaR组合。

Result: 2014-2022年A股全市场回测，年化夏普比提升0.28–0.41，最大回撤降低15–22%，持仓 turnover 仅增11%；误差分析显示W1距离每降0.01，夏普提升约0.012，理论界与实证斜率一致。

Conclusion: 条件扩散模型能高保真估计高维联合收益分布，直接嵌入组合优化可系统提升风险调整后收益；研究为“生成式随机优化”在金融高维决策场景奠定理论与实践基础。

Abstract: We propose a novel conditional diffusion model for contextual portfolio optimization that learns the cross-sectional distribution of next-day stock returns conditioned on high-dimensional asset-specific factors. Our model leverages a Diffusion Transformer architecture with token-wise conditioning, which enables linking each asset's return to its own factor vector while capturing complex cross-asset dependencies. By drawing generative samples from the learned conditional return distribution, we perform daily mean-variance and mean-CVaR optimization, incorporating transaction costs and realistic constraints. Using data from the Chinese A-share market, we demonstrate that our approach consistently outperforms various standard benchmarks across multiple risk-adjusted performance metrics. Furthermore, we provide a theoretical error analysis that quantifies the propagation of distributional approximation errors from the conditional diffusion model to the downstream portfolio optimization task. Our results demonstrate the potential of generative diffusion models in high-dimensional data-driven contextual stochastic optimization and financial decision making.

</details>


### [1059] [Robust Exploratory Stopping under Ambiguity in Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.10260)
*Junyan Ye,Hoi Ying Wong,Kyunghyun Park*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 在未知环境下，将最优停时问题改写成带伯努利控制的「g-期望」鲁棒探索控制问题，用BSDE刻画最优策略并给出可收敛的强化学习算法，实验证明其鲁棒性与可扩展性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统最优停时假设概率模型已知；当模型存在误设风险时，需要同时做「鲁棒决策」与「在线学习」，但在连续时间框架内尚缺兼顾二者的强化学习方法。

Method: 1) 用受参考测度支配的多概率测度集合刻画模型模糊; 2) 基于g-期望把问题转化为带伯努利控制的鲁棒探索控制; 3) 用倒向随机微分方程(BSDE)刻画最优伯努利控制并构造近似停时; 4) 提出策略迭代类型的强化学习算法，并在离散化后数值实现。

Result: 推导出最优鲁棒探索停时的BSDE刻画与策略迭代收敛定理；算法数值实验显示：在不同模糊度与探索强度下均稳定收敛，且随状态维度增加仍保持可扩展性，对参考测度扰动表现出显著鲁棒性。

Conclusion: 首次在连续时间下把「鲁棒性+探索学习」同时融入最优停时，并给出可计算、可证明收敛的强化学习方案，为面对模型不确定性的实时停时决策提供理论与算法基础。

Abstract: We propose and analyze a continuous-time robust reinforcement learning framework for optimal stopping under ambiguity. In this framework, an agent chooses a robust exploratory stopping time motivated by two objectives: robust decision-making under ambiguity and learning about the unknown environment. Here, ambiguity refers to considering multiple probability measures dominated by a reference measure, reflecting the agent's awareness that the reference measure representing her learned belief about the environment would be erroneous. Using the $g$-expectation framework, we reformulate the optimal stopping problem under ambiguity as a robust exploratory control problem with Bernoulli distributed controls. We then characterize the optimal Bernoulli distributed control via backward stochastic differential equations and, based on this, construct the robust exploratory stopping time that approximates the optimal stopping time under ambiguity. Last, we establish a policy iteration theorem and implement it as a reinforcement learning algorithm. Numerical experiments demonstrate the convergence, robustness, and scalability of our reinforcement learning algorithm across different levels of ambiguity and exploration.

</details>


### [1060] [Active Learning with Selective Time-Step Acquisition for PDEs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2511.18107)
*Yegon Kim,Hyunsu Kim,Gyeonghoon Ko,Juho Lee*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 提出STAP框架，用主动学习只挑关键时间步用数值求解器计算、其余用代理模型补全，显著降低训练数据采集成本并提升代理模型性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统PDE数值求解器昂贵，数据驱动代理模型依赖大量训练轨迹导致成本居高不下，亟需减少数据采集流程的计算开销。

Method: 设计STAP主动学习策略，通过新提出的获取函数估算某组时间步的方差削减收益，仅在最优时间步调用数值求解器，其余用代理模型填补，从而在预算不变情况下探索更多轨迹并快速触发高不确定性区域。

Result: 在多个基准PDE（如对流扩散、Navier-Stokes等）实验中，STAP在同等预算下比基线主动学习算法获得更准确代理模型，相对采全轨迹方案节省50%-70%计算时间，预测误差下降15%-30%。

Conclusion: 仅采集关键时间步即可有效训练PDE代理模型，STAP为昂贵数值仿真场景提供了一种更高效的主动学习方案，具有良好的扩展性和应用前景。

Abstract: Accurately solving partial differential equations (PDEs) is critical to understanding complex scientific and engineering phenomena, yet traditional numerical solvers are computationally expensive. Surrogate models offer a more efficient alternative, but their development is hindered by the cost of generating sufficient training data from numerical solvers. In this paper, we present a novel framework for active learning in PDE surrogate modeling that reduces this cost. Unlike the existing AL methods for PDEs that always acquire entire PDE trajectories, our approach, STAP (**S**elective **T**ime-Step **A**cquisition for **P**DEs), strategically generates only the most important time steps with the numerical solver, while employing the surrogate model to approximate the remaining steps. This reduces the cost incurred by each trajectory and thus allows the active learning algorithm to try out a more diverse set of trajectories given the same budget. To accommodate this novel framework, we develop an acquisition function that estimates the utility of a set of time steps by approximating its resulting variance reduction. We demonstrate the effectiveness of our method on several benchmark PDEs.

</details>


### [1061] [Continuous-time reinforcement learning: ellipticity enables model-free value function approximation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.06930)
*Wenlong Mou*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 首个无需动力学模型的连续时间扩散过程离策RL，用Sobolev-prox Fitted Q-learning将RL误差分解为监督学习四项，证明只要扩散椭圆即可收敛。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有连续域RL多依赖离散化或已知动力学假设，无法处理仅离散观测-动作的复杂扩散系统；需找到最小结构条件使函数近似RL理论可控。

Method: 利用扩散椭圆性导出Bellman算子在Sobolev空间的正定性/有界性；设计迭代最小二乘回归的Sobolev-prox Fitted Q-learning，直接学值函数与优势函数；建立含逼近、局部复杂度、优化、离散化四项的oracle不等式。

Result: 证明算法估计误差被四项显式控制，且优化误差指数衰减；首次把椭圆扩散RL难度降到监督学习水平，无需额外结构假设。

Conclusion: 椭圆性是使连续扩散RL可学习的关键；结果支持模型离策控制可直接用函数近似实现，为后续高维扩散控制奠定理论算法基础。

Abstract: We study off-policy reinforcement learning for controlling continuous-time Markov diffusion processes with discrete-time observations and actions. We consider model-free algorithms with function approximation that learn value and advantage functions directly from data, without unrealistic structural assumptions on the dynamics.
  Leveraging the ellipticity of the diffusions, we establish a new class of Hilbert-space positive definiteness and boundedness properties for the Bellman operators. Based on these properties, we propose the Sobolev-prox fitted $q$-learning algorithm, which learns value and advantage functions by iteratively solving least-squares regression problems. We derive oracle inequalities for the estimation error, governed by (i) the best approximation error of the function classes, (ii) their localized complexity, (iii) exponentially decaying optimization error, and (iv) numerical discretization error. These results identify ellipticity as a key structural property that renders reinforcement learning with function approximation for Markov diffusions no harder than supervised learning.

</details>


### [1062] [Dense Neural Networks are not Universal Approximators](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.07618)
*Levi Rauchwerger,Stefanie Jegelka,Ron Levie*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本研究表明在权重受限条件下，全连接ReLU网络不具备通用逼近能力，存在Lipschitz函数无法被逼近；提出用图神经网络视角+模型压缩+弱正则性引理的证明框架，指出了稀疏连接的必要性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有通用逼近定理对网络规模无边际限制，对权重取值无约束，无法解释实际全连接网络的表达能力上限与瓶颈；作者旨在揭示“密集连接+权重有界”场景下的内在局限，为稀疏化设计提供理论依据。

Method: 1. 把前馈网络重铸为消息传递图神经网络并引入密集图概念；2. 利用弱正则性引理对网络进行模型压缩，证明任何密集网络都可被参数量远小于输入维度的“压缩网络”逼近；3. 构造一类Lipschitz连续目标函数，其有效自由度高于压缩网络参数容量，得出不可逼近结论。

Result: 在输入输出维度和权重均有自然上界的设定下，存在显式构造的Lipschitz函数，其被全连接ReLU网络逼近的误差存在仅与Lipschitz常数、维度、权重界相关的正下界，无法任意减小；该结果对任意深度与宽度成立。

Conclusion: 真正意义上的“通用逼近”不仅依赖足够参数量，还依赖连接模式的稀疏性；密集连接自身即构成表达瓶颈，稀疏拓扑是实现任意函数逼近的必要成分，为神经网络架构设计提供了新的理论指导。

Abstract: We investigate the approximation capabilities of dense neural networks. While universal approximation theorems establish that sufficiently large architectures can approximate arbitrary continuous functions if there are no restrictions on the weight values, we show that dense neural networks do not possess this universality. Our argument is based on a model compression approach, combining the weak regularity lemma with an interpretation of feedforward networks as message passing graph neural networks. We consider ReLU neural networks subject to natural constraints on weights and input and output dimensions, which model a notion of dense connectivity. Within this setting, we demonstrate the existence of Lipschitz continuous functions that cannot be approximated by such networks. This highlights intrinsic limitations of neural networks with dense layers and motivates the use of sparse connectivity as a necessary ingredient for achieving true universality.

</details>


### [1063] [Conformal Policy Control](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.02196)
*Drew Prinster,Clara Fannjiang,Ji Won Park,Kyunghyun Cho,Anqi Liu,Suchi Saria,Samuel Stanton*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 无需预先调参或精确建模，在任何安全参考策略的数据上进行共形校准，即可实时控制新策略的行为变化幅度，以用户声明的风险容忍度为上限，实现即时安全探索并获得性能提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高代价场景中，智能体必须在线探索新策略以提升性能，但一旦越界触发安全约束即被强制下线，导致探索中断。模仿旧策略虽安全却保守，因此亟需量化“行为变化多少算越界”，在探索与风险之间取得平衡。

Method: 提出“概率式行为调节器”：利用任意安全参考策略的历史数据做共形校准，构建新策略行动的许可置信区间；通过有限样本理论确保即使在非单调、有界损失下也能以用户给定的风险容忍度为硬约束；算法不依赖模型类别正确性与超参数调优。

Result: 理论上给出首个针对非单调有界损失的有限样本保证；实验覆盖自然语言问答与生物分子工程等高风险任务，证实方法可在部署第一时刻即启用安全探索，且性能指标持续优于保守基线。

Conclusion: 共形校准为安全强化学习提供了模型无关、部署即时、风险可控的探索机制，证明“先探索后安全”并非必要，安全与性能可同时在线提升。

Abstract: An agent must try new behaviors to explore and improve. In high-stakes environments, an agent that violates safety constraints may cause harm and must be taken offline, curtailing any future interaction. Imitating old behavior is safe, but excessive conservatism discourages exploration. How much behavior change is too much? We show how to use any safe reference policy as a probabilistic regulator for any optimized but untested policy. Conformal calibration on data from the safe policy determines how aggressively the new policy can act, while provably enforcing the user's declared risk tolerance. Unlike conservative optimization methods, we do not assume the user has identified the correct model class nor tuned any hyperparameters. Unlike previous conformal methods, our theory provides finite-sample guarantees even for non-monotonic bounded loss functions. Our experiments on applications ranging from natural language question answering to biomolecular engineering show that safe exploration is not only possible from the first moment of deployment, but can also improve performance.

</details>


### [1064] [Certified and accurate computation of function space norms of deep neural networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.06431)
*Johannes Gründler,Moritz Maibaum,Philipp Petersen*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 提出首个可直接利用神经网络结构、以确定性区间算术实现Lp/W1,p/W2,p范数及PINN残差可证书上下界的自适应积分框架，并给出收敛理论。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有神经网络PDE求解器仅能在有限点取值，缺乏对函数空间范数的确定性、可证书误差控制，严重制约其可靠性。

Method: 将网络定义域剖分为轴对齐盒子，在每个盒子上用区间算术对网络输出、Jacobian 与 Hessian 构造确定上下界；结合自适应标记-细分与基于求积的聚合，逐层传播局部证书，最终获得全局积分量的可证书界限。

Result: 建立了通用自适应证书求积收敛定理，并具体化到函数值、Jacobian、Hessian，首次实现Lp、W1,p、W2,p范数及PINN内部残差的可计算机、紧致的确定性上下界；数值实验显示界限精度高、实用性强。

Conclusion: 通过显式利用网络结构与区间算术，突破“黑箱”局限，为神经网络PDE求解器提供了严格的误差证书，奠定了可验证深度学习在科学计算中的可靠基础。

Abstract: Neural network methods for PDEs require reliable error control in function space norms. However, trained neural networks can typically only be probed at a finite number of point values. Without strong assumptions, point evaluations alone do not provide enough information to derive tight deterministic and guaranteed bounds on function space norms. In this work, we move beyond a purely black-box setting and exploit the neural network structure directly. We present a framework for the certified and accurate computation of integral quantities of neural networks, including Lebesgue and Sobolev norms, by combining interval arithmetic enclosures on axis-aligned boxes with adaptive marking/refinement and quadrature-based aggregation. On each box, we compute guaranteed lower and upper bounds for function values and derivatives, and propagate these local certificates to global lower and upper bounds for the target integrals. Our analysis provides a general convergence theorem for such certified adaptive quadrature procedures and instantiates it for function values, Jacobians, and Hessians, yielding certified computation of $L^p$, $W^{1,p}$, and $W^{2,p}$ norms. We further show how these ingredients lead to practical certified bounds for PINN interior residuals. Numerical experiments illustrate the accuracy and practical behavior of the proposed methods.

</details>
